description: The true story of Edward Gein, a farmer responsible for horrific crimes. Raised with a strict upbringing imposed by an overbearing mother, Gein was arrested in 1957, uncovering the most heinous series of murders America has ever known.

title: 71 Fragmente einer chronologie des Zufalls
actors: Gabriel Cosmin Urdes, Lukas Miko, Otto Grünmandl, Anne Bennent

title: True Blue
actors: Tom Berenger, Lori Heuring, Pamela Gidley, Barry Newman
description: The discovery of a severed hand throws the city into panic, but investigator Rembrandt Macy manages to reconstruct the identity of the victim. Trying to shed light on the murder, Macy makes contact with Nikki, a friend of the murdered woman, who is convinced she is in danger and seeks protection. Gradually the detective falls in love with her. The investigations are becoming more and more complicated: in the victim's past there are ambiguous acquaintances in the political environment. Furthermore, Macy discovers the involvement of a gang of Asian drug dealers. But the Chinatown track is perhaps not the right one ..
notes: A botched and predictable thriller, which relies without too much luck on the monolithic Berenger.

title: L'autre
actors: Nabila Ebeid, Mahmoud Hemida, Hanan Tork, Hani Salama
description: Hanane is a young woman of humble origins who tries to make her way in journalism. When he meets Adam, scion of the ruling and corrupt class, he is love at first sight: the two soon get married, but his mother - who has an exclusive affection for her son - immediately considers Hanane as a rival and tries to get rid of her. going so far as to ally with Fatih, the girl's terrorist brother ...
notes: In a comedy plot, Chahine engages social reflections, "slapstick" humor, musical numbers and surreal situations. The mixture, always one step away from the superficial "divertissement", miraculously does not lose its balance.

title: Minoes
actors: Carice van Houten, Theo Maassen, Sarah Bannier, Hans Kesting
description: A cat, while maintaining some feline characteristics, takes the form of Minouche. The girl, taking advantage of her talents, will help the journalist Tibbe to score a scoop. Will he be able to unmask a well-known character, who plots in the shadows against the well-being of his fellow citizens ...
notes: Bland Dutch production.

title: Messo comunale praticamente spione
actors: Laura Gemser, Aldo Ralli, Aldo Sambrell, Nino Terzo, Gabriele Tinti
description: Folding in Bolsena in the middle of the election campaign, the new - and very procure - doctor conducted Selenia Anselmi is immediately located at the center of the general interest, between candidates of opposite factions (and related relatives), hallucassed councilors and jealous wives .. .
notes: Eroticism "Alla Paesana" of almost disheartening triviality.

title: Secret Santa
actors: Jessica Anne Bogart, Jennie Garth, Charles Robinson, Barbara Billingsly
description: Ebecca, a journalist who is entrusted with only insipid news items in the town of Hamden, receives yet another task in spite of herself: to find a mysterious Santa Claus who sends anonymous gifts to his fellow citizens. His suspicions fall on one of the richest representatives of the village, the lawyer Carter ...

title: Le retour du fils prodigue/Humiliés
actors: Rosalba Curatola, Aldo Fruttuosi, Romano Guelfi, Enrico Achilli, Martina Gionfriddo
description: After Workers, peasants, this diptych tackles again the novel Le donne di Messina by Elio Vittorini (1948-'49). Interested more in the profound substance of a text than in its narrative surface, Straub and Huillet, as always, derive from it a choral and "alienated" reading. Music by Edgar Varèse (Arcana).

title: The Waterdance
actors: Eric Stoltz, Helen Hunt, Wesley Snipes, William Forsythe, Elizabeth Peña
description: Due to a car accident, writer Joel Garcia finds himself in a wheelchair. The months of hospitalization are an opportunity to make friends with his two roommates, also paraplegic: the black Raymond and Bloss, a rude and violent ex-biker. His troubled relationship with Anna, a married woman he is in love with, is compounded by his handicap.
notes: The wheelchair-bound screenwriter and co-director Neal Jimenez (_Days of glory ... days of love_) has told this story with knowledge of the facts. 1992 Sundance Audience Award.

title: The Unexpected Mrs. Pollifax
actors: Angela Lansbury, Thomas Ian Griffith, Ed Bishop, Paul Birchard
description: A provincial woman has recently become a widow and is unsure which direction to take in her life. Her doctor inspires her by telling her it's time to try new things and indulge previous ambitions a month aside. So Emily writes to her representative in parliament asking to become a CIA agent! A series of coincidences causes her to first get an interview and then be confused for a real agent and sent to Morocco before she can even explain the situation. In the African country she is faced with the auction of two nuclear devices stolen from the KGB and is captured together with a real agent. However, he will demonstrate unexpected skills.

title: Le avventure di Pinocchio
actors: Andrea Balestri, Nino Manfredi, Gina Lollobrigida, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia
description: Made by the carpenter Geppetto, the puppet Pinocchio comes to life thanks to a spell of the Blue Fairy, to whom he promises to be a respectful and diligent child. But good intentions are soon forgotten ...
notes: A "short" version of the five-part script of the same name, a great television success of the time. Comencini, with the screenwriter Suso Cecchi d'Amico, makes Pinocchio a hero of freedom, through the idea of ??representing him as a real child, transformed back into a puppet by adults for cruel punishment. Perfect cast and also excellent sets, music and costumes.

title: The Growing Pains Movie
actors: Alan Thicke, Joanna Kerns, Kirk Cameron, Chelsea Noble, Tracey Gold
description: Jason and Maggie reunite the family for their wedding anniversary. During the family reunion we discover that Maggie, an assistant to an arrogant man, has quit after yet another fight with her employer. One of her nephews suggests ways to counter the hated former boss.

title: Il cartaio
actors: Stefania Rocca, Liam Cunningham, Silvio Muccino, Adalberto Maria Merli, Claudio Santamaria, Fiore Argento, Cosimo Fusco, Giovanni Visentin, Luis Molteni, Elisabetta Rocchetti, Vera Gemma, Mia Benedetta, Pier Maria Cecchini, Micaela Pignatelli, Carlo Gabardini, Alessandro Mistichelli, Francesco Guzzo
description: A mysterious assassin challenges the police who hunt him down by signing the Cartaio, given his mania for the game. His challenge consists of a series of video poker games to be played between himself and the police, in the virtual space of the network. Each time, a human life is at stake.
notes: A single convincing and truly Argentine shot (the total of Muccino chasing the woman paid by the maniac along the Tiber), dialogues and jokes to stop one's ears and an ending (more footnote) that one cannot believe in. And the typical elements of a once masterful and unique filmmaker - wind, nature, interior architecture - now smell of stale, and cannot fail to stimulate laughter.

title: Spy Kids 3-D. Game Over
actors: Antonio Banderas, Carla Gugino, Alexa PenaVega, Daryl Sabara, Salma Hayek, Sylvester Stallone
description: One of the most dangerous and difficult missions ever faced awaits the agents of the Cortez family: the confrontation with the "Toymaker" in a video game. The one who seems to make the most of cyber space is grandfather Cortez, who rediscovers his physical vigor in the virtuality of the game. But to win, the real key lies in intelligence and unity. The Cortez are joined by four skilled testers, kids who try the games before they go on sale and know the tricks.
notes: Taking his characters to cyberspace, to the colorful and fast-paced topography of reckless racing, robotic arena matches, lava surfing, fighting, geeks, codes, trials (driving, sports, shooter, fighting, action and adventure), Rodriguez thinks about a more modern and light-hearted _Tron_. It uses - like James Cameron - new video cameras, compensates with a dazzling imagination the technological gaps and dusts off the 3D format, rejected and abandoned for decades, with excellent results. Postmodern cinema forces the viewer to indulge in the amniotic screen. Rodriguez, who is a nostalgic, would like to take objects and characters off the same screen and throw them at the viewer / player.

title: The Last Samurai
actors: Tom Cruise, Ken Watanabe, William Atherton, Chad Lindberg, Billy Connolly
description: The young emperor of Japan entrusts Captain Nathan Algren with the task of educating a new conscript army to join the samurai, the dynasty of warriors who have consecrated their lives to the service of the country. But when the sovereign's advisers attempt to eliminate the samurai to pave the way for a more westernized and therefore more open to trade government, Algren himself finds himself unexpectedly fascinated and influenced by their beliefs, which remind him of the man he once was. ...
notes: Seen from a Western point of view, one understands the fascination exercised by the samurai and therefore some rhetorical licenses are forgiven, certainly closer to Roland Emmerich's _The patriot_, with Mel Gibson, than to the vibrant essentiality of Michael Mann's _The Last of the Mohicans_ , which could also function as a tall model. Instead Zwick, a modest illustrator, chooses the simplest way even in battle sequences, such as the massive and not always necessary use of slow motion: the first entry of the samurai is in slow motion and through an oleographic carousel of lights and mists , with all due respect to Kurosawa. Apart from some nice sequence (the challenge with the bokken between Algren and the child and the clash with the ninja) the best thing is Tom Cruise: considering the intensity with which he faces the part, it is clear that for him that of the soldier- samurai is not a role like any other, and his "physical" passion ends up influencing the entire film.

title: Runaway Jury
actors: John Cusack, Gene Hackman, Dustin Hoffman, Rachel Weisz, Bruce Davison
description: A young widow in New Orleans is suing a powerful business consortium she holds responsible for her husband's death. His lawyer, Wendall Rohr, has a strong moral sense and vehemently opposes the team of defenders, the screen behind which Rankin Fitch hides, an unscrupulous and brilliant "consultant for juries" aware that the verdict depends largely on the composition of the jury.
notes: On the jury, there is young John Cusack: he looks like a spineless, but he has a mission to accomplish, and even a shark like Hackman will struggle to manipulate him. Grisham's novel was an attack on the multinationals of smoking: to avoid duplication with Insider, director Gary Fleder shifts his sights on the arms industry and signs the thriller version of _Bowling a Columbine_. The plot is tight, the moral questions strong, the stellar cast: perhaps the best of the many Grisham-inspired films.

title: In America
actors: Paddy Considine, Samantha Morton, Sarah Bolger, Emma Bolger, Ciaran Cronin, Djimon Hounsou
description: Johnny and Sarah Sullivan, who immigrated to New York from Ireland with two daughters in tow, find lodgings in a chaotic condominium populated by drug addicts, drag queens and an assorted collection of various humanity. Nonetheless, the Sullivans set to work fixing up their apartment. While the parents see America as a succession of challenges and dangers, the daughters see it as a magical place where anything can happen ...
notes: Children look and look at us. Now they use a video camera as does Christy, the narrator, who documents the "American life" of an Irish immigrant family in a poor neighborhood of New York in the 1980s: father, mother and sisters hope to find a serenity that is shattered and torn apart by premature death. of Frankie (the real Frankie, to whom the film is dedicated, was Jim Sheridan's brother). The children go away and empty their rooms and families: they disrupt and spoil their memories, they threaten their future. The story (the screenplay is written by the director together with his two daughters Naomi and Kirsten) of this mélo with a happy ending uses autobiographical episodes, which increases the sentimentality that clings to the images and suffocates several sequences (one of the worst is that of the marital love). Sheridan is so involved in what he stages that he is unable to measure out emotion and sadness. However, Samantha Morton is excellent, who reveals - film after film - the strength of an acting free from dialogue.

title: The Strange Affair
actors: Michael York, Jeremy Kemp, Susan George, Jack Watson, Nigel Davenport
description: Pierce, a sergeant of Scotland Yard, discovers that Inspector Evans in league with Quince, a former colleague of his, is involved in shady deals and complicit in a murder. Not finding the evidence to frame him, he decides to fabricate them by blackmailing his subordinate, Peter.
notes: Gritty and courageous film, but not very original.

title: Carrie
actors: Angela Bettis, Patricia Clarkson, Rena Sofer, Kandyse McClure
description: The very shy student Carrie White is mercilessly targeted by the jokes - often quite cruel - of her classmates. Who, however, are unaware that Carrie is endowed with extraordinary telekinetic faculties, thanks to which she is able to move bodies of any size with the power of thought alone. During the prom, two rather unpleasant young people organize a particularly hateful joke against the girl: this unleashes her anger, and the episode turns into tragedy ...
notes: The character born from the pen of Stephen King and already brought to the screen in 1976 by Brian De Palma returns. Despite the television origin, the product is not to be thrown away.

title: Nabbeun namja
actors: Jo Jae-hyeon, Seo Won, Choi Duek-mun, Kim Yun-tae, Kim Jung-young
description: Han-ki, boss of Seoul's red light district, has an insane passion for Sun-hwa high school student. After attempting an approach and receiving a clear refusal, Han-ki forces the girl to kiss him. Now obsessed with the young woman, he begins to blackmail her with the intention of making her work for him and arrives to keep her prisoner in a room to spy on her. Until Sun-hwa decides to give in and ...
notes: Kim Ki-duk analyzes with the usual cruelty the relationship of victim and executioner that is established between Han-ki and the sweet Sun-hwa. The film features all the themes of the South Korean director's cinema. Presented at the 2002 Berlinale.

title: Il figlioccio del padrino
actors: Franco Franchi, Riccardo Garrone, Saro Urzì, Laura Belli
description: Oronzo, godson of the mafia boss Don Vincenzo, is sent from the USA to Italy, as a guest of Don Salvatore, so that he may lose the habit of hunting for women and become a man of honor. But Oronzo is surrounded by one of Don Salvatore's two daughters.
notes: Commonplaces as if it rained in this farce about the mafia.

title: Biancaneve & Co.
actors: Michela Miti, Oreste Lionello, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Aldo Sambrell
description: A Snow White very well disposed to "certain proposals", a Grimilde queen livid with envy, the inevitable dwarfs and various amenities.
notes: A few (rare) itchy winks drowned in a mess of such a low level as to be disarming, with Lionello in the role of the king and D'Angelo doing the "magic mirror" (sic!).

title: Haha o kowazuya
actors: Den Ohikata, Hideo Mitsui, Mitsuko Yoshikawa, Yumeko Aizome, Yukichi Iwata, Kyôko Mitsukawa
description: The two sons of a widow discover that they are step brothers, which complicates their relationship not a little ...
notes: The known version of Ozu's thirty-first film - still silent - is incomplete: both the prologue (the death of the father in the office) and the epilogue (the final reconciliation with the mother) have been lost.

title: L'uomo mascherato contro i pirati
actors: George Hilton, John Vari, Pietro De Vico, Claude Dantes, José Torres
description: Pirate Garda terrifies the oceans with his ship, Albatros. One day he crosses a Spanish ship commanded by Gomez; Abborda and abandoned it on fire. The fierce chief Pirate wants to get rid of all the prisoners with the exception of women who think of selling to the merchant Ramirez. On the island they land, a mysterious masked man appears ...

title: Vampires Journals
actors: David Gunn, Kristen Cerre, Starr Andreeff, Ilinca Goia, Mihai Dinvale
description: Zachery, half vampire and half man, tries to avenge the death of his beloved. To complete this feat, he will have to hunt down a bloodsucker that dominates Eastern Europe. Zachery will kill many of his servants and disciples.
notes: Faint horror movie directed by a specialist of the genre.

title: I tre sergenti del Bengala
actors: Richard Harrison, Wandisa Guida, Ugo Sasso, Nazzareno Zamperla
description: Three British sergeants are charged with a dangerous mission to the rebel tribes of Bengal. At first things go wrong because their guide turns out to be the leader of the rioters and has them captured. The three, however, will be able to free themselves and, taking possession of the machine guns, will massacre the enemies.

title: La muerte busca un hombre
actors: Peter Lee Lawrence, George Forsythe, Stan Cooper, Malisa Longo
description: Forsythe, who uses his woman as a decoy, has earned a reputation as a ruthless bounty hunter. But when his game backfires and Gladys is killed, he meditates revenge by finding the help of a mysterious gunslinger.

title: Killjoy
actors: Angel Vargas, Dee Dee Austin, Arthur Burghardt, Jamal Grimes

title: Pa kuo lien chun
actors: Wang Wei Lung, Richard Harrison, Shih Szu, Lihua Li, Henry Bolanos

title: Revelation
actors: Terence Stamp, James D'Arcy, Natasha Wightman, Derek Jacobi
description: After thousands of years, the forces of evil and good are still fighting each other to secure possession of a mysterious relic. The wealthy Magnus Martel, aware of the power of the relic, instructs his daughter Jake and Mira to destroy it before it falls into the hands of the Grand Master, demonic sentinel present at Christ's crucifixion.

title: Just One Night
actors: Timothy Hutton, Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Udo Kier, Natalie Shaw
description: To retrieve one of his mysteriously missing ceremonial shoes, Isaac exits the hotel and wanders around San Francisco. When he met the beautiful Aurora, he was struck by love at first sight. But she is married (although in crisis with her husband) and Isaac himself is expected at the altar: how will it end?
notes: Unpretentious romantic comedy.

title: Snow White
actors: Kristin Kreuk, Miranda Richardson, Karin Konoval, Tom Irwin
description: After freeing a strange green creature, the father of little Snow White receives as a reward the fulfillment of three wishes: a kingdom for himself, a queen as a bride and food for his daughter. But things take a turn for the worse when the evil Elspeth sits on the throne, who has a terrible plan in store for Snow White ...

title: Barbie in the Nutcracker
description: To cheer up her friend Shelly, struggling with some ballet steps, Barbie tells her the tale of the brave Clara who, after saving the kingdom of Parthenia from the tyrannical Mouse King and freed Prince Eric from the cruel spell that had changed it. in a nutcracker, she had discovered she was a princess ...

title: Beyond the City Limits
actors: Jennifer Esposito, Alyson Hannigan, Steve Harris, Nastassja Kinski
description: Sergei and Yuri plan a casino robbery with the help of a disgruntled employee.
notes: Russian mobsters, dirty cops, rebellious girlfriends: the first hour of this thriller is so indigestible and filled with badly written characters that it overshadows what is good in the second part.

title: Leprechaun in the Hood
actors: Ice T, Warwick Davis, Coolio, Anthony Montgomery, Rashaan Nall, Red Grant
description: The three young rappers Stray Bullet, Butch and Postmaster P enter the studio of producer Mack Daddy and discover that the latter owes its success to a magical flute. Obviously they get hold of it, but they will have to contend with Mack's vengeful ally: the evil Leprechaun ...
notes: The interminable saga gives no respite.

title: La dottoressa di campagna
actors: Marina Frajese, Antonella Antinori, Mark Shanon, Nino Terzo
description: The arrival of a provocative doctor in a provincial town puts the entire male population in turmoil, in perennial tail in front of the clinic. Taking advantage of the situation, the mayor tries to give a lesson to the local playboy ...
notes: The porn star Hedman-Frajese is the only attraction of this itchy and disheartening film.

title: The Errand Boy
actors: Jerry Lewis, Brian Donlevy, Howard McNear, Dick Wesson
description: Worried about the recurrence of some inexplicable and crazy expenses, the director of the Paramutual studios hires attacker Morty S. Tashman, a young film buff he has just hired, to spy on and report what is happening on the sets. There will be a barrage of trouble wherever it appears.
notes: Twenty-sixth film by Jerry Lewis (now without Martin) and his third direction. In this ideal sequel to _Hollywood o morte_ (and antelitteram precursor to _Hollywood Party_: Lewis as Sellers), the comedian pushes further on the metacinema pedal, between nonsense and jabs at the Hollywood myth. Abstract, surreal, irresistible.

title: Mutiny
actors: Mark Stevens, Angela Lansbury, Patric Knowles, Gene Evans
description: 1812: James Marshall, captain of the Yankee ship Concord, must beware of rebel officer Ben Waldridge, apparently passed to the British. In reality, however, Waldridge's real target is the cargo of gold stowed in the Concord ...
notes: Having re-emerged from the ordeal of the "black lists", Dmytryk conducts with skill but without particular jolts.

title: Red Line 7000
actors: James Caan, Laura Devon, Gail Hire, Charlene Holt, John Robert Crawford
description: Their names are Jim, Mike and Dan, and they make a living from car racing. The problems that haunt them are also those of the women they have at their side, between a sense of challenge and terror of the fatal moment ...
notes: Hawks' third last film, imbued with a bitterness and dryness that anticipate the New Hollywood of the 70s.

title: V shest chasov vechera posle vojny
actors: Marina Ladynina, Yevgeni Samojlov, Ivan Lyubeznov, Anastasiya Lysak
description: Two Russian army gunners stationed in Moscow encounter a girl just as the city is thrown upside down by war. A great complicity arises, so that one of the two young people falls in love. Historical events, however, loom and the three must separate, but not before meeting at six in the evening, after the war, on a bridge in Moscow ...
notes: Musical comedy shot as an ideal sequel to _Svinarka i pastuck (They met in Moscow) _ by Pyryev himself and with the same cast. The musical rehearsals are excellent, set in a romantic and at the same time epic atmosphere, where the struggle between individual and collective, between old and new, takes the form of a dance.

title: Caligula
actors: Malcolm McDowell, Teresa Ann Savoy, Helen Mirren, Peter O'Toole, John Gielgud, Giancarlo Badessi, Bruno Brive, Adriana Asti, Leopoldo Trieste, Paolo Bonacelli, John Steiner, Mirella D'Angelo, Rick Parets
description: Having ascended the imperial throne (in 37 AD, just 25 years old), succeeding his adoptive grandfather Tiberius, Caligula remained there until his death, which occurred less than four years later. A short reign but marked by an infinite theory of violence, cruelty, murders, orgies, incest and unspeakable extravagances.
notes: In the beginning there was a big budget, a stellar cast, a script signed by Gore Vidal and adapted by Masolino d'Amico. The outcome? An unspecified number of versions - including an integral and hard one, published only on DVD - reassembled and manipulated by a thousand hands (from Brass, reduced to mere "executor" of the shoot, to producer Bob Guccione, that of "Penthouse").

title: The Steel Helmet
actors: Gene Evans, Robert Hutton, Steve Brodie, James Edwards, Richard Loo
description: Following the extermination of his patrol by the North Koreans, Sergeant Zack will join that of Lieutenant Driscoll to face the common enemy together. The lieutenant will die a hero and Zack will end up paying him a moving tribute.
notes: First Hollywood film on the Korean War, capable of arousing a lot of controversy. The label of an "anti-communist" work, too influenced by the political climate of the time, postponed its true understanding, initially favoring a banal and prejudicial reading. Later the film was a real rediscovery in terms of actor interpretation and analysis of the war as a metaphor for a denied existence.

title: Kasaba
actors: Cihat Bütün, Emin Ceylan, Fatma Ceylan, Havva Saglam, Emin Toprak

title: Les anges du péché
actors: Renée Faure, Jany Holt, Sylvie, Marie-Hélène Dasté
description: Anne-Marie is a young girl animated by a very deep vocation, which pushes her to enter the convent of the Dominicans of Bethany. Here the rebellious Thérèse finds refuge, a "lost" soul that Anne-Marie tries with all her might to recover ...
notes: Cinema, the art of the image. A revealed discourse made up of subtle games of glances, alternating shadows / lights, reflections of personality. Cinema, the art of the enhancement of the gesture. Salvific, doomed to damnation, insanely altruistic in his utter obstinacy. It is the visual syntax of Robert Bresson, master of cinema, able to make the screen vibrate with the representation of a struggle between souls that encompasses the whole range of human feelings.

title: Choi lee bat siu ji
actors: Alexander Fu Sheng, John Liang, Wang Lung Wei, Philip Kwok
description: A boy and a girl experienced in combat, in the company of their ancient kung fu master, are forced to leave the island they live on due to the persecution of a rival faction. After many ups and downs we will arrive at the classic showdown.

title: Warlock III: The End of Innocence
actors: Bruce Payne, Ashley Laurence, Paul Francis, Jan Schweiterman
description: To his surprise, young Kris Miller learns that she has inherited an old house that is being demolished. The girl goes to visit her accompanied by a group of friends, just in time to fall prey to a bloody creature ...
notes: Pseudo-sequel to the films of Miner (1989) and Hickox (1993): boredom and inconsistency reign supreme.

title: Slam
actors: Saul Williams, Bonz Malone, Sonja Sohn, Lawrence Wilson

title: Week-end
actors: Jean Pierre Kalfon, Jean Yanne, Mireille Darc, Jean-Pierre Léaud
description: For Corinne and Roland, middle-class spouses in crisis, a weekend in the countryside turns into an endless nightmare of trafficking, terrorist attacks by the "Liberation Front of the Seine-et-Oise" and cannibalism. And on Sunday evening, the two will not - literally - be the same anymore ...
notes: In the year of _Two or three things I know about her_ and _The Chinese_, Godard gives continuity to the most political period of his cinema by shooting this visionary and ferociously anti-bourgeois apologue, a veritable "frontal attack" on consumer society and mass conventions on stage. The ten-minute sequence shot of the traffic jam of queued cars is famous.

title: Immacolata e Concetta - L'altra gelosia
actors: Ida Di Benedetto, Marcella Michelangeli, Tommaso Bianco, Lucio Allocca, Lucia Ragni

title: Curfew
actors: Kyle Richards, Wendell Wellman, John Putch, Frank Miller
description: Teenager Stephanie, forced to undergo a curfew by her parents after spending several weekends partying late into the night, rushes home to avoid a new head wash. The girl discovers that two fugitives have her family hostage.
notes: Thriller that recycles a predictable subject.

title: Chiamate 6969: taxi per signora
actors: Mark Shannon, Marina Frajese, Guia Lauri, Marcella Petry
description: The driver of a taxi is approached by a lady who leads him to a villa, he makes us love and pays him. From now on, many overlooking ladies and no, they go to him to pass nights of Passion for a fee. In the meantime, two landruncoli who believe themselves the blues brothers try to cut him.
notes: From the director of _Ramba challenges the beast_.

title: The Mother
actors: Anne Reid, Peter Vaughan, Anna Wilson-Jones, Daniel Craig, Danira Govich
description: Shocked by her husband's sudden death, Mary is welcomed into the home of her son Bobby whose marriage is in crisis. Misunderstandings with her daughter-in-law push Mary to move to her other daughter, Paula, who has a very conflicting relationship with her mother. When Mary begins an erotic relationship with her daughter's lover, the situation becomes irreparably complicated.
notes: _The Mother_ is what is called a surprise. In the sense that from a film directed by Roger Michell (_Notting Hill_, the mediocre _Ipotesi di crime_) and written by an author with a slightly tarnished talent (Hanif Kureishi) you don't expect who knows, at most the classic honest product. But no, here is a story that says non-trivial things about generational relationships, parent-child relationships, the bourgeois perception of old age, the need of the elderly to have their own sexuality, the hypothesis of an eroticism that goes beyond the very materialistic idea of ??the body and its beauty. Above all, the things he says and on which it is impossible not to pause to reflect, _The Mother_ forces you to look at them from a precise perspective, that of a director who is obviously not so "commercial" who chooses a radical point of view on the subject matter. scene.

title: Le coeur des hommes
actors: Gérard Darmon, Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Marc Lavoine, Bernard Campan, Ludmila Mikael, Fabienne Babe
description: Alex, Antoine, Jeff and Manu have been dating for over 25 years, ever since they played for the same soccer team in the Parisian suburbs. A series of crises leads them to confide in each other and question each other. At the center of all their conversations is the relationship with women.
notes: The next model is _Les choses de la vie_ by Sautet, in a more superficial and sugary version. The actors know how to do it, the jokes are agile, the film is also followed. But the "French quality" is submerged by a self-consoling molasses in comparison with which our Muccino is a merciless and cruel anatomist of feelings.

title: Laurel Canyon
actors: Frances McDormand, Christian Bale, Kate Beckinsale, Natascha McElhone, Alessandro Nivola
description: In Laurel Canyon (a road that crosses the Hollywood hills) lives Jane, a record producer who is currently producing the album for an English band whose singer Ian is her young lover. Jane offered her son Sam and girlfriend Alex, recently graduated from Harvard medics, the home in Laurel Canyon, assuring that there would be none. But when the two boys arrive Jane is still working on the record with the band. The coexistence of people so different from each other sharpens doubts and tensions.
notes: If you are not too demanding, however, the film can be easily seen, especially for the skill of the performers, Kate Beckinsale above all. Soundtrack up to expectations and Daniel Lanois cameo in the scene shot at the Chateau Marmont.

title: Hunter: Return to Justice
actors: Sam Hennings, David Grant Wright, Fred Dryer, Stepfanie Kramer, David Grant Wright, Sam Hennings
description: Dumped by the LAPD after a failed operation, Detective Rick Hunter moves to San Diego, where his one-time partner Dee Dee McCall lives. It's time for Rick to hang up his gun, but when he discovers that Dee Dee's boyfriend, the city's mayoral candidate, is a former KGB spy ...
notes: Second TV film inspired by one of the most successful detective series of the late 1980s (in Italy it aired on Raidue). Only absent from the original cast, Charles Hallahan (played Captain Charles Devane), who passed away in 1997.

title: Fantômas - À l'ombre de la guillotine
actors: René Navarre, Edmond Bréon, Georges Melchior, Renée Carl
description: In the Parisian Royal Palace Hotel, Fantômas steals the jewels and a large sum of money from Princess Danidoff. Inspector Juve is in charge of the investigation into the theft, who must also deal with the case of the late Lord Beltham.
notes: Masterpiece of the Seventh Art, the first French film to become a mass phenomenon. Fantômas, an almost intangible incarnation of absolute evil, fascinated not only the man in the street but also the avant-gardes, from the surrealists to Apollinaire. Feuillade, in his life as a conservative and a man of order, had some trouble with the censorship due to the unprecedented violence of its representation.

title: Juve contre Fantômas
actors: René Navarre, Edmond Bréon, Georges Melchior, Renée Carl
description: The unidentified body of a woman is found in the house of a certain Dr. Chaleck. Juve and Fandor follow the doctor, who transforms himself into the apache Loupart and manages to sow Juve. Meanwhile, Fandor, on the trail of Joséphine, an accomplice of the bandit, risks perishing in the Simplon-Express catastrophe caused by Fantômas. After escaping the explosion of the Bercy depot, the two friends manage to arrest the Master of Crime, who, however, manages to escape again. And Fantômas decides to send his "silent executioner" to Juve ...

title: La mort qui tue
actors: René Navarre, Edmond Bréon, Georges Melchior, André Luguet
description: After the alleged death of Juve in the explosion of Lady Beltham's villa, Fandor continues to investigate alone. Meanwhile, the painter Dollon, accused of the crime of Baroness de Vibray (actually killed by Fantômas), is murdered in a cell by the guard Nibet, an accomplice of the bandit ...
notes: Third episode of the "historical" series.

title: Fantômas contre Fantômas
actors: René Navarre, Edmond Bréon, Georges Melchior, Laurent Morléas
description: A hostile rumor begins to spread in public opinion: if Juve never manages to arrest Fantômas it is only because he himself is Fantômas! The police inspector is then put in jail. Meanwhile, in a popular neighborhood in Paris, Paulet and Nini murder a debt collection agent. Père Moche, under whose guise Fantômas is hiding, takes charge of making the body disappear, which is later found by the American detective Tom Bob. But Tom Bob is always ... Fantômas!

title: Le faux magistrat
actors: René Navarre, Edmond Bréon, Georges Melchior, Mesnery, Laurent Morléas
description: Fantômas is sentenced to life imprisonment in Belgium, where there is no death penalty. However Juve, convinced that his diabolical opponent can escape at the first opportunity, decides to make him flee and then capture him as soon as he returns to France. But Fantômas has other plans ...
notes: Fifth and final episode of the "historical" series.

title: Voyage of the Unicorn
actors: Chantal Conlin, Heather McEwen, Beau Bridges, Mackenzie Gray
description: After the death of their mother, a book illustrator, their daughters Cassie and Miranda and their father Alan are sucked into a magical world. To return home, they will have to find the magical dragon that will stop the troll threat.
notes: Two-part miniseries, merged here, based on a fairy tale by James C. Christensen

title: Abandon
actors: Katie Holmes, Benjamin Bratt, Charlie Hunnam, Zooey Deschanel, Mark Feuerstein, Fred Ward
description: Katie is under pressure: she has to finish her thesis and endure a difficult job interview. As if that were not enough, she is involved in the investigation by detective Wade Handler who investigates the disappearance, which took place two years earlier, of Embry, her ex-boyfriend. Handler has in fact discovered some surprising details concerning the last days of Embry, whose disappearance is perhaps linked to another mysterious episode that took place on the university campus.
notes: _Abandon - Mysterious homicides_ is so trite, boring and appealing that even a broken unreleased home video is more intriguing (we come out to the cinema with already more than a year and three months on his shoulders: good record). That big girl from Holmes has the expressiveness of an Emilian tortellino (if you look closely, she also looks like us). As expected, his past has something to do with it in some way. If it's a thriller, it can only scare a sparrow; if it is the investigation of an intimacy and a mind, it makes you re-evaluate _Shriek - Do you have commitments for Friday 17th? _; if it is the vision of the traumatic passage between adolescence and adult life, it is not convincing at all. For his directorial debut, the _Traffic_ screenwriter could come up with some more decent ideas than that of the personal a (b) banishment in the "empty" contemporaneity as a psychological alibi. At the Courmayeur Noir in Festival the jury awarded him the prize for music (!): The good composer Clint Mansell deserves better.

title: Yuke Yuke nidome no shojo
actors: Mimi Kozakura, Michio Akiyama
description: On the terrace of a building, a boy witnesses the rape of a young woman. The next morning, I'm still there: she wants to die, he sings her a song. They start talking. Life goes on?
notes: Wakamatsu, 98 films in 34 years: not all are perfect, this is one of the most beautiful.

title: Taiji ga mitsuryosuru toki
actors: Hatsuo Yamane, Miharu Shima
description: The young employee of a department store is involved by one of her bosses - who was abandoned by his wife because he was unable to give her a child - in a murky and sadistic relationship: the whip, the rape, teaches her the alleged male supremacy to sound of violence.
notes: “Wakamatsu's films offer their viewers an experience that has no equivalent to sunlight. The voice of desire echoing through the night, ”Nagisa Oshima said. Wakamatsu, a filmmaker of Japanese modernity, Godardian at heart, but radically anchored to the contradictions of his own land, makes an ambiguous, dry film, daring in the staging of the bodies, far from the complacency of the hard.

title: Near Death
description: Patients, families, doctors, infernors, spiritual "assistants": life and over death in a four-part documentary (the first three are on the air tonight, the last on January 25) shot in the corridors of Beth Israel Hospital in Boston. Yet another shocking testimony from Wiseman, awarded with Fipresci in Berlin.

title: Mario Schifano tutto
description: Luca Ronchi, Mario Schifano's collaborator since the 1970s, offers us a sort of autobiography of the painter. We are shown, through unpublished films, the intimate and human side of an "irregular" artist.
notes: The documentary was presented in the "New territories" section of the 58th Venice Film Festival.

title: Senza famiglia
actors: Luciano de Ambrosis, Erminio Spalla, Bianca Doria, Elio Steiner, Memmo Carotenuto
description: The little Remigio, son of a rich family, is abandoned and raised by two peasants who believes to be his parents. The false father, slacker and drunkard, sells him to an street player. But fate wants the child to come into contact with his real mother.
notes: Remake of the homonymous film by Marc Allégret.

title: Shurayuki-hime
actors: Hideaki Ito, Yumiko Shaku, Shiro Sano, Yoichi Numata, Kyusaku Shimada

title: Hellraiser: Inferno
actors: Craig Sheffer, Nicholas Turturro, James Remar, Doug Bradley
description: Thorne is a great cop but he has a drug problem. When assigned the murder case of a disfigured former partner of his, Thorne becomes obsessed with a small cubic box found at the crime scene. After a night spent with a prostitute, the policeman opens the cube: events begin to take a bad turn.
notes: Fifth sequel in the slasher series _Hellraiser_ directly to the video. Director Derrickson prefers to abandon the more exaggerated splatter, the trademark of the previous chapters, in favor of greater psychological introspection. Some thrills fade away. For the fifth time the terrible Pinhead is played by Doug Bradley.

title: Hellraiser: Hellseeker
actors: Dean Winters, Ashley Laurence, Doug Bradley, Rachel Hayward
description: Surviving the accident in which his wife Kirsty (the daughter of the first episode, for the uninitiated) dies, Trevor sinks into a labyrinth of amnesia and hallucinations full of sex and violence, while some of his acquaintances are killed: reality, dreams or holes of film script? At the origin of everything, as always, the diabolical box that opens the doors to the world of the Supplizianti.
notes: The gore effects are muted in favor of a flashback-clogged thriller track. The characters of the old episodes seem almost superfluous and appear little, so the film could disappoint even the most willing fans. Released directly on video.

title: Hellraiser Deader
actors: Doug Bradley, Kari Wuhrer, Paul Rhys, Georgina Rylance, Marc Warren
description: The editor of a London newspaper Charles Richmond received a videotape where some young people from Bucharest seem to become zombies. Charles decides to send journalist Amy Klein, who has just finished an investigation into London crack addicts, to Romania. Arriving at the scene, Amy must meet Marla, the member of the group who sent the video, but finds her dead holding a cube-shaped puzzle. Amy takes the item with her to the hotel and opens it there, starting a journey to hell.
notes: The _Hellraiser_ saga is now (and with reason) confined to the "straight to video" market.

title: Hellraiser: Hellworld
actors: Doug Bradley, Katheryn Winnick, Henry Cavill, Lance Henriksen

title: È già ieri
actors: Antonio Albanese, Fabio De Luigi, Goya Toledo, Pepón Nieto, Beatriz Rico
description: Filippo, a well-known television journalist who deals with scientific dissemination, is sent to an islet in the Canary Islands to study a flock of storks that have nested on the top of a volcano. Enrico, a shy and kind young operator, accompanies him. Rita, a biologist, awaits them on the spot, who will guide them. Filippo has a hostile attitude towards his companions and the place. Having completed the service in one day, he would like to leave immediately, but is forced to spend the night on the island due to a violent storm. When he wakes up he realizes that everything seems to repeat itself the same as the previous day ...
notes: Rare (unique?) Case of a remake on the contrary, an Italian production that remakes an American classic (_Ricomincio da capo_, now a cult, especially after an avalanche of TV passages and consumption of VHS), It's already yesterday it slips into the not very frequent " oxymoron titles "in the history of cinema. A corner of the dictionaries that boasts, for example, "Puzzle Week" games such as Cursed I will love you and The perfect storm. Strange, then. Like the (brilliant) idea that inspires him: to live for years on the same day and see the effect it has. It must be admitted that the Italian screenwriters managed to credibly transfer the moods and narrative tensions of the original: it was not easy. The character of the rampant TV presenter falsely folded on fruitful ecological issues works. The shy cameraman who has his beautiful problems with women also works. The woman with an environmentalist inspiration works less (here the parallelism with the then perfect Andie MacDowell was lost from the start). Basically, a curious operation, where Albanese finally plays for his part, because he is direct. Final regret: more courage would not have hurt. On the contrary: why not transform the handsome Antonio into a new John Belushi?

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
actors: Viggo Mortensen, Elijah Wood, Orlando Bloom, Sean Astin, Ian McKellen, Cate Blanchett, Liv Tyler, Bernard Hill, Billy Boyd, Dominic Monaghan, Hugo Weaving, Miranda Otto, David Wenham, Karl Urban, John Noble, Ian Holm, Sean Bean, Lawrence Makoare, Paul Norell, Marton Csokas, John Rhys-Davies
description: While Frodo and Sam, accompanied by Gollum, continue their journey to Mount Doom to destroy the Ring, the rest of the company rushes to the rescue of Rohan and Gondor, engaged in the great battle of the Pellenor Fields. Right here, in Minas Tirith, Sauron has decided to launch the final attack for the conquest of Middle-earth ...
notes: The four Hobbit boys grow old all of a sudden, and all the magic in the world is about to disappear once the time of Men is established. The great epic, airy moments are mostly human: the fires of Minas Tirith that light up to ask Gondor for help, the charge and breakthrough of the knights of Rohan (masterful scene, which gives the audience back the momentum and strength of bump of the cavalry), Aragorn leading his "For Frodo!", the bow of all the warriors, kings and elves before the four hobbits. And human are emotion and feelings: friendship first of all, then honor and the acceptance of one's responsibilities. Skilled in supporting the threads of a narrative that proceeds through parallel events and the rhythm of an incessant battle, Jackson cloaks this third part of an almost testamentary veil (an air that is also breathed in Tolkien's pages), with an insinuating melancholy, of regret for the reign of the marvelous and for the adventure that will not repeat itself. "You can't be divided forever," Frodo tells Sam, leaving the gardener - who is the real winner of the battle against Sauron - to complete the last pages of his book. The Fellowship of the Ring really separates: even the cavalrymen retire. And a Fordian breath stretches over the Shakespearean horrors.

title: Down with Love
actors: Renée Zellweger, Ewan McGregor, Sarah Paulson, David Hyde Pierce, Tony Randall
description: New York, 1962. Writer Barbara Novak conquers the top of the charts with the best-seller _Down With Love_, in which she urges women to favor careers at the expense of love. The heartthrob journalist Catcher Block, in charge of interviewing her, decides to change her mind by using any means.
notes: _Abbasso d'amore - Down With Love_ pays homage to that cinema, taking as a canvas a classic with Doris Day and Rock Hudson _ (The bed tells, 1959) _ and updating it just enough with touches of feminine vindication and hints of masculine fragility , but without distorting or modernizing the narrative game. Naïve film as far as the plot is concerned, it is, on the other hand, highly sophisticated in terms of imaginary reconstruction. Ultra-refined quotes from Tashlin / Wilder / Hawks / Douglas / Walters / Donen and in general from all the enameled visual system of the time; a meticulous work of split screen, transparencies, costumes, sets, choreography (it is not a musical, but often "sets up" the scenes as if it were); dialogues that reflect the shameless lack of innocence of a period in which sexual liberation had already taken place even if no one talked about it. The performers are perfect: Zellweger, sitting out and wide-eyed like Doris Day, McGregor, an astonishing young Sinatra, the careless Sarah Paulson and David Hyde Pierce comically wrestling in a story of love and nerves. It is essential to accept the rules of the game; then the enjoyment is assured.

title: L'ingenua
actors: Ilona Staller, Georges Ardisson, Daniele Vargas, Ezio Marano
description: A rather awkward young man distressed by a rather aggressive girlfriend, a variety actress, two fresh spouses who are far from faithful and a fake dumb saleswoman: all of them involved - victims and not - in a scam concerning a villa.
notes: Yes, that's fine, Cicciolina is there too, but don't expect much erotic ...

title: Paycheck
actors: Ben Affleck, Aaron Eckhart, Uma Thurman, Paul Giamatti, Joe Morton, Peter Friedman
description: Internationally renowned genius who develops top secret projects for companies, at the end of each assignment Michael Jennings undergoes a memory wipe so that he cannot divulge professional secrets. When he realizes that his own employers are hunting him to kill him, unable to defend himself as he does not remember his past, Michael relies on scientist Rachel, the woman he has worked with and has loved for the past three years. ...
notes: It seems that Woo wants to enjoy the California sun, making use of years of honorable career: glimpses of the style for which he was rightly famous burst here and there in a landscape dominated by Ben Affleck's inexpressiveness. Everything flows quite monotonous and predictable: perhaps the first to regret it will be Philip K. Dick, to whom we owe the original novel, who had been able to foresee the future but did not live long enough to witness the fulfillment of his own prophecies.

title: The School of Rock
actors: Jack Black, Mike White, Joan Cusack, Sarah Silverman, Joey Gaydos Jr.
description: The rock guitarist Dewey Finn, controversial and irreverent towards the system, wants to win at all costs a local competition with his band; but the latter, fed up with his attitude, fires him. Desperate and broke, Dewey answers a direct call to his partner Ned and accepts a substitute at a prestigious elementary school, directed by a very strict principal. Dewey immediately wins the trust of his students, and when he hears them playing in the school orchestra he decides to turn them into a high-voltage rock group ...
notes: Linklater directs a "family" film that parents like as much as children, which does not sell stupid myths but History (that of rock, summarized in a fussy and highly cultivated family tree), which does not reassure but invites you to stubbornly follow your passions and pass them on. Success is all there: in opening a rock school for boys, from which the musical genius of the next decade will perhaps emerge. The dominator, of course, is Jack Black, born to play this battered and cheating "loser", this busted and burly bankrupt, this "one-man-band" who improvises math songs and brings out the souls of others (not only of the students, even the headmaster neurotic of responsibilities: an irresistible Joan Cusack). Apparently less sulphurous, Black could really be the new John Belushi: same energy, same communicative strength, same "candor" under the voracious air.

title: Underworld
country: United States, Germany, Hungary, Great Britain
actors: Kate Beckinsale, Scott Speedman, Michael Sheen, Shane Brolly, Bill Nighy, Erwin Leder
description: A no-holds-barred war has been going on for some time between sophisticated and aristocratic vampires and brutal werewolves. Selene, a vampire warrior, uncovers a plot concocted by her enemies to kidnap Michael, a young doctor of the human race (who must create a new and invincible race of predators with the powers of both species, but without their weaknesses). After following him in his travels, Selene forms an unusual bond with Michael and when the werewolves try to carry out their plan, the vampire helps him fend off the ferocious attack.
notes: From sunset to sunrise in another dimension. The one where only the creatures of the night love, fight, survive. A cartoonish and stylized "underworld", indebted to other visions (from _Il crow_ to _Blade_) but basically original, thanks above all to Budapest which offers a "bewitched" context without the need for excessive fictions. Len Wiseman's film, based on a "Shakespearean" subject by Kevin Grevioux, also an actor as the giant black werewolf, is an enjoyable reinterpretation of two myths as old as cinema, and beyond: the vampire and the werewolf. Nothing particularly new under the moon (full ...); pure entertainment which, however, does not exceed in special effects (the temporal jumps of the flashbacks and the make-up are even démodé) and makes the natural decadence of places functional to the image. Certainly a little more courage in writing would not have hurt (for example by making the romance and sex between vampire and werewolf more explicit ...), and 90-100 minutes would have been enough to exhaust the topic. Vampire Kate Beckinsale dressed as the Black Widow from Marvel Comics is a surprise: fragile, petite and finally far from the Angelina Jolie-style silicone superheroines.

title: House of Sand and Fog
actors: Jennifer Connelly, Ben Kingsley, Ron Eldard, Frances Fisher, Kim Dickens
description: A small bungalow in northern California represents for Kathy Lazaro the last strip of hope to cling to in order to rebuild an almost destroyed life. When she is evicted due to a bureaucratic error, the house is bought by Massoud Amir Behrani, an Iranian emigrant who sees his American dream come true. The fight between Kathy and Behrani is getting tighter and tighter until it takes on the dimensions of a real clash between two cultures.
notes: The director directs a troubled, sad and contagious film of actors, sensations, burns of the heart. The camera plunges us into a world of helplessness and jarring cultures. It enhances the grains of the acting, of the plot, of the silences.

title: Mamma Ebe
actors: Berta Dominguez, Stefania Sandrelli, Barbara De Rossi, Ida Di Benedetto

title: Twilight Time
actors: Karl Malden, Jodi Thelen, Pavle Vujisic, Dragan Maksimovic
description: Marko is an elderly gentleman who lived in the US, where he won a dance contest with his favorite song: _Twilight Time_. Now he has returned to his native village in Yugoslavia where he takes care of Ivan and Ana, the two children of his son. He left for Germany abandoning his children and leaving only a letter, but Marko does not have the heart to tell Ivan and Ana the truth and so he writes a replacement letter with some life lessons. Then a new and beautiful teacher arrives in the village who turns the heads of many ...
notes: The American co-production does not help Paskaljevic, here a bit burdened by didacticism and folklore.

title: Blu cobalto
actors: Anna Bonaiuto, Flavio Bonacci, Susanna Javicoli, Enrico Ghezzi
description: An elderly peasant, believed to be mad by his family, dispenses wisdom to the other patients; an actress takes advantage of the hospitalization to shed light inside herself; a young doctor lives with schizophrenia his condition as a patient ...
notes: Shot at the Sant'Orsola in Bologna, a film suspended between drama and documentary. Screenplay by Aldo Braibanti.

title: Seom
actors: Jung Suh, Kim Yoosuk, Park Sung-hee, Jo Jae-hyeon, Jang Hang-seon
description: In addition to selling bait, food, and equipment at a fishing reserve on the Korean coast, wetsuit Hee-Ji occasionally concedes her body (like other young prostitutes in the area) to customers and tourists. At least until he meets Hyun-Shik, who is trying to escape the police after killing his girlfriend and is now persuaded to commit suicide: she falls in love with him and offers him help, and from that day nothing will be the same ...
notes: Slow, liquid, enveloping and silent, a film that summarizes the stylistic features (and some tricks) of a certain contemporary oriental cinema. Beware of hooks, and their cruelly alternative uses.

title: Hunter: Back in Force
actors: Fred Dryer, Stepfanie Kramer, Gregory Scott Cummins, William Schenker
description: San Diego: Detective Rick Hunter, recently reinstated in the ranks of the police, and his colleague Dee Dee McCall are the target of Randall Skaggs, currently on probation and determined to avenge the arrest suffered years ago precisely because of Hunter. Randall's side is his brother Harlan, a murderous psychopath, and a handful of ferocious outlaws. Meanwhile, Rick and Dee Dee are grappling with a series of bank robberies with rather unusual characteristics: the suspicions seem to fall on some women, probably under the orders of a prisoner and a corrupt officer ...

title: La sposa non può attendere
actors: Gino Cervi, Gina Lollobrigida, Odile Versois, Giacomo Furia, Ave Ninchi
description: Alfonso is running to get married. Along the way, he lingers to help a pregnant girl who wants to commit suicide. Arriving late at his wedding, his relatives do not believe what has happened and consider him an unfaithful liar who has tried to abdicate his responsibilities.
notes: Comedy not completely successful, written by Zavattini in collaboration with Pietrangeli and Tellini. The Lollobrigida is here in its first important part.

title: For Better, for Worse
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Susan Stephen, Cecil Parker, Eileen Herlie, Athene Seyler
description: The betrothed has neither money nor work, but he manages to bring his beloved to the altar even against the advice of his father-in-law. Despite the difficulties of life together, the two boys will manage to get by on their own.
notes: Weak script and weak direction, but the actors are appreciated for their commitment and despite everything the comedy slips away quickly to the end.

title: Glissements progressifs du plaisir
actors: Anicée Alvina, Olga Georges-Picot, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Michael Lonsdale
description: Alice is accused of killing the friend she was living with and is locked up in a women's prison for minors. When questioned at the trial, she boldly confesses to the lesbian games she was involved in and ensnares a policeman, a magistrate and a priest in a disturbing relationship.
notes: Intellectual and cold narrative machine, the sixth film by Robbe-Grillet stages the interrogation as a place where unconfessed impulses and desires emerge and explode. Sometimes a confusing film, sometimes very funny.

title: Submarine Command
actors: William Holden, Nancy Olson, William Bendix, Don Taylor, Arthur Franz
description: World War II: A submarine jailer accidentally causes the death of its commander. He will bear the mark of guilt until the war in Korea gives him the opportunity to redeem himself and prove his worth to everyone.
notes: A mediocre war movie, with some nice action scenes.

title: K-9: P.I.
actors: James Belushi, Gary Basaraba, Kim Huffman, Jody Racicot
description: For Dooley and his faithful dog friend Jerry Lee, colleagues in the police, there is really no peace: the day after retiring from service, the two are again forced to get busy, on the trail of some "high-tech thugs." "who have stolen a very precious chip. "Professional" complications aside, Dooley is convinced of the need to find a partner for Jerry Lee, but it will be him who will find himself embroiled in affairs of the heart ...
notes: Thirteen years after the first episode and three from the second (unreleased in Italy), Belushi returns in the role of detective Dooley. The fun, however, continues to disappear.

title: Home Alone 4
actors: Mike Weinberg, French Stewart, Jason Beghe, Joanna Going
description: Little Kevin spends the Christmas holidays with his father and his new partner, Nathalie. Meanwhile, Marv, an old swindler, plans with his accomplice Vera to kidnap a young prince who will be a guest at Nathalie's house. Left alone at home with the prince, Kevin will have to use all his wits to foil the plan of the two shady guys ...

title: Earth vs. the Spider
actors: Dan Aykroyd, Devon Gummersall, Amelia Heinle, Theresa Russell
description: Quentin, a shy avid comic reader, is experimentally injected with a serum that is supposed to transfer some spider skills to humans. The boy acquires extraordinary strength, which allows him to fight criminals and to live out his superhero dreams. However, the serum has engendered a progressive mutation and the strength grows until it becomes uncontrollable. The transformation also causes ever-increasing pain and hunger and drives Quentin crazy, and he develops spider legs and glands to emit venom and cobwebs. Inspector Jack Grillo will try to stop the creature, now out of control ...

title: Diary of a Madman
actors: Vincent Price, Nancy Kovack, Chris Warfield, Elaine Devry, Ian Wolfe

title: Brimstone and Treacle
actors: Sting, Denholm Elliott, Joan Plowright, Suzanna Hamilton, Benjamin Whitrow
description: Martin Taylor is a petty crook who, in order to get close to the wealthy Thomas Bates, pretends to be a friend of his spastic daughter. Thomas, a small industrialist, remains cold, but his wife is struck by the kindness of the young man, who thus manages to sneak up on the family, making their unspoken disagreements explode and setting his sights on money and jewels ...
notes: From a comedy by Dennis Potter, Loncraine draws a disturbing and cruel drama, with a good use of shadows and atmospheres, even if we have seen better on the theme of the guest among the bourgeois. Sting, in the first part as a protagonist, signs the soundtrack (three songs with the Police and five as a soloist).

title: È arrivato il Cavaliere
actors: Tino Scotti, Enrico Viarisio, Enzo Biliotti, Silvana Pampanini
description: The knight is the factotum of a group of street vendors camped in the Milanese suburbs who go out of their way to save friends from eviction.
notes: Monicelli's third film, it is a bittersweet comedy which, despite feeling the influences of neorealism, cannot compare with the masterpieces of the time.

title: Eloise at Christmastime
actors: Sofia Vassilieva, Julie Andrews, Sarah Topham, Rick Roberts
description: The Plaza Hotel staff is in awe of the upcoming wedding of Rachel Peabody, the owner's daughter, to the handsome Brooks Oliver. When Eloise discovers the true intentions of the betrothed she tries to convince Rachel to accept the court of Bill, a kindhearted waiter.

title: Il est plus facile pour un chameau...
actors: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Chiara Mastroianni, Jean-Hugues Anglade
description: Federica is very rich. This privilege does not make her feel free and prevents her from living a normal existence and assuming her responsibilities. In particular, the girl has to contend with a boyfriend who would like to start a family, an ex-lover who suddenly reappears, a family with whom she constantly quarrels and who is destabilized by the announcement of her father's death. Federica thus finds comfort in her imagination and indulges in her daydreams.
notes: If there is a style in this debut by Valeria Bruni Tedeschi it is in the choice not to have it, to let oneself be carried away (in fact) by intuition and heart, sifted in the shadow of a lost and vital rationality, punitive but inexorably creative. And so, the film lives on moments, situations, approaches, whips, suspended times and provocative ironies. As often happens in the works directed by the actors who move behind the camera, acting is the area most caressed and cared for, pampered and surrounded by affection.

title: The Good Die Young
actors: Laurence Harvey, Gloria Grahame, Richard Basehart, Stanley Baker

title: Gli fumavano le colt... lo chiamavano Camposanto
actors: Gianni Garko, William Berger, Chris Chittell, Nello Pazzafini

title: I guappi
actors: Franco Nero, Fabio Testi, Lina Polito, Raymond Pellegrin
description: Naples, late 19th century. Nicola leaves the reform school with the intention of becoming a lawyer. Thanks to Don Gaetano, boss of the Camorra, he graduated and was "guaranteed" to Don Antonio as an honored picciotto. He will find himself defending the innocent Don Gaetano from the false accusation of rape and murder.
notes: Squitieri skillfully handles the intricate affair.

title: The Strange Affair of Uncle Harry
actors: George Sanders, Geraldine Fitzgerald, Ella Raines, Sara Allgood
description: Harry Quincey, a lovable fabric decorator and middle-aged bachelor, lives with his sisters Hester and Lettie. The delicate family balance cracks when Harry falls in love with sophisticated colleague Deborah and wants to marry her. The possessive and jealous Lettie, however, manages to prevent the wedding and Harry decides to take revenge.
notes: Intense mélo with noir veins and incestuous overtones, taken from the theatrical drama by Thomas Job. The tragic ending was modified by the censorship which imposed another much more conciliatory and rambling one. Despite the Hitchcock-like atmosphere, the care of the staging and the excellent interpretation of the cast, in particular by Geraldine Fitzgerald, remains a minor Siodmak.

title: Jail Bait
actors: Clancy Malone, Lyle Talbot, Dolores Fuller, Herbert Rawlinson, Steve Reeves
description: Vic Brady, a professional in crime, misleads the young and arrogant Don Gregor, who had come into league with him for the sheer taste of thrill. Later, Brady blackmails the boy's father - a well-known plastic surgeon - to change his connotations ...
notes: One of the "masterpieces" of the ineffable Ed Wood.

title: Jennifer
actors: Ida Lupino, Howard Duff, Robert Nichols, Mary Shipp, Ned Glass
description: Agnes is hired as the caretaker of a large family mansion in Southern California. The previous caretaker, Jennifer, has mysteriously disappeared. Agnes finds the diary and falls into an obsession with finding it.

title: Julien Donkey-Boy
actors: Ewen Bremner, Brian Fisk, Chloë Sevigny, Werner Herzog, Joyce Korine, Evan Neumann, Miriam Martínez, Edgar Erikkson, James Moix, Victor Varnado, Oliver A. Bueno
description: Schizophrenic Julien works as an assistant in a school for the blind. His father torments him, his sister Pearl is expecting a baby, replacing her dead mother, and his brother is a gymnast. A shocking revelation will upset an already very delicate situation.
notes: Korine makes a disturbing movie in the style of "Dogma".

title: She Done Him Wrong
actors: Mae West, Cary Grant, Owen Moore, Gilbert Roland, Noah Beery
description: Singer and owner of a New York nightclub, the uninhibited Lady Lou boasts an almost infinite number of male friends, as well as some activities that are not exactly clear from a legal point of view. To keep an eye on her, Officer Cummings assumes the disguise of an upright Salvation Army captain, but the irresistible magnetism of his "prey" will soon make him lose his mind ...
notes: Cheeky, "scandalous", capable of firing bursts like a machine gun, the platinum-plated and certainly not filiform West - here at its best - has rightly risen to the status of an authentic icon of an era.

title: La lectrice
actors: Miou-Miou, Maria Casarès, Pierre Dux, Patrick Chesnais, Régis Royer

title: Phantom Lady
actors: Ella Raines, Franchot Tone, Alan Curtis, Elisha Cook jr., Aurora Miranda
description: Unjustly accused of murdering his wife, Scott Hendrickson has no way of defending himself: the unknown woman he was with at the time has in fact disappeared. Fortunately for him, his secretary Carol Richman - who has long been in love with him - sets out tenaciously in search of the mysterious woman ...
notes: From a novel by Cornell Woolrich (signed here with the pseudonym William Irish), the great Siodmak derives a suspenseful and very modern noir, even in his refusal to use extra-diegetic music. Master in the use of scenography, which here becomes almost abstract, the director creates a gloomy atmosphere, at times crossed by erotic tensions.

title: Una pistola per cento croci
actors: Tony Kendall, Marina Muligan, Dick Palmer, Monica Miguel
description: An Irishman is killed in the Wild West. The son Jimmy ponders revenge but ends up dead himself. Santana, a former Southerner, reads the letter he received from his sister Jessica and sets out on his trail. By bringing her her brother's body, Sartana will help her remain unscathed from the aims of her shrewd boyfriend Luis.

title: Il richiamo del lupo
actors: Jack Palance, Joan Collins, Fred Romer, Elizabeth Virgili, José Canalejas
description: Jim is ten years old and is left alone with his sister Mary, after losing his father. After inheriting the newspaper, they must reach Dawson City in Klondyke but there are several obstacles they encounter. However, they find in the unexpected friendship with Buck, half dog and half wolf, a valid help in dealing with wild nature and human greed.

title: No One Could Protect Her
actors: Joanna Kerns, Anthony John Denison, Peter MacNeill, Lori Hallier
description: Alone in the house in the absence of her husband Dan, Jessica barely saves herself from the assault of a murderous rapist who had already made a victim in the same neighborhood. While the police are groping in the dark, the assaults continue, with the criminal attempting to clean up possible witnesses. Dan equips the apartment as if it were a fortress, but that's not enough for Jessica: she continues to live in terror, so much so that - tired of suffering the psychological pressure - she decides to counterattack. Then begin to get busy and study the opponent's moves to prevent him ...
notes: A story seen a thousand times, each one better than this one.

title: The 51st State
actors: Samuel L. Jackson, Robert Carlyle, Meat Loaf, Nigel Whitmey
description: Elmo McElroy is a chemist who works for The Lizard, a psychopathic underworld. Intending to do one last, profitable job, Elmo moves to England to test the new, powerful drug he has invented. A series of unfortunate events stop him in Liverpool, while at his heels is Dakota - a fascinating and lethal killer - former mistress of business partner Felix. The situation gets complicated ...
notes: Badly successful, clumsy, yet another attempt to agree with the winners from Taranto. A dense and (only) apparently random plot is not enough. The frenzied pace is not enough, nor the poor Samuel L. Jackson to make _Pulp Fiction_. A little desire and talent would also be needed.

title: 84C MoPic
actors: Jonathan Emerson, Nicholas Cascone, Jason Tomlins, Christopher Burgard

title: Adorabili e bugiarde
actors: Nino Manfredi, Roberto Risso, Franco Fabrizi, Ingeborg Schöner, Isabelle Corey, Eloisa Cianni, Paolo Ferrari, Rick Battaglia

title: Magdanas lurja
actors: Dudukhana Tserodze, L. Moistrapishvili, Mikho Borashvili, Nani Chiqvinidze

title: Abraham
country: Germany, Italy, United States, Czech Republic, France
actors: Richard Harris, Barbara Hershey, Barbara Hershey, Maximilian Schell, Maximilian Schell, Vittorio Gassman, Vittorio Gassman
description: The patriarch Abraham, obedient to the voice of God, abandons the land of the Chaldeans with his family to seek the Promised Land on which to found a great nation. After a journey lived under the banner of many difficulties, Abraham and his people arrive at the promised land.

title: Jacob
actors: Matthew Modine, Lara Flynn Boyle, Sean Bean, Joss Ackland
description: Always in opposition to his brother Esau, Jacob is forced to leave his home. Son of Isaac and Rebecca, thanks to his faith Jacob will be able to demonstrate after years of dramatic experiences that he is the worthy heir of the Covenant stipulated with Abraham and will thus be able to make his love story with Rachel survive.

title: Joseph
actors: Paul Mercurio, Ben Kingsley, Martin Landau, Lesley Ann Warren
description: The eleventh son of Jacob and a favorite of his father, Joseph is sold by his envious brothers to a caravan of Ishmaelite merchants. Later condemned with the false accusation of having undermined his master's wife, in prison he will be able to make friends with the cupbearer and the baker of the pharaoh and redeem himself thanks to his skills in interpreting dreams.

title: Uncovered
actors: Kate Beckinsale, John Wood, Sinead Cusack, Paudge Behan
description: While working on a 15th-century painting by a Flemish school teacher, Julia, a young and capable restorer, makes an incredible discovery. In a scroll at the foot of the painting depicting two nobles who are playing chess while a woman is watching them, the Latin inscription "Qui necavit equitem", that is "Who killed the knight", appears. Just as Julia begins to search for the solution of the intriguing mystery, a series of crimes somehow related to the obscure inscription take place.
notes: Based on the novel by Arturo Pérez-Reverte entitled La tabla de Flandes and presented at Cannes in 1994, McBride's film, one of the most interesting and discontinuous talents in American cinema, manages to build a discreet atmosphere of mystery and tension. Yet, on the narrative level, it does not fully convince.

title: Telling Lies in America
actors: Brad Renfro, Kevin Bacon, Maximilian Schell, Calista Flockhart
description: Karchy, born in Hungary and emigrated to Cleveland in the early 1960s, finds himself floundering in the sea of ??American culture. Karchy tries to fit into the Catholic high school she attends, but becomes its laughing stock; at home, however, he has to endure the outbursts of his father, who would like him to follow the strict rules of the family. Karchy, a rock'n'roll enthusiast, has nothing left but to win the High School Hall of Fame contest, created by DJ Billy, which will allow him to impress his classmate Diney. Friendship with Billy will introduce him to the wild side of life.
notes: Discreet film written by Joe Eszterhas (_Basic Instinct_).

title: Tretij tajm
actors: Leonid Kuravlyov, Vyacheslav Nevinnyj, Gleb Strizhenov, Yuri Volkov

title: War Gods of the Deep
actors: Vincent Price, Tab Hunter, Susan Hart, David Tomlinson
description: Jill mysteriously disappears from a mansion, located on the edge of a cliff, during a stormy night. His lover Ben and his friend Harold, following the tracks of the kidnappers, discover a secret passage that leads to an underground city.
notes: Good the first part. The second is a little more sluggish.

title: Le calde notti di Don Giovanni
actors: Robert Hoffmann, Barbara Bouchet, Ira von Fürstenberg, Annabella Incontrera, Edwige Fenech
description: Don Giovanni is expelled from Seville for having dishonored the wife and daughter of a local noble. The wolf loses its fur but not its vice: first it seduces a nun, then a Berber princess.
notes: Becero sexy Italian-Spanish film, with a touch of swashbuckling. They are all there: Fenech, Bouchet, even Ira von Furstenberg.

title: Camicia nera
actors: Carlo Ninchi, Camillo Pilotto, Febo Mari, Enrico Marroni, Vinicio Sofia

title: Elena sì... ma di Troia
actors: Christa Linder, Don Backy, Petere Landers, Howard Ross, Pupo De Luca
description: Ottone and Savio, vagabonds from Etruria, find themselves on the shores of Ancient Greece in search of bread and adventures. Pretending to be exhausted, they are rescued by Paris and Elena and taken to the palace of Menelaus. The welcome is propitious to take advantage of the lavish lunches and beautiful women, not even excluded Helen, wife of the sovereign who will be kidnapped by Paris and taken to Troy. When he reaches the palace Ulysses, who recognizes the two vagabonds, they are chased away and, after other adventures, they reach the palace of Priam ...
notes: Among the worst comedies unglued, despite Mario Amendola among the screenwriters. Completely forgettable except for the brilliant title.

title: Fra' Tazio da Velletri
actors: Remo Capitani, Glauco Onorato, Christa Linder, Rose Margaret Keil
description: Fra 'Tazio da Velletri is known for being a friar with the talents of a thaumaturge. Messer Nuccio de 'Tornabuoni, in order to win over the wife of the gonfalonier of justice of Florence, spreads the word that he is the religious is also able to drive away the demon of lust from a woman's body. By pretending to be the same friar, he manages to seduce the gonfalonier's wife, meeting unexpected consequences both for him and for Fra 'Tazio.

title: The Godfather Trilogy: 1901-1980
actors: Marlon Brando, Al Pacino, Robert Duvall, James Caan, Diane Keaton
description: Corleone, 1901. Little Vito Andolini witnesses the massacre of his family at the hands of the powerful boss Don Ciccio and to be saved he is emigrated to America, where, due to an oversight, his surname becomes Corleone. After trying to earn to live honestly, Vito gives himself to the underworld together with friends Peter Clemenza and Salvatore Tessio. In a few years of activity, Corleone becomes one of the most important mafia bosses in the city. In 1945 he was reduced to the end of his life by an attack after refusing to go into the trafficking of drugs. To take his place at the head of the family will be Michael, who was the third son who until then had disinterested in family affairs.
notes: The three films of the Sagra de Il Padrino, gathered in a single feature film mounted in chronological order and distributed on the home video market.

title: Heaven's Burning
actors: Russell Crowe, Youki Kudoh, Kenji Isomura, Ray Barrett, Robert Mammone

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Zwei fremde Augen
actors: Henry Arnold, Daniel Smith, Salome Kammer
description: Hermann gets Juan (who failed the conservatory entrance exam) a job as a gym teacher; in the meantime, the two friends think they can make some money by giving concerts in the villas of the rich Munich bourgeoisie, but are immediately disillusioned. Hermann, Juan and Clarissa become more and more intimate; and while the first discovers with horror that his suitcase - containing, among other things, the scores of all his compositions - has been stolen, Juan and the girl go by train to visit her mother. Over time, attractions and jealousies intersect between the three; and luckily, one day, Hermann's suitcase is found ...

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Eifersucht und Stolz
actors: Gisela Müller, Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer
description: Narrative parenthesis on the young Evelyne Cerphal, who in 1961 - after her father's funeral - discovers that she is an illegitimate daughter: disappointed and embittered, she leaves for Munich determined to study music; here she is hosted - rather unwillingly, to tell the truth - by aunt Elisabeth, a mature and rich intellectual who often makes her villa available to artists and musicians. One evening, the filmmakers Reinhard, Stefan and Rob show their documentary on the bombing of Munich: Clarissa and Hermann are also present, always on the razor's edge "between jealousy and pride"; meanwhile Evelyne sympathizes with Ansgar, a medical student ...

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Weihnachtswölfe
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer
description: End of 1963: Clarissa is depressed by the abortion, Hermann is nervous about her music and her absence, compensated by the attentions of the young Schnüsschen. During her concert, Evelyne sings a lied previously composed with Ansgar. Clarissa ends up in hospital with septicemia, and Volker and Jean-Marie - more and more friends - assist her. Stefan and Helga take a trip to the mountains while Schnüsschen and Hermann's relationship continues. At Christmas, Evelyne sings in an empty church, while Clarissa - after a quarrel with her mother - leaves the hospital and takes refuge in Hermann's house: together they write a lied about the impossibility of making their love come true ...

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Das Spiel mit der Freiheit
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer
description: 1962: Hermann is invited by the parents of little Tommy - to whom he gives piano lessons - on a holiday on Sylt. But on June 22, Hermann and Helga are attacked by police in the Schwabing riots. He tries to get compensation for his broken guitar, then decides to go to Sylt: on the way, he visits Helga with her family, in Dulmen, where Dorli offers him hospitality (and not only). Helga and Marianne also contend for Hermann, but the former is hampered by her moralistic grandmother, the latter is married. Hermann then leaves for Sylt, buys his guitar and meets Clarissa, to whom he tells the recent events that happened to him ...

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Die Hochzeit
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer
