description: With the complicity of Elisabeth, who lends her the house, the young Waltraud - called Schnüsschen - gives herself to Hermann and wins him over, even though he always loves Clarissa inside. Which meanwhile, through an audition in Paris, goes on tour in San Francisco. At Hermann and Schnüsschen's wedding, all friends flock to La Tana della Volpe: Helga flirts with a Rhenish trumpet player, Renate arrives with Doctor Bretschneider, Evelyne with an African student, Jean-Marie sings accompanied by Volker on the piano. And Clarissa also arrives, to whom Volker declares his love. At the Cerphal house, meanwhile, Juan tries to kill himself, but Reinhard saves him ...

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Kunst oder Leben
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer
description: Ten years after his arrival in Munich, Hermann would have every reason to feel fulfilled. But her heart is full of restlessness, and yet another, noisy Oktoberfest is the spark that makes her explode: tired of everything, Hermann goes from train to train in search of Clarissa, the true love of his life, always enigmatic and elusive . On the way, he meets Renate and Juan and feels sorry for the modest fate that both of them have had; he sees his wife Schnüsschen and little Lulu again, cold and hostile; on a poster he also sees the face of Helga, wanted as a terrorist of the Baader-Meinhof. And one day, in Amsterdam, he finally finds Clarissa ...

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Zeit des Schweigens
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Peter Weiss, Noemi Steuer
description: Hermann makes ends meet by playing at parties thanks to Clemens' contacts; However, his financial situation improves when consul Handschuh, owner of Isarfilm, offers him to work on the futuristic multimedia project "Varia-Vision" together with Rob. For her part, Helga increases her political commitment by demonstrating against the American presence in Vietnam. But it is the couple's life that doesn't work: both Hermann and Schnüsschen, both Volker and Clarissa are in crisis, and the two women confide in loneliness and frustration. Meanwhile, on the anniversary of Reinhard's death, friends meet on the lake, where Rob films the point of disappearance ...

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Die Zeit der vielen Worte
actors: Henry Arnold, Anke Sevenich, Frank Roth, Carolin Fink
description: The rift between Hermann and his wife intensifies when she enrolls at the university: often, in fact, the girl invites groups of students who treat the landlord as a perfect stranger. In reality, what burns most to Hermann is the fact that Schnüsschen feels fulfilled by dealing with the recovery - however very problematic - of drug addicts. After yet another violent quarrel, the two break up: Hermann leaves for Berlin where he is hosted by Kathrin, who has never hidden her sympathy from him; but the life of the commune doesn't suit him and after some time he returns to Munich, where he finds the empty house ...

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Die Zeit der ersten Lieder
actors: Henry Arnold, Daniel Smith, Franziska Traub, Salome Kammer
description: 1960: Embittered by the end - provoked by family opposition - of his relationship with Klärchen, twelve years his senior, Hermann Simon leaves Schabbach and Hunsrück to move to Munich. Musician and composer (one of his concerts has already been broadcast on the radio), Hermann passes the admission exam to the conservatory; meanwhile, while looking for a room to rent, he makes friends with the talented Chilean flutist Juan and with his fellow countryman Clemens, who plays drums in nightclubs. But despite having sworn to himself not to fall in love anymore, it is the meeting with Clarissa, a cello student, that marks him deeply ...

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Die ewige Tochter
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer
description: The only one who still has access to the Cerphal house is Juan. Elisabeth goes to visit her father, a former Nazi hierarch and publishing magnate, who continues to treat her like a child and entrusts her with the task of recovering material from his office: she is surprised by the police, but is released. Her parent forces her to graduate to inherit everything, while Elisabeth realizes she has lived out of this world. Soon the house will be sold to a company that will make 150 homes. Meanwhile, Hermann returns to the conservatory to receive his diploma, Volker has become a great pianist, Clarissa is back and regains interest in him ...

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Das Ende der Zukunft
actors: László I. Kish, Peter Weiss, Susanne Lothar, Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer
description: 1966: Reinhard returns from Mexico to Monaco and films with Rob what is left of the Lair of the Fox. He meets old friends and undergoes the assaults of the fifteen-year-old Trixi, sister of the editor Dagmar, who wants to be the protagonist of his new film, but he leaves for Venice. Clarissa gives birth to Albert, Volker's son, who is increasingly in love with her. Hermann writes a requiem for the Burrow. In Venice, Reinhard meets Esther Goldbaum, falls in love with her and writes her film while she takes photographs. Back in Munich, he is attacked by Trixi, furious because her share has gone to Olga. Boating from Rob, Reinhard falls into the water and drowns ...

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Ansgar Tod
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer
description: Evelyne and Ansgar's relationship continues, despite the boy being haunted by strange omens of death. To stave off the anxiety, Ansgar takes a drug that also passes to Evelyne. The young man feels a failure, no longer attends medical school, finds work as a tram driver and definitively breaks off relations with his parents. Clarissa says goodbye to Hermann, with whom she remains friends, and retires to study music in the villa of Doctor Georg, the family doctor who has always loved her; however she binds herself to the musician Volker. As Hermann's neighborhood is about to be demolished, Ansgar dies in a stupid accident ...

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend - Kennedys Kinder
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer
description: Elisabeth Cerphal's villa also hosts Alex, a billed philosophy student, among others. Hermann is busy advertising the ultra-modern music concert he is preparing: the always in love - but rejected - Helga helps him. Clarissa takes a loan from Hermann, who directs her to Jean-Marie and Volker. The two, who have both had an affair with her, discover that she is pregnant and wants to have an abortion, and provide her with the necessary money. Hermann, Juan and the young Schnüsschen go to see _Cleopatra_ at the cinema, while Helga attempts suicide. Meanwhile, the news of Kennedy's assassination arrives: it is November 23, 1963 ...

title: Im Juli.
actors: Moritz Bleibtreu, Christiane Paul, Mehmet Kurtulus, Idil Üner

title: Jubilee
actors: Jenny Runacre, Nell Campbell, Jordan, Toyah Wilcox, Ian Charleson

title: L'oeuvre au noir
actors: Gian Maria Volonté, Anna Karina, Sami Frey, Philippe Léotard

title: Panique
actors: Viviane Romance, Michel Simon, Max Dalban, Emile Drain, Guy Favières
description: On the outskirts of Paris, an old maid is murdered. Anyone talking about the murder, except the misanthrope Mr. Hire. That same evening Alice, just out of jail, meets again with her lover Alfred. The two act as if they don't know each other, also because Alice has gone to jail to protect Alfred. Mr. Hire, however, falls in love with Alice and also knows who the killer is ...

title: Papa Giovanni XXIII
actors: Edward Asner, Claude Rich, Michael Mendl, Franco Interlenghi
description: Life of Cardinal Roncalli, patriarch of Venice who, on the death of Pius XII, goes to Rome without having any intention of becoming Pope. Due to differences over his name, the Conclave decides to appoint him Pope. Once in office, Roncalli launches the Second Vatican Council to renew the Church.

title: Io zombo, tu zombi, lei zomba
actors: Duilio Del Prete, Renzo Montagnani, Cochi Ponzoni, Nadia Cassini
description: A gravedigger, while about to dig a grave witnesses an accident in which a cyclist, a doctor and a traveling salesman are killed. The man, passionate about horror, by reciting a formula turns them into zombies. Having become a living dead, he too joins the three in search of victims.
notes: Pure trash.

title: We Were Strangers
actors: Jennifer Jones, John Garfield, Pedro Armendariz, Gilbert Roland, Ramon Novarro
description: In 1930s Cuba, a revolutionary group led by an American of Cuban origins plans to kill the dictator Machado. The attempt fails and their guide is killed by the police, but the seeds of the revolt have been sown.
notes: Huston's courageous film (which deserves credit for having dared to make a pro-Cuban film in the darkest years of McCarthyism) that was snubbed at home, with a notable engaging charge and a great ideal drive.

title: The Prophecy 3: The Ascent
actors: Christopher Walken, Vincent Spano, Dave Buzzotta, Kayren Butler
description: The fallen angel Zophael, emissary of the cherubs who rebelled against God in heaven, must kill Danyael, a unique creature half man and half angel, who according to legend could be the only one able to stop the new Antichrist. Surprisingly, Gabriel, the humanized archangel as a punishment, decides to side with the "good guys" ...
notes: Third episode of the saga begun by Gregory Widen with the surprising _The last prophecy_. A weakened archangel Gabriel (still played by Walken, here with awkward hair), however, drags the entire operation into the abyss of useless sequels. The film was released directly on home video.

title: Psych-Out
actors: Susan Strasberg, Dean Stockwell, Jack Nicholson, Bruce Dern
description: Jenny Davis is a deaf girl, who flees from the hospice/reformatory in which she was forced to live in order to go in search of her brother Steve, who disappeared in the Hippy neighborhood of San Francisco Haight-Ashbury. The leader of the Rock Mumblin 'Jim, Stoney complex complex, the girl who falls in love will think about her.

title: The Salamander
actors: Franco Nero, Anthony Quinn, Martin Balsam, Sybil Danning

title: La grande séduction
actors: Raymond Bouchard, David Boutin, Benoît Brière, Bruno Blanchet, Pierre Collin
description: Germain, a resident of Saint-Marie-La Mauderne, a small fishing village who lives only thanks to government aid, decides to take matters into his own hands and help his fellow citizens. A small factory could be opened in the village, but there needs to be a doctor. When a young doctor shows up to spend an entire month in Saint-Marie, Germain collects information about him to be able to satisfy his every wish. And so all the inhabitants make every effort to ensure that man decides to settle in the village.
notes: The plot is that of many contemporary English comedies, perhaps more _Awake Ned_ than _Thank you Mrs Thatcher_. Even if the unattainable model remains Harold Ramis, the neo-Preston Sturges of _Ricomincio da capo_. Quaint characters, beautiful views, musical refrain, and of course the beauty of the place. All predictable from the start, all vaguely poetic and sugary. You never get bored, the gags are all phone calls, the film runs pleasant, polite and useless until the end.

title: Amore e morte nel giardino degli dei
actors: Erika Blanc, Peter Lee Lawrence, Ezio Marano, Orchidea De Santis
description: The brothers Manfredi and Azzurra, abandoned to themselves by their parents, live a murky love relationship from an early age. When the girl gets married, the brother goes crazy. Manfredi does not know that in reality Azzurra ...
notes: The film falls far short of his intellectual ambitions and ends up being too boring.

title: The Butterfly Effect
actors: Ashton Kutcher, Amy Smart, Kevin Schmidt, Melora Walters, Elden Henson
description: Evan Treborn has lost the memory of time. His childhood is marked by a series of terrifying events involving his friends Kayleigh, Lenny and Tommy, but which he cannot remember. Encouraged by the psychologist and his mother, however, he kept a diary from an early age in which he records his life in detail. After many years, he reads it casually and suddenly finds himself thrown into the past: he is a child, but with an adult mind. This is why he thinks he can intervene on events to change the present.
notes: The idea of ??the temporal paradox married to chaos theory was a prelude to interesting results and the beginning of the film seemed to confirm this hypothesis. Then _The Butterfly Effect_ tends to take itself too seriously and occasionally falters in some temporal junctions. Neither does the fame of the new star Ashton Kutcher, rather insignificant in this test as a dramatic actor, help.

title: Beyond Borders
actors: Angelina Jolie, Clive Owen, Teri Polo, Linus Roache, Noah Emmerich
description: 1984. Naive American Sarah Jordan lives a hushed existence in England. Her world is turned upside down when Doctor Nick Callahan sneaks into a benefit ball to appeal for African children. Attracted by Nick and his cause, Sarah abandons her London comforts for the harsh reality of Africa, Cambodia and Chechnya to work alongside the man who awakened her passion for life.
notes: Already with the incredible opening scene we know what to expect in the spectacularization of pain. The tour takes place with ease, you do not miss anything: starvation deaths and pristine landscapes, horns and guerrillas, ethnic cleansing and illegitimate children. A cartoon that is basically _My Africa_ with the UN instead of safaris, and explains nothing of the conflicts it exhibits.

title: Cold Creek Manor
actors: Dennis Quaid, Sharon Stone, Stephen Dorff, Juliette Lewis, Kristen Stewart, Ryan Wilson, Dana Eskelson
description: Tired of the chaos of the city, Cooper Tilson, wife Leah and children Kristen and Jesse move to a large house in the woods of New York state. The home they bought, Cold Creek Manor, was once an elegant and prestigious home, but is now in a state of total neglect. The Tilson spouses do not lose heart and decide to restructure it. Everything seems to be going well until a series of disturbing incidents cause the new tenants to investigate who lived in that house before them.
notes: You can watch the film with your eyes closed: you know exactly what happens. The trouble is, this is less than ordinary predictability. Figgis, who is not already a great author, is completely invisible. The suspense is pre-cooked, of those from the freezer and to be defrosted at the appropriate time. The actors load the acting and widen their eyes, and get to the end. By comparison, Kaplan's Abuse of Power (whose memory is not atrocious) is a Siodmak finesse.

title: Wonderland
actors: Val Kilmer, Lisa Kudrow, Kate Bosworth, Dylan McDermott, Josh Lucas
description: On Wonderland Avenue, in the summer of 1981, a heinous crime is committed: four people who are participating in a cocaine-based party are brutally murdered. In the investigation, the "king of porn" John Holmes turns out to be the main suspect. At the time of the facts, at just 37, Holmes is on the verge of physical and financial decline. He has a wife, Sharon, and a teenage girlfriend, Down Schiller, and in addition to having close relationships with many drug dealers, he has ties to gangster Eddy Nash.
notes: A film like _Wonderland_ is not unwatchable, but useless, superficial, banal. And, in the end, uninteresting. Which is really bad, if you think about the story told, on very juicy paper. In the early 1980s, porn star John Holmes, already on sunset boulevard, is involved in the Los Angeles Wonderland Avenue murders, a massacre involving a drug, money, and pimp story. For those who don't remember: it is the episode touched by _Boogie Nights_ in the sequence with Alfred Molina. If director Cox, also co-writer, does not gloss over Holmes' real participation in the event, and, let's face it, shoots a scene of multiple murders and functional fury, very hard and ultrabloody, it is the general construction, and the idea of ??cinema that it follows (or that produces it, which is the same), to disappoint. Are we talking about "funky" years, psychotic characters, heroin, guns and the like? So it's a sketchy montage, split-screen, (de) saturated photography, psychotic acting, funky soundtrack. In short, all the food that one would expect is here pitted with a conventionality that becomes a way without problems (and it would be interesting to ask ourselves about the sources that led such a staging towards a now codified mannerism). _Auto Focus_ was really something else. Kilmer works hard, but it matters little.

title: Something's Gotta Give
actors: Jack Nicholson, Diane Keaton, Frances McDormand, Keanu Reeves, Amanda Peet, Jon Favreau
description: Harry Sanborn is an unrepentant bachelor who only dates women under thirty. While spending a romantic weekend with Marin, his latest flame in her mother's beach house suffers a heart attack. Marin's mother, Erica Barry, a successful playwright, reluctantly agrees to take care of the man who, on the advice of the young doctor who is treating him, cannot leave the house. As time goes on, Harry feels inexplicably attracted to Erica, but he's not alone. Even the doctor courts her ...
notes: Nancy Meyers shoots all the verve, irony and ailments of the unusual couple in the first forty minutes, where the two protagonists and Frances McDormand (her feminist sister) give their best. But the jokes thin out when the romance takes over. And unfortunately the film lasts two hours and seven minutes.

title: The President's Man: A Line in the Sand
actors: Chuck Norris, Robert Urich, Judson Mills, Jennifer Tung, Roxanne Hart, Joel Swetow
description: The secret agent Joshua McCord, right-hand man of American President Adam Mayfield, is grappling with a very delicate case for the security of the country: after breaking into a museum, a handful of terrorists managed to recover the components necessary manufacture of a nuclear device, which were hidden inside some statues. Having learned of the plan, the military attempted to arrest the charismatic leader of the group, but remedied a failure: it was then up to McCord to infiltrate the enemy ranks and disarm the bomb, thus preventing the destruction of an entire metropolis ...

title: Rasen
actors: Koichi Sato, Miki Nakatani, Yutaka Matsushige, Hinako Saeki

title: The Big Green
actors: Olivia D'Abo, Steve Guttenberg, Jay O. Sanders, John Terry, Chauncey Leopardi
description: Anna, a young English primary school teacher, moves to the USA. When she arrives at the school that has been assigned to her, she realizes that her children have lost enthusiasm: to cheer them up, she decides to create a "soccer" team that can participate in the championship. Fundamental will be the help of Sheriff Tom Palmer ...

title: Two-Lane Blacktop
actors: James Taylor, Dennis Wilson, Warren Oates, Laurie Bird, David Drake
description: The Mechanic and the Driver, aboard their souped-up 1955 Chevrolet, travel the highways of the southwestern United States with the sole purpose of participating in clandestine races. One day they meet Gto, nicknamed because he drives a Ferrari Gto, and they challenge him to get to Washington by giving away their Chevrolet. Eventually Gto will leave with the Girl who for some time had followed the Mechanic and the Pilot.
notes: A road movie that distorts all the canons of the genre and which best represents the alienation of man in Nixon's America. The two protagonists are singer James Taylor and _Beach Boys_ drummer Dennis Wilson.

title: Tarzan's New York Adventure
actors: Johnny Weissmuller, Maureen O'Sullivan, Virginia Grey, Paul Kelly

title: Zemlja
actors: Stepan Shkurat, Semen Svasenko, Julija Solnceva, Elena Maksimova, Nikolaj Nademskij, Vasilij Krasenko
description: We are towards the end of the 1920s, in Ukraine, where - as in the rest of the USSR - the collectivization of the lands is being put in the population, not without friction in the population. It is in this context that the story of the young farmer Vasilij takes place, which is fought for the modernization of agricultural production means and for collectivization. He will meet the death at the hands of another young man like him, hostile to change.

title: Terror House
actors: Linda Gillen, Arthur Space, John Neilson, Mary Jackson, Michael Macready
description: Regina is a college student who discovers she has won a vacation at the Red Wolf Inn. Even before communicating the good news to her parents, the owners of the inn send a means of transport to get her to the place, where she is in the company of two young women and an elderly couple. The hotel is magnificent but one of the guests disappears without a trace.

title: Kamigami no fukaki yokubo
actors: Kazuo Kitamura, Rentaro Mikuni, Choichiro Kawarazaki, Yoshi Kato
description: Engineer Kariya arrives from Tokyo to Kurage, an imaginary island in southwestern Japan, to dig a water well for a sugar factory. The contact with the locals (especially Ryu Ryugen, the head of the island community, and Nekichi, who has been digging a hole in the ground for twenty years to atone for the incest consumed with his sister Uma), linked to primitive pantheistic cults, it will undermine his rational spirit.
notes: Imamura and co-screenwriter Keiji Hasebe tackle the conflict between archaic and modern and draw from it a powerful and visionary work, one of the greatest in the filmography of the Japanese author.

title: La rivincita di Natale
actors: Diego Abatantuono, Carlo Delle Piane, Alessandro Haber, Gianni Cavina, George Eastman, Edoardo Romano, Osvaldo Ruggieri, Carlo Reali, Eliana Miglio, Augusto Zucchi, Nino Fuscagni, Vanessa Gallipoli
description: Fifteen years after the Christmas Eve card game in which he lost 550 million lire, Franco Mattioli returns to Bologna because he learned that his friend Lele - a film critic by profession, present at the fateful game (he had managed to win 500 thousand lire) - has an incurable disease. In all these years Franco has continually thought about the game and now he knows that the time has come for a rematch. For this he decides to convince the people present in 1986 (as well as Lele, Ugo Cavara, Stefano Bertoni and Antonio Santelia) to play again.
notes: Another Christmas night to be desecrated, like seventeen years before when a poker game ended at 5:30 in the morning which forced Franco to leave postdated checks for over five hundred million old lire. The ruin or the rebirth? It is the night of revenge, of redemption, of a past to be closed and from which to move away and above all - as the quote from Cioran warns at the beginning of the film - of revenge, of the soul, in any case, poisoned. Pupi Avati is the dealer who finds his characters and his talented actors (Diego Abatantuono, Gianni Cavina, Alessandro Haber, George Eastman and Carlo Delle Piane), naturally transformed by time, refined in technique and very well directed, to close the game of a lifetime. To answer that compelling question that flashes at the end of every good story: now what will happen to the protagonists? What will they do? Where will they go? Who will they meet? Will they change? The cinema has devised the sequel gimmick to sell answers and gadgets. Avati, on the other hand, thinks of a classic literary tradition, he knows how to auscultate the hearts of the protagonists and he knows how to imagine their moves, the signs of agreement, the wounds, the frustrations, the desire for revenge, the intention to balance the accounts with destiny. cynical and cheater. The gamble of a blind bet, the risk of a raise, bluffing and deceit are "accidents" and quite normal expedients in the condensed existence of cinematic characters and also occur in the most relaxed of spectators. This connection gives poker a metaphorical charm that Avati, as an excellent director, can describe and propose with a precise, incisive, tight touch. Its plot, in which the flashbacks are taken from Christmas Present, has many similarities with a game full of surprises, of details (the references to cinema go beyond the multiplexes owned by Franco or the use in Cineteca di Lele), of nuances and overturns. A game hand can be folded. Time, with a shadow of pessimism, passes through it and grabs all the stakes.

title: De reditu - Il ritorno
actors: Elia Shilton, Rodolfo Corsato, Romuald Andrzej Klos, Marco Beretta, Roberto Herlitzka
description: 5th century. In the aftermath of the sack of Rome by the Goths, Rutilio Namaziano, ex praefectus Urbi, leaves Rome and returns to his Gaul by sea because the consular roads are not safe. Rutilio faces the dangerous journey to try to unite men and weapons and thus overturn the government of Ravenna, emblem of the crisis in which the Roman Empire has plunged. But the malaise is generalized and also affects the consciences of individuals. This is what Rutilio learns from the indifference and betrayal of the friends to whom he turns, hoping at least for moral help.
notes: Today Bondì, a former pupil of Rossellini and television director, films an adaptation of the text by Rutilio Namanziano which looks precisely at the model of the television Rossellini, and thus emerges as a UFO in today's Italian cinema. The economic poverty of the staging is at times bleak (even if the film is "of national cultural interest" and therefore financed by the state), the casting is not always right, some lapses of taste leave us perplexed (the slow motion of the horses). The effort of attention that the film requires is not compensated by the particular intensity of the gaze. The film is partly saved by some well-chosen sets, and the final episode with the notable Herlitzka who, outdated by the times, commits a stoic suicide.

title: Osama
actors: Marina Golbahari, Arif Herati, Zubaida Sahar, Gol Rahman Ghorbandi
description: Kabul, Taliban regime. Maria, a twelve-year-old girl, to support her family left without boys, cuts her hair and disguises herself as a man, calling herself Osama. Discovered and imprisoned, the girl is sentenced to be stoned, but then pardoned and entrusted to an old mullah, a kind of ogre, who takes her into the house along with the other wives.
notes: The model of the film seems to be that of the "Iranian school", with its programmatic interweaving of reality and fiction. Instead the director, who makes his debut in the feature film, relaxes the pace and dedicates himself to narrating an exemplary story, with a clear metaphorical character. Caméra d'Or in Cannes in 2003 as best first film.

title: Bon voyage
actors: Isabelle Adjani, Gérard Depardieu, Virginie Ledoyen, Grégori Dérangère, Yvan Attal, Peter Coyote
description: In June 1940, people flee from Paris, which was now occupied by the Germans. Spies, actresses and journalists meet in Bordeaux ... The writer Frédéric on the run because he is accused of a murder he did not commit (but did not reveal the truth so as not to denounce the beautiful Viviane, a successful actress and lover of the powerful) knows Camille , assistant to a scientist. He'll help the girl get the professor out of France before the Germans get their hands on her important discoveries.
notes: The film mixes the light-hearted tones of comedy with the gloomy hues of history with rapid, precise, sometimes tasty characterizations, sometimes studied at the table.

title: Tarzan's Secret Treasure
actors: Johnny Weissmuller, Maureen O'Sullivan, Johnny Sheffield, Reginald Owen

title: Le testament d'Orphée
actors: Jean Cocteau, Maria Casarès, François Périer, Jean Marais, Nicole Courcel

title: Traktoristy
actors: Nikolai Kryuchkov, Boris Andreyev, Marina Ladynina, Pyotr Alejnikov
description: On the farm Mar'jana she is famous for being tireless: no one beats her with a plow. Besieged by suitors, the girl does not seem interested in finding a husband so she pretends to be engaged to her accomplice Nazar, one of the most slack peasants. Meanwhile, the supervisor asks the good Klim to join Nazar to help him, without knowing that he is secretly in love with Maryana ...
notes: Ivan Pyryev has always tried to react to the formalism of Ejzenstejn's nature. To do this he has made many comedies where the rural environment becomes the scene of peasant loves and collective songs, alongside entertainment and propaganda. _The tractor drivers_ is an excellent example of this.

title: Simple Men
actors: Robert John Burke, Bill Sage, Karen Sillas, Elina Löwensohn, Martin Donovan, Holly Marie Combs, Chris Cooke, Jeffrey Howard, Joe Stevens, Damian Young, Mark Chandler Bailey
description: After years of separation, the McCabe brothers (Bill, a sleazy and vaguely misogynist thug, and the younger Dennis, a staid and introverted philosophy student) travel the streets of New York together in search of their father, a former baseball champion and avowed anarchist. , on whose head hangs a charge of multiple homicide. Along the way, the two will meet the energetic bartender Kate (with whom Bill will fall in love), the enigmatic and epileptic Elina and a bevy of other bizarre characters ...
notes: With his estranged and "Godardian" style, restless and unconventional, the New York author removes the veil from the false myths of America and the relations between the sexes.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
actors: Matt Frewer, Kenneth Welsh, Jason London, Emma Campbell
description: In an isolated moor in the English countryside stands the Baskerville mansion, in which for over three centuries a ferocious and diabolical mastiff has sowed terror. The family estate is inherited by the young Sir Henry, who as soon as he arrives from Canada receives death threats and asks for Holmes' protection ...

title: The Sign of Four
actors: Matt Frewer, Kenneth Welsh, Sophie Lorain, Michael Perron
description: Each year, a mysterious benefactor delivers a priceless pearl to young Mary. One day, the stranger asks her for a meeting: at the appointment, Mary - accompanied by Sherlock Holmes and Watson - finds the writer Thaddeus Sholto, who tells the three of them the story of a fabulous hidden treasure ...

title: Rupan sansei: Majutsu-ou no isan
description: A journalist meets Jigen in a bar, who tells her how - ten years earlier - she had met Lupine. It all started when the thief decided to steal a cylinder containing a manuscript from a powerful underworld boss, on which was written the formula for creating an indestructible metal ...

title: Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter
actors: Erich Anderson, Crispin Glover, Kimberly Beck, Barbara Howard

title: Friday the 13th, Part VII: The New Blood
actors: Lar Park Lincoln, Terry Kiser, Susan Blue, Kevin Blair, Susan Sullivan

title: War of the Colossal Beast
actors: Sally Fraser, Roger Pace, Duncan 'Dean' Parkin, Russ Bender

title: Warlock: The Armageddon
actors: Julian Sands, Chris Young, Paula Marshall, Joanna Pacula, Steve Kahan
description: Every six hundred years, a satanic force has the opportunity to free itself: a configuration made up of five stones is able to both enact Evil and banish it from the Earth for another six centuries. Then there is an order of Druids, engaged in a fierce fight against an evil Warlock ...
notes: A very useless sequel to the first (and discreet) _Warlock_, directed in 1989 by Steve Miner: of the original cast, only Julian Sands remained of the game, while Lori Singer and Richard E. Grant have seen fit to slip away. For his part, the director Hickox seems to have subscribed to the sequels: the previous year, in fact, he had directed _Hellraiser III_.

title: Rupan sansei: arukatorazu konnekishion
description: Lupine III is in San Francisco to break into the safe of a floating casino run by criminals. By chance he learns that, on the bottom of the bay near Alcatraz, there is a ship loaded with gold, sunk in the second half of the 19th century. The cunning thief and his friends throw themselves into this new venture.

title: Blowback
actors: Mario Van Peebles, James Remar, Sharisse Baker-Bernard, Gladys Jimenez
description: Thanks to his religious background, Inspector Morrell managed to capture Whitman, a psychotic killer with mystical inclinations. However, he is freed by the CIA, which intends to make him a contract killer: but Whitman escapes custody and resumes sowing death ...
notes: The cast is discreet, but the story is known.

title: My Life Without Me
actors: Sarah Polley, Scott Speedman, Deborah Harry, Mark Ruffalo, Leonor Watling, Amanda Plummer
description: Ann is twenty-three, has two young daughters, a husband who is often unemployed, a mother who hates the world and a father who has spent the last ten years in prison. The girl lives in a trailer parked in her mother's yard and does cleaning at night at the university she would have liked to attend. After a medical check-up, her life changes completely: from that day Ann discovers that she loves everything around her.
notes: The protagonist does not intend to make pacts or exorcise or control death and the director does not seem to want tenderness. The actors, from Sarah Polley to Amanda Plummer, are, for the camera, naked faces.

title: Le barzellette
actors: Max Giusti, Gigi Proietti, Carlo Buccirosso, Enzo Salvi, Biagio Izzo, Massimiliano Cavallari, Bruno Arena, Chiara Noschese
description: The jokes are about everything and everyone: love, sex, friendship, marriage, death, history ... We thus pass from Spain to the North Pole, from Michelangelo to the Queen of England. But there is also room for extraterrestrials, doctors, lawyers, junkies, farmers, vacation convicts ...
notes: Joke cinema has always been synonymous with vulgar vulgarity, barracks moods, progressive shifts in the pleasure that becomes meat for slaughter. It was therefore a bet, that of the Vanzina brothers: to cinematically revive the stories that for centuries have inhabited, crowded and crossed the boot, without falling into the trap, into easy shortcuts, into the "comfort" of jokes. And from the very first scene, we understand that the challenge is, if not won, at least up to the ambitions. Le jokes is a film in episodes that intersect: a ploy if you want classic, but well thought out, linked to frames and funny catchphrases, at the moment of grace of Er Cipolla (alias Enzo Salvi), to the defilippiano (side Peppino) Buccirosso, to the surreal congenital madness of Marco Messeri, in our opinion the best of a group that, elsewhere, wallows only in the pure profession (from Proietti downwards). The most boring corner is that of the couple from the Marche and perhaps not by chance: jokes are beautiful when ... they don't last long (and instead Max Giusti prefers them to anything else, including sex). A little big business almost completely completed. The target, albeit easy, is hit. The message is closed: "There is power ...".

title: Mon oncle
actors: Jacques Tati, Jean-Pierre Zola, Adrienne Servantie, Alain Bécourt
description: While the imperturbable Monsieur Hulot continues to live in a picturesque and warm working-class neighborhood, his sister has married the manager of a plastic object factory; the couple has a little son, Gérard, who grows up in a hyper-technological house full of all modern devilry. The efforts of relatives to adapt Hulot to their lifestyle have unsuccessful results: indeed, it is Gérard himself who proves to be fascinated by the upset and confusing uncle ...
notes: Five years after _The holidays ..._, Tati plays again the role of his alter ego, inaugurating the satirical digs that will inspire the following _Playtime_ and _Trafic_.

title: To livadi pou dakrizi
actors: Alexandra Aidini, Nikos Poursanidis, Giorgos Armenis, Vasilis Kolosov
description: 1921: the Red Army enters Odessa causing the exodus of all foreigners. The Greek community returns to its homeland and settles on the estuary of the great river that flows into the Mediterranean. Alexis and Heleni discover they love each other, but his father, a widower, wants to marry the same girl. So the two young people take refuge in Thessaloniki; time passes and they become parents of two children, but misery forces a separation: Alexis leaves for America ...
notes: With admirable fidelity, Angelopoulos returns to themes and atmospheres dear to him: the poetic reinterpretation of the history of the twentieth century, Europe as a place of transits and nomadism (even tragic), the impotent and sublime role of Art. Nothing new, of course, compared to what has already been said (in a more rigorous and innovative way) at the time of _La recita_. Compared to many of his recent films, however, the director emphasizes the side of historical narration rather than the (dangerous) poetic flights. The result is more structured, concrete, fascinating. The quiet epic of the accordionist flows fluvial to melodies of yesteryear. You may or may not love him, but Angelopoulos is a giant among dwarves.

title: Mi piace lavorare - Mobbing
actors: Nicoletta Braschi, Camille Dugay Comencini, Stefano Colace, Marian Serban
description: Since the company where she works as an accountant is taken over by a multinational company, a real ordeal has begun for Anna - who lives with her daughter Morgana. Everyone is hostile to her and the harassment begins, small but inexorable: the personnel manager entrusts her with new tasks, all of little importance or aimed at putting her in a bad light in the eyes of colleagues, while her place is occupied by another person. ..
notes: Places and work relationships are sets, relationships and declinations of power from which Italian cinema distances itself and for which it does not find - and often does not even seek - the right words, times and cuts. The formal, stylistic and cultural problem connected to this frequent productive removal concerns the question of realism and reality. It is not a question of sustaining a "vague" of postmodern neorealism: it is a question of not ignoring the real as a field of action, of pragmatic and psychological dynamics, an inexhaustible reserve of social dramaturgies. Comencini and her collaborators are very good at staging a story of mobbing which is a "montage" of many lived events, making it a point of contact, prudent and participatory, between documentary and fiction: actors and non-actors, direction and shadowing of actions, script and personal experiences reworked for the camera. The plot and the circularity between cinema and home runs have a single, clear point of view: the work continues to ennoble people and make them less fragile.

title: Cold Mountain
actors: Jude Law, Nicole Kidman, Renée Zellweger, Donald Sutherland
description: America, 1860. Soldier Inman, wounded in battle, embarks on a difficult return journey to return to his beloved Ada. Meanwhile, the woman finds herself having to prevent, by herself, that her father's farm ends up in ruins. Help comes from a tramp named Ruby who teaches her what strength and self-confidence are.
notes: Packer of stories of twisted passions on epic or vintage backgrounds, the Englishman Anthony Minghella (who found the means for his somewhat high-sounding and very polished cinema in Hollywood) makes his best film with Cold Mountain, more homogeneous than The English Patient and less pretentious than Mr. Ripley's Talent. Perhaps because the novel by Charles Frazier from which it is based offers him all the necessary stereotypes prepackaged, perhaps because the Civil War is by definition romantic, the fact is that here Minghella is not forced to get involved in narrative flights or to seek alibis for the popularity of story. Which is declared and explicit: a rough Southerner boy and a cultured "southern belle" meet, fall in love, declare and are immediately separated by the war; for three years, he lives in the horrors of battle, she waits for him, the letters of both are lost, she becomes impoverished and is forced to face a new life of hardships, he tries to go home. The film begins in 1864, on the Petersburg field, just before Inman deserted from the Confederate army to return to Cold Mountain, and the stories proceed parallel: flashbacks of their love, his journey, studded with encounters, ambushes and unexpected aid. , the hardships of Ada, besieged by poverty and southern jackals (but the Northerners are no less) and supported by the vigor of an unexpected companion, a vagabond named Ruby. Minghella masters the different temporal planes of the tale; realizes an effective glimpse of the battle, dominated by the sense of death, horror, uselessness; it has a beautiful visionary glimpse (the scene in which Ada looks at her destiny in a well, through the mirror); calibrates twists, emotions, characters. In _Cold Mountain_ there is everything you expect and every moment has the outcome you expect. A little too much, and above all too diluted, told, "phoned". What seems to be missing is the heartbreaking passion of the real mélo, the epic feeling of the real war film. We therefore remain dry-eyed, as if in front of a good, somewhat wordy television product.

title: My Boss's Daughter
actors: Ashton Kutcher, Tara Reid, Terence Stamp, Jon Abrahams, Molly Shannon
description: Tom works for an advertising company and would like to join the creative group. The bad relationship he has with his boss Jack doesn't help him realize his dream. The opportunity to be appreciated comes when Jack asks Tom to spend the night at his house to check on his daughter Lisa. Jack who is in love with the girl accepts with enthusiasm, but will have to deal with unexpected guests.
notes: The director, one of the Zucker brothers, the parody wizards of the '80s and' 90s, strives to show a lively spirit, create some visual gags, and set a decent pace. But he completely fails all his good intentions.

title: La lettera
actors: Vittoria Belvedere, Gianni Federico, Dino Abbrescia, Timothy Martin
description: Everything falls apart in Margherita's carefree life when her father is arrested on suspicion of being involved in Tangenotopoli. Left alone, the girl takes refuge in a small town in the Aspromonte where she teaches in elementary schools. One day, he and his pupils write a letter in English in response to a request for correspondence chosen at random from an American newspaper. After a few weeks the answer arrives: to write it is George, a young red man imprisoned on death row.
notes: It is not known what is worse, in this mess that is among the worst films of the year: the lopsided construction (with a useless prologue and secondary plots forcibly inserted), or the affected and rhetorical dialogues? The characters, walking stereotypes? Is the direction of the actors, whether excited or woody, terrible, and the style of the direction alternates sloppiness with surges from video clips with digital effects in the least opportune moments? Unfair in the use of children and in mobilizing all possible "big themes", the film would also cause indignation. But it's not worth it, because it hardly came out in the hall. On the other hand, he used public funds for beginners.

title: The Man Who Saw Tomorrow
description: Robert Guenette uses a selection of dramatic scenes, archival images, clips and news from period television to ask himself: which prophecies of Nostradamus, a French astrologer who lived in the sixteenth century, have come true?
notes: In the original version the voiceover is that of Orson Welles.

title: The Turn of the Screw
actors: Claire Szekeres, Joseph England, Patsy Kensit, Julian Sands, Joseph England, Claire Szekeres, Stéphane Audran
description: Mr. Cooper, a young aristocrat, hires a nanny Jenny to take care of Flora and Miles, her orphaned grandchildren. Soon the girl realizes that the kids are possessed by a spirit and ends up suffering the evil influence too.
notes: Acceptable film based on Henry James' Turn of the Screw.

title: Maid in Sweden
actors: Christina Lindberg, Per-Axel Arosenius, Monika Ekman, Krister Ekman
description: Inga, little more than a teenager, is a provincial student Ligia to his duties, tired of a life that consists in going to the cinema twice a week in the company of peers as silly as they are not very attractive, invited by his sister, a brisk girl and emancipated who lives with a friend, goes to Stockholm, near the same. Agitated by the thrills and disturbances that seem dangerously indefinable to her, crowned - dragged above all by the example of her sister - abandon itself to morally and painful disastrous experiences psychologically. The relationship with a young sculptor leaves his sister indifferent who, however, struggles herself

title: Masterminds
actors: Vincent Kartheiser, Katie Stuart, Patrick Stewart, Brenda Fricker
description: Ozzie, sixteen, is a computer genius. Expelled from school for his stunts (virtual and otherwise), he returns secretly to send the internal network into a tailspin. While in the building, however, the institute's security expert, hired to block Ozzy's cyber offensives, reveals his true intentions: to kidnap 10 students and ask for a millionaire ransom.
notes: Embarrassing staging by the director of _Battaglia per la Terra_, which, among other things, is out of time (this kind of film was a classic of the 80s). It's just a pity that the good Patrick Stewart also ended up in the trap.

title: Il fiacre n. 13 (Delitto)
actors: Leonardo Cortese, Vera Carmi, Roldano Lupi, Ginette Leclerc, Sandro Ruffini
description: The countess of Latour leaves everything to her son Filippo, disinheriting Giorgio, the most reckless. He kills his brother and makes his son disappear too, but an innocent person is accused of the crime. Years later, the family requests a review of the trial, but the papers have disappeared.
notes: First part of the feuilleton in two episodes directed by Mario Mattoli.

title: Cinderella II: Dreams Come True
description: Helped by the fairy Smemorina, the mice decide to give Cinderella a book written by them and containing three different stories. In the first of these, Cinderella remains alone at the Prince's castle and finds herself managing her new life as a court. In the second, the little mouse Giac asks Smemorina's fairy to be transformed into a man. Finally, in the third, Cinderella helps her half-sister Anastasia, who has fallen in love with a baker.

title: Invincible
actors: Billy Zane, Byron Mann, Stacy Oversier, Tory Kittles, Dominic Purcell
description: Os (Billy Zane) is a martial arts expert whose life purpose is to form a group of misfits to fight absolute evil. Once a member of a group of angels of darkness who aim to destroy the Earth, Hos changed his life and put his immortality at the service of humanity.

title: Relative Values
actors: Edward Atterton, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Julie Andrews, William Baldwin, Sophie Thompson
description: Nigel, Earl of Marshwood, returns home accompanied by his new wife Miranda, a famous Hollywood actress. To marry him, she had to leave Don Lucas, her colleague and companion. The woman has to contend with the mother-in-law.
notes: Good example of filmed theater taken from Noel Coward's _Milord gets married_.

title: Primo amore
actors: Michela Cescon, Vitaliano Trevisan
description: Vittorio is troubled and restless, and he can only love a woman if she falls within her strict aesthetic canons: that is, if she is extremely thin. Sonia volunteers, she is socially attentive, but she is almost inexplicably attracted to Vittorio's dark side ...
notes: "Hallucinatory journey" in the darkness of a sick relationship, in which the ambiguity of a passion, the mystery of a symbiosis, the contortions of two psychologies that do not give up to normality, and that perhaps of our world, are most fascinating "anthropocentric" (because the body and the satisfaction of its needs are the basis of the concept of consumption) are both unhappy slaves. More cerebral than the previous _The embalmer_, but still dense and painful, necessary for our now asphyxiated visions. Cescon lost 15 kilos during the shooting, the protagonist-writer Trevisan is a presence that disturbs and affects.

title: Les enfants de la pluie
description: Two peoples have always faced each other: the Pyross, sun worshipers for whom water is only death and desolation, and the Hydross, the children of rain who in the dry season are transformed into stone statues. The war between the Pyross and Hydross seems destined to never end, but one day Skän, a young fire warrior sets his gaze on the beautiful Kallisto, of the enemy faction.
notes: French animation confirms its vitality by churning out another interesting product, the Children of the Rain inspired by a fantastic tale by Serge Brussolo and which already in the 80s René Laloux, famous for his Wild Planet, had tried to make. The story combines fantasy to mythological thriller and thriller and recalls the dynamics described by Aida of the trees of Manuli. Somewhere in the universe the people of the Hydross and that of the Pyross confront each other relentlessly. The former need water, the latter need fire and in these two diametrically opposed needs an irreducible battle is served until the love between Skan, a young warrior Pyross, and the beautiful Hydronian Kallisto introduces a wedge between the two civilizations and which spreads out centuries of hatred allowing tolerance to run its course. Poetic and optimistic but not in the direction of Tonino Guerra's phony dullness, this film by Philippe Leclerc, released on the sly, demonstrates that in Europe an alternative animation to Japanese American models is still possible, adult and characterized by the "contaminated" design of Philippe Caza , and from the fascinating backgrounds that peek at Moebius.

title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
actors: Colin Firth, Scarlett Johansson, Tom Wilkinson, Judy Parfitt, Cillian Murphy
description: Griet is taken into service in Johannes Vermeer's home. The painter feels attraction for the little servant. It will be van Ruijven, Vermeer's patron, to convince him to portray Griet ...
notes: Based on Tracy Cavalier's best-seller, the film is soulless: beautiful but with the icy beauty of a catalog reproduction ...

title: Scary Movie 3
actors: Anthony Anderson, Simon Rex, Anna Faris, Denise Richards, Charlie Sheen, Eddie Griffin, Queen Latifah, Pamela Anderson, Jenny McCarthy
description: Ambitious reporter Cindy Campbell is looking for a new TV scoop, and so stumbles upon an absurd series of episodes that threaten the planet: an alien invasion, killing videotapes, creepy crop circles, prophecies, children with supernatural gifts. , ambitious white rappers and even ... Michael Jackson.
notes: Insane cinema is shameless, rude, liberating. And he's healthy, because he doesn't care too much about himself or others. "Transgender" par excellence (it knows them and goes through them all, according to a specific narrative "non-logical"), it goes freewheeling. _Scary Movie 3_ (inherited from one of the fathers of the demented, David Zucker, from his grandchildren Wayans) is a triumph of the "politically incorrect" built on the materials of the most recent horror (_The Ring_, _Signs_, _Il sixth sense_, _The Others_, but also _8 Mile_ and _Matrix_, plus a hilarious homage to _Mars Attacks! _). Nobody is saved: black oracles and young white aspiring rappers; ghostly girls asking for revenge from a video; psychic kids bloodless and exhausted from being circled by babysitter priests and Michael Jackson; mother Teresa and a procession of disabled people mistaken for aliens; silicon, Texans, policemen, bodyguards and a president of the United States - Leslie Nielsen in fraternal appearance for his friend Zucker - very stupid who pays homage to his predecessor Ford (Harrison, not Gerald). Do not pay attention to the plot, abandon yourself to the barrage of quotes: to finally laugh at everything.

title: L'amore è eterno finché dura
actors: Carlo Verdone, Laura Morante, Stefania Rocca, Rodolfo Corsato, Gabriella Pession, Antonio Catania
description: ophthalmologist Gilberto, married to the psychologist Tiziana and father of Marta, is summoned to the barracks. The wife discovers that Gilberto has participated in a speed date. One of the participants, Stella, has disappeared and the carabinieri are investigating. The couple crisis is inevitable and the man asks his partner Andrea, who lives with Carlotta, for hospitality. Gilberto continues to see his daughter and from her he discovers that Tiziana has also been in a relationship for over two years ...
notes: Despite a partly cast and a good ending, the film is a superficial staging of the Roman bourgeoisie. Too bad, because once Verdone had the right timing and his plays knew how to tell the mood of the country.

title: Vaniglia e cioccolato
actors: Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Joaquín Cortés, Alessandro Preziosi, Serra Yilmaz
description: Penelope and Andrea have been married for eighteen years. In all this time the woman has often "closed her eyes" and endured her husband's escapades. But one day she declares tired of Andrea's superficiality and selfishness, capable of making up for a betrayal with a tub of vanilla and chocolate ice cream. Penelope escapes from married life, but begins a very dangerous journey between doubts and memories.
notes: Ciro Ippolito, former champion of Neapolitan cinematographic trash, smells the new line of "average auteur cinema" and throws himself into fish. Family Crises, Forty-year-olds at the Crossroads, Dolly and Great Themes. The result is a turgid carampana-movie taken by Sveva Casati Modignani, which in addition provides Life and Art, Illness and Death. A woman discovers that her husband is cheating on her, and leaves home. Her husband is unable to navigate the house routine, while she accepts the court of a Spanish painter (Cortes). Colossal inability of the performers, Neapolitan specks galore, a string orchestra in the rain. Every two minutes, for no reason, the shots are crooked and with an exposed ceiling, "a la Orson Welles". The dialogues have some gems, like the Cucinotta that explains Brahms, or the metaphor of the title ("two strong tastes, but that go very well together"). The film is above all an involuntary demystification of its models: Muccino, Özpetek and Tognazzi jr. cubed here become a Franco and Ciccio parody: suffice it to say that the Turkish matron icon of Özpetek is a grandmother pianist from Gozzo. But it was more fun _Arrapaho_.

title: Lo scocciatore
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Alberto Sordi, Lidia Martora, Arlette Poirer, Giulietta Masina
description: Eager to escape from his monotonous clerical routine, Arduino Buongiorno decides to accept the invitation of Iolanda, an "easy" girl who gives him an appointment at his house. Arduino arrives on time, but no one responds to his ringing. There and then he is disappointed, but when the next day all the newspapers report the news of the death of the girl, murdered by a stranger, panic assails him: in fact, her presence had been noticed, and some might think that the culprit is him. ...
notes: Despite Peppino and Albertone (the "nuisance" who gave the alternative title to the film), the operation is neither stinging nor amusing.

title: Domenica è sempre domenica
actors: Alberto Sordi, Vittorio De Sica, Mario Riva, Lorella De Luca
description: The popularity of the program _Il musichiere_ has by now aroused a real fever in Italian families. Countess Castaldi, for example, sent an application to participate in the name of her daughter Maria Luisa because she hopes to stop the financial difficulties caused by the gambling debts of the "Commander" with the eventual winnings. The girl initially disagrees, but then accepts and finds herself competing with the engineer Alberto Carboni, an industrialist passionate about songs ...
notes: On the wave of the extraordinary success of Mario Riva and his music quiz, a cross-section of the Italian provincial of the carefree 1950s.

title: The Rescuers Down Under
description: The Australian boy Cody, a lover of animals, finds a rare example of a golden eagle tied to a rock overlooking a precipice. While cutting the ropes that hold her captive, Cody falls into the void and is saved by the bird. The bird of prey was tied up by Percival, a treacherous poacher, who wants to capture it and destroy its eggs to make it more valuable. The eagle gives Cody one of his golden feathers, but when Percival finds the boy in possession of the feather, he wants to force him to reveal where the bird's nest is. Two mice, Bianca and Bernie, think about saving Cody.
notes: First computer colored Disney film.

title: Il fiacre n. 13 (Castigo)
actors: Leonardo Cortese, Vera Carmi, Roldano Lupi, Ginette Leclerc, Sandro Ruffini
description: The countess of Latour leaves everything to her son Filippo, disinheriting Giorgio, the most reckless. He kills his brother and makes his son disappear too, but an innocent person is accused of the crime. Years later, the family requests a review of the trial, but the papers have disappeared.
notes: Second part of the feuilleton in two episodes directed by Mario Mattoli.

title: Derailed
actors: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Tomas Arana, Laura Harring, Susan Gibney
description: Jacques Kristoff, a special agent of the US government, is assigned to protect the Russian biologist Galina Konstantin. When some terrorists, determined to kidnap the scientist, seize the train on which the two are traveling, Kristoff will have to do his best to put the bad guys in a position to do no harm, before they can get their hands on the high-tech biological weapons that Galina brings with her ...
notes: To the delight of his fans, the strong Belgian granite does not deviate an inch from its everlasting cliché. Others can console themselves with the Lynchian Harring (_Mulholland Drive_).

title: Big Fish
actors: Ewan McGregor, Albert Finney, Billy Crudup, Jessica Lange, Alison Lohman, Helena Bonham Carter, Steve Buscemi, Robert Guillaume, Marion Cotillard, Matthew McGrory, David Denman, Missi Pyle, Danny DeVito
description: For Edward Bloom, the essence of life lies in what is told. From an early age Edward spends his time reading and learning many things. His thirst for adventure leads him to travel the whole world and become famous for the stories he tells about his eccentric life and about encounters with werewolves, two Korean Siamese twin singers, a witch with a true eye capable of seeing the future. and a big fish that refuses to be caught. The only one not enchanted by the tales is Edward's son, Will, who has left home. But when Edward falls ill, Will embarks on his own personal journey to shed light on his father's past.
notes: Tim Burton weaves and weaves with amazing narrative fluidity the parallel stories of Edward Bloom young and old (Ewan McGregor and Albert Finney, magnificent and vital "twin" histrions), of his son (Billy Cudrup, in a subdued and very difficult part), of the people he met and how he imagined them, of his real life and how he transformed it into a story to tell to children at night in front of the fire (or to adults, in front of a table set at a party). Film of water, light and deep blacks, capable of passing from the bright pop of the fifties and sixties to the restless suggestions of the American gothic, from the multiform creatures of the circus to the lived and marked faces of real life, from the submerged world of Lynch to the overexposed one of the Coens, Big Fish is the quintessence of Tim Burton. Maybe it's his masterpiece.

title: Agata e la tempesta
actors: Licia Maglietta, Giuseppe Battiston, Emilio Solfrizzi, Claudio Santamaria, Marina Massironi
description: Agata, owner of a bookshop in Genoa, Gustavo's elder sister, is a woman full of energy with an older daughter who studies abroad. She falls in love with Nico, younger than her and married, who with his emotional discharges strikes light bulbs and traffic lights. The storm breaks out when the clothing salesman Romeo communicates news to Gustavo that will upset his life and that of Agata ...
notes: A choral film, discreetly interpreted by the actors, about electric shocks, about the ganglia of the feuilleton, about a Madame Bovary from the alleyway and dance hall, about losing normality and getting lost (by the director) among the morphological loops of "a slightly raised world From reality".

title: Sotto falso nome
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Anna Mouglalis, Greta Scacchi, Giorgio Lupano, Michael Lonsdale, Magda Mielcarz
description: Writer Daniel Boltansky achieved success by signing his novels under the pseudonym of Jerzy Novak. Shortly after starting a relationship with a beautiful woman, the man is blackmailed by a frustrated writer because his works were never published.
notes: The film is dripping with literature and theater, even in the sex scenes. But then, as the intrigue unfolds, we get passionate and appreciate the elegance of the layout, the direction of the actors, the strength of the sets. At times the refined direction, like a little Italian Chabrol, gives the film a real "European" breath. The clothes of the Mouglalis are wonderful.

title: Route 9
actors: Kyle MacLachlan, Peter Coyote, Amy Locane, Wade Andrew Williams

title: L'amica di mia madre
actors: Barbara Bouchet, Carmen Villani, Roberto Cenci, Raul Martinez
description: The seventeen year old Billy occupies only and blessed (with Mammà's money) a luxurious villa in an exotic location. The hallman boy drools for the uninhibited Andrea: but when the refined Parisian Barbara arrives at home, he definitively goes on tilt ...
notes: More than anything else, a historical finding of the concept of Eros in the 70s Autilietta.

title: Se sei vivo spara (Oro Hondo)
actors: Tomas Milian, Marilù Tolo, Roberto Camardiel, Ray Lovelock, Piero Lulli, Milo Quesada
description: After a robbery, Hermano is betrayed by his American cronies but survives. He sets out in search of the stolen goods but is destined to meet increasingly greedy and ruthless cowboys.

title: Atti impuri all'italiana
actors: Dagmar Lassander, Maurizio Arena, Ghigo Masino, Stella Carnacina, Isabella Biagini
description: The doctor from Montecatini Terme dies. Her place is taken by doctor Elia Bonvicini, who surprises everyone for being a young and attractive woman. Soon, her clinic will be crowded with men and women struggling with frustrated sexuality ...

title: Ôdishon
actors: Renji Ishibashi, Eihi Shiina, Ryo Ishibashi, Tetsu Sawaki, Jun Kunimura
description: Seven years after his wife's death, Aoyama, a company executive, is invited to audition for the choice of an actress. Leafing through the photos of the participants, his attention is captured by Yamazaki Asami, a girl with a background as a dancer. During the auditions Aoyama is literally hooked and takes note of her phone number to invite her to dinner, but has no idea who she is dealing with ...
notes: Without the characteristic ghosts of Japanese horror, the eclectic Miike demonstrates how slow but inexorable obsession turns out to be more terrifying than any supernatural nightmare.

title: The Burning Bed
actors: Farrah Fawcett, Paul Le Mat, Richard Masur, Grace Zabriskie

title: Beffe, licenze et amori proibiti del Decamerone segreto
actors: Dado Crostarosa, Malisa Longo, Giacomo Rizzo, Orchidea De Santis
description: The storyteller-acrobat Cecco Angiolieri is a marvel in relations with the fair sex: with his cunning he manages to conquer married women, girlfriends and even nuns ...
notes: A trashy comedy that disturbs the figure of the well-known poet and uses a courtly title in vain. Shot in a real convent in San Gimignano.

title: These Thousands Hill
actors: Don Murray, Lee Remick, Patricia Owens, Richard Egan, Stuart Whitman
description: The wolf hunter Lat Evans wants to become the owner of a farm: thanks to the savings of the prostitute Callie, who has fallen in love with him, he manages to make his dream come true. After a few years, Lat - who became a senator - forgets about Callie and marries Joyce, only to repent ...
notes: From a novel by Alfred B. Guthrie jr. (who is writing with Alfred Hayes), Fleischer draws a western full of interesting ideas, even if the director of _The hyenas of Chicago_ and _Viaggio hallucinante_ has certainly done better. Discreet the protagonist Murray, splendid Remick (not yet twenty-four at the time) in the role of Callie.

title: Impulse
actors: Tim Matheson, Meg Tilly, Hume Cronyn, John Karlen, Bill Paxton
description: After a small earthquake, apparently without serious consequences, the quiet routine of the town of Sutcliffe is disturbed by strange and disturbing changes. The inhabitants begin to vent their aggressive impulses openly, and violence and crime are rampant ...
notes: Good cast, suspense "phone call".

title: Blindman
actors: Tony Anthony, Ringo Starr, Lloyd Battista, Agneta Eckemyr
description: A blind gunslinger and his faithful companion have a mission: to deliver their wives "bought" by mail order to a group of miners in a remote Texas town. Unfortunately, the two will have to fight against a group of Mexican bandits who will do everything to stop them ...
notes: Light-hearted western inspired by Japanese blind samurai movies, starring an incredible Ringo Starr as a Mexican outlaw. Filled with grotesque elements, it is supported by fast and effective editing, especially in action scenes. Atypical and undeservedly little known, it can boast an impeccable direction and some anthology scenes.

title: Bronenosec Potëmkin
actors: Aleksandr Antonov, Grigorij Aleksandrov, Vladimir Barskij, Michail Gomarov
description: Odessa, 1905: aboard the Potemkin, a war unit of the Tsarist fleet, the conditions of the crew are intolerable. Thus began to spread ferments of revolt: in front of yet another abuse, the situation explodes, triggering a bloody mutiny. The people of Odessa show their solidarity with the uprising and crowd the steps of the port, but are brutally massacred by a Cossack unit ...
notes: One of the titles that have made the history of cinema, with an unparalleled expressive power and with a montage that makes modern video clips pale. Ultracited, from De Palma (_The Untouchables_) to ... Fantozzi.

title: Le déjeuner sur l'herbe
actors: Paul Merisse, Catherine Rouvel, Fernand Sardou, Jacqueline Marane
description: Professor Alexis is a staunch advocate of artificial insemination. Having met the waitress and peasant Nenette, he lives with her a satisfying love story in Provence. A few months later, when he learns she is pregnant, he marries her.
notes: Inspired by the well-known painting by Manet, Renoir's film is both a hymn to life and a tribute to the pictorial and cinematographic impressionism of his father Auguste. Peculiar technique: up to eight cameras to stay as close as possible to the naturalness of acting. Shot on the family country estate.

title: Prestupleniye i nakazaniye
actors: Georgij Taratorkin, Innokentj Smoktunovskij, Tatjana Bedova

title: Detention
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Alex Karzis, Kata Dobó, Corey Sevier, Dov Tiefenbach
description: Fresh from the Gulf and the Balkans, Sam Decker returns to his hometown to teach in the most "difficult" school in the area. Shortly thereafter, frustrated by the obstacles in the school system, he decides to resign. But the last day, assigned to a punitive class, will have to face the unexpected raid of a group of armed men ...
notes: Sidney J. Furie is directing Dolph Lundgren for the first time in an action movie without backbone and without tension. "Mischief" that he allegedly committed also have following it with _Direct Action_. Strange for a director who in the course of his career films full of suspense such as _Ipcress_ and _Entity_.

title: The Dunwich Horror
actors: Sandra Dee, Sam Jaffe, Dean Stockwell, Donna Baccala, Ed Begley, Joanne Moore Jordan, Talia Shire, Michael Fox, Jason Wingreen
description: Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell) goes to Miskatonic Univerisity to be able to borrow and consult the original edition of the Necronomicon, the famous black magic text. Here he meets Nancy (Sandre Dee), an attractive young student, who ends up falling into the clutches of man, whose intentions and true nature are somewhat suspect.

title: Volga-Volga
actors: Igor Ilyinskij, Ljubov Orlova, Pavel Olenev, Andrej Tutyshkin
description: Ivan Byvalov is commissioned to prepare, with some local companies, a festival of amateur artists. The popular chorus of the peasant Dunja participates, who incidentally composes a radio success: Ivan will try to steal the authorship of the song from her ...
notes: "Regime" musical, but not without rhythm and inventiveness.

title: Femmes femmes
actors: Hélène Surgere, Sonia Saviange, Michel Duchaussoy, Michel Delahaye

title: Taza, Son of Cochise
actors: Rock Hudson, Barbara Rush, Gregg Palmer, Bart Roberts, Jeff Chandler

title: Brat'ja Karamazovy
actors: Mikhail Ulianov, Lionella Piryeva, Kiryll Lavrov, Andrey Myahkov

title: I giochi proibiti de l'Aretino Pietro
actors: Femi Benussi, Tony Kendall, Shirley Corrigan, Angela Covello, Orchidea De Santis
description: Angelica, Lisa, Violetta and Bettina, four women from Gubbio, are taken to court by their respective husbands and lovers. Each is accused of committing adultery.

title: Kljatva
actors: Michail Gelovani, Nicolaj Boljubov, Sofiya Gasineva, Dmitri Pavlov, S. Boguljubova
description: In 1924, the Bolshevik veteran Petrov had to deliver a letter to Lenin to inform him of the Kulak brigands who wander sowing death and misery throughout the Tsaritsyn area. The Kulak, however, intercept him and kill him and it is his widow, Varvara, to continue his mission. When he arrives in Moscow, however, he discovers that Lenin is dead. Stalin, in mourning for the death of his mentor, pronounces a funeral praise in which he invites all the Soviet people to swear to keep alive the legacy of the disappeared leader. People swear. Varvara manages to meet Stalin and gives him the bloody letter intended for Lenin. A few years later, at the end of the Second World War, Varvara and Stalin meet again at the Kremlin. Stalin kisses his hand, as a recognition of the contribution of the Soviet mothers to the victory in the war, ensuring that soon all that Lenin had foreseen would come true.

title: Run for the Money
actors: Christian Slater, Val Kilmer, Sara Downing, Vincent Laresca
description: Former inmate Thomas Taylor, who has found a new dimension by becoming a paramedic, can't resist the temptation to land a million-dollar robbery. When Thomas and his accomplice strike, they realize that the money is stamped with indelible ink. Things get complicated when Mark Cornell, an FBI agent with a passion for opera, gets on their trail ...
notes: Antonijevic moves away from the good performance of _Savior_ and directs an "action" that borders on the ridiculous. Embarrassing dialogues and too banal script.

title: Ramatou/Hyènes
actors: Ami Diakhate, Djibril Diop Mambety, Mansour Diouf

title: Hakuchi
actors: Masayuki Mori, Setsuko Hara, Toshiro Mifune, Yoshiko Kuga, Takashi Shimura
description: Kameda, who escaped shooting during the war, suffers from epileptic dementia. On his way to Hokkaido he meets Akama, with whom he will form a deep friendship. The two will share the love for Taeko, a woman who unleashes Hayako's jealousies, who would like to marry the "pure" Kameda.
notes: Based on Dostesky's novel of the same name, it was originally conceived to be a two-part film, lasting a total of 265 minutes. It was cut from the Shochiku studio against the wishes of the director. In fact, it took forty years before Kurosawa returned to work with Shochiku, for _Rapsodia d'agosto_, and all the searches to find the cut material were in vain.

title: The Nightcomers
actors: Stephanie Beacham, Marlon Brando, Christopher Ellis, Verna Harvey
description: Two little brothers, orphaned, are raised by an elderly housekeeper (Stephanie Beacham) and taught by a young teacher. However, the morbid and sadomasochistic relationship between the gardener Quint (Marlon Brando) and the housekeeper herself has a great influence on them: an influence that will manifest itself in a nefarious way as they grow up.
notes: Inspired by Henry James' short novel "Turn of the Screw", it somehow tells the background. The finished story is instead narrated in Suspense (The Innocents) of 1961 directed by Jack Clayton

title: Les cousins
actors: Gérard Blain, Jean-Claude Brialy, Juliette Mayniel, Claude Cerval

title: Buying the Cow
actors: Jerry O'Connell, Bridgette L. Wilson, Ryan Reynolds, Alyssa Milano

title: Injeong sajeong bol geot eobtda
actors: Park Joong-hoon, Ahn Sung-kee, Jang Dong-Kun, Choi Ji-woo
description: Detective Woo, exuberant and inclined to strong manners, and his partner Kim, with a less impetuous and more contemplative character, scour the streets of the capital in search of the deadly and impregnable killer Chang Sungmin. Episodes of violence continue unabated, until the inevitable final showdown.
notes: Plot reduced to the bone for one of the greatest hits recorded in the 1999 season at the Korean box office, also passed to the 2000 edition of the Sundance Festival. Lee conducts with a smug technical tour de force, which damages the effectiveness of the ensemble considerably. The original version lasts a quarter of an hour longer.

title: La cameriera seduce i villeggianti
actors: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Carlo Giuffrè, Giorgio Bracardi, Pippo Santonastaso, Raf Luca, Isabella Biagini
description: Orazio and Marina, managers of a pension, have some bills outstanding with the spouses Amedeo and Pucci Ferretti. Between the four a series of seductions and escapades is triggered, in which a drug trafficker, a gangster, a brigadier and the clumsy waitress Guendalina are involved ...
notes: Farsaccia without head or tail.

title: Security Risk
actors: John Ireland, Dorothy Malone, Dolores Donlon, Keith Larsen
description: Dr. Lanson, an atomic scientist, Ted Nolan, Donna Weeks and dedicated sister Peggy are on vacation at a Big Bear resort. Among the snow are also Joan Cochran, Burje and Johnny, three young Communists who intend to get their hands on Lanson's documents. As the three plot and plot a plan to follow, a love story arises between Donna and Ralph Payne, an FBI agent on vacation. Lanson's death will cause Paul Malone, Payne's supervisor, and Sheriff Bowman to enter the scene as well.

title: Sollazzevoli storie di mogli gaudenti e mariti penitenti
actors: Monica Audras, Marzia Damon, Francesca Romana Davila, Attilio Dottesio
description: A man leaves for work and his wife takes the opportunity to host her lover. The husband returns and does not notice his lover.

title: Tangos, l'exil de Gardel
actors: Marie Laforêt, Philippe Léotard, Miguel Angel Sola, Marina Vlady
description: Paris, late 1970s: a group of Argentine exiles strive to keep in touch with their own culture (and to exorcise, at least in part, the burning nostalgia of the distant land) by staging a "tanghédia". The rehearsals of the show alternate with episodes of private life, between bare apartments and underpaid jobs, attempts to communicate with family members left at home and the hope of being able to one day reach them in a new free homeland.
notes: The voice of the legendary Carlos Gardel and the notes of Astor Piazzolla innervate an atypical and political musical, angry and melancholy, signed by a "militant" director par excellence.

title: An Extremely Goofy Movie
description: It is not a good time for Pippo, because he has lost his job and cannot hope to have another one without a diploma: to obtain it, Pippo is therefore forced to join his son Max at university. On campus, Mickey's friend meets a librarian who shares a nostalgic love for the 70s with him ...

title: Devil Winds
actors: Joe Lando, Nicole Eggert, Peter Graham-Gaudreau, Erica Parker
description: Pete Jensen is a brilliant and ambitious meteorologist, specializing in the study of natural catastrophic phenomena. Until one of these destroys his life: a gigantic tornado hits his house and, while his daughter is saved by a miracle, his wife is killed. Shaken by the tragedy, Jensen walks away and throws himself headlong into work neglecting the child. Years later he finally returns to his small town in Oklahoma where he meets his friend and colleague Brooker. A new storm of frightening proportions is about to hit the area: for them and the enterprising reporter Julia Merrow a fight against time begins to try to save the inhabitants from imminent danger.

title: Una vergine in famiglia
actors: Franca Gonnella, Femi Benussi, Gianni Dei, Georges Ardisson, Mario Colli, Carla Calò, Luis La Torre, Enzo Andronico, Ester Carloni
description: A girl of respectable bourgeois family has remained virgin. However, when he discovers the hypocrisy of relatives, he will unleash himself.

title: Kalina krasnaja
actors: Vasiliy Shukshin, Lidija Fedoseva-Suksina, Shanna Prokhrenko
description: A former thief gets out of prison. Then he tries to start a new life with a pen friend of his, a good woman from a village, but his past doesn't seem to want to let him go.

title: Nippon sengoshi - Madamu onboro no Seikatsu
actors: Tami Akaza, Etsuko Akaza, Chieko Akaza, Fukumi Kuroda
description: Always interested in "low practices" and eccentric points of view, Imamura chooses to combine the subjectivity of the confidences and memories narrated by the owner of a bar (and former prostitute) with the objectivity of the historical events that occurred in her country after the end of the Second World War.

title: Les Vampires
actors: Musidora, Edouard Mathé, Marcel Lévesque, Fernand Herrmann
description: The "Vampires" are the ferocious members of the criminal gang led by the beautiful and ruthless Irma Vep. The journalist Philippe Guérande, backed by a repentant "vampire", the gravedigger Mazamette ...
notes: First 5 episodes of the 10 that make up the series shot by the director of _Fantômas_. Parts VI to IX air tomorrow.

title: Il grande addio
directors: Dziga Vertov, Mikhail Ciaureli, Sergej Gerassimov
description: After his death on March 5, 1953, Josip Vissarionovic Dzugasvili is honored with a ceremony that expresses, with all the grandeur dear to the regime, his condolences for the disappearance of the "Little Father". To follow, _The speeches of Stalin_, montage of unpublished materials on the public rallies of the Soviet leader.

title: Duelle (une quarantaine)
actors: Juliet Berto, Bulle Ogier, Jean Babilée, Hermine Karagheuz, Nicole Garcia
description: As the full moon rises, Leni and Viva compete for possession of a stone that ensures eternal life.
notes: Inspired by _The seventh victim_ by Mark Robson (1943), a segment of the _Scenes de la vie parallèle_ project, which also includes _Noroît_ (1976) and _Histoire de Marie et Julien_ (2003).

title: Palabras
actors: Paloma Calle Alberdi, Corso Salani, Monica Rametta, Alessandro Mizzi
description: Adela has recently moved to Santiago de Chile on behalf of an environmental company and is trying to prevent the construction of a dam. Alberto instead works for the European company that wants to carry out the project. A year after their meeting, Adela recalls the love story with Alberto, telling it to two friends.
notes: Salani likes to film life, the one that flows, and scrutinize the gazes of the people who live there.
