His is almost the work of an anthropologist, modest and silent, without anger and full of respect. Filmed in Spanish and subtitled, it uses a close-knit and confidential group of actresses (there is also the co-screenwriter of the film, Monica Rametta), among which Paloma Calle stands out, sentimentally perfect.

title: Carried Away
actors: Dennis Hopper, Amy Irving, Amy Locane, Julie Harris, Gary Busey
description: Joseph Svenden, a former farmer and now a teacher in a small Midwestern town, is cornered by his girlfriend Rosealee Henson, who is pressing for their relationship to be regularized. But one of Joseph's students, the beautiful Catherine Wheeler, tries to seduce him and does nothing to hide it ...
notes: An obvious and conventional "triangle", scripted by Ed Jones from the novel _The Man of Dreams_ by Jim Harrison. For his part, the Brazilian Barreto (that of _Donna Flor and her two husbands_, _Gabriela_ and _4 days in September_) doesn't make much effort to spice up the dish. Classic "food" participation for Hopper.

title: Jeeper Creepers 2
actors: Ray Wise, Jonathan Breck, Garikayi Mutambirwa, Eric Nenninger, Marieh Delfino
description: Returning from a league game, a bus full of basketball players, cheerleaders and coaches is attacked by The Creeper. It is a winged beast that appears every 23 years to feed non-stop human beings for 23 days in order to regenerate. When night falls, the terrified group of young athletes must contend with their fears and prejudices and join in a hopeless fight against the horrible creature.
notes: Salva, after the first chapter, increases homoerotic ardor and pushes relational tensions on the pedal. The result is a troubled picture of a country, which has not yet managed to eliminate racist waste and gender disturbances.

title: Segui le ombre
actors: Nicola Di Pinto, Francesco Di Leva, Luigi Iacuzio, Gaetano Amato, Daniela Gargiulo
description: 1946. The young Gatta, brigadier of the Carabinieri, is assigned to a barracks in a town on the Neapolitan coast. The war seems to have marginally affected the life of the community, but the carabiniere is convinced that there are unclear facts: in the country there was in fact a series of unexplained deaths, which took place in a hotel, but the investigation was covered in sand. And so the sergeant takes charge of the investigation, bringing to light fragments and shadows ...
notes: Lucio Gaudino _ (First light of dawn) _ shoots with elegance, with a careful use of photography and a sober period reconstruction even within the limits of an inexpensive production. The use of music (pleonastic or anachronistic) is a bit incongruous. Renounce the suspense, also because the gist of the story is basically clear almost immediately. He plays a little too much with temporal comings and goings and silences, more than anything else he illustrates with elegance and directs the actors well. If nothing else, the attempt at an atmospheric film is appreciated, not too "explained", but in the end the real emotion is lacking.

title: Che ne sarà di noi
actors: Silvio Muccino, Violante Placido, Giuseppe Sanfelice, Elio Germano, Valeria Solarino, Enrico Silvestrin
description: In the magical atmosphere of the "Caldera" of Santorini, the post-graduation journey of three young people who know almost nothing about their lives takes place. They are just too young to know who they are. Parents and children untie from each other precisely in these moments and that is when the desires of young people meet the realism of adults, too full of problems to be interested in their children.
notes: Silvio Muccino, after Valerio Mastandrea and others whose names have already been lost in the seasons of the day before yesterday, is the person closest to the spectators to whom this holiday in Santorini (Greece is another of the unoriginal constants of a cinema where the young men of the past went to Ischia or the Romagna coast) is destined.

title: The Rundown
actors: Dwayne Johnson, Seann William Scott, Rosario Dawson, Christopher Walken, Ewen Bremner, Jon Gries
description: A man instructs Beck, a guy accustomed to recovering what is asked of him by any means, to bring home his son Travis, who has long since gone on a trip to Brazil. However, the mission turns out to be more difficult than expected, not only because the boy has no intention of returning, but also because there are a couple of complications: Mariana, a young local who knows the mysteries of the jungle, and Hatcher, a tyrant. madman who uses the jungle and its inhabitants to make his fortune ... Without making any claims, the film succeeds in its intent of mixing action and comedy in a funny collage with engaging stunt sequences.

title: Open Range
actors: Robert Duvall, Kevin Costner, Annette Bening, Michael Gambon, Michael Jeter, Diego Luna
description: Charley Waite, Boss Spearman, "Button" and Mose Harrison are on the run from their past: the only place where they feel truly free is the boundless plains of the West, where nature dictates the law. Champions of just causes, the four cowboys try to avoid violence: but a frontier town ruled by fear and tyranny will change their lives and force them into action ...
notes: A film that delights in its slowness, its pauses on the details of the scenes and the script, the rain that wets the prairies, the hats, the men and the herds, the mud that sticks to the boots and soils the deeds of a people with a short history. A people who at the cinema do not have the memory to sing chivalrous deeds or to write epic poems and which looks up, towards the great sky, or in front of itself towards unexplored borders. The West of Costner is inhabited by wolves, by Indians, by the last cowboys (who can also be ruthless). A land where no man can tell another man what to do: Ford and Mann, Boetticher and Hawks have explained it well.

title: Movimenti
actors: Cecilia Dazzi, Fabrizio Gifuni, Gabriele Parrillo, Francesco Pini, Paolo Zuccari, Rolando Ravello, Julia Sarano, Hossein Taheri
description: Six micro-stories of bizarre utopia told with a "jazzy" structure: concentrated in a single night, the six stories intertwine in a continuous movement. Everyone is leaving for somewhere. Love stories that are born, loves that die out, masks that fall.
notes: The lesson is that of John Cassavetes, updated to the digital age: three "bees" (as Giuseppe Bertolucci would define them) stuck on the characters, following glances and obliquities, quarrels and outbursts, games of seduction and shadows. A reality that tries to reinvent and transform into emotions. To feel alive in a diseased dimension inhabited by monsters.

title: Brother Bear
description: Kenai is a young hunter who deeply hates bears since they killed his older brother Sitka. But when because of a spell he is transformed into a bear, he must learn to defend himself from the attacks of men and above all from Denahi, the third brother, determined to avenge the disappearance of Sitka and Kenai.
notes: The animation is well made, but the first part is slower and more tedious than the second, when the enthralling sympathy of the sweet Koda enters the scene, the real asset of the film together with the backgrounds that are the result of an accurate patchwork and that transmits a strong ecological message.

title: Along Came Polly
actors: Ben Stiller, Jennifer Aniston, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Debra Messing, Hank Azaria, Alec Baldwin
description: Reuben Feffer is a meek man who is afraid to take risks but analyzes risks as a profession. After being betrayed by his wife during his honeymoon, he falls in love with Polly, a childhood friend who returns to his life to completely upset him.
notes: Jennifer Aniston for the second time in her film career, after _A week from God_, holds the scene well and looks good with Ben Stiller. The direction of the young John Hamburg confirms some qualities of his previous scripts _ (Meet my parents and Zoolanders) _ in which farce and satire of costume exchange, at every intersection of the plot, the right of way.

title: La cameriera nera
actors: Carla Brait, Femi Benussi, Al Capri, Gianni Dei, Magda Konopka
description: Several tenants live in a building in Rome: they range from Major Galeazzo to Chancellor Enea, from goalkeeper Placido to Dr. Muller, from journalist Antenore to Paolo who still lives with his parents. Everyone is conquered by the maid Mariolina, who will be undermined by the black Amita ...
notes: Terrible comedy.

title: Howling VI: The Freaks
actors: Brendan Hughes, Bruce Payne, Michele Matheson, Sean Gregory Sullivan
description: Arriving in the rural town of Canton Bluff, the enigmatic and lonely Ian earns his living by making small repairs in the local church. Sensing Ian's unnatural attraction to the full moon, the shady Harker blackmails him by forcing him to perform in his walking bandwagon. But even Harker hides a monstrous secret ...

title: Indagine su un delitto perfetto
actors: Leonard Mann, Adolfo Celi, Joseph Cotten, Franco Ressel, Anthony Steel, Janet Agren
description: The president of a multinational company dies in a plane crash of which no one suspects the malicious origin. The lack of testamentary dispositions forces the three vice presidents - Harold Boyd, Hartick Dundy and the young Paul de Révère - to appoint a successor as soon as possible. While a sabotage apparently puts Paul out of action, a mysterious killer eliminates the other two: but things are not at all as they seem ...
notes: Expert in the "policeman", Rosati tries his hand unsuccessfully with the mechanisms of yellow, to the point of giving up the set when the work is not yet finished. Wasted Celi and Cotten; particina also for Alida Valli.

title: Wall of Secrets
actors: Nicole Eggert, Dean McDermott, Bruce Gray, Stephen McHattie
description: Paige and her husband Mark move to Chicago: here, to their surprise, they manage to secure a splendid apartment for an incredibly advantageous rent. What seems like a stroke of luck, however, reveals a mysterious and disturbing side, which the couple will soon discover at their own expense ...

title: Céline et Julie vont en bateau
actors: Juliet Berto, Dominique Labourier, Bulle Ogier, Marie-France Pisier
description: Céline is a magician, Julie a librarian: they meet by chance in Montmartre, become friends and find themselves entangled in a hallucinatory parallel reality.
notes: Hypnotic, with a touch of alienated humor. The daily time overlaps the inner one, in an enigmatic and stimulating short circuit.

title: Titicut Follies
description: A merciless reconnaissance among the wards, corridors and cells of the criminal asylum in Bridgewater, Massachussets, where inmates stage a musical entitled _Titicut Follies_.
notes: For 24 years, until 1991, the film was banned due to its irredeible, provocative harshness.

title: La seconda ombra
actors: Remo Girone, Victoria Zinny, Eva Mauri
description: 1961: freshly appointed, Franco Basaglia takes up service at the psychiatric hospital in Gorizia. Disguised as an attendant, he observes the inhuman conditions in which the patients find themselves: electric shocks, lobotomies, straitjackets, beatings, bars on the windows ...
notes: Semi-documentary on the father of the "law 180", a bit hagiographic and superficial.

title: Les Vampires
actors: Musidora, Edouard Mathé, Marcel Lévesque, Fernand Herrmann
description: The "Vampires" are the ferocious members of the criminal gang led by the beautiful and ruthless Irma Vep. The journalist Philippe Guérande, backed by a repentant "vampire", the gravedigger Mazamette ...
notes: Third and fourth episode of the ten that make up the series shot by the director of _Fantômas_.

notes: Fifth episode of the ten that make up the series shot by the director of _Fantômas_.

notes: Seventh and eighth episode of the ten that make up the series shot by the director of _Fantômas_.

actors: Musidora, Edouard Mathé, Marcel Lévesque, Fernand Herrmann

notes: Ninth and tenth episodes of the ten that make up the series shot by the director of _Fantômas_.

title: For Hire
actors: Rob Lowe, Joe Mantegna, Bronwen Booth, Charles Powell, Steve Adams
description: Mitch Lawrence who works as a taxi driver in Chicago happens to load the writer Lou Webber into his car several times. One evening Lou tells Mitch that a drug dealer has recognized himself in one of his novels and is threatening him with death for this. One day Mitch, waiting to become a father, discovers that he has cancer that allows him a few months to live. When he confides in Lou, Lou proposes that he eliminate the drug dealer in exchange for a better future for his wife and unborn child. A crime committed Mitch is devoured by guilt, but one day he discovers that ...
notes: Honest thriller with a Rob Lowe in good shape.

title: Blind Horizon
actors: Val Kilmer, Neve Campbell, Sam Shepard, Noble Willingham
description: A man is picked up by the sheriff of a small town in the middle of the New Mexico desert. He does not know how to explain his identity and what he is doing in that place. The sheriff immediately realizes that the man hides a mysterious past. Chloe, a local girl, takes to heart the story of the forgetful, who in an attempt to find his identity makes a terrible discovery: he is the missing piece of a plot aimed at eliminating the president of the United States.

title: Last Food
actors: Gigio Alberti, Fanny La Monica, Hal Yamanouchi, Silvana Bosi
description: An Italian-French and a Japanese are the only survivors of a plane crash. The two are very different from each other: the rich Italian-French is always in a hurry and always angry while the Japanese, who is a cook by profession, is calm and relaxed. Finding themselves alone in a wasteland, the two are forced to confront each other and above all to fight the hunger that will lead them to extreme situations. But it will be from this experience that their lives will radically change.
notes: The newcomer (in the long run) Daniele Cini chooses the impervious path of the grotesque, a very difficult weapon that shoots between the lines. But even in the cinema, as in life, it is not convenient: because they only pay for the lines. Alberti is alternate, La Monica a young girl to keep an eye on and Yamanouchi is Nippoglycemic.

title: Les rivières pourpres 2. Les anges de l'Apocalypse
actors: Jean Reno, Benoît Magimel, Christopher Lee, Camille Natta, Johnny Hallyday
description: Commissioner Niemans and his former pupil Reda, now a police captain, are investigating the "angels of the Apocalypse", a group of monks who sow terror in Lorraine. Here there is a mysterious monastery that also interests the very powerful Heinrich. For their investigations, Niemans and Reda turn to Marie, a specialist in the history of religions ...
notes: Narratively unlikely, this second "purple" episode retains its dignity due to the irony of the characters of the two policemen, who seem to be Indiana Jones emulators, and for the action scenes shot with dignified professionalism by Dahan, obviously supervised by Luc Besson.

title: 3MSC. Tre metri sopra il cielo
actors: Riccardo Scamarcio, Katy Saunders, Claudio Bigagli, Galatea Ranzi, Mauro Meconi
description: Nineteen-year-old Step spends his time amidst fights and motorbike racing at night. He left home because they say he's a violent type. Eighteen-year-old Babi is a model student, a perfect daughter, but above all a romantic girl who awaits the arrival of prince charming. The two meet by chance, argue, fall in love, all over the course of a year that will remain unforgettable not only for them, but for everyone around them.
notes: Lucini, still far from having a personal style, demonstrates to handle the camera with ease and reveals a good nose in the choice and direction of the actors. Where the film doesn't convince is in the writing.

title: Non ti muovere
actors: Penélope Cruz, Sergio Castellitto, Claudia Gerini, Marco Giallini, Elena Perino
description: A fifteen-year-old falls off her scooter and is transported to the hospital where her father Timoteo works as a surgeon. While a colleague operates the girl, Timothy thinks back to the past and strips himself, shedding his mask as a model parent and husband. In an imaginary dialogue with his daughter, he reveals the story of an extramarital love consummated in a torrid summer many years ago ...
notes: As an actor, Castellitto interprets Timoteo's ambiguities well. As a director, he wanders between excellent visual insights and, on the contrary, excessive framing between the pages of his wife Margaret Mazzantini's novel. Cruz got ugly, Castellitto let himself go too far.

title: Jeux d'enfants
actors: Guillaume Canet, Marion Cotillard, Gérard Watkins, Emmanuelle Grönvold, Gilles Lellouche
description: Julien and Sophie are eight years old, but they are different from their peers. The two children invent a game that consists in setting out challenges that involve ever more daring and courageous actions. A music box is the symbol of their bets. Once they grow up they find themselves so involved that they can no longer get out of it while friendship turns into devouring passion.
notes: The film is shot in a lively and cloying style, with abuse of digital effects, funny secondary characters and half a dozen different versions of La vie en rose. The film displaces, disconcerts, does not bore, but never convinces, sparks cunning from all sides and remains a futile and old-fashioned exercise.

title: Cheaper by the Dozen
actors: Steve Martin, Bonnie Hunt, Piper Perabo, Tom Welling, Hilary Duff
description: The Bakers (Tom, Kate and twelve children) live in Midland, Illinois, where Tom coaches the college football team. When he is offered to coach the team of a major university he moves with the whole family. Meanwhile, the book Kate wrote about their life in fourteen is about to be published and her agent sends her to New York to promote it. Tom thus finds himself managing his new job alone and an increasingly discontented and chaotic family.
notes: The pleasantness of the comedy is due to the excellent cast. The film more than a remake of _Dodici They Call Him Dad_ is the rewrite of the novel by Frank B. Gilbreth jr. and Ernestine Gilbreth Carey.

title: Scenes of the Crimes
actors: Jeff Bridges, Jon Abrahams, R. Lee Ermey, Mädchen Amick
description: Lenny is about to get married, but cuts the rope from his bachelor party to chauffeur the gangster Rick, who, unbeknownst to him, is planning a kidnapping. The plan goes wrong, and Lenny ends up alone in the van, with the gun pointed at the kidnapped, Jimmy. He turns out to be a powerful criminal himself and warns his jailer that there will be serious consequences for him if he doesn't free him. As Jimmy's friend negotiates his release with Rick's boss, Jimmy's ambiguous bodyguard Seth tries to find a way to resolve the situation himself.
notes: Based on an anecdote the director heard in a dodgy bar.

title: Possession
actors: Isabelle Adjani, Sam Neill, Heinz Bennent, Margit Carstensen, Johanna Hofer, Carl Duering, Shaun Lawton, Michael Hogben, Maximilian Rüthlein, Thomas Frey, Leslie Malton, Gerd Neubert
description: Berlin, 1980s. The wall dominates the city. Mark, a former spy agent, returns home after his last mission. The relationship with his wife Anna deteriorates. Mark investigates, suspecting treason. She discovers that in addition to an "official" lover, Heinrich, Anna lives a second life with a mystery that she does not want to reveal, and that, slowly, drags her into a climax of violence and madness that makes her forget everything: her son Bob, his men, life itself.

title: Noah's Ark
actors: Jon Voight, Mary Steenburgen, F. Murray Abraham, Carol Kane, Mark Bazeley
description: The destruction of Sodoma and Gomorra, inhabited by sinners, was not enough to make men repent. God therefore orders a just name to build a huge ark where - together with his wife, three children and couples of all animal species - he will wait for the end of the flood destined to punish the evil mankind ...

title: L'amour c'est gai, l'amour c'est triste
actors: Claude Melki, Bernadette Lafont, Chantal Goya, Jean-Pierre Marielle
description: The tailor Léon divides the Negozio apartment with his sister Marie, who pretends herself chiromante but in reality receives the men who send her the "boyfriend" Maxime by appointment. The respective customers cross; Meanwhile, Léon falls in love with Arlette ...
notes: The pivot of the story is the talented Melki, actor-actor of Pollet.

title: The Rules of Attraction
actors: James Van Der Beek, Shannyn Sossamon, Jessica Biel, Faye Dunaway, Kate Bosworth, Ian Somerhalder
description: Camden College, a small New England university, is crowded with young people from good families: handsome Sean Bateman, up to his neck in debt; the cynical and libertine Paul Denton; the confused Lauren Hynde and Lara, her roommate ... The boys spend their time between classes - they attend occasionally - and the numerous parties of alcohol, drugs and sex.
notes: Just like in Bret Easton Ellis' book, the dramatic nature of the fresco is "explained" through the complexity of the language, with split-screen and fragmentations that break the linearity of a story for teen-agers (the cast is also symptomatic in this sense , given that the protagonist is the star of _Dawson's Creek_), restoring the imbalance and horror vacui of a generation that has become "world". Avary tackles narrative matter in the best possible way, even if it is precisely his formalism that keeps us away from the characters: preventing us from loving them or hating them, condemning them without appeal to their solipsistic drift.

title: Zorba il Buddha
actors: Elisabetta Cavallotti, Sid Meier, Roberto Zibetti, Luca Lionello
description: Loris, a DJ who would like to open a nightclub, meets Ritu, a lonely skipper, in an unspecified town on the Mediterranean coast where the girl is repairing the boat. Loris is so immersed in reading _Zorba the Greek_ that he establishes a dialogue with the novel's protagonist. Ritu, on the other hand, loves meditation and travels with a statuette of the Buddha who has a very precious diamond on his forehead, coveted by many.
notes: More than in front of Buddhist inspirations, it seems to be in the Maria De Filippi area, with "friends" who exchange the dream of a disco all for themselves, with the resolution of philosophical-existential problems.

title: L'amore ritorna
actors: Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Margherita Buy, Sergio Rubini, Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Mariangela Melato
description: Forty-year-old Luca Florio is an actor at the height of his career: there is no longer any trace in him of the provincial boy who fled the country by cutting ties with his family. But when, after an illness, he is hospitalized in a very luxurious clinic, he thinks back to his own existence, to the women he loved, to his closest friends, to his parents ... He thus regains possession of the culture of his land and rediscovers fantasies, beliefs, dreams with open eyes of the South that he left behind.
notes: Between visual insights, moving moments, songs, funny engravings, Rubini talks about himself and about cinema, about undressing and finding oneself, about the absurd and cruel job of the actor.

title: Arven
actors: Ulrich Thomsen, Lisa Werlinder, Lars Brygmann, Ghita Nørby, Karina Skands
description: Christoffer, the scion of the owners of the Copenhagen steel mills, has decided not to take care of the family business anymore. He is happily married to Maria, who is an actress, and runs a restaurant in Stockholm. When the father commits suicide, the mother insists that the son return to the family business. Initially Christoffer doesn't want to give in, but then, with a decision that takes everyone by surprise, he accepts. It is the beginning of a new life that will also have repercussions on man's private life.
notes: Although the film conscientiously tackles the brutal and perfidious laws of neocapitalism, the film nails above all for the psychological implications.

title: A/R Andata + Ritorno
actors: Libero De Rienzo, Vanessa Incontrada, Kabir Bedi, Remo Girone, Ugo Conti, Fabio Troiano, Mandala Tayde
description: Dante, a pony express by profession, never left the big city where he was born. Nina, a professional hostess, was born in Spain. Dante wants to leave forever and to do so he borrowed money from dangerous people, with the intention of not returning it. Destiny, thanks to a city blocked by a general strike, decides that Dante must stay and meet Nina. The love story becomes a race against time to pay back the money and close the account with the past.
notes: Libero De Rienzo is here promoted to protagonist, but his verve is too harnessed. The accompanying character actors, despite exhibiting various catchphrases, are quickly forgotten.

title: Le coût de la vie
actors: Fabrice Luchini, Vincent Lindon, Camille Japy, Géraldine Pailhas, Isild Le Besco
description: In Lyon the stories of various characters intertwine: an irreducible stingy, an overly generous restaurateur who gets ruined by dint of investing, a mysterious woman, an entrepreneur who sells out his factories after a heart attack, a young heiress who wants to be loved regardless of his possessions ... You think you are talking about money, in reality, feelings are at stake.
notes: Despite his ability to manage comedy intersections, excellent interpreters and brilliant dialogues, the film would risk being yet another French patrol if it did not force us to think about how much our life is conditioned by money, almost never for reasons of survival or basic well-being. Among the characters involved, it would be nice for everyone to identify with the Kenyan worker Catherine Hosmalin, who has a good laugh when faced with an "empty" credit card ...

title: City Hunter: Ai to shukemei no Magnum
description: Pianist Nina arrives in Japan not only to give a concert, but to search for the father she suspects is still alive, despite everyone trying to convince her otherwise. He hires City Hunter Ryo Saeba for the investigation.
notes: One of the best films of the animated series _City Hunter_, in turn based on the comic by Tsukasa Hôjô.

title: Detonator
actors: Randall Batinkoff, Elizabeth Berkley, Stan Shaw, Bokeem Woodbine
description: A disgraced former FBI agent, Postal Inspector Beau Stoddard is back in action when a series of explosive packages terrorize the Californian metropolis, coinciding with an international hockey tournament. The case is complicated by the intervention of Jane Dreyer, former colleague of Beau, and of the politician Robert Brickland, whose career is at stake ...
notes: Pure Serie B, seen and overwhelmed, smashing and stuffed with explosions and shootings. As in other similar productions, the cadence is sustained and in the finale there is also some passable mass scene, all however in the absence of any idea of ??direction. The revived Berkley is that of _Showgirls_.

title: Les Vampires
actors: Musidora, Edouard Mathé, Marcel Lévesque, Fernand Herrmann
description: The "Vampires" are the ferocious members of the criminal gang led by the beautiful and ruthless Irma Vep. The journalist Philippe Guérande, backed by a repentant "vampire", the gravedigger Mazamette ...
notes: Sixth episode of the ten that make up the series shot by the director of _Fantômas_.

title: Rupan sansei - Moeyo zantetsu ken
description: Goemon's sword is believed to be invincible. At least until the existence of an even more powerful metal alloy is discovered, whose formula - well kept inside the statuette of a dragon, sunk together with the Titanic - is tempting to many: for example Chin Chin, the king of the mafia of Hong Kong. But this is where Lupine comes in ...

title: Tunnel
actors: Kim Coates, Daniel Baldwin, Janine Theriault, Audrey Benoit
description: Agent Seale must escort the infamous thief Geary while he is being transferred to a train carriage. On the way, the convoy finds itself trapped in a tunnel to which a terrorist cell has barred both entrances; and in between there is also an immense swag in stolen diamonds ...
notes: At a latest census, there are five Baldwins in circulation in and around Hollywood: brothers Alec, Daniel, William and Stephen (in order of age), plus cousin Joseph. Here the good Danny has seen fit to try his hand also behind the camera, but the results do not differ from the family average: gruesome.

title: City of Industry
actors: Timothy Hutton, Harvey Keitel, Stephen Dorff, Famke Janssen
description: Petty criminal Lee wants to land the last shot of his career and retire. To fulfill his wish, his older brother Roy, a hardened criminal, and two accomplices Jorge and Skip give him a hand. The goal is a Palm Springs jewelry store. Everything is fine, but when the time comes for the partition, Skip kills Jorge, Lee and runs away with the loot. From that moment Roy only wants to avenge his brother. To find the homicidal traitor he asks for news, but the only one willing to help him is Jorge's widow.
notes: John Irvin directs with an expert hand and with an eye on the industrial landscape around Los Angeles.

title: Gothika
actors: Halle Berry, Robert Downey jr., Penélope Cruz, Charles S. Dutton, John Carroll Lynch
description: Under the supervision of her husband, director of the psychiatric ward of a women's prison, the criminal psychologist Miranda Gray follows dangerous patient-inmates suffering from mental disorders. One of them, Chloe, is a devil-obsessed killer. The meeting with an enigmatic girl upsets the doctor's life: recovering after a terrible accident, the woman discovers that her husband has been murdered and she is accused of the heinous crime. Miranda is thus relegated to Woodward ...
notes: In his first Hollywood experience (produced by Joel Silver and Robert Zemeckis), Kassovitz does all he can to keep the helm of the story firm and not to be blown away by the currents of apparent truths, by premeditated symptoms, by the restlessness of voices, words, writings. and invisible entities; from the parareligious possessions, from the demonic nightmares of which Chloe speaks; from the sinister visions of Miranda who, after a fatal and ghostly night, is accused of brutally slaughtering her husband.

title: Hysterical Blindness
actors: Uma Thurman, Gena Rowlands, Juliette Lewis, Justin Chambers

title: L'amore di Màrja
actors: Vincenzo Peluso, Laura Malmivaara, Lucia Sardo, Veronica Visentin, Tiziana Lodato
description: 1970s, Scandinavia. During a march for peace, Màrja, a cheerful and optimistic twenty-year-old, meets Fortunato, a Sicilian contemporary, and falls madly in love with him. The two decide to marry and create a family based on their ideals, but when, a few years later, they have to deal with the collapse of their generation's dreams, they find two daughters, a precarious existence and an uncertain future. To follow her husband, Màrja agrees to move to a small town in Sicily.
notes: Embarrassing film based on the theatrical comedy _Amarsi da pazze_, which was nominated for the IDI Autori Nuovi Award in 1995.

title: The Company
actors: Neve Campbell, Malcolm McDowell, James Franco, Barbara E. Robertson, Domingo Rubio, William Dick
description: Chicago's Joffrey Ballet is preparing a new show, _The Blue Snake_. Sacrifices and rivalries are the order of the day in the ranks of aspiring dancers: among them is Ry, torn between the desire to become an "étoile" and the reality of a waitress job ...
notes: More than a film, _The Company_ looks like the dress rehearsal of a film, where the "scene" engulfs the "off-stage", transforms fatigue and conflicts into lightness and unanimity, turns the strident imperfections of private life into choreographic perfection. During the days of rehearsal and exercises and during the evenings - often lonely and exhausted - of the dancers, the camera of Altman sinks with the usual fluidity in the faces, in the slaughtered feet, in the angry or worried looks, in the muscles and in the aching joints. ; he uses his proverbial zoom, the overcrowding amplified by the mirrored walls and the usual "overlapping dialogue" to underline the characters and their dynamics, to make us understand the individual events behind the construction of each show. In detail, it focuses only on the love story between the protagonist Ry and Josh (the only non-dancer in the film, who works as an assistant cook in a restaurant) and on the disruptive ego of the director of the company, masterfully played by a white-haired Malcolm. McDowell.

title: The Haunted Mansion
actors: Eddie Murphy, Terence Stamp, Jennifer Tilly, Wallace Shawn, Marsha Thomason
description: Jim Evers, a successful real estate agent, only thinks about his professional career. For work reasons he goes to a haunted house dragging his wife and children with him. It will be a ghost to make him understand the importance of the family that, in recent times, he had neglected a little too much.
notes: The film does not scare and does not make you smile. It is a mediumistic session of a unique boredom. It has a tired, listless and slow pace. The acting, aside from Stamp's, is dazed sleepwalker. The narrative scheme has an organization made up of levels, environments and tests typical of role-playing video games in which, moreover, one is much more involved.

title: Il vento, di sera
actors: Corso Salani, Francesca Mazza, Sergio Romano, Fabio Valletta, Ivano Marescotti
description: Marco leaves the station, takes his bicycle and rides home. Meanwhile, Paolo, from his home, talks on the phone with Luca, his partner who is waiting for dinner. Marco arrives in front of the door, but as soon as he opens two gunshots they kill him. On the way of the killer on the run, Luca accidentally appears and is fatally wounded. Among the people rushed there is also Paolo who, shocked, witnesses the arrival of the ambulance.
notes: A film of pure direction, stifled and proud, which has its Achilles heel in the acting of Corso Salani, a non-actor author, frankly unable to hold a role of such difficulty. Once again, in the young independent Italian cinema, acting - except in very rare cases - is optional. When instead it should be the tool to communicate emotions.

title: Les Vampires
actors: Musidora, Edouard Mathé, Marcel Lévesque, Fernand Herrmann
description: The "Vampires" are the ferocious members of the criminal gang led by the beautiful and ruthless Irma Vep. The journalist Philippe Guérande, backed by a repentant "vampire", the gravedigger Mazamette ...
notes: Seventh episode of the ten that make up the series shot by the director of _Fantômas_.

title: Senza scrupoli
actors: Sandra Wey, Marzio Honorato, Antonio Marsina, Cinzia De Ponti
description: Diego, a robber already scheduled by the police, penetrates the house of Massimo, a jeweler of Turin. Finding neither money nor jewels, violent Silvia, the wife of the landlord, momentarily remained alone. The woman finds the clumsy and suffers its charm ...
notes: The director of _a girl named Giulio_ runs this sad epigone of the Italian hero without conviction. Wey came from _histoire d'O number 2_, Honorato (the Renato Poggi of the Neapolitan soap _A place in the sun_) by _a woman in the mirror_ with Sandrelli. In a particle even Alessandra Canale, Angelica "Miss Buongo" appears by Mamma Rai.

title: Kaijû daisenso
actors: Nick Adams, Akira Takarada, Jun Tazaki, Akira Kubo, Kumi Mizuno
description: # Following the discovery of satellite X - shadowed by the immense size of Jupiter - scientists organize an expedition with the two astronauts Glenn (Nick Adams) and Fuji (Akira Takarada). After landing, the two are captured by the inhabitants of X, who are not aggressive and instead ask for help: to get rid of the "Monster Zero" - the three-headed flying dragon known by the earthlings as "King Ghidorah" - which is raging on the surface of their planet, forcing them to live underground, they need the help of Godzilla and Rodan. If the governments of Earth agree to let them carry the two monsters to X, in exchange they will provide remedies against diseases not yet eradicated.

title: Cara dolce nipote
actors: Ursula Heinle, Femi Benussi, Lucio Flauto, Francesco Parisi
description: Daniela, a collegiate collegial, is a guest of Uncle Corrado, an inconsolable widower. In the nephew, Corrado finds his beloved Laura: protects her from bad companies, but the spy in the shower and is attempted. In addition to her morbid attention, Daniela must also defend herself from those of a mature fake pilot bachelor and fake dongiovanni ...

title: D'Artagnan contro i tre moschettieri
actors: Fernando Lamas, Roberto Risso, Walter Barnes, Franco Fantasia
description: D'Artagnan and the Three Musketeers are not allies. The first must serve the interests of Cardinal Mazarin against the fallen English king Charles II. The others, on the other hand, refuse to hand Carlo over to the English dictator Cromwell and are wary of Mazarin's plans.

title: Désordre
actors: Wadeck Stanczak, Ann-Gisel Glass, Lucas Belvaux, Remi Martin

title: Rad der Zeit
description: The Indian locality of Bodh Gaya, on the border with Tibet, is the site of an initiation ceremony to Buddhism, celebrated in the presence of the Dalai Lama and crowded with hundreds of thousands of faithful. During the liturgy (lasting six weeks), a gigantic and very elaborate mandala is composed, a sacred painting made of colored sand, the subsequent destruction of which symbolizes the "impermanence" of the things of this Earth. A new tour de force for the Bavarian director, who has always witnessed extreme situations (and their paradoxical implications, such as the repetition of the ritual in an "unthinkable" place like the Austrian city of Graz).

title: Reazione a catena. Ecologia del delitto
actors: Claudine Auger, Luigi Pistilli, Claudio Volonté, Laura Betti, Leopoldo Trieste
description: In a wooded bay, an old countess and her heirs are killed by a mysterious killer, who kills with rare savagery.
notes: On the model of _10 little Indians_ by Agatha Christie, Mario Bava deviates from his gothic path and dwells on the slasher drifts of our local thriller. The author's visionary structure fits perfectly with the dramaturgical tension given by the logic of the progressive elimination of the victims, agonizing in the woods that will be resumed years later by the American _Friday 13_. A fundamental work to understand the contemporary and subsequent genre season, as well as Bava's best thriller outcome. Great care of a photograph with a psychedelic color rendering.

title: Che dottoressa ragazzi!
actors: Maria Pia Conti, Femi Benussi, Francesco Parisi, Lucio Como
description: The doctor conducted by a small island is also a beautiful woman. The inhabitants invent diseases of all kinds in order to be visited and it is obvious that the respective wives do not see the doctor well.

title: Metti lo diavolo tuo ne lo mio inferno
actors: Antonio Cantafora, Margareth Rose Keil, Mario Frera, Fortunato Arena
description: Ricciardo is a fourteenth-century playboy who wants at all costs to sleep with the wife of the mayor of Montelupone. He succeeds but is caught in the blankets with the woman and sentenced to death. He will be saved by a kind of pilgrim saint who is in love with him.

title: Flickorna

title: La dérobade

actors: Bradford Dillman, Robert Ryan, Jeff Bridges, Lee Marvin, Fredric March, Robert Ryan, Jeff Bridges, Bradford Dillman

title: Gli orrori del castello di Norimberga
actors: Elke Sommer, Joseph Cotten, Massimo Girotti, Rada Rassimov
description: Peter von Kleist, descendant of a ferocious baron who lived in the seventeenth century, possesses a very rare parchment containing the instructions for a spell capable of resurrecting the "accursed" ancestor. Accompanied by student Eva Arnold, Peter enters the manor and recites the magic formula: the ghost awakens and kills three people. Meanwhile, a mysterious paralytic named Alfred Becker buys the castle and renovates it, becoming friends with Eva, Peter and his uncle, Professor Karl Hummer: but there are those who swear that Becker's identity is very different .. .
notes: Bava and Cotten don't take themselves too seriously, and the film's economy makes a profit.

title: Frau Wirtins tolle Töchterlein
actors: Femi Benussi, Gabriele Tinti, Marika Mindzenthy, Sonja Jeannine

title: Narc
actors: Busta Rhymes, Ray Liotta, Jason Patric, Chi McBride, Anne Openshaw
description: Nick Tellis put him to rest. Yet he is young, and he was one of the brightest narcotics agents. Except that in a gunfight he accidentally killed a pregnant woman ... Now they want him back. A policeman, infiltrated in the drug sector, was killed; maybe Nick can help out with the investigation. Entrust to Henry Oak, tied to the victim like a brother. Nothing, however, is as it appears ... Low budget, refined direction, independent production (in which Tom Cruise participates) for one of the best films of 2002, never released in Italy. Jason Patric's performance is surprising, while Ray Liotta (also co-producer) is a confirmation.

title: Love Object
actors: Desmond Harrington, Melissa Sagemiller, Rip Torn, Brad Henke
description: Kenneth is a shy and insecure employee who invests $ 10,000 to buy "Nikki", a silicone doll strikingly similar to a real woman online. But when he falls in love - surprisingly reciprocated - with the beautiful (and real) Lisa, his colleague from the office, the doll gets jealous and becomes violent ...
notes: The newcomer Paris passes with ease from comedy to psycho-horror developments, with all too frequent injections of morbid eroticism. The unfolding of the story seems rather obvious, and the character of the pathologically introverted protagonist is not sufficiently characterized to be likeable to us.

title: Lisa e il diavolo
actors: Telly Savalas, Elke Sommer, Sylva Koscina, Alida Valli, Gabriele Tinti
description: Lisa gets lost and ends up in a psychic labyrinth created by the Devil.
notes: Version cut and reassembled with sequences shot by Alfredo Leone after the veto of the producers on the original _La casa dell'exorcismo_. The visionary charge and the oneiric (therefore Bavarian) potential of the first version are lost.

title: Federal Protection
actors: Armand Assante, Angela Featherstone, Dina Meyer, David Lipper
description: Frankie Carbone, a thug serving a Chicago Cosa Nostra boss, is pinched by the feds and agrees to testify against his boss. From that moment his life changes radically: the FBI gives him a new identity, from now on he will be called Howard Akers, and finds him an apartment in a residential area. The man befriends Leigh, his neighbor. She is married to Denny who cheats on her with Bootsie, Leigh's sister. The story gets complicated when Bootsie and Denny, having learned of Howard's true identity, will try to collect the bounty that the mafia boss has placed on his head.

title: Calore in provincia
actors: Enzo Monteduro, Francesco Mulè, Valeria Fabrizi, Patrizia Gori, Venantino Venantini, Carla Calò, Angela Covello, Annie Carol Edel, Edoardo Faieta
description: Don Calogero Lentini's daughter is pregnant. Looking for a repaired husband, the young "clothes" Ciccio Zannone, an insignificant little man who finally manages to become a relative of the boss.

title: Poppea... una prostituta al servizio dell'impero
actors: Femi Benussi, Linda Sini, Eva Czemerys, Howard Ross, Vittorio Caprioli
description: Imperial Rome: Ottone and Savio, idlers by profession, captain at Nero's court, where they are mistaken for valiant praetorians and involved in dangerous conspiracies ...
notes: Indigestible mix of spaghetti western and sexy comedy. All disguised as a peplum with parodic intentions: a failed attempt.

title: Patty Hearst
actors: Natasha Richardson, William Forsythe, Ving Rhames, Frances Fisher, Jodi Long
description: Patricia, eldest daughter of the rich and powerful American press tycoon W. Randolph Hearst, was kidnapped on February 4, 1974 by the Free Symbionese Army, made up of revolutionary fanatics. Segregated and humiliated, the young woman undergoes a long and traumatic process of indoctrination. Meanwhile Sinkiou, responsible for the crime, intends to exploit the popularity of the hostage in order to see some comrades freed and to capture the participation of many ...
notes: Taken from Hearst's autobiographical book and scripted by Nicholas Kazan, it is a disappointing film both from the point of view of the plot and from the documentary point of view.

title: On the Double
actors: Danny Kaye, Dana Wynter, Diana Dors, Wilfrid Hyde-White, Margaret Rutherford

title: À meia-noite levarei sua alma
actors: José Mojica Marins (Zé do Caixão), Magda Mei, Nivaldo Lima, Valéria Vasquez

title: In the Shadows
actors: Matthew Modine, James Caan, Joey Lauren Adams, Lillo Brancato jr., Cuba Gooding jr.
description: A stuntman is accidentally killed on a film set. His uncle, a criminal from New York, sends the infallible hitman Eric O’Byrne to eliminate the stunt coordinator, Lance, who is considered to be responsible for the death. But Eric is fascinated by the adrenaline-pumping world of stunt performers and becomes part of it; in addition, he ends up falling in love with Clarissa, the daughter of the man she has to kill. The situation is further complicated when he discovers that the dead man had hidden a drug consignment, on whose trail some criminals have set out ...
notes: The cast is definitely of a good standard: much less the final result of this "action" set in the universe of stuntmen.

title: Effroyables jardins
actors: Jacques Villeret, André Dussollier, Thierry Lhermitte, Benoît Magimel

actors: Vany Miller, Verônica Krimann, George Michel Serkeis, Íris Bruzzi, Oswaldo De Souza

actors: Masaaki Daimon, Kazuya Aoyama, Akihiko Hirata, Hiroshi Koizumi

actors: José Mojica Marins (Zé do Caixão), Antoninho, Ronaldo Beibe, Big Boy, Andreia Bryan

title: Delirios de um anormal
actors: José Mojica Marins (Zé do Caixão), Jorge Peres, Magna Miller, Jaime Cortez

title: Tôkyô nagaremono
actors: Tetsuya Watari, Chieko Matsubara, Hideaki Nitani, Ryuji Kita
description: Tetsu was a yazuka, but now he's running straight: when a rival gang threatens to unleash a new war for dominance over the territory, he can only side with the old boss ...
notes: Among Suzuki's best works, the film stands out for its eccentric humor and a use of color akin to pop art.

title: Tú que harías por amor?
actors: Alberto Escobar, Fele Martinez, Silke, Geraldine Chaplin, Francisco Rabal, Patxi Freytez
description: Milio is thirteen. His brother Luis just a handful more. But their childhood has long passed for them: the two boys have in fact found a way to support themselves by being drug couriers for the powerful and feared Don Vicente. Giving in to their mother's recurring protests, Luis tries to persuade Milio to stop dealing with dangerous traffic. But when one of their friends is killed, the little boy gets even more involved in the risky operations. Presented at the Cannes Film Festival in 2000, the film represents the interesting debut of Carlos Saura's son, Carlos Saura Medrano.

title: Peter Pan
actors: Jason Isaacs, Jeremy Sumpter, Rachel Hurd-Wood, Lynn Redgrave, Richard Briers, Olivia Williams
description: Wendy Darling tells her two younger siblings the stories about Captain Hook, the mythical pirate who is not afraid of anything. Wendy's father, on the advice of strict aunt Millicent, however, has decided that it is time for Wendy to leave fairy tales aside and grow up. But Peter Pan also loves the stories that the girl tells and comes specifically to listen to them. He will be the one to ask Wendy and the brothers to follow him to Neverland, even if this triggers Tinkerbell's jealousy.
notes: The film is a happy mediation between standards and inspiration, fantasy and fairy tale grammar, entertainment and analytic session, playground and identification procedures. At least four casting choices are impeccable: Jason Isaacs in the double role of dad Darling and Captain Hook, Rachel Hurd-Wood, the candid Wendy with the kiss hidden on the lips, Lynn Redgrave, the seasoned Aunt Millicent and the saucy Ludivine Sagnier, the jealous. Fairy Tinker Bell.

title: L'odore del sangue
actors: Michele Placido, Fanny Ardant, Giovanna Giuliani, Sergio Tramonti
description: Carlo is divided between his wife Silvia, with whom he shares an apartment in Rome, and the young lover Lù, with whom he lives from time to time in his house in the countryside. The man does not keep his relationship hidden from his wife and indeed accepts that Silvia may have lovers. During a phone call, she discovers that a young man is courting her. From now on he will have their meetings told in detail and he will no longer have peace.
notes: The truth is that _The smell of blood_ is an unsolved film which however remains open, not so much in its narrative succession, quite respectful of the "phases" of the novel, as in its "hand-to-hand" with the viewer. It is full of beautiful and important things, starting with the amazing work of (and with) the actors: Michele Placido, Fanny Ardant and Giovanna Giuliani are courageous and in a state of constant tension, physically perceptible by the beholder. But it is also a film by which you always wait to be overwhelmed, in vain.

title: The Passion of the Christ
actors: Jim Caviezel, Monica Bellucci, Claudia Gerini, Maia Morgenstern, Sergio Rubini
description: The last twelve hours of Jesus' life: from the Garden of Olives, where he went to pray after the Last Supper, to the arrest and death sentence by the high priests. Then the decision of Pontius Pilate to entrust the choice to the crowd, the scourging, the cross to be carried through the streets of Jerusalem to Golgotha, the crucifixion.
notes: The _Passion of Christ_ is - without sin of blasphemy, in a translated way - "Gibson's passion": the passion for an idea of ??cinema that confronts a mystery of faith and reveals its visual force as a "lethal weapon". The slowed-down images, the very close-ups, the stubborn time dilation, the persistence of torture and affliction lead to an epic instance of the story, to the rejection of a conventional and widespread dramaturgy in three acts and a "rewriting" of the stations. of the Via Crucis; to the perceptual breakdown of an experimental, underground cinema compared to the mainstream and Hollywood costs. A spectator unaware of the Gospel letter on the passion and martyrdom of Christ and - even before - on the earthly life of the son of God (the flashbacks are not enough) would find it difficult to understand what is happening (a person condemned to death cannot and does not want to escape and accepts his own torture in the name of a supreme and implicit law) and would not understand who in the crowd - apart from the figure of the mother - the people who suffer with the man humiliated, beaten, mistreated, mocked and finally crucified.

title: Mariti in affitto
actors: Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Pierfrancesco Favino, Chevy Chase, Brooke Shields, Diego Serrano, James Falzone
description: Vincenzo lives in New York, but returns to Procida once a year to his beloved wife Maria and children. When he suddenly disappears, Maria decides to pack up and go after him. But when she arrives at her destination, she realizes that for years Vincenzo has only been telling her lies: not only is he penniless, but he is also regularly married to an American, Charlene. Despite the thirst for revenge, the two women become friends and allies.
notes: The story is told with sloppiness, the specks are folkloric, the photography is unnecessarily precious, the film has no glimmer of rhythm, it is always fake and not funny.

title: Stuck On You
actors: Matt Damon, Greg Kinnear, Eva Mendes, Wen Yann Shih, Cher, Jackie Flynn
description: Bob and Walt Tenor are Siamese twins who own a fast-food restaurant. The two have never hindered each other in anything, so when Walt decides to attempt an acting career, the two move to Hollywood. Here, after a series of bad auditions, they come across Cher who hires them on her show with the aim of burying him. However, Walt is very successful, but he has to make a decision that will change his life and Bob's forever.
notes: The film is more of a prosthetic exploit (the special trick used to encapsulate the two protagonists in a rubbery shell) than an unprecedented chapter in comic aesthetics. In fact, from _Tutti crazy for Mary_ to here, the irreverence, the mockery, the wickedness have partially subsided. The humorous perfidy has blunted, almost blunted. If Love at first oversight is the incorrect praise of the beauty of the soul in a world debased by look and exteriority, _Fratelli per la pelle_, in which there is no shortage of witty gags and sketches, the desire for family pampering invests the partnership, the complicity, the monozygotic understanding. All are (we are) spectators and protagonists of a life-musical.

title: Senza ragione
actors: Franco Nero, Telly Savalas, Duilio Del Prete, Mark Lester, Ely Galleani
description: Memphis, known as the American, Dino "Mosquito" Bianco and the hippy Maria, a friend of the second, carry out a robbery in a jewelry store in Rome. The dead man escapes and so the three are forced to seek refuge in France. They make the mistake of stealing a car with a little boy on board.
notes: Good action scenes.

title: Golpe de estadio
actors: Nicolás Montero, César Mora, Andrea Giordana, Emma Suarez, Lorena Forteza
description: In a Colombian town, which grew up around an oil well, soldiers commanded by Sergeant Garcia clash daily with groups of guerrillas. The two sides decide to suspend hostilities to watch all together, in front of the only TV in the village, at the qualifying match for the USA '94 World Cup that Colombia is playing against Argentina. The only one intent on breaking the truce is arms dealer Klaus Mauser ...
notes: Cabrera and his seven co-writers find nothing better than to satirize the complex Colombian situation in a less pungent and indifferent way.

title: Ginger Snaps
actors: Emily Perkins, Katharine Isabelle, Mimi Rogers, Kris Lemche
description: 15-year-olds Ginger and Brigitte are often derided by their peers for their weirdness. The two love to make photo shoots in which they simulate violent deaths and suicides. During one of these sessions they are attacked by a werewolf. It will be the beginning of a nightmare ...
notes: Negligible teen-horror.

title: Live From Baghdad
actors: Michael Keaton, Helena Bonham Carter, Lili Taylor, Joshua Leonard

title: Tommy
actors: Roger Daltrey, Ann-Margret, Oliver Reed, Elton John, Eric Clapton
description: After the death of his father, little Tommy loses the use of his senses. Growing up, he will have to undergo the most traumatic experiences (the meeting with the "Acid Queen", the tortures of his cousin Kevin and his uncle Ernie), but he will be able to redeem himself by becoming a pinball star before reaching full self-control.
notes: At the height of his most imaginative period, Russell signed the film adaptation of the famous "rock-opera" signed by the glorious Who. The result is not without flaws, excesses and a risky propensity for metaphor, but the firepower released by the Daltrey-Townsend-Moon-Entwistle quartet is one of those "epochal" to say the least.

title: Tulitikkutehtaan tyttö
actors: Kati Outinen, Elina Salo, Esko Nikkari, Vesa Vierikko, Silu Seppälä
description: Iris works in a match factory, and is shy to the point of never talking, certainly not at home, where she irones or prepares dinner while her parents are watching TV, or even at the dance hall, during her vain waiting for an invitation. One day she doesn't buy a new dress and thinks she will find love. She will find out the truth only after she gets pregnant.
notes: We are perhaps at the apex of Kaurismäki's invincible and laconic sadness, who says of this film: "it testifies to the end of dreams, death, ruin, destruction, despair of men who live on the threshold of the third millennium." Last chapter of the proletarian trilogy, after _Ombre in paradiso_ and _Ariel_.

title: Lezioni private
actors: Carroll Baker, Rosalino Cellamare, Leonora Fani, Renzo Montagnani, Leopoldo Trieste
description: Eighteen-year-old Alessandro, enrolled in the conservatory, is more interested in music than in sex. The vivacious Emanuela of the same age, her gay brother Gabriele, a house maid and even the new piano teacher will undermine her virtue.
notes: In addition to the future Ron, the star of the film is the then 44-year-old "Baby Doll" Baker: how sad ...

title: The Mists of Avalon
actors: Edward Atterton, Julianna Margulies, Joan Allen, Samantha Mathis, Anjelica Huston
description: Viviana, Lady of the Lake and high priestess of the island of Avalon, sacred to the druidic cult, chooses her niece Morgana, half-sister of King Arthur, to participate in the ancient rite of the Sacred Wedding, during which she will offer her virginity. The chosen one will be Arthur himself, unhappily married to Guinevere ...

title: Les Vampires
actors: Musidora, Edouard Mathé, Marcel Lévesque, Fernand Herrmann
description: The "Vampires" are the ferocious members of the criminal gang led by the beautiful and ruthless Irma Vep. The journalist Philippe Guérande, backed by a repentant "vampire", the gravedigger Mazamette ...
notes: Eighth episode of the ten that make up the series shot by the director of _Fantômas_.

title: The Foreigner
actors: Steven Seagal, Max Ryan, Harry Van Gorkum, Jeffrey Pierce
description: Contacted by a mysterious interlocutor, former government agent Jonathan Cold agrees to transport a package whose contents remain top secret from France to Germany. However, it must be something very important, since all hell breaks loose to get hold of it: political corruption, betrayals, bloody deaths. Broken from all experiences, Cold knows perfectly well that the only way to save his skin is to stay out of the game: but it won't be easy ...
notes: The usual, unchanging film with Seagal. Also in 2003, director Oblowitz directed the rocky actor (?) In the equally mediocre _The Avenger_.

title: The Return of the Six-Million-Dollar Man and the Bionic Woman
actors: Lee Majors, Lindsay Wagner, Tom Schanley, Martin Landau, Richard Anderson, Martin E. Brooks, Gary Lockwood
description: Ten years have passed: both Colonel Steve Austin and his colleague Jaime Sommers have retired from service and lead a peaceful existence. However, the couple is destined to reunite: a dangerous terrorist group is threatening the United States, using the powers of Steve's bionic son ...

title: Harlow
actors: Carroll Baker, Peter Lawford, Martin Balsam, Red Buttons, Raf Vallone, Michael Connors
description: Having landed in Hollywood at a very young age, Jean sets the stage for success with the help of agent Arthur Landau. Her image as a girl next door conquers men and is a model for women, but behind the facade the reality is very different ...
notes: "Biopic" without quality of the famous diva (who died just 26 years old in 1937).

title: Pinocchio's Revenge
actors: Rosalind Allen, Candace McKenzie, Brittany Alyse Smith, Lewis Van Bergen, Todd Allen
description: Lawyer Jennifer must defend a child serial killer who was caught hiding a victim's body. Along with the body was found a puppet with the features of Pinocchio who, according to the murderer, is the bearer of a curse. Jennifer has the unfortunate idea of ??taking the puppet home.

title: Milano odia: la polizia non può sparare
actors: Tomas Milian, Henry Silva, Ray Lovelock, Gino Santercole, Laura Belli
description: Giulio Sacchi, a fierce suburban fool, organizes the kidnapping of a girl, the daughter of a wealthy businessman. In his footsteps Commissioner Grandi, who understood everything, even the tragic epilogue of the story. He will have to do himself justice.
notes: Crudest detective story that Ernesto Gastaldi wrote paying attention to the climate of tension of the time. He was accused of fascism, especially for the definition of the cop (Henry Silva, once so "good"), but revised today he is above all one of the few Italian genre films to have an "American" rhythm and structure. Umberto Lenzi's best performance behind the camera.

title: Hidalgo
actors: Viggo Mortensen, Zuleikha Robinson, Omar Sharif, Louise Lombard, Said Taghmaoui
description: Frank T. Hopkins, one of the greatest horseback riders in America, becomes a legend when with his mustang Hidalgo he fights with the best Arab horses and riders. The man is in fact invited to participate in the "Ocean of Fire", a grueling 3,000-mile race across the desert.
notes: Hopkins, played by the woody (but likeable) Viggo Mortensen, wants to be one of those shadowy adventure novel heroes; he keeps a secret "in his blood" that will save his life at the end of the race and above all is complementary to the true protagonist of the story, Hidalgo, a splendid "red Indian" mustang. _Oceano di fuoco_ is a harmless divertissement, touristic and oleographic like a Bertolucci in the desert, naive in digging out references from a cinephile past (Sheikh Omar Sharif is already an imaginary in himself), but also engaging when he returns to the zero degree adventure.

title: The In-Laws
actors: Michael Douglas, Albert Brooks, Ryan Reynolds, Lindsay Sloane
description: The peaceful existence of podiatrist Jerry Peyser is literally shattered by meeting future consu-in-law Steve Tobias. The latter, a reckless CIA official who spends his days dodging bullets and meeting dangerous arms dealers, involves him in spite of himself in a series of breathtaking adventures around the world.
notes: The odd couple works and the two actors are in good harmony, some lines are guessed, environments and characters are deliberately farcical. The characterizations of the two consuocere are amusing. Dull, the betrothed. The film is a decent remake of _A strange couple of in-laws_.

title: Secret Window
actors: Johnny Depp, John Turturro, Maria Bello, Timothy Hutton, Charles S. Dutton
description: The famous crime writer Mort is in a deep crisis: he is in the midst of a painful divorce and can no longer write. As if that weren't enough, one day John knocks on his door accusing him of copying a story and claiming satisfaction. As much as Mort tries to placate him, the man becomes more and more insistent and hostile stating that he may even go so far as to kill him in cold blood ...
notes: Based on a Stephen King long-length novel (_Secret window, secret garden_, contained in the _Four after midnight_ collection), it is a reeling chamber thriller with a Turturro at its worst. More was expected from an experienced screenwriter like Koepp.

title: Takedown
actors: Tom Berenger, Skeet Ulrich, Angela Featherstone, Ned Bellamy, Russell Wong
description: Kevin Mitnick is the most dangerous cybercriminal around. The FBI repeatedly tries to frame him, collecting sensational failures: the only opponent of the same level is Shinomura, a former infallible hacker like Mitnick, who together with a federal agent sets out on the latter's trail in an attempt to block his illegal activity. Mitnick, hunted and willing to do anything, plays his last card ...
notes: Based on a true story, the starting idea is certainly not original. However, the development has a bite and always keeps the pace high, thanks to a few well-chosen twists that chase away the ghost of predictability.

title: La moglie dell'amico è sempre più buona
actors: Carlo Delle Piane, Maria Rosaria Omaggio, Sydne Rome, Carlos Larranaga
description: Giulio is married to Mirella, a militant feminist; Romano with Giustina, deputy of a Catholic party. The two, still young, are tired of being neglected by their respective spouses and think it well to have fun with some "happy" girl: it will end with a couple swap.
notes: Unspeakable nonsense with an itchy background.

title: Ablaze
actors: Ice T, Michael Dudikoff, John Bradley, Amanda Pays, Tom Arnold, Cathy Lee Crosby
description: Wendell, owner of a refinery in the United States, plans to burn down his plant. Its purpose? To cheat the insurance and collect the substantial premium in this way. Wendell achieves the only result of causing a terrifying fire that threatens to spread throughout the city.

title: Giunse Ringo e... fu tempo di massacro
actors: Mickey Hargitay, Lucy Bomez, Anna Cerreto, Omero Gargano, James Luisi

title: Deception
actors: Dina Meyer, Gary Hudson, Steve Bacic, Anna Silk, Alan Fawcett
description: The beautiful Erin works for a detective agency, seducing married men only to be caught red-handed by their wives. The alarm goes off when, after some telephone threats, someone tries to harm her: is it her boss, in love with her, one of the old "customers" or her new man?

title: Moi, un noir
actors: Oumarou Ganda, Petit Touré, Alassane Maiga, Amadou Demba
description: Looking for work, some boys from the Nigerian countryside came to Abidjan. One of them, who like the others has taken on a "symbolic" pseudonym (his is "Eddie Constantine"), tells of the traumatic passage from rural roots to the metropolis.
notes: One of the best known works of the great French documentary maker.

title: Et la lumière fut
actors: Sigalon Sagna, Saly Badji, Binta Cissé, Marie-Christine Dieme
description: In a village of huts in Senegal, life flows quietly in compliance with environmental laws and tribal rites. Sometimes rain is invoked and sometimes the old god, a wooden idol, sends it to everyone's delight. Marriages and divorces are operated according to ancient formulas. The collapse of this primitive world comes with the first trucks of whites, driven by black people, who cut down trees to open new roads. Then the village is set on fire ...
notes: By mixing fantastic images with other surreal images, Ioselians find a miraculous balance between ethnographic gaze and dreamlike visions.

title: Les Vampires
actors: Musidora, Edouard Mathé, Marcel Lévesque, Fernand Herrmann
description: The "Vampires" are the ferocious members of the criminal gang led by the beautiful and ruthless Irma Vep. The journalist Philippe Guérande, backed by a repentant "vampire", the gravedigger Mazamette ...
notes: Ninth episode of the ten that make up the series shot by the director of _Fantômas_.

title: Scooby-Doo and the Cyber Chase
description: While attempting to capture the fearsome Phantom Virus, Scooby-Doo and his friends find themselves in a video game based on one of their own adventures. Through the ten levels of the game, our heroes roam from Prehistory to the future, always grappling with a horde of "virtual" villains ...

title: Dark Asylum
actors: Paulina Porizkova, Judd Nelson, Jürgen Prochnow, Larry Drake
description: Finally captured, a dangerous serial killer is transferred to a maximum security facility intended for the custody of psychotic criminals. Doctor Maggie Belham takes care of the new inmate, but soon he manages to escape and the woman ends up finding herself in a far from easy position: alone and trapped in a labyrinth of corridors at the mercy of the maniac. The only person who could help her is a certain Quitz: apparently a cleaner, but perhaps a "forgotten" guest of the institute himself ...
notes: Anyone expecting jolts of originality is requested to turn elsewhere.

title: Money Talks
actors: Charlie Sheen, Chris Tucker, Gérard Ismaël, Paul Sorvino, Heather Locklear
description: A report by TV journalist James Russell draws police attention to the modest illegal activities of Franklin Hatchett, who thus finds himself in a jail. During the transfers from one prison to another, Hatchett is handcuffed to Raymond Villard, a jewel thief in a big way: the latter's thieves attack the cell phone, killing several victims but managing to free their boss. Now Hatchett is a wild bird too, although he has a heavy accusation of murder on his head: therefore all he has to do is turn to Russell, to whom he proposes a pact ...
notes: Yet another variation on the theme of the "strange couple".

title: The River's Edge
actors: Ray Milland, Anthony Quinn, Debra Paget, Byron Foulger
description: After clearing out a bank, Nardo Denning heads to the Mexican border. To orient himself in the mountains, however, he needs the help of an expert guide: he finds her in the Ben Cameron ranchero, who forces him to escort him. But Ben is married to Margaret, who had once been Nardo's woman, and fleeing into the mountains the ancient passion re-emerges, inevitably putting the two men in conflict.
notes: One of the latest films from veteran Dwan. A contemporary western setting, a low-budget Cinemascope, with a very macho Anthony Quinn and Ray Milland in the unusual role of the bad guy.

title: Oleanna
actors: William H. Macy, Debra Eisenstadt
description: During a long conversation in his study with Carol, a somewhat obtuse college student, Professor John makes a few potentially ambiguous statements. The next day, much to his bewilderment, the teacher is accused of sexual harassment ...
notes: Fourth film by Mamet, from one of his plays (and it shows).

title: Le nombril du monde
actors: Marie Jose Nat, Delphine Forest, Roger Hanin, Thomas Langmann, Michel Boujenah
description: In the years in which Tunisia is freeing itself from the French protectorate, the unscrupulous Bajou tries in every way to look after his own interests and become "someone" ...
notes: Fluviale, ambitious but not completely resolved film by Zeitoun, of which in 2001 the very little memorable _Yamakasi_ arrived in Italy.

title: Les Vampires
actors: Musidora, Edouard Mathé, Marcel Lévesque, Fernand Herrmann
description: The "Vampires" are the ferocious members of the criminal gang led by the beautiful and ruthless Irma Vep. The journalist Philippe Guérande, backed by a repentant "vampire", the gravedigger Mazamette ...
notes: Last episode of the ten that make up the series shot by the director of _Fantômas_.

title: John Goldfarb, Please Come Home
actors: Shirley MacLaine, Peter Ustinov, Richard Crenna, Patrick Adiarte
description: Due to a court incident that disturbs the life of the Fawz kingdom, the American ambassador is expelled. Jenny, a journalist assigned to do a report on the sultan's harem, will try to remedy the scandal. The woman is helped by a distracted pilot and by Prince Ammud.
notes: Disappointing exotic farce.

title: Evilenko
actors: Malcolm McDowell, Marton Csokas, Ronald Pickup, Frances Barber
description: Late 1980s. Detective Lesiev, a young magistrate and father of a family, is investigating the frightening crimes of the "Forest Stripe Monster", a ruthless serial killer who raped, devoured and killed over 50 children without leaving a trace. When he discovers that the man is a schizophrenic, Lesiev realizes that in order to unmask and capture him he is forced to enter his sick mind.
notes: Grieco's staging also has happy moments, especially because he works on space as if he were on stage. What spoils everything is the indefensible acting of Malcolm MacDowell, exaggeratedly over the top and in contrast to the German TV show underplaying of the other actors. The exasperated dubbing of Giancarlo Giannini then gives the coup de grace.

title: Il siero della vanità
actors: Margherita Buy, Barbora Bobulova, Valerio Mastandrea, Francesca Neri, Rosario J. Gnolo, Marco Giallini, Ninni Bruschetta, Maddalena Maggi, Marco Cortesi, Nicola Paduano, Antonio Ianniello, Francesca Barone
description: Suddenly some famous personalities of Italian television disappear into thin air. The media are unleashed and the television guru Sonia Norton, owner of the show of the same name, does not hesitate to make the situation even more dramatic with her alarmist reports. Former police inspector Lucia Allasco with colleague Fabio Berradi investigate the case and discover that there is a direct link between Sonia Norton Show and the disappearances.
notes: In the film there are some inconsistencies and not always the tension of the suspense and the grotesque notations come together without jolts. The two protagonists are good and convincing.

title: Capturing the Friedmans
actors: Arnold Friedman, Elaine Friedman, Howard Friedman, Jesse Friedman, David Friedman
description: The Friedmans are a middle-class family living in Great Neck, a residential suburb of Long Island. On November 26, 1987, the day of Thanksgiving, the door to their home explodes, torn to pieces by a police ram. The agents break in and accuse the head of the family Arnold and youngest son Jesse of acts of pedophilia aggravated by violence.
notes: The strength of the film also lies in a suspense that American fiction cinema has now forgotten: an ability to organize the material not to captivate the viewer, but to displace him, to continually return to what he has seen and heard.

title: Valentín
actors: Jean Pierre Noher, Rodrigo Noya, Julieta Cardinali, Carmen Maura, Mex Urtizberea
description: Buenos Aires, 1960. Valentin has lived with his grandmother since the age of three, since he was abandoned by his mother ...
notes: In the dubbing, the little voice off explains each scene step by step, with sentences and metaphors so foolish as to suggest translation errors. More than a bad movie, a non-existent movie.

title: Scooby-Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed
actors: Freddie Prinze Jr., Sarah Michelle Gellar, Matthew Lillard, Linda Cardellini, Alicia Silverstone
description: Fred, Daphne, Velma, Shaggy and Scooby must transform into "monster catchers". The quiet town of Coolsville is in fact shocked by the constant appearances of strange creatures, unleashed by the mind (and by a hellish machine) of a mysterious masked man, who aims to take control of the city.
notes: _Scooby-Doo2 - Monsters unleashed_ is more dynamic, fun and calibrated than the first prototype born from the idea of ??converting a historic cartoon series into a film with actors. The exception remains Scooby, the real star and pivot of the investigative team's adventures, which is the result of constant advances in digital technology.

title: Lettomania
actors: Carmen Villani, Harry Reems, Alberto Squillante, Armando Celso
description: Giulio is a young forgiveness with the passion of the piano. Together with his friend Max divides his time between the subterfuge and beds of beautiful girls. When Max in London meets Dora, wife of a well -known writer, and invites her to Italy, Giulio ends up losing his head for her. But Dora proves to be not easy prey, so much so that the boy is sent in crisis.

title: Quella peste di Pierina
actors: Marina Marfoglia, Lucio Montanaro, Oreste Lionello, Carmen Russo
description: Pierina, an impertinent, brazen girl with a very foul language, does not scruple to make jokes to anyone who comes within range, both at home and at school. Worthy of her is her sister Rosy, with a sex life ... very free.
notes: Okay, there is also the taste of trash: here, however, there is not even that.

title: I sogni proibiti di don Galeazzo, curato di campagna
actors: Franco Aloisi, Eva Gabriel, Anna Zinnemann, Eleonora Morana

title: A zsarnok szíve, avagy Boccaccio Magyarországon
actors: Ninetto Davoli, László Gálffy, Teresa Ann Savoy, Jozsef Madaras
description: The staging of a show by a company of Italian wandering actors in a foreign court is opposed in all ways.
notes: Using optical effects and the artifices of the theatrical machine, the Hungarian director "dynamizes" the unity of space on which he works. Screenplay by Giovanna Gagliardo.

title: Kenka erejii
actors: Hideki Takahashi, Junko Asano, Yusuke Kawazu, Isao Tamagawa
description: 1935: high school student Kiroku sublimates the ardor of adolescence by joining a band with fascist tendencies. The influence of the "ideologist" Kita Ikki will also distract him from the feeling he feels for Michiko, dragging him on an increasingly extremist slope ...
notes: A keen look at the authoritarian soul of Japan.

title: Yo puta
actors: Daryl Hannah, Denise Richards, Joaquim De Almeida
description: Investigation film in the world of prostitution, which combines fiction and reality.
notes: The director Luna, on her second work, based on a script by the author of the book, has drawn a work that is a kind of hybridization between narrative forms: the frontal inquiries with prostitutes and prostitutes alternate with the voice off of the journalist, more a thin narrative thread with a girl in financial difficulty, enlisted by an expert ringing high-profile (Daryl Hannah, just her). But the intersection of styles and points of view has no intimate need: what the director is looking for is to ensnare the audience by showing how good she is (the director of photography is veteran Ricardo Aronovic, that of _The Missing_ and _The family_).

title: Après vous...
actors: Daniel Auteuil, José Garcia, Sandrine Kiberlain, Maryline Canto, Michèle Moretti
description: Returning home, Antoine saves Louis, a stranger who has attempted suicide: but the latter takes it out on him, accusing him of not having let him die in peace. Antoine, feeling responsible, hosts him, finds him a job and little by little a friendship is born between the two. But Louis can't get Blanche out of his head, the woman he tried to die for: and without saying anything to Antoine, he sets out on her trail ...
notes: The film is based on the transformation of the character of Auteuil: at first he is cold and almost detached, then he remains at the mercy of the emotions that almost overwhelm him in front of the imperfect beauty of Blanche (delightful Kiberlain).

title: Dawn of the Dead
actors: Sarah Polley, Ving Rhames, Jake Weber, Mekhi Phifer, Ty Burrell
description: Driven by an insatiable hunger for human flesh, zombies roam menacing, ready to pounce on the few survivors. Ana Clark, who has escaped from her home in Wisconsin, joins Kenneth, a stoic police officer, Michael, a shy electronics salesman, and André, a tough guy used to everything, with his pregnant wife. The five find refuge in an abandoned shopping center, which turns into a fortress ...
notes: The film "does its job" with honesty and good craft: it doesn't throw it into a joke, but it doesn't forget humor; he never relaxes the tension, he knows how to use clichés without trivializing them, he does not philosophize but neither consoles.

title: Dopo mezzanotte
actors: Giorgio Pasotti, Francesca Inaudi, Fabio Troiano, Francesca Picozza
description: Martino is the night guardian of the Mole Antonelliana, seat of the Cinema Museum. After midnight it becomes the kingdom of Martino, happy to be surrounded by the shadows of the silent films that he projects only for himself. When Amanda, engaged to "the Angel", car thief and tombeur de femmes, is forced to flee from the police, Martino hides her in the Mole ...
notes: High definition, own production, prizes on prizes abroad, actors at the height; singular music (Banda Ionica, Daniele Sepe), narrator of Silvio Orlando and in addition Buster Keaton tutelary and anti-sentimental deity. Result: a truly independent, fair, tender, beautiful film.

title: Kill Bill: vol. 2
actors: Uma Thurman, David Carradine, Daryl Hannah, Michael Madsen, Sonny Chiba, Vivica A. Fox, Ambrosia Kelley, Michael Parks, James Parks, Lucy Liu, Julie Dreyfus, Bo Svenson, Chiaki Kuriyama, Chia-hui Liu, Samuel L. Jackson, Sid Haig, Larry Bishop, Claire Smithies, Clark Middleton
