description: The "Bride" continues to carry out her revenge: after killing the first two ex-classmates on the list, Vernita Green and O-Ren Ishii, she sets out on the trail of Elle Driver and Budd, leaving Bill for the last. But the situation becomes complicated when the "Bride" learns that her daughter, whom she thought dead, has survived the massacre of the church ...
notes: "Volume 2" is also stylistically freed from the comic book hyperrealism that cloaked the first chapter. Camera sometimes by hand, grainy photography, an image quality that changes according to the narrative register. Clear references (Lucio Fulci of _Fear in the city of the living dead_, Sergio Leone a go go, the productions of the Shaw Brothers ...) but basically secondary, simple ideas for immersion in an imaginary that is now only his, of Tarantino. Who, in "volume 1", had reiterated the two-dimensionality of his characters, moved by a cartoon violence that is finally contradicted - and denied - in this second film, where there is much less blood and much less action, but much more ache. It's love. _Kill Bill - vol. 2_ is a great love story. As in _Jackie Brown_, love is what defines individuals by tearing them away from their (in) cinematic consistency (remember Robert Forster, who goes out of focus the moment his beloved Pam Grier walks away?). Only this time passion has to do with revenge: so people don't blur them, but transfigure them into a tragic mask.

title: Ogni volta che te ne vai
actors: Fabio De Luigi, Cecilia Dazzi, Rolando Ravello, Giorgio Colangeli, Franco Mescolini, Bruno Corazzari, Giampiero Bartolini, Raul Casadei
description: Since childhood, Orpheus' dream has been to become a smooth singer. Twenty years later, his dream becomes complicated: to become a ballroom singer ... together with Pamela, the woman he is in love with. And while she - free and unattainable - continues to come and go in Orpheus's life, music and dreams mark the rhythm of this bizarre love story.
notes: For lovers of smooth and its sequins, there are some opportunities for fun (the writer prefers _The suburban mazurka_), but overall it is a wasted opportunity. A little "heretic" is the piece composed by Andrea Guerra (of unexceptionable Romagna genìa), more Capossela than Casadei. Which, for its part, makes an embarrassed cameo.

title: Fate come noi
actors: Pupella Maggio, Agnese Nano, Francesco Venditti, Mauro Meconi
description: Two special days, mid-August and the eve of Christmas, in the lives of two boys who live in Torbellamonoca: Bove, 23, robust physique and pleasing, apparently skilled in life and women and Peking, 18, skinny, insecure but forced to fend for himself. The two find themselves dealing with people of different ages, cultures and social backgrounds.
notes: Shot between 1999 and 2000 and remained on standby due to lack of funds, the film retains its poetic freshness. The brilliant dialogues are recited with spontaneity above all by Francesco Venditti (to date, his best performance) and by Mauro Meconi (a "Peking" of brazen modesty).

title: Missing Pieces
actors: Elizabeth Montgomery, David Haskell, Leigh Hamilton, John Reilly
description: Private detective Sara Scott becomes widowed after the violent death of her husband, journalist Andy. Later, a client named Helen Richman instructs her to track down her husband James: but when the latter ends up losing his skin too, Sara begins to glimpse a link between the two crimes ...

title: L'infermiera... di mio padre
actors: Daniela Giordano, Enzo Monteduro, Francesco Mulè, Bianca Toccafondi
description: Both Don Gualtiero, prince of Lueca (formerly a frequenter of the town's brothel, now paralyzed in a wheelchair), and his inept son Filippo Maria are horned as much as possible by their respective spouses, notably with a fake general and a stable boy . Thanks to the loving care of a German nurse, the two will take their revenge: Don Gualtiero recovers, but continues to pretend to be ill and disguises himself as a ghost to terrify his wife's lover and make him dislodge; for his part, Filippo Maria will surprise everyone by showing off an unexpected courage ...
notes: Sexy homegrown of the lowest level.

title: The Big Brass Ring
actors: William Hurt, Nigel Hawtorne, Miranda Richardson, Rosemary Garris, Irène Jacob
description: In St. Louis, the stage of his election campaign for the presidency of the United States, Blake Pellarin has a chance encounter that brings to light (compromising) fragments of a past that he believed was now buried ...
notes: Hickenlooper co-wrote and directed - with mixed results - a story signed by none other than Orson Welles (and Oja Kodar).

title: A Woman Hunted
actors: Alexandra Paul, Linden Ashby, Michele Greene, Maxim Roy
description: After a difficult period, Lainie Wheeler tries to rebuild her life, regaining the esteem and trust of her daughters and facing a new job as a producer of a TV show. During the first day of work, however, her car breaks down: the baseball champion Harry Brewer - one of the guests in the studio - meets her and gives her a hand, but then the situation degenerates into tragedy and in front of Lainie it opens wide. another chasm ...
notes: Rather banal both in the narrative and in the staging. The protagonist Alexandra Paul revealed herself back in 1983 with John Carpenter's _Christine_.

title: British Sounds
description: In February 1969, Godard and the collective "Dziga Vertov" made their first work. Conceived as a survey of the groups of the British revolutionary left, the film - in accordance with the title - offers the most interesting ideas in the interconnections between images and soundtrack (voices, noises and music).

title: Belfast, Maine
description: Homonym of the capital of Ulster, Belfast is a port center of 6,500 inhabitants located in Maine, the northernmost state of the US Atlantic coast. Wiseman (who has been spending his summer holidays there for five decades) explores his daily life in all the smallest aspects, with an attentive and inquisitive eye.

title: Te doy mis ojos
actors: Laia Marull, Luis Tosar, Candela Peña, Rosa María Sardà, Kiti Manver
description: One night, Pilar decides to leave home with her little son Juan and take refuge with her sister Ana. Antonio, the abusive husband, manages to convince her to return with him. Soon the situation seems to have improved, Pilar has found a job and the man is trying to control his temper tantrums with the help of a therapist. But it doesn't take much for everything to fall apart ...
notes: The actress Icíar Bollaín (_Earth and freedom_ by Ken Loach), since 1992 has also dabbled behind the camera with a feminist flair and style that goes beyond the profession. The only reproach is in the forced fatalism that also emerges in this film. On the other hand, the rehearsals of the actors are excellent.

title: Honey
actors: Jessica Alba, Lil' Romeo, Mekhi Phifer, David Moscow, Joy Bryant
description: By day, Honey gives hip-hop lessons to the neighborhood kids. At night he goes wild on a club dance floor. Right here she is noticed by a television director who offers her to be a backup dancer in a commercial.
notes: Director Woodruff made the Britney Spears videos, and there he stayed. The general impression of the characters' falseness is amplified by the dubbing, and the adolescent target very clear from the beginning. Since it is not so clear that the protagonist is a great dancer, the other characters keep repeating: "Wow!", "Fantastic!", "So you do it!".

title: Luther
actors: Joseph Fiennes, Alfred Molina, Bruno Ganz, Peter Ustinov
description: Having become a monk, Martin Luther fights against the hypocrisy of the ecclesiastical hierarchies and publishes the 95 theses against the trade in indulgences and for the reform of the Church, denying the Pope's infallibility. After burning the papal bull in the square that invites him to retract , is excommunicated ...
notes: A predictable and somewhat theatrical big movie, with sharp dialogues, very high interpretations and historical "adjustments". But, unlike what is expected, boredom is avoided thanks to a direction that does not hesitate in the face of the clichés of adventure films and theatrical hits. Almost a genre film, aware of it: and it is certainly not a demerit.

title: Taking Lives
actors: Angelina Jolie, Ethan Hawke, Kiefer Sutherland, Gena Rowlands, Olivier Martinez, Tchéky Karyo
description: Illeana Scott, a brilliant FBI psychologist is recruited by the Canadian police to solve the case of a serial killer who wreaks havoc in North America by assuming the identity of his latest victim.
notes: The story, taken from Michael Pye's novel _Thief of lives_, is thin and all too predictable. There is hardly any material for a show, and the writers have added a useless prologue and a false "coda" to it. To save the shack, Angelina Jolie concedes topless; on the other hand, the Canadian setting, with French-speaking actors in secondary parts, confirms the impression of a real mess.

title: Monster
actors: Charlize Theron, Christina Ricci, Bruce Dern, Lee Tergesen
description: Aileen Wuornos, who supports herself by prostituting herself, commits her first murder in self-defense. The victim is a client who beaten her up and attempted to rape her. The violence suffered triggers a chain reaction in her that pushes her to commit more murders. The only hope of redemption is Selby, the girl Aileen fell in love with and ran away from home to be with her.
notes: Patty Jenkins, who met Wuornos, reconstructs her story with compassion and with a careful look at the flat banality of the locations and her encounters. But the film is so cautious as to be a little too schematic. Oscar to Charlize Theron.

title: Party Monster
actors: Macaulay Culkin, Seth Green, Chloë Sevigny, Marilyn Manson, Dylan McDermott
description: New York, 1980s. Rise and fall of Michael Alig, famous club kid and entertainer of New York nights who, at the height of his success, owned a record company, a magazine and Disco 2000, one of the most famous night clubs. His golden world falls apart when he reveals on TV that he killed his flatmate and trusted drug dealer Angel Melendez. Initially it is not believed, it is thought of a publicity move, but then the boy's body is found ...
notes: The shock of witnessing the ex-baby Culkin in drag is brief, also because there is a lack of courage to go all the way (there is not a single hint of sex). Moralism always peeps out, the music is conventionally assorted and the dubbing is atrocious.

title: The Missing
actors: Cate Blanchett, Tommy Lee Jones, Evan Rachel Wood, Jenna Boyd, Aaron Eckhart, Val Kilmer
description: Wild West. Maggie has to work hard to support her two daughters: teenager Lilly and little Dot. Jones, the woman's father, has returned home after spending twenty years with the Apaches, but Maggie, who suffered from being abandoned by him as a child, rejects him. When a band of renegade whites and indians led by an evil wizard kidnaps Lilly, Maggie is forced to ask for her help.
notes: Howard designs an ostentatiously classic direction, knows how to deal with the prairies and makes use of two perfect actors like Blachett and Lee Jones. But he is too shy, he does not choose between realism, epos and psychologies.

title: Kamchatka
actors: Ricardo Darín, Cecilia Roth, Hector Alterio, Fernanda Mistral, Mónica Scapparone
description: 1976, Argentina. Little Harry's life is brutally turned upside down when the government is overthrown by a coup. With his parents and younger brother, Harry moves to a house in the suburbs in hopes that the military regime will collapse soon. The family is forced to take on a new identity and Harry chooses that of his idol, the magician Houdini who tries to emulate especially in the art of escape.
notes: Since the protagonist is a child, it is avoided to really tell the tragedy and the shame of the disappeared. On the other hand, all the clichés of the story-through-the-eyes-of-the-child genre abound.

title: Fame chimica
actors: Marco Foschi, Matteo Gianoli, Valeria Solarino, Teco Celio, Mauro Serio
description: Milan: Claudio and Manuel have never stopped meeting in the square where they met as children and where they grew up together. They now have two different lives: one is a pusher, the other has a regular, very tiring and poorly paid job. But they keep seeing each other until Maja arrives, with whom they both fall in love ...
notes: The film is intensely immersed in a real city also and above all in the faces and in the language, adhering to the harsh slang of the Milanese suburbs. A courageous independent production where the soundtrack stands out, which together with its curator - Zulù dei 99 Posse - functions within the story as a kind of Greek choir.

title: El amor perjudica seriamente la salud
actors: Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, Ana Belén, Penélope Cruz, Juanjo Puigcorbe, Gabino Diego
description: During the 1960s, Diana and Santi met thanks to a common passion for John Lennon. Their relationship lasts for the following three decades, in the most varied places and moments, often in correspondence with the most important events of the different eras.
notes: An ideuzza so-so holds up a moderately funny film.

title: The Mayor of Casterbridge
actors: Ciarán Hinds, James Purefoy, Jodhi May, Juliet Aubrey, Polly Walker

title: Pusher
actors: Kim Bodnia, Zlatko Buric, Laura Drasbaek, Slavko Labovic, Mads Mikkelsen
description: Frank is a pusher on the crest of a wave, until a deal goes wrong and he gets hunted down by the police. He tries to get rid of the drug by throwing it into a lake, but must now be able to scrape together the money in the worst slums of Copenhagen to pay his supplier, who is certainly not willing to give discounts.

title: The Nine Lives of Fritz the Cat
description: Exasperated by the conjugal routine, Fritz lights up a joint and begins to fantasize about the other eight existences that belong to him: here he is then astronaut, Hitler's psychoanalyst, adept of an Indian guru in the sewers of New York ...
notes: Three years after Bakshi's film, Robert Crumb's underground strip hero returns.

title: Love and a Bullet
actors: Anthony 'Treach' Criss, Kent Masters King, Charles Guardino
description: While preparing to carry out his latest task - the elimination of the beautiful and naive Cynda, the boss's girlfriend -, Malik, a professional killer, reflects on his "work" choices and on the destiny from which he can no longer escape. Torn between a "sense of duty" and a newfound humanity, Malik discovers that the only way out is a dangerous final confrontation with men as tough and perhaps harder than him.
notes: Originality is certainly not on the menu, but taken for what it is (a television product that landed on some American screens) the Kants & Ramsey film delivers what it promises: gunfights, gang language and a gentleman murdering protagonist.

title: Bad Taste
actors: Peter Jackson, Mike Minett, Pete O'Herne, Terry Potter, Craig Smith
description: The Astro Investigation and Defense Service (AIDS) sends Derek, Frank, Ozzy and Barry to investigate the disappearance of an entire New Zealand town: Kaihoro. The location is now populated by aliens in human form who, when Barry kills the first of them, begin a furious attack to eliminate the four unfortunates. Meanwhile, the collector Giles has also arrived in Kaihoro, where he repeatedly risks being devoured ...
notes: Among the most famous films of the demented "splatter" genre, with massacres, cannibalism, exposed brains and ridiculous tortures. Peter Jackson, still in his infancy, does almost everything by himself: he interprets, writes, directs and produces with a non-existent budget.

title: Jonny Vang
actors: Aksel Hennie, Laila Goody, Fridtjov Såheim, Marit Andreassen

title: Blinkende lygter
actors: Søren Pilmark, Ulrich Thomsen, Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Lie Kaas

title: I Kina spiser de hunde
actors: Dejan Cukic, Kim Bodnia, Nikolaj Lie Kaas, Tomas Villum Jensen

title: Mávahlátur
actors: Margret Vilhjálmsdóttir, Ugla Egilsdóttir, Heino Ferch, Hilmir Snær Gudnason
description: 1950: Icelandic province. Freyja, who had left as a chubby teenager, returns from America, a charming widow, seven suitcases of clothes, and an aspiration: to find a new husband. The social order, class divisions and family balance will become decidedly more complicated.

title: Angels in America
actors: Al Pacino, Meryl Streep, Emma Thompson, Justin Kirk, Mary-Louise Parker, Jeffrey Wright, Ben Shenkman, Patrick Wilson, James Cromwell, Brian Markinson, Robin Weigert, Melissa Wilder, David Zayas, Fatima Da Silva
description: 1985. The lives of different characters are intertwined in Reagan America devastated by AIDS.
notes: Six-part television miniseries based on the play by Tony Kushner, a fantastic allegory of the crisis of values ??and certainties that America went through in the second half of the 1980s. Ambitious, brilliant, out of the ordinary work. Phenomenal interpretations and stash of prizes at home.

title: Den Osynlige
actors: Gustaf Skarsgård, Tuva Novotny, Li Brådhe, Thomas Hedengran

title: Aberdeen
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Jean Anderson, Lena Headey, Charlotte Rampling

title: Barbara
actors: Anneke von der Lippe, Lars Simosen, Trond Høvik, Jesper Christensen

title: The Chelsea Girls
actors: Nico, Ondine, Brigid Polk, Ingrid Superstar, Ari, Eric Emerson
description: On the screen, divided into two parts, there are six pairs of segments (of which only one is spoken), all consisting of a single sequence shot of about half an hour. Fully deployed in the legendary Chelsea Hotel in New York, the "court of miracles" of the inventor of pop materializes the triumph of Chance in cinematic form.

title: Roma rivuole Cesare
actors: Hiram Keller, Daniel Olbrychski, José de Vega, Lino Troisi
description: 44 BC: the revolt of the Numidians and some Roman rebels against Caesar seems to have been crowned with success. But when Octavian, one of the rebels, ascends the throne, the hopes of those who - like Claudius - had believed in the end of all authority are bitterly disappointed.
notes: Metaphorical reinterpretation of an episode in the history of the Empire.

title: Riget II
actors: Ernst-Hugo Järegård, Peter Mygind, Kirsten Rolffes, Søren Pilmark
description: At the "Il Regno" hospital in Copenhagen, the chain of strange and disturbing events seems to never end: the apparitions of the ghost ambulance, the evil presences identified in the basements by Mrs. Drusse, and much more ...
notes: Second episode of the second tranche of the bizarre, demonic and mocking Vontrierian saga.

title: Miss Mend
actors: Vladimir Fogel, Natal'ja Glan, Igor Ilyinskij, Boris Barnet
description: Littletown, United States: the very rich Gordon Storn is kidnapped by the bandit Cice, who stages a murder carried out by the Bolsheviks. Meanwhile, typist Vivian Men raises an orphan who ...
notes: A three-episode film that is a brilliant attempt to "find the cinematic equivalent of the Jack London committed novel".

title: El Cisco
actors: William Berger, George Wang, Antonella Murgia, Lamberto Antinori, Tom Felleghy
description: After repelling the assault of a group of bandits on the city bank, the sheriff of Calabasas is absent to escort one of the outlaws to jail. Left alone, his deputy favors a new robbery by some Mexicans with whom he colludes, but in the coffers there is no bill of a dollar: before them, in fact, the mysterious adventurer El Cisco passed through there, accused years ago of a blow not committed. Captured and seriously wounded by the Mexicans, El Cisco is entrusted to the care of a doctor friend of his, who makes him pass for dead helping him to escape ...
notes: Cheesy "spaghetti", obvious and devoid of any inventiveness.

title: Radio West
actors: Pier Giorgio Bellocchio, Pietro Taricone, Massimo Bosi, Kasia Smutniak, Marco Cocci
description: Kosovo. Three Italian soldiers who left volunteers have to face every day the suffering and pain of a fratricidal war of which they are unable to grasp the meaning. In an attempt to help a young woman on the run, the three find themselves struggling to survive due to an unexpected event during a routine mission.
notes: Faced with the overwhelming power of television images, a film that feeds on urgencies should have the guts to go to other and unknown territories. Goodwill is not enough, an honest film but substantially and involuntarily useless. Which adds nothing to what we see, watch, read, hear on the media every day.

title: Il vestito da sposa
actors: Maya Sansa, Andrea Di Stefano, Pier Paolo Lovino, Salvatore Lazzaro, Piera Degli Esposti, Mauro Marchese, Chiara Conti, Pietro Faiella, Lorenzo Branchetti
description: In a wedding dress atelier, Stella is trying on a sumptuous white dress. A few hours later, happiness gives way to terror. Suddenly Stella abandons the idea of ??getting married, pushes her boyfriend away, leaves university, cuts her hair and gets a job in a nearby town. This is where it all starts all over again.
notes: Hard and cruel, _The wedding dress_ is one of those works that slowly envelop thoughts, which gradually nail to the chair, which move and wriggle like those wounded animals convinced that they have fallen into a trap disproportionate to their invisible fate.

title: Cypher
actors: Jeremy Northam, Lucy Liu, Nigel Bennett, Timothy Webber, David Hewlett
description: Morgan Sullivan, apparently a gray man, is actually an industrial spy for the multinational Digicorp. During one of his missions, he meets the mysterious Rita who reveals inconvenient truths about the real activities of the company Morgan works for: he and his colleagues are regularly brainwashed for exploitation. Morgan decides to double-cross and goes to work in a rival company ...
notes: The tangles wind around the film itself, which is affected. And then the inability to sustain a rhythm emerges, to follow the scattered traces, the heaviness of an aesthetic-visual apparatus which, not because it is opaque-sepia-shady, must necessarily be interesting-fascinating-distressing. Ultimately, _Cypher_ is just science fiction academism, the resolution of which is then a rehashing of the ending of the seminal TV series _The prisoner_.

title: Country of My Skull
actors: Samuel L. Jackson, Juliette Binoche, Brendan Gleeson, Menzi Ngubane, Nick Boraine
description: A Washington Post reporter and a South African poetess try to uncover the truth about the violence committed during Apartheid.
notes: Film that never really thrills or moves. Wasted talented actors (is there anything worse ?!) and direction among the worst in Boorman's career.

title: Van Helsing
actors: Hugh Jackman, Kate Beckinsale, Richard Roxburgh, David Wenham, Silvia Colloca, Will Kemp, Elena Anaya
description: The famous monster hunter Van Helsing travels to Transylvania on behalf of a secret society in order to kill Count Dracula. Anna will help him, who wants to destroy the vampire to erase the curse that hangs over his family. But Van Helsing also has to contend with Frankenstein and the Wolf Man ...
notes: Everything - myths, anxieties, legends - is mixed in the special effects blender: the emotion is eliminated, the suggestions of low cost are regretted. The only found (so to speak): the little friar with his amazing inventions of death, a sort of Bondian Q ante litteram. It seems to be in the parody of _Frankenstein junior _...

title: Good Boy!
actors: Molly Shannon, Liam Aiken, Kevin Nealon, Brittany Moldowan
description: Twelve-year-old Owen Baker worked as a "dog sitter" to get his parents' permission to keep a dog: in this way he can adopt a scruffy and melancholy foundling he calls Hubble. But things take an unexpected turn when Owen wakes up one morning to find he understands everything the dog is saying ...
notes: Produced by Jim Henson, the de facto film is proposed as a revised and corrected version of Disney's "superfamily" of the 1950s and 1960s, in which pets played a primary role. Like _The cat from outer space_, Hubble is smart and likeable, as well as chatty, thanks to the visual effects that are really not bad.

title: Under the Tuscan Sun
actors: Diane Lane, Sandra Oh, Lindsay Duncan, Raoul Bova, Vincent Riotta
description: Frances, an American writer in crisis (she recently divorced and seems to have lost her inspiration), goes to Italy for a vacation. To change his life he decides to buy a villa in the Tuscan countryside and renovate it. Unexpectedly Frances also finds love.
notes: The Arcadian colors of the Campania coast and the Tuscan countryside are a very powerful magnet to which the director-screenwriter Audrey Wells offers no resistance not so much in the staging as in substance in the form. The picturesque spreads, bores and irritates, folklore is unworthy of a postcard, the characters seem like pencil portraits sold in the square to less than casual tourists. To signal the presence of Mario Monicelli in a small role.

title: Ni pour ni contre (bien au contraire)
actors: Marie Gillain, Vincent Elbaz, Simon Abkarian, Dimitri Storoge
description: Caty, 27, is a journalist: she works as a camera operator for the news. She meets Jean who offers her to resume an armed attack in exchange for a large sum of money. So she gets in touch with Lecarpe, Loulou and Mouss, Jean's gang and realizes that she is more and more fascinated by the man who convinces her to participate in a "big coup".
notes: The film starts as _Seven men of gold_ and ends as _Nido di wasps_ (with all due distinctions of both cases). He doesn't dwell too much on the romance of the underworld, and in the last twenty minutes he rears towards unexpected pessimism and cruelty.

title: Nowhere to Go But Up
actors: Audrey Tautou, Justin Theroux, Jennifer Tilly, Jenna Lamia
description: The aspiring Canadian actress Val Chipzik to be successful decides to move from Quebec to New York. Here, between sentimental adventures and professional misadventures, he will have to overcome a thousand difficulties before fulfilling his dreams.
notes: The style does not know which way to go: first he zooms down, then hints at some shy jump cuts, and there is also a moment of Tautou's shower at slow motion (the actress has a hard time shaking off the character of Amélie Poulain). But the story is a predictable fairy tale (with characters that are never exciting, and false and gooey side cards), and the few hazards of directing make it only limp and confused.

title: The Borrower
actors: Rae Dawn Chong, Don Gordon, Tom Towles, Antonio Fargas
description: An alien, condemned by his fellows to live in the worst place in the galaxy together with the worst race of all creation, is thrown to Earth. After a while the extraterrestrial loses his head and finds himself in the unpleasant condition of having to borrow it from others. Detectives Diane Pierce and Charles Krieger set out on the trail of the head-cutter maniac.
notes: Rae Dawn Chong is the one who was with Schwarzenegger in _Commando_. She's cute and can do tough roles too. John McNaughton is not cute, but his debut film ("Henry, Rain of Blood") was hard. This is much less so.

title: The Ladykillers
actors: Tom Hanks, Irma P. Hall, Marlon Wayans, J.K. Simmons, Ryan Hurst, Tzi Ma, George Wallace
description: Professor G.H. Dorr brings together a handful of thugs to rob a casino. To get to the vault, the thugs rent out old Mrs. Munson's cellar posing as musicians in need of a place to rehearse. However, the woman discovers their plan: the only solution is to kill her, but the company turns out to be more difficult than expected ...
notes: The screenplay, apart from the time and place updates, almost step by step follows William Rose's original for Alexander Mackendrick's Lady Murders (1955). But the feeling is that the whole operation plays a little on the downside: humor almost entirely on the surface, malice on the sly, more than anything else a meeting-clash of characters bordering on caricature. As much as he bursts into Edgar Allan Poe, Tom Hanks 'Professor Dorr is far less creepy than Alec Guinness' Professor Marcus, and his four cronies (who also correspond to real types) are far less lashing out at their respective social categories than they are. were their British models from half a century earlier. The only character that truly emerges in the round is that of the hostess, Mrs Munson, less faded than Mrs Wilberforce but just as energetic and determined to make the five fake musicians go straight. Ultimately, a film to be counted among the minors of the Minneapolis brothers, which however sees the usual team of luxury collaborators lined up: above all, Roger Deakins to photography and Carter Burwell to music.

title: The Motorcycle Diaries
country: United States, Germany, Great Britain, Argentina
actors: Gael García Bernal, Rodrigo De la Serna, Susana Lanteri, Mia Maestro
description: Early 1950s: the young Ernesto Guevara de la Serna, graduating in medicine, and his biochemist friend Alberto Granado, departing from Buenos Aires, crossed South America aboard a Norton 500 called "la Poderosa". Leaving the bike, now battered, they continue by any means and arrive in Caracas ...
notes: Compared to the famous diary there is less introspection, and the political awareness of Che (an Argentine bourgeois, destined to graduate in medicine, who in the face of widespread poverty on the continent decides to give himself up to revolution) is more enunciated than shown. There is obviously more "plot", more dialogue, and the character of Granado, a womanizer and braggart, comes out.

title: La mala educación
actors: Gael García Bernal, Fele Martinez, Daniel Gimenez Cacho, Javier Cámara, Francisco Boira, Lluís Homar, Francisco Maestre, Juan Fernandez, Nacho Pérez, Raúl García Forneiro, Javier Cámara, Alberto Ferreiro, Petra Martínez
description: Madrid 1980. The 27-year-old Enrique Goded, an established director, seeks inspiration from the news for his fourth film. Suddenly an attractive young man arrives at his house who claims to be his schoolmate Ignacio Rodríguez. Enrique does not recognize him immediately, but realizes that 17 years have passed. Although he doesn't know it yet, the story for his next film is right in front of his eyes. In fact, Ignacio gives him a story entitled "The visit" which is inspired by their childhood in the boarding school: the problems with the priests and in particular with the father director, repression, football, hypocrisy, masses in Latin and cinema. .
notes: Ignacio and Enrique's novel of initiation and love, the religious college and pedophilia (reducing the film to a paper on sexual abuse is like watching some sequences and forgetting everything else), "good education" and discovery of the cinema, murder and damage, the Spain of the day before and yesterday, the black soul of Angel / Juan and the dangerous passion of the man who wanted to take off his cassock without being able to undress his desires, excellent performances of the actors who lie and "act" in a film that incorporates one in progress and many others in Almodóvar's mind, the bad and the worse, the songs of an inner playlist and an innocence that has never been lost because for the characters it never existed, the archetype of the homme fatal that undermines the femme and disguises itself as the turbid, anxious and crazy creatures, chained between the curses of noir and the perfect unhappiness of melodrama.

title: De-Lovely
actors: Kevin Kline, Ashley Judd, Jonathan Pryce, Angie Hill
description: Cole Porter relives his past as a spectator, as the people and episodes that marked his existence - especially the complicated relationship with his wife and muse, Linda Lee Thomas - come to life on stage.
notes: After "Notte e dì" (1946) by Michael Curtiz, a sweetened Hollywood biopic in which it was Cary Grant who played Porter (1891-1964), Winkler brings the figure back to the screen. The director lingers on the "strange" partnership with Linda, which lasted 35 years (until her death in 1954) despite the musician's notorious homosexuality: the film reconstructs their story in flashbacks, risking a musical. With Porter's songs (as seductive in music as in lyrics, even his own, and ingenious), a musical film should be served on a silver platter: unfortunately, however, the visual layout of _De-Lovely_ does not correspond to that sonorous, it does not have the grace and lightness. The direction is a bit woody and "realistic", and the narrative is too pompous. Kline and Judd are perfect incarnations of the time, but the film - however luxurious - has no air, it doesn't "breathe", it doesn't dance.

title: Shrek 2
directors: Andrew Adamson, Kelly Asbury, Conrad Vernon
description: Returning from their wedding Shrek and Fiona are invited to court by her parents, King Harold and Queen Lilian. Who do not know that the two are green orcs. To redress the crime, the sovereigns, who had made other plans for their daughter's wedding, call upon the Fairy Godmother, Puss in Boots and the beautiful Prince Charming.
notes: Definitely apt is the recruitment in the fabulous star cast of Puss in Boots, an extraordinarily perfidious but also sweetly vulnerable and faithful feline. The impression is that _Shrek 2_ pushes the accelerator even more towards an adult audience.

title: Troy
actors: Brad Pitt, Eric Bana, Orlando Bloom, Diane Kruger, Sean Bean, Brian Cox, Peter O'Toole, John Shrapnel, Brendan Gleeson, Siri Svegier, Adoni Maropis, Julian Glover, Ken Bones
description: 1193 a. C .: Paris, prince of Troy, kidnaps Helen, queen of Sparta and wife of Menelaus. This episode unleashes a war destined to last ten years, which will have as main antagonists Achilles for the Greeks and Hector for the Trojans.
notes: Expecting the film to be something other than what it is, appears ridiculous and superfluous, revives the prejudice about the inferiority and "vulgarity" of cinema, makes us forget the rule according to which a film inspired by a book - of very high value or of banal consumption - must have the courage and the impudence to betray it. All the more reason, in the case of a Hollywood blockbuster, imagined, written, shot and launched to be a summer blockbuster, this laborious "betrayal" has to stick more to the conventions of one "genre" than to another. As usual, the hand of the Teutonic Petersen is not the lightest, but in the end the result holds: faithful to the narrative economy, the star mix, the simple structural lines, the dialogues, the rhythms of the "peplum" (which is has always been considered by most critics to be a minor trend, a low practice in the mosaic of artisanal cinema production). The fun is not lacking, and even those who will not be able to get into the spirit of the film will not fail to appreciate the beautiful scene in which Priam asks Achille for the corpse of his son Ettore.

title: Kad je zivot bio cudo
actors: Slavko Stimac, Vesna Trivalic, Davor Janjic, Mirjana Karanovic
description: Luka builds a beautiful railway for tourists to arrive in his city and pretends not to see the war going on. When his wife runs away with a musician and his son is called to arms, Luka's life is turned upside down. But then he meets Sabaha ...
notes: As always, Kusturica has in mind his dreamed Yugoslavia, in which everyone lived happily and, to celebrate, sparacchia here and there (in the air). Then, it is not clear why, they lowered their aim and started shooting at each other. Kusturica does not explain, he hides behind the story and the anecdotes. There are still some gimmicks, but he'd better stop and think. On history and its stories.

title: Les trois mousquetaires
actors: Gérard Barray, Georges Descrières, Bernard Woringer, Jacques Toja, Mylène Demongeot
description: Arrived in Paris from Gascony, the young and sanguine D'Artagnan at first strikes a fight, then makes friends with Athos, Porthos and Aramis, the king's musketeers. The four will join forces to thwart the plans of Cardinal Richelieu and the perfidious Milady ...
notes: The packaging is luxurious, but the weakness of the direction ends up watering everything down.

title: El Rojo
actors: Richard Harrison, Nieves Navarro, Peter Carter, Mirko Ellis, Annie Gorassini
description: The Sorenson family is massacred, #apparently #by the Indians. Over the years a small town has risen on the site of the killing, run by a group of businessmen. Years later, El Rojo, the last survivor of the Sorensons, will shed light on the massacre and exact revenge.

title: Overland Telegraph
actors: George Nader, Hugh Beaumont, Tim Holt, Richard Martin, Gail Davis
description: The construction of a new telegraph line would have deleterious effects for the trader Paul Manning, who in fact makes an agreement with the criminals led by Brad Roberts to sabotage it. Tim Holt and his buddy Chito Rafferty investigate, but ...
notes: Western lace-up routine for the prolific Selander, specialized in the genre.

title: La nuora giovane
actors: Simonetta Stefanelli, Philippe Leroy, Maurizio Bonuglia, Didi Perego, Marcel Dalio, Renzo Montagnani
description: Franco, a wealthy Don Juan entrepreneur, has problems with his wife and for this reason he approaches his young and uninhibited daughter-in-law. The son, in turn, seduces the sister-in-law ...

title: Juego de amor prohibido
actors: Javier Escrivá, John Moulder-Brown, Inma de Santis, Simon Andreu
description: In an isolated villa, a perverse professor submits some unfortunate to unnameable sadistic practices together with a deranged young man. He learned that two of his students ran away from the house, invites them to spend the night from him and kidnaps them ...
notes: The film would also have had other ambitions, but the censorship made it unjustable.

title: Merry-go-round
actors: Maria Schneider, Joe Dallesandro, Françoise Prevost, Maurice Garrel, Danièle Gégauff, Sylvie Matton, Michel Berto, Dominique Erlanger, Frédéric Mitterrand, Jean-François Stévenin
description: Ben has an appointment at the airport with his lover, but instead finds the sister he does not know. The other woman is missing, and the two forced traveling companions begin a pilgrimage through the slums of Paris on her trail.
notes: Rivette's method, based largely on improvisation, is applied profitably to this completely sui generis "crime story". Merry-Go-Round's first interest is the processing. The protagonist Maria Schneider was then such a star that she chose the co-star, in this case Joe Dalessandro, Andy Wharol's favorite actor, who didn't know a word of French and therefore communicated with Rivette through a third party. During the filming, the director let out an unequivocal "I can't wait for them to end" ... Despite everything, however, the result is very interesting. A mysterious, intricate fake-popular that on the one hand respects the rules of the genre (with broad references to Hitchcock, one of Rivette's first loves and associates), on the other he does not fail to denounce his "author" nature, on the "going around" that frustrates any rational initiative. The screenplay suffers the hindrances of a cumbersome narrative structure (even Lynchian ante litteram, if you like), and there is some dated ambition in the dialogues; but the filmmaker's camera is amazing when he wanders around the outskirts of the Ville Lumière, recovering the dark ravines as in a 1950s noir. Never released in theaters, even if Enrico Grezzi previewed it at Fuori Ora in the original language , with subtitles. The title is the same as a 1922 film by Eric Von Stroheim, Music by Barre Phillips and John Surman.

title: Le conseguenze dell'amore
actors: Toni Servillo, Olivia Magnani, Adriano Giannini, Angela Goodwin, Raffaele Pisu
description: Titta di Girolamo, a distinguished fifty, has lived for eight years in a hotel room in a small town in Italian-speaking Switzerland. He apparently spent all this time without working, spending his days at the hotel bar between cigarettes. The only element that disturbs this routine is the arrival, once a month, of a suitcase that is deposited in front of his door. What secrets does it hide?
notes: "The habit of life is not a good reason to live", said Jean-Claude Izzo. Beyond the noir implications, the need for an explanatory twist that is perhaps not all that important, the second film - after _L'uomo in più_ - by the Neapolitan director works on this theme: on habit, on emptiness, on the lack of meaning of the gestures and thoughts of an individual adrift. Dropped into an exquisitely metaphysical dimension, then, Sorrentino's becomes a great film. It does not matter, that is, that "behind" there is a story of the Mafia, and that the end of Titta symbolically refers to his by now well-established "embalming" (petrified in front of everything, of life and death). After all, the meaning of the film is already in its being so suspended, "emptied", liquid. Not surprisingly, Sorrentino and the director of photography Luca Bigazzi keep us outside, shielding the vision through glass and filters and letting us witness the tragedy of the protagonist (extraordinary proof of actor by Servillo) as if he were immersed in a sort of aquarium .

title: Fahrenheit 9/11
description: Michael Moore focuses on the post-9/11 and long-standing ties between the Bush family and that of Osama Bin Laden.
notes: A mountain of meat in the fire, in practice (largely reproduced in Moore's book published in 2003, _But how have you reduced this country? _), Which however does not correspond to a cinematic rendering as effective as that of the two previous feature films of the more quarrelsome (and, currently, the richest) documentary filmmaker of America, _Bowling a Columbine_ and _Roger & Me_. Opened by the alleged electoral fraud of 2000 in Florida (when the favorable response to Al Gore was suddenly overturned, accomplices, apparently, the brother of the future president, governor of the state, and other members of his staff, involved in the counting of votes) , _Fahrenheit_ soon reveals a certain carelessness with effect that the previous films did not have: a voice off too much (in the school scene, which would have been very effective if silent), an excess of populist didacticism, a vein of blackmailing moralism, an unpleasant exploitation of pain.

title: Innocence: Kôkaku kidôtai
description: Batou, a cyborg special agent, investigates a series of murders committed by prostitute androids, who may be developing a conscience. The plot is very dense, but Batou seems to get help in unraveling the plot from the computer entity that was once the major Kusanagi.
notes: Mamoru Oshii does not trust stereotypes and designs a universe in which the image is always more and less than what we understand. Visually impressive the mixture of 2D and 3D computer graphic animation, but terrible the dialogues (this second film in the series is not scripted by Kazunori Itô, but by Oshii himself) constructed through exchanges of quotations, with a result of rare pretentiousness.

title: Bad Santa
actors: Billy Bob Thornton, Tony Cox, Brett Kelly, Lauren Graham, John Ritter
description: Crook Willie earns his living disguising himself as Santa Claus in department stores, where he listens to the wishes of a slew of snotty, petulant kids. He is unfair and rude beyond all measure (he drinks, throws up, swears, robs old ladies), but he's not bad. Her partner is Marcus, a black dwarf dressed up as a goblin, in the role of "Santa's little helper". In reality, the two use the disguise to rob the places where they work ...
notes: From an idea of ??the Coen brothers, Zwigoff directs a rude and intelligent film, which scoffs at the annual rhetoric of good feelings with a background of sharp humanity.

title: Clean
actors: Jeanne Balibar, Ian Brown, Maggie Cheung, Béatrice Dalle
description: Emily, wife of Lee Hauser, once a rock star who later fell (died of an overdose), after spending six months in prison for drug possession, decides to rebuild her life. He goes to Paris, where he lived in the past and realizes how much the city has changed ...
notes: Clean is a film about forgiveness and the possibility that people change, it is a monument to an actress like Maggie Cheung for whom the term "artist" is more than ever adequate, it is an extraordinary journey through the streets of a city, Paris , and its worlds (nocturnal, artificial, sweaty, toxic, exotic); it is the magnificent (and saving) gaze that rises in the finale on the San Francisco Bay.

title: Comme une image
actors: Jean-Pierre Bacri, Marilou Berry, Agnès Jaoui, Serge Riaboukine
description: Lolita, Sylvia, Pierre, Etienne are people who know very well what they would do if they were in the place of others. It cannot be said that they know how to conduct their lives as well ...
notes: Unlike other authors of "bourgeois" cinema, Jaoui and Bacri carry out disturbing "patrols" on men and women who have everything but precise identities. A world of masks and make-up, almost "horror" if you think of the character of the father played by Bacri himself. The only problem with _Così fan tutti_ (as well as _Il gusto degli others_) is paradoxically its "perfection". Everything runs smoothly, with a certain literary mechanics. Have it, though.

title: Exils
actors: Romain Duris, Lubna Azabal, Leila Makhlouf, Zouhir Gacem
description: Zano and Naïma from Paris don't know what to do with it. He was born there of pieds noir parents, while she is from Algiers, but she has been in France for not even remembering how long. He doesn't even know his mother tongue. Leaving is a bit of a rebirth, and the two choose to go towards the roots of both.
notes: The musical montage underlines the coordinates of the journey, the physical displacement and the existential path: from the metropolitan techno of Paris to the Sufi trance of Algiers, passing through the flamenco of Andalusia. Two, three sequences to remember: the first, from the "window on the courtyard" of a world to which one does not belong (anymore), the sensual one of the peach groves and the final one of the Sufi dance, eternal and unconscious, emotional summa of a cinema to which we must abandon ourselves with the senses.

title: Die fetten Jahre sind vorbei
actors: Daniel Brühl, Julia Jentsch, Stipe Erceg, Burghart Klaußner
description: Jan, Peter and Jule are united by the passion to change the world. Jan and Peter are transformed into "educators", mysterious executors who in a non-violent way warn the rich that their well-being is numbered. Meanwhile, Jule realizes that she has fallen in love with both of her friends. The situation is further complicated when an operation goes wrong and the three young idealists have to deal with their values.

title: The Life and Death of Peter Sellers
actors: Geoffrey Rush, Charlize Theron, Stanley Tucci, Emily Watson, Emilia Fox
description: The life of Peter Sellers, one of the most eclectic and brilliant comic actors in the history of cinema: the success that made him immortal and the contradictions of private life.
notes: Rush's astonishing performance manages to reproduce Sellers' amazing transformism, not his unrepeatable madness. As for the excavation in his devouring relationship with his mother Peg and in the stormy and cruel ones with women, friends, colleagues, in his overwhelming and irrepressible neuroses, in his underlying sadness, unfortunately the film does not go into depth and never reaches tragedy which probably represented the actor's other face.

title: Oldboy
actors: Choi Min-sik, Yu Ji-tae, Kang Hye-jeong, Ji Dae-han, Oh Dal-su
description: A 20-year-old is kidnapped and locked up in a room by criminals hired by an unknown client. When he finally comes out, after fifteen years, the man sets out on the trail of the principal.
notes: The film is extremely stylized, the characters are prisoners in and of themselves, succubus to the past and predestined for a terrible future, without the consequences of love capable of freeing them (indeed, even love responds to the law of retaliation). Ambiguity is a key to understanding, a poetic choice. The feeling that Oh Dae-soo is "better" than before is too clear to think it is a coincidence after his imprisonment. Inspired by the manga of Tsuchiya Garon and Minegishi Nobuaki but shining with its own light.

title: La niña santa
actors: María Alche, Carlos Belloso, Mercedes Morán, Alejandro Urdapilleta
description: In Salta, northern Argentina, some teenage mystics question the role of the divine in their lives. An otolaryngology congress brings Dr. Jano, a famous middle-aged doctor to town. Amalia, one of the girls, is convinced that her mission is to save him from his sins: little by little, the man's certainties are shattered in front of the young woman's determination ...
notes: The second work by the director of _La ciénaga_ tells a daily life made up of sacred hymns, of eyes that peep through openings, of affections, tensions, insecurities. Of a palpable and concrete human warmth, which is imprinted in the memory.

title: Sud pralad
actors: Sakda Kaewbuadee, Banlop Lomnoi
description: Keng, a young soldier and Tong, a country boy, are in love and happy. Then the life of the village where Tong's family lives is turned upside down by a disappearance and the appearance of a beast that kills cows. According to local legends, a human being can transform into another creature ... Thus begins the story of a soldier who enters the jungle, a place where the legend often becomes reality.

title: Moro No Brasil
actors: Walter Alfaiate, Velha Guarda da Mangueira, Seu Jorge, Mika Kaurismäki
description: A musical journey through Brazil in the company of director Mika Kaurismäki. 4000 kilometers to discover the popular and local culture of the country. The meeting with musicians, singers, dancers and ordinary people who tell each other through the rhythms and words of the songs.
notes: Philologically correct the study of musical genres: not only samba and bossa nova but also the choro, a kind of jazz very influenced by European rhythms, and tropicalia, which looks at American rock'n'roll but always with a "sambistic" aftertaste . Interviews and participation of many musicians, some of them friends and collaborators of Mika, as well as Brazilian celebrities to discover (and export ...) like the old men of the Social Club.

title: Phone
actors: Ha Ji-won, Kim Yu-mi, Choi Woo-jae, Choi Ji-yeon, Eun Seo-woo
description: Tired of receiving phone threats, single reporter Ji-won changes her mobile number. To be alone for a while, she goes to the house of a couple of friends who live in the suburbs, but here too she finds herself haunted by enigmatic calls in which a woman's moans are heard. Ji-won begins to investigate and discovers that two people who knew her new number have committed suicide under mysterious circumstances, while a third has gone missing ...
notes: Ahn's film is an unhealthy and clumsy theft of a common heritage, an imaginary. Fears, suspense, anxiety? Sure, but of those to defrost and cook in the microwave.

title: Chasing Liberty
actors: Mandy Moore, Jeremy Piven, Annabella Sciorra, Mark Harmon, Matthew Goode, Beatrice Rosenblatt
description: While in Europe, and more precisely in Berlin, with her father, the president of the United States, the restless Anna Foster gets permission to spend an evening alone, without the control of the secret services. The girl would like to go with her friend to the Love Parade, a musical event that winds through the streets of Berlin following the deafening rhythm of techno music. But upon leaving, the President changes his mind. Anna escapes and thus runs into Ben Calder who accompanies her on an adventurous journey around the Old Continent.
notes: Andy Cadiff proves rather uncertain both in directing and in directing the actors.

title: Nema problema
actors: Zan Marolt, Labina Mitevska, Vincent Riotta, Fabrizio Rongione
description: War correspondent Lorenzi ventures with a local translator into dangerous territory. Commander Jako may have taken refuge here, believed to be the author of the disappearance of an entire convoy of refugees. The two are joined by Maxime, a novice journalist and Sanja, a local girl who is looking for her relatives.
notes: In reconstructing the tragedy of the war in Bosnia-Herzegovina with the clearest objectivity possible, the filmmaker-documentary-journalist Giancarlo Bocchi forgot about one thing: emotion. I agree that an attempt has been made to make a raw document, but the interest does not even blossom.

title: Radio
actors: Cuba Gooding jr., Ed Harris, Debra Winger, Alfre Woodard
description: Football manager Harold Jones has a mentally disturbed boy nicknamed "Radio" play on his team. Over time, he transforms from a shy boy to a real community leader.
notes: The film is inspired by a true story, but the very flat staging and the remote-controlled script manage to make it false, sentimental, syrupy, uninvolving. If Ed Harris maintains a decent level of interpretation, Cuba Gooding jr. he seems blackmailed, in every shot, by the idea that a dramatic role like this could lead to a nomination or even an Oscar.

title: Notre musique
actors: Sarah Adler, Nade Dieu, Rony Kramer, George Aguilar, Leticia Gutiérrez
description: An indictment against modern times. Divided into three realms: the "Hell" is made up of war images; the "Purgatory" takes place today in Sarajevo on the occasion of the European Book Meetings: conferences and conversations on the need for poetry, self-image, Palestine and Israel ... The "Paradise" shows a young woman who having sacrificed herself, she finds peace on a small beach guarded by some US Marines.

title: Mondovino
description: The disputes over succession problems of billionaire families: the Napa, in California, two Florentine aristocratic dynasties, and the conflicts of three generations of a Burgundian family struggling to preserve its hectares of vineyards. Behind all these differences there is a single protagonist, Bordeaux, which has always been a symbol of civilization.
notes: We will continue to wonder why Mondovino even ended up in competition at the Cannes Film Festival; and why the main French newspapers ("An epic", "Le Monde"; "A Balzachian comedy", "Première"; "Sensational", "Libération"; "We love him", "Studio") want us to believe that these are a great film, rather than a curious pamphlet entirely within an economic-gastronomic controversy of no primary importance.

title: Shi mian mai fu
actors: Takeshi Kaneshiro, Andy Lau, Zhang Ziyi, Song Dandan
description: Flying daggers are a revolutionary group of China from 859 AD. Leo and Jin, captains of Feng Tian County, organize an elaborate deception to expose the rebel leader. But Jin falls in love with the woman, Leo, it will be discovered, he had already been in love with her for some time. The intrigue of double games will lead to an adventurous and then tragic outcome.
notes: Those who love the "essential" aesthetics of wuxiapian will not like the affectation of certain moments (the sequence of beans) or the calligraphy of others (the fights in the forest). If the director is suspected of opportunism, the choreography by Ching Siu-tung and the prodigious prowess of the performers are unblemished.

title: Salvador Allende
description: A reflection on the other 11 September, that of 1973, when a coup d'état supported by the United States led to the dismissal of the president elected by the people Salvador Allende. General Augusto Pinochet was installed in its place.
notes: The film, with a flat and traditional setting, is exciting, thrilling and indignant. And, as often happens in these cases, the most instructive part is the interview with the then American ambassador, who recounts the methods of the government and the CIA with chilling cynicism.

title: Bab-el-chams
actors: Hiyam Abbas, Orwa Nyrabia, Hala Omran, Rim Turkhi
description: The story of the Palestinian refugees, traveling from the Galilee camps to Lebanon over the span of fifty years, is intertwined with that of the love between Younès, an underground fighter, and his young wife Nahila.
notes: Great history and private events, between color flashbacks and moments of true, overwhelming tenderness.

title: The Price of Kissing
actors: Leon, Pauley Perrette, Nicole Eggert, Jon Seda, Loretta Devine, Lou Rawls, William R. Moses
description: The mystery of love is one to which everyone must find a personal answer. This is what Renee tries to do since childhood - first by investigating her mother's life, then basing herself on her own experiences - the girl seeks a "solution" that becomes increasingly difficult over the years.

title: Götter der Pest
actors: Harry Baer, Hanna Schygulla, Margarethe Von Trotta, Günter Kaufmann
description: Franz Walsh gets out of prison and goes to his ex-lover Joanna, who is now a singer in a nightclub. He searches for his brother Marian and discovers that he has been murdered. Tale Gunther, nicknamed "gorilla", confesses to having killed him. Meanwhile, Franz made the acquaintance of Margarethe and left Joanna. Franz, Gunter and Jo, gangsters on the way to sunset and retired to the countryside, decide to rob a supermarket. Joanna, disappointed by Franz's betrayal, denounces them.

title: The Ghost Ship
actors: Richard Dix, Russell Wade, Edith Barrett, Ben Bard, Edmund Glover
description: An officer on Captain Stone's "Altair" ship, Tom Merriam is conquered by his superior. But after two strange deaths among the crew, Tom begins to think that Stone is actually a psychopath ...
notes: Little known seafaring thriller on the theme of authority, loyalty and madness. Photograph by Nicholas Musuraca.

title: Youth Runs Wild
actors: Bonita Granville, Kent Smith, Jean Brooks, Glenn Vernon, Tessa Brind
description: Neglected by adults - too busy coping with the problems of World War II - children end up indulging in all sorts of abuses. A soldier returned from the front decides to open a center where he can assist the youngest. Propaganda film that analyzes the problem of stragglers with participation.

title: Riget II
actors: Ernst-Hugo Järegård, Peter Mygind, Kirsten Rolffes, Søren Pilmark
description: At the "Il Regno" hospital in Copenhagen, the chain of strange and disturbing events seems to never end: the apparitions of the ghost ambulance, the evil presences identified in the basements by Mrs. Drusse, and much more ...
notes: Third episode of the second tranche of the bizarre, demonic and mocking Vontrierian saga.

title: Certi bambini
actors: Gianluca Di Gennaro, Carmine Recano, Arturo Paglia, Miriam Candurro
description: Naples. Eleven-year-old Rosario lives in the suburbs with her grandmother Liliana, a sick woman who spends her time in front of the television. The child is the leader of a small pack that spends its days in arcades, sandwich bars, small crimes and challenges on the ring road.
notes: The starting point of the film is the novel of the same name by Diego De Silva and the Frazzi, together with the writer and the other screenwriters, have deconstructed the book and devised a double path. In the first, which covers almost the entire story, Rosario is on the subway and goes towards his first murder and in the second, mental, the fragments, the flashes, the details, the episodes of his unfortunate young life are illustrated. The cumbersome structure cages the film, which has visually and emotionally very successful moments, on the tracks of the double journey.

title: Mille mois
actors: Fouad Labied, Nezha Rahile, Mohamed Majd, Abdelati Lambarki
description: 1981, Morocco. Medhi, a seven-year-old boy, goes to live with his mother with his grandfather. His father is in prison and, to protect him, his mother and grandfather tell him that he has gone to work in France. Meanwhile, life continues: at school Mehdi has the privilege of having to guard the teacher's chair.
notes: The film begins with a tone of pure realism, focused on Medhi and his family, and then gradually broadens and multiplies the perspective to the entire village, told in an almost surreal way, with a camera that does not indulge in complex movements. and that chooses to position itself on the total rather than on the first floor. Overall there is some uncertainty in the script, but Bensaïdi offers some images of great suggestion.

title: Reverendo Colt
actors: Guy Madison, Richard Harrison, Thomas Moore, María Martín

title: The Elephant Man
actors: Philip Anglim, Kevin Conway, Penny Fuller, Glenn Close, Richard Clarke

title: Quella provincia maliziosa
actors: Karin Well, Andrea Nova, Gianluigi Chirizzi, Lidia Costanzo
description: Antonella and Fabrizio, two lovers, live their relationship to sunlight, hosted in the villa of his father, a rich industrialist with irreproachable costumes. Everything proceeds for the best until one day Fabrizio's father finds exposed in an newsstand among adult magazines photos of Antonella ...

title: Traveling with Che Guevara
actors: Alberto Granado, Walter Salles, Gael García Bernal
description: On the basis of the travel diary written by Ernesto Guevara, Minà reconstructs the journey that in 1952 led the then 23-year-old medical student and his biologist friend Alberto Granado to cross the most rural and profound Latin America in six months, first on horseback. of an old Norton 500 and then as hitchhikers.

title: Animal Instincts
actors: Maxwell Caulfield, Jan-Michael Vincent, Shannon Whirry, Delia Sheppard
description: When policeman David Cole discovers - quite by chance - that he is a voyeur, his wife Joanna indulges him by engaging in a series of relationships with other men, whom he witnesses via closed circuit TV. Soon, however, the matter becomes risky ...
notes: Yet another useless thriller with an erotic background.

title: They Crawl
actors: Daniel Cosgrove, Tamara Davies, Mickey Rourke, Ken Lerner
description: Autopsies on two corpses lead to a disturbing revelation: both bodies have no internal organs. Agents Ted Gage and Gina O'Bannon discover a connection to the bizarre sect headed by Tiny Frakes, responsible for unleashing a terrible horde of mutant cockroaches ...
notes: Pure Series B.

title: Mademoiselle Fifi
actors: Kurt Krueger, Simone Simon, John Emery, Alan Napier, Helen Freeman
description: While war rages with the Prussian army in occupied France, the young washerwoman Elisabeth Rousset shares a carriage with some aristocrats fleeing to England. When Lieutenant von Eyrick blocks the car, the girl will be the only one to react ...
notes: Taken from two short stories by Maupassant.

title: Riget II
actors: Ernst-Hugo Järegård, Peter Mygind, Kirsten Rolffes, Søren Pilmark
description: At the "Il Regno" hospital in Copenhagen, the chain of strange and disturbing events seems to never end: the apparitions of the ghost ambulance, the evil presences identified in the basements by Mrs. Drusse, and much more ...
notes: Fourth episode of the second tranche of the bizarre, demonic and mocking Vontrierian saga.

title: Miss Mend
actors: Vladimir Fogel, Natal'ja Glan, Igor Ilyinskij, Boris Barnet
description: Assisted by photographer Fogel 'and journalist Barnet, Tom Hopkins saves Vivian Mend from the clutches of Cice, who in the meantime is cultivating a monstrous criminal project ...
notes: A three-episode film that is a brilliant attempt to "find the cinematic equivalent of the Jack London committed novel".

title: Suchwiin bulmyeong
actors: Yang Dong-kun, Kim Young-min, Ban Min-jung, Bang Eun-jin
description: Chang-guk's mother has been writing for years to the boy's father, an American black soldier, without receiving a reply; the woman lives with a dog meat trader, who employs Chang-guk in his makeshift slaughterhouse. Jihum is the son of a proud Korean War veteran, an invalid in perpetual waiting for government recognition. Eunok, with whom Jihun is in love, is a one-eyed student who will get "help" from a Yankee military ...
notes: In his perhaps most lucid film, Kim shows an almost bestial humanity, humiliated by war and American bases, capable of venting only in violence (even self-defeating).

title: Ici et ailleurs
description: Godard resumes the material of a film shot in Palestine in 1970 and then abandoned mixing it with TV images and the everyday life of France in 1975.
notes: The opposition that arises from here and elsewhere (France, Palestine) becomes complicated with that man-woman thanks to the comment entrusted to the voiceover of Miéville.

title: Garage Days
actors: Kick Gurry, Maya Stange, Pia Miranda, Marton Csokas, Brett Stiller, Russell Dykstra
description: An Australian garage band, led by Freddy, is willing to do almost anything to succeed, or at least get to perform on stage. but amidst blackmail and unpleasant situations, the boys will realize that life often holds surprises much more breathtaking than rock'n'roll.
notes: _Garage Days_ recalls another famous film: _The Commitments_ by Alan Parker, of which it seems a more updated and politically incorrect version. In Proyas' filmography, which since the beginning of his career seems inclined to a decidedly dark fantastic, this film seems a pleasant parenthesis, drawing a credible and interesting youth universe.

title: Il servo ungherese
actors: Tomas Arana, Andrea Renzi, Chiara Conti, Edoardo Sala, Milica Djukic, Cesare Bocci
description: August Dailermmann runs a concentration camp. When he meets Miklos, a Jewish servant but above all a refined intellectual, he begins to take an interest in art. In this way he selects painters and musicians from among the deportees and creates an orchestra, while his wife Franziska has a portrait made by seven painters. When August is transferred to Berlin, the command passes to the young and ruthless Lieutenant Tross ...
notes: The idea of ??tackling the crux of the relationship between art and the Nazi abomination was not so strange after all. But the film itself embodies the opposite of the aesthetic ideals it declaims. The staging is a deadly mixture of traditional theater and TV, with the worst of both.

title: Signora
actors: Sonia Aquino, Paolo Seganti, Urbano Barberini, Angela Finocchiaro, Yorgo Voyagis
description: Rome, 1933. Sarah, an American aristocrat married to a wealthy businessman, falls in love with Guido, a young engineer. The two begin an overwhelming relationship, so much so that Sarah declares herself willing to leave her husband. But suddenly Guido disappears without leaving a trace. Sarah then hires an investigator to find out if her lover is cheating on her with another woman ...

title: The Day After Tomorrow
actors: Dennis Quaid, Jake Gyllenhaal, Emmy Rossum, Dash Mihok, Sela Ward, Arjay Smith, Austin Nichols
description: Research by climatologist Jack Hall indicates that global warming could trigger a sudden and catastrophic change in our planet's climate. Confirmation comes when unexplained weather events begin to occur in different parts of the world. While Hall is at the White House to raise the alarm, his son Sam is trapped in a suddenly sub-zero New York. The scientist immediately sets out to save what he holds most dear, but not even he is prepared to face what awaits him.
notes: A committed, serious blockbuster, with an indeterminate happy ending and that does not give up the proceeds for this reason, it is not very frequent in Hollywood. The digitized blizzards and transformation of New York into a gigantic set enclosed in a planetary snowball are more convincing than the characters (even if the actors get away with it) and their dialogues (and it's not the first time in Emmerich).

title: El abrazo partido
actors: Daniel Hendler, Sergio Boris, Adriana Aizemberg, Diego Korol
description: Ariel, a Polish-born Jew who emigrated whose family emigrated to Argentina to escape the Holocaust, has a home-made video made on the day of his circumcision as his only memory of his father. The day after that event, his father went to war in Israel and never came back. The man goes out to send letters and call every now and then. For the mother and for Joseph, her brother, it is normal, but for Ariel it is not fair ...
notes: Minute events, habits, resigned and tired looks, lunch breaks, furtive embraces, silences, confessional minimalism. An unoriginal direction of details and sketches of human comedy. Grand Jury Prize in Cannes.

title: Pontormo - Un amore eretico
actors: Joe Mantegna, Galatea Ranzi, Toni Bertorelli, Laurent Terzieff, Sandro Lombardi
description: France, 16th century. The painter Jacopo Carrucci, known as Pontormo, struggles to defend Anna, his muse, from being accused of witchcraft. The woman, a young Flemish exile whose tongue was cut out during the Flanders War, is also accused of murder. Pontormo, now almost at the end of his life, exposes himself in the first person to defend it.
notes: As long as it stays within the limits of disclosure, the film is not too boring. A good company of actors holds the roles professionally. But then didacticism suffocates everything: the dialogues seem like captions, and Pontormo, famous for his reserve, becomes a talkative self-theorist.

title: Song for a Raggy Boy
actors: Aidan Quinn, Iain Glen, Marc Warren, Dudley Sutton, Chris Newman
description: The methods of William Franklin, the only lay teacher in St. Jude's reformatory, are diametrically opposed to those used by priests. trying to build a relationship based on trust, Franklin brings out the hidden talents of the boys, teaching them to read and appreciate poetry.
notes: A work that lives and is satisfied with its contents, which does not need (nor seeks with particular commitment) any other form that distinguishes it and makes it remembered in the crowded sub-genre, which shakes and - in some sequences - horrifies. Good interpreters, from good Aidan Quinn to bad Iain Glen, diligently directed by television.

title: La spettatrice
actors: Barbora Bobulova, Andrea Renzi, Brigitte Catillon
description: Valeria, closed and lonely, meets Massimo, a charming forty year old. The two do not know each other, but the girl spies on him from her home and is willing to change city, job, life just to be close to him. But Flavia, the man's companion, is also involved.
notes: Paolo Franchi's is an intimate cinema that anthropologically studies the frozen blood of men and women who have fired emotions. The film is a reiterated psychoanalytic session, which vainly pursues reason. The two main actors are of great depth: Andrea Renzi is extraordinarily mummified in his fear of love; Barbora Bobulova is shy but very bold.

title: La maschera del demonio
actors: Barbara Steele, John Richardson, Ivo Garrani, Andrea Checchi
description: 1830: Stopping in a ruined chapel deep in the woods, Dr. Chomas and his assistant Gorobec discover a sarcophagus that holds the mummified remains of the witch Asa, executed two centuries earlier. She, incidentally coming into contact with Chomas's blood, comes back to life and resumes her victims in the family of her great-granddaughter Katia, who lives in a nearby castle with her father, brother and an old servant ...
notes: The debutant Bava - who also signs the photograph - is inspired by the story _Il Vij_ by Nikolaj Gogol 'and draws from it one of the absolute masterpieces of horror (not only Italian). The Steele is memorable.

title: Once We Were Strangers
actors: Vincenzo Amato, Ajay Naidu, Jessica Whitney, Anjalee Deshpande, Alisha McKinney
description: The Sicilian Antonio and the Indian Apu live in New York and pursue the American dream. The first's life becomes complicated when he falls in love with Ellen, who has to go to Paris for work. Apu instead has to deal with Devi, the bride that his parents chose for him when he was still a child ...
notes: First work by the director of _Respiro_ and _Nuovomondo_.

title: Masques
actors: Philippe Noiret, Bernadette Lafont, Robin Renucci, Anne Brochet
description: The brother of a girl who disappeared after meeting a TV presenter pretends to be a biographer and discovers his dark secret.

title: Borstal Boy
actors: Shawn Hatosy, Danny Dyer, Lee Ingleby, Robin Laing, Eva Birthistle

title: The Laramie Project
actors: Christina Ricci, Steve Buscemi, Laura Linney, Summer Phoenix

title: This Is Spinal Tap
actors: Rob Reiner, Michael McKean, Christopher Guest, Harry Shearer
description: Spinal Tap, an English hard rock band that has been on the scene for many years now, are leaving for a tour in the USA. With them he is a documentary maker intent on capturing every moment of their day to capture "the smell of rock'n'roll". But the tour has to face several difficulties: the time of success has passed, many dates are canceled, the new album has an ignoble cover that is censored. As if that were not enough between the two leaders of the group, the singer and the lead guitarist, together since they were children, the disagreements begin also due to the frequent interference of the singer's wife.
notes: Hilarious mockumentary that marked Reiner's debut. Spinal Tap, a non-existent band, brings together all the worst stylistic features of the worst rock and yet, despite the obvious and grotesque absence of neuronal connections, they prove to be credible and enjoyable.

title: Five Graves to Cairo
actors: Franchot Tone, Anne Baxter, Erich Von Stroheim, Akim Tamiroff

title: Laserblast
actors: Kim Milford, Cheryl Smith, Gianni Russo, Ron Masak, Dennis Burkley

title: La colt era il suo Dio
actors: Jeff Cameron, Krista Nell, Sophia Kammara, Donald O'Brien
description: A group of bandits, led by the Mexican Manuel, terrorize the town of Landford. The sheriff asks for the help of the army, which sends Captain Mike Jackson to see what is happening in his hometown and to search for a missing government agent in that area. Before long, Jackson finds himself at the center of brawls and shootings with outlaws who, in addition to harassing local farmers, force Mary, the woman the captain once intended to marry, to work in a saloon.

title: Dog Park
actors: Natasha Henstridge, Luke Wilson, Kathleen Robertson, Janeane Garofalo
description: Andy is left for another by his girlfriend Cheryl, who also takes away the custody of his dog. But soon he runs into Lorna, the host of a children's TV show too obsessed with her dog to pay attention to anyone else and just back from breaking up with Trevor. Andy also interacts with another woman, Keiran, while Cheryl decides to take her dog to an animal psychiatrist, discovering how her promiscuity has hurt her four-legged friend.

title: Gang Related
actors: James Belushi, Tupac Shakur, Lela Rochon, Dennis Quaid, James Earl Jones

title: Bang, Bang, You're Dead
actors: Thomas Cavanagh, Ben Foster, Randy Harrison, Janel Moloney

title: Bife Titanik
actors: Bogdan Diklic, Boro Stjepanovic

title: Bastardo, vamos a matar
actors: George Eastman, Lincoln Tate, Thomas Rudy, José Manuel Martín
description: A bounty hunter chases a Mexican destined for hanging. Realizing that the charges against him are unfounded, she helps him find the real culprits. Together they will do justice.

title: Sud sanaeha
actors: Kanokporn Tongaram, Min Oo, Jenjira Jansuda, Sa-gnad Chaiyapan

title: Riget II
actors: Ernst-Hugo Järegård, Peter Mygind, Kirsten Rolffes, Søren Pilmark

notes: Fifth episode of the second tranche of the bizarre, demonic and mocking Vontrierian saga.

title: Miss Mend
actors: Vladimir Fogel, Natal'ja Glan, Igor Ilyinskij, Boris Barnet
description: Assisted by photographer Fogel 'and journalist Barnet, Tom Hopkins saves Vivian Mend from the clutches of Cice, who in the meantime is cultivating a monstrous criminal project ...
notes: A three-episode film that is a brilliant attempt to "find the cinematic equivalent of the Jack London committed novel".

title: Introducing Dorothy Dandridge
actors: Halle Berry, Cynda Williams, Brent Spiner, Klaus Maria Brandauer
description: The film tells the story of Dorothy Dandridge, the first black actress to get an Oscar nomination in 1954 for _Carmen Jones_. The director also tackles her controversial romance with Otto Preminger who helped her in her career, but doesn't clarify the mysterious overdose that ended her life.

title: Morning Glory
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Adolphe Menjou, Douglas Fairbanks jr., Mary Duncan
description: Eva Lovelace, aspiring actress, arrives on the Broadway scene. With her optimistic character and her beauty more than with her talent she attracts the interest of a paternal actor, a womanizer producer and a serious playwright.

title: La course du lièvre à travers les champs
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Robert Ryan, Lea Massari, Aldo Ray
description: Tony, witness to a crime committed by a group of gypsies, receives a large sum from the victim, just before the latter dies. But the gypsies want the loot back and chase Tony to get it back ...
notes: Written by Sebastien Japrisot (pseudonym and anagram of Jean-Baptiste Rossi) based on his novel of the same name, it is an atypical noir, with macabre hues and marked symbolism. Between black humor and dreamlike suggestions, he boasts a very careful direction of actors and allows himself to be contaminated by different registers without ever neglecting the psychological excavation of the characters. Mocked at the time by the Cahiers, today it deserves to be recovered and reconsidered. Appearance of Emmanuelle Béart as a child.

title: The Gathering Storm
actors: Albert Finney, Vanessa Redgrave, Jim Broadbent, Linus Roache

title: Riget II
actors: Ernst-Hugo Järegård, Peter Mygind, Kirsten Rolffes, Søren Pilmark
description: At the "Il Regno" hospital in Copenhagen, the chain of strange and disturbing events seems to never end: the apparitions of the ghost ambulance, the evil presences identified in the basements by Mrs. Drusse, and much more ...
notes: Sixth episode of the second tranche of the bizarre, demonic and mocking Vontrierian saga.

title: Miss Mend
actors: Vladimir Fogel, Natal'ja Glan, Igor Ilyinskij, Boris Barnet
description: Cice is determined to spread the plague in the USSR: Fogel ', Barnet, Hopkins and Vivian try in every way to block it, but Johnson - alias Arthur Storn - plots in the shadows ...
notes: A three-episode film that is a brilliant attempt to "find the cinematic equivalent of the Jack London committed novel".

title: Witchboard 2: The Devil's Doorway
actors: Ami Dolenz, Christopher Michael Moore, Laraine Newman, Timothy Gibbs
description: After moving to her new apartment, the young Paige Benedict finds an "oujia" tablet left by the previous tenant, through which she begins to receive strange messages about terrible and disturbing events that occurred in the past ...
notes: "Fake sequel" to _Spiritika_ (1986), by Tenney himself.

title: Operazione paura
actors: Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Micaela Esdra, Erika Blanc, Fabienne Dali, Piero Lulli
description: A doctor (Giacomo Rossi Stuart) arrives in a remote village in the fog, where a police commissioner (Piero Lulli) awaits him to perform an autopsy on the corpse of a young woman who died under unclear circumstances.
notes: The film closes the gothic genre and, probably, constitutes the highest example of it. Bava is an Author, and the fact that this work was shot in a few weeks is a further attestation of merit. Special handcrafted effects to remember. Gorgeous Erika Blanc.

title: Sult
actors: Per Oscarsson, Gunnel Lindblom, Birgitte Federspiel, Knud Rex

title: Talaye sorkh
actors: Hussain Emadeddin, Kamyar Sheisi, Azita Rayeji, Shahram Vaziri
