description: Tehran. Hussein, who by profession delivers pizzas to home, comes into possession of a bag containing a receipt for the purchase of a necklace in an uptown jewelry store. But the owner prevents him from entering his shop because of the clothes he wears and humiliates him. This attitude triggers Hussein's reaction.
notes: The former pupil of Kiarostami (who provided the subject, from a news story), Golden Lion with the _Cerchio_, manages to escape the risks of the "Iranian way" with an injection of realism, mediated by a thousand obstacles that displace him. viewer. Perhaps the project was a bit simplistic in structure, but the director has built it on a free and circular path in a city of the "Islamic world" today, confirming that in Iran cinema still has a lot to say.

title: Jagoda u supermarketu
actors: Branka Katic, Srdan Todorovic, Dubravka Mijatovic, Goran Radakovic
description: Jagoda is a shop assistant in the first American supermarket opened in Belgrade. One day a man in a camouflage suit, armed to the teeth, breaks into the shop and takes everyone present hostage. It's Marko, who is demanding justice because someone mistreated his grandmother: the previous evening an old woman insisted on buying strawberries, but the boxes were closed. The police are laying siege to the business, but have to deal with the crowd cheering for Marko.
notes: Emir Kusturica here as a producer would have done better to impose on Dusan Milic - director and screenwriter of this hodgepodge - the budget and duration of a short film.

title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
actors: Emma Watson, Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Gary Oldman, Maggie Smith, Richard Griffiths, Michael Gambon, David Thewlis, Emma Thompson, Julie Christie, Tom Felton, David Bradley
description: Upon arriving at Hogwarts for his third year, Harry discovers that the dangerous killer Sirius Black has escaped from Azkaban prison, where the evil wizards are held, and has set out on his trail. And this time Harry can't even count on his closest friends, as a traitor is hiding among them ...
notes: Probably the best of the first three films (according to the lovers of the literary saga, this is also the best of the five books): the Mexican Cuarón has managed to grasp not only the dark side of fairy tales, but also everything black and eccentric flows under the green of old England and disrupts its order.

title: Das Wunder von Bern
actors: Louis Klamroth, Peter Lohmeyer, Johanna Gastdorf, Mirko Lang, Birthe Wolter
description: Germany, 1954. The Soviet Union is repatriating prisoners of war. Among them is Richard Lubanski, the father of Matthias, an 11-year-old football fan. However, the return to normalcy is not easy: marked by the years of imprisonment, Richard struggles to adapt to life in post-war Germany and reacts by mistreating his family. He sees football as a waste of time, as well as the World Cup which will soon be played in Bern, Switzerland. Matthias instead dreams of being next to his idol, who has been chosen to play for the German national team.
notes: The director stages a captivating story, but here and there too verbose.

title: Ladri di barzellette
actors: Aurelio Grimaldi, Bruno Colella, Alvaro Vitali, Stefania Corona, Stefano Masciarelli
description: In order to be able to realize the trilogy on Aldo Moro, an operation that has in fact been in the works for some time, Aurelio Grimaldi in the role of himself agrees to direct the sequel to the Vanzina's _Barzellette_. The producer supports him with two consultants: one is the borgataro Stefano Masciarelli, the other is Alvaro Vitali. As often happens behind the scenes of Italian cinema, the rogue producer pockets his money (even Grimaldi's) and runs away to Montecarlo with Ferrari and a blonde in law.
notes: _Joke thieves_ is naÏf, amateur in the package, but he doesn't try to hide it. Post-scriptum for Grimaldi: we are counting on the role of the "great old man" of the trilogy promised to Vitali !!

title: Bom yeoreum gaeul gyeoul geurigo bom
actors: Seo Jae-kyeong, Kim Young-min, Oh Yeong-su, Kim Ki-duk, Kim Young-min, Seo Jae-kyeong
description: Two monks live in a hermitage on an islet in the center of a small lake surrounded by mountains. But not even they can escape the attraction of life, desires, sufferings and passions. Under the watchful gaze of the elderly monk, the young monk loses his innocence, discovers love when a woman enters their closed world, understands what jealousy and possession mean. As the seasons continue to alternate, so the hermitage remains a refuge for the spirit ...
notes: The clarity is what "hurts" the most in Kim Ki-duk's cinema, as proof of a resoluteness (even stylistic) stripped of the superfluous.

title: 50 First Dates
actors: Adam Sandler, Drew Barrymore, Rob Schneider, Sean Astin, Dan Aykroyd
description: Playboy Henry, a veterinarian in Hawaii, knows what may be the woman of his life, the beautiful Lucy, but discovers that she has lost control of her short memory following an accident. Every day, for months, she wakes up as if it were October 14, the day she had the accident, and erases what happened the day before. Poor Henry must therefore win back Lucy every day, and contend with her father and brother as well.
notes: Despite some lapses in taste and the presence of too many gags, the Sandler Barrymore couple works and gets more than a laugh and more than a sigh of love. Also thanks to a soundtrack, pimp at the right point.

title: Dos hombres van a morir
actors: Peter Martell, Piero Lulli, Dyanik Zurakowska, Miguel Del Castillo
description: To get rid of Bill Anderson's gang, the citizens of Springfield hire a Pinkerton agent, Ringo, who is joined by a former Northern Army captain, Allan. The friendship between the two cracks when Ringo kills Kid, Allan's brother.
notes: A western with little emotion.

title: Carnival of Souls
actors: Bobbie Phillips, Shawnee Smith, Larry Miller, Paul Johansson
description: Alex was shocked by Louis Seagram's brutal rape and murder of her mother, who committed the crime disguised as a clown. Many years pass, and Alex seems to see Louis again threatening her dressed up in the same costume ...
notes: Modest remake of a 1962 film of the same name. Produced by Wes Craven.

title: Carnosaur
actors: Diane Ladd, Raphael Sbarge, Jennifer Runyon, Ned Bellamy, Harrison Page

title: Il marito in vacanza
actors: Renzo Montagnani, Lilli Carati, Enzo Cannavale, Bombolo, Cinzia De Ponti
description: The principal of an elementary school is meeting with other teachers in a not very elegant hotel. During the day the man works tirelessly for the union, while at night with the complicity of a janitor he goes wild with the procure teachers.
notes: One of the nine films interpreted by Montagnani in 1981.

title: Snapshot
actors: Burt Reynolds, Julie Christie, Carmen Chaplin, Angela Groothuizen
description: Larry, who has been in Holland for thirty years, is the owner of a second-hand bookshop in Amsterdam. Half a hermit who loves to chat and who always has an answer for everything, one day he sees a girl enter his library who reminds him of the great love he lived in Morocco.

title: I Want You
actors: Rachel Weisz, Alessandro Nivola, Luka Petrusic, Labina Mitevska
description: Martin, fresh out of prison, returns to his hometown on the English coast to reconnect with his ex-girlfriend, Helen, who has long been in a relationship with Bob. Helen is friends with Honda, a fourteen-year-old mute boy who lives with his sister. Honda is secretly in love with Helen and secretly records her conversations thus witnessing the fights between Martin and Helen.

title: To End All Wars
actors: Robert Carlyle, Kiefer Sutherland, Ciarán McMenamin, Mark Strong
description: Life is brutally hard for a group of British soldiers held hostage by the Japanese in Thailand. Westerners led by Captain Gordon are considered part of an "inferior race" and have to deal with a grueling job - the construction of the new railway line in minimal time - and with psychological and physical torture every day heavier.
notes: Carlyle and Sutherland give a good test of actors despite the mediocrity of the dialogue and the narrative clichés. The film starts well and gets lost in the rhetoric and do-gooders to which the subject matter could easily give rise. Taken from the memoirs of Captain Gordon.

title: Schastye
actors: Mikhail Gipsi, Pyotr Sinovyev, Yelena Yegorova, Nikolai Cherkasov
description: Despite his efforts, poor farmer Zmyr cannot be happy: the horse does not want to work, the harvest is taken away from him by various parasites and he cannot even afford to die, who else would keep the rich? After the proletarian revolution he will win happiness when he sacrifices his own interest (and the burning house) to save the horses of the whole community, regaining the esteem of his wife Anna.
notes: _La Happiness_ was born as a propaganda film about life in the kolkhozes but filtered through the gaze of Medvedkin who will meet, as in all his films, the Stalinist censorship and then be rediscovered in Europe only in the 70s

title: Greenwich Mean Time
actors: Alec Newman, Ben Waters, Steve John Shepherd, Chiwetel Ejiofor

title: Cani arrabbiati
actors: Riccardo Cucciolla, Lea Lander, Luigi Montefiori, Aldo Caponi
description: The Doctor, Scalpel and 32 are three robbers who, along with a fourth accomplice, steal the wages of employees of a small pharmaceutical company. The blow goes bad immediately, the fourth man leaves the feathers and the three escape by a whisker from the police, taking hostage first a woman, Maria, then a man who is kidnapped the car, not knowing that the car is also a sick child, who should be taken to hospital as soon as possible. The three will have to travel for a long time together with their victims in the cramped cockpit.
notes: Breathless thriller on the road, which paints a hellish journey with a rigorous unity of place - the cockpit - gradually more chilling. He is known for having vaguely inspired Tarantino's Le Iene, with which he actually has very little to do. It is rather the cursed film by Mario Bava, who at the time titled it _Angry dogs_ without being able to complete it according to his will due to the failure of the producer. In fact, it did not come out in theaters and it was seen in Italy for the first time on Sky, in 2004, in a not very philological reconstruction - including repertoire material by Umberto Lenzi - made by his son Lamberto, at the time assistant director of the parent.

title: La cameriera
actors: Daniela Giordano, Mario Colli, Enzo Monteduro, Carla Calò, Rosemarie Lindt, Annamaria Tornello, Anna Melita, Giacomo Furia
description: In a family of baronial origin of southern Italy the harmony is broken by the arrival of Mary, alarm clock and the attractive service woman who arrived from Veneto. The girls are immediately concentrated on the girl, the attention of the males of the country but also those of her employer, who remained widowed, and the son.

title: Joy-Rider
actors: Paul Nicholls, Andrew Lee Potts, Sienna Miller, Mathieu Carrière
description: Raf lives in a squalid London suburb with his father Mario - unemployed and perpetually drunk - and has an all-consuming passion: to ride a motorcycle and one day become world champion. But the boy also has a soft spot for Savannah, who is with his friend Ruben ...
notes: A "youthful" film without quality.

title: Earthly Possession
actors: Susan Sarandon, Stephen Dorff, Elisabeth Moss, Jay O. Sanders
description: To cover his back after cleaning up the bank of a provincial town, the young thug Jake Simms takes hostage the first person he comes across: the unfortunate is Charlotte Emory, a middle-aged lady bored by a marriage (with the pastor of the local church) now worn out. Over time, a relationship that resembles a love story develops between the two, with Charlotte doing her best to help Jake eclipse himself with the swag. The fact is that the boy also has a wife, very young and pregnant, which does not leave Charlotte indifferent: the experience lived together will, however, leave its mark on both ...

title: The Winner
actors: Vincent D'Onofrio, Rebecca De Mornay, Delroy Lindo, Frank Whaley, Michael Madsen, Billy Bob Thornton
description: Every Sunday that God sends to earth, Philip walks into the same casino in Las Vegas, places his bets, wins a bundle of money and goes home as if nothing had happened. However, his exploits do not go unnoticed. In fact, Louise, a messy nightclub singer, agrees a plan with her partner Jack: after making Philip fall in love with her, she will extort the money that Jack will need to pay the debts to his boss, the sinister and powerful Kingman. But then Joey, another fool, comes on the scene with his coven ...
notes: Super cast but little substance in this black comedy from the director of _Sid and Nancy_.

title: Fino a farti male
actors: Agnese Nano, Christopher Buchholz, Karin Giegerich, Jacqueline Lustig
description: Marc, a music manager, returns from a trip and discovers that his wife Martina, 30, has decided to commit suicide. The woman made this decision because she is unable to choose between her husband, whom she loves deeply, and Lara, with whom she has an affair. Marc has only three days to understand Martina's reasons and to try to save her.
notes: The inner tragedy that afflicts Martina does not envelop, involve and influence anyone. Also because the artistic and emotional participation of Agnese Nano is exaggeratedly restrained. To the point of wondering if the fault of a structural inability on the part of the actress or the demerit of a management too busy looking at the navel. Positive notes, on the other hand, as regards Christopher Buchholz, a Marc of essential rigor, who here seems to recall a great acting lesson from the recent past: those painful glances entangled among the imperceptible nuances of Daniel Auteuil of _Un heart in winter_.

title: Gori vatra
country: Bosnia and Herzegovina, Austria, Turkey, France
actors: Enis Beslagic, Bogdan Diklic, Sasa Petrovic, Izudin Bajrovic, Jasna Zalica
description: 1998: The news of US President Bill Clinton's upcoming visit pushes the inhabitants of Tesanj, a town in Bosnia devastated by ethnic intolerance and corruption, to pretend to live in an enlightened democracy, characterized by peace and total harmony ...
notes: The exposed cynicism and black humor that mark some initial sequences are soon overturned into an absolutist indifference and an unpleasant final "volemose bene". Derivative of the models (from Kusturica to _Svegliati Ned_), a film that would like to be cunning, but is marred by a total lack of flair and an irritating sloppiness in making.

title: Michel Vaillant
actors: Sagamore Stévenin, Peter Youngblood Hills, Diane Kruger, Jean-Pierre Cassel
description: Driver Michel Vaillant with his blue car no. 10 goes from success to success. His victories on circuits around the world arouse much envy, especially in the rival team, the Leader, led by the ruthless Ruth Wong, willing to do anything to win. For Michel and his teammate Steve Warson, the 24 Hours of Le Mans thus turns into a race for life ...
notes: Phrases that look like slogans, characters cut with an ax (and don't say they are in line with those of comics because it's not true!), Eroticism that can be spent in prime time television and spectacular packaging all barrels and speed, without thickness. In addition, there is the stench under the nose (in the States, the automotive genre is forced, see Fast & Furious, here the drivers live in a sort of castle in the Loire) and the politics of the current times.

title: Welcome to Mooseport
actors: Gene Hackman, Ray Romano, Marcia Gay Harden, Maura Tierney
description: Former US President Monroe Cole returns to his hometown of New England, where he agrees to run for mayor elections. Cole initially underestimates other candidate Handy Harrison, who owns a local computer shop. But the battle will be tougher than expected ...
notes: In the obviousness of the system and its developments, the film has flashes of enjoyable dialogue and little else. In addition to the two protagonists, the other actors (Marcia Gay Harden, Maura Tierney, Rip Torn, Christine Baranski) are simply functional to their side characterizations and do not mitigate the feeling of a superficial waste of the cast for a film that could have been ferocious and mocking.

title: High Speed
actors: Andrew Lee Potts, Paul Nicholls, Massimo Ghini, Sienna Miller
description: For Raf, who lives in an English suburb with his father Mario, unemployed with alcohol problems, motorcycling is everything. The boy spends every minute of his free time riding his bike with which he hopes, one day, to be able to participate and win the world championship. And Raf is almost sure he can fulfill his dream ...

title: Dentro la città
actors: Edoardo Leo, Elisabetta Cavallotti, Luca Ward, Rolando Ravello
description: Commissioner Chessari and his deputy, Lorenzo Corsi, run a small police station on the outskirts of Rome. Their task is not easy, as the agents assigned to this detachment are a group of mavericks who often reach the limit of legality. This could affect Chessari's chances of career advancement, while Corsi, fresh from the Academy, is forced to deal with a reality that clashes with the theory he learned at the police school.
notes: The ambition is watered down by a script full of already heard chatter and worn out badges, of words engraved in the obvious stone that, involuntarily, sound like those of the parodies signed by the Premiata Ditta.

title: Haven
actors: Natasha Richardson, Martin Landau, Anne Bancroft, Kenneth Welsh
description: World War II: American journalist Ruth Gruber takes on the delicate task of escorting a thousand Jewish refugees from Nazi concentration camps overseas. The girl, who works for the secretary of the interior Harold Ickes, seems to be the perfect candidate, not only because she herself is Jewish, but also for experience and linguistic skills. In the United States, however, there will be difficulties ...
notes: Gray casts a full-bodied black and white drama backed by compelling cast evidence. Too bad he loses sight of the point, and the result struggles to arouse any emotion.

title: Una noche embarazosa
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Claudia Islas, Queta Caver, Carlos Estrada, Francis Córdova
description: Emigrated to Mexico for 13 years, the Calabrian taxi driver Amalio Badalamenti had 12 children by his wife Carmen, baptized with the names of the months. But there are also those who have no offspring and risk being disinherited, like the poultry industrialists Pablo and Ronnie Copeka ...
notes: Faint adaptation of a subject by Luis García Berlanga.

title: Wie angelt man sich seinen Chef?
actors: Johanna Lumley, Sophie Schütt, Johannes Brandrup, Oliver Petszokat
description: Anna is Christian's factotum secretary, who runs a successful business consulting agency. Secretly in love with her boss, she feels hopeless because he doesn't even notice her, surrounded as he is by a myriad of complacent women and perpetually inebriated by the continuous successes in his work. One evening, however, Christian, a well-known Don Juan, finds himself without other women around outside of Anna and, having drunk a lot more than usual, makes advances to her. The secretary, even knowing that his words are not sincere, cannot resist him and from that evening on, their lives will never be the same ...

title: The Last Brickmaker in America
actors: Sidney Poitier, Piper Laurie, Jay O. Sanders, Wendy Crewson
description: Henry is a senior brickmaker. He recently lost his wife, a librarian at the local school, who had been a faithful companion for years. Together with Dorothy he also lost the desire to make bricks, a job he was proud of, considering himself heir to a millenary tradition. It will be a little boy to get him out of the crisis ...

title: Bombardier
actors: Pat O'Brien, Randolph Scott, Anne Shirley, Eddie Albert, Walter Reed
description: Major Chick Davis trains his cadets with an iron fist to make them suitable for the new precision bombers, without disdaining outbursts of humanity and genuine friendship.
notes: Shot in a semi-documentary style, with the outline of personal events. Great O'Brien, spectacular battle sequences.

title: Noroît
actors: Geraldine Chaplin, Bernadette Lafont, Kika Markham, Humbert Balsan
description: Giulia lives in a castle on an island in the Atlantic, protected from pirates. Morag, one of her victims, will challenge her ...
notes: Inspired by _The Revenger's Tragedy_, written in 1607 by Cyril Tourneur, a segment of the _Scenes de la vie parallèle_ project, which also includes _Duelle_ (1976) and _Histoire de Marie et Julien_ (2003).

title: Witchblade
actors: Yancy Butler, Conrad Dunn, Anthony Cistaro, David Chokachi
description: Sara Pezzini, a New York police detective, has only one purpose in life: to bring to justice Tommy Gallo, responsible for the deaths of his father, his best friend and his own partner. While on the trail of Gallus, the woman comes into possession of the "Witchblade", a prodigious glove (which is said to have belonged to Joan of Arc) capable of deflecting bullets, drawing sharp blades and compacting itself into a small bracelet. Using this deadly weapon, Sara will try to put the hated antagonist with his back to the wall.
notes: Boring and very sloppy cinematic version of Mark Silvestri's comics.

title: La mazzetta
actors: Nino Manfredi, Paolo Stoppa, Ugo Tognazzi, Marisa Merlini
description: In Naples, Sasà Jovine makes ends meet by illegally passing himself off as a "lawyer". When the industrialist Michele Miletti offers him a large "bribe" to track down his daughter Giulia, who has run away from home, and to retrieve some compromising documents, Sasà - not particularly gifted with neither nose nor guts - gets to work. However, the corpses begin to flock: and what's more, Nicola Casali, partner and enemy of Miletti, in turn interested in the matter, also comes into play ...
notes: Multi-handed adaptation of a novel by Attilio Veraldi, with some good sketches (the "spaghetti torture") and a mouth-watering cast.

title: Le intermittenze del cuore
actors: Clément Sibony, Hector Alterio, Assumpta Serna, Florence Darel
description: A director prepares a film about the life of Proust. while the writing work proceeds, the man reviews some salient moments of his life: the abandonment of the partisan struggle, falling in love with a woman who, years later, does not even recognize, the relationship with his twenty-year-old son ...
notes: The elegance of direction that musically intertwines past and present, accompanied by the never cloying photography by Fabio Cianchetti, equally conquers the viewer, offering a serious lesson in staging, outdated in the best sense of the term.

title: Out of Time
actors: Denzel Washington, Eva Mendes, Sanaa Lathan, Dean Cain, Alex Carter
description: Matt Lee Whitlock, a Florida town police commander, is respected by his peers and popular with citizens. Until a series of clues indicate him as the perpetrator of a heinous double murder. Matt will have to face a race against time to find out the truth and prevent his name from ending up on the list of suspects.
notes: _Out of Time_ is a puzzle with a few pieces to combine and Denzel Washington does his duty with ease and his "dirty work" as an actor.

title: Highwaymen
actors: Jim Caviezel, Rhona Mitra, Frankie Faison, Gordon Currie
description: For five years Rennie Cray has been on the trail of his wife's killer: aboard his '68 Plymouth Barracuda, he wants to find the ruthless psychopath who killed her. Thus he discovers that the latter has transformed his Cadillac El Dorado into a monstrous extension of his own body ...
notes: The director knows how to frame roads, shortcuts and moving vehicles. So the film meshes with the first and increases the number of revolutions of the narrative engine with a certain ease, to then pack itself in the description of the psychologies of the characters and in the unveiling of the identity of the murderer: a mass of prostheses, a mechanically modified being it makes the “road thriller” skid and overturns it.

title: The Cat in the Hat
actors: Mike Myers, Dakota Fanning, Spencer Breslin, Alec Baldwin, Kelly Preston
description: Sally and Conrad, left alone at home with their goldfish, are bored: it's raining outside and they don't know how to pass the time. Suddenly a strange character knocks on the door: a talking cat who drags them on a series of fun adventures.
notes: The baby actors are magnificent and the adults, apart from Myers who unleashed his taste for grotesque characters, experience these contractual commitments as a vacation from methods, schools and techniques. Alec Baldwin, crude, vain, self-righteous, is hilarious. The film thrives on gimmicks and disconnected scenes, but it is better than many fragile scripts without rhyme or reason. Goldfish deserves a place in the fantasy of contemporary cinema.

title: The Blues - Warming by the Devil's Fire
actors: Nathaniel Lee jr., Tommy Hicks, Sister Rosetta Tharpe, Reverend Gary Davis
description: Vicksburg, Mississippi, 1955: "kidnapped" by uncle Buddy, a great lover of the blues, a little boy comes into contact with the world of music.
notes: Burnett (who sets the story in Vicksburg, where he was born in 1944) combines fiction, documentary and autobiographical elements to explore the relationship between "heaven" and "hell", or between gospel and blues. Particular emphasis is placed on the female figures who challenged the ire of the Church by singing "racy songs", including Lucille Bogan, Mamie Smith, Ma Rainey and Bessie Smith. Archival footage of Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Reverend Gary Davis, who on the contrary maintained the observance of the precepts of the clergy.

title: Dr. Quinn Medicine Woman: The Movie
actors: Jane Seymour, Joe Lando, Jim Knobeloch, Frank Collison, Henry G. Sanders
description: Far West, 1860. Widower Byron Sully opposes building a mine in Colorado Springs. In retaliation, his daughter Katie and Dr. Michaela "Mike" Quinn are kidnapped, just as she is celebrating her birthday. The traces of the kidnapped lead as far as Mexico.

title: Joe Somebody
actors: Tim Allen, Julie Bowen, Kelly Lynch, Greg Germann, Hayden Panettiere
description: After being humiliated for the umpteenth time by an overbearing colleague, moreover in front of his daughter, Joe Scheffer - an underrated video specialist employed by a pharmaceutical company - decides that the time has come to rebel. Former actor Chuck Scarett comes to his aid, giving him karate lessons, getting him back into shape and earning him the esteem of his colleagues. The daughter and ex-wife, however, are not all that impressed ...
notes: The comedy is so predictable that even the best Tim Allen would not be able to revive it. Unusual part for Jim Belushi in a sort of Steven Seagal parody.

title: Bianchi cavalli d'agosto
actors: Renato Cestié, Jean Seberg, Frederick Stafford, Ciccio Ingrassia, Alberto Terracina, Alberto Farnese, Carlo Gaddi, Vanna Brosio, Filippo Fantini, Paolo Paoloni, Paola Rosi, Lorenzo Piani, Vittorio Fanfoni
description: The American spouses Nicolas and Lea (plus their son Barney and the dog Clipper) spend their holidays in Pugnochiuso, in the Gargano. Neglected by his parents, who have long been accustomed to mutual infidelity, Barney has Pasqualino, the little hotel attendant, as his only friends, and the journalist Aldo, Lea's young lover ...
notes: Cheap tears.

title: Condemned Women
actors: Sally Eilers, Louis Hayward, Anne Shirley, Esther Dale, Lee Patrick
description: Jailed for theft, Linda Wilson has fallen into a deep state of depression: only the relationship with Philip Duncan, the psychologist of the prison, gives her the will to live. Despite this, the woman finds herself involved in a bloody escape attempt that leads to a revolt ...
notes: Robust civilian-inspired drama.

title: The Mad Miss Manton
actors: Frances Mercer, Sam Levene, Barbara Stanwyck, Henry Fonda, Sam Levene, Frances Mercer
description: The exuberant heiress Melsa Manton leads some friends (all in high places like her) to an abandoned house, where the bizarre group has the good fortune to stumble upon a dead body. Obviously the version of the girls does not convince the police, and moreover the journalist Peter Ames thinks well to publish a poison article on Melsa's "misdeeds": he focuses on pride, the latter recruits seven companions and begins to investigate on his own ...
notes: Enjoyable mix of comedy and suspense, enriched by the Stanwyck-Fonda duets that alone are worth the vision. To complete it all, then, there is the photograph of the great Nicholas Musuraca.

title: Duplex
actors: Drew Barrymore, Ben Stiller, Justin Theroux, Eileen Essel, Harvey Fierstein
description: Alex and Nancy finally find the house of their dreams and decide to buy it despite the expense being higher than what they had budgeted for. But as soon as they settle in, they realize that they have underestimated a problem not just: Mrs. Connelly, the tenant upstairs, who despite her advanced age is not at all fragile and kind as the young couple had believed ...
notes: _Duplex_ would like to be a black comedy of those dear to Danny De Vito, director here, but basically it tells a story with well-known developments. The trouble is that he tells it without verve, limiting the gags to the minimum wage, borrowing the (fake) political incorrectness of the Farrellys and worrying instead not to "dirty" with a bit of healthy malice. Ben Stiller confirms himself as the most overrated brilliant actor of his generation. Thinking about him driving Zebra Tre gives us the creeps.

title: Torque
actors: Martin Henderson, Ice Cube, Monet Mazur, Matt Schulze, Max Beesley
description: Motorcyclist Cary Ford is unjustly accused of murdering another biker. The man is hunted not only by the law, but also by the gang to which the victim belonged, who wants to take revenge. To survive, Ford must track down the real killer.
notes: A film of this type, all played on the likelihood of the actions and the skill of the stuntmen, loses a lot from the display of digital. If anything, the effects should be hidden, believed to be true. But when from the beginning the whole film is as colorful as a cartoon and as fast as a playstation, whatever the protagonists do we no longer believe it.

title: The Actors
actors: Michael Caine, Dylan Moran, Michael Gambon, Lena Headey, Miranda Richardson
description: Ireland. O'Malley, an Irish stage actor in decline, convinces his young colleague Tom to pass himself off as an emissary of the London bad and collect a debt from the head of the family Barreller, who is actually a bloodthirsty good man. The disguise works, but things get complicated when the real tax collector arrives (Scottish, this time) and Barreller has to deal with his beautiful daughter who falls in love with "English" ...
notes: The sufficiency assigned to this predictable nonsense is due to the moments of fun offered by the actors, especially the vain and greedy cartoon villain Caine, with his Shakespearean fixes. Miranda Richardson is the head of the London mafia.

title: Fararishtay kifti rost
actors: Uktamoi Miyasarova, Maruf Pulodzoda, Kova Tilavpur, Mardonkul Kulbobo
description: At the idea that, on her death, the coffin does not pass through the door of the house with a single leaf, Halima pretends to be on the verge of death to get her son Khamro back from Russia, so that the other leaf ends. The son comes back and begins major renovations, but he got into debt believing he could pay off the huge sum he borrowed from his maternal inheritance. The woman then turns to the "angel of the right shoulder" to make her die so that the son sells the house and pays off the debts ...
notes: Realistic cinema with some magic touches and a streak of legend, that of the angels we carry on our shoulders. Non-professional actors (all the director's family), spontaneity, the right look: a sharp, funny and ironic film that comes from afar.

title: Japón
actors: Alejandro Ferretis, Magdalena Flores, Yolanda Villa, Martín Serrano
description: Mexico. A painter is looking for a place to commit suicide. On his wanderings, he finds lodging in a small village at the home of an elderly woman, Ascen, who is very religious. The relationship that is established between the two will change something in the mind of man.
notes: This intense first feature directed by the Mexican Carlo Reygadas won the Caméra d'Or at Cannes 2002, struck by his youth on the road to Damascus that leads (goes) to Tarkovskij's cinema. For now, and in the hope that he doesn't get lost, a talented and worthy disciple.

title: Al Malaika la tuhaliq fi al-dar albayda
actors: Abdessamed Miftah El Kheir, Abderrazak El Badaoui, Leila El Hayani, Rachid el Hazmir
description: Said's pregnant wife Aicha and children live in a small village in Morocco. Said, on the other hand, has moved to Casablanca and works with Othman and Ismail in a restaurant. However, their dreams and aspirations collide with harsh reality, in a whirlwind of tragic events that suddenly disrupts their lives ...
notes: In the Moroccan sky the angels and the poor cannot take flight. This is the certainty of the newcomer Mohamed Asli (48 years old, has experience as a producer). A pair of shoes, a horse and a sick wife are inconceivable luxuries in a situation described with tones of poetic neorealism.

title: Stai con me
actors: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Adriano Giannini, Claudio Gioè, Paolo Briguglia
description: Chiara and Nanni live in Ostia with their two four-year-old twin children. Chiara teaches in an elementary school, while Nanni, who would like to be an actor, is a swimming instructor. Their existence passes quietly and friends admire and envy their serene stability. Everything flows perfectly, until a young actress falls in love with Nanni and does everything to win him over ...
notes: The talented Francesca Antonelli, in the role of the actress who makes Nanni fall into temptation, is one of the few happy notes of the film: a cameo lasting a few minutes that leaves its mark. For the rest, everything is rather obvious in this operetta that would like a lot, but can not get anywhere.

title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White and Blonde
actors: Reese Witherspoon, Sally Field, Regina King, Jennifer Coolidge, Bruce McGill
description: After graduating from Harvard, Elle Woods is determined to continue the fight for animal rights. Thus she arrives in Washington, determined to boycott a decree in favor of laboratory tests conducted on guinea pigs ...
notes: Elle's character exudes a lot of sympathy: unlikely, out of place, endowed with an unstoppable and naive desire to live and to break through, but above all with a profound sense of justice. The tones of the American comedy of the 50s thus marry with the spirit of Frank Capra and his _Mr. Smith goes to Washington_, of which this sequel to Revenge of the Blondes seems to be a revised and corrected version.

title: Intermission
actors: Shirley Henderson, Colin Farrell, Kerry Condon, Johnny Thompson, Emma Bolger
description: Lehiff, a petty criminal, wants to land one last blow and then retire. He is joined by John who quits his job at the supermarket hoping to win back his love, Deirdre, who fled with Sam, a married bank manager. But keeping an eye on them is Jerry, a policeman who wants to impose himself on his environment. Things get worse when Sam's ex-wife steps in ...
notes: the film certainly has the good fortune to count on an excellent cast that finds in Colin Farrell and Colm Meany, respectively Lehiff and Lynch, its spearheads and in Kelly Macdonald and Cillian Murphy excellent shoulders. It is an average product, which sometimes annoys with the ambitions of a camera that mimics the aesthetics of Dogma and indulges in moments from video clips, but it is written and interpreted with skill and even if it does not stand out for originality, it certainly offers good reasons to be seen.

title: Les textiles
actors: Barbara Schulz, Alexandre Brasseur, Jackie Berroyer, Sonia Vollereaux
description: Sophie and Olivier own a bakery in Paris: Olivier gets up at three to make bread, while his wife looks after the shop and their two children. One day Olivier decides to buy a timeshare villa on an island and gets in touch with Paul and Colette, a strange elderly couple who have put their share up for sale at a very low price. Sophie and Olivier do not investigate further, but when they arrive on the island they discover that the house is in the heart of a village of nudists who glare at them because they are "textiles".
notes: The moral is easy easy, in the style _Porta a Porta_ summer version: tolerance does not have to be one way. Maybe thirty years ago it would have made sense (and not unique) but today frankly it embarrasses the opposite. And the naked body festival is not enough to relieve boredom. Tourist.

title: Lorna
actors: Lorna Maitland, Mark Bradley, James Rucker, Hal Hopper, Althea Currier, Doc Scortt, James Griffith
description: Although married to Jim, Lorna is sexually dissatisfied: but one day, while her husband is as always at work at the salt mine, she is attacked by a fugitive who abuses her, causing her to reach orgasm for the first time. Lorna gets involved with her attacker, but Jim - despite gossip and warnings from colleagues - doesn't notice the betrayal until he gets home earlier than usual to celebrate his wedding anniversary ...
notes: As always in Meyer (also author of the splendid black and white photograph), sex acts as a revealing element of the hypocrisy, narrow-mindedness and racism that run through America.

title: Motor Psycho
actors: Haji, Alex Rocco, Stephen Oliver, Holle K. Winters
description: Three "bad boys" on motorcycles carry out ferocious raids based on torture, robbery and rape. Against them will join forces a veterinarian and a Cajun woman, whose criminals have respectively raped his wife and killed her husband ...
notes: A more "political" than erotic film, closed by a memorable and "incendiary" ending.

title: Faster Pussycat, Kill! Kill!
actors: Tura Satana, Haji, Lori Williams, Susan Bernard, Stuart Lancaster
description: During one of their raids in the middle of the Mojave desert, Varla, Rosie and Billie - strippers with huge breasts and disproportionate nastiness - take out the unfortunate Tommy and kidnap his girlfriend Linda. Arriving at the farm inhabited by an old paralytic and his two offspring, the diabolical trio sets their sights on the family's nest egg: the blood will flow freely ...
notes: Shot in blinding black and white and rendered "abstract" by the infinite horizontality of the spaces, one of the most significant pieces of Meyer's systematic deconstruction of the moralism and false conscience that afflict the Great Country.

title: Mondo Topless
actors: Lorna Maitland, Babette Bardot, Pat Barrington, Sin Lenee, Diane Young, Donna X
description: Against the backdrop of uninhibited San Francisco, some of the most well-known and generous "strippers" parade in front of Meyer's camera and microphone, dancing to the rhythm of rock and free-wheeling confession.
notes: Perhaps the most famous of the "documentary nudies": after an hour of bouncing boobs, however, boredom ends up dominating.

title: Katzelmacher
actors: Hanna Schygulla, Rainer Werner Fassbinder, Irm Hermann, Harry Baer
description: Marie is Erich's woman, Paul sleeps with Helga, Peter is supported by Elysabeth, and Rosy talks to Franz for money. These relationships that each of the characters have within the group - relationships of exploitation and mutual aggression - become even more cruel when the Greek immigrant Jorgos appears, who becomes Elisabeth's tenant and is immediately marginalized as an "animal" and " Communist". The men immediately unite against him and try to chase him away using physical force, while the reaction of the women is ambivalent, either because they think they are playing Jorgos' sexual potency (of which it is said) against that of their lovers, or because they think they can exploit it economically, or finally because they are attracted by its "diversity". The men will unite to violently beat the immigrant. But Elisabeht and Marie will convince him to stay. Either for reasons of money or for attraction to the "other" it has become indispensable for them.

title: Sei bounty killers per una strage
actors: Robert Wood, Donald O'Brien, Attilio Dottesio, George Wang

title: The Way She Moves
actors: Annabeth Gish, Kerry Beyer, Bo Brinkman, Lee Burns, Daniel Cosgrove
description: Amy has all the luck: she is beautiful, rich and engaged to the rampant Jason. However, her life takes an unexpected turn after meeting Nick, a salsa teacher in a Houston neighborhood, who offers her to partner with him on the dance floor: the "hot" attraction that will arise between them will force Amy to a difficult choice ...

title: Lady Scarface
actors: Dennis O'Keefe, Judith Anderson, Frances E. Neal, Eric Blore, Rand Brooks
description: Chicago: Lieutenant Bill Mason leads the investigation into a daring heist by the gang led by the scarred Slade. One after the other, the members of the gang are arrested: the only one missing is Slade, also because Mason is unaware that it is a woman ...
notes: Successful mix of suspense and brilliant ideas.

title: Jason X
actors: Kane Hodder, Lexa Doig, Chuck Campbell, Lisa Ryder, Peter Mensah
description: XXV century. The Earth has long since been habitable and humans have moved into space. A colony receives two cryogenically stored bodies and thaws them. But one of the two is from serial killer Jason Voorhees ...
notes: The slasher is renewed as it can and slips on some avoidable sloppiness (for example, in 2500 and broken they dress like us: a little more fantasy, come on!), But this time the slaughter is more fun than usual. It will be for a couple of cute gimmicks (like the crumbling head) and it will be because the director Jason Isaac, student of David Cronenberg (present in a tasty role) does not want to overdo it.

title: The Alamo
actors: Billy Bob Thornton, Jason Patric, Patrick Wilson, Dennis Quaid, Emilio Echevarria
description: Texas, 1836. One hundred and eighty-nine Texan civilians who believed in the future of their state, led by Colonels William Travis, Jim Bowie and the legendary Davy Crockett, occupied Fort Alamo. For twelve days they resisted the five thousand soldiers of General Antonio López de Santa Ana. A fierce battle ensued that saw the occupiers succumb. Six weeks later, General Sam Houston redeemed their demise.
notes: Boring and colorless staging of over two hours of an important episode in American history that was repeatedly brought to the screen. Remember _The Battle of the Alamo_ by and with John Wayne and _Alamo_ by Frank Lloyd.

title: Ma mère
actors: Louis Garrel, Isabelle Huppert, Emma de Caunes, Joanna Preiss
description: Seventeen year old Pierre lives with his grandmother. When suddenly his father dies Pierre is initiated into perversion by his mother, Hélène, whom the boy adores and in whom he sees a pure woman who has lived with a repulsive man. Hélène introduces him to Réa, his young mistress who involves Pierre in her orgies ...
notes: In the cinema, Bataillian inspiration is a sure guarantee of kitsch nine times out of ten. And this is undoubtedly also the case of this harmless and feeble digression, shot with absolute uncertainty, swerving between the dialogues and paradoxical situations of Bataille and inexplicable moments of flat realism. Various crafty toppings (but not so much, then): Barber's _Adagio_ bursts into the soundtrack, the characters whistle Bernard Herrmann and read Don DeLillo.

title: Ripper
actors: Derek  Hamilton, A.J. Cook, Bruce Payne, Ryan Northcott, Claire Keim
description: Sixteen-year-old Molly is the only survivor of a group of brutally murdered friends. The girl becomes interested in the minds of serial killers and participates in a study group on a murder that took place on the local campus. The students understand that the killer repeats Jack the Ripper's actions and once again Molly's friends begin to die around her.
notes: More than once the film slides widely into ridicule, but above all the whole is a great confusion in which in the end the direction is so clumsy that it is not even clear that the dissolution of the story is even more clear. A few moderately splattered gambles don't save the day.

title: House of 1000 Corpses
actors: Sid Haig, Bill Moseley, Sheri Moon Zombie, Karen Black, Chris Hardwick, Erin Daniels, Matthew McGrory, Jennifer Jostyn, Rainn Wilson, Walton Goggins
description: Due to a car breakdown, two couples find themselves in a remote place while a storm rages on. They knock on the door of an old abandoned house and are greeted by a "strange" family ...
notes: As it is, _The house of 1000 bodies_ remains a beautiful horror of flesh and blood, with some guessed characters (sensational Karen Black hooker and Sid Haig clown), tricks with bows and a sense of malaise and filth that emanates so much from the places as much as by faces and bodies. It means that the ingredients are spot on, and ten films like that are more necessary (even if it's just genre), rather than just one _My mother likes women_.

title: Strike!
actors: Kirsten Dunst, Gaby Hoffmann, Lynn Redgrave, Rachael Leigh Cook
description: In 1963 New England, "Miss Godard" - an exclusive college reserved for girls - is shocked by a sudden and dramatic revelation: the coffers are empty, and the only way to cope with the hardships is to merge with an institution. male...
notes: Innocuous silly trifle timidly "scollacciata".

title: The Punisher
actors: Thomas Jane, John Travolta, Will Patton, Roy Scheider, Laura Harring
description: The existence of Frank Castle, a special agent of the FBI, is turned upside down by the brutal killing of his wife and little son on behalf of the Saint spouses. Since Frank knows that the law will never adequately punish the guilty, he decides to take justice for himself.
notes: The film forgets all of this, and Frank Castle becomes the only conceivable American hero today. He acts with a single, explicit principle, that of "si vis pacem para bellum", but it is clear from how he kills that he doesn't give a damn about peace. Mind you, the revolting ideological attitude isn't that different from Troy's, but _The Punisher_ is all so crude and vulgar that it makes old Chuck Norris and Joseph Zito films look elegant.

title: Anatomie de l'enfer
actors: Amira Casar, Rocco Siffredi, Alexandre Belin, Manuel Taglang
description: In the bathroom of a nightclub, a girl decides to end it: she will pay a guy who doesn't like women to look at her. Four nights to confront and face the unspeakable.
notes: The idea of ??making Rocco play the part of a gay and making him play the part above all as a spectator (but in the end he also lets himself go to straight sex) is nice and overturns his image as a stallion and star of the hard. All the rest, however, is a wordy delirium all centered on the man-woman conflict, including that of the bodies, including that of their respective secretions. Very old speeches, from the self-awareness of the 70s, served on the screen with convoluted style.

title: Danny Deckchair
actors: Rhys Ifans, Miranda Otto, Justine Clarke, Rhys Muldoon, John Batchelor
description: When the long-awaited vacation goes up in smoke because of his girlfriend Trudy, Danny decides to leave in a deck chair raised by balloons. Due to a storm, he ends up in Clarence where he meets Glenda, a parking cop ...
notes: The spirit "a la Frank Capra" is exhibited right from the name of the happy town, which is called Clarence after the angel of _Life is wonderful_. The film is inevitably old but not too sugary, and above all it manages to keep up the pace for at least an hour (against the average 15 minutes of equivalent Hollywood products). Ifans may not be a comedy genius, but it works.

title: Histoire de Marie et Julien
actors: Emmanuelle Béart, Jerzy Radziwilowicz, Anne Brochet, Bettina Kee
description: Julien, a 40-year-old watchmaker, blackmails Madame X. Although he knows all the details of her traffic in antiques, Julien ignores the most dangerous of the woman's secrets: the one that binds him to Marie, with whom Julien fell in love a year earlier and who just revised ...
notes: Halfway through the film, with a twist, the love story between Marie and Julien shifts towards the fantastic and the gothic, giving life to one of Rivette's most exciting works: a melodrama that burns slowly, more and more intense and musical. The guardian of the affair - in addition to the various possible Cocteau and Hitchcock - is Edgar Allan Poe, singer of "returning" women.

title: The Whole Shebang
actors: Stanley Tucci, Bridget Fonda, Christian Boucher, Giancarlo Giannini
description: In Neptune, New Jersey, the Bazinni and Zito families compete for primacy in the art of pyrotechnics. After the death of Frank jr., His nephew Giovanni Bazinni arrives from Italy and in a short time he has to face two challenges: one with the Zito and the other for the heart of the beautiful widow Val ...
notes: Discounted "custom" comedy.

title: Winter Solstice
actors: Sinead Cusack, Jan Niklas, Geraldine Chaplin, Sophie Schütt, Ralf Bauer, Jason Durr, Jean Simmons, Emma Streets, Gregory Finnegan, Peter Ustinov
description: Elfrida, a 60-year-old former musical actress, is heartbroken over the death of her man. Oscar, a retired musician, lost his wife and daughter in an accident. United by adversity, Oscar and Elfrida leave the past behind and move to Scotland. The first Christmas spent together gives both of them the strength to start living again ...

title: I motorizzati
actors: Alberto Bonucci, Walter Chiari, Nino Manfredi, Ugo Tognazzi
description: Alberto Bonucci recounts some episodes that have made him lose his passion for the car: husband and wife struggling to buy a car, scams that have gone wrong to the detriment of insurance and motorists mistaken for thieves.
notes: At the time the film had a moderate success with the public.

title: The Last of the High Kings
actors: Jared Leto, Lorraine Pilkington, Emily Mortimer, Christina Ricci
description: Dublin, 1977. Frankie has just finished high school but is convinced he will not graduate. To survive the summer, he throws a party on the beach where he hopes to meet some girls. He will snob the daughter of an old friend of his father's and end up in bed with a classmate.
notes: Disappointing first feature.

title: Forever Mine
actors: Joseph Fiennes, Ray Liotta, Gretchen Mol, Vincent Laresca, Myk Watford
description: Alan Riply, a young Miami Beach lifeguard, has an affair with Ella Brice, who is on vacation with her husband Mark. Discovering the affair, he reacts violently and physically eliminates the rival. Or so he believes: in fact Alan survives and fifteen years later, with a scar on his face and in the disguise of the financier Manuel Esquema, he returns to Mark (who in the meantime has made a career in politics) to help him solve a litigation with justice. But what is the revenant really aiming for? To take revenge or to win back Ella's heart?
notes: Schrader writes and directs a "flamboyant" and pleasantly anachronistic melodrama.

title: Mädchen, Mädchen
actors: Diana Amft, Karoline Herfurth, Felicitas Woll, Andreas Christ
description: On her eighteenth birthday, Inken receives a sex education videotape as a gift, which she watches with her best friends, Victoria and Lena. Intrigued by the vision, the three girls begin a meticulous and often surprising search for true pleasure. After a series of experiments and some not always satisfying encounters, things will take an unexpected turn for all three.
notes: An ironic and light-hearted comedy, blockbuster in Germany.

title: Vixen!
actors: Erica Gavin, Garth Pillsbury, Harrison Page, Jon Evans, Vincene Wallace
description: Vixen lives with her husband, the naive pilot of planes Tom, in the mountains of British Columbia, Canada. As soon as Tom is absent for work, she takes advantage of it to unleash her uncontrollable libido on anyone who happens to him on fire, including brother ...
notes: A delusional and explicit infringement of every possible sexual taboo.

title: Supervixens
actors: Shari Eubank, Charles Napier, Uschi Digard, Charles Pitts, Henry Rowland
description: Clint Ramsey has to leave his job at Martin Bormann's service station and flee after his wife was killed by the psychopathic policeman Harry Sledge. Crossing America, Clints will be sexually harassed by various voluptuous nymphomaniacs in an increasingly lesser climate.

title: Up!
actors: Edward Schaaf, Raven de la Croix, Monty Bane, Janet Wood, Robert McLane, Candy Samples, Su Ling, Linda Sue Ragsdale, Marianne Marks, Bob Schott, Foxy Lae, Elaine Collins, Ray Reinhardt, Kitten Natividad
description: The sad fate of Adolf Schwarz, "killed" by a ravenous piranha, is consummated in a pseudo-Bavarian-style manor. But who really is the breasted Margo Winchester, whose arrival has turned the local males upside down?
notes: Meyer pushes on the crazy pedal to satirize the customs of the deep (and reactionary) American province.

title: Feng yun xiong ba tian xia
actors: Aaron Kwok, Ekin Cheng, Sonny Chiba, Kristy Yang, Shu Qi

title: Mucha sangre
actors: Paul Nachy, Rodolfo Sancho, Txema Sandoval, Isabel del Toro

title: Beneath the Valley of the Ultra-Vixens
actors: Kitten Natividad, Ken Kerr, Uschi Digard, Ann Marie, Stuart Lancaster, Michael Finn, Sharon Hill
description: Tired of enduring the homosexual tendencies of her husband Lamar, Levonna tries the card of despair and - with the help of a wig and a strong Mexican accent - she transforms herself into "Lola Langusta", a torrid stripteaseuse capable of resurrecting even the dead. The treatment proves effective, but the troubles of the ramshackle couple are by no means over ...
notes: Meyer directs her latest film building it around the "strong profile" of Francesca "Kitten" Natividad, the Mexican-born top girl with whom she had already worked three years earlier in _Up! _. Everything to taste the "therapeutic" show of the irresistible Lola Langusta.

title: The Poof Point
actors: Mark Curry, Tia Iwasaki, Camille Jensen, Raquel Lee, Dawnn Lewis
description: The lively parents Eddie and Marie have come up with an invention that allows people to travel through time. However, it happens that the prodigious machine has problems and that Eddie and Marie, subjected to the experiment, continue to grow while remaining kids at heart. It will be hard to figure it out ...

title: Virginia's Run
actors: Gabriel Byrne, Joanne Whalley, Lindze Letherman, Kevin Zegers, Rachel Skarsten
description: The life of 14-year-old Virginia Lofton, her sister Caroline and their father Ford is turned upside down by the death of their mother in an equestrian accident. For Virginia, taking care of the foals will be of great comfort in exorcising the pain.
notes: The plot doesn't deviate one iota from the stereotypes of the "family film".

title: La campagnola bella
actors: Femi Benussi, Franca Gonella, Gianni Dei, Filippo Torriero, Carla Calò
description: In a village of central Italy, all the most important exponents, starting with the mayor Cirillo, think of anything except to govern properly. One of the favorite victims of their interests is the prostitute Felicetta, who will soon have the opportunity to take revenge thanks to the beautiful Letizia.

title: Unspeakable
actors: Dennis Hopper, Dina Meyer, Lance Henriksen, Jeff Fahey, Pavan Grover
description: Dr. Diana Purlow conducts experiments on death row inmates in the prison run by the sadist Earl Blakely. Testing a device that can read criminals' minds, Diana subjects serial killer Jesse Mowatt to her experiment, finding herself facing the essence of pure evil.

title: Bloody Mallory
actors: Olivia Bonamy, Adriá Collado, Jeffrey Ribier, Laurent Spielvogel

title: Gangway for Tomorrow
actors: Margo, John Carradine, Robert Ryan, Amelita Ward, William Terry
description: The stories of five workers at an ammunition factory are told in flashbacks: a woman who served in the French Resistance, an injured car driver, a disillusioned "Miss America", an executioner who had to execute her brother, a vagabond who decides to fight for the homeland ...
notes: A dignified and heartfelt civil drama.

title: Dancer, Texas Pop. 81
actors: Breckin Meyer, Peter Facinelli, Eddie Mills, Ethan Embry, Ashley Johnson
description: Fulfilling a mutual promise made long ago, recent graduates Keller Coleman, Terrell Lee Lusk, John Hemphill and Squirrel are preparing to move together to Los Angeles. Their fellow citizens in the remote Texan village of Dancer, however, refuse to see the local population drop from 81 to 77 ...
notes: Newcomer McCanlies (also a screenwriter) builds a nice apology for "small towns", managing to draw a good contribution from a well-assorted cast of young emerging actors: among others, Facinelli (_The Big Kahuna_, the TV series _Six Feet Under_ ) and Meyer (_Rat Race_, _Road Trip_).

title: This Time Around
actors: Carly Pope, Sara Rue, Brian Austin Green, Gina Tognoni, Sherry Miller
description: As little girls, Melissa and Gabby were the classic ugly ducklings, often forced to swallow big boys: like that time, at school, when the first one was humiliated in front of everyone by the handsome Drew, for whom she had a crush. Eleven years later, despite that episode ruined her life, Melissa has become a successful PR. It is her job that gives her the opportunity to meet Drew again, now the owner of a restaurant whose image Melissa must take care of, and take revenge. And to do so, she asks for the help of her trusted friend. Obviously, as everyone has grown up, things will not go as planned ...

title: Baby Monitor: Sound of Fear
actors: Josie Bissett, Jason Beghe, Barbara Tyson, Jeffrey Noah, Lalainia Lindbjerg
description: Carol, Michel's babysitter, has an affair with the baby's father, Matt, a well-known jeweler, with whom she becomes pregnant. One day, overhearing a phone call accidentally, between the two, Matt's wife, Ann, learns of the affair. He will skillfully simulate that nothing has changed, while plotting the elimination of his rival in the shadows. One evening, in fact, Matt and Ann go to a party. Carol, left alone in the house, is attacked by two criminals, paid by Ann to kill her. But the babysitter reacts and eliminates the attackers ...
notes: Production made for TV in all mediocrity, recycling and more trite situations of the family thriller genre.

title: Baywatch - Hawaiian Wedding
actors: David Hasselhoff, Pamela Anderson, Michael Bergin, Yasmine Bleeth
description: Healed from the strong amnesia that had hit him, the result of a tremendous explosion, Mitch returns to Hawaii to take Allison to the altar, who looks like a drop of water to his old flame Stephanie Holden. But the bride-to-be is actually employed by Mason Sato, who wants to take revenge on Mitch ...

title: Cartoni animati
actors: Fiorello, Franco Citti, Elide Melli, Olimpia Carlisi, Guerrino Crivello
description: Salvatore arrives at the Villaggio Felice slum and distributes colored bottles containing potions that make dreams come true. The inhabitants seem happy when a multinational buys the land to build a shopping center and gives everyone an apartment. But a short time later, shouts and insults can be heard from the houses. Salvatore decides to leave and invites everyone to follow him.
notes: It looks like a Ufo, this Cartoons: linked to ideas, images, projects, figures, characters who were already mourned and elegy thirty years ago, so much so that at times they are tired and evasive, even if the film has continuous happy, authentically poetic foundations. . But that a title like this appears to us today as "useless" or anachronistic is certainly not just the fault of the Citti brothers. And its vagrant progress is enough to show it as a free film in the midst of films that are slaves of the market and creative mediocrity, a human film in the midst of zombie films. Fiorello works in a surprising way, Franco Citti carries himself around with the usual rude grace, while a handicap is the interpretation of Elide Melli, rigid and affected.

title: Timeline
actors: Paul Walker, Frances O'Connor, Gerard Butler, Lambert Wilson, Billy Connolly
description: In the Dordogne, some archaeologists are trying to unearth the ruins of a 14th century castle. For Professor Edward Johnston, the head of the project, it is the fulfillment of a lifelong dream: but things fall apart when the students realize that Johnson has been thrown back in time, ending up in the midst of a feudal battle between the French and English ...
notes: The film demonstrates its strength: first of all in the sure hand of the old craftsman Donner; then in the script which - although predictable in some junctions - reveals the usual and reassuring tale with a happy ending that never seems to go out of fashion.

title: The Stepford Wives
actors: Nicole Kidman, Matthew Broderick, Bette Midler, Glenn Close, Christopher Walken
description: Attorney Walter Kresby moves with his wife Joanna to the idyllic village of Stepford. Walter is immediately welcomed into the "circle of men", while Joanna makes friends only with Bobby, who has also recently arrived. Over time, the two realize that all the other women behave in exactly the same way, almost as if they had remained in the 50s.
notes: The film is based on the novel by Ira Levin which inspired _The wives factory_, from 1975 with Katharine Ross and Paula Prentiss. Compared to the prototype of the '70s, the tone of a fantastic comedy prevails. The film starts well, but ends up scratching badly, too busy being distracted by the details (costumes, sets, furnishings) and not realizing that the stage is spinning around in circles.

title: Chakushin ari
actors: Shin'Ichi Tsutsumi, Kou Shibasaki, Kazue Fukiishi, Atsushi Ida, Anna Nagata, Renji Ishibashi, Goro Kishitani
description: Yumi's friends die mysteriously after each of them has received a missed call on their cell phone that carries the date of three days later as a date. When Yumi herself receives the fateful phone call, she tries to find out what lies behind these fatal calls.
notes: Compared to serial films, _The Call - Don't answer_ does not renounce a strong poetic, well present in the melodramatic implications that contrast the love between the protagonists with a pervasive conception of Evil that goes well beyond the pure pretext to create fear.

title: Against the Ropes
actors: Meg Ryan, Omar Epps, Charles S. Dutton, Tony Shalhoub, Timothy Daly
description: Jackie Kellen sees Luther Shaw - a black boy who grew up in the ghetto - fight and realizes he has what it takes to be a champion. She thus becomes his agent and helps him achieve success, a feat not easy for her in the very male chauvinist world of boxing.
notes: The script is textbook, almost predictable, with a heroine who rises, falls and gets up after having learned a great lesson from her mistakes and the direction of Charles S. Dutton, who also carves out the role of coach Felix, does not it has nothing to do with that of Scorsese and his raging Bull. But the news is that there is a Meg Ryan, ex-girlfriend of America thin and all nervous, constantly looking for her new place in the world of cinema, who in the androgynous character of Jackie seems a little more at ease than in that of the protagonist of the presumptuous erotic thriller _In the Cut_.

title: Tale of the Mummy
actors: Jason Scott Lee, Louise Lombard, Sean Pertwee, Christopher Lee, Shelley Duvall
description: Egypt, 1948: Sir Richard Turkel's expedition discovers access to an underground room of a pyramid. An inscription warns them against opening Talos' tomb on pain of death. But Turkel's greedy partner, Parson, violates the grave by awakening the terrible evil force. Fifty years later Sam Turkel, Sir Richard's nephew, returns to the same place with another expedition. Confused, predictable, sometimes reckless in its parastorical ruminations, the film confirms the involution of the overrated Mulcahy, that of Highlander - The Last Immortal. The only heartbeat is given by the appearance of Christopher Lee.

title: Scorched
actors: Alicia Silverstone, Rachael Leigh Cook, Woody Harrelson, John Cleese, Paulo Costanzo
description: Who robbed the Desert Savings Bank? Cashier Stuart, who dreams of gambling for money in Las Vegas; or the clerk Sheila, just ditched by the manager; or the deputy director with an unfinished business with a wealthy client?
notes: Harmless comedy without infamy and without praise, with a discreet cast and a few well-crafted situations.

title: The Wisdom of Crocodiles
actors: Jude Law, Elina Löwensohn, Timothy Spall, Jack Davenport
description: Steven Grlscz, a seductive and mysterious businessman, has a physical need to kill the women he has an affair with. But then he meets one who stands up to him, and for which it is difficult for him to carry out his ferocious and irrepressible desire. Inspector Haeley, who believes he is innocent, and Detective Roche, who is convinced of the contrary, set out on his trail.
notes: The film is about loneliness and pain, the impossibility of love and relationships hovering over the abyss. He does it with a flat and slow style, enveloping and at the same time icy, which does not gag the fury and desire for blood. More than nihilism, melancholy. The Löwensohn is perfect.

title: Rushmore
actors: Jason Schwartzman, Bill Murray, Seymour Cassel, Olivia Williams
description: Very intelligent, hyperactive in the so-called "extracurricular" activities but unable to channel his skills in the traditional school curriculum, the fifteen-year-old Max Fischer risks expulsion from Rushmore Academy, the prestigious private school to which he is enrolled. However, two characters enter his life: the very rich but unhappy Herman Blume and Rosemary Cross, a young widowed teacher whom they both fall in love with ...
notes: Anderson writes (with Owen Wilson, his longtime partner) and stages a story that avoids clichés and easy consolations. Max's precocity anticipates one of the reasons for the following _I Tenenbaum_.

title: Eva nera - Black cobra
actors: Jack Palance, Laura Gemser, Gabriele Tinti, Michele Stark, Ziggy Zanger
description: Judas, a rich Playboy who lives in Hong Kong, is obsessed with snakes: his house is full and treats them as children. One night, his brother convinces him to accompany him to see the performance of a disco dancer and Judas is amazed to see how the beautiful Asian woman Danzi naked with a python in hand. Struck, he decides to take it to look after his snakes while he is away for work. However, things soon take a left crease ...

title: Emanuelle e Françoise - Le sorelline
actors: George Eastman, Rosemarie Lindt, Mary Kristal, Annie Carol Edel
description: For a man's love, a woman knows all the steps of depravity and finally kills herself. To avenge her, the sister of this kidnaps the man by submitting him to torture of all kinds.

title: Emanuelle e gli ultimi cannibali
actors: Laura Gemser, Gabriele Tinti, Susan Scott, Donald O'Brien, Percy Hogan
description: Reporter Emanuelle is interned in a psychiatric institute to get material for his magazine. He witnesses here to the aggression of a nurse by an apparently crazy girl. Emanuelle decides to discover the reasons for the mysterious aggression, so he knows prof. Mark Lester, an anthropologist who shows her various cannibalism movies. The two leave for the Amazon, looking for the last cannibals. There they meet a missionary, Sister Angela, Isabel and a couple in crisis, Donald and Maggie McKenzie: the latter present themselves as hunters, but in reality they are on the trail of a large load of diamonds transported by a plane precipitated in the area.

title: Voodoo Baby
actors: Nieves Navarro, Lucia Ramirez, Richard Harrison, Annj Goren
description: The researcher Paul goes to Santo Domingo with his wife Helen to discover the secrets of an autochthonous sect. While her husband leads her research, Helen gets bored until the day she knows the young man haini and is impressed by his sensuality ...

title: Stranded
actors: Ice T, Michael Dudikoff, Hannes Jaenicke, Paul Michael Robinson
description: The Russian space station Avma, in orbit around the Earth, falls into failure. The Shuttle Atlantis team goes into action to avert the risk of a collision that would cause a huge catastrophe, but the shuttle is hit by a meteor shower and finds itself adrift in the cosmos ...
notes: Yet another "Z movie" of the infamous Ray.

title: Sinnui yauman II
actors: Leslie Cheung, Joey Wong, Michelle Reis, Jacky Cheung, Wu Ma
description: Ning, the protagonist of the first episode, is imprisoned by mistake. However, an old man helps him to escape, giving him a magical medallion that will cause a series of misunderstandings with the group of rebels led by the young Windy ...
notes: Romance, martial arts, dizzying special effects: a sequel to the height of the prototype.

title: Firestarter 2: Rekindled
actors: Marguerite Moreau, Malcolm McDowell, Dennis Hopper, Danny Nucci
description: Using her exceptional psychic powers, young Charlie McGee is able to set fire to with just one glance. A similar ability does not go unnoticed by government agents led by John Rainbird, a psychopath who intends to kidnap the girl and turn her into a lethal weapon of war. Fortunately, the private investigator Vincent - sent by the police to keep an eye on Charlie - realizes the situation and helps her escape from the evil Rainbird, who meanwhile is forming a group of boys with very "special" abilities in the mad attempt to dominate. the world...

title: Around the Fire
actors: Devon Sawa, Bill Smitrovich, Tara Reid, Eric Mabius, Colman Domingo
description: The death of his mother, which took place under unclear circumstances, and the difficult relationship with his father Matt have sharpened Simon's angular character. Sent by Matt to study away from home, Simon befriends Andrew, a neo-hippy peer who will make him savor the charm of life "on the road" ...
notes: Discreet youth drama.

title: First Target
actors: Gregory Harrison, Daryl Hannah, Doug Savant, Brandy Ledford
description: Disappointed at not having received the desired favors from the new president of the United States, some individuals who had supported him during the electoral campaign plan to assassinate him. The beautiful agent Alex McGregor, head of the secret services, will have to do her utmost to foil the plot, assisted by her boyfriend Grant ...

title: American Psycho 2: All American Girl
actors: Mila Kunis, William Shatner, Geraint Wyn Davies, Robin Dunne
description: The encounter with the homicidal maniac Patrick Bateman aroused in the young Rachael Newman a special interest in the psyche of the killers. The girl aspires to a career in the FBI, but will face both bureaucratic and ... lethal obstacles.
notes: Laughable "false sequel": the reference to the Easton Ellis novel is just a pretext.

title: Can't Hardly Wait
actors: Jennifer Love Hewitt, Ethan Embry, Peter Facinelli, Michelle Brookhurst, Lauren Ambrose
description: After high school, new graduates have only one idea in mind: the end of year party. Here Preston hopes to finally hook Amanda, the girl of his dreams, who has just broken up with super-sporty boyfriend Mike: is it the right time? Meanwhile, Kenny, who poses badly as a rapper, hopes to lose his virginity ...
notes: The two directors wanted to resume and update the sentimental-goliardic-student vein of the 80s, using the party as a unit of time, place and action. None of the actors became stars, although Ambrose later worked on the TV series _Six Feet Under_.

title: Japanese Story
actors: Toni Collette, Gotaro Tsunashima, Matthew Dyktynski, Lynette Curran, Yumiko Tanaka
description: While traveling between mines in the Australian outback Sandy, a geologist by profession, has to look after an important Japanese client, Hiromitsu. There is bad blood between the two. Sandy regrets not having found an excuse to refuse the assignment while Hiromitsu cannot understand having a woman as a guide. But when their jeep gets stuck in the Pilbara desert, the two are forced to help each other.
notes: A beautiful film, between drama and melo, respectful of the viewer as well as of its characters, each understandable in pain and, paradoxically but not so much, in incomprehensibility. Magnificent and shining Toni Collette. The music of Elizabeth Drake is evocative. Attention to the dubbing of Hiromitsu, at the risk of trivialization.

title: Wilde Side
actors: Stéphanie Michelini, Yasmine Belmadi, Edouard Nikitine, Josiane Stoléru
description: A love triangle between a Russian boxer who doesn't speak French, a young North African who prostitutes himself in station bars and Sylvie, an independent and self-confident transsexual. The three go to Sylvie's country house, where her mother is dying ...
notes: A work pervaded by a feeling of despair, symbolically expressed by the leaden and wonderful photograph by Agnès Godard. But the most obvious elements of the mélo (the proclamations of the dramas) never explode, as if a sort of inner stillness stemmed the evil and the definitive drift. Lifshitz focuses on the intimacy of the three characters, central to the second part of the film.

title: Sauvage innocence
actors: Mehdi Belhaj Kacem, Julia Faure, Michel Subor, Mathieu Genet, Valérie Kéruzoré
description: After the death of his wife Carole from a heroin overdose, the young director François decides to make a film about drug charges: Lucie, the actress he is in love with, will play it. But no one seems to want to produce the project: the only one to offer him money is Chas, a shady businessman who knew Carole and who in exchange asks him to smuggle two suitcases of heroin ...
notes: Garrel coldly drags us into the heart of a problem that is often forgotten but which belongs to him in depth, which knows how to make - ambiguously and bitterly - art. Finally a reflection on cinema as an "artist" and not as a "merchant".

title: The Order
actors: Heath Ledger, Shannyn Sossamon, Mark Addy, Benno Fürmann, Peter Weller, Rosalinda Celentano
description: Alex, a young priest of the ancient secret Carolingian order, is sent to Rome to investigate the mysterious circumstances in which the head of the congregation died. With the help of two old friends, Father Thomas and Mara Sinclair, a girl he once exorcised, sets out on the trail of the likely culprit ...
notes: The film is too verbose and static, so much so that its authentic belonging to the genre is doubtful. The use of the Roman set is very flat (think of Mario Bava and Dario Argento's Rome ...), the ending is pulled away. Rosalinda Celentano, satanic assistant, repeats the role of _The Passion_. The Catholic Church, then, does not make a great impression on us.

title: Balzac et la petite tailleuse chinoise
actors: Zhou Xun, Chen Kun, Liu Ye, Wang Shuangbao, Cong Zhijun
description: Luo and Ma, two middle-class adolescents, sons of doctors, are sent to a remote mountain village to be "re-educated", or subjected to all kinds of hardships. Here they come into possession of a suitcase full of forbidden Western novels, translated into Chinese and discover the charm of literature. Which they transfer to the most beautiful girl in the village, turning her into a character: the little Chinese seamstress.
notes: Dai Sijie follows the unfolding of the narrative story without shots or cinematic illuminations, with an omnipresent voice off that explains what we already see. There is the fatigue of life in the countryside, there is a magnificent natural background, there is the adventure of friendship and love. There is history and there is a story, there is the world of nature and there is a languid sentimentality, too bad there is little cinema.

title: Agent Cody Banks
actors: Frankie Muniz, Hilary Duff, Angie Harmon, Keith David, Cynthia Stevenson
description: For his family and for the people who know him, Cody Banks is a fifteen-year-old like many: he loves skateboarding, hanging out with friends and girls. But the young man hides a little secret: he was trained by a CIA agent to take part in several missions. Cody must make contact with Natalia, the daughter of a scientist who works for a criminal organization.
notes: Harald Zwart shoots a spy movie parody that targets teen audiences. Given the good public success, in 2004 the sequel (_Agent Cody Banks: Destination London_) produced by Madonna was released.

title: Isola: Tajuu jinkaku shôjo
actors: Yoshino Kimura, Yû Kurosawa, Ken Ishiguro, Makiko Watanabe

title: Science Fiction
actors: David Geclowicz, Koen de Bouw, Wendy van Dijk, Liesbeth Kamerling
description: Little Andreas moves with his parents to a new city. Once he settles in, Andreas manages to convince his classmates that his father and mother are actually not humans, but alien beings who have come down from their planet to study life on Earth ...
notes: Not too original idea for an acceptable film.

title: Point of Origin
actors: Ray Liotta, John Leguizamo, Colm Feore, Illeana Douglas, Ling Bai
description: John Orr is a veteran police investigator in 1980s California with a particular skill in identifying the causes and principles of fires, the so-called "points of origin". His young colleague Keith Lang admires this innate ability to find out whether the flare-ups are due to natural or malicious causes. But when a series of fires erupts across the region, it becomes clear that someone who has a great knowledge of fire is behind this affair. Only an expert could turn them on, and only an expert could turn them off. Could it be the same person? Is John an upright cop or a cunning arsonist?
notes: Yet another Tv movie with Ray Liotta.

title: The Point Men
actors: Christopher Lambert, Kerry Fox, Vincent Regan, Cal Macaninch
description: Tony Eckhardt works for the Mossad, or for the Israeli secret services. Credited with a license to kill, he will find himself using it to thwart the action of a notorious Palestinian terrorist bent on blocking the peace process in the Middle East. The mission proves particularly thorny as his squad members are eliminated one after the other, and Tony will have to deal with the situation exclusively on his own strength.
notes: The Middle Eastern scenario is the starting point - certainly not original - for this effort by Glen, known for having directed five James Bonds during the 1980s.

title: New Best Friend
actors: Mia Kirshner, Meredith Monroe, Dominique Swain, Scott Bairstow

title: A Rumor of Angels
actors: Vanessa Redgrave, Ray Liotta, Catherine McCormack, Trevor Morgan, Ron Livingston, George Coe
description: James Neubauer is still traumatized by his mother's death two years earlier. One day, playing on the beach, he damages the fence of the cottage of Maddy Bennett, an old lady considered crazy. Maddy forces James to repair him and a friendship is born between the two, as the woman teaches the young man how to deal with the pain. However, the boy's family, conditioned by common opinion, does not look favorably on this misunderstanding ...
