notes: Despite the good performance of the entire cast, especially of Vanessa Redgrave, the story is a bit predictable and ends up tiring or, at most, tearing a few tears by force.

title: Jackass: The Movie
actors: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Chris Pontius, Ryan Dunn
description: Collection of performances between demented-scatological humor and pure self-harm. The duration varies from less than a minute to about five minutes, but there is no connection between the fragments, nor any narrative pretext.
notes: Taken from a controversial MTV program, _Jackass_ is almost entirely shot with amateur digital techniques, like a short video for YouTube, where this genre of productions then found fertile ground. The prologue and the epilogue made in film are exceptions. The success in the hall was good, enough to justify _Jackass number two_ in 2006, but it is ultimately a deep emptiness, more disconcerting than amusing.

title: Moglie nuda e siciliana
actors: Cristiana Borghi, Maria Pia Conti, Lucia Como, Mariangela Giordano, Lucio Flauto
description: The Sicilian Rosalia, innocent and naive, goes to Milan where many of her inhibitions fall (men and women think about it). Eventually she finds a husband.

title: Sinnui yauman III: Do Do Do
actors: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Jacky Cheung, Joey Wong, Lau Shun
description: After a prologue from the first episode, the story focuses on a couple of monks, the young Fong and his elderly teacher, traveling through the countryside with an image of Buddha. Their troubles will begin during an overnight stop in a temple inhabited by ghosts ...
notes: The saga goes on, but tension and fun do not diminish.

title: My Dog Skip
actors: Frankie Muniz, Luke Wilson, Diane Lane, Kevin Bacon, Caitlin Wachs
description: Mississippi, summer 1942: for his ninth birthday, among other gifts, little Willie Morris receives a puppy whom he names Skip. Dad Jack is against it, but Mom Ellen's intervention allows the two new friends to reunite. Willie and Skip thus become inseparable, and the presence of the animal accompanies all the most significant moments of the boy's adolescence (including first love). One bad day, however, Willie takes it out on Skip for failing on the baseball field ...
notes: Film that is more "for families". The accompanying cast, rather high-sounding, guarantees the professionalism of the context.

title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
actors: Michael Gross, Shawn Christian, Susan Chuang, Ariana Richards
description: The town of Perfection, Nevada, is once again at the mercy of the hideous carnivorous worms that inhabit the subsoil. This time it's up to Burt Gummer, an expert in survival and all kinds of weapons, to work hard to avert the terrifying threat ...
notes: Number 2 was already too many: imagine this ...

title: Glasskår
actors: Eirik Evjen, Jonas Lauritzsen, Iben M. Akerlie, Ine M. Eide
description: To emulate his older brother O.K., who seems to have no problem attracting the attention of girls, the enterprising 11-year-old Viktor decides to ... go rock. And in the face of the terminal illness that has struck O.K., it will be Viktor who proves to be the bravest of all ...
notes: Acceptable "family drama" from Scandinavia.

title: Wrong Turn
actors: Desmond Harrington, Eliza Dushku, Emmanuelle Chriqui, Jeremy Sisto, Kevin Zegers
description: Chris Flynn is driving his car to an appointment, but as he is late he unfortunately decides to take a shortcut through a wooded area. Here he collides with a car parked on the side of the road. In search of help, the boy goes into the vegetation, not knowing that those areas are infested with monstrous beings and hungry for human flesh.
notes: In this story there is no lack of gender inconsistencies and carelessness. But the pace is fast, the gore conspicuous (at least a couple of notable murders: the one on the tree and the sheriff's) and the pretty dirty fury. The idea of ??the escape between the branches is apt and original.

title: You Got Served
actors: Omarion, Marques Houston, Jennifer Freeman, J-Boog, Lil' Fizz
description: Elgin and David, close friends, are part of a band of street dancers who raise some money with bets. The two do not disdain to be drug couriers for a dealer. David falls in love with Liyah, Elgin's sister, who doesn't let her down, and at the same time he is robbed of drug money, which he must return to the boss. The opportunity to raise the necessary nest egg will be a super-challenge with a group of very strong whites, with fifty thousand dollars at stake.
notes: The plot of the film is pure stereotype. Much is due to the strength of the musical numbers, and to the effectiveness of the night and metropolitan setting.

title: Miracle
actors: Kurt Russell, Patricia Clarkson, Noah Emmerich, Sean McCann, Kenneth Welsh
description: The true story of Herb Brooks, coach of the US hockey team, at the 1980 Lake Placid Winter Olympics. Herb will have to overcome several obstacles: select the best players, mix them together avoiding arguments and unnecessary jealousies, protect them from external pressures to perform the "miracle" ", that is, defeating the unbeatable Soviet national.
notes: Every detail is true, every episode is documented, with a desire for redemption capable of eating all the ice minute by minute. Add to it a rhetoric kept at bay by the director, well-balanced political implications in the background and shots that thrill even non-hockey fans, and here is an average film of nice dignity.

title: Catch That Kid
actors: Kristen Stewart, Corbin Bleu, Max Thieriot, Jennifer Beals, Sam Robards
description: To save her ailing father in need of a costly operation, 12-year-old Maddy intrepid and accomplished climber, with the help of two friends - computer genius Gus and mechanics wizard Austin - hatches a plan to rob one of the world's largest banks. safe in the world, where the mother works. The trio of nasty kids during the coup manages to escape the security men and neutralize the sophisticated alarm systems. Will they be able to carry out the sophisticated robbery?
notes: Decent remake of _Klatretøsen_ Danish film directed by Hans Fabian Wullenweber which had a special mention at the 2002 Berlin Film Festival.

title: Natural City
actors: Yu Ji-tae, Lee Jae-un, Rin Seo, Jeong Eun-pyo, Jung Doo-hong
description: 2080: gigantic metropolises have taken the place of nations and a war is underway between men and machines. Cyborgs - intelligent, endowed with great strength and capable of feeling emotions - increasingly rebel against the fate planned by their builders, which foresees an existence of a few years. Policeman R, in love with cyborg dancer Ria, who is destined to die within three days, is ready to sacrifice everything for her ...
notes: The plot is more than necessary: ??after an initial action scene, there is a dry hour in which nothing happens. Then everything explodes; and apart from a few clashes with tough and very fast ninjas, there is nothing else.

title: Ella Enchanted
actors: Anne Hathaway, Hugh Dancy, Cary Elwes, Vivica A. Fox, Joanna Lumley, Minnie Driver
description: At the birth of Ella, the fairy Lucinda gives her obedience as a gift. But over time, that dowry becomes a kind of curse, because the girl cannot refuse to fulfill what is asked of her and is often at the mercy of unscrupulous individuals. To try to regain control of her life, Ella will have to traverse a realm full of orcs, giants, evil stepsisters and talking books ...
notes: Harmless fairy tale made to measure to enhance the soap and water charm of Hathaway (_Pretty Princess_, but also _The Secrets of Brokeback Mountain_). In the original edition, the narrator is Eric Idle, formerly of Monty Python.

title: House of the Dead
actors: Will Sanderson, Jonathan Cherry, Tyron Leitso, Clint Howard, Ona Grauer, Ellie Cornell, Will Sanderson
description: Three girls and two boys have to go to an island rave party. They forgive the boat that must accompany them. They pay more than a thousand euros to rent another one. But once there, there are walking and hungry corpses waiting for them.
notes: How do you start a film with someone who pays a thousand euros to not miss a rave? It's okay that he's an underwear model, so he should be earning a lot, but anyway. On the other hand, the moralistic equation of all history is evident. A few smashed heads, a few holes, slow motion bullets, demented dialogues and doll-like interpreters. Let's go well.

title: Le sette folgori di Assur
actors: Jackie Laine, Luciano Marin, Howard Duff, Giancarlo Sbragia, Arnoldo Foà
description: After the Assyrians have killed her parents, the beautiful Myrrh is taken to Nineveh, at the court of Sardanapalo. Soon between the girl and Shammash, the king's brother, passion arises: but Sardanapalo, who in turn has his eye on Mirra, intends to play his cards ...
notes: A "sandalone" without particular qualities.

title: Mirror Images II
actors: Shannon Whirry, Luca Bercovici, Tom Reilly, Kristine Kelly
description: The twins Carrie and Terrie were separated as children when their father murdered their mother and was in turn killed by her "bad" daughter. Years later, the marriage of the "good" sister falls apart: the other will take advantage of it to try to ruin her life ...
notes: The tireless Dark churns out yet another useless sexy-thriller.

title: The MatchMaker
actors: Janeane Garofalo, David O'Hara, Milo O'Shea, Jay O. Sanders
description: To ascertain that he has ancestors on the Green Island and thus secure the vote of the Irish community, Senator John McGlory sends his collaborator Marcy to the site. Once in the village of Ballinagra, the girl will have to deal with someone who wants to marry her at all costs ...
notes: Good views and decent verve.

title: The Richest Girl in the World
actors: Miriam Hopkins, Joel McCrea, Fay Wray, Henry Stephenson, Reginald Denny
description: Heiress Dorothy Hunter has had enough of discovering that the men hovering around her are really aiming for nothing but her luck. Therefore, before embarking on a love story with Tony Travers, he proposes an identity swap to secretary Sylvia ...
notes: Written by Norman Krasna, a sharp and brilliant "romantic comedy".

title: A Girl in Every Port
actors: Groucho Marx, William Bendix, Marie Wilson, Don DeFore
description: After buying a racehorse, the sailors Benny and Tim do not take long to understand that it is a crook: but when they realize that the animal has a twin, and moreover much more gifted, they struggle to exploit the situation...
notes: Despite Groucho (now 62) tries hard, the film runs on AC.

title: Ren xiao yao
actors: Zhou Quing Feng, Zhao Tao, Zhao Wei, Wu Qiong
description: Xiao Ji and Bin Bi are inseparable friends and incurable time wasters. Even for them, however, the time of sentimental disturbances arrives: the heart of Xiao Ji beats for the singer Quia Quiao, while the more introverted Bin Bin has an affair with a student. Their paths will have dramatic developments ...
notes: An intense and incisive work.

title: Public Housing
description: "Full immersion" by Wiseman in "project Ida B. Wells", a cluster of buildings located on the outskirts of Chicago. As usual, the great American documentarian penetrates deeply into a complex and difficult social fabric, exploring its different aspects and bringing to the surface the contradictions of America today.

title: Little Heroes 3
actors: Thomas Garner, Brad Sergi, Mike Grief
description: Slick and Carny, a pair of down-and-out criminals, unwittingly wear a microchip that is tempting to many. Especially to Miss Clorine and her helpers, similar to sumo wrestlers, who organize themselves to capture the two unsuspecting "couriers". But Samson and Hercules, the four-legged heroes, come to their aid ...

title: Whatever it Takes
actors: Marla Sokoloff, Shane West, Jodi Lyn O'Keefe, James Franco
description: Chris cannot convince his best friend Maggie that he is deeply in love with her. Devoid of seduction techniques, but rather handsome in appearance, Chris asks his cousin Ryan to help him as a "prompter" of love phrases. Ryan accepts, but then he too falls in love with Maggie.

title: Class Warfare
actors: Lindsey Mckeon, Wade Carpenter, Robin Dunne, Dave McGowan
description: In a remote mountain cabin, Kristen tries to convince her boyfriend to kill their schoolmate Richard in order to get hold of his winning lottery ticket ...
notes: Little American teenagers grow up and ... kill. Shepard's short film dispenses suspense to the minimum wage.

title: Hard Country
actors: Kim Basinger, Jan-Michel Vincent, Michael Parks
description: Kyle loves Jodie, Jodie loves Kyle. He is a cowboy, but also a barfly at night. She would like to get out of that city of losers, he would like to stay. She hates Texas, he loves it ...
notes: Basinger practically a rookie and in the shoes of a free-range Texan: not bad ... It's a pity that the melo doesn't take off, despite suggestive backgrounds.

title: Crime Spree
actors: Richard Bohringer, Gérard Depardieu, Harvey Keitel, Johnny Hallyday, Said Taghmaoui
description: A gang of French thieves fly to Chicago for a robbery. By a tactical mistake, they enter the wrong house and steal a top secret cassette from none other than the local mafia boss. Within hours, as they try hard to return to Paris, they will have the FBI, the mafia and an incredible number of thugs at their heels ...
notes: Apart from the most obvious things, however, the beauty of _ Crime Spree - Escape from Chicago_ is its ability to make fun of the cinematic stereotypes of both, the polar and the gangster movies, the French comedy and the "pulp ".

title: The Fighting Temptations
actors: Cuba Gooding jr., Beyoncé Knowles, LaTanya Washington, Wendell Pierce
description: Darrin, a successful New York advertiser, returns to his hometown to collect the inheritance his old aunt left him. However, he discovers that to get hold of the large sum of money he must first realize the dream of the deceased: to win the Gospel Explosion contest that is held every year. To make this possible, Darrin tries to start a gospel choir. When he meets Lilly, a glamorous jazz singer, he thinks he's finally made things right. Unfortunately, he has to contend with his hostility to the project.
notes: Jonathan Lynn directs this funny comedy making the most of Beyoncé Knowles (_Destiny's Child_) singing skills.

title: Uptown Girls
actors: Carmen Electra , Brittany Murphy, Dakota Fanning, Heather Locklear, Jesse Spencer, Donald Faison, Marley Shelton
description: Molly Gunn, the daughter of a rock legend, is forced to find a job when her father's manager seizes her inheritance. She then becomes Ray's nanny, a very precocious eight-year-old girl, the ignored daughter of a record company. The adventures of the two girls begin and find themselves having to solve several problems.
notes: If the starting character is vaguely screwball (the billionaire Hepburns with leopards on a leash), with a few winks at the events of rock and atmospheres like _Sex and che City_, it is however an abortive attempt.

title: Open Water
actors: Blanchard Ryan, Daniel Travis, Saul Stein, Estelle Lau, Michael E. Williamson
description: Daniel and Susan are on vacation on an island. One day they board a crowded boat to take part in a diving excursion. But, due to a distracted crew, after spending forty minutes underwater, they resurface and realize they are alone in shark-infested waters.
notes: The film works on the mechanisms of the unconscious in an almost perfect way, throwing the viewer into a vortex of anguish that becomes almost unbearable. The sharks - almost invisible - that roam in the dark sea of ??the Bahamas and that threaten the couple of divers forgotten in the open sea during an excursion, embody the metaphor of what is happening in the world today, with terrorism moving around us but without being allowed to know when and where it will strike. Here, the intrinsic strength of the film lies in unleashing this blind terror. But that aesthetics? That does not exist, the film does not exist from a narrative point of view and the whole prologue, will also be for the use of digital, it seems a useless tinsel as well as the dialogues between the castaways who are sometimes even comedians and that distance us from the true purpose of the film: to measure our fear.

title: Dickie Roberts: Former Child Star
actors: David Spade, Craig Bierko, Jenna Boyd, Alyssa Milano, Jon Lovitz, Mary McCormack
description: Dickie Roberts, a former child prodigy in the 1970s, a sitcom star and idolized by millions of viewers, is now 35 and has been reduced to working as a valet. He decides to take back the reins of his film career and audition for a film to be shot by Rob Reiner. Willing to do anything to win the part, he rents a typical American family to help him build a normal childhood ...
notes: Weisman's film tells the story of a TV star who, after leaving the star system at the age of six, decides to return. There are many extras of television actors, including Gary Coleman (star of the legendary series My Friend Arnold).

title: Jersey Girl
actors: Ben Affleck, Jennifer Lopez, Liv Tyler, Matt McFarland, Sarah Stafford, Paul Litowsky
description: Ollie is a successful New York advertiser with a beautiful wife and son on the way. Suddenly, however, he finds himself unemployed and a single father, and is forced to return to live with his parent. Things seem to settle down when he meets Maya, a beautiful single mother who teaches him to appreciate life changes ...
notes: Dull, bungled and with unsuitable actors, the film is very predictable and burns some possible eccentricities of the script. Luckily, Tom Waits' eponymous song (performed by Springsteen) only passes on the credits: it would have been a pain to hear it accompany this stuff!

title: Madhouse
actors: Joshua Leonard, Jordan Ladd, Lance Henriksen, Leslie Jordan, Natasha Lyonne
description: A young psychiatrist hides secrets about the mental health faculty where he works.

title: Grandi cacciatori
actors: Klaus Kinski, Harvey Keitel, Debora Caprioglio, Yorgo Voyagis, Iris Peynado
description: A young biologist is found brutally murdered in a rugged Arctic area. A colleague of his suspects that the killers are the poachers of the area, dedicated to the extermination of seals: for this he asks for help from a former hunter who knows those territories well ...
notes: This adventure film by Caminito, not surprisingly considered cult by fans, is so rare that it doesn't even appear on the almost all-encompassing Internet Movie Database. Considering the international cast involved, this is even more surprising. The film also stands out as Debora Caprioglio's debut on the big screen.

title: G.I. Blues
actors: Elvis Presley, James Douglas, Juliet Prowse
description: The American soldier Tulsa bets with his fellow soldiers to be able to seduce the star of the Café Europa, Lilli. He tries hard, but the ending will be a surprise.
notes: First film for the King, financed by the army to which it did not seem true to have such an illustrious "testimonial". The song _G.I. Blues_, an Elvis classic, remains the best.

title: Gli uomini dal passo pesante
actors: Joseph Cotten, Franco Nero, Ilaria Occhini, Gordon Scott
description: Not wanting to surrender to the winning Northerners, a rich Texan farmer decides to boycott the Yankees in his territory by any means. One of the sons, however, convinced anti-slavery, firmly opposes him. The father's anger is unleashed.
notes: Abnormal and rare Italian western from a director known for a couple of soft cores.

title: Win a Date with Tad Hamilton!
actors: Kate Bosworth, Topher Grace, Josh Duhamel, Ginnifer Goodwin, Nathan Lane, Sean Hayes
description: Rosalee Futch, a girl from Virginia, makes her wish come true: she wins the competition to spend an evening in the company of Tad Hamilton, her favorite actor. The appointment, designed to re-evaluate the image of the star, is fine, so much so that Tad moves to the city of Rosalee to continue attending it. But Pete, Rosalee's colleague and secretly in love with her, will do anything to put a spoke in his wheel ...
notes: A second choice DreamWorks product, Luketic's film - specialist in comedy for teen-agers - lives by postponing the wait for the moment when the "unpredictable" triumph of the current underdog will occur.

title: Eurotrip
actors: Scott Mechlowicz, Jessica Boehrs, Jacob Pitts, Michelle Trachtenberg, Travis Wester, Lucy Lawless, Vinnie Jones
description: When the American Scott discovers that the German friend he has been chatting with for some time is a girl, he decides to leave for Europe with three friends to meet her. During the journey, the four run into a series of misadventures.
notes: What was once the Grand Tour for the good offspring of old Europe, today is a sort of rite of passage for young American graduates, but if those of _Eurotrip_ reflect them, the future of the world is certainly in bad hands. Ridiculous gags and a sea of ??insipid madness in the journey of the four in search of a Grail that has the grace of Jessica Boehrs, singer of the techno group "Novaspace".

title: Club Dread
actors: Bill Paxton, Elena Lyons, Dan Montgomery Jr., Tanja Reichert, Nat Faxon, Michael Weaver
description: The tranquility of Paradise Island, a tropical resort owned by Coconut Pete, a former rock star of the '70s, is disturbed by the arrival of a serial killer who is claiming victims everywhere with a machete. The local staff tries to unmask the executioner in an attempt to restore peace to the place. Meanwhile an old legend emerges ...
notes: Although the plot may make us think of a horror, we are faced with a comedy that jokes the stereotypes of the slasher trend. Behind this disappointing operation there is the hand of the comic group of Broken Lizard, namely: Jay Chandrasekhar, Steve Lemme, Kevin Heffernan, Paul Soter, Erik Stolhanske.

title: Tube
actors: Kim Seok-hun, Park Sang-min, Bae Du-na, Kwon Oh-jung, Park Joong-hoon
description: Some terrorists take citizens hostage inside the subway. A group of brave policemen are trying to catch them and save the people.
notes: Woon-hak Baek's film is anything but representative of the goodness of a cinematography and, indeed, of a genre. Let it be a copy of _Speed_, with a sprinkle of - remember? - _30 seconds left_, that's not a problem. Unfortunately _Tube_ is to the Korean action thriller as much as any Albert Pyun is to its American counterpart. He also looks, but he is without inspiration, not very loose and often pulled away.

title: Ong-bak
actors: Phanom Yeerum, Tony Jaa, Pumwaree Yodkamol, Suchao Pongwilai
description: Ting, an expert in Muay Thai, a martial art that uses the so-called "nine weapons of the body", leads an expedition that must recover the head of Buddha Ong-bak. This precious object was stolen from a village temple in the Thai countryside to be donated to a criminal boss ...
notes: Pinkaew's short film exists only in function of the perfection in the fight and the real acrobatics of the actor Phanom Yeerum (aka Tony Jaa). In any case, beyond the hand-to-hand clashes (however tough), the two sequences of the race between the stalls and the motorized "bees" through the streets of the city amused.

title: Walking Tall
actors: Dwayne Johnson, Johnny Knoxville, Neal McDonough, Kristen Wilson, Ashley Scott
description: After retiring from the Army Special Forces, Chris Vaughn decides to return to the small town he came from to start a new life. When he arrives, however, he realizes that things have gotten considerably worse: drugs, corruption and crime are rampant. At the head of these shady trades is an old acquaintance of Chris: his former schoolmate and rival Jay Hamilton ...
notes: In the midst of a "pre-emptive war" climate, the United States finds a new hero: The Rock, a former wrestler who aspires to take Schwarzenegger's place in the muscular imagination. The film is vulgar and obvious, but at home it was a success.

title: The Chronicles of Riddick
actors: Vin Diesel, Colm Feore, Thandie Newton, Judi Dench, Karl Urban
description: After five years of losing track of him to escape the mercenaries who seek him, Riddick finds himself on the planet Helion. Here he ends up in the midst of a confrontation between two fierce rival gangs fighting for power.
notes: Unfortunately "The Chronicles of Riddick" is half a disappointment. Much less nastiness overall and much less marked Diesel's character as the king of drop-outs. Instead the film wastes time between exaggerated aesthetic baroque (a new style is born: the "necrobaroque") and a slender and well-known story, which however tries to mask the paucity of the roast with a lot of smoke. Hence the need to accumulate various subtexts to the main plot (such as that of the prison) or useless characters (the evanescent creature played by Judi Dench).

title: Serva e padrona
actors: Rossella Dassu, Sabrina Venezia, Eugenia Capizzano, Véronique Bouteille
description: A mistress and two servants live in a house: each of them plays the part that suits her best, with (or against) the others.
notes: The Turin filmmaker - who shoots digitally - confronts the female universe again: this time in terms of opposition between classes, explicitly inspired by Jean Genet's _Les bonnes_.

title: Nan va koutcheh/Zang-e tafrih/Dow rahehal baraye yek massaleh/Hamsarayan
description: After his debut in advertising, in 1969 Kiarostami was commissioned to create the film section of the "Center for the intellectual development of children and young people" in Tehran. The "Out of Hours" evening features four short films shot for the Institute over the course of a dozen years. _Pane e vicolo_ (1970): on the street, a child finds a dog barring his way; _Recreation_ (1972): a pupil is removed from the class; _Two solutions to a problem_ (1975): the quarrel between two kids; _Il coro_ (1982): an elderly person uses his earphone to connect and disconnect from the surrounding environment.

title: Most Xtreme Primate
actors: Robby Benson, Devin Douglas Drewitz, Trevor Wright, Ian Bagg, Gwynyth Walsh
description: After spending a busy year playing hockey with the Seattle Simians team and learning to skateboard, the chimpanzee Jack is passionate about snowboarding. And "fluttering" on the snow will save two brothers who, left alone in the house, are threatened by a couple of dangerous criminals ...

title: Inugami
actors: Yuki Amami, Atsuro Watabe, Eugene Harada, Shiho Fujimura

title: Villmark
actors: Bjørn Floberg, Kristoffer Joner, Eva Röse, Sampda Sharma, Marko Iversen Kanic
description: A TV crew, under Gunnar's control, is about to start production of a reality show in which attendees will have to survive in the desert. After reuniting friends Per and Lasse, a Swedish girl named Elin and Sara, Gunnar decides to test the team by taking them to a cottage in the woods where he used to spend his childhood. Soon, they will find themselves experiencing strange incidents that will help create a climate of paranoia, accusations and distrust.

title: Hoodlum
actors: Laurence Fishburne, Tim Roth, Vanessa Williams, Andy Garcia
description: Harlem gangster Bumpy Johnson joins the criminal war unleashed by Jewish mafia boss Dutch Schultz, who wants to bypass Lucky Luciano to take control of gambling. Who, for convenience, allies himself with the Sicilian.
notes: Underrated gangster movie directed by a talented filmmaker-actor (Bill Duke, so to speak, is the giant black who frames Richard Gere in _American Gigolo_). Disagreements between the director and the production led to a partial editing of the filmed material, and the lack of the final cut. Despite everything, however, the film is enjoyable and original.

title: Otogiriso
actors: Megumi Okina, Yoichiro Saito, Koji Ookura, Reiko Matsuo

title: Interstate 60
actors: James Mardsen, Amy Smart, Gary Oldman, Michael J. Fox, Christopher Lloyd
description: Neil is a painter hampered by his father who would like to see him graduate in law at Oxford. The situation changes suddenly when he meets One Wish Grant, a person able to grant every wish. For the boy begins an adventure on the road that will lead him to take Interstate 60 with his red BMW, a road that, in reality, does not exist. As he walks along the highway, Neil will make a lot of encounters. Will he be able to meet the girl who appears to him every night and who inspires his canvases?
notes: Bob Gale, producer of the entire _Back to the Future_ series, directs a funny fantasy comedy and is bringing in Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd for the occasion.

title: Who Is Cletis Tout?
actors: Christian Slater, Tim Allen, Portia De Rossi, Richard Dreyfuss, Billy Connolly, Peter MacNeill, Bill MacDonald, Richard Chevolleau, Elias Zarou, RuPaul
description: Trevor Finch (Christian Slater), a long-standing forger and con man, discovers he is in the sights of Critical Jim (Tim Allen) killer. The cause of this death wish is linked to an identity exchange: Trevor has in fact taken the name of Cletis Tout, a long-dead criminal. Having escaped from prison with his partner Micah (Richard Dreyfuss), a jewelry thief who had stolen diamonds twenty years earlier with the help of his daughter Tess (Portia de Rossi), Finch must find a way to escape the shots of the killer.

title: The Piano Player
country: Great Britain, United States, Germany, Spain
actors: Christopher Lambert, Dennis Hopper, James Faulkner, Diane Kruger
description: Rich and greedy South African underworld lawyer Robert Nile desperately needs to have a bodyguard at his side who can protect him from Christo, a powerful local gangster, as well as his client for many years, who wants to kill him to stop him from testifying against. of him in an upcoming trial. Nile hires Alex Laney, a former German robber expert in solving thorny problems on behalf of wealthy and select clients, who follows his protégé on a getaway in the middle of Africa's wildest heart. But unexpectedly, Laney's childhood trauma resurfaces ...
notes: Discreet action movie with the odd couple Dennis Hopper / Christopher Lambert.

title: Model
description: Stylists, models, agencies, contracts, advertisements, TV commercials, covers, photo shoots: even in a context apparently in contrast with the social themes favored by the great American documentary maker, Wiseman's "analytical" gaze finds the opportunity to express itself with the usual rigor.

title: The Phantom of Crestwood
actors: H. B. Warner, Ricardo Cortez, Karen Morley, Gavin Gordon
description: Pushed by the beautiful Jenny Wren, banker Priam Andes throws a party at Crestwood, his summer residence. The girl asks Priam to also invite three wealthy men whom she intends to pluck, but her plans will be unexpectedly upset by an inexplicable death ...
notes: Discreet suspense and pleasant "gothic" atmosphere.

title: Ecco lingua d'argento
actors: Carmen Villani, Nadia Cassini, Roberto Cenci, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Huberta Shaw, Enzo Andronico, Ali Zaiem, Roberto Pace
description: On the Mediterranean shores of Africa, Billy is in love with the beautiful Andrea and tries to seduce her. Among them is Bobby, Andrea's other suitor, and Dr. Censi who will try to cure Billy of his irrepressible sexual desire.
notes: Frayed comedy of sexual misunderstandings.

title: Sideshow
actors: Jamie Martz, Michael Amos, Scott Clark, Jessica Keenan, Phil Fondacaro

title: The Florentine
actors: Michael Madsen, Virginia Madsen, Tom Sizemore, Luke Perry, James Belushi
description: In a small town in Pennsylvania, everyone makes a trip to the Florentine Café, one of the places that, although in decline, is a real meeting point. Here the bitter stories of disappointed men and women intertwine, aware that they have played their cards with destiny.
notes: All in all, an acceptable film.

title: Carosello del varietà
actors: Aldo Quinti, Odoardo Spadaro, Josephine Baker, Aldo Fabrizi, Gino Latilla
description: A painter gives his daughter, who is about to turn eighteen, a television set. At the birthday party, the father invites Odoardo Spadaro (who plays himself), who sees a variety show with them. The show consists of excerpts from magazines, musical numbers and excerpts from films. On the small screen there are well-known artists of the variety, magazine and cinema: from Ettore Petrolini to Totò, from Josephine Baker to Wanda Osiris, from Erminio Macario to Renato Rascel, from the _Quartetto Cetra_ to Natalino Otto.
notes: Sort of encyclopedia of the entertainment world that had little circulation due to rights problems.

title: L'ultimo gladiatore
actors: Richard Harrison, Lisa Gastoni, Marilù Tolo, Livio Lorenzon
description: Naor, a slave with superhuman strength, is made to fight as a gladiator. The strongman rebels against Messalina who decides to have him killed. Emperor Claudius, her husband, will save him by ordering the arrest of the woman who plotted to overthrow Caligula.
notes: A minor peplum signed by Umberto Lenzi.

title: Cannibal Women in the Avocado Jungle of Death
actors: Shannon Tweed, Bill Maher, Karen Mistral, Adrienne Barbeau
description: A government agency hires a professor, a well-known militant of feminist movements, to track down the "piranha women" who live in the Avocado jungle. To succeed in the enterprise, however, the explorer is forced to rely on a guide, a chauvinist tomboy, with whom she immediately comes into conflict.
notes: The original title ("Cannibal women in the jungle of the death of Avocado") is brilliant and the atmosphere of a light-hearted protofeminist B-movie is amusing. Not surprisingly, the director will write a script a few years later that will make him rich and famous: _Pretty Woman_. Adrienne Barbeau was John Carpenter's wife at the time.

title: Creepozoids
actors: Linnea Quigley, Ken Abraham, Michael Aranda, Richard L. Hawkins

title: Zarkorr! The Invader
actors: Rhys Pugh, Mark Hamilton, Eileen Wesson, Ron Barnes, R. Allan Bexton

title: La vedova inconsolabile ringrazia quanti la consolarono
actors: Edwige Fenech, Carlo Giuffrè, Didi Perego, Guido Leontini, Pino Ferrara
description: After the death of her very rich husband Salvatore, the beautiful Caterina is preparing to collect a fabulous inheritance. But there is a problem: since the deceased has not made a will, the wife will be able to benefit from the bequest only if, within the three hundred days established by law, she gives birth to a child. Knowing this, Tano and Rico - Salvatore's brothers, who would pocket the billions if Caterina did not fulfill this condition - organize an armed guard at the villa where the widow lives with her mother Teresa, blocking the way to any male individual. . But the unexpected puts a hand in it ...
notes: Unspeakable farsaccia.

title: Tangled
actors: Lorraine Bracco, Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Estella Warren, Rachael Leigh Cook, Shawn Hatosy
description: A young man is found wounded and beaten up on an isolated street. As the police try to reconstruct what happened to them, the twisted relationship created between a young woman and her two suitors emerges.

title: Love's Brother
actors: Giovanni Ribisi, Adam Garcia, Amelia Warner, Silvia De Santis
description: Australia, 1950s: the willing Italian brothers Angelo and Gino moved to the antipodes to escape the misery that beset them at home. Angelo, whose insecure character has so far prevented him from finding a girlfriend, has for some time begun an intense correspondence with the beautiful Rosetta, who lives in a town in southern Italy. The day of the fateful meeting is imminent: Rosetta is unaware, however, that her future husband, instead of sending her his photo, has sent her Gino's. And when the love at first sight between the latter and the girl, the matter becomes damn intricate ...
notes: Nothing fancy, but pleasant.

title: Rocco
actors: Niccolò Centioni, Federica Citarella, Antonello Fassari, Barbara D'Urso
description: Little Rocco lives with his father Ottavio (who works in a pasta factory), his mother Lucia and his older sister Chiara. Lively and jaunty, he will find himself - together with his friends Leo, Luca and Madda - to face an unexpected and extraordinary adventure, in which the very young gang will even be able to lend a hand to the "grown-ups".

title: Envy
actors: Christopher Walken, Ben Stiller, Jack Black, Rachel Weisz, Amy Poehler
description: Tim and Nick are great friends. But things change when Nick gets rich thanks to the creation of a particular spray ...
notes: When Nick's wife shows up as a Senate candidate, people ask her: where is the shit going? Yes, where does it end? ... Successful metaphor of today's politics.

title: My Baby's Daddy
actors: Eddie Griffin Anthony Anderson, Michael Imperioli, Paula Jai Parker, Joanna Bacalso
description: Lifelong friends Lonnie, Dominic and "G" are forced to shoulder their responsibilities when their respective girlfriends get pregnant at the same time. For the three new dads, a phase of their life begins in which they will learn a lot about themselves.
notes: The film lets itself be watched, with a couple of sequences that even elicit some laughs (the parody of _Rocky_, the severe Chinese father-in-law of one of ours who reveals himself to be a former thug). Even if the ending is one of generalized despair, since in the United States if you can't become someone, you are nobody. Moral difficult to digest, always and in any case.

title: New York Minute
actors: Mary-Kate Olsen, Ashley Olsen, Andy Richter, Jared Padalecki, Riley Smith, Andrea Martin, Eugene Levy
description: Jane and Roxy Ryan, twins who can't stand each other, travel together from Long Island to New York where Jane must deliver a speech to be admitted to Oxford University. Meanwhile, the sister takes the opportunity to participate in the backstage of a music video. But the trip to the Big Apple becomes complicated when the two are involved in a series of situations that are not very clear. To get out of it, they decide to join forces ...
notes: Americans, as we know, have now lost any degree of dignity and depth and therefore are not ashamed to bring this incredible pair of sisters to success, capable of billing a thousand million dollars every year. American, Canadian, Mexican and Japanese children seem to be unable to do without them. We hope, here in Italy, to lead by example.

title: Laws of Attraction
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Julianne Moore, Parker Posey, Michael Sheen, Frances Fisher
description: Daniel Rafferty and Audrey Woods, famous divorce lawyers from New York, find themselves against each other in the divorce of two well-known personalities, a rock star and his wife, who compete for an Irish castle. For work reasons they are therefore forced to spend a few days in Ireland. What better opportunity to get to know each other better?
notes: Unfortunately, the film lacks inventiveness, the story is stretched and, short of gags, we take refuge in some vulgar double meaning. He giggles only with the divorced couple (he is a rock star and she is a stylist), and in the end Brosnan, who jokes about his superman air, is the nicest.

title: Palabras encadenadas
actors: Dario Grandinetti, Goya Toledo, Fernando Guillen, Eric Bonicatto
description: Laura, a young psychiatrist, is held captive by Ramon. In the basement where she is tied to a chair, Laura looks in horror at a video where the man confesses to being a serial killer. The only hope of salvation for her seems to be Ramon's favorite game, "the chained words": if she wins she will be free ...
notes: A man gags and ties a psychoanalyst to a chair in his apartment, forcing her to watch a video in which he confesses heinous deeds. What does the maniac want? And is she really a victim? And what is the use of the pun, a kind of verbal puzzle week, to which the man forces the woman with the promise of freeing her in case of victory? Unfortunately these are questions that make the figure of the riddles of the yellow TV at lunchtime. And the tension of the situation gradually fades in a succession of boring revelations.

title: Starsky & Hutch
actors: Carmen Electra , Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson, Snoop Dogg, Vince Vaughn, Juliette Lewis, Amy Smart, Chris Penn
description: The strange pair of agents formed by the precise David Starsky and the relaxed Ken "Hutch" Hutchinson on their first day of work together must investigate a murder case: a body has surfaced on the coast of Bay City. With the help of Huggy Bear, their informant and two pom pom girls, the two agents set out on the trail of a wealthy businessman suspected of being the perpetrator of the murder.
notes: In reading, in filigree, one of the most popular and followed TV series of the 70s, the director, counting on the complicity of set and life of Ben Stiller and Owen Wilson, plays with the show as a modern collector would do.

title: Mean Girls
actors: Lindsay Lohan, Rachel McAdams, Tim Meadows, Amy Poehler, Ana Gasteyer, Tina Fey, Lacey Chabert, Amanda Seyfried, Lizzy Caplan, Daniel Franzese, Jonathan Bennett
description: Fifteen-year-old Cady Heron, raised in Africa by zoological parents, thinks she can cope in any situation. But when she returns to America to attend high school, she is faced with a much more difficult world of the jungle, dominated by Plastic - aka Regina, Gretchen and Karen, the three prettiest girls in school - who make her life impossible. ..
notes: This comedy about female rivalry and some manias of very young girls has a certain sociological truth and a remarkable freshness in the workmanship and in the dialogues. Lindsay Lohan reunites with Mark Waters, who had already directed her in _That crazy Friday_.

title: Catwoman
actors: Halle Berry, Benjamin Bratt, Sharon Stone, Lambert Wilson, Frances Conroy
description: Patience Prince, shy and sensitive artist, works as a designer in a cosmetic products company. One day, by chance, she discovers a terrible secret regarding a new anti-aging product that is about to be released on the market and should therefore be eliminated. He manages to save himself thanks to the qualities that distinguish his second nature as a cat ...
notes: The film will be remembered for the fetish onesie and the sadomasochistic whip of the Berry, for the clashes and the "blows" between the Stone and the woman cat. It will be forgotten as a mediocre attempt to draw a pop-feline-feminist icon.

title: Fallout
actors: Teri Ann Linn, Frank Zagarino, Daniel Baldwin, Hannes Jaenicke, Scott Valentine, John Reilly
description: To repair the computer on board of a Russian-American spacecraft orbiting the Earth, computer experts Amanda McCord and Previ Fedorov are boarded on a shuttle: along the way, however, Fedorov turns out to be a dangerous terrorist ...
notes: Anachronistic cold war tones for a poorly directed and worse acted short film.

title: Los salvajes
actors: Pedro Armendariz, Anita Blanch, Carlos Baena, María Esquivel
description: Pedro, a wealthy landowner, convinced that he can get whatever he wants with arrogance, marries Yaira. The woman does not forgive her husband for his brutality and so falls into the arms of her brother-in-law. But an unknown shot kills Pedro and ...
notes: Turbid story directed in a rather conventional way.

title: Crash! Che botte... Strippo strappo stroppio
actors: Jacques Dufilho, Robert Malcolm, Antonio Cantafora, Lo Lieh, Sal Borgese, Shih Szu, Isabella Biagini
description: Federal agent Wallace must end drug trafficking - orchestrated by the gang headed by Chen Loh - which takes place between Hong Kong and Bangkok. Kung fu expert Tang, Chinese secret agent Suzy and the two thieves Max and Jerry rush to his aid. It will be hard to be right about Chen Loh.
notes: Pure trash.

title: The Chaplin Revue
actors: Charles Chaplin, Edna Purviance, Syd Chaplin, Henry Bergman
description: An anthology of three famous short films by Charlot: _Life as a dog_ (1918), _Charlot soldier_ (1918) and _Il Pellegrino_ (1923). Chaplin himself signs the original musical commentary and the linking interventions. Interesting retrospective observations on _Charlot soldier_, which according to the author is set in the "pre-atomic" era.

title: The Princess and the Marine
actors: Mark Paul Gosselaar, Marisol Nichols, Keith Robinson, Dave Power
description: Sent on duty in Bahrain, the young marine Jason Johnson meets the beautiful Meriam and falls in love with her: what he ignores is that the girl is none other than a princess, a direct descendant of the ruling family. In contravention of the latter's ancient and strict rules, Meriam rejects the official suitor designated by her father, knowing that the difference in religious faith between her and Jason constitutes an almost insurmountable obstacle to their union. The two therefore only have to take refuge in the United States, where they will be able to marry freely, in spite of the serious risks that such a decision entails ...

title: The Glow
actors: Dean Cain, Portia De Rossi, Hal Linden, Dina Merrill, Joseph Campanella
description: Matt and Jackie, a recently married couple, live in an apartment in New York. What seems strange is that the rent is very low, considering that the house is located in a very elegant area of ??the city. But the surprises for the two are not over; in fact they learn that the couple who lived there before them have disappeared into thin air.

title: Dogtown and Z-Boys
description: The documentary tells the skateboarding revolution, which took place in Dogtown, a run-down neighborhood between Santa Monica and Venice. It all started in the surf shop run by Jeff Ho, Skip Engblom and Craig Stecyk. That's where the Zephyr Skating Team was formed and the Z-Boys were born. Their style attracted the attention of the mass media and sports circles.
notes: The film is a snapshot of an era whose tireless liveliness has melted over time in the sunlight. The same protagonists, both on the tracks for the four wheels, and on the watery masses of the ocean, (they) show themselves, (they) tell: and the direction of Stacy Peralta (a former Z-Boy) looks at them with evident participation.

title: Janghwa, Hongryeon
actors: Lim Su-jeong, Moon Geun-young, Kim Kap-su, Yum Jung-ah
description: Two sisters return home after spending some time in a mental institution where they have been hospitalized following their mother's suicide. They find their father and cruel stepmother waiting for them. In addition to having to cope with the woman's obsessions, the two sisters also have to contend with a ghost ...
notes: Sure, when compared to Phone, Two Sisters makes a splendid figure. But elegance alone is not enough. It turns out that the film is even boring, repeating itself. Memories, the episode that is part of the movie Three directed by Kim Ji-woon himself, gave more chills. But that lasted about forty minutes, while this lasted a hundred and fifteen.

title: The Prince & Me
actors: Alberta Watson, Julia Stiles, Luke Mably, Ben Miller, Miranda Richardson, James Fox
description: Paige Morgan studies medicine and then travels the world to help those in need. When she falls in love, reciprocated, with Edward, a Danish student, everything seems to be in question since the boy is the crown prince: Paige will have to choose whether to become a doctor or the queen of Denmark.
notes: The contrast between Yankee spontaneity and the rigid form of hierarchical Europe apparently still exists and not just in the minds of four screenwriters. The specific outcome of this latest variation is insignificant, and the obstinacy with which one wants to make Julia Stiles a diva is astounding.

title: The Terminal
actors: Tom Hanks, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Stanley Tucci, Diego Luna, Zoë Saldana, Kumar Pallana, Chi McBride
description: Viktor Navorski, from Eastern Europe, finds himself blocked at the JFK airport in New York because his country of origin has been canceled due to a coup. This means that the man's passport and documents are no longer valid. With nowhere to return to, Viktor settles down in the airport terminal, becoming friends with the people who work there and falling in love with a hostess, Amelia Warren.
notes: The film is a bet, between airport staff and homeless passenger Viktor Navorski, on his chances of survival inside the international terminal and Gate 67, and between Spielberg and the spectators, on his ability to keep us hooked in that enclosed space and that tiny event for 128 minutes. They both win it, the two lonely dreamers.

title: Mar adentro
actors: Javier Bardem, Belén Rueda, Lola Dueñas, Mabel Rivera, Celso Bugallo, Clara Segura
description: The true story of Ramón Sampedro, a Spanish quadriplegic, who for years fought for the right to euthanasia. To support him on opposite positions are two women, Julia and Rosa, who find themselves dealing with the principles that up to that moment have governed their lives ...
notes: As if he had put himself inside the head and heart of the protagonist (immobile, necessarily on the defensive, protected by self-irony), Amenábar cools the emotionality (which could have been explosive), aided in this by Javier Bardem's millimetric acting. But at the same time he can't resist the sinuous mobility of the camera, the openings that Ramón's unrealizable dreams and desires allow him: in the most beautiful moment of the film, that of the accident told to a friend, his whole life passes before him to the eyes, punctuated by the rapid succession of photographs of the faces, places, and loved girls. And it is the evocative vitality of Amenábar's gaze that basically makes us understand why Ramón wants to die: because there is no music, voice, affection that holds up against the impossibility of being - and recognizing - oneself.

title: L'amore ritrovato
actors: Stefano Accorsi, Maya Sansa, Marco Messeri, Luisanna Pandolfi, Vania Rotondi
description: Mario, a banker by profession and married for some time, met Giovanna during a train journey in the years preceding the outbreak of the Second World War. The girl, of humble origins, lives in Livorno where she works as a manicure and is pointed out by the locals as an "easy" girl. A strong passion was born between the two that between quarrels and reconciliations continued until 1945.
notes: Mazzacurati says that he let himself be guided by "a desire for authenticity". However, on the screen, more than authenticity you hear the reconstruction (also in Luca Bigazzi's photography), more than the daily whispering you listen to a dull talk, more than a relationship that could have been a love one follows an inconsistent relationship. Stefano Accorsi and Maya Sansa do not seem convinced and convincing neither as wild lovers (on an uncomfortable pile of wood!), Nor as exponents of a humble secluded humanity.

title: Collateral
actors: Tom Cruise, Jamie Foxx, Jada Pinkett Smith, Mark Ruffalo, Peter Berg, Irma P. Hall
description: Over the course of a night, Los Angeles taxi driver Max finds himself hostage to Vincent, a professional killer who must eliminate a number of people and forces him to accompany him around the city. The relationship between the two becomes more and more conflicting, with Max frantically searching for a way to survive and to save at least the last designated victim ...
notes: Mann short-circuits two losing and mirrored anti-heroes, separated - on both sides by the law - by a very thin thread. A film thrown into modernity, in a world of the third millennium in which all that remains is to do one's job: quickly, efficiently and with coldness.

title: Home on the Range
description: Wild West. Roseanne, Mrs. Calloway and Grace are three cows who team up to save their owner's farm, which is about to fall into the clutches of the bandit Slim. The three with the help of the other farm animals and in particular the sheriff's horse who loves kung fu and dreams of an adventurous life, do not mind the risks in order to achieve their goal.
notes: The style of the designs is edgy, while the backgrounds, with a truly colorful palette, recall those of the best Western classics. Latest Disney animated film made with the traditional 2-D technique. Beautiful soundtrack by Alan Menken

title: Godsend
actors: Greg Kinnear, Rebecca Romijn, Robert De Niro, Cameron Bright
description: Paul and Jessie Duncan, distraught after the death of their beloved eight-year-old son Adam, meet Dr. Richard Wells who says he is able to bring the baby back to life. The doctor explains that he will clone Adam so that Jessie can give birth to him again. Since this is an illegal operation, however, the confidentiality must be total. The Duncans accept and Jessie gives birth to the new Adam at the Godsend Clinic. The child seems to be the exact copy of the other until he crosses the threshold of the eighth year of age ...
notes: With a nod to the contemporary metaphysical thriller, from The Sixth Sense to _The Hidden Truths_, shaken by the usual _Shining_ quote, _Godsend_ is a quick-consumption short film packaged with all-Hollywood professionalism. The director Nick Hamm (_The Hole_) is actually British, but we challenge anyone to find traces of a personal style among the dark and sometimes a bit oleographic sequences. However the tension is managed discreetly.

title: The Manchurian Candidate
actors: Denzel Washington, Meryl Streep, Liev Schreiber, Jeffrey Wright, Jon Voight, Vera Farmiga, Bruno Ganz
description: Surprised by an ambush during the first Gulf War, Major Ben Marco passes out, but he and his team are saved by Sergeant Raymond Shaw. At the end of the conflict, the surge of popularity raised by his heroic gesture brings Shaw - entered into politics and "assisted" by his influential mother - on the doorstep of the vice presidency. But in Marco's mind something is not right: obsessed with nightmares, he begins to suspect that the episode in which he was involved and its subsequent developments hide a diabolical plot ...
notes: By remaking and actualizing John Frankenheimer's Go and Kill (1962), Demme - by instinct, a director of the subconscious, capable of realizing the monsters crouched behind the front door - works with alternate montage, with intertwined glances, with holes that go to gradually filling up; but it will never, ever come to reassure us about our future. Not an "electoral" film, nor a consoling one, and much less imaginative than one might have assumed was (but was not) the original; with three magnificent actors (Washington, Schreiber and Streep, big enough not to make you regret the amazing Angela Lansbury of the first version) and a bitter awareness of reality. As usual in the films of Demme, cameo by Roger Corman, in the part of the secretary of state.

title: Shark Tale
directors: Bibo Bergeron, Vicky Jenson, Rob Letterman
description: Oscar, whale cleaner fish and aspiring rapper, dreams of a life in the showbiz spotlight. He succeeds when he brags about the killing of a fearsome shark, son of the boss Don Lino who cuts through the peaceful and industrious city of the riff. The lie, however, backfires and then he has to come to terms with Lenny, the other son of the boss who needs Oscar to hide a terrible secret, but both can not do without sweet Angie, in love with Oscar .
notes: Despite the wealth of backgrounds and characters, the film fails to match _Shrek 2_'s coolness and ease.

title: Ni vu, ni connu
actors: Louis De Funès, Moustache, Noelle Adam, Jean-Marie Amato
description: Poacher Blaireau is the thorn in the side of the forest ranger Parju, who usually always gets away with it. But one day it happens that Parju is attacked by a stranger. Thinking his assailant is the poacher, Parju throws him in jail ...
notes: Yves Robert's first big success.

title: Sangue chiama sangue
actors: Fernando Sancho, Stephen Forsyth, German Cobos, Antonella Judica
description: In a village on the border between the US and Mexico, the outlaw Sancho and his gang steal a precious ex-voto kept in a convent and kill some friars who try to oppose the theft. Andrej, brother of one of the slain friars, looks for the killers and tries to recover the diadem.
notes: Penultimate disappointing film by Capuano.

title: A Cinderella Story
actors: Hilary Duff, Jennifer Coolidge, Regina King, Chad Michael Murray, Madeline Zima, Andrea Avery Ray, Dan Byrd, Julie Gonzalo
description: After the death of her father, Samantha Martin - aka Sam - lives with her stepmother Fiona and twin stepsisters Brianna and Gabriella, who exploit her and give her the hardest jobs. Browsing the Internet, the girl meets the athletic and wealthy Austin, who is looking forward to meeting at the prom organized for Halloween. During the party, Sam is proclaimed queen, but at the stroke of midnight ...
notes: Rosman takes the fable of the Frenchman Charles Perrault (1628-1703) and updates it to our times by adding sugar. The protagonist is Hilary Duff, whom the director directed in the TV series _Lizzie McGuire_.

actors: Hilary Swank, Colin Hanks, Rachael Leigh Cook, Henry Thomas, Barbara Hershey
description: In the quiet town of Middleton, a series of disturbing events occurs one night: Jack runs over a passerby, Buzzy, a shop assistant in a grocery store, is injured in a shooting, three teenagers driving a van have fun throwing objects to racing cars ... Everyone tries to escape their fate, but they end up arriving on time for the appointment that awaits them at the same time, 11.14.
notes: The films that take advantage of their ability to interlock-parallel stories, juxtaposition-concomitant events, real bastard and degenerate children of Tarantino, very fashionable a decade ago after the exploit of you know what, are not finished. Here is another one, all beautifully focused on making sure that the coincidence accounts return, that the elements of the game find their appointment determined, that the characters meet on the board exactly as it should be. The grotesque and the irony, insipid, are for novice students. The only positive note: the opening credits with the music of Clint Mansell.

title: I tre volti del terrore
actors: John Phillip Law, Riccardo Serventi Longhi, Elisabetta Rocchetti, Ambre Even
description: In a train compartment two men and a woman are sleeping. Suddenly they are awakened by the irruption of a mysterious individual, Professor Peter Price, who claims to be able to read deeply into his interlocutors thanks to a metal sphere he invented for hypnosis. This meeting transforms young travelers into the unwitting protagonists of three nightmare stories: _The ring of the moon_, _Dr Lifting_, _The guardian of the lake_.
notes: Then one wonders if this type of self-sufficient and exaggeratedly cinephile product still has its own target audience, and is it not instead the wing shot of a certain way of conceiving horror that is very 80s. The make-up of Stivaletti are amazing, the cameos of Claudio Simonetti and Lamberto Bava (the latter in the role of himself on the set of _Demoni 7_!) Funny, but in the end there is a persistent feeling that the film tastes stale.

title: The Merchant of Venice
actors: Al Pacino, Joseph Fiennes, Jeremy Irons, Lynn Collins, Charlie Cox
description: The rich Venetian merchant Antonio asks Shylock, a Jewish usurer, to lend three thousand ducats to the noble Bassanio so that he can court the beautiful Portia. The usurer, who has always been mistreated by the merchant, however, makes Antonio sign a bizarre clause whereby, in the event of failure to return the money, he will allow Shylock to remove a pound of flesh from his body.
notes: He probably did not ask himself why, of all Shakespeare's works (and in particular the great tragedies), Mercante was the one most rarely arrived on the screen, without leaving a trace (apart from a titanic Michel Simon in the 1950s and some "graffiti "of a never realized project by Orson Welles). It is that, the eternal relevance of the Bard is fine, but Mercante is a dark and intimate drama, not very "melodramatic" and very rational, and moreover as twisted in the plot as the comedies are. As Machiavellian as the pact proposed by Shylock to Antonio, it does not have the noise and the fury, the flesh and the passion of other plays. So, either it is reinvented by the cinema (as Julie Taymor did with _Titus_) or it remains an inert transcription, a verbose calligraphic exercise that arouses no echo. This is the case with Michael Radford's film.

title: Come inguaiammo il cinema italiano
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Lando Buzzanca, Pino Caruso, Tony Bruno, Antonietta Scalisi Bonetti, Gregorio Napoli, Tatti Sanguineti, Giuseppe Ciprì
description: Vintage images and testimonies retrace the careers of Franco Franchi and Ciccio Ingrassia, the famous comic duo born on the streets of Palermo at the beginning of the postwar period and raised among gags, musical performances and tricks of the cinema and TV of the 70s and '80.
notes: _How inguaiammo the Italian cinema_ is almost a remake of the Return of Cagliostro, equally melancholy and attracted by the cupio dissolvi. Of the enormous preparatory work (about a hundred interviews, to make a good book) there remain fulminating jokes, ideas, provocations: Pippo Baudo who tells a scene worthy of _Quei good boys_, Kezich who confesses himself exhilarated and shameful, Bertolucci who fears parody of Franks higher than _Last tango in Paris_, and so on. As an accompaniment, in addition to the well-known black and white "splinters", two hilarious ciceroni, Gregorio Napoli of the "Giornale di Sicilia" and the young cinephanatic Francesco Puma (rescued after very distant appearances in Cinico Tv), almost two Bouvard and Pécuchet of the critics. The tone of Ciprì and Maresco's homage is the right one: if Franco and Ciccio's films were almost never memorable (even if those of Fulci stand out for their inventiveness), nevertheless they often contained "pearls" and always the echo of one popular show that was already disappearing.

title: Lavorare con lentezza
actors: Tommaso Ramenghi, Marco Luisi, Claudia Pandolfi, Valerio Mastandrea, Valerio Binasco, Jacopo Bonvicini
description: Bologna, 1976. Two twenty-year-olds, Sgualo and Pelo, occasionally do some "job" for a local fence to remedy the chronic lack of money. This time, however, they have to dig a tunnel underground in the center to reach the Cassa di Risparmio in Piazza Minghetti. To liven up the long hours of excavation at night, the two bring a radio into the tunnel and tune in to Radio Alice. One night they decide to go to the broadcaster's headquarters. Thus they come into contact with a new world, they discover music never heard before, they know the intoxicating possibility of free communication and then the street clashes and the barricades of the student movement.
notes: Chiesa and the Wu Ming gang are shrewd in circumventing a series of inevitable obstacles and so the violent language that today would sound absurd even if boring of those hot and crowded years, is surpassed by the series of curtains shot as exhibits from Cinema Silent; and the thrust into politics is diluted with the trick of the hole to be dug to get to a bank vault. There is the freshness, the "unwillingness", the refusal of profit as an existential logic, free love, the creative curiosity that made that season a fertile area from which overflowing revolutions were born, starting with feminist emancipation. If something is missing it is in a corner that you can guess and that is probably stuck in a (in?) Voluntary self-censorship.

title: Eros
directors: Wong Kar-wai, Steven Soderbergh, Michelangelo Antonioni
actors: Gong Li, Chang Chen, Robert Downey jr., Alan Arkin, Christopher Buchholz, Regina Nemni, Luisa Ranieri
description: Three short films directed by Wong Kar-wai, Steven Soderbergh, Michelangelo Antonioni. In _La mano_, set in Shanghai in 1963, Chang, a tailor's apprentice, is seduced by the body measurements of Miss Hua, a charming and handsome high-class prostitute. In _Equilibrium_ we are in New York in 1955: an advertiser is obsessed with the recurring dream of a woman he knows but cannot remember when he wakes up. Ironically, his psychoanalyst during their first analytic session is continually distracted by an attractive woman peering through the windows of the office. Finally in _The dangerous thread of things_, set in today's Tuscany, a forty-year-old couple in crisis decides to take a short trip to the sea to rediscover some magic in their relationship. Her husband's passion, on the other hand, seems to awaken thanks to the meeting with a young woman with a free spirit.
notes: Immersed in the impressionist style that now distinguishes Wong, _La mano_ manages to communicate to the viewer those emotions that the cold mannerism of _2046_ denied. The second episode, _Equilibrium_, in turn underlines the state of affairs regarding its author, Steven Soderbergh. Who directs whatever he directs pretty well (except Traffic's awful action scenes) but with a scholastic attitude. _The dangerous thread of things_ is written with a presumption of poetry or literariness, of which co-screenwriter Tonino Guerra is an accomplice, who contributes to making the film cloying and pompous.

title: Le chiavi di casa
actors: Kim Rossi Stuart, Andrea Rossi, Charlotte Rampling
description: Fifteen-year-old Paolo is handicapped from birth due to complications that occurred during childbirth, in which his mother lost her life. The boy was raised by his uncles because his father Gianni, upset by the tragedy, abandoned him. But when Paolo has to go to Berlin for some specialist visits, one of the uncles manages to convince Gianni to accompany him ...
notes: A film made up of trains and objective disorientation (not only because everything takes place in Berlin and Norway, but above all because the young protagonist is necessarily displaced by the most banal and everyday actions), which - with his journey of mutual knowledge between a parental figure and a child - he can at first glance remember _The child thief_, but which also hides in filigree the bitterness and violence of _Così laughed_. And, perhaps, _The keys to the house_ was born precisely as a gesture of emotional liberation compared to the tragic and dark note of the 1998 film.

title: Finding Neverland
actors: Johnny Depp, Kate Winslet, Julie Christie, Dustin Hoffman, Ian Hart, Freddie Highmore, Joe Prospero, Nick Roud, Luke Spill, Kelly Macdonald
description: London 1904. Writer James Barrie invents the story of Peter Pan, the famous fiction classic for children, premiered at the Duke of York Theater. The premature death of his brother and the knowledge of four fatherless children prompted him to write.
notes: _Neverland - A dream for life_ is academic and elegant, superficial and watered down. He does not dig into the infinite possibilities of the relationships between the characters and mechanically approaches passages from life and scenes from theatrical fiction. It seems more Miramax (in decline) than Forster, whose previous film (_Monster's Ball_) was marked by a solid realism that has nothing to do with the adventure of Barrie and the Davies boys.

title: Il resto di niente
actors: Maria De Medeiros, Rosario Sparno, Raffaele Di Florio, Imma Villa, Lucia Ragni, Riccardo Zinna
description: The Neapolitan revolution of 1799 seen through the eyes of Eleonora Pimentel Fonseca, an apparently fragile woman, who seems to let herself be carried away by events, but who has great strength inside and possesses the ability to analyze events with extreme clarity. A person who with intelligence and firmness embraces revolutionary ideas because he feels their rightness, while understanding their limits and weaknesses.
notes: Antonietta De Lillo derives from a highly articulated and layered simplicity. As if Manoel de Oliveira had wanted to go back on the didactic footsteps of the television Rossellini to reassemble, in a theatrical staging that magically manages to combine with the purest cinema, readjust, rework, (re) see history from a point of view futurist. Based on the novel of the same name by Enzo Striano, _The rest of nothing_ also lives on the ethereal, dreamy, stripped-down interpretation of a splendid Maria de Medeiros, capable of transforming all the ugliness of the world into beauty.

title: La demoiselle d'honneur
actors: Laura Smet, Benoît Magimel, Aurore Clément, Bernard Lecoq, Philippe Duclos
description: Petra is beautiful and fatal: at a wedding, the young Philippe is struck by it and the passion grows in him day after day. As proof of love, the girl asks that they both kill a stranger: he thinks it's a joke, but the girl seems deadly serious ...
notes: Even in his "minor" films, Chabrol takes you by the hand and takes you around the French province between murky and tender stories, never disappointing. Here he avoids dark melodrama; and the two lovers, even in desperation, blend in with the placidity of the environment. The Gothic touch of Ruth Rendell, author of the original novel, becomes "everyday". Or rather: Chabroliano.

title: O quinto império - Ontem como hoje
actors: Ricardo Trêpa, Luis Miguel Cintra, Glória De Matos, Miguel Guilherme, David Almeida
description: In 1578, Sebastião, king of Portugal, leads an expedition to fight the infidels. On August 4, his army is destroyed by the Moors and the king's body is reported missing. The country falls into deep despair and Sebastião becomes "the hidden one", the one who should have returned to restore peace and glory to his land ...
notes: Cinema of speech, images such as frescoes, dark environments, inflamed souls and uncertain souls, an atmosphere of gloomy and nocturnal collapse among courtiers, buffoons and prophets. Meditative and provocative cinema in its frontally rarefied and elegant clarity.

title: She Hate Me
actors: Anthony Mackie, Kerry Washington, Monica Bellucci, Ellen Barkin, Woody Harrelson, John Turturro
description: Jack, vice president of a major US pharmaceutical company, denounces a round of bribery and bribery involving his superiors. For this reason he is fired on the spot. Suddenly without money, he accepts the offer of his ex turned homosexual: $ 5,000 to help her conceive a child. Jack turns the invitation into his new profession ...
notes: It starts as the story of a "financial gate" (Frank Wills, the agent who sued Watergate, is one of Jack's obsessions), continues as a bizarre sexy-ethnic comedy, ends by making Jack discover the values ??of a eccentric and "democratic" extended family.

title: Steamboy
description: London, 1889: on the evening of the inauguration of the World Expo, a fair displaying the latest in technology, the young inventor Rei receives a package from his grandfather Roid, who lives in the United States. The content is an important device that Roid sent to his nephew to prevent it from falling into the hands of the fearsome O'Hara Foundation ...
notes: Visionary, intense and complex, the film by the Japanese master - which has a decade of gestation behind it - is a sort of fresco that tells the period of the Industrial Revolution in the manner of Philip K. Dick, with history mixed with echoes Dickensians and turns into science fiction.

title: Yau doh lung fu bong
actors: Louis Koo, Aaron Kwok, Cherrie Ying, Tony Leung Ka Fai, Jordan Chan
description: Sze-To, a night club manager, was once a great Judo champion until, for no apparent reason, he left the sport. He is now an alcoholic gambler with no hope of the future. But one day, arrogant champion Tony challenges him ...

title: Le scandale
actors: Anthony Perkins, Maurice Ronet, Yvonne Furneaux, Stéphane Audran

title: Assault of the Killer Bimbos
actors: Elizabeth Kaitan, Christina Whitaker, Tammara Souza, Nick Cassavetes
description: Lulu and Peaches, two go-go dancers, are wanted for the murder of their boss. They flee to the Mexican border, but the police chase them.

title: La clinica dell'amore
actors: Mario Colli, Ria De Simone, Flavia Fabiani, Gino Pagnani, Dario De Grassi

title: Io Cristiana studentessa degli scandali
actors: Glenn Saxon, Malisa Longo, Rossano, Patricia Reed, Antonella Murgia, Eva Czemerys
description: Professor Davide, teacher of a provincial high school, contested by his students who claim full sexual freedom, is seduced, by bet, by one of his pupils, Christian. However, the girl falls in love with Davide, arousing the reaction of her classmates.
notes: First erotic film by Bergonzelli.

title: Il figlio di Zorro
actors: Robert Widmark, William Berger, Fernando Sancho, Elisa Ramirez, Franco Fantasia, George Wang
description: Mexico, at the time of Maximilian of Austria. The aristocracy is shaken by the apparitions of the son of Zorro, a supporter of the rebels and committed to collecting aid for the revolution. The young Zorro will have to avenge the killing of Don Herrera, Alcalde of San Ramon, who took his side.
notes: Messed up adventure movie.

title: L'intrus
actors: Michel Subor, Béatrice Dalle, Grégoire Colin
description: On the eve of a heart transplant, a long-ill man decides to leave the mountain where he lives isolated to embark on a sort of initiatory journey in the footsteps of his past and of a son he abandoned thirty years earlier in Polynesia.

title: Rois et reine
actors: Mathieu Amalric, Emmanuelle Devos, Catherine Deneuve, Noémie Lvovsky
description: Ismael is mistakenly hospitalized in a psychiatric hospital from which he will come out in a sorry state. Nora faces her father's agony in parallel with the resurfacing of her memories. Both, therefore, are prisoners of themselves and their forcibly claustrophobic and conventual lives (Nora is locked up in the hospital in Grenoble). Annihilated by loneliness, beset by ghosts. Even if the woman reacts to misfortunes even with joy, with ferocious self-irony. The two paths touch and then divide. The two are lovers and then they are no longer.
notes: Self-satisfied like almost all "Parisian" films of the last twenty-five years, he is nevertheless perfectly acted (Emmanuelle Devos is really, at this moment, the best French actress), well written, and shot like an average Italian director would not know how to do even after five years of Experimental Center of Cinematography.

title: Promised Land
actors: Anne Parillaud, Hanna Schygulla, Rosamund Pike, Diana Bespechni
description: A group of Eastern European women warms up around a fire on a cold night in the Sinai desert: a few hours later they will enter Israel where they will be auctioned by Anna, a trafficker of white slaves. The unexpected arrival of Rose, a tourist, represents for the victims the only hope of salvation from a destiny they cannot rebel against ...
notes: The didactic assumption of the film is supported by a visual impact that leaves no way out and handles an incandescent material with surprising reserve. The final sequence of the attack alludes to the possibility that freedom and hope can be born from chaos: it may be over the top, but it is magnificent.

title: Birth
actors: Nicole Kidman, Cameron Bright, Lauren Bacall, Anne Heche, Peter Stormare, Danny Huston
description: After the death of Sean, her husband, Anna has rebuilt her life and is about to marry her new boyfriend Joseph. All of a sudden a ten-year-old boy shows up claiming to be the reincarnation of her missing husband.
notes: The story is on the edge of ridicule, with this child introducing himself to rich Kidman, about to remarry, telling her he is her deceased husband. But Glazer is not a fool. And with a very courageous use of the foreground, he shoots what could be _Rosemary's Baby_ filtered by Cassavetes' gaze. Not everything is in focus, and sometimes it slips, but the film also has a moral tension that should not be underestimated.

title: Coffee jikou
actors: Yo Hitoto, Tadanobu Asano, Masato Hagiwara, Kimiko Yo, Nenji Kobayashi
description: Writer Yoko has just returned to Japan from Taiwan. Before returning to her family, she visits Hajime, a close friend who has a used book shop and has long been in love with her. Once home, the woman tells her relatives that she is pregnant and wants to keep the baby without marrying the Taiwanese man who is the father.
notes: Misunderstood at the Venice exhibition, this homage to Ozu, shot in Japan by the Taiwanese Hou, with a calm rhythm and interior shots at tatami height, enchants for how adherence to the very high model does not flatten the copy and maintains poetic traits own of the Taiwanese director. A masterpiece of balance.

title: 5x2 cinq fois deux
actors: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Stéphane Freiss, Géraldine Pailhas, Françoise Fabian, Michael Lonsdale, Antoine Chappey, Marc Ruchmann, Jason Tavassoli, Jean-Pol Brissart, Eliane Kherris, Yannis Belkacem, Sylvie Debrun, Jean Neisser
description: How do you live in two? Five stages in the history of a couple starting from the end. Marion and Gilles divorce, argue, have a child, get married, meet ...
notes: The title does not say, but it is understood quickly, that the story will be told the other way around, starting from the bottom and going backwards (as already Campion in her first film, _Le due amici_, or as in the theater and then at the cinema il Pinter by _Tradimenti_). Divorce, childbirth, marriage, falling in love and love. Everything looked good what went wrong. The ascent to the source of a (dis) love tinged with masochism is interspersed with a nice selection of Italian songs from the 60s that are the best thing about the film, from Bobby Solo, _Una lacrima sul che _, to Luigi Tenco, _Mi sono in love with you_, to Nico Fidenco, _If you lose me_, with the addition of Paolo Conte. Valeria Bruni Tedeschi plays a self-punishing role that fits her perfectly.

title: Ovunque sei
actors: Stefano Accorsi, Violante Placido, Barbora Bobulova, Stefano Dionisi, Giuditta Saltarini
description: Matteo, a 35-year-old doctor, is not satisfied with his life: he is not interested in his career, his relationship with his wife Emma is in crisis (she cheats on him with Leonardo). In the hospital he meets Elena, a volunteer in the emergency room, who awakens his interest. One evening the ambulance the two work on has an accident. Matteo, seriously wounded and on the threshold of death, discovers once again the profound meaning of love ...
notes: Missed lyricisms, enigmas about identity, pre- and post-mortem guilt, serial situations, Roman-style metaphysics, intellectualisms galore, from Pirandello to Kieslowski, to Caproni (of which we read the Farewell of the ceremonious traveler, one of the most beautiful poems of our twentieth century). Michele Placido dares (too much) and falls (very precipitously). Will the public rush to Accorsi's final-frontal-full nude? It will run, it will run ...

title: Land of Plenty
actors: Michelle Williams, John Diehl, Richard Edson, Bernard White, Burt Young
description: After spending many years following her missionary father, Lana returns to the United States to study. But after his arrival, he decides to take care of his uncle Paul, a veteran of the Vietnam war who, after 9/11, lives in a state of isolation and constant alert in fear of a new terrorist attack ...
notes: Good news: The Wenders of _Land of Plenty_ is not the one of his distant best days, but neither is he the boring one of the end times, guru and preacher. He is an unexpected Wenders, with a particular and personal vision of America: which is certainly not the biblical land of fullness where milk and honey flow.

title: Vera Drake
