actors: Imelda Staunton, Richard Graham, Eddie Marsan, Anna Keaveney, Jim Broadbent, Alex Kelly, Daniel Mays, Phil Davis, Lesley Manville, Sally Hawkins, Simon Chandler, Sam Troughton, Marion Bailey
description: London, 1950. Vera Drake is an exemplary mother of a family. But behind the guise of a quiet life, she hides a secret: she is a pro-abortion activist who helps women stop unwanted pregnancies for free.
notes: Mike Leigh frames gestures, interiors, faces with the affection of a dry but not alien observer. He manages to register hesitations and expressions and, weaving his lucid "chronicle", offers us a precise moral judgment, in which an intonation of the voice, a glance denote class and gender chasms, in which violence and power regulate the world beneath its surface. Golden Lion in Venice and Coppa Volpi in Imelda Staunton.

title: Hauru no ugoku shiro
description: 18-year-old Sophie is the victim of a spell that has turned her into her much older counterpart. An encounter with the bizarre wizard Howl - who lives in an extravagant moving castle, powered by the energy of a demon named Calcifer - could solve his predicament. Calcifer in fact makes a pact with Sophie: if the girl manages to break the contract that binds him to Howl, he will undertake to dissolve the curse that afflicts her by giving her back her eighteen-year-old appearance ...
notes: Compared to masterpieces such as The Enchanted City and Princess Mononoke, the film denotes a very slight step backwards: as if, despite its originality, this time Miyazaki wanted to give a sort of account of what has been done so far; and in fact we recognize echoes of situations and characters from previous films that chase each other relentlessly. However, the invention of the castle door remains extraordinary, capable of transferring its occupants to different times and spaces: an obsession, this one of parallel times and worlds, which seems increasingly central in his cinema.

title: Vanity Fair
actors: Reese Witherspoon, Romola Garai, Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Gabriel Byrne, Jim Broadbent
description: Born into a poor London family Becky Sharp can only count on her charm and cunning to make her way into good society together with her virtuous, pretty and silly friend Amelia. However, his strategy will have repercussions in the affective field.
notes: Mira Nair stages the story taken from the novel _Vanity Fair_ by William Makepeace Thackeray (1811-1863), with meticulous application, at least in the first half of the film. Then, you have to run to cram too many events into the time that remains. What is missing is at least one point of view that can be leveraged to lift the film above the mere illustration of the plot.

title: Sag - Haye Velgrad - Stray Dogs
actors: Gol Ghoti, Zahed, Twiggy, Agheleh Rezaïe, Sohrab Akbari
description: Two little brothers from Kabul go every night to the prison where their mother is held. According to the law they could not sleep there, but since no one can take care of them, the guards made an exception to allow the little ones to stay with their mother. But when a superintendent finds out, he stops the two of them from entering. The two children thus try to commit a crime to return to be with their mother.
notes: A very informative film to understand how films about the misfortunes of today and always must not be. Bets are accepted on a sequel: in prison they project _Un condemned to death has escaped_, the boy escapes, becomes a sciuscià and ends up as in _Germany year zero _...

title: Palindromes
actors: Stephen Adly-Guirgis, Ellen Barkin, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Shayna Levine, Alexander Brickel, Sharon Wilkins, Rachel Coor, Matthew Faber, Hannah Freiman
description: Aviva is a thirteen year old with a palindrome name, clumsy and sensitive but very determined to glorify life by giving birth to a child. For this reason she will leave her family and begin a pilgrimage to an America even more "borderline" than her ...
notes: The cruel director of _Happiness_ is not afraid to irritate and returns to the office with a farce in which the interpretation of the protagonist is entrusted to as many as seven actresses and an actor! The same character changes suddenly and perhaps for no reason, appearing from time to time black, white, fat, thin, young, old, man and woman ... Crazy, annoying and pretentious, but certainly original and stimulating.

title: Mambo italiano
actors: Paul Sorvino, Ginette Reno, Luke Kirby, Peter Miller, Mary Walsh
description: Angelo Barberini is the son of two Italian immigrants, Gino and Maria, who live in Canada. Parents are not happy with their son's decision to move in alone, but are even more shocked when the son reveals to them that he is gay. Angelo's boyfriend, policeman Nino Paraventi, is not yet ready to reveal his sexual orientation to his mother Lina.
notes: It's okay to use stereotypes, but the film's apparent progressivism is just soured old stuff. Could anyone still feel the need for stuff like that? Revolting, and offensive to the dignity of all, and certainly not of queer culture alone.

title: Dirty Dancing: Havana Nights
actors: Romola Garai, Diego Luna, Mika Boorem, Jonathan Jackson, January Jones, Sela Ward, Patrick Swayze
description: Katey settled with her parents in Cuba shortly before the outbreak of the revolution. On the Caribbean island she meets Javier, who is impressed by her skills as a dancer and starts courting her. But after Castro's victory, the Americans have to leave the country and Katey doesn't know whether to stay or return to the United States ...
notes: To give an idea of ??the nullity of the cast, suffice it to say that when the luster and aged Swayze appears on the screen in a supporting role, the audience (mostly made up of teenagers enrolled in Latin dance classes, plus some thirty-something who think back to fifteen years old) explodes into a roar.

title: Kamen'
actors: Pjiotr Alexandrov, Leonid Mozgovoj
description: In Yalta, the young caretaker of Chekhov's house-museum encounters an elderly and mysterious individual from the afterlife and reincarnated in several people at the same time ...
notes: Thin, dilated, characterized by sparse dialogues and the use of lenses that "deform" perspectives in an expressionist sense.

title: Korotkije vstrechi
actors: Nina Ruslanova, Vladimir Vysotskij, Kira Muratova, Yelena Bazilskaja
description: The young countrywoman Nadja meets the fascinating geologist Maksim and loses her head for him: to follow him, she goes to the city and finds a job as a waitress with Valentina. The latter, however, also has something to do with Maxim ...
notes: In the role of Maxim there is Vysotskij, the famous and brilliant dissident "singer" who died in 1980.

title: Lightning: Bolts of Destruction
actors: Joanna Pacula, Nick Mancuso, Ken Tremblett, Ellen Dubin, Philip Granger
description: A calamity struck the city of Bell's Point, which was destroyed by a lightning storm of unprecedented strength. The only one able to explain what happened is Valery, a meteorologist from the local university, who realizes that similar phenomena are occurring all over the world. His problem? Nobody is willing to give her credit ...

title: The Stalking of Laurie Show
actors: Jennifer Finnigan, Mary-Margaret Humes, Rel Hunt, Marnette Patterson
description: Michelle, the most "famous" student of the school, takes a liking to the shy Laurie, who by attending her tour acquires greater self-confidence. One night, however, Michelle's boyfriend rapes Laurie, who from that moment will become the object of a smear campaign by her ex-friend ...

title: Ned Kelly
actors: Heath Ledger, Orlando Bloom, Geoffrey Rush, Naomi Watts, Joel Edgerton
description: Australia, late 19th century. Legendary Ned Kelly leads a gang that includes his brother Dan, Steve Hart and Joe Byrne. The four commit a series of robberies and, chased by the police, end up taking an entire city hostage for three days. Here, barricaded inside a pub, they await the decisive confrontation with the police ...

title: L.A. Without a Map
actors: David Tennant, Saskia Reeves, Julie Delpy, Steve Huison, Vinessa Shaw
description: Richard lives in Bradford, England, where he makes a living writing obituaries in the local newspaper. He would like to be a screenwriter and his dream seems to come true when he meets Barbara, an apirant Hollywood actress. The two get married and move to Los Angeles, but making it big in the cinema isn't that easy ...
notes: Enjoy satire of the star system.

title: Once Upon a Time in the Midlands
actors: Robert Carlyle, Vanessa Feltz, Rhys Ifans, Ricky Tomlinson, Kathy Burke
description: Dek and Shirley live with Marlene, the daughter Shirley had from Jimmy, her former partner who disappeared without giving any news. To prove his love, Dek decides to ask Shirley to marry him on live TV, but the woman refuses. Jimmy, who has seen the show, comes back, determined to win back his beloved in every way.
notes: The cast is very good but Meadows indulges in portraying characters who often go beyond the lines and the rustic "duel" for the conquest of the anonymous and childish Shirley between Jimmy, the violent ex-husband who returns after seeing her on TV, and Dek his new clumsy companion, played by Robert Carlyle and Rhys Ifans respectively, turns into something of a comedian. Better in the side characters, like the volcanic Kathy Burke who plays Jimmy's sister or the newcomer Finn Atkins, the sweet and strong-willed daughter of Shirley who actually finds herself growing up too fast.

title: 13 Going On 30
actors: Jennifer Garner, Mark Ruffalo, Judy Greer, Andy Serkis, Kathy Baker
description: Jenna is about to turn 13. And she is in crisis: her parents are too apprehensive, her classmates ignore her and the boy she likes does not deserve a glance. Only Matt, her neighbor and best friend, comforts her in the worst moments. but when her birthday party also turns out to be a disaster, Jenna expresses a desire to become an adult right away. The dream comes true and Jenna wakes up in the shoes of a beautiful 30-year-old career, esteemed and admired. But in the passage he lost sight of Matt ...
notes: Gary Winick (_Will for Vengeance_) tunes and crushes the film on this step between one generation and the next and there aren't enough ideas and ideas to make this little story work smoothly. Jennifer Garner is nice, but she makes a fool of an agitated Julia Roberts from a few years ago and Mark Ruffalo risks overexposure in films that only make a filmographic number. The funniest sequence is the one in which the guests to a party throw themselves on the dance floor to the notes of Michael Jackson's _Thriller_.

title: Man on Fire
actors: Denzel Washington, Dakota Fanning, Radha Mitchell, Christopher Walken, Mickey Rourke
description: Mexico City. Former Marine John Creasy is hired to protect little Pita after his parents, industrialist Samuel Ramos and his wife Lisa, receive various threats from a gang of kidnappers. After the initial reticence, a particular feeling is established between the girl and the man and when Pita is kidnapped Creasy is willing to do anything to free her.
notes: An abomination: as long as Lent, unthinkable, familist and pompous. Not to mention everything else, hero morals and the like. The best face is that of Rourke, who is hardly seen. Walken is now on autopilot, while Denzel has the expression of a deck chair. Giannini does not know what he is doing there. There is also a parrot.

title: El último tren
actors: Hector Alterio, Federico Luppi, José Soriano, Gastón Pauls, Balaram Dinard
description: A Hollywood major has bought a historic 19th-century Uruguayan locomotive, the 33, for its next film. Three elderly members of the association for the safeguard of the heritage, with the help of a child, decide to prevent the sale by seizing the train and traveling on the rails of the country.
notes: The film deserves a return ticket for its nice anarchist streak and, above all, for the presence of three sacred monsters of South American cinema and theater, Héctor Alterio, Federico Luppi and Pepe Soriano (rightly awarded in Valladolid). The direction, perhaps intimidated by such an actor's presence, while taking refuge in evocative western evocations, is however too bent on television rhythms and styles. However, there remains the merit of having brought to the fore an event which, although it has recently occurred, does not belong to our century, to our world, to our haste.

title: The Girl Next Door
actors: Emile Hirsch, Elisha Cuthbert, Timothy Olyphant, James Remar, Chris Marquette, Olivia Wilde, Paul Dano, Timothy Bottoms, Jacob Young
description: Matthew's dreams of love, an ambitious model student with political aims, seem to be crowned when he meets his new neighbor, the beautiful Danielle. The two start dating and everything seems to be going well until the guy discovers that Danielle was a pornstar ...
notes: The title plays on the sociological convention that Hollywood wanted full of girls next door transformed into divas and stars who could be met between the stairs of the condominium and the landing. The explicit models of the film are _Risky Business - The old men out ... the children dance_ and _American Pie_ and joins them with disrespectful freshness.

title: Così fan tutte
actors: Claudia Koll, Paolo Lanza, Ornella Marcucci, Franco Branciaroli
description: Diana, happily married to Paolo, hides sexual impulses that she would like to satisfy with third parties ...
notes: Brass on the edge of the hard, without passing by category: an old pig handbook comes out, full of fantasies that are anything but free, suffocated indeed by a small bourgeois vision.

title: Tu che ne dici?...
actors: Raimondo Vianello, Ugo Tognazzi, Fred Buscaglione, Hélène Chanel
description: Solitario and Amedeo are two friends who live miserably by expedients, cheating each other. Disguised as priests, they convince a ganster, who believes himself to be dying, to give them all his possessions. When the healed bandit realizes he has been the victim of a scam, he seeks revenge.
notes: Rather messy farce.

title: Una parigina a Roma
actors: Erwin Strahl, Anna Maria Ferrero, Barbara Laage, Alberto Sordi
description: Riccardo, a brilliant pianist studying in Rome, takes a crush on Germaine, a young and pretty French tourist. Once the crush is disposed of, the concert performer makes court to fellow citizen Fiorella, with whom he discovers he is in love ...
notes: Not even Albertone's presence can do anything to revive Kobler's film, modest instead of.

title: L'affaire Maurizius
actors: Daniel Gélin, Madeleine Robinson, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Charles Vanel
description: Etzel von Andergast, son of a prosecutor general, discovers that twenty years before the father had unjustly condemned Léonard Maurizius to life imprisonment, for the murder of his wife. He is Maurizius' father who, telling him the facts, convinces him to reopen the case: then he hides the only witness to restore the truth, but the ending will be bitter.
notes: From the novel of the same name by Jakob Wassesman, Duvivier draws a fresco in which evil dominates, but is not particularly helped by the cast, in which only Charles Vanel stands out in the role of his father.

title: The Final Programme
actors: Jon Finch, Jenny Runacre, Hugh Griffith, Patrick Magee, Sterling Hayden

title: La calda vita
actors: Catherine Spaak, Jacques Perrin, Gabriele Ferzetti, Fabrizio Capucci
description: A summer of the early 60s: on a remote Sardinian island a disturbing teenager seduces two peers by putting them in competition, and then indulges herself with a more mature man: envy upsets the more sensitive of the two boys whose anger will lead to a tragic epilogue.
notes: Vancini adapts a novel by Quarantotti Gambini to tell young people about the economic boom and the conflict between generations. Despite the dated flavor, the attempt to avoid moralistic and consoling loopholes must be recognized. Good photography and suspended atmospheres that are affected by Antonioni. Scandal at the time for Spaak's (cleverly masked) nudes.

title: Peccati di gioventù
actors: Gloria Guida, Dagmar Lassander, Fred Robsham, Silvano Tranquilli
description: The young Angela does not accept that her father, the widower Dr. Batrucci, married Irene. After investigating her past, Angela learns not only of Irene's lesbian tendencies, but also that her stormy affair with a high school teacher led her to commit suicide over the scandal. Backed by her lover Sandro, a photography enthusiast, Angela decides to use this information to blackmail Irene, but the matter inevitably ends up getting out of hand ...
notes: Squinternate mix between tones of bourgeois drama and morbid eroticism: a very fashionable formula in the now distant 70s.

title: Krocodylus
actors: Dax Miller, Matt Borlenghi, Katie Fischer, Joel West, Duncan Regehr
description: With more guts than brains, Bog and Zack want to experience the thrill of circling their surfboards after spilling blood in the water to attract sharks. But while the videoreporter Cecily is filming their exploits, a huge and ferocious crocodile arrives: save who can ...
notes: A festival of cheap horrors.

title: Daleks' Invasion Earth: 2150 A.D.
actors: Peter Cushing, Bernard Cribbins, Ray Brooks, Andrew Keir
description: Doctor Who and his crew travel to the year 2150 on the Tardis time machine. Arrived in the future, they witness the invasion of Earth by the cruel aliens Daleks, aided by the robot men they enslaved. The group decides to join the human resistance to foil the attack.
notes: Film based on the English TV series _Doctor Who_, the longest running science fiction series ever produced. The film, while presenting the mythical Doctor and his bitter enemies, differs from the original series for the different characterization of the characters. Peter Cushing proves to be an excellent Time Lord and does not try to imitate his television counterpart.

title: The Christmas Shoes
actors: Rob Lowe, Kimberly Williams, Max Morrow, Maria Del Mar
description: The cross stories of Maggie and Robert. Maggie is a young music teacher who has a heart disease which is slowly leading to her death; her son Nathan would like to give her a pair of Christmas shoes before she dies. Robert is a lawyer who is distancing himself from his wife Kate, who replaces Maggie as the direction of the school choir by giving up a job in her husband's office. When Robert's mother dies, he begins to reconsider his life; and this is where Robert and Nathan's destinies will meet ...

title: Sorority Boys
actors: Barry Watson, Michael Rosenbaum, Harland Williams, Melissa Sagemiller, Tony Denman
description: Three particularly rowdy boys are expelled from the house of their college fraternity: they decide to dress up as women and join the women's groups, fitting in quite well. Faced with this new situation, the boys at the school repudiate their old closed mentality and begin to understand how harmful it has been towards the opposite sex up to that point. Things are starting to change, but not without unexpected twists.
notes: Teenage comedy that tends to paraphrase the numerous precedents, without any pretense of originality. The interpretations are still acceptable and the humor is at times well constructed.

title: Saraband
actors: Liv Ullmann, Erland Josephson, Börje Ahlstedt, Julia Dufvenius
description: Marianne and Johan have never stopped loving and hating each other, getting lost and finding each other. But now their relationship is made more complex by the presence of Henrik, Johan's son, and Karin, Henrik's daughter: three generations in comparison.
notes: Bergman (born in 1918) returns to his favorite themes, shooting digitally for Swedish TV.

title: Wishmaster 3. Beyond the Gates of Hell
actors: A.J. Cook, John Novak, Jason Connery, Tobias Mehler, Louisette Geiss
description: Prisoner from time immemorial in a tomb on an archaeological site, the bloodthirsty "djinn" is accidentally freed by the young student Diana Collins. Thus a wave of death and destruction is unleashed, and the girl will have the thankless task of saving the world from the forces of Evil.

title: Skulls II
actors: Robin Dunne, Nathan West, Ashley Lyn Cafagna, Lindy Booth
description: Joined the "Skulls", a very powerful secret society, the naive student Ryan Sommers is strictly forbidden not to reveal its activities or the identity of its members. But the murder of a woman will nail him to a terrible dilemma ...
notes: Impossible to make a sequel worse than the original? Not for Chappelle ...

title: Night Crossing
actors: John Hurt, Jane Alexander, Glynnis O'Connor, Beau Bridges
description: Exasperated - like most of their East German compatriots - by the regime's daily prevarications, Peter Strelzyk and Günter Wetzel devise a risky way to travel to the West with their families: a balloon ...
notes: Well-meaning Disney production made in British soil.

title: Women of the Prehistoric Planet
actors: Wendell Corey, Keith Larsen, John Agar, Paul Gilbert, Irene Tsu

title: Spider-Man 2
actors: Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, James Franco, Alfred Molina, Rosemary Harris
description: It's been two years since Peter Parker decided to give up Mary Jane, the girl he has always loved, to be Spider-Man. Meanwhile, his friend Harry Osborne is always determined to avenge his father's death by killing Spider-Man. Peter decides to try to be a normal person, but when a new enemy, Doctor Octopus, threatens the city, he feels he has to do something ...
notes: Raimi works the miracle and mixes the intimate half with the adventurous-spectacular half with balance. Above all, it proves that not all blockbusters are enemies of thinking cinema. Open parenthesis on the villain, who for his dramatic stature deserves a spin-off. The Doc Ock in the film, played with Shakespearean class by Alfred Molina, is not a comic book villain full of clichés and brute force but a freak in spite of himself towards whom even Spider-Man seems indulgent. Furthermore, the symbiosis between Octopus and its biomechanical prostheses, the monstrous tentacles, refers to horror melodrama scenarios that someone like Sam Raimi certainly cannot ignore. Like the little monkey Ella against the tetraplegic of _Monkey Shines - Experiment in terror_, the tentacles love and defend the doctor until death do them part.

actors: Sean Arnfinson, Lynsey Brothers, Erica Cerra, Clayton Champagne

description: In a world of "giants", the fate of two small creatures has become one. Thumbelina and Thumbelina love each other but she is kidnapped by an evil king. Tom Thumb will need the help of all the forest friends to save her.
notes: In the English version, Tom Thumb's voice is that of former hobbit Elijah Wood.

title: Stranger Than Paradise
actors: John Lurie, Eszter Balint, Richard Edson, Cecilia Stark, Danny Rosen
description: Willie is of Hungarian origin, but has always lived in the Big Apple and is keen to be considered 100% New Yorker. One day, Eva Molnár, an unknown cousin who left Hungary with the intention of joining Aunt Lotte in Cleveland, knocks on his door. Eva asks for ten days of hospitality from her relative, who reluctantly accepts but introduces her friend Eddie to her anyway. The paths of the three will intertwine in the most unpredictable of ways ...
notes: Jarmusch's second feature film, Caméra d'or at Cannes 1984. Sardonic humor, catatonic rhythm, milky black and white, a few seconds of black screen between one sequence and another: the absurd side of the "American way of life".

title: Brzezina
actors: Olgierd Lukaszewicz, Daniel Olbrychski, Emilia Krakowska

title: Leprechaun
actors: Warwick Davis, Jennifer Aniston, Ken Olandt, Mark Holton
description: In Ireland, Dan O'Grady finds the gold of the "leprechaun", a sort of evil wood elf. Back home, the man locks the creature in the cellar and tries to burn it, but he dies of a heart attack; ten years later, J.D. and his daughter Tory buy Dan's house, unaware of what is hiding there ...
notes: First episode of an endless horror-gothic series.

actors: Carla Brait, Giorgio Favretto, Vincenzo Ferro, Franca Gonnella

actors: Magda Mei, Nivaldo Lima, Valéria Vasquez

actors: Gloria Guida, Martine Brochard, Alberto Terracina, Emilio Cigoli
description: Davide, photographer and former seminarian in crisis, and Viviane, uninhibited a wife of an actor, meet and is immediately sex. The young man specializes in portraying the buttocks of her (the "fishing furrow"); The intertwining continues between servants virgins and jealous husbands, with ending in ... convent.
notes: Velleitarian cocktail between feminist instances and sexy comedy. Second and last film by Liverani who tries to make irony on the claims of liberation of women and on the counter -reformist tendencies of those years. But goliardia suffocates everything. To remember the scene of avant -garde theater, taken from a show by Luigi Quadrucci and Andrea Camilleri.

actors: Marilù Tolo, Riccardo Salvino, Glauco Onorato, Altea De Nicola
description: While driving in the middle of the night on a country road, Roberta sees a female figure thrown out of a car. Examining what has all the appearance of a corpse, Roberta notices some bullet holes and rushes to the police: but when the agents arrive, the body has disappeared without a trace ...

title: Fermo posta Tinto Brass
actors: Tinto Brass, Cinzia Roccaforte, Erika Saffo Savastani, Carla Solaro, Paolo Lanza
description: The director "Hyotomish" Tinto Brass, together with his secretary Cinzia Roccaforte, who does not bring his panties, reviews the letters to red lights that send him from all over Italy. Of course, the senders are mainly women. Beautiful, shapely, eager ...
notes: The confirmation that the national tinto continues, in the spirit, the moral of our sexy comedy, "photography" facesca of the sexual costumes of a guiding country rather than actually "fiery". Fake prostheses as if it rained, because Brass speaks speaks but then he does not even have the courage to face real bodies. A film at the bottom frustrating.

title: W la foca
actors: Michela Miti, Riccardo Billi, Fabio Grossi, Franco Bracardi, Victor Cavallo, Bombolo
description: A young Venetian nurse decides to go to Rome and work in a very special family made up of a doctor father, mother and daughter nymphomaniacs, retarded son, grandfather pig and a seal ...
notes: So silly and pecoreccio (see the title) that it has become the manifesto of trash cinema.

title: 44 Minutes: The North Hollywood Shoot-Out
actors: Michael Madsen, Ron Livingston, Mario Van Peebles, Andrew Bryniarski, Oleg Taktarov
description: On February 28, 1997, two men with devastating AK-47s attempt to rob Bank of America in North Hollywood in Los Angeles. Something goes wrong, and the arrival of the police sets off the biggest gunfight in the history of US law enforcement. For 44 minutes, 50 agents and a platoon of SWAT special teams attempt to penetrate the building, overcoming the resistance of the criminals and trying to rescue the hostages trapped in the bank. Meanwhile, the confrontation is being filmed live on television and broadcast to every home in the United States ...
notes: Inspired by a real event, it does not fully exploit the potential of the story, weighed down by useless subplots.

title: Te lo leggo negli occhi
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Teresa Saponangelo, Camilla Di Nicola, Luigi Maria Burruano, Ernesto Mahieux
description: Three women, divided between Rome and Naples, who move away and approach. Margherita, a singer by profession, is in crisis after severe damage to her vocal cords; Chiara, her daughter, lives in Rome where she is a speech therapist; and then there is Lucia, Chiara's daughter, who experiences the relationship with her grandmother as a breath of freedom ...
notes: Films of women with women and men on one side, resigned husbands and lovers, excluded from the future. Produced by Sacher di Moretti (who appears in a Hitchcock cameo) and Barbagallo, it is a debut that starts slowly and begins to take off only in the pre-final: as if the author needed a good hour to shake off her shyness .

title: Vento di terra
actors: Vincenzo Pacilli, Vincenzo Modica, Giovanni Ribera, Francesco Giuffrida, Edoardo Melone, Francesco Di Leva
description: The eighteen year old Enzo lives with his family in Naples, in the Secondigliano district. After the death of his father, the boy tries to lend a hand, but finds himself involved in a series of dramatic episodes ...
notes: Neorealist cinema, almost chronicle; cinema of displacements and stalking in search of dignity and in the battle against the misfortune that crushes you. Actors taken from that tangle of streets and high-rises that suffocate Naples. You can see that Marra knows this universe well: what is a bit lacking is a narrative snap, some invention in a staging that does not abandon itself to just following an infinite and thin via crucis.

title: Volevo solo dormirle addosso
actors: Giorgio Pasotti, Cristiana Capotondi, Eleonora Mazzoni, Carlo Freccero
description: Marco Pressi, a young manager who deals with training in a multinational company, is summoned by his bosses for a proposal to which it is difficult to say no: if he wants to have a substantial career advancement, he must cut a third of the staff within a few weeks ...
notes: More mannerist than cynical, the film seems uncertain between the tones of bitter comedy and those of social denunciation. It enters the number of not many films on the world of work, but compared to the Cantet of _Risorseuman_ and Francesca Comencini of _Mi Likes to Work - Mobbing_ remains a few steps below.

title: The Bourne Supremacy
actors: Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Joan Allen, Brian Cox, Julia Stiles, Karl Urban
description: Jason Bourne, who has abandoned his life as a secret agent, is forced to return on a mission to find out who committed a double murder by placing the blame on him.
notes: Directing went from Doug Liman (who remains executive producer) to Paul Greengrass, who applies his signature nervous cadence to the thriller, with many close-ups and quick editing cuts. A style that gives its best in the immediate identification of the locations (not trivial, even if, as always in these films, it remains a "tourist" suspect) and in the sequence of the ambush in Alexanderplatz, among the crowd of demonstrators.

title: Duty Dating
actors: Chuck Franklin, Lee Everett, Cynthia Forbes, Eric Gustavson
description: Clarice is beautiful and independent: what prevents her from having all the men she wants at her feet is her character, fussy and frankly irritating. To help her, her friend Darlene introduces her to Dr. Hartley, an expert in relationships and advocate of a singular theory ...
notes: A little faint, but "viewable".

title: L'ultimo Decameron - Le più belle donne del Boccaccio
actors: Beba Loncar, Femi Benussi, Angela Covello, Marina Malfatti

title: Hell Asylum
actors: Debra Mayer, Tanya Dempsey, Joe Estevez, Stacey Scowley

title: Head of the Family
actors: Blake Bailey, Jacqueline Lovell, Bob Schott, James Jones Dianne Colazzo

title: La sposina
actors: Antenisca Nemour, Carlo De Mejo, Magda Konopka, Riccardo Garrone

title: Le cousin
actors: Alain Chabat, Patrick Timsit, Agnès Jaoui, Marie Trintignant, Samuel Le Bihan, Caroline Proust
description: The "cousin" of the title is Nounours, a small drug dealer who has a special agreement with the cops: he spills everything he knows, they give him 10% on the drugs raked thanks to his tips. However, the wind begins to change when Inspector Maurin - who personally kept in touch with Nounours - commits suicide: his colleague Gérard Delvaux takes his place, around whom Judge Lambert is tightening the circle regarding a circle of corrupt policemen ...
notes: Not new to forays into the polar (_Police Python 357_, _The charm of crime_), Corneau gets the best of a plot suitably tinged with black comedy.

title: Garfield
actors: Breckin Meyer, Jennifer Love Hewitt, Stephen Tobolowsky, Stephen Tobolowsky, Evan Arnold, Evan Arnold
description: Jon, former owner of the pestiferous cat Garfield, brings home Odie, a puppy dog. At first the cat feels overthrown and does everything to make life impossible for the new tenant, but when the dog is kidnapped, he will go out of his way to find him.
notes: Those who love the feline, taken from a comic strip, will find his cinematic alter ego very similar even if in the passage on the big screen the biting humor produced by short and witty mottos that are his indelible mark seems softened. As for the mixing between digital animation and the actual set, there is a slow but noticeable loss of quality throughout the film.

title: La femme de Gilles
actors: Colette Emmanuelle, Emmanuelle Devos, Clovis Cornillac, Laura Smet
description: 1930s. Elisa takes care of the children and the house while waiting for the return of Gilles, her man, who works in the blast furnaces. Her sister Victorine often comes to visit her, but Elisa, pregnant again, begins to suspect that there is an affair between her and her husband ...
notes: But as the plot unfolds, the film becomes less interesting (and some of the directing hazards, especially in the finale, are rather out of register); on everything then weighs an impression of far too sophisticated aestheticism. But the reconstruction of the period, a certain hold in the description, abrupt and laconic, of the relationships, the good plays of actors (in particular the very intense Emmanuelle Devos) are appreciated.

title: Nel mio amore
actors: Licia Maglietta, Urbano Barberini, Vincent Riotta, Damiano Russo, Alessia Fugardi
description: After the sudden death of her husband, Stella returns to live in the house in the mountains where she was born. Putting old photos back in place, she is assailed by memories: she thinks about how she met Fausto, the marriage, the birth of their two children, Laura and Michele, the death of the latter ... has been in relationships for years. Will she be able to win back her daughter's trust?
notes: "Is someone waiting for you?" Asks the painter to the unknown woman who swoops into her cabin. "No," she replies a little annoyed. "Then someone chases her," he says with the authority of the one who knows. An embarrassing exchange of jokes, like almost all those of _Nel mio amore_, the first feature film by Susanna Tamaro (who in the 80s directed nature documentaries), in which the writer spreads "poetry" and "art" with both hands and to the four winds, perhaps without realizing that you are navigating the insidious waters of cinematic kitsch, not the exhibited and exalted one, but the fake-refined, restrained, sententious one. A bundled script, salty rhythm, soap acting (yes, even Licia Maglietta).

title: A Guy Thing
actors: Jason Lee, Julia Stiles, Selma Blair, James Brolin, Shawn Hatosy
description: Paul, while loving his girlfriend Karen, is very afraid of his relatives, even though her father has got him a job in the family business. Shortly before the wedding, the boy is dragged by his friends to a bachelor party where the liquors flow to go-go and there is no shortage of dancers. During the party Paul befriends Becky whom he finds in her bed the next morning. Just then Karen calls him to warn him that she is about to come and see him. Paul shoots Becky out of her apartment without knowing that the girl is Karen's cousin.
notes: The subject and the direction are trivial; listless and out of part actors.

title: La ballade des Dalton
directors: René Goscinny, Henri Gruel, Morris, Pierre Watrin
description: The four Dalton brothers, the most dangerous outlaws in the West, escape from prison to take out the jurors who sentenced an old uncle to death. But cowboy Lucky Luke stands in the way of the fearsome quartet's plans ...
notes: Last cartoon (co) directed by René Goscinny, the creator - with Albert Uderzo - of Astérix.

title: Hangman
actors: Lou Diamond Phillips, Mädchen Amick, Mark Wilson, Vincent Corazza
description: Detective Nick Roos is on the trail of a serial killer who, before killing his victims, subjects them to bizarre and atrocious tortures inspired by the verbal game called "hanged man". Soon, Roos finds himself investigating the chatty and ambiguous psychiatrist Grace Mitchell, behind whom the real culprit may be hiding ...

title: The Whole Ten Yards
actors: Bruce Willis, Matthew Perry, Amanda Peet, Kevin Pollak, Natasha Henstridge
description: Cynthia, Oz's wife, is kidnapped in Beverly Hills by Franckie Figs on the orders of boss Lazlo Gogolak. The reason for the kidnapping is to get Oz to get in touch with his friend Jimmy "The Tulip" Tudeski and have him return the $ 10 million he stole from Lazlo. Jimmy, sensing that this is a trap, decides not to go to Los Angeles personally, but to send his friend Jill ...
notes: The focus is on a well-known canvas, with arbitrary twists and basically uninteresting. The duets between Perry and Willis are tested and funny, perhaps the result is less worse than the average of comedies and action-movies.

title: Machuca
actors: Matías Quer, Ariel Mateluna, Manuela Martelli, Aline Küppenheim, Ernesto Malbran
description: Santiago de Chile, 1973. Eleven-year-old Gonzalo Infante and Pedro Machuca live in two neighboring but opposite areas: the first in a luxurious neighborhood and the second in a slum. Father McEnroe, principal of the parish school, tries in every way to promote the integration between the two worlds and with the support of the students' parents, he admits the children of the slum in his school. Pedro and Gonzalo thus become friends ...
notes: The film has a simple, linear structure, with delicate and exciting scenes, with the camera at the height, not for bias or for false aesthetic ideology, of its characters who act well (the two boys are both rookies and the little girl has a very limited experience behind him). It is no longer easy to frame a protest or party march or a terrible page of history and Wood succeeds.

title: King Arthur
actors: Ivano Marescotti, Stellan Skarsgård, Clive Owen, Keira Knightley, Stefania Garello
description: We are in a particularly important historical moment: the Roman Empire has just fallen and the peripheral kingdoms are starting to form. The knights of the round table defend the country from the Saxons and free themselves from the Roman conquerors, choosing Arthur as their king.
notes: Unfortunately _King Arthur_ is as weak and pompous as a TV movie, scattered with endless philosophizing dialogues between the knights, thunderstruck by drumming and courtly music, embellished with soft focus, trolleys, dollies, marked by an annoying fake-poor look. Its forests are without mystery, its battles without pathos (apart from the inflated quotes by Aleksandr Nevskij and by _Enrico V_). Forget Arthur and the Knights of your childhood and the erotic thrill connected with them (Lancelot and Guinevere, here, have no relationship, at most a look from afar); but also forget the barbarism and primitive black of Bresson's Lancelot and Guinevere and Boorman's Excalibur, from which King Arthur steals with both hands, but without arousing the slightest echo.

title: La vita che vorrei
actors: Luigi Lo Cascio, Sandra Ceccarelli, Galatea Ranzi, Fabio Camilli, Roberto Citran
description: Laura, thirty years old, is chosen as the protagonist to shoot a costume film set in the 19th century that tells of an unfortunate love story. So she meets Stefano, an established actor who returns to acting after a failure. A relationship is born between the two that traces the story recited on the set ...
notes: The intimate camera of the author from the Marches is, as always, at ease in the territory of interiority. But it is evident that the seductive game, this time, turns too much on itself, eliminating the world and the male universe (even the good Luigi Lo Cascio is subdued), in favor of an actress and a woman towards whom the director he had already given and enlightened. A life that would like but cannot (perhaps) and fails as imagined. A film that confirms the fatal attraction of the camera towards Ceccarelli and that nevertheless does not thrill, like a melon forgotten for too long in the freezer.

title: Comunque mia
actors: Sabrina Paravicini, Cesare Bocci, Francesco Martino
description: Thirty-year-old Sandra is about to marry Marco, a precise and rational doctor. At a basketball game he meets Alex, the future 19-year-old brother-in-law, with a charismatic personality. Between the two, love at first sight is inevitable.
notes: The story of _Comunque mia_ is that of Sandra, who is about to marry the serious doctor Marco. But when the inevitable car accident occurs twenty minutes from the start, Marco's brother, Alex, loses a leg and Sandra takes care of him, falling in love with him in an overwhelming and carnal way. The film is shot in late Dogma style, but continually derails towards the most banal TV, due to sententious dialogues, didactic scenes, disastrous actors. The only positive thing about the film is that, being courageously self-produced (55 thousand euros), it has not received any public contributions.

title: Deux frères
actors: Guy Pearce, Jean-Claude Dreyfus, Freddie Highmore, Philippine Leroy-Beaulieu
description: 1920s, Angkor, Cambodia. The two tiger cubs Kumal and Sangha, taken from their newborn parents and subsequently separated, find themselves by chance after many years. Their fate will be sealed by a hunter who has come up there to plunder the statues of the temple. The tiger cubs will be placed facing each other in an arena for a deadly duel.
notes: The two felines protagonists, whose interpretation was built thanks to the contribution of thirty different specimens, are, with grimaces and sparkling looks, the absolute stars of this story that can please the little ones because it does not have the trend of beautiful documentaries on nature made for TV.

title: Plata quemada
actors: Leonardo Sbaraglia, Eduardo Noriega, Pablo Echarri, Leticia Bredice
description: Argentina, 1965. Angel and Nene are responsible for heinous robberies across the country. Known by all as "the twins" they are actually lovers. With other people they set up the robbery of a bank in Buenos Aires, but something goes wrong and they are forced to take refuge in Uruguay.

title: 3 A.M.
actors: Sarita Choudhury, Danny Glover, Pam Grier, Paul Calderon, Michelle Rodriguez, Sergej Trifunovic
description: New York is only five minutes away from midnight and the Lady Lucky Cab Company's taxi shift is about to begin. There's Box, who inherited the business from his father and is trying to keep it afloat. There is Hershey who, left by his wife, has his eye on a maid. Then there is the Latin American Salgado, often a victim of sexual harassment by her clients. Finally, José who has found a briefcase full of money in his taxi and the Bosnian Rasha who, still tormented by the violence his family has suffered, cannot concentrate on driving. All this while a serial killer searches for his prey among New York taxi drivers.

title: La belva col mitra
actors: Helmut Berger, Marisa Mell, Richard Harrison, Marina Giordana
description: Nanni Vitali, handsome and crazy, is at the head of a gang of escapees who returns to sow terror after a period in prison. Commissioner Giulio Santini tries to stop the overflowing violence of the beast, blinded by the thirst for revenge towards those who have betrayed him.

title: The Wicker Man
actors: Edward Woodward, Christopher Lee, Diane Cilento, Britt Ekland
description: British police sergeant Neil Howie receives an anonymous letter reporting the disappearance of a girl on the Scottish island of Summerisle. On reaching the island, the policeman finds himself in the midst of a suspicious community that practices a pagan religious cult.
notes: Cult movie of British cinema, unpublished in Italy but presented in 2001, in a sparkling copy, at the Bergamo Film Meeting. The policeman represents civilization (and colonialism), the island a sort of archaic tradition that resists ... for the time, a revolutionary film, full of ambiguity and mystery. Diane Cilento was then Sean Connery's wife.

title: Requiem per un agente segreto
actors: Stewart Granger, Peter Van Eyck, Giulio Bosetti, Giorgia Moll
description: "Bingo" Merrill, a secret agent ready to serve anyone who pays him well, is commissioned by the FBI to take out an organization headed by a former Nazi criminal. A Norwegian colleague of his and a woman who can recognize the criminal give him a hand.
notes: Negligible films of the spy-tourist genre. Music by Piero Umiliani.

title: Le mille e una notte... e un'altra ancora
actors: Vinicio Sofia, Angela Bo, Dada Gallotti, Mario Brega, Enrico Miotti

title: Left Luggage
country: United States, Netherlands, Belgium, Great Britain
actors: Laura Fraser, Adam Monty, Isabella Rossellini, Jeroen Krabbe
description: Antwerp, 1972. Chaja is a free-spirited Jewish student who has a revolutionary lover and two parents who survived the concentration camp. To support herself, she agrees to work as a nanny for the Kalmas, an Orthodox Hasidic family. Initially reluctant to accept their rigid traditions, she will end up accepting their way of life and teaching the four-year-old to follow his father's teachings.

title: Maigret tend un piège
actors: Jean Gabin, Annie Girardot, Olivier Hussenot, Jeanne Boitel
description: Paris, 1957: in the days following the killing of a woman in Place des Vosges, three other female corpses are found in different parts of the city. The modalities are the same: the killer attacked the victims by stabbing them violently. The judicial police are in check, but the commissioner Jules Maigret has an intuition: certain to tickle the susceptibility of the culprit, he declares that he has already made his arrest to push him to come out ...
notes: Gabin's "first time" as Maigret perfectly renders the awkwardness and "carnality" of the famous character created by Georges Simenon.

title: Sass
actors: Ben Becker, Jürgen Vogel, Henry Hübchen, Frank Sieckel, Karin Baal

title: L'Aretino nei suoi ragionamenti... sulle cortigiane...
actors: Luciano de Ambrosis, Geraldine Stewart, Fiorella Masselli, Marisa Traversi

title: Gli eroi del West
actors: Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello, Silvia Solar, Beni Deus, Mary Andersen
description: The two outlaws Mike and Colorado make their living by storming stagecoaches and plundering passengers. The bandits take the place of the heirs of a mine that the mayor had eliminated to seize their wealth.
notes: Discounted parody of western cinema in which only a few gags of the Vianello / Chiari couple are saved.

title: Squadra volante
actors: Tomas Milian, Gastone Moschin, Ray Lovelock, Mario Carotenuto
description: Pavia: the Marseillaise gang has successfully scored a robbery leaving behind the corpse of a policeman. Inspector Calò, while disapproving of his rather abrupt methods, entrusts the investigation to agent Tomas Ravelli. The man has one more reason to get his hands on the Marseillaise, since - during a robbery - his gang killed his wife. Hunted by the policeman, the Marseillaise seeks escape on the banks of the Po where Mizar awaits him, a Tunisian who has promised to bring him to safety. Tomas joins him, who ...
notes: In his first detective story, Massi launches Tomas Milian, a transfugee from spaghetti-westerns.

title: The Edge of the World
actors: Eric Berry, Niall MacGinnis, Belle Chrystal, John Laurie, Kitty Kirwan
description: Great Britain, islands of Hitra, in Shetland: a clash is underway between the Manson and Gray families, one against and the other in favor of the evacuation of the archipelago gripped by poverty. An unexpected pregnancy and a rescue offshore will help the islanders find their lost unity.
notes: The film anticipates some of the themes of all of Powell's subsequent cinema (signed on his own or in collaboration with the other "Archer", Emeric Pressburger). The crew shot about four hours of material in the field, which was then shortened to its final length by editors Derek N. Twist and Robert Walters.

title: Jet Pilot
actors: John Wayne, Janet Leigh, Jay C. Flippen, Paul Fix, Richard Rober
description: A Soviet plane piloted by Anna lands in the cold and inhospitable state of Alaska. Is it a spy or, more simply, a woman who intends to seek political asylum? That's what Colonel Shannon will have to find out. The man, however, falls in love with her and marries her.
notes: The film shot in 1950 was reworked only seven years later.

title: Blood, Guts, Bullets & Octane
actors: Joe Carnahan, Dan Leis, Dan Harlan, Ken Rudolph, Hugh McCord
description: Sid and Bob, two used car salesmen, have financial problems. They agree to park a Pontiac Le Mans for a large sum. They don't know that the trunk of the car is equipped to explode if they try to open it.
notes: Adrenaline-filled debut by the director of _Narc - Analysis of a crime_.

title: Se devo essere sincera
actors: Luciana Littizzetto, Dino Abbrescia, Donatella Finocchiaro, Fabio Troiano, Neri Marcoré
description: Adelaide, a high school literature teacher, is married to Renzo, a driving school instructor and has an eight-year-old daughter. The woman's existence proceeds quietly but when a colleague of hers is killed in mysterious circumstances, Adelaide meets the fascinating Commissioner Gaetano, in charge of the investigations ...
notes: It is as if the remains (or the extras or some "fegatelli") of _After midnight_ had moved away at night to take refuge in another area of ??the Piedmontese capital and then return to the other set, less entangled intellectually, more of a genre (a yellow moved to comedy that forgets the thriller) and in the open air, less claustrophobic and cinephile and more free and personal (there are, in fact, many of the Ferrarian manners and unmistakable signs of authorship: the first shot from the bottom up, the most French soundtrack in the history of Italian cinema, Françoise Hardy ...). Luciana Littizzetto, Neri Marcoré, Donatella Finocchiaro and Dino Abbrescia are a close-knit string quartet.

title: Hellboy
actors: Ron Perlman, Selma Blair, Jeffrey Tambor, Karel Roden, Rupert Evans, Doug Jones, John Hurt
description: 1944: a mysterious magical ritual wanted by a group of Nazis generates a child with demonic features. The creature - called "Hellboy" - is saved by Dr. Broom; who, after some time, gets him a job at Broom's Bureau, an institute for the defense of the paranormal. This is where the young man realizes the breadth of his powers and becomes a great detective ...
notes: Ordinary tricks, including Rick Baker's for Perlman. If we really have to choose a discreet scene, we opt for the one in the subway: the rest is just enough, including the performers. It will go much better in the second chapter.

title: La prophétie des grenouilles
description: At the edge of the world, Ferdinand, a retired sailor, has just moved with his wife Juliette and adopted son Tom to a quiet cottage on top of a hill. The Lamottas, the new neighbors, are leaving for Africa where they have to take a pair of crocodiles. During their absence, Juliette and Ferdinand offer to take care of their only daughter, Lili. But on the evening when the Lamottas have to leave, they are alarmed by a strange forecast: they will have to face a forty-day long deluge.
notes: The stroke does not follow the richness and verisimilitude of American animated cinema and although it is very simple and aimed essentially at a childish audience, it has its own undoubted style thanks to the work of the Ukrainian artist Iuri Tcherenkov. The characters, such as the gruff but generous Ferdinand, are born from the imagination and memories of the director Jacques-Rémy Girerd who from France confirms, after the beautiful _Appointment in Belleville_ by Chomet, that in animation another way - artistic but above all productive - that is not the American one, it is possible.

title: Tutto in quella notte
actors: Luciano Scarpa, Eleonora Russo, Flavio Insinna, Rolando Ravello
description: Marco is about to leave with his wife Lucia for a week's vacation in New York. Reluctantly he agrees to leave the keys of his house to Giorgio, a dear friend and brother-in-law who wants to take Gloria, which he has just met, to the apartment. The man would like to spend a hot night with the girl, but his intentions collide with Enzo, the boyfriend of Helena, the cleaning lady who urgently needs money to pay off his debts with a loan shark.
notes: Franco Bertini, author of the theatrical text _Crack_ from which Giulio Base had made a film, gives life to a low-cost project that does not look bad in the panorama of Italian cinema.

title: La mala ordina
actors: Mario Adorf, Henry Silva, Woody Strode, Adolfo Celi, Luciana Paluzzi
description: A boss of the bad American is convinced that the Sicilian pimp Luca Canali has made a few billion worth of heroin disappear. To do so he sends the killers Frank Webster and David Catania to Milan, where the man lives. The assassins, backed by Don Vito, kill Luca's wife and daughter. His revenge will be terrible.
notes: Scerbanenco, from which Leo is inspired, is only a pale memory, but the noir elements of the film are sublime nonetheless. Perhaps the director's masterpiece, to which Tarantino did not look too closely for the characters of Travolta and Jackson in _Pulp Fiction_.

title: Ikisudama
actors: Koji Matsui, Yuuchi Matsuo, Asumi Miwa, Hitomi Miwa, Yuma Nakamura

title: Phase IV
actors: Dean Cain, Brian Bosworth, Mimi Kuzyk, Nigel Bennett, Richard Donat
description: In the course of some scientific research, journalism student Simon Tate realizes that behind the mysterious death of four of his classmates is probably a friend of his, Dr. Benjamin Roanic, who is working on a secret program. intended to isolate a cure for AIDS ...

title: The Conqueror
actors: John Wayne, Susan Hayward, Pedro Armendariz, Agnes Moorehead
description: 600 The warlord Temujin kidnaps Bortai, daughter of a rival Mongol leader, and thus starts the warlike enterprises that will lead him to dominate the steppe with the name of Genghis Khan ...
notes: Historical meatloaf by Rko, which sees a John Wayne now on the threshold of his fifties in the role of the famous leader of the Mongols.

title: Light It Up
actors: Usher Raymond, Forest Whitaker, Rosario Dawson, Judd Nelson
description: Queens has never been an easy neighborhood in New York. But at the high school in the neighborhood, anarchy is now approaching: it is winter and the heating does not work, the principal is a dull tyrant and the teachers are rigid and arrogant. As if that were not enough, the only one among them willing to listen to the boys is suspended. So a small group of students rebels, but the situation gets out of hand and the police intervene too drastically ...
notes: Written and directed by Craig Bolotin, the film focuses above all on young protagonists, lost in a world whose violence and insensitivity they underestimate.

title: A Love Song for Bobby Long
actors: Scarlett Johansson, John Travolta, Gabriel Macht, Deborah Unger, Dane Rhodes
description: At the news of her mother's death, Purslane Hominy Will, a sad and lonely teenager, decides to return to the city of her childhood. He discovers that his mother's house is inhabited by two strange men - Bobby Long, a former literature professor and Lawson Pines, his student and biographer - who have no intention of leaving. Thus began a coexistence destined to change their lives.
notes: Of course, the rhetoric of the cursed poet is more than touched upon, and even in recent cinema we have seen several incarnations of this myth (from _Wonder Boys_ to _Discovering Forrester_). But the newcomer Shainee Gabel seems to put a remarkable sincerity in it, and with her models that are not brand new but "right" (Dylan Thomas above all), with her southern world of loser and drawl and dying she manages to move in the end. Although much of the credit goes to the two protagonists, the gray-haired Travolta, sly and pathetic, and the beautiful Scarlett Johansson, one of the few real actresses to come out of Hollywood in the last decade.

title: A Home at the End of the World
actors: Colin Farrell, Dallas Roberts, Robin Wright, Sissy Spacek
description: 70's. Bobby Morrow has no family of his own and develops a very intense relationship with Jonathan Glover and his mother Alice. The friendship between the two boys continues in New York in the 80s where Jonathan lives with Clare, a strange girl with colored hair who would like a child.
notes: Although the story seems a little out of the ordinary, Michael Mayer's first work, which translates a Michael Cunningham novel into a screenplay, has many conventional aspects. However, it is also pleasant thanks to the actors who act to the best of their ability. Excellent soundtrack ranging from Bob Dylan to Bruce Springsteen, from Paul Simon to Patti Smith.

title: Nathalie...
actors: Fanny Ardant, Emmanuelle Béart, Gérard Depardieu, Wladimir Yordanoff
description: Catherine, middle-class and cultured, pays Marlene, who works as an entraîneuse by profession, to sleep with her husband Bernard after discovering he is cheating on her. And she also wants Marlene - with Nathalie's new identity - to tell her in detail about their encounters ...
notes: The film is shot well, interpreted better, dialogued with care, full of meticulous observations on "being a woman today": emancipated and self-confident, in the face of themes such as betrayal and desire. All with measure and modesty, also because the Béart - although beautiful - gives herself little. In short, nothing to say about the packaging and the wealth of topics, but the interest remains moderate.

title: Raising Helen
actors: Kate Hudson, Joan Cusack, John Corbett, Helen Mirren, Kevin Kilner, Hayden Panettiere, Abigail Breslin, Spencer Breslin, Larry Miller, Joseph Mazzello
description: Helen Harris goes through a magical moment: she works for a major modeling agency and is invited to the most exclusive parties. However, his life is turned upside down by the news of the death of his sister and brother-in-law in a car accident: it will be Helen who will have to take care of Audrey, Henry and Sarah, the three grandchildren aged 15, 10 and 5.
notes: This time, sentimental comedy specialist Garry Marshall puts love in the background, focusing on the protagonist's abrupt entry into true adulthood. The theme was interesting but the writing proceeds in fits and starts alternating brilliant and moving moments with other atonic, almost boring, all directed by a direction that resembles that of a TV series.

title: Duvara karsi
actors: Sibel Kekilli, Birol Ünel, Catrin Striebeck, Güven Kirac, Meltem Cumbul
description: The beautiful Sibel to escape the strict rules of the family, devout and conservative, pretends to commit suicide, but the staging fails. At this point only marriage can save her, which is why she asks Cahit, a depressed forty-year-old, to marry her. The man, initially reluctant, ends up accepting and finds himself living with her. But when Cahit falls in love with Sibel, the mutual disinterest ends.
notes: The film, Golden Bear in Berlin in 2004, seems to fit into the trend of interethnic dramas that focus on superficial conflicts of cultures. Fortunately, after an hour the film has a melody twist, which makes the mind go back to very vague Fassbinderian precedents.

title: I, Robot
actors: Will Smith, Bridget Moynahan, Alan Tudyk, James Cromwell, Bruce Greenwood
description: 2035: robots have become a normal household appliance, present in every home. But after the death of their inventor, Dr. Lanning, Detective Spooner begins to investigate and discovers that his doubts are well founded: robots can pose a serious threat to the human race ...
notes: The film lends itself to a mini-reflection that has four main entrance doors. The first gives access to the room in which Hollywood summer blockbusters, even when they are inspired by quality literary sources (in this case the stories of Isaac Asimov), are to be evaluated as robotic products-texts. The second takes us to the area where films are rewarding when viewed with the same eyes as a documentary on advances in special effects technology. The third leads into the narrow vestibule where the correlation between plots and dialogues is the material of a creative neo-science fiction. The fourth opens up into the dark cellar where the bodies disappear: after that of the set and that of the actors, we witness the eclipse of the body of the director and director. If you don't want to open one of these four doors (there could be more or less), the film can be liquidated on impulse, or you can wait until 2035 to analyze it as a fossil of a vintage cinematic fantasy.

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
actors: Jim Carrey, Kate Winslet, Elijah Wood, Mark Ruffalo, Kirsten Dunst, Tom Wilkinson
description: When the relationship between Joel and Clementine ends, the girl resorts to an operation to have the section of memory related to their history eradicated. When Joel finds out, he contacts the inventor of the method, Dr. Howard Mierzwaik to undergo the same treatment, but as the memories begin to disappear, he relives the initial moments and realizes he doesn't want to erase them ...
notes: Joel's race against self-memory finally finds an insurmountable obstacle. We do not want to reveal more than necessary, but it is Mary who relaunches the story and the film, with a gesture that is the idea of ??a fulminating script, and at the same time a very hard blow to a possibility of solution. _Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind_ is thus destined to find no rest. And that eternal light of an immaculate mind (but spotless also literally means "without place") is like the whiteness of a padded cell. Unheard of sadness.

title: Whasango
actors: Jang Hyuk, Kwon Sang-woo, Shin Min-ah, Kim Hyeong-jong, Kong Hyo-jin
description: Kim Kyung-soo, an undisciplined but gifted student with extraordinary powers, is expelled for the ninth time from his school and confined to Volcano High School. Here he discovers that several of the new classmates share similar faculties with him, and he competes with them not only to claim the title of "number one", but also to gain access to a secret manuscript that - as far as he says - it holds the key to absolute power. But a bunch of evil teachers, headed by the vice principal, will give them a lot of trouble ...
notes: Already not great, the film was re-edited by MTV, which cut over 20 minutes.

title: Blood Simple
actors: John Getz, Frances McDormand, Dan Hedaya, M. Emmet Walsh
description: Deep Texas: Abby is married to Julian Marty, a bar owner, but has an affair with Ray, one of her husband's employees. After discovering the affair, Marty hires the nasty private investigator Loren Visser to eliminate them both; however, after taking action, Visser realizes that the deal can pay him far more than the compensation agreed with Marty. From here on the matter gets terribly complicated, and many will pay dearly for it ...
notes: Intricate and highly stylized, stretched to the point of agony and crowned by a surprising ending: a debut that is totally worthy of the future, extraordinary career of the Minneapolis brothers.

title: Violets Are Blue...
actors: Sissy Spacek, Kevin Kline, Bonnie Bedelia, John Kellogg, Augusta Dabney
description: At the time of high school, Henry and Gussie were in love and had planned to get married. Then the girl had left Ocean City, while her boyfriend had dedicated herself to journalism and had started family. Fifteen years later, Gussie, a famous photojournalist, returns to the town to visit his loved ones. The meeting with Henry, director of the local newspaper, is fatal: the two of realize that the ancient flame was not dormant at all. When the woman proposes to Henry to leave her wife Ruth and follow her around the world, the man hesitates.
notes: Second weakening of Jack Fisk, Sissy Spacek's husband.

title: The Corporation
description: Through fragments of 40 interviews (out of 70 recorded), the documentary makes a critical analysis on the nature of multinationals: from birth to massive diffusion in the present, from the impact on our planet to the reactions of ordinary people.
notes: A weighty reconnaissance (145 minutes: some cuts and a greater synthesis would not have penalized either the understanding of the thorny questions, or the effectiveness of the medical-sociological report) on the establishment of a planetary dictatorship, as well as on the perversions of a financial, economic, environmental effects and weighs on the global imagination.

title: Shall We Dance?
actors: Richard Gere, Jennifer Lopez, Susan Sarandon, Stanley Tucci
description: Chicago: lawyer John Clark, at the height of his success, in love with his wife Beverly and with two wonderful children, decides to shake up his life by secretly enrolling in a dance class. Thus he finds himself in a world unknown to him, made of music, physicality and passion. Dancing becomes an obsession for John that he hides from the rest of the world. His wife, thinking that he is cheating on her, hires a detective ...
notes: While it may be fun to watch Gere enjoy himself and act with a feigned fluency, his interpretation is irritating. There remains more than one doubt about the fact that the desire to dance is a fault to be kept hidden. Lopez is beyond good and evil.

title: La luz prodigiosa
actors: Alfredo Landa, Nino Manfredi, Kiti Manver, José Luis Gomez
description: Joaquin, a miserable child from the countryside of Granada, found himself saving a republican shot by the Francoists in August 1936. In 1980 he sets out on his trail, and finds him a tramp with no memory. The twist is that the homeless man is none other than Federico Garcia Lorca, the great poet who was given up for dead in 1936, who would instead wander into foreign Spain at the end of Francoism.
notes: The starting idea, a little forced, could have some metaphorical potential, but the result is really devoid of interest. The style of the film oscillates between an aestheticism that is all fiery sunsets in the prologue and in the flash-backs, and an absolute sloppiness less than televised in the parts on the present.

title: Napravlenieye glavnogo udara
actors: Fritz Diez, Yevgeni Burenkov, Vladlen Davydov, Larisa Golubkina
description: The story of the liberation of the territory of the Soviet Union and the consequent defeat of Nazi Germany retraced through five major offensives on the eastern front, from the battle of Kursk to that of Berlin.
notes: Miniseries divided into five parts.

title: Bichunmoo
actors: Shin Hyeon-jun, Kim Hee-seon, Jeong Jin-yeong, Jang Dong-jik
description: China, 14th century, during the Yuan dynasty: while the country is under Mongol rule, the young Jinha and Sullie live a tormented love story. After the death of her mother, Sullie had to follow her illegitimate father, the Mongol leader Taruga: in the latter's plans, the girl is destined to marry a powerful Chinese warlord with whom Taruga intends to ally. But when Jinha learns that Taruga is responsible for the massacre of his entire family, hatred and the desire for revenge push him to become a master of Bichun, a secret and deadly martial art ...
notes: Korean "Action" with a historical background.

title: The Disappearance
actors: Donald Sutherland, Francine Racette, David Hemmings, John Hurt

title: Blood from the Mummy's Tomb
actors: Andrew Keir, Valerie Leon, James Villiers, Hugh Burden, George Coulouris

title: Un uomo un cavallo una pistola
actors: Tony Anthony, Dan Vadis, Marina Berti, Ettore Manni, Marco Guglielmi
description: A mysterious adventurer whom everyone calls "the Stranger" learns that a gang of outlaws has taken possession of a solid gold carriage that was attempting to clandestinely cross the border between the United States and Mexico. Once the bandits have been eliminated, "the Stranger" gets his hands on the precious vehicle, but ...
notes: Trivial and unnecessarily violent.

title: I fuorilegge del matrimonio
directors: Paolo Taviani, Vittorio Taviani, Valentino Orsini
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Annie Girardot, Romolo Valli, Marina Malfatti
description: A prologue and five episodes sarcastically describe the many points on which a bill on divorce has been built.
notes: Second film by the Taviani brothers, who prefer a grotesque style with some happy ideas such as the Boccaccio episode with Ugo Tognazzi as protagonist.

title: Giulia e Giulia
actors: Kathleen Turner, Gabriel Byrne, Sting, Gabriele Ferzetti, Angela Goodwin
description: Six years after losing her husband Paolo in an accident during her honeymoon, the American Giulia finds the courage to return to Trieste: from this moment, reality and imagination merge and merge in her mind ...
notes: Del Monte shoots in electronic high definition, but the story does not escape a trite and glossy banality.

title: Le parole a venire
actors: Natalino Longo, Mario Cellupica, Ennio Di Stefano
description: Between an engineer, owner of a small outboard factory in Fiumicino, and his workers, a series of intimate bonds arise that affect the various members of their respective families.
notes: A short story by Albert Camus provides the inspiration for this medium-length film, made by Del Monte at the dawn of the 1970s.

title: Forces occultes
actors: Maurice Rémy, Gisèle Parry, Marcel Vibert, Bovério, Léonce Corne
description: A young idealist deputy is persuaded to join Freemasonry (the Grand Orient de France) but soon realizes the corruption and political scandals that are being plotted there. He also discovers that the Freemasons have allied themselves with the Jews to lead France to war against Germany.

title: Barbie as The Princess and the Pauper
description: A long time ago, in a distant place, Anneliese and Erika were born at the same instant; the first, however, was born in a sumptuous palace while the second in a very poor house. Although they were identical, the two girls lived two different lives, completely ignoring each other's existence. Then one day ...

title: To the Devil a Daughter
actors: Richard Widmark, Christopher Lee, Honor Blackman, Denholm Elliott

title: Gangsters per un massacro
actors: Tony Kendall, Brad Harris, Erika Blanc, Franco Fantasia, Hannelore Auer
description: In Montreal, during the 1967 Expo, Arthur tries to contact brother Robert, to recover three million dollars in jewelry, the result of a blow scored a few years earlier. On the trail of him, Captain Tom of the Murolic Team of New York and Joe, detective at the service of an insurance company. Arthur, found his brother who resembles him like a drop of water, kills him and assumes his identity. It is then installed in the widow's house to get the key to the safety box where the jewels are kept.
notes: A comic book of action equal to many others.

title: Annie Oakley
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Preston Foster, Melvyn Douglas, Moroni Olsen
description: Young shooter Annie Oakley is hired for the Buffalo Bill western show. To tutor her is the champion Toby Walker, with whom a professional rivalry begins, destined to turn into something more intimate.

title: Come una rosa al naso
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Ornella Muti, Madeleine Hinde, Adolfo Celi
description: Antonio Macaluso, a mature Sicilian who had moved to London for several years (where he assumed the identity of Anthony M. Wilson and worked as a restaurateur), was delivered from his native island to his delightful teenage cousin Lucia. And the troubles begin ...
notes: We try to make fun of the Mafia, but the results are disappointing.

title: Le amorose notti di Ali Baba
actors: Alan Barker, Krista Nell, Pierre Mirat, Ivana Novak, Colette Castel
description: Ali Babà is an unrepentant womanizer. To convert him to a life away from women, his father summons Professor Freuch. However, it will not be easy.

title: New York chiama Superdrago
actors: Ray Danton, Marisa Mell, Margaret Lee, Jess Hahn, Carlo D'Angelo
description: A dangerous international crime has studied a terrible drug that completely removes the will, and intends to propose it to the students of American university colleges. The intervention of the Special SuperDrago agent and his assistant of him, very skilled inventor of sophisticated anti-crime devices, will be fatal for the band.

title: House IV
actors: Terri Treas, William Katt, Scott Burkholder, Denny Dillon, Melissa Clayton

title: Alien Hunter
actors: James Spader, Janine Eser, John Lynch, Nikolai Binev, Leslie Stefanson
description: NASA picks up a mysterious signal coming from the Antarctic ice and entrusts the task of decrypting it to Julian Rome, who, once at the base-laboratory, finds his ex-wife Kate. The message comes from a bio-capsule and is an alarm that warns not to open it. The object should indeed contain a dangerous alien, but by the time the warning is decoded it's too late ...
notes: The setting of _The Thing_, an _X-Files_-style investigation, a monster wandering around dark corridors (ideally) as in _Alien_, and so on: a tasteless sci-fi smoothie intended for the little fussy eaters of the small screen.

title: Shisha no gakuensai
actors: Thane Camus, Kyoko Fukada, Shuntaro Hani, Tomoka Hayashi

title: The Godfather 1902-1959: The Complete Epic
actors: Marlon Brando, Al Pacino, Robert Duvall, Diane Keaton, John Cazale
description: New York, 1945. The powerful mafia boss Vito Corleone is dying following an attack of which he was the victim after refusing to approve the entry of his family into the lucrative drug trafficking market. The third son Michael, a veteran of Vietnam until then foreign to mafia dynamics, takes the reins of the family in his hand and takes revenge on the death of his father. Just like Vito, who has become aware of his role thanks to the experiences of youth, Michael also adapts to his inevitable fate as a mafia, ferrying the Corleone towards a new age of investment in the casinos of Las Vegas and business with the corrupt Cuban regime by Fulgentio Batista.
notes: The first two films of the Saga de Il Padrino mounted together as a single feature film lasting 386 minutes, distributed in 1981 for the home video market.

title: My Fellow Americans
actors: Jack Lemmon, James Garner, Dan Aykroyd, Lauren Bacall, John Heard
description: Russell P. Kramer and Matt Douglas, both former US presidents but on opposing political sides, are forced to join forces - albeit with great reluctance - when they discover they are being targeted by a conspirator infiltrating the administration. by William Haney, Washington's current number one. The two therefore set out in search of evidence: along the way, they will have a series of bizarre encounters and will end up finding themselves even in the middle of a march for the "gay pride" ...
notes: First-rate cast for a comedy that non-Yankees will struggle to grasp all the implications of.

title: Gangsters
actors: Richard Anconina, Anne Parillaud, François Levantal, Gérald Laroche, Francis Renaud, Guy Lecluyse, Pierre Laplace, Jean-Jacques Le Vessier, Jean-Louis Tribes, François-Régis Marchasson, Catherine Marchal, Alexandra Vandernoot
description: Franck Chaïevski and his partner Nina Delgado are taken from their Paris apartment during a sudden raid by a police squad. The two alleged criminals are accused of having participated in the theft of a lot of diamonds that turned into a carnage. Transported to the police station of the 18th arrondissement, the couple are interrogated with violent and brutal methods. However, from their words emerge disturbing details according to which some members of the anti-crime team are involved in the crime.
notes: Son of the French polar tradition, Marchal's debut film is not one of the most memorable. He will do better then with _36, Quai des Orfèvres_.

title: Proshchay, Amerika!
actors: Lilija Gritsenko, Nikolaj Gritsenko, Ianis Osis, Ljudmila Shagalova
description: 1945: employed at the US embassy in Moscow, the young Anna Bedford clashes with colleagues and superiors, engaged in espionage activities. Returning to her homeland, she will discover an America devastated by the crisis and anti-communist hysteria ...
notes: "Rebuilt" version of Dovzenko's latest film, heavily censored by the regime.

title: The Village
actors: Bryce Dallas Howard, Joaquin Phoenix, Adrien Brody, William Hurt, Sigourney Weaver
description: 19th century: the community of Covington, Pennsylvania, lives isolated from the rest of the world under the guidance of the elders and surrounded by a forest populated by mysterious creatures, with whom a pact of mutual respect has been made. But suddenly the situation worsened: the strange beings of the forest violate the borders and sow panic in the village ...
notes: Working slowly in the staging, drawing inspiration from the imaginary level of American Gothic, Wuthering Heights and the tales of the Brothers Grimm, the Indian-born director tells of a dark, wounded and subjugated America. Mainly because of herself. Howard is an art child of immaculate beauty.

title: Baara
actors: Omou Diarra, Balla Moussa Keita, Bubukar Keita, Baba Niare

title: Les choristes
actors: Gérard Jugnot, François Berléand, Jean-Baptiste Maunier, Jacques Perrin, Kad Merad
description: 1949. Clément Mathieu, a music teacher, is hired as an overseer in a re-education institution for minors with a repressive and violent education system. Thanks to singing, Mathieu will gradually succeed in transforming the lives of the boys.
notes: The film is not very original and has no writing and staging energy to stand out in the school-setting film strand. _Les choristes - The boys of the choir_ is an artifact model of this aria from a bygone era. Despite this, it had considerable success on the domestic market and was in the running for an Oscar nomination for best foreign film.

title: In questo mondo di ladri
actors: Valeria Marini, Carlo Buccirosso, Max Pisu, Biagio Izzo, Leo Gullotta, Ricky Tognazzi, Luca Sandri
description: In Livigno, a timeshare in a residence that has never been built is sold to more people for the same period. The five cheated - Fabio, Monica, Nicola, Walter and Lionello - who until now did not know each other, find themselves at the restaurant after filing a complaint ...
notes: For a few films, the award-winning firm Vanzina has stayed away from vulgarity, trying to construct comedies that, at least remotely, recall our healthy tradition. But the flaw is in the handle, especially in the sloppy and rhythmic direction (let's face it once and for all: Enrico the screenwriter is worth more than Carlo the director). On the moral (already ambiguous in the song by Venditti borrowed for the title and overused in the soundtrack) we postpone.

title: Sonnenallee
actors: Alexander Scheer, Alexander Beyer, Robert Stadlober, Teresa Weissbach
description: Berlin, late seventies: on the eastern side of the Sonnenallee, a road cut in half by one of the checkpoints located between the opposite sectors of the city, live the teenagers Micha and Mario. Shaken from time to time by some thrills of rebellion, rock fans (and in particular the Rolling Stones), in reality the two boys devote much of their energy to the number one problem that haunts teenagers all over the world: losing one's own virginity...

title: Ruang talok 69
actors: Lalita Panyopas, Tasanawalai Ongartittichai, Black Phomtong
