description: The morning after being sacked for budgetary reasons from the role of secretary in a finance company, Tum finds a box, delivered by mistake, containing a million bath in five-hundred bills at her door. Not even the time to think about what to do with it that two ugly thugs knock, recriminating her: she denies having ever seen her but they forcefully enter, ending up both accidentally killed. With no job or prospects, and with two deaths on his conscience, Tum decides to act accordingly: make the bodies disappear, buy a fake passport and run away. But the criminal gangs, in search of that money, are not watching.

title: Witchouse 2: Blood Coven
actors: Ariauna Albright, Nicholas Lanier, Andrew Prine, Jeff Burr, Adriana Butoi

title: Beach Babes from Beyond
actors: Joe Estevez, Don Swayze, Joey Travolta, Burt Ward, Jaqueline Stallone
description: Left out of fuel during an intergalactic journey in a spaceship, three alien girls are forced to land on the Californian coasts, where between one adventure and another they entertain themselves with a group of young men and participate in a "bikini contest" ...
notes: Sort of a messy cross between soft-core and '60s beach movie.

title: La nipote
actors: Francesca Muzio, Daniele Vargas, Annie Edel, Ezio Marano
description: At the end of the fifties, in a villa in the Veneto region, the fifty-year-old engineer Luigi lives, who, married in second marriage to a much younger woman, has an affair with the maid. With the arrival of his wife's son and granddaughter for the summer holidays, the situation will be destined to take an unexpected turn.

title: Dom na Trubnoj
actors: Vladimir Fogel, Vera Maretskaja, Yelena Tjapkina, Sergej Komarov
description: Recently arrived in the capital from the suburbs, Parasha is hired - and exploited - by the hairdresser Golikov and his wife, enriched petty bourgeois in search of a non-union maid. Thanks to a misunderstanding, however, the girl will make a career in politics ...
notes: Verve and humor have never been lacking in Barnet.

title: The Clay Pigeon
actors: Bill Williams, Barbara Hale, Richard Loo, Richard Quine
description: The imprisonment in a Japanese camp caused profound trauma in Jim Fletcher's psyche. But when, awakened from amnesia, he finds himself accused of murder, Jim escapes from the hospital where he is hospitalized and tries to piece together the truth ...
notes: Fleischer confidently directs a script by Carl Foreman, inspired by a true story.

title: Bodyguard
actors: Lawrence Tierney, Priscilla Lane, Philip Reed, June Clayworth
description: The fight with a superior costs dear to the sanguine Mike Carter, forced to resign from the LAPD on the infamous accusation of being a murderer. Hired by the young industrialist Freddie Dysen as his aunt Gene's bodyguard, Mike soon ends up in trouble and with his former colleagues on his heels. The policeman will come into contact with a web of corruption, blackmail and intrigue.
notes: Richard Fleischer mixes noir tones well with pink yellow. The story is co-written by Robert Altman, the screenplay is by Fred Niblo jr. and Harry Essex.

title: Follow Me Quietly
actors: William Lundigan, Edwin Max, Dorothy Patrick, Jeff Corey, Charles D. Brown
description: Detective Harry Grant must capture a serial killer who calls himself "the Judge" and has invested himself in the task of cleaning up the city. Although Grant has numerous traces, the undertaking turns out to be much more difficult than expected ...
notes: Stringy and intriguing (the co-subject writer is Anthony Mann), with a "bomber" ending.

title: The Don Is Dead
actors: Anthony Quinn, Frederic Forrest, Al Lettieri, Robert Forster
description: The brothers Tony and Vince, sons of a big shot of the mafia, have also entered the "business" in the narcotics branch. However, when the father-godfather is murdered, the two refuse to recognize the authority of Don Angelo, the new designated boss: meanwhile, an "outsider" is plotting in the shadows ...
notes: Not one of Fleischer's best things.

title: Make Mine Laughs
actors: Ray Bolger, Joan Davis, Dennis Day, Anne Shirley, Leon Errol
description: This is the second of three "pastiche" that Rko has obtained by assembling unpublished materials with other taken from previous productions of the studio. Actor Gil Lamb connects and comments on the various performances, including choreographic moments, songs and variety numbers (such as that of ventriloquist Robert Lamouret).

title: Banjo
actors: Jacqueline White, Sharyn Moffett, Walter Reed, Una O'Connor
description: After the death of her father, owner of a plantation in Georgia, little Pat has to move to Boston, to the home of an unpleasant aunt. Moreover, she doesn't want to know about Banjo, Pat's beloved dog, which sends the little girl into a rage ...
notes: A story based on good feelings, one of Fleischer's first works.

title: One Piece
description: On board their ship, Merry, Luffy, Usopp, Nami and Zoro are robbed by members of the El Dorago crew, a pirate who has found Woonan's treasure map and who has the great power to hurl powerful waves thanks to his voice. . Due to one of these waves, the Straw Hat crew is split.

title: Second Nature
actors: Alec Baldwin, Powers Boothe, Louise Lombard, Philip Jackson
description: The only survivor of the plane crash that destroyed his family, Paul Kane cannot get over the shock that prevents him from remembering his life before the tragedy. Little by little, after a facial plastic surgery and rehabilitation therapy, Paul realizes that he is a killer in the service of the government agency headed by a certain Kelton Reed. However, until he has completely shed light on the past (solving, among other things, the mystery linked to the word "Chilly Willy" tattooed inside a lip), Kane proves that he is not even able to distinguish between friends and enemies. ...

title: Agents secrets
actors: Vincent Cassel, Monica Bellucci, Sergio Peris-Mencheta, Ludovic Schoendoerffer, Serge Avedikian, André Dussollier
description: Captain Georges Brisseau and the three secret agents Lisa, Raymond and Loïc are in Morocco for a sabotage operation. The goal is to prevent Igor Lipovsky, a powerful Russian businessman, from handing over his arms to the Angolan rebels by sinking his ship. Everything seems to be going well, but ...
notes: Not that there are no hitches in this film. For example, there is a screenwriting chasm in the first sequence, when Charles Berling sows the stalkers and soon after finds himself chased by them in the open countryside. What happened in between? Even the use of digital is sometimes redundant. All in all, though, fascinating things win on points over flaws. And Vincent Cassel, perfect for the role and with a magnetic physicality, is Belmondo's worthy heir.

title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
actors: Vince Vaughn, Christine Taylor, Ben Stiller, Rip Torn, Justin Long, Missi Pyle, Jamal Duff, Alan Tudyk
description: To prevent Average Joe's gym from being acquired by the mighty White Goodamn, its owner Peter LaFleur decides to challenge his rival in a dodgeball showdown match. His team includes the shabby customers of the gym, a group of inept who will do everything to win the impossible bet.
notes: The little film is ramshackle and shot flat, so much so that probably his ideas are more fun to tell than to see. The many puns may have been tasty in the original, but in Italian they are bland. However, there are some nice gimmicks: the fake 1950s educational video about dodgeball, the federation called ADAA (American Dodgeball Association of America), the team of teenagers banned for doping. Irresistible Ben Stiller, Nazi supervillain fitness maniac who represses all gastronomic pleasures, except masturbating while sniffing a pizza or attaching electrodes to his nipples to prevent himself from grabbing a donut.

title: Resident Evil: Apocalypse
actors: Milla Jovovich, Sienna Guillory, Oded Fehr, Thomas Kretschmann, Mike Epps
description: Alice, who has acquired extraordinary powers following a biogenetic manipulation, discovers that the bloodthirsty zombies she had fought have returned to the city surrounding the secret headquarters of the Umbrella Corporation. With a small group of uninfected people, he prepares to do battle with the terrifying creatures for the second time.
notes: Okay, from films like Resident Evil, so evidently focused on their imaginative potential, fine scripts are not expected, but when there are phrases like "Angela Ashcroft, isn't that a grown-up name for a little girl like you?" to the little co-star, we are in a state of overt deficiency. And anyway, the film also lacks heavy on the spectacular: a great noise but without any sense. The German co-production is the same as the controversial _Der Untergang_ about Hitler's last days. And Wenders said that between the two films, _Resident Evil_ is better. We tremble at the mere thought of how that other can be!

title: Nemmeno il destino
actors: Stefano Cassetti, Mauro Cordella, Fabrizio Nicastro, Giuseppe Sanna, Lalli, Gino Lana
description: Alessandro and Ferdi have always been friends. They attend the same school and live in an industrial area overrun with construction sites. The two boys try to escape from the sad reality that surrounds them and from a destiny that seems already sealed ...
notes: For the second feature film after _I nostra anni_, Gaglianone adapts a novel by Gianfranco Bettin and shows very high ambitions, in the themes and above all in the style, very worked and experimental, with a work of rare power on sound and photography, to make a world of suspended adolescents . Then, almost by excess of rigor, he suffocates the characters, engulfing the film with music and flashbacks until it touches redundancy (and the parts with the adults are less successful than those, very intense, with the kids). But the film, even in excesses and waste, has a lot to say and is courageous and often inspired (just look at how the mountain and the reception center make up, in the last part of the film).

title: Anatomie 2
actors: Barnaby Metschurat, Herbert Knaup, Heike Makatsch, Roman Knizka

title: Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow
actors: Gwyneth Paltrow, Jude Law, Giovanni Ribisi, Angelina Jolie, Michael Gambon
description: New York, 1939: an airship lands on the Empire State Building, strange flying machines invade the skies and giant robots wreak havoc on Fifth Avenue. Journalist Polly Perkins is commissioned by the "Chronicle" to follow the investigation into the case. An old flame of hers helps her: the reckless aviation captain Joseph Sullivan, better known by the nickname of "Sky Captain". The two embark on an adventurous journey around the world to discover the mystery of unexpected events ...
notes: The fun is very partial, because the film exhibits a too perfect awareness of all the interpretations: from the metaphorical potential (the skyscrapers of New York violated by threatening planes) to the heap of quotes (_Orizzonte perduto_, _King Kong_, _The wizard of Oz_ , and especially the Buck Rogers comics). In short, there is no ingenuity, even if the show - in single sequences - is enjoyable. The actors, by the way, look as fake as the rest, including Angelina Jolie. Curiosity: the director is from Flint, the (post) industrial city that was also the birthplace of Michael Moore.

title: Girl's Night
actors: Brenda Blethyn, Julie Walters, Kris Kristofferson, George Costigan
description: Northern England: fellow workers in an electronics industry, Jackie and Dawn are also sister-in-law. Dawn has in fact married Jackie's brother, while the latter - in full marital crisis - has an affair with Paul, the manager of a bingo club: and it is here that, one evening, Dawn manages to hit the jackpot. The lucky one shares the swag with Jackie (who gives up husband and employment), but shortly after she is diagnosed with a brain tumor, which she decides to keep hidden from everyone. The two friends will leave for Las Vegas, where they will have a lot of fun before Dawn's situation goes downhill ...
notes: "British style" bittersweet comedy.

title: Dead Presidents
actors: Larenz Tate, Keith David, Chris Tucker, N'Bushe Wright, Freddy Rodriguez
description: A veteran of the war in Vietnam tries to resume a normal life to maintain his family but the possibility of a better future passes through the world of crime and bloodshed.

title: The Connection
actors: Warren Finnerty, Jerome Raphael, Garry Goodrow, James Anderson, Carl Lee, Barbara Winchester, Freddie Reed, Roscoe Lee Browne, Jackie McLean, Larry Richie, Michael Mattos
description: Eight drug addicts are in an apartment in New York. Jim Dunn gathered them, a friend of theirs who makes the director, who asked them to allow him to film the moment when the purchase of the doses from the drug dealer will take place: in return he himself will pay for them. After men have taken their dose, they propose to Jim, the director, to try in turn to have a direct experience of the matter. And from then on things are destined to fall.
notes: The work avoids the combination/crime in vogue in many Hollywood films of the time, drug problems are seen in an unconventional and introspective way. Criticism in Cannes in 1961.

title: Cats
actors: Elaine Paige, John Mills, Ken Page, Rosemarie Ford, Michael Gruber
description: The cats from the Jellicle neighborhood gather for the annual ball. During the evening, the cat who will have the honor of ascending to the paradise of cats will be chosen but not everything will go as expected due to unexpected presences.
notes: From the Andrew Lloyd Webber musical.

title: Igby Goes Down
actors: Kieran Culkin, Claire Danes, Jeff Goldblum, Susan Sarandon, Amanda Peet
description: Jason "Igby" Slocumb jr. he is a teenager who does not find his place in the world: he feels more mature than his peers and neglected by his father, who prefers his older brother Oliver. Expelled from high school, Igby decides to abandon everything and move to New York with his stepfather. Wandering around the city, he meets and falls in love with an eccentric girl named Sookie.
notes: Burr Steers' (_Pulp Fiction_'s Roger) debut behind the camera is a bitter and intelligent comedy, albeit imperfect: the script lacks the arrogance typical of the first feature, but exudes a sincere affection for its misfit protagonist. (the excellent Kieran Culkin, Macaulay's younger brother).

title: Une visite au Louvre
description: The inspections carried out by the two directors in the museum of museums during the making of Cézanne (1989) provide the starting material for this "paradoxical reflection on movement".

title: Walk On Water
actors: Lior Ashkenazi, Knut Berger, Caroline Peters, Gideon Shemer
description: Eyal, an agent of the Mossad (the Israeli secret service), is commissioned to find an old Nazi officer wanted as a war criminal and left for dead. In this way he meets the man's nephew, Axel German and homosexual, with whom he forms a special friendship.
notes: The film is more interesting than beautiful, but it is very important: it stirs up the themes of homophobia, the Holocaust, the sense of encirclement that grips Israel, the bad German conscience and the list goes on. Curious intertwining of spy-story and gay pride, _Camminando sull'acqua_ perhaps puts too much meat on the fire: but the flavors are strong, and the result is not indigestible.

title: El Cid, la leyenda
description: After the death of King Fernando, the noble Rodrigo de Vivar, from exile, seeks the monarch's forgiveness by forming a group of braves to fight the enemy of the new ruler Alfonso: the fearsome Ben Yussuf, intent on conquering Spain.
notes: Little fantasy despite Goya for the best animation.

title: A Different Loyalty
actors: Sharon Stone, Rupert Everett, Julian Wadham, Michael Cochrane
description: 1956: Sally Tyler, American war correspondent living in Beirut, meets British colleague Leo Cauffield. The two intertwine a passionate relationship until one day Leo disappears: Sally begins to investigate and discovers that Leo is not what she thought ...
notes: The 50s and 60s of the twentieth century are fruitful decades for spy plots, but also a dangerous temptation for the costume department: especially if the wife Leo leaves behind in the West is a black-haired Stone who seems to believe in the role. The actress drastically moves the film: the "spy story" (inspired by the true story of the British spy Kim Philby) is diluted in the marital drama of a separation with no return.

title: Una talpa al bioparco
actors: Adriano Giannini, Giorgia Surina, Luca Angeletti, Emanuela Galliussi
description: David takes care of his brother Libero, a boy full of doubts and phobias. To make ends meet, he agrees to be a zoo keeper. Here he meets Martina, the veterinarian, and on his first appointment with her he runs into the charming and aggressive Giorgia, destined to upset his existence.
notes: The problem with the film is not that it is constructed like a juvenile pimp; is that he can't even be. The leading actors do not show particular talent for comedy, the story is slender; and despite the romantic pretensions, to get to an hour and twenty by cashing in a few laughter, at the right moment burps, fart and fuck you once upon a time come to the rescue.

title: 13dici a tavola
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Kasia Smutniak, Maria Amelia Monti, Luca Angeletti, Alessandro Benvenuti, Angela Finocchiaro, Nicolas Vaporidis
description: Giulio, divorced in middle age, goes with his brothers and cousins ??to the old villa in Tuscany, where he spent his summers as a boy, to understand what to do with the now uninhabited house. In the grip of memories of the past, he decides to buy the house himself ...
notes: The intertwining of past and present is mechanical and limp (one of the two horns of the story is often forgotten), the editing darts "Tornatore" thrusts that clash with an otherwise very flat direction. Above all, none of the actors are up to par, from the dazed young men to a charmless Giannini. Only a few duets are saved between Finocchiaro and Monti, which at times have the air of really having fun.

title: Ondskan
actors: Andreas Wilson, Henrik Lundström, Gustaf Skarsgård, Jesper Salén, Marie Richardson
description: After being expelled from school, Erik is sent to a private boarding school where the younger students fall victim to the grown-ups. Erik in particular has to contend with Otto Silverhielm. But the boy also forms a strong friendship with Pierre and meets Marja ...
notes: This adaptation of an autobiographical novel by Jan Guillou was nominated for an Oscar in 2004. It is not a particularly new operation, staged in a traditional and somewhat elementary way in conflicts. After all, very similar things had already been told (with greater urgency) by a Swedish film of sixty years ago, _Spasimo_, written by Bergman. The direction, rather than going for the subtle, shows a certain energy and a discreet rhythm, assisted by the equally energetic interpretation of Andreas Wilson.

title: Shattered Glass
actors: Hayden Christensen, Peter Sarsgaard, Chloë Sevigny, Rosario Dawson
description: Mid-1990s: the very young Stephen Glass is a brilliant journalist who writes for "The New Republic" - an authoritative journal of politics and news - and collaborates with various other magazines. Before long, he became one of Washington's most sought-after brands, but was fired when it was discovered that most of his pieces were invented from scratch. Glass had cleverly built a house of cards made up of sources, names, websites and answering machines ...
notes: A great film about staging and the quality of power, with enormous and difficult acting tests (magnificent Peter Sarsgaard and Hayden Christensen). Inspired by a story that really happened ..

title: Exorcist: The Beginning
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Izabella Scorupco, James D'Arcy, Remy Sweeney, Julian Wadham
description: After the Second World War, the young father Merrin in the throes of a mystical crisis goes to Africa. During an expedition, a Byzantine church is found in excellent condition, and Merrin discovers that an even older crypt is hidden in the basement, owned by the devil ...
notes: Pastiche not without charm but completely free from mystery, a few ravens and jackals too many and a use of the montage of attractions so insistent as to be redundant. But the definitive question remains: did you really feel the need for a prequel to Friedkin's masterpiece which already contained in the first sequence a background that is still worth a hundred of these "genesis" today?

title: Nirgendwo in Afrika
actors: Juliane Köhler, Merab Ninidze, Sidede Onyulo, Matthias Habich
description: A Jewish family emigrated to Kenya shortly before the outbreak of World War II. Parents and children live on a farm and try to adapt to the new continent as their return to Germany becomes more unlikely every day.
notes: The loss of the concept of homeland and racism at every latitude are the protagonists of this film by Caroline Link which is inspired by the autobiographical novel of the Jewish writer Stefanie Zweig. Illustrated perhaps a little too oleographically by an exemplary photograph / postcard and with a narration that declines on a television side.

title: What Price Hollywood?
actors: Constance Bennett, Lowell Sherman, Neil Hamilton, Gregory Ratoff

title: Back Roads
actors: Sally Field, Tommy Lee Jones, David Keith, Miriam Colon, Michael V. Gazzo

title: The Driller Killer
actors: Jimmy Laine, Carolyn Marz, Baybi Day, Bob DeFrank, Peter Yellen
description: The painter Remo Miller is not accepted by the artistic environment of the New York underground, furthermore his girlfriend cheats on him with a woman. Completely sirocco, he takes an electric drill and starts wandering around the city killing bums.
notes: It is the first non-porn film by Abel Ferrara, a really strange, very sick object, shot in total economy and played by the director under a pseudonym (Jimmy Laine). There is already all his urban curse, which compared to Scorsesian is less intellectually mediated, and instead more carnal and disturbing, even if the debt with _Taxi Driver_ is evident. More curious than beautiful.

title: Inspector Gadget 2
actors: French Stewart, Elaine Hendrix, Tony Martin, Caitlin Wachs
description: Inspector Gadget and the super policewoman G2, created with revolutionary technology, must recapture Artiglio, a dangerous criminal escaped from prison. The two super agents will have to go all out to bring him to justice.
notes: Sequel made with very modest means and without Matthew Broderick replaced here by French Stewart.

title: Malevolent
actors: Lou Diamond Phillips, Edoardo Ballerini, Kari Wuhrer, Gwen McGee
description: Policeman Jack witnesses the death of his patrolling colleague who has been ambushed. To answer the questions of Joe, the detective in charge of the investigation, she goes with him to a bar. The two are approached by Ollie who drugs Jack's drink. Upon awakening, he discovers that he is in a lot of trouble.
notes: All too obvious thriller.

title: Hideous!
actors: Michael Citriniti, Rhonda Griffin, Mel Johnson jr., Jacqueline Lovell
description: A man supervising the sewage system finds a deformed fetus underground. The strange "creature" is sold to a trafficker who gives it to a collector. On the way home, the collector is robbed of the "precious" purchase from a rival. With the help of a private detective, the robbed along with the trafficker and her secretary penetrates the thief's castle, where, in the meantime, the deformed fetus, endowed with extraordinary abilities, has managed not only to animate, but even to animate the others. fetuses present in the thief's collection.
notes: The film has interesting ideas but is lacking in tension.

title: Dorian
actors: Ethan Erickson, Malcolm McDowell, Victoria Sanchez, Ron Lea
description: 1980. The astonishing beauty of Louis, an aspiring photographer, is noticed by the ambiguous Henry, who after taking some photographs of him pushes him to enter the world of fashion. When Henry offers him a pact: he will remain young forever, to grow old in his place will be a photograph. The model accepts thinking it is a joke. From this moment the life of Louis, soon renamed Dorian, will be characterized only by women and professional success. When he discovers the considerable aging of his photo Dorian will understand that Henry was not joking at all.
notes: Allan A. Goldstein's film is based on Oscar Wilde's Portrait of Dorian Gray.

title: Dollar for the Dead
actors: Emilio Estevez, William Forsythe, Joaquim De Almeida, Howie Long
description: An unnamed stranger arrives in a village in search of treasure, but soon realizes that he will have to fight a war not his own. Reager, his sworn enemy, will try in every way to kill him because of the blood past that binds them to each other. In the end, one man will carry out his revenge ...

title: Sankofa
country: Burkina Faso, Germany, Ghana, United States, Great Britain
actors: Kofi Ghanaba, Oyafunmike Ogunlano, Alexandra Duah, Nick Medley
description: American supermodel Mona is possessed by Cape Coast fortress spirits while in Ghana. He is embodied in Shola, one of his slave ancestors on a North American plantation forced to suffer violence of all kinds by her master. Nunu and Shango, the man from Shola, rebel against the slave system. Driven by their example, the woman decides to challenge the system and become mistress of her destiny. Mona will come out of the fortress very different from how she entered it.
notes: In Akan language, one of the dialects spoken in Ghana, Sankofa means "going back to the past and turning to the future".

title: Youngest Godfather/Bonanno: A Godfather's Story
actors: Martin Landau, Edward James Olmos, Bruce Ramsay, Robert Loggia, Patti LuPone, Costas Mandylor, Tony Nardi, Harry Standjofski, Vito De Filippo
description: When Giuseppe Bonanno, the son of a respected man of honor, is orphaned of his parents, he goes to Palermo. But he soon flees the city and ends up in the United States where he enters into business with two Sicilian immigrants who, in the era of prohibition, enrich themselves with alcohol trafficking. Giuseppe will climb the top of the Cosa Nostra.

title: Rupan sansei - 1$ Money Wars
description: Lupine attempts to win a ring at an auction, but his bid is beaten for a single dollar by that of Cynthia, president of a bank involved in shady deals. The ring is of little value: what really matters to the contenders is the message it contains, deciphered which would open the doors of enormous power ...

title: Maria, llena eres de gracia
actors: Catalina Sandino Moreno, Yenny Paola Vega, John Álex Toro, Johanna Andrea Mora, Wilson Guerrero
description: Bogotá. Maria lives in a modest house with her grandmother, mother, sister and grandson. Together with Blanca, her best friend, she works in a rose garden outside the city. She spends her days removing the thorns from the roses until she meets Franklyn who offers her to be a drug courier. It involves swallowing dozens of cocaine balls and transporting them to the United States. Attracted by the gain ($ 5,000 per trip), Maria accepts.
notes: Made by an American filmmaker, Joshua Marston, and paid for by the well-deserved HBO, cable TV, _Maria Full of Grace_ (why not translate the title?) Is a big punch in the stomach. Okay, the religious symbolism is very evident (the name Maria, the pregnancy, the eggs given as a host ...) but pertinent. As Dave Alvin writes: "Jesus was a poor fellow born on the wrong side of the road." The wrong part, in this case, are the degradation of an environment, the wickedness of the men who take advantage of this degradation, the indifference of those who pretend not to see. Marston heels his Maria, looking for hope. Don Fernando is played by Orlando Toblon, who in life does exactly what his character does: he helps the couriers out of the tunnel to really find hope.

title: AVP: Alien Vs. Predator
country: Czech Republic, Canada, Germany, United States
actors: Sanaa Lathan, Raoul Bova, Lance Henriksen, Ewen Bremner, Joseph Rye
description: A billionaire industrialist brings together an international team of archaeologists and scientists to investigate a mysterious heat release emanating from the depths of the Antarctic ice. Leading the expedition is environmentalist Lex Woods. What they discover initially excites them, then terrifies them: under the ice cap is a pyramid created by an extra-terrestrial intelligence. It's just the beginning of the clash between two monsters: Alien and Predator.
notes: It will be that by putting two giants like Alien and Predator, which remain among the most fascinating creatures of all time, it is easy to create a show. But you still need someone who can keep clumsiness and ridicule at bay. On the assumption itself, of primitive struggle between the two monstrous forms, in the midst of human sacrifices and desires of dominance, we leave the surprise to the spectator. Raoul Bova (from which the Italian dubbing removes a couple of "characteristic" lines) is part of an expedition of archaeologists in a pyramid in the ice of Antarctica, and it is there that the battle begins. The tricks are amazing. One thing: the giant spiders that cling to your face and make you pregnant, are still quite disgusting.

title: The Last Unicorn
country: United States, Great Britain, Japan, Germany
description: When the evil King Haggard expresses his intention to eliminate all unicorns from his domains, the last representative of the species allies with the bizarre wizard Schmendrick and embarks with him on a long and dangerous journey, in the hopes of finding - exiled to the most remote corners. of the world - some of its kind ...

title: Immortel (ad vitam)
actors: Linda Hardy, Thomas Kretschmann, Charlotte Rampling, Thomas M. Pollard, Jean-Louis Trintignant
description: New York, 2095. To continue to remain immortal, the god Horus has seven days to find Jill Bioskop, a mysterious blue-haired woman, and seduce her. To do this, he must find a human body in which he can incarnate. The choice falls on Alcide Nikopol, a political prisoner frozen thirty years earlier.
notes: Enki Bilal's film is visually gigantic, but it is also boring and conventional; and tracing citations or derivations is a useless pastime. The air chase is a beautiful piece of cinema, but it gets lost in a pompous spectacle that gasps when it wants to charm, and shoots into the void when it wants to hit the mark.

title: The Machinist
actors: Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, Christian Bale, Jennifer Jason Leigh, John Sharian, Michael Ironside
description: For a year, the paranoid Trevor Reznik has not been able to sleep: his body is weakened and his mind is also starting to show signs of imbalance. The man works as a mechanical worker in a factory; and when he causes a colleague to have an accident, his sense of paranoia becomes even stronger ...
notes: The script, the direction and the good actors disseminate symptoms and clues without betraying the inner suspense. The final solution can be guessed. The closure of the story does not affect a very remarkable, Polanskian film. A gem of the uncanny cinematic. To "enter" the role, Christian Bale lost 30 kilos ..

title: The Agronomist
actors: Jean Dominique
description: The true story of Jean Dominique, Haitian agronomist and radio journalist, committed to the defense of human rights in his country. From 1968 he directed Radio Haiti-Inter and fought hard for the democracy of his people against corruption and injustice.
notes: Since 91, the director has interviewed Dominique several times over the years, letting him tell his story, his vocation. But the film, passionate and interesting, has a twist with an unexpected change of pace. Sober and detailed, The Agronomist is the portrait of a likeable character full of dignity and a sober hymn to freedom of information. Among the best films of Jonathan Demme.

title: The Broken Hearts Club: A Romantic Comedy
actors: Timothy Olyphant, Andrew Keegan, Dean Cain, Billy Porter, Ben Weber, Zach Braff, John Mahoney, Matt McGrath, Nia Long
description: West Hollywood photographer Dennis is about to celebrate his 28th birthday with his friends, all gay like him. The group includes the fitness Benji, Howie, a psychology student, Cole, an actor full of charisma, Patrick who plays the cynic and Taylor who really likes to act. They are joined by Jack, the restaurateur always ready to give advice and in whose restaurant everyone takes refuge. When tragedy strikes the group, friendships are put to the test.
notes: This gay comedy, moderately successful at Sundance, marks the directorial debut of Greg Berlanti, who later established himself as a screenwriter and producer of television series.

title: Vendetta dal futuro
actors: Daniel Greene, Janet Agren, Claudio Cassinelli, George Eastman
description: A criminal organization in the pay of a multinational orders the cyborg Paco Querak to eliminate an authoritative ecologist, who has denounced the environmental damage it has caused. The cyborg, at the moment of killing man, experiences an identity crisis feeling vague memories of his human personality resurface, and, disobeying the orders of his programming, leaves the intended victim free. Against Paco, who has found refuge in the motel of a remote village, Francis, head of the organization, unleashes other assassins with orders to shoot him down.
notes: Sergio Martino returns to measure himself with science fiction, but the results are depressing.

title: Au secours, j'ai trente ans!
actors: Pierre Palmade, Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Nathalie Corré, Franck Dubosc, Marthe Villalonga
description: Kathy, Tara and Yann, friends since childhood, have made a pact to always help each other. The three of them live in Paris, but only Yann seems to be happy with his partner Alfredo. The other two girls, on the other hand, have rather disastrous love lives.
notes: The director Marie-Anne Chazel has been an actress for many years and it shows: she manages the acting sector well, although tired from a script that seems to be the festival of stereotypes, banalities, insignificance. This is a perfect cross-section of the times. Gone are the times of Claude Sautet and his detailed, affectionate, meticulous descriptions of human factors, of the spiritual tangos between men and women.

title: Notte senza fine
actors: Laura Morante, Galatea Ranzi, Toni Servillo, Anna Bonaiuto
description: An oriental woman sung and loved by a European troubadour. A married man obsessed with his wife's betrayal that one day materializes by overturning all predictions. A father and daughter wrapped in the shadow of incest ...
notes: Elisabetta Sgarbi said that with _Notte senza fine_ she wanted to treat words as people. All right. But the viewer who watches the film (but is it a film or something else?) Can only wear a garment that may not be his, that of agoraphobia. Four great actors in monologues about loves that died before they were born, betrayals dreamed of and perhaps not true, darkening past for fathers and daughters: _Notte senza fine_ is a very rigorous, essential, shady theater, where light, when it exists, is deadly; but the shadows crush and, as in a noir, kill.

title: La Venere di Cheronea
actors: Belinda Lee, Jacques Sernas, Massimo Girotti, Maria Frau, Luigi Tosi, Claudio Gora, Elli Parvo, Camillo Pilotto
description: Wounded during the war against the Greeks, the Macedonian captain Luciano is rescued by Iris, a beautiful model who poses for the sculptor Praxiteles: the girl admits Luciano to the artist's home, and soon love breaks out between her and the warrior. . This arouses the irrepressible jealousy of Praxiteles, who in the face of the escape of the two lovers does not hesitate to report them to some Greek soldiers who were his guests at that time. Luciano and Iride are chased and joined: the first, hit by an arrow and believed dead, is abandoned, while Iris is led back to Praxiteles' study. But...
notes: Turgid "peplum" without particular qualities.

title: Before Sunset
actors: Ethan Hawke, Julie Delpy, Vernon Dobtcheff, Louise Lemoine Torres, Rodolphe Pauly, Mariane Plasteig
description: Jesse, who has become a successful writer, is in Paris to promote his book and, after nine years, sees Celine who works for an environmental association. The two spend the few hours that separate them from Jesse's departure, together.
notes: It is not a simple sequel to _Prima alba_: it is enough for the two protagonists to break the ice after the embarrassment of the meeting and it seems to have never lost sight of them. Even the banalities of the film, Richard Linklater, Ethan Hawke and Julie Delpy seem to suggest, who wrote the film together, are part of that tangle of conflicting sensations called love.

title: Mean Creek
actors: Rory Culkin, Ryan Kelley, Scott Mechlowicz, Trevor Morgan, Josh Peck
description: Shy Samo and older brother Rocky come up with a plan to teach George, the school bully, a lesson. The idea is to invite George to a party on the lake to humiliate him. When the appointed day arrives, Sam would like to back off, but it's too late ...
notes: A generation that has two fathers: the ex-yippies who broke out and escaped to the countryside, prisoners of happiness pills and tranquilizers; and the rednecks who vote Bush and know only one language, that of violence. The director Estes, also the author of the subject, shows how the link between "guilt" and "responsibility" has been lost, so a society that hates Darwin and fills its mouth with the word God, making it automatically empty, learns quickly, since adolescence, how can one endure the former without assuming the latter.

title: The Last Shot
actors: Matthew Broderick, Alec Baldwin, Toni Collette, Tony Shalhoub, Calista Flockhart
description: Joe Divine, an incorruptible FBI agent pretends to be a producer to capture Mafia boss John Gotti. He then sets up a real production that begins to bear fruit, but Steven Schatz, the director he has entrusted with, does not know that it is a farce, and has no intention of seeing his dream fade. Add to this the fact that Joe Divine and the other members of the FBI participating in the operation are starting to take a little too much taste in Hollywood life.
notes: Jeff Nathanson's debut feature (screenwriter of _Try to Catch Me_ and _The Terminal_) is a fun comedy based on a true story.

title: Sweet Sweetback's Baad Asssss Song
actors: Melvin Van Peebles, Simon Chuckster, Hubert Scales, John Dullaghan

title: Un mundo menos peor
actors: Carlos Roffe, Mónica Galán, Julieta Cardinali, Mex Urtizberea
description: A woman leaves Buenos Aires to the south, together with her two daughters, to meet her husband who she believed had died twenty years earlier. Once at their destination, the man (who has something obscure in the past) shows himself hostile and indifferent, pretending not to know his wife. But the woman does not give up. Meanwhile, around, we get to know stickers and side events.
notes: Agresti is now a champion of festival academism. This latest work, presented at the Venice Film Festival (Orizzonti section), is barely better than the very affected _Valentín-, but it remains superficial and evasive in its relationship with the present, and ultimately inexorable boredom. Full of tricks, with a superficial use of landscapes, the film rarely renders some atmosphere more consistent, especially thanks to the contributions of the actors (above all the protagonist Mónica Galán).

title: Letter to Brezhnev
actors: Alfred Molina, Peter Firth, Alexandra Pigg, Margi Clarke, Tracy Lea
description: Disembarking in Liverpool with a free evening to spend, Soviet sailors Piotr and Sergej roam the city in search of fun. Piotr is the only one who mumbles a few words of English, but enough to establish contact with two local girls, Elaine and Teresa. Elaine and Piotr fall in love at first sight, but the night is short and the next day is already the time to part. Unable to bear the distance, Elaine decides to go directly to Leonid Brezhnev ...
notes: On the realistic and disillusioned tones - especially in the description of the environment - typical of the English cinema of the 80s, the story engages ideas of undoubted and pleasant originality.

title: Blacula
actors: William Marshall, Vonetta McGee, Denise Nichols, Thalmus Rasulala
description: 1780: After visiting Count Dracula, the African prince Mamuwalde transforms himself into the vampire Blacula. Almost two centuries later, in 1972, two collectors buy an antique trunk and transport it to Los Angeles: back free, the bloodthirsty noble sows panic in the city and wins the love of Tina, or the reincarnation of the one who once was was his wife with the name of Luva. But a friend of Tina's, Doctor Gordon Thomas, discovers Blacula's true nature and starts hunting him ...
notes: Modern version of the story of the most famous of the "undead", produced by the glorious Aip by Samuel Z. Arkoff.

title: Black Caesar
actors: Fred Williamson, Gloria Hendry, Art Lund, D'Urville Martin, Julius Harris, Minnie Gentry
description: Little Tommy Gibbs is a Harlem shoeshine. During a settling of scores he is arrested by the corrupt agent McKinney. Released from prison, Tommy wants to take revenge on the cop and become a boss. Working for the killer Santosa, he gets hold of a register against the authorities. He becomes powerful, but loses the love and esteem of his loved ones. To broaden his domain, Gibbs kills Santosa, unleashing the revenge of the local gangs ...
notes: Remake all black by _Piccolo Cesare_, Cohen's film has a frenetic pace, telling the violence of the ghetto in a truthful and less sensationalist way than other films of the _Blaxploitation_ genre. Music signed by James Brown.

title: Foxy Brown
actors: Pam Grier, Antonio Fargas, Peter Brown, Terry Carter, Katherine Loder
description: Plot in preparation

title: Face of Terror
actors: Ricky Schroder, Paulina Gálvez, Sergi Mateu, Abel Folk, Eric Balfour
description: Nick, a Los Angeles police officer, travels to Barcelona on the trail of his missing sister while she was pursuing the dream of becoming a model. Following a thorough investigation, the man discovers that his sister has come into contact with terrorists who use American girls as suicide bombers.
notes: Fiacco action movie.

title: Bangkok Dangerous
actors: Pawalit Mongkolpisit, Premsinee Ratanasopha, Patharawarin Timkul
description: Kong is a deaf killer: he cannot hear the sound of gunfire or the cries of the victims. The marginalization he suffered as a boy made him full of anger, to be vented in the murders commissioned by a local boss through the stripper Aon. Kong falls in love with a pharmacist and starts rethinking his life: but when a gangster rapes Aon, Jo kills him, sparking a bloody feud.
notes: The second work of the Pang brothers is a classic and desperate Far East gangster movie, embellished by the elaborate temporal montage. More effective than the subsequent horror films of the two directors, it will generate, ten years later, an American remake with Nicholas Cage.

title: Adrenaline
actors: Jason Fijal, Georgina Verbaan, Daniel Louis Rivas, Keren Tahor
description: Jason is a brilliant lawyer on his way to a blazing career. When his girlfriend Freya disappears without a trace, the man begins to investigate. The lawyer discovers that the girl led a double life: she was part of a group of extreme sports fanatics, suspected of being linked to the world of crime. Jason just has to infiltrate the band of reckless to understand what happened to Freya, but the continuous search for the thrill brings to light a new side of his personality. Jason begins to enjoy it and ...
notes: Reiné is the producer, director, cinematographer and editor of this film. It doesn't seem like a bit too much.

title: The Furies
actors: Barbara Stanwyck, Walter Huston, Judith Anderson, Wendell Corey, Gilbert Roland
description: Tom, a violent self-made man with an authoritarian character, managed to get hold of vast plots of land out of nowhere. He lives on the ranch "Le furie" with his daughter Vance who resembles him in his despotic disposition. The girl falls in love with the banker Rip, but is deeply disappointed when he gets paid by old Tom to give up on her. After a while Tom brings Flo, an unscrupulous adventurer with him from town, whom he intends to marry. An all-out struggle begins between father and daughter.
notes: Walter Huston and Barbara Stanwyck, respectively in the roles of Tom and Vance, give life to a diatribe with a Freudian aftertaste.

title: The Incredibles
description: After being two famous superheroes, Bob Parr and his wife have retired to private life assuming the identity of two ordinary people who lead a completely normal existence with their three children. But the desire to get back into action is strong. Therefore, when he is summoned to a remote island for an assignment of the utmost secrecy, Bob immediately accepts ...
notes: Despite careful sets full of hyper-technological devilry, Bird's winning choice was to humanize his heroes, highlighting more than their powers, weaknesses and imperfections, making them truly similar to us spectators and the anti-heroes described by Alan Moore in the his milestone comic-book Watchmen.

title: The Clearing
actors: Robert Redford, Helen Mirren, Willem Dafoe, Alessandro Nivola
description: On the surface, Wayne and Eileen Hayes have made the American dream come true. But it all falls apart when Wayne is kidnapped in broad daylight from his Pittsburgh home by someone with nothing to lose ...
notes: The dramaturgical inconsistency denounces the total inexperience of the debut writer Justin Haythe, and the endless repetition of the close-ups (Redford comes out shredded) shows the ignorance of the debut director Brugge (producer of _Insider - Behind the truth_, _Bulworth - The senator_ , _Heat - The challenge_, _Glory - Men of glory_). Who knows, maybe the cousin went to those sets ...

title: Occhi di cristallo
actors: Luigi Lo Cascio, Lucía Jiménez, José Ángel Egido, Eusebio Poncela
description: To defeat a ruthless serial killer, Inspector Amaldi must race against time and retrace the stages of a painful trail of blood one by one ...
notes: Bravo Puglielli, who works on the image as few colleagues have been able to do recently. Through the chromatic mixture and the fast shutter (which allows a certain anxiety to be conveyed with the frenzy of the shooting) he builds flashes of unprecedented suspense and at least three sequences of good cinema: the initial chase, the triple crime in broad daylight and the murder of the doll lady, who smacks of old-fashioned Silver. In short, a modern look, not obvious and far from Alex Infascelli's video clips. Then, unfortunately, the script comes in straight leg.

title: Donnie Darko
actors: Jake Gyllenhaal, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Patrick Swayze, Drew Barrymore, Jena Malone, Mary McDonnell, Holmes Osborne, Daveigh Chase, James Duval, Noah Wyle, Beth Grant, Seth Rogen, Katharine Ross, Lisa K. Wyatt, Jolene Purdy
description: October 1988. After escaping a terrifying and bizarre accident, Donnie Darko, an American teenager, realizes what it means to be alive and in love and consequently discovers his potential to alter time and destiny with the help of Frank, a giant rabbit. and monstrous. Is it just imagination?
notes: More than Weir or Gilliam (cited by the director as influences) Kelly recalls the Lynch of _Twin Peaks_, from the restless carts, to the small slow motion, to the bizarre and inexplicable characters that appear in the shots. Of course Kelly is not Lynch and the film really puts too much meat on the stove. But it's quirky and sincere enough to make it interesting.

title: Twisted
actors: Ashley Judd, Samuel L. Jackson, Andy Garcia, David Strathairn
description: Recently promoted police inspector Jessica Shepard is on the trail of a serial killer. The situation becomes complicated when she discovers that the victims are men with whom she had a relationship ...
notes: Obviously a film on which we focus a lot, so much so that in the opening credits we write David Starthairn and not the correct Strathairn, that's what we arrived at. By the way, the originality of the Italian titolists is always in the foreground: after vices, spiders, various webs, we are only missing silkworms and country caterpillars.

title: White Chicks
actors: Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans, Jaime King, Frankie Faison, Lochlyn Munro
description: FBI agents Marcus and Kevin Copeland ring one failure after another. When a plan is uncovered to kidnap the Wilson sisters, their rivals are entrusted with the task, while Kevin and Marcus have a simple routine task: escorting the girls from the airport to the hotel. The two manage to get into trouble on this occasion too ... and that's just the beginning.
notes: The Wayans evidently believe that if one raspberry makes you smile, two make you laugh, ten are hilarious and with fifty the hall comes down. Without any irreverent force, the vulgarity of the film is as if pre-cooked, softened by useless sentimental parentheses, and the satire is more misogynistic than social. To quote Lemmon and Curtis is really an exaggeration: already _Bellifreschi_ by Oldoini, with De Sica and Banfi, was much more fun.

title: Piccola pesca
actors: Luciano Marica, vari pescatori
description: The fishermen of the Lower Sulcis cannot fish due to the NATO military exercises at the Capo Teulada shooting range. Since 1997, the restrictions on fishing have been increasingly severe, but fishermen are not resigning themselves and are mobilizing to get "their" sea back.
notes: Enrico Pitzianti's document, swallowed up by the militant Gianluca Arcopinto, is punctual, rhythmic, respectful, rich in repertoire materials (the "colonization" began in the 1950s ...) and sacrosanctly indignant.

title: Noel
actors: Susan Sarandon, Paul Walker, Penélope Cruz, Alan Arkin, Marcus Thomas
description: New York: in the days leading up to Christmas, the lives of five lonely and disappointed people intertwine. Rose is the only one to take care of her mother with Alzheimer's, as her love life is non-existent; the policeman Mike is too jealous and risks wrecking his relationship with the beautiful Nina; Artie, a restaurant manager, is convinced that Mike is the reincarnation of his wife. Then there is Jules who, alone like a dog, gets his hands broken to spend the eve in the hospital.
notes: Palminteri made his directorial debut by churning out the most incredible, impressive, arteriosclerotic, institutional, regulatory, vulgar attic gift pack of the new millennium.

title: Bin-jip
actors: Jae Hee, Lee Seung-yeon
description: Tae-suk, settles in homes in the absence of the owners. So he runs into the rich Sun-hwa, abused by her husband ...
notes: As always, pessimism and loneliness reign supreme in the cinema of the Korean director, who in _Ferro 3 - The empty house_ achieves a perfect balance, making us see and feel the pain without escaping feeling and emotion (the sequence of her on the sofa of others , alone: ??from tears). Very important cinema. The title refers to a type of golf club: and the blow that rages on the spectator's stomach is both lethal and revitalizing.

title: Confidences trop intimes
actors: Sandrine Bonnaire, Fabrice Luchini, Michel Duchaussoy, Anne Brochet
description: Convinced that she is in the office of a psychotherapist, without realizing that she has the wrong door, Anna confides in William Faber, a financial consultant. Other appointments follow, even after William revealed his true identity to her ...
notes: Wonderfully served by all his performers (the cast is admirable even in the most circumscribed roles, but Bonnaire and Luchini are true champions), the director of _The hairdresser's husband_ and _The man on the train_ realizes his "short meeting" around a sofa, reaffirming that the imagery of cinema can also consist only of words and looks.

title: The Polar Express
actors: Tom Hanks, Michael Jeter, Nona Gaye, Harter Zemeckis, Eddie Deezen
description: A little boy eagerly awaits the arrival of Santa Claus. There are five minutes to midnight: suddenly a thunderous roar is heard and a train stops right in front of the child's house. The driver seems to have come to pick him up to take him, on the Polar Express, to the North Pole.
notes: With the screen adaptation of _The Polar Express_, by Chris Van Allsburg, Zemeckis and Hanks have transformed the nighttime adventure of a Christmas story into a pioneering work on "performance capture": the possibility of digitizing the acting of the actors and transform it into an expressive repertoire of computer-modeled creatures.

title: Surviving Christmas
actors: Ben Affleck, James Gandolfini, Christina Applegate, Udo Kier
description: Terrified at the thought of spending another Christmas alone, Drew Latham - a successful "executive" but with a disastrous love life - decides to return to the house he lived in as a child, even though the people who live there now are complete strangers. . By offering a decent amount of money, Drew convinces new tenants to spend the holidays with him, giving them the illusion of being in a real family ...
notes: To get an idea of ??the film, just add the inherent stickiness of the subject to Affleck's motionless inexpressiveness. Gandolfini of _Soprano_ does his best, but he certainly cannot work miracles.

title: Il magico Natale di Rupert
actors: Giammaria Corolla, Piera Cravignani, Renato Liprandi, Clara Droetto, Eugenio Allegri
description: Christmas' Eve. Nonna Porfilia sends Rupert to the attic to look for the tip of the Christmas tree, but the boy finds a box with the inventions left by the former tenant. The trouble begins when Rupert lights a strange lamp that emits signals that propagate through space and reach a passing spaceship ready to invade the earth ...
notes: The operation, explicitly aimed at childhood, however, has nothing dreamy about: all the actors (starting with the protagonist) bambociano, after twenty minutes a lethal boredom falls, there is not a single real visual invention and the sets alone they are not enough. The generous middle thumb is due to a certain sympathy that the craftsmanship arouses, with its iconography indebted to comics to Uncle Tibia or _Guerra d'eroi_.

title: Maschio latino... cercasi
actors: Vittorio Caprioli, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Gloria Guida, Gino Bramieri, Aldo Maccione, Dayle Haddon

title: Air Rage
actors: Ice T, Cyril O'Reilly, Rick Cramer, Kimberly Oja, Alexandra Raines
description: Found guilty of heinous war crimes, Marine Colonel Skikes is sentenced to life in military prison. His loyalists, however, manage to make him escape, and with him at the head they hijack a plane to obtain a strong ransom. There is work for Matt Marshall and his counterterrorism unit ...
notes: Fred Olen Ray, a brand a guarantee: according to the annals, our company would have signed - both in its own name and with a plethora of pseudonyms - the beauty of 93 films from 1971 to 2006! Seven in 2001 alone, one of which is this _Air Rage_: and the reader will forgive us, if at this point we have run out of space for further comments ...

title: Evil Never Dies
actors: Thomas Gisbon, Katherine Heigl, Simon Bossell, John Waters (III)
description: After his wife is killed by serial killer William Charles Lee, police detective Mark Ryan goes into a depression which forces him to quit his job and serve as a private guard in college. Some time later, a series of sexually motivated murders take place which resemble, in the modus operandi, those committed by Lee. The police think it is impossible that it is Lee, as he was executed. But Ryan is sure it's him and that's why he involves policewoman Eve in her hunt for revived Lee.
notes: Modest television film directed by Uli Edel which had debuted with _Christiana F. - We the boys of the Berlin zoo_.

title: The Era of Vampires
actors: Michael Chow Man-Kin, Ken Chang, Yu Rongguang, Lam Suet, Chan Kwok Kwan
description: China, 19th century: after the death of their teacher Jiang, killed in combat by a vampire-zombie, four former students of the Mao Shan Taoist school of kung fu and magic - called "Rain", "Lightning", "Thunder" and " Wind "- set out on the trail of the monstrous creatures who, led by the Vampire King, incessantly terrorize the villages in the area. The thirst for revenge will lead them far away, between loves and priceless riches, while the legion of the "undead" continues their deadly mission ...
notes: Written and produced by Tsui Hark, a pleasant film, with good fights, but which does not add anything relevant to the established tradition of the genre.

title: Hiroshima
actors: Kenneth Welsh, Saul Rubinek, Timothy West, Naohiko Umewaka

title: Decameroticus
actors: Orchidea De Santis, Gabriella Giorgelli, Riccardo Garrone, Umberto D'Orsi

title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka
actors: Keenen Ivory Wayans, Bernie Casey, Antonio Fargas, Steve James
description: After years of desk routine, Sergeant Jack Spade returns to New York to avenge the death of his brother, who disappeared from an overdose of gold chains. He sets out in search of the notorious criminal Mr. Big and, with the help of the legendary John Slade, organizes his revenge.
notes: Written by the director with Robert Townsend, it is a homage parody of the black-only crime films of the 1970s. A humor more and more attentive to the "quantity" that the quality is the driving force for this comedy that would like to be offensive but cannot be funny. The Italian spectator loses most of the allusions.

title: Fake-Out
actors: Pia Zadora, Telly Savalas, Desi Arnaz jr., Larry Storch, G. Wesley Stevens
description: Bobbie Warren, a Las Vegas nightclub singer, compromises with the local mob and ends up in the jail. Trained by previous experience, she agrees to testify - or so she says - and is placed in the custody of agents Clint Morgan and O.W. Thurston ...
notes: Very feeble "action" with comedy overtones.

title: The Triangle
actors: Luke Perry, Dorian Harewood, Polly Shannon, Dan Cortese, Olivia D'Abo
description: Having decided to go fishing, four friends (Stu and his girlfriend Julia, Tommy and Gus) rent a boat from a certain Louis Morgan and his girlfriend Charlotte, called Charlie. But after crossing a thick bank of fog, the group finds themselves aboard an old ship of the line that had disappeared several years earlier ...

title: Dak miu mai shing
actors: Jackie Chan, Eric Tsang, Vivian Hsu, Kim Min Jeong, Wu Hsing Kuo
description: Following his hitherto repressed instinct for adventure, the penniless salesman Bei manages to upset the criminal plans of two swindlers. Headlining the headlines as a hero, Bei learns from a private detective that his real father is a wealthy businessman currently dying. Eager to reunite with his parents, Bei joins them in Korea and discovers that both are ... professional spies: thus begins a series of vicissitudes that will take him to Turkey, where he will have to contend with a powerful drug lord ...
notes: Jackie Chan goes ... Jackie Chan, as the film drags on without infamy or praise.

title: The Black Swan
actors: Tyrone Power, Maureen O'Hara, Laird Cregar, Thomas Mitchell
description: Appointed governor of Jamaica, the infamous pirate Henry Morgan entrusts the young Jamie Waring with the task of defeating a frond of former rebel colleagues into whose hands Lady Margaret, the daughter of his predecessor, has fallen ...
notes: Power is expressionless as usual, but there is no shortage of fun. Oscar for photography by Leon Shamroy.

title: The Pentagon Papers
actors: James Spader, Claire Forlani, Paul Giamatti, Alan Arkin, Kenneth Welsh

title: Elephant Juice
actors: Emmanuelle Béart, Sean Gallagher, Daniel Lapaine, Daniela Nardini
description: London: more or less single and more or less neurotic thirty-year-olds navigate between more or less improbable and ephemeral stories. Don Juan Will fell in love with a French woman. Billy believes in love at first sight, but knows it's hard to fall victim to. Frank loves Daphne, but she is quite reluctant. Graham has a crush on a model ten years younger than him ...
notes: Third film by the director of _Fra i Giganti_, he indulges in endless rants in the (unsuccessful) attempt to create a generational and metropolitan fresco. A "tranche de vie" that struggles to overcome the talk show syndrome, professionally performed but cold and soulless.

title: Blizzard
actors: Brenda Blethyn, Zoë Warner, Josh Buckle, Christopher Plummer, Gary Johnston
description: When her best friend Bobby leaves her to move to another city, little Jess can't rest. To console her, eccentric Aunt Millie tells her the story of Katie, a ten-year-old girl fond of ice skating, and Blizzard, a reindeer baby who has just seen the light in the kingdom of Santa Claus ...

title: Mickey's Once Upon a Christmas
directors: Alex Mann, Bill Speers, Toby Shelton, Bradley Raymond, Jun Falkenstein
description: Mickey, Donald and Goofy and all their friends are ready to relive the joy, magic and warmth of Christmas, in three different stories.

title: The Santa Clause 2
actors: David Krumholtz, Tim Allen, Elizabeth Mitchell, Judge Reinhold, Eric Lloyd

title: Pas si méchant que ça
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Marlène Jobert, Dominique Labourier, Jacques Debary
description: When his father's heart disease prevents him from continuing to run the family's small cabinet-making, Pierre has to work hard to avoid the impending bankruptcy. Without mentioning it to anyone, not even his wife Marthe, Pierre therefore dedicated himself to ... armed robbery in the villas in the area: in a short time, the debts were paid off and the workers returned to work normally. But during one of his strokes, Pierre meets the young Nelly, who becomes his lover and his accomplice ...
notes: Usually very caustic with the "perfect" social organization of his country, this time the Genevan Goretta scratches only partially.

title: La Betìa ovvero in amore per ogni gaudenza...
actors: Nino Manfredi, Rosanna Schiaffino, Smoki Samardì, Mario Carotenuto

title: Rupan sansei - Otakara henkyaku daisakusen
description: Lupine I have to rearrange some items stolen by his friend Mark. In return he will be revealed the place where the dark diamond is hidden, a fragment of meteorite that could lead him to a legendary hidden treasure. Along the way, the thief meets Mark's niece Anita ...

title: Rupan sansei: Kariosutoro no shiro
description: Lupine and the faithful Jigen have traced the origin of the counterfeit banknotes that are bringing the world economy to its knees: the village of Cagliostro, governed by the homonymous count. Within the stone walls of his castle, the man keeps the beautiful Princess Clarissa imprisoned, who knows the key to a hidden treasure. Lupine is intent on freeing the girl, punishing the wicked and taking the treasure.
notes: Excellent operation by Mikado and Yamato Video, who refurbish this (first) feature film by Hayao Miyazaki by resetting the dialogues and duplicating them with the original voices of the serial. In truth the cartoon is naive and a little discount the years on the shoulders, but if you love the characters and the not so bitter stroke of the great Miyazaki, everything still becomes very enjoyable and snappy.

title: The Great Northfield, Minnesota Raid
actors: Robert Duvall, Cliff Robertson, Elisha Cook jr., Luke Askew
description: 1876: The bandits led by Jesse James and Cole Younger rob the Northfield bank in the state of Minnesota. Already enlisted in the Confederate ranks in the years of the Civil War, the two turned to crime as a reaction to the speculations perpetrated by the greedy railroad magnates. In preparing the blow, Younger took pains to persuade the owners of the Northfield farms of the extreme safety of the bank's coffers, thereby inducing them to deposit their savings there ...
notes: In full "New Hollywood" climate, Kaufman returns to the events of Jesse James and associates with an attitude that is not at all inclined to the celebration of the myth.

title: Oliver Twist
actors: Alex Trench, Richard Dreyfuss, Elijah Wood, David O'Hara
description: England, 1837: after a series of hardships, the orphan Oliver Twist falls into the clutches of the nasty and greedy Fagin, who enjoys the fruits of the thefts committed by a gang of very young pickpockets; What's more, he also has to endure the bullying of evil stepbrother Monks. In his heart, however, Oliver dreams of escaping that miserable life ...

title: Arlette
actors: Josiane Balasko, Christopher Lambert, Ennio Fantastichini, Stéphane Audran
description: Frank Martin owes a large sum to the Cosa Nostra. He deludes himself to solve his problems by convincing a rich widow to marry him, but his fearsome creditors have better plans for him: he will have to bring to the altar the unsuspecting heiress of a huge fortune (with attached casino), identified in Arlette Bathiat , waitress in a restaurant for truckers.
notes: Specialist Zidi fires a passable comedy, but a little stale-looking, tailor-made by Balasko and on the charm of luxurious locations. Cameo by Stéphane Audran, Chabrol's partner and fetish actress.

title: Rapid Exchange
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Lance Henriksen, Aviva Gale, Matt O'Toole
description: A band of daring air bandits devises a risky plan: to seize a Boeing 747 en route to Europe, on which also travel the beauty of 250 million dollars. But with such a lot of money involved, the outlaws themselves are starting to wonder if they can really trust each other ...

title: Bride & Prejudice
actors: Aishwarya Rai, Martin Henderson, Naveen Andrews, Indira Varma, Namrata Shirodkar
description: Ms. Bakshi is frantically searching for a husband for her four daughters: to the point that when Balraj arrives in town for a wedding, she welcomes him as a gift from heaven for Jaya, the eldest. With Balraj there is his friend Darcy, who is struck by the beautiful and bold Lalita: however, during a vacation, she also meets Johnny Wickham, an attractive tourist whose younger sister Lakhi falls in love ...
notes: Colors, flowers, sweets, fabrics, elephants, beautiful women: despite the pomp, in this adaptation of Jane Austen's _Pride and Prejudice_ there is an air of "poverty", from a year-end party gone bad.

title: Closer
actors: Julia Roberts, Jude Law, Natalie Portman, Clive Owen, Nick Hobbs
description: The chance encounters, the instant attractions and the distracted betrayals of two couples: Anna, Dan, Alice and Larry ...
notes: Among the few able to represent the body of amorous emotions outside the conventions (old and new) of melodramas, Nichols squeezes and nails his quartet of performers in a syncopated succession of narrative climaxes. Portman and Owen are excellent, the only two dealing with characters who really know, as a profession, what leather is; both Law, who keeps a safe distance from her character, and Roberts, who turns off her natural brightness, are less incisive.

title: National Treasure
actors: Nicolas Cage, Diane Kruger, Justin Bartha, Sean Bean, Jon Voight, Harvey Keitel
description: Benjamin Franklin Gates is the latest descendant of a family for six generations engaged in the search for the treasure of the Templars, war booty of the founding fathers of the United States. Benjamin, having learned that the map is hidden on the back of the Declaration of Independence, has to deal with those who would like to get hold of the precious document. He then devises a plan in which technology wizard Riley and Abigail, director of the Washington National Archives collaborate.
notes: The rhythm is fast-paced, the characters are pure narrative functions (Justin Bartha is a good shoulder), the editing is not boring, the music is migraine.

title: Boat Trip
actors: Cuba Gooding jr., Horatio Sanz, Roselyn Sanchez, Vivica A. Fox
description: Jerry and Nick, close friends, have really come to an end: in particular Jerry, who during a balloon ride threw up on his girlfriend just a moment before asking for her hand! To escape the bad luck and harpoon some young ladies, the two decide to book a cruise. But the bad star does not abandon them: in fact, the travel agent to whom they turn is angry with Nick, guilty of having offended his gay lover. So, once on board, the unfortunate cronies begin to realize that among their companions in adventure there is not the shadow of a woman. Rather...
notes: Very coarse-grained comedy.

title: The First $20 Million Is Always the Hardest
actors: Adam Garcia, Rosario Dawson, Jake Busey, Enrico Colantoni
description: Andy is successful in his job, but leaves marketing because he no longer feels in tune with the values ??his father taught him. But at his new workplace, a colleague wants to put him in trouble by assigning him the impossible mission of creating a $ 99 personal computer. The boy, with the help of three computer geniuses, makes it, but falls victim to the speculations of others. Together with the three messed up friends he must find a way out of the impasse.
notes: Sort of "revenge of the nerds", applied to the New Economy of Silicon Valley. Also in the cast are Rosario Dawson and Jake Busey, son of Gary.

title: Une histoire simple
actors: Romy Schneider, Bruno Cremer, Claude Brasseur, Arlette Bonnard, Vera Schroeder, Francine Bergé, Sophie Daumier, Eva Darlan

title: Jack and the Beanstalk: The Real Story
actors: Matthew Modine, Vanessa Redgrave, Mia Sara, Daryl Hannah
description: Wealthy businessman Jack Robinson decided to have the remains of the family's English castle torn down, to build a casino in its place. But the mysterious Countess Wilhelmina reveals a secret to him: centuries ago, Jack's ancestor had climbed a beanstalk to save the country from the oppression of a terrible giant ...

title: Blue Collar
actors: Richard Pryor, Harvey Keitel, Yaphet Kotto, Ed Begley jr., Harry Bellaver

title: Doragon bôru Z: kono yo de ichiban tsuyoi yatsu
description: Freed from his icy grave by trusty assistant Kochin and Dragon Ball, the evil dr. Wheelo sets out to take over the planet, but he needs a new body to house his brain. To this end, Kochin and his androids kidnap Piccolo and Roshi: Goku, Gohan and Krillan must intervene to help their friends ...

title: Les visiteurs en Amérique
actors: Jean Reno, Christian Clavier, Christina Applegate, Malcolm McDowell
description: Persecuted by a witch, Count Thibault and his squire-jester André think it well to turn to a magician: however, something goes wrong and the two are catapulted from the 13th century to the year of grace 2000, with all the consequences of the case ...
notes: Useless re-chewing in Yankee sauce of the 1993 French original.

title: Le lion
actors: Alain Delon, Ornella Muti, Anouchka Delon, Heino Ferch, Putla Sehlapelo
description: Kenya, 1950s: Patricia is ten years old and lives with her parents John and Sybil in the nature reserve administered by her father. Always used to playing carefree with the wild animals of the savannah, Patricia has developed a special relationship with King, a huge lion who over time has become her inseparable companion ...

title: I fratelli Dinamite
description: From an early age, the three Dinamite brothers - sons of a drunkard captain - have combined all the colors. Shipwrecked on a desert island and saved by some hunters who entrusted them to the protection of indulgent Aunt Cloe, the terrible kids grew up free and intolerant of any discipline, to the point of even escaping the Devil himself. After a string of pranks, the trio arrives in Venice during the carnival, where they will be able to redeem themselves by returning a smile to a child ...
notes: Being the first Italian color animated feature film, the film can boast an undoubted historical value. Restored in 2004.

title: Never a Dull Moment
actors: Dick Van Dyke, Edward G. Robinson, Dorothy Provine, Henry Silva
description: While practicing for a role, actor Jack Albany is mistaken for the outlaw "Ace" Williams. When he realizes it, it is too late, so much so that the boss Joe Girasole entrusts him with a delicate task to complete: stealing a van Gogh ...
notes: Farcical tones but without excesses, in perfect Disney style.

title: Prancer Returns
actors: John Corbett, Stacy Edwards, Michael O'Keefe, Jack Palance, Gavin Fink
description: Eight-year-old Charlie Hooper befriends a reindeer cub he met in a clearing. The little boy believes he has found Prancer, the reindeer he was very fond of and lost, and decides to send an e-mail to Santa Claus asking him not to take his new playmate away with him ...
notes: John Corbett stands out among the actors, the interpreter of the lucky _My big fat Greek wedding_ and 22 episodes of the series _Sex and the City_. Directed instead Joshua Butler who has directed several television series. The result is far below expectations.

title: Christmas in Love
actors: Danny DeVito, Christian De Sica, Massimo Boldi, Sabrina Ferilli, Anna Maria Barbera
description: Professor Fabrizio Barbetti, renowned plastic surgeon, continues to hate his wife Lisa deeply despite five years have passed since the stormy divorce. The two carefully avoid meeting, but this Christmas they will end up in the same place with their respective companions ... Guido Baldi, a successful 50-year-old with a beautiful wife and a daughter he adores, embarks on a relationship with a young model. On vacation with her he finds himself in the same house with his daughter and his "old" love. Finally, Concetta sees her dreams come true when she wins the "Christmas with Ridge" contest, a week with Ron Moss, her idol ...
notes: Small pochades of a hundred years ago, in short, without even the slightest cunning reflection of the (worse than) present. The setting in the snowy hotel is pure white telephones, you try to avoid trash and you don't give anything else in return.

title: Ocean's Twelve
actors: Brad Pitt, Catherine Zeta-Jones, George Clooney, Julia Roberts, Matt Damon, Andy Garcia, Vincent Cassel
description: Danny Ocean gathers his team for three new hits that this time target three different cities: Rome, London and Amsterdam. Meanwhile, Terry Benedict, owner of the casino in Las Vegas burglarized in the past by Danny, wants his 160 million dollars back and prepares his terrible revenge ...
notes: The film is a documentary about a team of actors who, rather than act, stand on show and pose, interpret without identifying with the characters, distort their roles, parade in the streets of Rome, on the canals of Amsterdam, on the streets of Paris, on the banks of Lake Como for a relaxed crime comedy, for a hit from the usual suspects.

title: Tu la conosci Claudia?
actors: Aldo Baglio, Giovanni Storti, Giacomo Poretti, Paola Cortellesi
description: 600 Giovanni, married to Claudia, is a man of habit who considers himself miraculous just because he is her husband; Giacomo, separated and satisfied with his life, when he meets Claudia he realizes he has nothing; Aldo, a taxi driver who falls in love easily, has been living only for Claudia for some time ...
notes: Missing are the film - because the characters are groping in the dark, even Cortellesi, all in search of an author - and a vague idea of ??"dramaturgy". For three actors who arrive from the theater, it is even more serious. Claim, Aldo Giovanni & Giacomo, an idea of ??light and artisanal cinema. You said nothing. Here the raw material is missing: a story to tell. And then, the "small white world" in which they move, where everyone is basically good and the quarrels are friendly, more like the nativity scene than Milan or Italy.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
actors: Gerard Butler, Emmy Rossum, Patrick Wilson, Miranda Richardson, Minnie Driver
description: Erik, a disfigured boy wanders with his face covered by a mask behind the scenes of the Paris Opera, sowing terror. The only person he cares about is Christine, who he is in love with.
notes: The musical score draws, the scenographic system is sumptuous and deliberately kitsch. One of the problems (and has no extenuating circumstances) of the film branded with the name of Webber, is the very modest direction of Schumacher. Boring, immobile, dazed. A direction inferior to the inventions, dynamism and twists of the theatrical productions of the musical.

title: The Dinosaur Hunter
actors: Alison Pill, Bill Switzer, Simon MacCorkindale, Christopher Plummer
description: Julia who lives on a Canadian farm with her brother Daniel meets Jack, an archaeologist looking for dinosaur bones. His dream is to find the complete skeleton of a prehistoric animal. Julia and Daniel, involved in his search, have to deal with Hump intent on stealing the artifacts found by Jack.

title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Invisible Man
actors: Bud Abbott, Lou Costello, Nancy Guild, Arthur Franz, Adele Jergens
description: Gianni and Pinotto are two bizarre private investigators on the trail of a boxing champion, wrongly accused of having committed a murder. The problem is that the boxer, due to a serum, has acquired the gift of invisibility and, therefore, is hardly identifiable for everyone. Including Gianni and Pinotto.
notes: Comedy at the minimum terms for the two followers of Stanlio and Ollio. Nothing panache in the gags, which struggle to find their own territory of satire and, consequently, their audience to retain. Only the rhythm is pressing, while the components of the film language (editing, direction ...) are to be considered accessory elements of secondary importance.

title: Melinda and Melinda
actors: Radha Mitchell, Will Ferrell, Chloë Sevigny, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Amanda Peet
description: A couple organizes a dinner for a film producer: at a certain point an old friend, Melinda, appears unexpectedly and begins to tell her story as a single, alone and without a place to stay. It is the beginning of a series of acquaintances, loves, entanglements and betrayals, examined from the point of view of comedy and tragedy ...
notes: Allen knows which actors to call on the set (here they all integrate very well with the company, in particular Will Ferrell and Chlöe Sevigny) and moves between the two narrative registers with an expertise, a confidence and an intelligence that no longer amaze, but that it is foolish to treat with disdain (especially when you see so many out-of-the-box scripts around). Watching the film we often smile, we think every now and then, we become aware of "being on stage" even if we are in the audience. Despite appearances, the assonances with _Sliding Doors_ and _Smoking _ / _ No Smoking_ are quite random.

title: The Grudge
actors: Sarah Michelle Gellar, Jason Behr, Clea DuVall, Bill Pullman, Ryo Ishibashi, Yoko Maki
description: Young Karen, in Japan for a cultural exchange, agrees to replace a nurse who has not shown up for work. Thus he makes the acquaintance of Emma, ??an elderly American lady in a catatonic state who lives in a deserted and messy house. While taking care of the woman, Karen hears noises coming from the upper floor: she will have to deal with a series of horrors unleashed by an episode that happened years before ...
