notes: Identical to the film of which it is the remake (_Ju-on - Rancore_, of 2003) and shot by Shimizu himself, _The Grudge_ is pure theoretical cinema that uncovers the failure - now and always - to remake a world and a culture that they are not their own. But Japanese people also die in the film, so how do we put it? We put it that this thesis is illusory madness, that _The Grudge_ is not Van Sant's _Psycho_, that it goes nowhere, that tedious as death and that it seems the rigid and mathematical essay of a student of a film fear course. We then say it with all possible respect: the Gellar is literally unwatchable. If this is the new horror heroine, first get someone like Linnea Quigley out of the closet: at least she screamed better ...

title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
country: Great Britain, France, Germany, Ireland, United States
actors: Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant, Gemma Jones, Jim Broadbent
description: Bridget Jones and Mark Darcy are happy and in love. Everything goes smoothly until a new intern shows up in Mark's studio: a beautiful and intelligent woman who undermines Bridget's certainties. But Daniel Clever, Bridget's former boss, also shows up ...
notes: _What a mess, Bridget Jones! _, Underneath, tells just this: how does a girl size 46 survive among chromosomally perfect sylphs, how a bum juggles in refined and prevailing minimalism, how a petty bourgeois can hold onto a high-ranking snob. This is why it is a much less soothing and comic film than the previous one, with a heroine of such disastrous clumsiness as to make every process of identification somewhat harsh (and highly self-critical). Less brilliant and smooth (but perhaps more interesting) than the first film, it is a prelude to the third chapter of Bridget's story: Helen Fielding has not yet published it, but already rumored around that it is much more bad and bitter than the previous two .

title: Ae Fond Kiss...,
country: Great Britain, Belgium, Germany, Italy, Spain
actors: Atta Yaqub, Eva Birthistle, Shabana Bakhsh, Gerard Kelly
description: Casim Khan, of Pakistani origin, lives in Glasgow where he acts as a DJ in the hottest clubs in the city. His parents, Tariq and Sadia, are practicing Muslims and would like Casim to marry his cousin Jasmine, who will soon arrive in England. But when Casim meets Roisin, a teacher in his sister's school, the two fall in love, but their respective communities struggle to accept him.
notes: Muslim rigidity, Catholic prejudices, lightning vacations to the sea seasoned with lies and revelations, the intrusions of Casim's elder sister who sees her coveted wedding in danger: these are some of the themes of one of Loach's ugliest films.

title: Christmas with the Kranks
actors: Tim Allen, Jamie Lee Curtis, Dan Aykroyd, M. Emmet Walsh, Elizabeth Franz, Kevin Chamberlin, Julie Gonzalo, René Lavan, Erik Per Sullivan, Austin Pendleton
description: Fed up with the commercialization of Christmas, Luther and Nora Krank go on vacation to escape their end-of-year obligations. But when suddenly the daughter decides to spend the holidays with the family, Luther and Nora, reluctantly, must take action to make the house welcoming ...
notes: The cast works, but Roth's direction is completely irremediable, for whom the word "time" does not seem to exist: the camera is perpetually delayed in the rhythm of the lines, the gags are diluted, even the gaps between a scene and the other are painstakingly slowed down. Italian dubbing does not help, but for once it is not the main cause of the disaster.

title: The Lion King II: Simba's Pride
description: Simba and Nala have a daughter, Kiara. Timon and Pumbaa are in charge of babysitting her but the little girl escapes by venturing alone into the forbidden land. There he meets Kovu, a lion cub, and the two become friends. What little Kiara and her family don't know is that Kovu is the son of Zira, an exiled follower of the late Scar. Zira's plan is to make her son Kovu king, supplanting Simba.

title: Auch Engel wollen nur das Eine
actors: Thomas Heinze, Esther Schweins, Steffen Groth, Anna Thalbach
description: Daphne and Tom are about to pronounce the fateful yes, but between them the atmosphere is far from idyllic: she is sure that her future husband is not faithful to her and demands an immediate confession. The quarrel becomes so heated as to cause a fatal accident: between the two, however, the accounts remain pending even in the afterlife ...

title: Mad About Mambo
actors: William Ash, Keri Russell, Paul McLean, Russell Smith, Joe Rea
description: Danny, a student of a Catholic school, dreams of becoming a great footballer. Convinced that the practice of dance can help him perfect his agility and reflexes, he enrolls in a mambo course where he meets the pretty Lucy, with whom he will eventually fall in love ...
notes: Dignified sports-dance fairytale.

title: Mikaël
actors: Walter Slezak, Benjamin Christensen, Nora Grégor, Max Auzinger, Robert Garrison
description: The relationship between the young pupil Michael and the painter Zoret, his teacher, is ambiguous. In fact, Zoret adopted him as his son, but his affection is misplaced: in fact, as soon as Lucia Zamikoff, a Russian princess, covets him, the young painter runs away with her, stealing moreover a painting to which the old master was immensely linked. . Zoret's pain is great. Only his faithful friend Swift, an American journalist, remains to console him. But the artist also finds refuge in art: he will paint a last intense picture that depicts a man alone on the beach and will be able to face solitude and death with serenity.

title: Sons of Mistletoe
actors: Roma Downey, George Newbern, Scott Terra, Cathy Lee Crosby
description: Christmas is upon us, but the "Mistletoe" shelter for boys has a big problem: there is a lack of funds, because the generous benefactor Harold is dead and the subsidies are on the run. Now the fate of the young and unfortunate guests is in the hands of Helen, the daughter of the tycoon, who inherited his business ...

title: Promises
directors: Carlos Bolardo, B.Z. Goldberg, Justine Shapiro
description: Between 1995 and 1998, the three directors followed seven children born and raised in Jerusalem, some Jews and others Arabs, from different backgrounds and social classes. Each of them tells their own story, indirectly confirming how deep - and almost incurable - the rift that tears the Middle East has become.

title: Yaju no seishun
actors: Jô Shishido, Ikuko Kimuro, Misako Watanabe, Seijun Suzuki

title: The Diary of Ellen Rimbauer
actors: Steven Brand, Lisa Brenner, Kate Burton, Tsodii Le Loka, Brad Greenquist

title: Intruder
actors: Elizabeth Cox, Renée Estevez, Dan Hicks, David Byrnes, Sam Raimi

title: Subarnarekha
actors: Madhabi Mukherjee, Abhi Bhattacharya, Satindra Bhattacharya
description: 1948: the division of Bengal between India and Pakistan causes the exodus of an immense number of Hindu refugees. Among these is Ishwar, who settles in a village on the banks of the Subarna River with his little sister Shita and Abhiram, a small refugee whose mother has been kidnapped ...
notes: A milestone in Indian cinema.

title: Michurin
actors: Grigorij Belov, Sergey Bondarchuk, Fëdor Grigorev, Vladimir Isaev
description: The professional and human story of the Russian biologist Ivan Vladimirovic Michurin (1855-1935), through whom Dovzenko expresses his hopes "on the modernization of agriculture, on gardening, on the transformation of nature".
notes: Third to last film - and first in color - made by the master of _La terra_ and _Arsenale_.

title: Astenicheskij sindrom
actors: Olga Antonova, Sergej Popov, Galina Zakhurdaeva, Natalja Buzko
description: The medical term of the title designates what was once known as "hypochondria" or "melancholy". Now the teacher Nikolaj suffers from it, daily busy facing a group of students of rare indifference. But perhaps society as a whole is afflicted by it ...
notes: A hyper-realistic, sharp, wholesome disturbing film.

title: Malta Story
actors: Alec Guinness, Jack Hawkins, Anthony Steel, Muriel Pavlow
description: 1942: due to its strategic position, the island of Malta has become fundamental for both sides, which compete for control. Against this background the relationship between a RAF lieutenant and a Maltese girl is grafted.
notes: The reconstruction of the war scenarios is accurate, thanks also to the use of archival materials.

title: Don Quixote
actors: John Lithgow, Bob Hoskins, Isabella Rossellini, Vanessa Williams
description: An avid devourer of ancient adventurous texts, Alonso Quixada decides one day to transform himself into a knight-errant with the name of Don Quixote de la Mancha. Chosen as squire the fellow citizen Sancho Panza, he will travel the dusty streets of Spain to conquer the glory and the heart of Dulcinea del Toboso, the Beauty among the Beauties ...

title: La gorilla
actors: Lory Del Santo, Tullio Solenghi, Giorgio Bracardi, Gianfranco D'Angelo

title: Blague dans le coin
actors: Fernandel, Eliane D'Almeida, Perrette Pradier, Billy Kearns, Karl Studer
description: The capital of gambling is in turmoil: the truce between Lippy and Stenberg, the two largest owners of gambling establishments in the city, is about to collapse due to sabotage and blackmail perpetrated by a third party. And when Jeff, an elderly French comedian, enters the scene, the situation worsens ...
notes: Only for spectators with a very good mouth.

title: Sungnyangpali sonyeoui jaerim
actors: Yim Eun Kyung, Kim Hyun Sung, Kim Jin Pyo, Jin Sing
description: Ju, a young pizza runner passionate about video games finds himself dragged into a world that is just that of an extremely realistic video game. The purpose assigned to him is to prevent others, besides him, from freezing a small and diaphanous match girl, but the game becomes complicated when Ju falls in love with the girl.
notes: Advertised as a mix of mystical Taoism and techno-culture, the film, despite some confusion in the narrative, feels more like a reflection on the craft of living and a current redefinition of the fable that still maintains Andersen's bitter tone but to which it adds a look ironic, perhaps the only way to dominate reality and not be overwhelmed by it.

title: Corps et âmes
actors: Hélène de Fougerolles, Jean-Marie Lamour, Jean-Yves Berteloot
description: The beautiful hostess Lisa has recently crowned her dream of love with Gilles, whom she met just a year earlier. But one day, while she is accompanying a group of businessmen to Limoges, the girl sees a banal wedding image in a photographer's window: the man on the altar is Gilles, but there is another woman at his side. ...

title: Privideniye, kotoroye ne vozvrashchayetsya
actors: Boris Ferdinandov, Maksim Shtraukh, Dmitri Vvedenskij, Olga Zhizneva
description: Obtained a day off to visit his family, a prisoner takes a train bound for his country of origin. But the guardian who escorts him, determined to compromise him, narcotizes him: once he gets off at a later station, the prisoner will walk home, where he will lead a strike ...
notes: A story with strong tones, energetic and well-paced.

title: Riflessi di luce
actors: Laura Gemser, Pamela Prati, Gabriele Tinti, Loredana Romito
description: Widowed and paralyzed following a dramatic accident, a well -known composer spends his days in his suburban villa, confined to a wheelchair. With him live his young companion and his twenty -year -old son, who shortly thereafter a relationship ...
notes: The film is what it is, but the Geser never disappoints.

title: Silent Trigger
actors: Dolph Lundgren, Gina Bellman, Conrad Dunn, Emma Stevens
description: Waxman, a former member of the special forces, is hired by an agency that deals with commissioned murders. But when he and his partner Clegg refuse to perform an impossible mission, their bosses decide to add the two to the list of "eliminables" ...
notes: One of the lowest points in the career of the director of _Razorback_.

title: Hot Enough for June
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Sylva Koscina, Robert Morley, Leo McKern, Roger Delgado
description: Hired thanks to his knowledge of the Czech language, the currently unemployed English writer Nicholas Whistler believes he was sent to Prague to carry out industrial espionage. The man is unaware that he is actually acting on behalf of Her Majesty's Intelligence, and that the beautiful Vlasta Simonova, who drives him around the city, is herself a secret agent ...
notes: Scripted by Lukas Heller (from a Lionel Davidson novel), a passable "spy" comedy. The specialist Thomas can count on an impeccable Bogarde, a splendid Koscina and a side cast that lines up some old lions of British cinema and theater.

title: The Lion King 11/2
description: Timon and Pumbaa reveal where they came from, when they met, and how they helped Simba save the Serengeti.
notes: Following the story of Timon and Pumbaa, we retrace some of the most important events of the Lion King, seen however from the bizarre perspective of the two of them.

title: Try Seventeen
actors: Elijah Wood, Franka Potente, Mandy Moore, Chris William Martin, Deborah Harry

title: Imperia la grande cortigiana
actors: Manuela Arcuri, Antonio Giuliani, Filippo Valle, Paolo Triestino, Sergio Assisi, Giuseppe De Rosa, Isabella Orsini, Oreste Lionello, Pier Maria Cecchini
description: Rome, early sixteenth century. The most admired courtesan of the moment is called Imperia and lives near Castel Sant'Angelo. The woman is the lover of Agostino Chigi, the greatest banker in Christendom, whose income reaches eight hundred thousand gold ducats a year, making him one of the most powerful men in the city. Imperia, however, is in love with Angelo del Bufalo, less rich, but handsome in appearance and endowed with considerable charm. At the great Chigi party, Imperia thinks she has recognized the mysterious man who saved her from a bad encounter the day before. Between the two, now engaged in dance, a spark of sympathy immediately strikes. Who will be the charming knight?

title: Lucie Aubrac
actors: Carole Bouquet, Daniel Auteuil, Patrice Chéreau, Jean-Roger Milo
description: Lyon, March 1943. Raymond Samuel and his wife Lucie are part of the Resistance fighting against the Nazi occupation. On 21 June the man is arrested by the Gestapo, with Jean Moulin (known by his nom de guerre Max) and other comrades, in Caluire, during a secret meeting. Lucie will do anything to try to free her husband from the clutches of the Nazi regime's political police.
notes: Claude Berri (_Jean de Florette_, _Manon delle sources_ and _Uranus_) took the subject from the autobiographical book of Lucie Aubrac. Carole Bouquet and Daniel Auteuil are perfect in the roles of Lucie and Raymond.

title: The Wisher
actors: Ron Silver, Liane Balaban, Drew Lachey, Siri Baruc, Billy Morton
description: Mary, a horror film enthusiast, often has nightmares and suffers from bouts of sleepwalking. But her passion is so great that she agrees to go with her friends to the cinema to see _The Wisher_. The story tells of a spirit that satisfies the desires of those who evoke it. From that moment Mary is haunted by a mysterious figure, ready to fulfill her every wish in a decidedly macabre way. The girl must be able to find out who this individual is and above all how to stop him. The solution perhaps lies between the frames of the film.
notes: Gavin Wilding (_La casa di Cristina_) is shooting this decidedly unambitious slasher-movie.

title: Briciole
actors: Claudia Zanella, Gabriele Mainetti, Franco Castellano, Elisabetta Cavallotti, Francesca Figus
description: Sandra is eighteen, she is smart, pretty and has a family who adore her. Nonetheless, there is a problem that haunts her: losing weight, losing weight. Day after day, seeing the scales go down gives her strength and security: but the obstinate refusal of food can turn, almost imperceptibly, into a death trap ...

title: Porto das Caixas
actors: Irma Álvarez, Reginaldo Farias, Paulo Padilha, Sergio Sanz, Joseph Guerreiro
description: Determined to end a bond now impossible to bear, Irma is looking for an accomplice that helps her to suppress the sinister and reprehensible spouse. To reach her, she will use her seduction, but the situation will escape her hand ...
notes: A raw and blood drama, inspired by a fact that really happened in Rio de Janeiro in the 1950s.

title: Blade af Satans Bog
actors: Helge Nissen, Halvard Hoff, Jacob Texière, Hallander Helleman
description: The persistence of Evil in the world in four episodes, placed in as many historical periods. But after three triumphs (Judas betraying Jesus, a monk who tortures an alleged witch, a servant who denounces his masters to the Jacobins), the latest satanic design fails ...
notes: Second film by Dreyer, inspired by the Griffithian _Intolerance_.

title: Blow Dry
actors: Alan Rickman, Natasha Richardson, Rachel Griffiths, Rachael Leigh Cook, Josh Hartnett
description: The annual British Barbershop Championship lands in Keighley, but the town lacks a candidate to match: the shop of Phil, former hairdresser prodigy, and his son Brian has been in rather run-down since ex-wife Shelly opened a shop. beauty salon with his mistress Sandra. But when she is diagnosed with cancer, Shelly decides to go home and so the family is reunited and ready to fight ...
notes: Comedy signed by the director of _The amateurs_ and the screenwriter of_Full Monty_, of which he tries to repeat the mix of competition, proletarian environment, melodrama and "camp" taste: with less striking, but enjoyable results.

title: Shunpu den
actors: Yumiko Nogawa, Tamio Kawaji, Hiroshi Cho, Hideaki Esumi
description: World War II: abandoned by her beloved, the prostitute Harumi sneaks into a brothel of a military outpost. He gets into the good graces of the Chinese command, but falls in love with Mikami and forms a clandestine relationship with him. Tragedy is around the corner.

title: Saw
actors: Leigh Whannell, Cary Elwes, Danny Glover, Ken Leung, Monica Potter
description: A serial killer known only as Jigsaw has devised a series of grisly games for his victims to have them either kill each other or make extreme choices without him being directly involved. But on the trail of Jigsaw are two skilled detectives, Tapp and Sing.
notes: A game that in its unpredictability reserves surprises, perhaps sometimes predictable, but functional. And then _Saw - The Riddler_ has the guts to go all the way, both from the visual point of view (he doesn't skimp on truculence and frankness), and from the moral one. The figure of the killer remains in the shadows, and this helps in the construction of his myth, from which numerous sequels will emerge, however fairly successful.

title: Alexander
country: United States, Great Britain, Germany, Netherlands
actors: Colin Farrell, Anthony Hopkins, Angelina Jolie, Val Kilmer, Jared Leto, Rosario Dawson
description: The story of Alexander III of Macedon (356-323 BC), king and great leader who, having ascended the throne when he was just twenty, subdued much of the then known world.
notes: Stone wanted to bring out the hidden and problematic sides of man, his disorientation in front of the cultures he crossed, his submerged childhood legacies; but even among these he moves cumbersome, without being able to throw either a hero or a cursed character. Charmed by the raging voice off of the old Ptolemy (Anthony Hopkins), the only follower of ripe old age, who tells the story of Alexander's adventure in flashbacks, the film trudges pleonastic for 175 minutes.

title: Private
actors: Tomer Russo, Lior Miller, Areen Omari, Mohammad Bakri, Hend Ayoub
description: Mohammed lives with his wife and five children in a house located between a Palestinian village and an Israeli settlement. The house becomes a highly strategic place and is occupied by the army. But despite the invasion of Israeli soldiers, Mohammed refuses to leave ...
notes: What is the right position, ethically and politically correct, in which to place the camera when framing the edges, outlines, collateral damage, less known and very often invisible, of a war? Saverio Costanzo in his valuable and important debut film (Golden Leopard and award for actor Mohammad Bakri at the 2004 Locarno Festival) seems to ask himself this question in every shot, in every overrun of the field (to be understood here not in the sense of strictly technical, but the field is cultural and anthropological) and before giving his talented (at least in the original version) actors-people the action and the stop. The exact and axiomatic answer, according to the director, does not exist (it is not unthinkable that it never existed). It is an ontological question that requires a language made up of tears, of visual reticence, of a use, sonorous and threatening, of the home run, of an excited and outlined sounding of the time of the narration and of the time narrated.

title: Into the Arms of Strangers: Stories of the Kindertransport
description: In the nine months leading up to the outbreak of the Second World War, ten thousand Jewish children were made to flee by their parents from Germany, Austria and Czechoslovakia to England. The film tells their stories: from their inclusion in foster families, to attempts to reunite with loved ones at the end of the war.

title: Fatti di gente perbene
actors: Giancarlo Giannini, Catherine Deneuve, Fernando Rey, Tina Aumont
description: Bologna 1902. In a patrician house the body of Count Francesco is found, pierced by thirteen stabs. Shortly after, Augusto Murri, the countess's father-in-law, goes to the police and declares that his son Tullio is responsible for the murder.
notes: Taken from a true fact, the story is reconstructed with narrative subtlety.

title: La minorenne
actors: Gloria Guida, Rosemary Dexter, Marco Guglielmi, Luciano Roffi
description: Valeria returns home after growing up in the college. To welcome her there is her Catholic family but the girl's main thought is to lose virginity and have fun. Soon, however, he discovers the mother's betrayal against his father and the perverse intentions of his brother.

title: Nicotina
actors: Diego Luna, Marta Belaustegui, Lucas Crespi, Jesús Ochoa, Rafael Inclán
description: Lolo, an expert hacker who manages to infiltrate any computer, one day makes a serious mistake. Thus chaos breaks out in Mexico City, in the streets of which a woman, a gangster, a Russian mafioso, a hairdresser and a pharmacist battle to recover twenty mysteriously disappeared diamonds ...
notes: This Mexican pulp seasoned in chili sauce with the usual ingredients (Elmore Leonard, Tarantino and in addition _Amores perros_) is pleasant in its digressions, in that long sequence of home harassment via webcam that seems to have no connection with the plot, in the fresh faces of its protagonists, especially Diego Luna. For the rest, the mechanism is well known and the story quite inconsistent.

title: 36, Quai des Orfèvres
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Gérard Depardieu, André Dussollier, Valeria Golino
description: For some months some criminals have spread terror in Paris. Whoever manages to defeat the fearsome gang will become the head of the Judicial Police (based at number 36 of Quai des Orfèvres). The war between Léo Vrinks, head of the anti-crime team and Denis Klein, who heads the investigation team, is so open.
notes: Of course, Marchal is an excellent "action" director, and there is something to enjoy here, but it is the human and inhuman paths that sand the soul. They are the tears of one of the most beautiful funerals ever seen in the cinema or the dull intensity of certain passages, certain glances, certain phrases whispered in the ear, full of allusions. In the second part, when Auteuil seems to end up in Monte Cristo forever and Depardieu's betrayal cries out for vengeance to heaven, some narrative implications become cumbersome. But it is nothing, an excess of love towards a story that is one's own, and for this reason one would never want to give up. Up to the phrase whispered by Auteuil in the toilet ("If you can't get the first bullet, there are thirteen more"), however, a beautiful polar.

title: Ray
actors: Jamie Foxx, Kerry Washington, Regina King, Clifton Powell, Aunjanue Ellis, Harry Lennix, Bokeem Woodbine, Sharon Warren, C.J. Sanders, Curtis Armstrong, Richard Schiff, Larenz Tate, Terrence Howard
description: The life of Ray Charles: from his birth in Albany, in the middle of the Depression, to the tragedy of his little brother who died drowned; from the illness that makes him blind at the age of seven to the signing of a contract with Atlantic that marks the beginning of a legendary career ...
notes: Honest work of historical and psychological reconstruction, obviously supported by a fantastic musical column (God forbid!), The film does not escape the hagiographic trend that distinguishes the majority of "biopics" (especially if made while the character is still alive, but not only). The condescension towards his hero, without erasing his vices, nevertheless tends to smooth out the edges and justify his shortcomings. The visual style adapts, softening and diluting. Impressive is the interpretation of Jamie Foxx, who does not "do" but "is" Ray Charles.

title: Little Black Book
actors: Brittany Murphy, Holly Hunter, Kathy Bates, Ron Livingston, Julianne Nicholson
description: Stacy Holt, producer of a TV talk show, can't stand her boyfriend Derek refusing to talk about his exes. Encouraged by a colleague, Stacy takes Derek's PDA to find out about his love past. Using the show as a ploy, he begins interviewing the old flames and realizes that the past is closer than he thought ...
notes: A bittersweet romantic comedy (perhaps not so indirectly inspired by one of the trashy TV and fake reality show crusaders, Jerry Springer) that was a half flop in the US and failed to raise Brittany Murphy's prices.

title: Chasing Papi
actors: Roselyn Sanchez, Sofia Vergara, Jaci Velasquez, Eduardo Verástegui
description: Lorena, an attractive Chicago lawyer, Cici, a barman in a Miami club, and the wealthy New Yorker Patrizia discover that they are all married to Papi, a Los Angeles playboy of South American origin. The three girls decide to join forces to teach him a lesson. On the advice of Walter Mercado, a well-known astrologer and owner of a successful television column, they go to Los Angeles. Lorena, Cici and Patrizia will soon find themselves in the middle of a wild adventure and will have to deal with strange and dangerous characters.
notes: Funny "Latin" comedy directed by television director Linda Mendoza, in her first film destined for cinemas.

title: I ragazzi di via Panisperna
actors: Andrea Prodan, Ennio Fantastichini, Laura Morante, Michele Melega
description: 1934, Rome: sincere but not always happy friendship between Enrico Fermi and Ettore Majorana, souls of the physics research group called _The boys of via Panisperna_, to discover slow neutrinos, which are then essential for nuclear energy.
notes: Gianni Amelio, against everyone's will, Rai screenwriters and producers let Enrico Fermi and Ettore Majorana be simply Enrico and Ettore. As in Open Doors, History is reduced to a minimum, those of men and women (a great Virna Lisi), with their name and their soul. Popular success: the TV version had 6 million viewers. _The second part will air on Sunday 13 May at the same time_.

title: I ragazzi della Roma violenta
actors: Gino Milli, Cristina Businari, Emilio Lo Curcio, Sara Crespi

title: I ragazzi del massacro
actors: Pier Paolo Capponi, Susan Scott, Marzio Margine, Renato Lupi
description: Milan, suburbs. A group of stoned classmates kidnap, rape and kill the teacher. Investigate Duca Lamberti, who will find himself having to deal with a wall of "rubber" and silence as not even in Palermo.
notes: And therefore, the Milanese do not kill only on Saturdays, to quote Giorgio Scerbanenco from whose homonymous novel the film is based. The most popular work by Fernando di Leo (by the critics of the time) does not actually hold up to comparison with his other noirs (_Milano calibro 9_, _Il Boss_, _La mala ordina _...). In fact, there is an evident "sociological" ambition. Still, more than decent.

title: In Enemy Hands
actors: William H. Macy, Til Schweiger, Scott Caan, Thomas Kretschmann, Lauren Holly, Connor Donne
description: During the Second World War, the submarine conflict between the United States and Germany reaches the height of its intensity. After a bloody and spectacular fight, the US submarine Swordfish is sunk by the Nazi U-boat 429, and the few survivors are taken prisoner. On board the enemy ship, the Americans try to sabotage its maneuvers: however, an epidemic of meningitis and repeated attacks by the Allies endanger the survival of crew and prisoners, forcing everyone to unite to save their lives ...
notes: Giglio fails to add anything that goes beyond the stereotypes of the war-submarine genre.

title: I ragazzi di Bandiera gialla
actors: Gianni Pettenati, Gianni Boncompagni, Lucio Dalla, Patty Pravo

title: River's Edge
actors: Dennis Hopper, Crispin Glover, Keanu Reeves, Ione Skye, Daniel Roebuck
description: A group of high school kids have to deal with Jamie's death, killed almost for fun by their friend Samson, who then abandoned his body on the river bank. The reactions are different: while Layne tries to protect Samson, the others believe it is better to turn to the police. Things get complicated when Matt's younger brother learns of the murder ...
notes: Excellent cast of very young people - even if Hopper shines on everyone -, for a film that deals with violence without moralistic tirades. Scripted by Neal Jimenez with the objective gaze of those who spare comments, it is based on a fact that really happened.

title: I Was a Teenage Zombie
actors: Steve McCoy, Michael Rubin, Cassie Madden, Ken Baggett

title: The Devil's Arithmetic
actors: Kirsten Dunst, Brittany Murphy, Paul Freeman, Mimi Rogers
description: Hannah, a teenager of Jewish origin, is somewhat intolerant of her family's religious and cultural heritage. However, this attitude is destined to change radically when suddenly Hannah finds herself catapulted into the horrors of a Nazi prison camp in Poland in 1941 ...

title: Quicksand
actors: Mickey Rooney, Jeanne Cagney, Peter Lorre, Barbara Bates

title: Violentata sulla sabbia
actors: Carole André, Kiki Caron, Angelo Infanti, Marisa Solinas

title: Péril en la demeure
actors: Anémone, Richard Bohringer, Nicole Garcia, Michel Piccoli, Christophe Malavoy
description: Guitarist David goes to Julia's house who asked him to give lessons to his daughter Viviane. The dissatisfied and casual woman, since the industrial husband is often absent for work, becomes the musician's lover. From this moment on David is involved in a perverse game that will involve him more and more.
notes: Deville engages in a thriller that has the tones of comedy and in which the characters play a leading role in the story told.

title: Mekagojira no gyakushu
actors: Katsuhiko Sasaki, Tomoko Ai, Akihiko Hirata, Katsumasa Uchida

title: Libera, amore mio!
actors: Adolfo Celi, Bruno Cirino, Bekim Fehmiu
description: Zanoni Matteo lives in Rome together with Libera-Anarchia Valente, with whom he had two children: Carlo and Anna. The woman, daughter of an anarchist exiled to Ustica by fascism, is unable to remain silent and, before ending up in confinement for 5 years, she is sent with her family to Livorno and then to Modena, where she is targeted. by political commissioner Franco Testa. Once the war has broken out, Matteo tries to get by in some way by moving to Padua. Carlo became a youngster, he plays in the Resistance; Libera supplies weapons to the partisans. Several comrades die in reprisals or in the summary and brutal executions of the Nazi-Fascists. After the war, Carlo himself frees his mother from the Paduan prison where she ended up. Rebuilt the family, Libera discovers that the Testa sits again in the housing office of the town hall. Unnecessary protests are raised, she falls on the street under the blows of a fascist sniper.

title: Max mon amour
actors: Charlotte Rampling, Anthony Higgins, Diana Quick, Pierre Etaix

title: Difendo il mio amore
actors: Martine Carol, Gabriele Ferzetti, Charles Vanel, Vittorio Gassman, Arnoldo Foà
description: A Milanese journalist on the hunt for fame scraps the documents of old trials to publish them in his newspaper in tabloid and ruthless articles. One of these brings to light the murky story of Elena, involved in a crime of passion years before. The reporter's insinuations undermine Elena's marriage to Pietro, who comes to doubt that he is the real father of their little daughter ...
notes: Mélo tearjerker scripted by Suso Cecchi d'Amico, with a tasty Vittorio Gassman in the role of the ambitious and unscrupulous hack. The direction is attributed to Giulio Macchi, but was most likely directed by the American Vincent Sherman, who appears in the titles as a supervisor.

title: Expose Me, Lovely
actors: Jennifer Welles, Jody Maxwell Cary Lacy, Ras Kean, Eve Adams

title: Hitler's Children
actors: H. B. Warner, Tim Holt, Bonita Granville, Otto Kruger, Lloyd Corrigan
description: Berlin, 1933: the US school of prof. Nichols stands door to door with a section of the "Hitlerjügend", the Hitler youth. Between Karl, a member of the latter, and the German-American Anna a relationship is born that is destined to end tragically ...
notes: A propaganda drama, shot in the middle of the war.

title: Memoria - I sopravvissuti raccontano
description: An absolutely unique historical document, which collects the testimonies of the Italian Jewish deportees in Auschwitz. It is a series of interviews with the last 90 survivors for that terrible and unspeakable experience, the only ones still alive (of the approximately 800 freed) at the time of the making of the film.

title: Spartan
actors: Val Kilmer, Derek Luke, Tia Texada, Jeremie Campbell
description: Secret agent Robert Scott is given the task of investigating the mysterious disappearance of Laura Newton, the daughter of a big shot in the White House. The girl has been kidnapped, but with the passage of time the situation is destined to get complicated and to reveal a conspiracy of great proportions ...
notes: Thriller about the inevitable self-awareness of a fade, the one that concerns Scott, and the one that concerns us. The conclusion, in a deserted and post-atomic Piccadilly Circus, seems to come from a cold war spy. Mamet's film looks our age in the face, and never laughs. Nice cast, tight dialogue and great music by Mark Isham.

title: San geng
directors: Peter Chan, Kim Ji-woon, Nonzee Nimibutr
actors: Kim Hye-su, Jeong Bo-seok, Suwinit Panjamawat, Leon Lai
description: Memories. A woman wakes up in the street not knowing why she is there, or how she got there. Meanwhile, the husband does not remember why his wife went missing. _The Wheel_. Cursed puppets cause fires, possessions and nightmares in a small Thai community. _Going Home_. While searching for his missing son, a policeman is kidnapped by a man who keeps his dead wife at home, believing he can rise again.
notes: Episode film that brings together three Asian directors from different countries and with very different styles. Overall discontinuous but offers an interesting and evocative journey into oriental horror cinema. Also distributed as _Three ... Extremes 2_.

title: The Prisoner of Zenda
actors: Peter Sellers, Elke Sommer, Gregory Sierra, Lynne Frederick
description: Two suitors compete for the throne of Ruritania, an imaginary central European state, following the death of the sovereign Rudolph IV, who died in a hot-air balloon accident. Illegitimate son Michael kidnaps first heir Rudolph V and imprisons him in his castle. But the situation becomes complicated when Sidney suddenly appears, a Rudolph V double who works as a coachman by profession ...
notes: Not excellent, it is certainly the worst of the five films based on Anthony Hope's swashbuckling novel, despite the presence of Peter Sellers. Tired actors and dragged rhythm. Far from the levels of the 1937 version directed by John Cromwell.

title: Alla luce del sole
actors: Luca Zingaretti, Alessia Goria, Corrado Fortuna, Giovanna Bozzolo, Lollo Franco, Salvo Scelta
description: Palermo, 1990: Don Giuseppe Puglisi is entrusted with the parish in the Brancaccio district, just outside the city. In less than two years, the priest manages to build a shelter and, with the help of a group of volunteers, collects dozens of young people from the street. Inevitably, however, his path leads him to come into conflict with the interests of the mafia power that has always controlled the area ...
notes: Recounting the last three years of life and activity of Don Pino Puglisi (killed on September 15, 1993), Faenza does not allow himself to be directed and remains attached to the history and charisma of his character, to whom Zingaretti gives a full-bodied, credible naturalness.

title: Tokyo Godfathers
description: On Christmas night, in Tokyo, three homeless people keep company: they are the ex alcoholic cyclist Gin, the ex transvestite Hana and Miyuki, a girl who ran away from home. As they rummage through the garbage for their gifts, they hear a muffled cry: among the bags they find a baby girl, and in no time at all they decide to track down the little girl's house ...
notes: Kon (also screenwriter) worked with Katsuhiro Otomo, one of the masters of Japanese animation: here he bases an exciting story full of humanity, in which there is no lack of suspense moments, told with a high level animation. A treat for lovers of the genre.

title: The Aviator
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Cate Blanchett, Kate Beckinsale, John C. Reilly, Alec Baldwin, Alan Alda, Ian Holm, Danny Huston, Jude Law, Adam Scott, Kelli Garner
description: The story of Howard Hughes, young heir of the oil company "Hughes Tool Co.", film producer, director, aviator ... In addition to airplanes, he has a passion for women (among his conquests there are Jean Harlow, Katharine Hepburn, Ava Gardner). But Hughes has delusions and phobias that gradually take over.
notes: An act of love and amazing technical expertise; so much so that the chill of the philological reconstruction extinguishes the flames of passions. Unlike any other Scorsese film (even on commission, like The Color of Money, even partially wrong and reworked, like _Gangs of New York_), _The Aviator_ has no heart, no pain. It has a compelling and unassailable Scorsesian logic (the inevitable collapse of the individual in front of the system) and an admirable direction. But the nervous energy on which it builds and which it transmits, the adrenaline that devours Hughes' life, are completely cerebral, they do not echo in the belly and soul. And from the most flamboyant author of contemporary cinema we want more, we want him to penetrate our skin through the eyes.

title: The Woodsman
actors: Kevin Bacon, Kyra Sedgwick, Mos Def, Benjamin Bratt, Eve
description: After spending 12 years in prison, Walter settles in a small town where he finds work at a lumber yard. He's a loner who doesn't make friends with others. Only Vickie, a colleague, manages to insinuate herself into her world and a relationship is born between the two. Vickie wants to know Walter's past and promises not to judge him whatever he did. The man confesses to her that he was in prison on charges of pedophilia ...
notes: This film is beautiful in a moral rather than aesthetic sense, which not only has the courage to take on a difficult theme head on, but does so by touching the right chords.

title: Mur
description: A documentary about the wall that the Tel Aviv government has been building since November 2003 to divide Israelis and Palestinians. It is 500 km long and aims to "avoid acts of terrorism and theft in the state of Israel" but it is the sign of isolation and the impossibility of communication between cultures.
notes: With the right choice of a sort of panoramic format, Simone Bitton at the beginning frames the wall from the front, making it seem impassable; then slightly from above, in wide angle, no longer so invincible. Until, in the last sober image, it becomes almost a mirror image of the Western Wall. An exciting style lesson.

title: Going Berserk
actors: John Candy, Joe Flaherty, Eugene Levy, Alley Mills, Pat Hingle
description: John Bourgignon, a big clumsy limo driver who plays drums in his spare time, falls in love with the beautiful Nancy. The girl, however, is the daughter of Senator Edward Reese, a politician whom a group of religious fanatics (who have their headquarters in an aerobics gym) want to die. And so, just before the wedding, the sect tries to brainwash Bourgignon into killing his future father-in-law during the wedding celebration ...
notes: Plenty of juxtaposed comedians don't necessarily make good comedy, and even John Candy's broad shoulders can't carry the whole movie.

title: Desert Blue
actors: Casey Affleck, Kate Hudson, Christina Ricci, Brendan Sexton III
description: While traveling through the Californian desert, Lance Davidson, an academic pop culture scholar, and his daughter Skye, an emerging starlet, come to Baxter, a remote town populated by eccentric characters, known only for the distinction of owning the cone. largest ice cream in the world. Father and daughter would like to leave, but are blocked due to the escape of a mysterious liquid that has invaded the highway, rendering it unusable and isolating the entire locality.

title: Jet Set
actors: Bruno Solo, Samuel Le Bihan, Lambert Wilson, Ornella Muti, Ariadna Gil
description: To save the Bombay Bar in Montreuil from closing, Jimmy and Fifi have an enlightenment: to persuade the actor Mike to infiltrate the beautiful Parisian world to convince the VIPs to frequent the club. Things get complicated when Mike achieves unexpected success in the Jet Set.
notes: Pleasant Franco-Spanish co-production.

title: Ag-o
actors: Jo Jae-hyeon
description: Crocodile, from under the bridges over the River Hun, awaits unfortunate suicides to be able to rummage through their clothes and, like a vulture, plunder them leaving them practically naked in the water. The young man lives with a teenager and his old grandfather, until a woman arrives with a child who expands the bizarre "family".

title: Amori e veleni
actors: Amedeo Nazzari, Lois Maxwell, Anna Nievo, Alfredo Varelli, Olga Solbelli, Afro Poli, Marisa Merlini, Giulio Donnini
description: Christina of Sweden is a guest in Rome of a cardinal who hopes to convert her to Catholicism. One evening, after a tiring hunting party, Cristina asks the Duke of Cerio for hospitality, who has recently arrived in his castle with his young wife Anna Maria. Santinelli, captain of the queen's guards, and her favorite, falls madly in love with the young duchess. This passion naturally arouses the queen's jealousy. The Duchess's sister-in-law takes advantage of the situation, anxious to get rid of Anna Maria, whose marriage with the Duke has deprived her son of any hope of inheritance.

title: Il medaglione insanguinato (Perchè?!)
actors: Richard Johnson, Joanna Cassidy, Evelyne Stewart, Nicoletta Elmi, Lila Kedrova, Ida Galli, Riccardo Garrone, Dana Ghia, Eleonora Morana, Edmund Purdom

title: The Survivors Club
actors: Roma Downey, Jacqueline Bisset, Lauren Lee Smith, James Remar
description: Jillian, Carol and Meg, brutally raped by the same man, decide to team up to create a kind of club they think they call "survivors". Their aim is to take revenge on their rapist. When the man is murdered, police suspicions focus on the three women.

title: Welfare
description: The documentary, shot in a New York welfare office, chronicles the frustration of miserable welfare recipients, who spend their time seated or "shuffled" from office to office. All while the degrading system continues its inexorable march.
notes: Bitter and provocative.

title: Chronique d'un été
description: Paris, summer of 1961. On the streets of the city, people are urged, through confidence or provocation, to answer questions about happiness.
notes: The ethnographer Rouch and the sociologist Morin conduct an investigation that is halfway between fictional and documentary cinema.

title: Deep Throat
actors: Linda Lovelace, Harry Reems, Dolly Sharp, Bill Harrison, William Love
description: Linda Lovelace, who is unable to enjoy during sexual intercourse, is visited by Dr. Young, who discovers that his problem is due to a small physical inconvenience: he has the clitoris in his throat. Dr. Young himself will teach her the "deep throat" technique ...
notes: Gerard Damiano, former Queens hairdresser, directs a film that entered the history of cinema (porn). Linda Traynor, renamed Lovelace, will soon become such a star. The film, released on November 15, 1972 at the New World Theater in New York, had a huge success for the public and critics. The story originated the documentary _ininside Gola Deep_.

title: Around the World in 80 Days
country: United States, Germany, Ireland, Great Britain
actors: Jackie Chan, Steve Coogan, Robert Fyfe, Jim Broadbent, Ian McNeice, Arnold Schwarzenegger
description: An eccentric London inventor, Phileas Fogg is determined to be taken seriously by the Royal Academy of Science to which he belongs. For this he engages in a bizarre bet with Lord Kelvin, the head of the Academy: he will be able to circumnavigate the globe in just 80 days.
notes: Already _ Around the world in 80 days_ of 1956 (Michael Anderson-David Niven version - and above all Mike Tood, the manufacturer who had patented the new Todd-AO panoramic system) was not overwhelming; but at least it was motivated by the desire for spaces and surprises of the declining cinema audience. But this, childish and flat, not only does not do justice to Verne, but not even to the patience of the spectators.

title: Satree lek
actors: Jesdaporn Pholdee, Sahaphap Tor, Ekachai Buranapanit, Giorgio Maiocchi
description: Mon and Jung, very talented volleyball players, are often excluded from training because they are homosexuals. With coach Bee, things seem to change: in fact, the woman calls Jung and Mon to play as owners despite the opposition of the other players. Indeed, it revolutionizes the team with the inclusion of a gay military man, the transsexual star of a cabaret show and her boyfriend ...
notes: _The Iron Ladies_, directed by one of the most important directors of Thai television, tells this amazing adventure with goliardic lightness and bold irony. A smiling film that wants to break down at least a couple of prejudices and that, in the end, gives itself a game on the edge of the paranormal, almost in the _Shaolin Soccer_ area.

title: Anacondas: the Hunt for the Blood Orchid
actors: Johnny Messner, Morris Chestnut, Eugene Byrd, Peter Curtin, Nicholas Gonzalez, Nicholas Hope
description: A pharmaceutical giant sends a group of scientists to Borneo. The expedition has the task of finding a rare specimen of orchid whose properties would guarantee immortality. But in the course of their research, scientists come across a group of gigantic snakes ...
notes: The beginning of this sequel to the forgettable _Anaconda_ starts quite fast, and gets watched. Having set the absurd premises with candidly explanatory dialogues, we move quickly on the river. But then before the anacondas of the title arrive it takes a good hour, and nobody cares about what happens on the raft and in the jungle.

title: Paran daemun
actors: Lee Ji-eun, Lee Hae-eun, Ahn Jae-mo, Jeong Hyeong-gi, Son Min-seok

title: All Fall Down
actors: Eva Marie Saint, Warren Beatty, Karl Malden, Angela Lansbury
description: Ralph and Annabell Willart are the parents of Berry-Berry, a wimp who is often in trouble. When Berry-Berry begins yet another senseless love story with Echo O'Brien, the epilogue of the story will forever mark the younger brother Clinton.

title: Una spirale di nebbia
actors: Claude Jade, Marc Porel, Duilio Del Prete, Carole Chauvet, Marina Berti, Stefano Satta Flores, Roberto Posse, Martine Brochard, Flavio Bucci, Marina Berti, Eleonora Giorgi, Anna Bonaiuto, Elvira Cortese, Valeria Sabel, Carlo Puri

title: Sonny
actors: James Franco, Brenda Blethyn, Harry Dean Stanton, Mena Suvari
description: After his military service, Sonny returns home to pre-Aids New Orleans in the early 1980s. The charming young man resumes, under the supervision of his mother maîtresse who directed him since he was a child, a fruitful career as a gigolo. But after falling in love with colleague Carol, he tries to change his life ...
notes: For his directorial debut, Cage surrounds himself with a cast of great actors and young people with discreet hopes, but quickly drowns in the Sundance-style, which has already claimed so many victims among American independents. Rough, but also moralistic and even feel-good, he can only make us regret bitterly _American Gigolo_.

title: Day of the Dead
actors: Lori Cardillo, Terry Alexander, Joseph Pilato, Jarlath Conroy

title: Cose da pazzi
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Enrico Luzi, Carla Del Poggio, Enrico Viarisio
description: The young Dalia Rossi is considered crazy and, for this reason, she finds herself interned at Villa Felicità, a psychiatric institution run by Professor Ruiz. Examined for the first time, she turns out to be sane but having checked her is actually a madman who believes himself to be a psychiatrist. The real doctor, for his part, is more than convinced that Dalia is out of her mind.

title: La bête
actors: Sirpa Lane, Lisbeth Hummel, Pierre Benedetti, Marcel Dalio

title: Baltic Storm
actors: Greta Scacchi, Jürgen Prochnow, Donald Sutherland, Dieter Laser
description: On the night of 27 September 1994 the MS Estonia, which covered the section between Tallinn and Stockholm, sank causing the death of more than 850 people. The investigations will go very close to burning truths.
notes: The film combines embarrassing political fictional moments with the true story of the sinking of MS Estonia.

title: La liceale
actors: Gloria Guida, Giuseppe Pambieri, Gianfranco D'Angelo, Alvaro Vitali
description: Loredana is an uninhibited student who enjoys fooling classmates and professors. She has little sympathy for books, but she is very beautiful and provocative and causes havoc wherever she goes. It will be a collaborator of her father the only one who knows how to take full advantage, deceiving her and then abandoning her ...
notes: A comedy that never makes you laugh, but that gave rise to a prolific trend and launched Gloria Guida in the Olympus of the disgraced nymphets. However, Alvaro "Pierino" Vitali's joke is mythical: "In front of art, take off your underwear and put them aside". Cameo by Ilona Staller, not yet Cicciolina.

title: Screwed
actors: Danny DeVito, Norm Macdonald, Elaine Stritch, Dave Chappelle
description: Willard, a seventeen-year butler in the service of Miss Crock, a rich and greedy old business woman, is fired. The man takes revenge by kidnapping the little dog so loved and pampered by his former mistress. The kidnapping of the animal fails, but Willard and the quadruped have bizarre adventures.
notes: Pretty depressing comedy.

title: Mauvais présage
actors: Lucie Jeanne, Laurent Hennequin, Erick Chabot, Manuela Lopez
description: Mathilde, a talented dancer about to leave for a tour, receives a "chain of St. Anthony" in the mail. During the trip she reads to her friend Sophie all the disasters that should happen to her in case of no answer. Mathilde, who has decided to ignore it, will be the victim of a series of strange incidents.

title: The Day After
actors: Jason Robards, JoBeth Williams, John Cullum, Steve Guttenberg

title: Ma quando arrivano le ragazze?
actors: Claudio Santamaria, Vittoria Puccini, Paolo Briguglia, Johnny Dorelli, Augusto Fornari, Roberta Garzia, Alessio Modica, Enrico Salimbeni
description: 1994. Gianca and Nick, two twenty-year-olds from Bologna, met in Perugia during the stage for young musicians of Umbria Jazz. Both dream of making it into the world of entertainment. Nine years later, the two will meet again at Nick's great concert at the Teatro Comunale in Bologna, to which Gianca, confused in the audience, attends troubled and moved.
notes: Pupi Avati lives its own cinema, among the other aesthetic options of its filmography, also as a long jazz jam session. Films as a set for a concert of memory and autobiography. Stories as songs, standards, classics on which you can improvise, dig into the harmonies, chords, interpreting them, each time with a different key but close to the score placed on the lectern. A melancholy that holds all the characters (well interpreted by a good cast in which Johnny Dorelli should be pointed out) of this orchestra of human feeling.

title: Elektra
actors: Goran Visnjic, Jennifer Garner, Terence Stamp, Will Yun Lee
description: Tortured by the past and haunted by her mysterious death, Elektra returns to life animated by the desire for revenge against her family's brutal murderers. And so she in turn becomes a ruthless killer. But things change when he has to take out 13-year-old Abby and her father ...
notes: The salvation of the film, compared for example to _Daredevil_, of which it is in effect a spin-off, is paradoxically that of falling into the production category of the B series, therefore with a relatively small budget compared to that of the blockbusters of the genre. This means fewer bulky special effects, more human material, more ideas. The definition of the bad guys is interesting, especially the one with the deadly "living" tattoos.

title: Ladder 49
actors: Joaquin Phoenix, John Travolta, Jacinda Barrett, Robert Patrick, Morris Chestnut
description: Firefighter Jack Morrison, after rescuing a man imprisoned inside a burning building, is also trapped. Waiting for his friend and fire chief, Mike Kennedy to rescue him, he retraces his entire life: from when he realized his dream by joining Squad 49, to when he met the girl who would become his wife, to the decision to start a family ...
notes: John Travolta carves out a background role and the final moving celebration of the category in contemporary society. The direction, entrusted to Jay Russell, privileges the familiar / sentimental side to the dramatic / spectacular one that reserves few emotions, with an alternation between flashbacks and present action, all in all flat and with brachycardic rhythms.

title: Si può essere più bastardi dell'ispettore Cliff?
actors: Stephanie Beacham, Ivan Rassimov, Patricia Hayes, Verna Harvey

title: Extraconiugale
directors: Massimo Franciosa, Mino Guerrini, Giuliano Montaldo
actors: Gastone Moschin, Liana Orfei, Franca Rame, Pepe Calvo, Renato Salvatori, Maria Perschy
description: A new shower model unleashes the erotic fantasies of a middle-aged engineer, determined to lose weight. The man will have an affair with a singer who turns out to be the girlfriend of his brother-in-law. A modest employee, harassed by everyone, decides to take revenge when he discovers he has won the lottery. It will have a very bitter surprise. Renato, a Sicilian married to a Scandinavian, is convinced that he is finally free from the prejudices that accompany his countrymen. The free and uninhibited behavior of women shocks everyone. The punishment that Renato's family devise is terrible.
notes: The second episode is the best one.

title: Les Misérables
actors: Lino Ventura, Michel Bouquet, Jean Carmet, Evelyne Bouix, Valentine Bordelet

title: Gonggongui jeog
actors: Sol Kyung-gu, Lee Sung-jae, Kang Shin-il, Kim Jeong-hak, Do Yong-gu
description: Kang Cheol-jung is a policeman devoted to dirty little business who accidentally runs into a man with whom he has an altercation and who ends up slashing him with a knife. It will not take long to connect that encounter with a crime just committed nearby, where two elderly spouses were stabbed to death. When the victim's son goes to recognize the corpses, Kang Cheol-jung is convinced he recognizes him as his attacker. But the man, who turns out to be an influential businessman, has a solid reputation, while Kang Cheol-jung is known by all as a bad guy: for him being able to prove his guilt will be a really difficult task.

title: Cien
actors: Zygmunt Kestowicz, Adolf Chronicki, Emil Karewicz, Ignacy Machowski

title: Pociag
actors: Zbigniew Cybulski, Helena Dabrowska, Michal Gazda, Roland Glowacki

title: Una cavalla tutta nuda
actors: Don Backy, Barbara Bouchet, Renzo Montagnani, Vittorio Congia

title: Una storia ambigua
actors: Minnie Minoprio, Beba Balteano, Gabriele Gori, Piero Gerlini

title: 5 donne per l'assassino
actors: Francis Matthews, Pascale Rivault, Giorgio Albertazzi, Howard Ross

title: 99 mujeres
actors: Maria Schell, Herbert Lom, Mercedes McCambridge, Luciana Paluzzi, Rosalba Neri

title: Prigione di donne
actors: Martine Brochard, Marilù Tolo, Erna Schürer, Katia Kristine

title: The Princess Diaries 2: Royal Engagement
actors: Anne Hathaway, Julie Andrews, Hector Elizondo, John Rhys-Davies
description: After discovering that she is the heir to the Genovia throne, Mia has taken on her responsibilities. But now a new law forces her to get married within a month ...
notes: Under the anonymous Italian title lies the sequel to _The Princess Diaries_, already titled in Italy _Pretty Princess_, having been directed by _Pretty Woman_ director Garry Marshall.

title: Nanook of the North
description: One year in the life of Nanuk and his family, members of the Inuit community, the indigenous people of the cold lands of Alaska. Hunting, fishing, domestic life, the education of the children of those who live their lives in symbiosis with an inhospitable nature.
notes: Robert J. Flaherty had the intuition to use a camera during his exploratory expeditions. He did not know that he would thus achieve fame as the first accredited documentary maker in history. _Nanuk_ was commissioned by a French fur company and, from an anthropological cross-section, became a great and lasting success with the public, struck by the charm of a distant culture and the poetry of an uncontaminated nature.

title: Halloween
actors: Jamie Lee Curtis, Donald Pleasence, Nancy Loomis, Tony Moran, P.J. Soles, Charles Cyphers, Kyle Richards, Brian Andrews, John Michael Graham, Nancy Stephens
description: Haddonfield, Illinois, 1963: On a cold Halloween night, six-year-old Michael Myers brutally kills his older sister. The child is thus locked up in the asylum of Smith's Grove, where Dr. Sam Loomis seems to be the only one to notice his luciferian nature. And when fifteen years later, still on the eve of Halloween, Michael breaks out of the institute, Loomis knows that something terrifying is about to happen ...
notes: Carpenter realizes the progenitor - "sequelized" and imitated - of a new course of horror. First-person shooting forces us to identify with Michael, and that's no small insight.

title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre
actors: Marilyn Burns, Allen Danzinger, Paul A. Partain, William Vail, Teri McMinn, Edwin Neal, Jim Siedow, Gunnar Hansen, John Dugan, Robert Courtin
description: In Newton, Texas, someone has desecrated some graves, amputating the limbs and heads of the corpses. The authorities are alerted, but they seem unable to deal with it. Meanwhile, a group of young people decide to spend the weekend in that region in a van. Running out of petrol, the boys and girls separately reach a house inhabited by a family of butchers: whose pater familias, however, has every intention of feeding his slaughterhouse with their bodies ...
notes: Splendid horror with an unhealthy and distressing atmosphere, which suggests an unprecedented violence without ever showing it completely. With three sequels, a prequel and a remake.

title: Dèmoni
actors: Urbano Barberini, Natasha Hovey, Fiore Argento, Nicoletta Elmi
description: The patrons of a cinema are injured with a diabolical mask, and little by little they are transformed into hideous anthropophagous creatures. Gradually a horrendous contagion spreads, and the possessed multiply throughout Berlin ...
notes: First film of a successful film series ahead of its time, and certainly the best work of Lamberto Bava, son of art and solid artisan of fantastic cinema. Produced by Dario Argento, who however did not participate in the work on the set, _Demoni_ is a title that fell in its time (the 80s), aged better than other similar operations. To be rediscovered.

title: Saikaku ichidai onna
actors: Kinuyo Tanaka, Toshiro Mifune, Masao Shimizu, Ichirô Sugai
description: In feudal Japan, O-Haru, a court girl, falls in love with a young man of lower rank. Discovered, she is hunted together with her entire family. The father, in particular, reproaches her for their new condition and urges her to earn, so O-Haru obtains the ephemeral favors of a lord and then descends the different stages of prostitution, from a pleasure house to the alleys of a port, to finally become a nun and live on alms ...
notes: Staging of a ruthless social mechanism to which one can only succumb: but in the surrender there is a sort of tragic serenity. Among the most famous masterpieces of Mizoguchi.

title: Narayama Bushi-ko
actors: Kinuyo Tanaka, Teiji Takahashi, Yûko Mochizuki, Seiji Miyaguchi

title: The Barefoot Contessa
actors: Ava Gardner, Humphrey Bogart, Edmond O'Brien, Rossano Brazzi
description: From barefoot dancer in a Spanish cabaret to Hollywood star. But success is no guarantee of happiness ...
notes: Four narrative voices for as many flashbacks that dig back into the life of a fragile and sensitive film star. From success to tragic and sudden death, passing through tormented loves, irrepressible jealousies and betrayals perpetuated in the name of desperation. The points of view are different, necessarily partial, conflicting. But functional to the participatory delineation of a human profile that is impossible to convey in its complex exhaustiveness. Cinema can "limit itself" to suggesting the idea of ??this wealth, but only the one with a capital C.

title: Dersu Uzala
actors: Maxim Manzuk, Yuri Solomine
description: 1902: in a wild area along the Ussuri river, on the border with Manchuria, Dersu Uzala, a solitary Mongolian hunter of indefinite age, meets the small cartographic expedition of the Russian captain Arseniev. The nomad saves the officer's life and the two become friends. They will meet again five years later, and this time it will be the Mongolian who owes his life to the Russian.
notes: Inspired by the two travel books that make up the memoirs of Vladimir Arseniev and shot over the course of two years in difficult conditions, it marks Kurosawa's return to cinema after a five-year period of depression. Magnificent staging of the relationship of friendship and that between man and nature. Oscar for best foreign film in 1976.

title: Cría cuervos...
actors: Ana Torrent, Geraldine Chaplin, Conchita Perez, Monica Randall

title: The Monte Carlo Story
actors: Marlene Dietrich, Vittorio De Sica, Arthur O'Connell, Mischa Auer

title: I sequestrati di Altona
actors: Sophia Loren, Maximilian Schell, Fredric March, Françoise Prevost
description: Franz Gerlach, a former Wehrmacht officer, remained for years in the attic of the family villa in Altona, near Hamburg, hidden and protected by his father and sister. But after meeting his sister-in-law Johanna, his life changes radically ...
notes: From a play by Jean-Paul Sartre, written by Abby Mann and Cesare Zavattini.

title: Le couteau dans la plaie
actors: Sophia Loren, Anthony Perkins, Gig Young, Yolande Turner

title: Desire Under the Elms
actors: Sophia Loren, Burl Ives, Anthony Perkins, Frank Overton, Pernell Roberts

title: Legend of the Lost
actors: John Wayne, Sophia Loren, Rossano Brazzi, Kurt Kasznar, Sonia Moser
description: When his father disappears in the Sahara desert under mysterious circumstances, the rich and young Paul Bonnard decides to go after him. Thus he reaches Timbuktu where he meets the cynical John and the beautiful Dita. The two accompany him among the ruins of an ancient city, where Paul discovers the treasure for which his parent was killed, but also the evidence of his debauchery. He will end up going mad and turning against his traveling companions.
notes: Very weak and tedious, one of Henry Hathaway's worst adventurous films, with a bewildered John Wayne and an endless string of daring and melodramatic events in the desert that often touch involuntary comedy. Useless.

title: Ikiru
actors: Takashi Shimura, Nobuo Kaneko, Kyoko Seki, Makoto Kobori
description: Watanabe works as an employee to the Municipality. He is a lonely man, widowed by a luster, and he discovered he has stomach tumor. His life seems to come to the terminus and he thus decides to withdraw his savings from the bank and best live the time that remains. In his night wandering for the Tokyo night clubs, a young man who had been his colleague advises him to resign and perhaps commit himself to something that has value. And to Watanabe the project of a playground that had run in the pasteies of the municipal bureaucracy returns.

title: Taiyo no hakaba
actors: Kayoko Honoo, Isao Sasaki, Masahito Tsugawa, Fumio Watanabe, Kamatari Fujiwara, Tanie Kitabayashi, Junzaburo Ban
description: In the midst of reconstruction, Osaka is a city in pieces not only in its buildings: immorality is rampant, and in the poorest neighborhoods you live among thefts, violence, prostitution and gang wars ...
notes: Oshima - in an unusual territory for him, close to that of Fukasaku - retains his poetics as a cruel and claustrophobic narrator.

title: Gishiki
actors: Kenzo Kawarazaki, Atsuo Nakamura, Akiko Koyama

title: Ai no corrida - L'Empire des sens
actors: Tatsuya Fuji, Eiko Matsuda, Aoi Nakajima, Melka Seri

title: Kuroi Ame
actors: Yoshiko Tanaka, Kazuo Kitamura, Etsuko Ichihara, Shoichi Ozawa

title: Narayama bushi-ko
actors: Ken Ogata, Sumiko Sakamoto, Tonpei Hidarei, Takejo Aki

title: Fukushu suru wa ware ni ari
actors: Ken Ogata, Rentaro Mikuni, Chocho Mikayo
description: After the brutal murder, for the purpose of robbery, of two Monopoly debt collectors, the police open an investigation: the number one suspect is Enokizu, who works as a messenger for the same institution. The investigations open disturbing glimpses on him: he is married and has two daughters, but the family hardly ever sees him and lives without being able to count on his financial contribution. Jailed several times, Enokizu has a lover whom he subjects to repeated violence: and when the latter discovers the truth, the man does not hesitate to kill again, then giving himself a desperate escape ...
notes: A very hard and ferocious foray into the abysses of the human soul.

title: Buta to guntan
actors: Yuji Nagato, Masao Mishima, Teatsuro Tanba, Mitzi Mori
description: 1961: Kinta is employed by a gang that traffics food supplies destined for an American naval base. When he tries to start his own business on the advice of his friend Haruko, big trouble starts for him ...
notes: Imamura mercilessly analyzes the relations between the foreign occupiers and the corruption of his country.

title: Wong Fei-hung
actors: Jet Li, Yuen Biao, Rosamund Kwan, Jacky Cheung, Steve Tartalia
description: In the late 19th century, the legendary martial arts hero Wong Fei-Hung opposes the foreign forces (British, French and American) who are plundering China. The situation is made more complicated by the arrival of Yee, the aunt of whom Wong is the protector who has returned from America with Western ideals.

title: Wong Fei-hung ji yi: Naam yi dong ji keung
actors: Xiong Xin-xin, Jet Li, David Chiang, Rosamund Kwan, Yan Yee Kwan
description: In late nineteenth-century China, Wong Fei-Hung, martial arts master, finds himself facing the followers of a fanatic cult that would like Europeans out of the country with the use of violence and that does not hesitate to prosecute the Chinese who follow customs westerners. He must also defend the revolutionary Sun Yat Set from the military.

title: Wong Fei-hung tsi sam: Siwong tsangba
actors: Jet Li, Rosamund Kwan, Lau Shun, Mok Siu Chung, John Wakefield

title: Wong Fei-hung chi saiwik hung si
actors: Xiong Xin-xin, Jet Li, Rosamund Kwan, Chan Kwok-Pong, Jeff Wolfe
description: I know, martial arts expert, moves to San Francisco to open a school. But the tension between Americans and Chinese immigrants is very high ...

title: Warvi yatsui hodo yoku nemuru
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Takeshi Kato, Takashi Shimura

title: Nora inu
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Takashi Shimura, Ko Kimura, Keiko Awaji

title: Dodès'ka-dèn
actors: Yoshitaka Zushi, Kin Sugai, Kiyoko Tange, Junzaburo Ban, Michiko Hino
description: 8 stories of outcasts make up the decadent portrait of Japanese society from the slums of human misery.

title: Akahige
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Yuzo Kayama, Chishu Ryu, Kinuyo Tanaka

title: Coup de torchon
actors: Philippe Noiret, Isabelle Huppert, Jean-Pierre Marielle, Stéphane Audran, Eddy Mitchell
description: Senegal, late 1930s: Lucien Cordier is the guardian of the law (but without a uniform) in a remote French colony. Harassed by his wife and her lover, apparently inept and inconclusive, he takes the advice of a superior as a pretext to do justice for himself for the abuses of local notables, towards whom he had always been more than tolerant until then. In one way or another, many will pay the price of his "swipe in the sponge" ...
notes: By re-setting the novel _Pop 1280_ by the great Jim Thompson under the African sun, Tavernier draws - also thanks to an ineffable Noiret - a mocking and "philosophical" reflection on the theme of Evil.

title: La paura
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Mathias Wieman, Renate Mannhardt, Kurt Kreuger
description: Irene has a husband with whom she works, a lover, a blackmailer and an underlying anguish that threatens to lead her to suicide.
notes: From a story by Stefan Zweig, a film that was then crushed by critics and snubbed by the public. Today, an experiment of extraordinary modernity appears and the coherent development of the Rossellinian path, now free from any neorealist approach and close, if anything, to the explication of an ever-present Catholic background. Sore and good Ingrid Bergman.

title: Cicciolina, amore mio
directors: A. Van Dyke (Amasi Damiani), Jimmy B. Matheus (Bruno Mattei)
actors: Ilona Staller, Paola Ludovica Barbanera, Patrizia Basso, Giancarlo Marinangeli

title: Tsubaki Sanjuro
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Tatsuya Nakadai, Yuzo Kayama, Akihiko Hirata

title: Kakushi toride no san-akunin
actors: Misa Uehara, Toshiro Mifune, Minoru Chiaki, Kamatari Fujiwara, Takashi Shimura
description: Two Japanese peasants, in the middle of the Middle Ages, are recruited by a general to escort the young and beautiful heir to the throne. Above all, they must transport his treasure in gold bars to a land controlled by the rival dynasty.

title: Donzoko
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Isuzu Yamada, Ganjiro Nakamura, Kyôko Kagawa
description: In a dormitory run by an old moneylender and his wife, some vagabonds stay. Everyone dreams of escaping from misery.

title: Naniwa Hika/Naniwa Ereji
actors: Isuzu Yamada, Seiichi Takegawa, Chiyoko Okura, Shinpachiro Asaka

title: Gion no shimai - Gion no kyudai
actors: Isuzu Yamada, Yoko Umemura, Eitaro Shindo, Taizo Fukami

title: Sanshô Dayû
actors: Kinuyo Tanaka, Yoshiaki Kanayagi, Kyôko Kagawa, Masao Shimizu

title: Yokihi
actors: Machiko Kyo, Masayuki Mori, Sô Yamamura, Sakae Osawa

title: Akasen chitai
actors: Machiko Kyo, Ayako Wakai, Aiko Mimasu, Michiyo Kogure

title: Le gai savoir
actors: Juliet Berto, Jean-Pierre Léaud
description: The student Emile Rousseau was hit by a bullet fired by a paratroop unit but saved by a copy of the Cahiers du Cinèma that he kept under his jacket while Patricia, on the other hand, is a recently hunted Citroen worker. The two decide to start a life together again.
notes: Inspired by Jean-Jacques Rousseau's Emile and shot entirely in the Joinville studios between 67 and 68, it was rejected by the French television, which had commissioned it, but it will be presented the following year at the Berlin Film Festival. Before being a political film, The Gay Science is a film of great sweetness, one of the most exciting of all the work of Godard, a film about frailty.

title: Le petit soldat
actors: Michel Subor, Anna Karina, Henry-Jacques Huet, Laszlo Szabo

title: Les carabiniers
actors: Marino Masé, Albert Juross, Geneviève Galéa, Barbet Schroeder
description: During a war in an imaginary nation, unscrupulous soldiers recruit poor peasants with the promise of an easy and happy life. Two of these peasants - Ulysses and Michel-Ange - are sent to Italy where they commit war crimes. Their return home gives them hope that the day of the expected rewards they promised is near, but the end of the war will reveal very different scenarios.

title: Une femme mariée
actors: Macha Meril, Bernard Noël, Philippe Leroy, Roger Leenhardt

title: Masculin féminin
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Chantal Goya, Michel Debord, Catherine-Isabelle Duport, Brigitte Bardot

title: Made in Usa
actors: Anna Karina, Laszlo Szabo, Jean-Pierre Léaud, Marianne Faithfull

title: La chinoise
actors: Anne Wiazemsky, Jean-Pierre Léaud, Juliet Berto, Francis Jeanson
description: Summer 1967, young Maoist militants listen to Radio Beijing in a large bourgeois apartment, discuss theory, art, theater and prepare for the revolution.

title: Je vous salue, Marie
actors: Myriem Roussel, Thierry Rode, Philippe Lacoste, Juliette Binoche
description: Marie, a virgin and daughter of a gas station attendant, receives the announcement of her impending motherhood from Gabriel. Her fiancé Joseph is a little desperate but then, out of love, he resigns himself to his son who isn't his.
notes: Contemporary paraphrase of one of the pivotal events of Christianity. Godard with a desecrating spirit directs a work that is not blasphemous but of great spirituality: the ecumenical jury at the Berlin Festival understood and rewarded him, while the Catholics of Italy and France (and the fresh Pope Wojtyla) condemned in a loud voice. Also because Marie-Myriem Roussel's splendid nude was hard to digest ...

title: Soigne ta droite
actors: Jean-Luc Godard, Jacques Villeret, François Périer, Jane Birkin

title: The Weekend
actors: Gena Rowlands, Deborah Kara Unger, Brooke Shields, Jared Harris
description: Exactly one year after Tony's death from AIDS, friends and family seem to have not gotten over the loss. A weekend at the lake seems like a way to heal old conflicts and new misunderstandings. This is how Marian, Tony's inconsolable sister-in-law, his brother John, and Lyle, Tony's ex-partner, with her new boyfriend Robert find themselves. The few days spent together will detonate domestic and couple crises.
notes: Based on a novel by Peter Cameron, it is a choral film with a traditional structure that is boring in the long run due to the lack of truly destabilizing events. Funny Brooke Shields as a hot-headed TV actress.

title: Student Seduction
actors: Elizabeth Berkley, Corey Sevier, Rick Roberts, Karen Robinson
description: Among the new students of Christie Dawson, a young and attractive high school teacher, there is also the restless Josh Gaines, from a dysfunctional family. However, Christie's (purely professional) solicitude is misunderstood by the boy, who mistakes it for sexual attraction and, one day, even comes to assault the woman ...

title: I senza Dio
actors: Antonio Sabato, Erika Blanc, Paul Stevens, Franco Marletta, Pilar Velazquez
description: After the robbery in El Paso, a price of $ 15,000 is placed on the head of the bandit Corbancho. And when $ 400,000 loot is plundered in Tucson (with the aggravating circumstance of the murder of McFallow, director of the lender), everyone believes it is a new venture by the same outlaw. They don't think so Roy, the son of the late McFallow, and a bounty hunter known as the "Minnesota Killer". Banker Barrett, his wife Jennifer and Sheriff Sam Huston are also interested in the misdeeds that are multiplying in the region ...
notes: A sluggish "spaghetti" and out of time.

title: Half Life
description: An accurate and cutting-edge analysis, with a strong emotional impact, on the guilty cynicism shown by the US government on the occasion of the atomic experiments conducted from the 1950s onwards near the Bikini Atoll and the Marshall Islands. The film won, among others, the prestigious Peace Prize at the Berlinale '85.

title: Un long dimanche de fiançailles
actors: Audrey Tautou, André Dussollier, Gaspard Ulliel, Tchéky Karyo, Marion Cotillard, Jodie Foster, Dominique Pinon, Chantal Neuwirth, Ticky Holgado, Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Clovis Cornillac, Denis Lavant, Dominique Bettenfeld
description: WWI. Mathilde learns that her fiancé Manech is one of five French soldiers condemned by a court martial and abandoned in nobody's land between the French and German trenches. He is almost certainly dead. Mathilde does not give up and begins a journey in her footsteps ...
notes: Jeunet, a scholar and enthusiast of the First World War which marked the transition from 800 to 900, directs a seductive and dense film, overflowing and amazed by the inessential. It follows, not getting lost, the many trenches (the real ones and the others) around which the characters fight to win over fairy tales and tragedies. With a more engaging and exciting actress than Tautou it would be extraordinary.

title: Meet the Fockers
actors: Robert De Niro, Ben Stiller, Dustin Hoffman, Barbra Streisand, Teri Polo, Blythe Danner, Owen Wilson, Alanna Ubach, Ray Santiago, Tim Blake Nelson
description: Jack Byrnes and his wife, along with their daughter and future son-in-law Greg, travel to Miami to meet the boy's parents. Bernie and Roz Fotter are the most distant from the Byrnes: he is a retired lawyer and her sex therapist, they immediately prove to be too eccentric for the tastes of the former Cia agent Byrnes ...
notes: In this brilliant sequel to Meet the Parents, the brilliant intuition was that he had entrusted the role of Stiller's parents to Dustin Hoffman and Barbra Streisand. Together, they take over the film with a verve that, apart from De Niro, knocks everyone else out. The Focker saga cannot end there.

title: Un silenzio particolare
actors: Matteo Rulli, Stefano Rulli, Clara Sereni
description: Clara Sereni and the well-known screenwriter Stefano Rulli - parents of Matteo, a 20-year-old with psychic problems - are the founders of "La città del sole", an agritourism destined to host diversity. The moment of the inauguration is a party for everyone except for Matteo, who is on the sidelines. At the end of the day, Stefano and Clara question their son's attitude of rejection ...
notes: Cinema is still capable of giving us splendid utopias. With a digital video camera, led by the talented operator Ugo Adilardi, Rulli patiently tries to walk on that rift that fate wanted to interpose between the world and Matteo.

title: Provincia meccanica
actors: Stefano Accorsi, Valentina Cervi, Ivan Franek, Miro Landoni
description: Marco and Silvia are married and have two young children. He works as a forklift worker, she works as a housewife but is depressed, she doesn't clean the house, she doesn't send her children to school.
