Her mother then manages to get her eldest daughter entrusted. Silvia will first end up having a child with a sailor from the East, then in an institution for single mothers. Meanwhile, Marco turns to a magician.
notes: On a plot of _Donne al bivio_, winks of an eye to Antonioni-Visconti-Fellini are grafted, animal symbolisms (dogs, iguanas, chicks) and endless socio-psycho-pathological dialogues in the mouth of super-gigion actors. Even the (post) industrial landscape of Ravenna does not breathe on the screen.

actors: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Gong Li, Faye Wong, Zhang Ziyi, Takuya Kimura
description: Hong Kong, 2046. Fifty years have passed since Great Britain returned the city to China and the economic and social situation is chaotic. Two pairs of special agents are grappling with a delicate affair that could have dramatic consequences.
notes: Not a film for fans of logical connections or the plot, nor for the hyper-rational, for the exegetes of purity or for those who expect an author every time a masterpiece. _In the Mood for Love_ it was certainly more beautiful, more perfect: but Cho Mo-wan has left his secrets and memories in the crack of the crumbling stone of a temple; he left us old Hong Kong and old China; what has escaped confusedly returns to reach into the future, in 2046.

title: L'esquive
actors: Osman Elkharraz, Sara Forestier, Sabrina Ouazani, Nanou Benhamou
description: Suburbs of Paris. Lydia was chosen to act in the end-of-year show and parades through the streets with the eighteenth-century costume repeating the text of Marivaux's _Game of chance and love_. When Krimo, the tough guy from the neighborhood, sees her, he falls madly in love with her. To woo her he accepts a part in the comedy ...
notes: Abdel Kechiche's is a stylo room that portrays his characters with modest force, applying a "high" poetics (Marivaux: it is social conditioning that enslaves a role and an environment) to a terribly "low" context. The banlieue, the frontier, the darkness on the edge of town where the destinies are (already) marked. Without didacticism, rhetoric or anything else, all in a state of grace starting from the two protagonists. The dubbing exceeds in Roman dialect but it is useless to rage. This time it was a difficult task.

title: Popeye
actors: Robin Williams, Shelley Duvall, Ray Walston, Paul Dooley, Linda Hunt
description: The sailor Popeye, raised as an orphan but now in search of his father, arrives in the port village of Sweethaven. Here she would like to stay in the inn of Olivia's family, which she falls in love with despite the fact that she is already betrothed to Bluto, the sheriff who tyrannizes the country.
notes: Shot in Malta on a large set, the film has its only merit in its almost philological fidelity to Segar's strips and the Fleischer brothers' cartoons, but its transposition into a live action feature film meets disastrous results. The characters' crippled speech and their dramatic excesses, as well as the agitated rhythm, are irritating after a few minutes. The coup de grace comes with the singing numbers.

title: Come Back to the Five & Dime, Jimmy Dean, Jimmy Dean
actors: Sandy Dennis, Cher, Karen Black, Sudie Bond, Kathy Bates
description: 1975: a meeting of a fan club devoted to the memory of James Dean is held in a shop in the Texan town of McCarthy. Among the members of the heterogeneous group is Mona, mentally disturbed, who after an appearance on the set of _Il gigante_ had (according to her) a son from the star; there is the sardonic maid Sissy and there is Joanne, who will reveal a lacerating secret kept hidden for years ...
notes: In adapting the play by Ed Graczyk (who also wrote the screenplay), strongly influenced by Tennessee Williams, Altman works on time and on the claustrophobic space by "dynamizing" them with a series of flashbacks conveyed through a large mirror.

title: Streamers
actors: Matthew Modine, Michael Wright, Mitchell Lichtenstein, David Alan Grier
description: Four young recruits about to be sent to fight in Vietnam confront their ideas and prejudices when they discover that one of them is homosexual.
notes: Adaptation of the play by David Robe, staged on Broadway since 1976 and repeated 476 times. The entire cast of the film - with a surprise move - was awarded at the 40th Venice Film Festival with the award for best actor.

title: Fool for Love
actors: Sam Shepard, Kim Basinger, Harry Dean Stanton, Randy Quaid
description: Eddie, a wandering cowboy, reconnects with the great love of his life, May, at an old motel in the desert, despite the fact that she has a new partner. But that's not the only threat hanging over their passion. A mysterious old man hides a secret so dark and fatal that it could kill Eddie and May's love forever.

title: Meres tou '36
actors: Kostas Pavlou, Petros Makaris, Vangelis Kazan, Christos Kalabruzos

title: Gycklarnas afton
actors: Åke Grönberg, Harriet Andersson, Annika Tretow, Hasse Ekman
description: At the beginning of the twentieth century, in Sweden, a group of traveling circus performers. Alberto, the director, suffers the jealousies of the horsewoman Anne, his mistress, and at the same time the rejection of his wife, Agda. Meanwhile the clown Frost has an affair with Anne which leads him to have violent arguments with the director. Alberto, desperate, will not even be able to take his own life.
notes: Ingmar Bergman shows a humanity that is unable to withstand even everyday situations: narrow-minded, treacherous and disillusioned, which drags itself from country to country without ever being able to overcome the superficial dimension. It is the staging that, on the contrary, highlights the inner chasms that the characters do not face.

title: Contes immoraux
actors: Lise Danvers, Fabrice Luchini, Charlotte Alexandra, Paloma Picasso, Pascale Christophe, Lisbeth Hummel, Florence Bellamy, Lorenzo Berinizi, Jacopo Berinizi
description: A film composed of a short film and three episodes. The first episode turns on a Norman beach, where the twenty year old André begins her sixteen year old cousin Julie at sexuality. The second episode sees the religious Thérèse locked up for punishment by the housekeeper in a closet in which the young woman will discover the solitary pleasure. In the third short, the director takes us in 1610 with the Countess Erzsébet Báthory, accompanied by the Paggio Istvan, who visits the villages around his castle by collecting young women with whom he intends to organize sacrifices of blood convinced of obtaining regenerating qualities. The film closes with an episode set in 1498 with Lucrezia Borgia who, with her husband Giovanni Sforza, visits the father and brother, entertaining incestuous relationships with both.

title: Les heroïnes du mal
actors: Marina Pierro, François Guetary, Gaëlle Legrand, Hassan Fall, Pascale Christophe
description: Three heroines of evil that grant themselves to the joys of lust and the pleasure of revenge: Margherita Luti, called the Fornarina, model and lover of Raffaello, betrays the painter with a banker, then he poles them both; Marceline is a teenager who curls with her rabbit; Marie is kidnapped by a gangster, and freed from the adorate Dobermann who first kills the gangster and then the husband.

title: Journal d'un curé de campagne
actors: Claude Laydu, Joan Riveyre, Nicole Maurey, Adrien Borel, Rachel Bérendt, Nicole Ladmiral, Martin Lemaire, Antoine Balpêtré, Jean Denet
description: A young idealistic priest in charge of leading the parish of Ambricourt tries to fulfill his duty, but is often misunderstood and the community begins to reject him. In addition, his weak stomach causes him constant suffering.

title: Un condamné à mort s'est échappé
actors: François Leterrier, Roland Monod, Charles Le Clainche

title: Le journal d'une femme de chambre
actors: Jeanne Moreau, Georges Géret, Michel Piccoli, Françoise Lugagne
description: First half of the 1920s. The Parisian Célestine finds a job as a waitress with a wealthy provincial family. She is forced to face the advances of the fetishist landlord, among other things she discovers that the gardener Monteil is a maniac who kills little girls. The social rise of the woman is accomplished when she manages to marry a doting officer.
notes: Luis Buñuel, thanks to the novel by Octave Mirbeau (Renoir also made a film in 1946), offers us a caustic portrait of the French province which, behind a semblance of respectability, hides murky obsessions. Screenplay by Jean-Claude Carrière.

title: Nazarin
actors: Francesco Rabal, Marga López, Rita Macedo, Jésus Fernández

title: Él
actors: Arturo de Córdova, Delia Garcés, Luis Beristain, Aurora Walker
description: During the lavender ceremony of the feet on the occasion of Holy Thursday, the 40 -year -old Francisco Galvan De Montemayor, a rich landowner and fervent devotee, is struck by the vision of the feet of a stranger. Once the young woman named Gloria, she discovers that she is her girlfriend of her friend Raoul. The subject of a passionate court, in a short time Gloria truncates his relationship with Raoul to marry Francisco who, during the first wedding night, confesses to her that she had kept chasing until then. After the idyll of the honeymoon, the man immediately proves to be morbidly jealous and paranoid towards his wife, so much so that he pushes glory to confide with Raoul, hoping to be believed.

title: La ilusión viaja en tranvía
actors: Lilia Prado, Carlos Navarro, Fernando 'Mantequilla' Soto, Agustín Isunza

title: High Art
actors: Radha Mitchell, Ally Sheedy, Gabriel Mann, Charis Michelsen, David Thornton, Anh Duong, Patricia Clarkson, Helen Mendes

title: Le mystère Picasso
actors: Pablo Picasso
description: In his Victorine studio in Nice, the famous painter Pablo Picasso offers himself to the camera in the act of painting. The technique is to work a particular ink that is imprinted so deeply on the canvas as to allow the painting to be taken upside down during its execution. From drawing to watercolor to oil painting: the first film on pictorial creation. Not a documentary, nor a biography, nor an illustration, but a unique experiment, a sort of "animated drawing". Special Jury Prize in Cannes in 1956.

title: The Terence Davies Trilogy
actors: Phillip Mawdsley, Terry O'Sullivan, Wilfred Brambell
description: Three autobiographical short films made over the seven years in which a gay man resets with various themes of his existence: from his Catholic education to the sense of guilt, from the death of his parents to solitude.

title: The Neon Bible
actors: Gena Rowlands, Jacob Tierney, Diana Scarwid, Denis Leary
description: America, 40s. During a train ride, a teenager recalls his childhood spent in a small town in the southern United States and marked by suffering and exuberant escapes thanks to an aunt who was somewhat over the top ...
notes: Nostalgia, dreams, songs: there is everything in Terence Davies' film. Everything you need to be moved, smile, have fun, sigh. Memories run parallel to the tracks of the moving train and lead to the re-elaboration of the sufferings experienced. But above all Gena Rowlands dominates, a character with an incredible energy charge, the incarnation of a cinematography that wants to be pure escape, pure fun, healthy transgression. We all wanted an aunt like that!

title: Les demoiselles de Rochefort
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Françoise Dorléac, Danielle Darrieux, George Chakiris

title: Les parapluies de Cherbourg
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Nino Castelnuovo, Anne Vernon, Marc Michel, Ellen Farner
description: Genevière Emery loves Guy Foucher, a young mechanic, but Genevière's mother, who owns an umbrella shop, doesn't approve of their relationship. When Guy leaves for the war in Algeria and Geneviève finds herself pregnant, her mother pushes her to marry Roland Cassard, a wealthy diamond cutter. A few years later, however, during a Christmas night, while it is snowing, something unexpected happens.

title: Præsidenten
actors: Halvard Hoff, Elith Pio, Carl Meyer, Olga Raphael-Linden, Betty Kirkeby

title: Der var engang
actors: Clara Wieth, Svend Methling, Peter Jerndorff, Hakon Ahnfelt-Rønne

title: La chute de la maison Usher
actors: Jean Debucourt, Marguerite Gance, Charles Lamy, Fournez-Goffard
description: In the Usher house the owner paints the portrait of his wife Madeline, and it is as if the woman lived in the painting. When she dies, her husband absolutely does not want her coffin sealed, but only covered with a very thin veil. One stormy night, however, in the tomb, the coffin falls to the ground, the candles are overturned, setting fire to the house and Madeline appears. While the devastating flames devour everything, in the painting the female figure has mysteriously disappeared.
notes: Based on two short stories by Edgar Allan Poe, the film is influenced by German expressionism, but reworked by Jean Epstein seeking exasperation in the suggestion of natural elements and objects. Bold technical innovations, such as "slow motion", to create distressing atmospheres.

title: Fontane Effi Briest
actors: Karlheinz Böhm, Hanna Schygulla, Wolfgang Schenk, Ulli Lommel

title: Il dono
actors: Michelangelo Frammartino, Gabriella Maiolo

title: Sürü
actors: Tarik Akan, Tuncel Kurtiz, Melike Demirag, Levent Iranir

title: Rekopis znaleziony w Saragosie
actors: Zbigniew Cybulski, Iga Cembrznynska, Joanna Jedryka, Kazimierz Opalinski

title: Senatorium pod Clepsydra
actors: Jan Nowicki, Tadeusz Kondrat, Irena Orska, Halina Kowalska
description: Joseph (Jan Nowicki) ventures by train on a dreamlike and hallucinatory journey with the final destination of the sanatorium where his father is dying.

title: Fengkuei-lai-te jen
actors: Niu Chengze, Lin Xiulung, Chen Shufang, Chao Pengju, Zhang Minling
description: Four boys, who have just finished their studies, spend their days bored and aimless. After yet another clash with the rival gang, they leave their native village on a small island in Taiwan and move to Gaoxiang. Life in the big city is tough and the four will eventually separate.

title: Dongdong de jiaqi
actors: Wang Qiguang, Lin Xiuling, Koo Chuen, Mei Fang

title: Hai shang hua
actors: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Rebecca Pan, Michelle Reis, Shuan Fang, Michiko Hada, Annie Shizuka Inoh, Jack Kao, Carina Lau

title: Szerelmen, Elektra
actors: Mari Töröcsik, Jozsef Madaras, György Csarhaimi

title: Seppuku
actors: Tatsuya Nakadai, Akira Ishihama, Shima Iwashita, Akira Ishihama
description: At the beginning of the seventeenth century, the ronin (a samurai without a master) Hanshiro Tsugumo, appears at the doors of the Iyi house. He asks that, given his misfortune, be granted a place to commit ritual suicide. With the intention of dissuading him, the steward tells him about another ronin, who appeared some time earlier with the same request. But another truth lies behind the samurai ritual ...
notes: The pacifist Kobayashi creates a work of great formal elegance that analyzes and challenges the mechanisms of Japanese military authoritarianism. This is supported by the elaborate script by Shinobu Hashimoto who, as already in _Rashomon_, plays with real and apparent motivations.

title: Jôi-uchi: Hairyô tsuma shimatsu
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Yoko Tsukasa, Tatsuyoshi Ehara, Etsuko Ichihara

title: King and Country
actors: Dirk Bogarde, Tom Courtenay, Leo McKern, Barry Foster, James Villiers
description: World War I: Private Arthur Hamp is tried for desertion. He is defended - not without reluctance - by Captain Hargreaves, to whom Hamp explains the reasons for his gesture: the only survivor of a battle and upset by his wife's betrayal, he no longer saw any reason to remain in the ranks. Little by little, the officer's contempt turns into sympathy, but the need for an "exemplary" sentence takes over ...
notes: A claustrophobic and dense dialogue "chamber" film, in which Losey declines in an incisive and personal way the antimilitarist assumption of the play _Hamp_ by John Wilson (scripted by Evan Jones).

title: Le deuxième souffle
actors: Lino Ventura, Paul Meurisse, Raymond Pellegrin, Marcel Bozzuffi
description: Criminal Gu Minda escapes from prison. Meanwhile, his former cronies wage gang war in Marseille to gain control of the local cigarette smuggling. Commissioner Blot, who follows the case, tries to frame Gu, who is preparing the expatriation together with his friend Manouche. First, however, he participates in a robbery that ends in carnage. Blot frames him and passes him off as an informant. The moment of reckoning comes.
notes: Melville's masterpiece, a great existential fresco: essential, tense, with a first-rate cast. Based on a book by José Giovanni.

title: Pjat' Vecerov
actors: Ljudmilla Gurcenko, Stanislav Ljubsin, Valentina Teleckina, Larisa Kuznetzova

title: Genroku chushingura

description: During an official reception at the shogun, the master of ceremonies is threatened with a sword inside the palace. The perpetrator of the gesture will be forced to do hara-kiri. 47 samurai in his service are left without a master (turning into ronin), and swear to avenge him. Two years later they will take their revenge and the shogun, admiring their loyalty, will condemn them to death.

title: The Four Devils

title: City Girl
actors: Charles Farrell, Mary Duncan, David Torrence, Edith Yorke, Dawn O'Day

title: Whisky Galore!
actors: Basil Radford, Catherine Lacey, Bruce Seton, Joan Greenwood
description: At the end of the war, in full rationing, a ship bound for America with a load of whiskey runs aground off the coast of Scotland. Short of "water of life", the inhabitants decide to recover the precious nectar by any means (and illegally).

title: Un'ora sola ti vorrei
description: Alina Marazzi has recovered sixty reels of amateur films in 16 and 8 mm that tell the life of her mother Líseli Hoepli Marazzi, who committed suicide in 1972 at the age of 33, and of her family. The filming was carried out by the maternal grandfather Ulrico Hoepli, homonymous and son of that Ulrich who founded a publishing house specialized in scientific and technical publications. It is a very painful research journey, which focuses on the discomfort and the evil of living that led a beautiful woman, who seemed to have everything, to give up her life. But it is also the path of a bourgeois family through Italy in the second half of the twentieth century.

title: Milano '83
description: A documentary on the dawn of Milano da Bere told from the very personal point of view of the director from Bergamo.

title: Yoshiwara
actors: Michiko Tanaka, Sessue Hayakawa, Pierre Richard-Willm, Roland Toutain
description: The young Kohana, from a high-ranking but now decayed family, is forced into prostitution: Isamo, who loves her deeply, tries to change her life; but when she loses her head for the Russian lieutenant Sergej, events take a tragic turn ...
notes: The great Franco-German author signs a mélo with abstract and hallucinatory implications.

title: Kôkaku kidôtai
description: Japan, 2029: the world is completely computerized and cybernetic implants amplify the physical and mental capacities of human beings, but also make them susceptible to new attacks. The mysterious lord of puppets exploits these technologies, a terrorist who takes control, through computer channels, of the minds of men. The men of section 9 investigate him, commanded by the Machiavellian Aramaki and led on the field by the beautiful and determined Motoko Kusanagi.
notes: The animation technique is extraordinary, the direction of the action scenes is breathtaking and the philosophical implications of remarkable charm and depth. From the Masamune Shirow manga, with a sequel and two TV series.

title: The Yakuza
actors: Robert Mitchum, Ken Takakura, Brian Keith, Eiji Okada, Kishi Keiko
description: Harry Kilmer, an American who traffics in arms, returns to Japan after an absence lasting the beauty of twenty years. He is called by his friend George Tanner whose daughter the Yakuza has kidnapped. Harry can count on the support of Eiko Tanaka, loved by him during the occupation, and his brother Ken. The undertaking proves to be more difficult than expected ...
notes: Under the - here and there gruesome - bark of this violent thriller is a passionate story about love and friendship. Written by Robert Towne and Paul Schrader (from a story by the latter's brother, Leonard)? Originally, the film ran 123 minutes.

title: Pather Panchali
actors: Kanu Bannerjee, Karuna Bannerjee, Subir Bannerjee, Runki Bannerjee
description: The little Apu witnesses the sad condition of his fallen Bengali family, of Brahmin caste, at the beginning of the twentieth century. The elder sister Durga dies as a violent monsoon sweeps the village. The father, after losing his job, decides to move with his family to Benares.
notes: Made with little means, it is the extraordinary debut of Satyajit Ray and the first part of the Apu trilogy. The Indian government censored him because he showed "too abject poverty". The elegiac rhythm and the gaze turned to beauty know how to deal with misery without aestheticizing it, touching a truer and deeper dimension of everyday life. Human Document Award in Cannes in 1956.

title: Sideways
actors: Paul Giamatti, Thomas Haden Church, Virginia Madsen, Sandra Oh
description: Miles, an aspiring novelist and great wine connoisseur, decides to take a trip with his best friend Jack, a failed actor, through the vineyards of the Santa Ynez Valley the week before Jack gets married ...
notes: Like a Bob Rafelson without - perhaps - the great rage imploded, like a Hal Ashby without - perhaps - the desperate melancholy, _Sideways - Traveling with Jack_ traces imaginary, reality and characters, as the title literally says, "sideways", feel, on tiptoe (sideways to what, it is easy to guess). The film is so far from the din and noise of the contemporary that it feels good.

title: Apur Sansar
actors: Soumitra Chatterjee, Sharmila Tagore, Swapan Mukherjee, Alok Chakravarty

title: Million Dollar Baby
actors: Clint Eastwood, Hilary Swank, Morgan Freeman, Jay Baruchel, Mike Colter, Lucia Rijker, Brian F. O'Byrne, Anthony Mackie, Margo Martindale, Riki Lindhome, Michael Peña
description: Frankie Dunn spent his life in the ring, training many boxers. His only friend is Scrap, also a former boxer, with whom he runs a gym in Los Angeles. The arrival of Maggie, a girl determined to fight, changes Frankie's habits and attitude: he will make her a champion, but the price she will have to pay will be very high ...
notes: Here is a profoundly religious film, of a human and, if you like, secular religiosity: not only because the "sinner" Frankie has been serving for 23 years by going to mass every day and every day by asking questions that the priest does not want to answer, but because that of Maggie Fitzgerald, "white garbage" that redeems itself, is an authentic Passion. Directed by Eastwood with an essential style that never fails, always one step away from cliché and effect, always punctual in cutting or dissolving a scene when it is about to break into melodrama, and written (by Paul Haggis) with an economy and an irony that faithfully reproduce the shy character of the protagonists. A film about good and bad roots, about the dreams we carry inside, about the best part of us, about Ireland and therefore about John Ford. "The world is full of Irish people, or people who want to be," says narrator Scrap. And who still doesn't know what "Mo chuisle" means, the Gaelic inscription that Maggie wears imprinted on the robe given to her by Frankie for the match against the English welterweight champion, wait for his heart to crack when the same Frankie reveals it in the finale.

title: The Witchfinder General
actors: Vincent Price, Ian Ogilvy, Rupert Davies, Hilary Dwyer, Robert Russell
description: In seventeenth -century England, an inquisitor is around the country countries in search of alleged witches to be punished in the most atrocious ways.

title: Madame Bovary
actors: Pierre Renoir, Valentine Tessier, Alice Tissotn Héléna Manson
description: In the French province of the mid-nineteenth century, the young Emma marries the doctor Charles Bovary: but soon, disappointed by the flat marriage ménage, she takes refuge in adultery. Abandoned and burdened with debt, she poisons herself.
notes: Deliberately gray and monotonous "like life", a somewhat "plastered" version of the famous novel.

title: Toni
actors: Charles Blavette, Jenny Hélia, Célia Montalvan, Max Dalban
description: Toni, an Italian quarrier who emigrated to Provence, marries his landlady while remaining in love with Josefa, raped and then married by the master builder Albert. The wife tries to commit suicide and this pushes Toni even more into Josefa's arms, who meanwhile is meditating on killing her husband ...
notes: Shot in Marcel Pagnol's Marseille studios and "on location", with many non-professionals, it is considered a precursor of neorealism. Renoir is inspired by the news, he looks with empathy at the social conditions he describes, but goes further and draws an anthropological study on elementary and violent drives: a tragedy full of sensuality and contradictions.

title: French Cancan
actors: Jean Gabin, Françoise Arnoul, Maria Felix, Gianni Esposito
description: Nini is called as a laundress to work behind the scenes of the new venue that is causing all Paris to talk about: the Moulin Rouge. Soon, however, everyone will realize that the girl is also an excellent dancer, ready to challenge the stage.
notes: Great film by Renoir, who for once thinks above all of having fun. The real-life impresario of Montmartre Danglard is played by Gabin, and many have seen the director's alter ego in it, no longer young but still able to become attached to the characters and amaze. And this time with a frenetic and almost "American" sentimental musical in the breath.

title: Le testament du docteur Cordelier
actors: Jean-Louis Barrault, Michel Vitold, Gaston Modot, Jacques Catelain
description: Dr. Cordelier is a famous psychiatrist completely absorbed in research. In his will he names a certain monsieur Opal as sole heir, unknown even to the doctor's faithful friend, Joly. Meanwhile, bloody events take place near Cordelier's home ...
notes: Renoir's genius reinvents the myth of Jekyll and Hyde.

actors: Anthony Wong Chau-Sang, Francis Wong, Jackie Lui Chung-yin
description: Triad boss Lung, just escaping a bombing, hires five hit men for his protection: Curtis, James, Mike, Roy and Shin. Silent, ineffable, efficient and with an iron sense of honor of a modern samurai: however, the group will be challenged by the conflict between mutual solidarity and obedience.
notes: An unforgettable soundtrack, which revolves all around a thumping arcade tune, like in a futile carousel. Still shootings of extraordinary geometric perfection, characters with a mythical and painful halo who miraculously manage not to be specks: To freezes the "heroic bloodshed" and signs a masterpiece.

description: Gleaning is the agricultural activity of researching and harvesting the ears left in the field after the harvest, but - translating - it can be extended to define any survival activity that operates starting from recycled materials. It is on this broader meaning that the documentary by the Belgian director focuses, who travels through the countryside as well as through the cities in search of all those who practice gleaning.

title: Danton
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Wojtiech Psznoniak, Patrice Chéreau, Roger Planchon
description: Autumn 1793: the French Republic goes through a period of crisis. While the borders are threatened by the royalist forces, the internal situation in the country amidst poverty, famine and infighting rapidly degenerates. Danton, one of the great protagonists of the Revolution, returns to Paris alarmed by the situation to implement a peace program that puts an end to the regime of Terror. The irremediable conflict with Robespierre is unleashed.
notes: The Polish Andrzej Wajda stages the clash between Danton, played by Gerard Depardieu, and Robespierre focusing above all on the psychology of the characters, outlined in their contradictions, against the backdrop of an emblematic piece of history.

description: Swordmaster Feng Ou-yang is a hitman who has decided to live in isolation in the desert. The visit of a girl who wants to avenge her brother's death brings back the memory of the only woman he ever loved.

title: Vojna i mir
actors: Ludmila Savel'eva, Irina Skobceva, Vjaceslav Tikhonov, Sergey Bondarchuk
description: In 1805 Napoleon's troops invade Russia. Prince Andrei enlists, disappointed in his marriage, while his friend Pierre woos the gay Natasha; but marries another. Prince Andrei is wounded during the war against the Napoleonic invader. Back home, he falls in love with Natasha, then returns to the front and dies. His friend Pierre feels the war like a curse, then a new life begins alongside Natasha.
notes: The transcription of Tolstoy's novel is not unfaithful even if the direction is more focused on spectacular scenes, such as the war, the dances, the retreat of the troops into the snow.

actors: Rudolf Klein-Rogge, Gustav Diessl, Camilla Spira, Oskar Beregi

actors: Malgorzata Foremniak, Wladyslaw Kowalski, Jerzy Gudejko
description: Ash earns his living from the credits he wins in the Avalon video game. Soon the real and virtual worlds merge definitively.

title: Heimat - Eine Chronik in elf Teilen
actors: Marita Breuer, Gertrud Bredel, Michael Lesch, Dieter Schaad
description: Made by Edgar Reitz Filmproduktion between 1979 and 2006 (30 chapters, 55 hours in duration), Heimat is an immense saga on the history of Germany that spans a span of time from 1919 to the beginning of the third millennium. From Schabbach, an imaginary village in the Rhineland, the director's region of origin, and with large sections in Munich and Berlin, through the events of the Simon family, Reitz follows the evolution of German history, its tragedies and the profound transformations experienced in the span of a century. It is a complex reconstruction of historical memory in search of the deepest roots of the German soul, torn apart by the events of the twentieth century. The point of view adopted is that of the "humble", common people protagonists of the truest history of a country, and the re-foundation of the authentic and profound concept of Heimat that derives from it is in stark contrast to the sweetened celebrations of the Heimatfilm, for a long time present in German cinema, from the years of Nazism to the 1950s. The work is divided into three sections and an epilogue: Heimat - A German story; Heimat 2 -History of a youth; Heimat 3 - Chronicle of an epochal turning point; Heimat Fragmente.

title: Die Zweite Heimat - Chronik einer Jugend
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Anke Sevenich, Noemi Steuer

title: Out 1: Noli me tangere
actors: Pierre Baillot, Juliet Berto, Marcel Bonozet, Françoise Fabian
description: In the Parisian off-theater environment, two different companies operate at the same time united and divided by mysterious correspondences, engaged in as many productions of _Prometeo_ and _The seven against Thebes_.
notes: Fluviale (over 12 hours in total) monument of the Nouvelle Vague.

title: Mirai shônen Conan
directors: Hayao Miyazaki, Isao Takahata, Keiji Hayakawa
description: In the 21st century, twenty years after World War III, the world has been destroyed and 12-year-old Conan lives on an island with his grandfather, believing he is the only two survivors of the conflict. One day, however, Conan discovers an unconscious girl on the beach: it is 11-year-old Lana, on the run from the evil rulers of Indastria, who intend to kidnap her and use her as bait to convince her grandfather to reveal the secret of solar energy. useful to rule the world. After Lana is kidnapped from the island, Conan decides to save her and leaves for Indastria.
notes: Produced by Nippon Animation for the NHK television network. Series consisting of 26 episodes broadcast in Japan in 1978 and in Italy in 1981. Directed by Hayao Miyazaki. Adaptation of Alexander Key's children's science fiction novel The Incredible Tide.

title: Kaze no tani no Naushika
description: Following a cataclysm that devastated the entire planet, a toxic forest covered most of the earth's surface. In this apocalyptic scenario, where a new war is about to break out, the kingdom of the Valley of the Wind - ruled by Jihl, father of the brave Princess Nausicaä - is one of the few areas still populated. Nausicaä has two gifts: knowing how to ride the wind flying like birds and being able to communicate with the Ohms, the giant guardian insects of the forest. Thanks to her skills and the love and esteem of her people, Princess Nausicaä will undertake a courageous challenge to restore peace and reconcile humanity with the Earth.
notes: The first of a long series of heroines created by Miyazaki, Nausicaä perfectly embodies both the author's pacifist spirit and his passion for flying, hovering above a very light aircraft in visionary sequences reminiscent of Moebius's Arzach. Already arrived in Italy broken into "episodes" by Rai in the 80s, the film benefits from a new distribution with a new controversial adaptation by Gualtiero Cannarsi.

title: Tenkû no shiro Rapyuta
description: Pazu, an orphan boy, is returning home from his shift in the mine when Sheeta, a little girl wrapped in a mysterious light that allowed her to float in the air, falls on her arms from the sky. Awakened the next day from a long sleep, Sheeta tells him that she is a resident of Laputa, a legendary castle floating in the clouds and that she escaped from a group of pirates intent on capturing her. Since Pazu remembers a photograph that her father had managed to take in Laputa, he decides to help her find her way home, embarking on a long and dangerous adventure with her.
notes: Suspended in a timeless space, Il castello nel cielo is a fatal criss cross of cinema, literature, painting, history. The adventure of teenager Sheeta and Pazu is littered with anti-militarist signs and Miyazaki's love for open science / nature conflict, with its marvelous winged devices, the flaptors, ridden by good pirates, "Mother Help" twins. of Porco rosso. Suspense, action, melancholy, and in the center an immense "tree of life" with roots reaching out towards the stars.

title: Tonari no Totoro
description: In the 1950s, the young Satsuke and little Mei move to a small town near Tokyo, together with their father, while their mother is hospitalized in a hospital not too far away. The two show an extraordinary enthusiasm for the world of the countryside and for popular folklore, a purity that leads them to get to know the creatures of the forest where a sacred tree stands majestically. In addition to the guardian spirit, Totoro, large, plump and hairy, will meet other smaller "totori", the tiny "nerini" (similar to the soot spirits of the Enchanted City) and the imposing and fast Gattobus.
notes: The most famous creature of Hayao Miyazaki arrives in our country 21 years after its birth. The coexistence of mythical creatures and rural life is of a simple but irresistible magic, like the softness of the line, with warm colors and accompanied by the memorable melodies of the trusted Joe Hisaishi. A fundamental chapter in the history of cinema not only in animation, included among the 100 best films of all time by Akira Kurosawa.

title: Majo no takkyûbin
description: As per tradition for every little witch, at the age of 13 Kiki is invited by her mother to leave the house to live a year of apprenticeship with her black cat in tow. Arriving in a seaside town, she finds hospitality at the bakery Osono, who in exchange asks her to take care of the deliveries.
notes: In theaters 24 years after its release, Miyazaki's fifth feature film hasn't aged a day in staging a Bildungsroman of overwhelming freshness. As in the painting painted by her friend Ursula, the mutation is frightening and fascinating, and Miyazaki knows how to tell it with impeccable grace; on the side, really, of the girls.

title: Kurenai no buta
description: Marco Pagot is an exceptional pilot of the Italian military aviation who during the First World War survives a mysterious and terrible accident, after which however he undergoes an extraordinary transformation that makes him similar to a pig. The new features lead him to move away from aviation and the good life he led, also leaving his girlfriend Gina, a singer in a nightclub. Thus ends up on the Dalmatian coast and with his red plane he is dedicated to fighting the pirates of the air, starting a new life and making new acquaintances.
notes: Shintoism and Marxist secularism, the greatest contemporary animator creates stylistic and emotional metamorphoses between Disney and manga in this masterpiece created to entertain the passengers of the JAL and has become one of the most important titles of the Totoro brand (symbol of the Studio). The pig man metaphor has many interpretations, starting with the fascist insult aimed at the communists. But it is also an ironic allusion to the innocent sensuality that binds him to a 17-year-old, with boundless fantasy-engineering qualities, in love with him despite her bestial appearance. And then, that "pig" materializes the sense of guilt that Miyazaki carries inside because his family built military aircraft during the Second World War. What is certain is that his planes only drop bombs of pure, sublime poetry.

title: Maniac
actors: Joe Spinell, Caroline Munro, Gail Lawrence, Kelly Piper, Rita Montone
description: Frank Zito is a middle-aged man who lives in solitude in a New York neighborhood. In reality he is a schizophrenic killer who commits the most heinous murders at night: he assaults young couples and prostitutes by scalping unfortunate women, then placing it on mannequins he keeps at home.
notes: The film directed by William Lustig is a thriller that does not spare scenes of considerable gory and sadism. In the succession of violence, the director manages to fuel the suspense of the viewer by making him identify with the thoughts and disturbing neuroses of the killer (Joe Spinell), neglecting the aspect of police investigations. Special effects and makeup by Tom Savini, here also an actor.

title: Rivelazioni di un maniaco sessuale al capo della squadra mobile
actors: Farley Granger, Sylva Koscina, Silvano Tranquilli, Annabella Incontrera
description: A dark mystery hovers in the city: five corpses of women are found horribly tortured and mutilated. These are the five wives of five big shots, so the plot thickens: who will be the terrible maniac and what is the motivation that drives him to such heinous actions?

title: Vertical Limit
actors: Chris O'Donnell, Bill Paxton, Robin Tunney, Scott Glenn
description: A group of climbers is facing a wall. Suddenly the patatrac happens: they all remain in the balance, and one of them - father of the other two - sacrifices himself for the offspring. We meet the two brothers years later: the girl insists on climbing and is about to face K2, the boy has given himself more prudently to nature photography. But when she gets in trouble, do you bet he'll challenge the planet's second mountain to save her little sister and honor her father's memory?
notes: Martin Campbell signs everything with one eye on the digital effects and the other on the reasonable check cashed at the end of the shoot.

title: Die Schwarzen Adler von Santa Fé
directors: Albert Cardiff (Alberto Cardone), Albert Cardiff (Alberto Cardone)
actors: Brad Harris, Tony Kendall, Thomas Moore, Helga Sommerfeld
description: Terrified by the Scrolls of the Indian, the settlers of the Santa Fé region find refuge in a military fort. While the soldiers temporarily, a federal agent and a journalist discover that the Indian uprising was fomented by a wealthy landowner ...
notes: Very high Italian-French-German production.

title: Three Sisters
actors: Joan Plowright, Jeanne Watts, Louise Purnell, Alan Bates, Laurence Olivier

title: What's Up, Tiger Lily?
actors: Tatsuya Mihashi, Miya Hana, Akiko Wakabayashi
description: Two rival gangs go on a frenzied hunt for a chicken salad recipe.
notes: This is the American edition of the Japanese film _Kizino Kizi (The key to the keys) _, which in the hands of the newcomer Allen - who directed some added scenes and distorted the dialogues in dubbing - becomes a parody of the Bond adventures.

title: Miquette et sa mère
actors: Louis Jouvet, Bourvil, Danièle Delorme, Mireille Perrey, Pauline Carton
description: Early twentieth century: Corneille's Le Cid is staged in the French town of Casteldon. One of the performers, Monchablon, pushes young Miquette, daughter of the local widow tobacconist, Mrs Grandier, to go to Paris to become an actress. But Urbain, nephew of the Marquis de la Tour-Mirande, pays tribute to her, even if he is promised to another.
notes: From the play of the same name by Robert de Flers and Gaston Armand de Cavaillet, already brought to the screen twice in 1932 and 1940, Clouzot draws a satirical comedy about Paris belle époque.

title: La vérité
actors: Marie Jose Nat, Brigitte Bardot, Sami Frey, Paul Meurisse, Charles Vanel
description: Dominique Marceau is tried for the murder of her lover, Gilbert Tellier, who is engaged to her sister, Annie. The trial is opposed by the thesis of the prosecutor Eparvier, who supports the death penalty, and the defense lawyer Guérin, convinced of the crime of passion. Dominique, subjected to lynching by the jury, retraces all the stages of history.
notes: Scripted by the director with his wife Vera, Jérôme Geronimo, Simone Drieu and Michelle Perrein, it sees Bardot struggling with a tough acting test. Nominated for an Oscar in '61, he earned a Golden Globe.

title: A Tree Grows in Brooklyn
actors: Peggy Ann Garner, James Dunn, Dorothy McGuire, Joan Blondell

title: The Arrangement
actors: Kirk Douglas, Faye Dunaway, Deborah Kerr, Hume Cronyn
description: Eddie Anderson has everything you could want: money, professional affirmation (he's a successful advertiser), a satisfying menage with his wife Florence. The meeting with Gwen will be the spring that will push him to reconsider values ??that seemed immovable.
notes: Kazan is writing a novel of his with strong autobiographical implications, obtaining a painful existential balance sheet and, at the same time, a reflection on the anti-bourgeois anxieties that crossed contemporary society. For the character of Eddie, the director of Greek-Turkish origins would have liked Marlon Brando but, after initially accepting, he declined the invitation.

title: Os canibais
actors: Luis Miguel Cintra, Leonor Silveira, Diogo Dória, Oliveira Lopez
description: Margarida is in love with the Viscount of Avelada: for this reason she refuses the passionate and insistent court of Don Giovanni. Finally, during a dance, she manages to approach the object of her desire. Later she takes him as a husband. But on the night of the wedding he reveals a horrible secret: he is not a man, but an automaton. Only the heart and the head are not mere mechanisms. The tragedy explodes.
notes: An opera film based on a wonderful long story by Álvaro do Carvlahal. _The cannibals_ is a very rigorous fantastic apologue, surgical in the subtle cruelty of its gaze, in the tragic paradox staged with placid tranquility. Calm, free and sharp surrealism, about the inevitable setback and decadence of the aristocracy.

title: The Last of England
actors: Spring, John Phillips, Gay Gaynor, Gerard McArthur, Matthew Hawkins

title: Poor Cow

Mizzi tries to seduce Dr. Braun, who has recently married her excellent friend Charlotte and at the same time Dr. Mueller, who has always had a soft spot for Charlotte, looks favorably on these initiatives by Mizzi, hoping to have the way clear. . Hours go by and young people end up getting to know each other and talking to each other. After the first teases and the inevitable quarrels, the five confront their lives.
notes: Although everything is very stereotyped, the film - written, produced and directed by John Hughes - sincerely highlights the problems of youth.

title: Broken Lullaby

notes: In Ernst Lubitsch's filmography, this _The Man I Killed_ has a very special place, because the director makes a foray into the melodramatic genre with tears and piety at will. At the time it was also very popular for the openly pacifist subject. Taken from _L'homme que j'ai tué_ by Maurice Rostand.

title: Design for Living
actors: Gary Cooper, Fredric March, Miriam Hopkins, Edward Everett

When Tom goes to London, the other two go to work on their own, but when he returns, things get bad and Gilda marries another man. When marriage fails ...
notes: Based on a Coward comedy.

Unique elements of scenography a table, a glass of water and two maps. Gray's story moves among the memories of life to Southeast Asia to the testimony of the atrocities suffered by the Cambodian people.
notes: Deme films a theatrical monologue by Gray and adapts it for the big screen by reducing the original duration of 4 hours. A great documentary, made with simplicity, with a minimum budget (less than half a million dollars), making use of an organic and unconscious assembly, of the evocative soundtrack of Laurie Anderson and the stage presence of Gray.

Screenwriter David Sherwin makes fun of the capitalist world and, while the outcome is sometimes a bit confusing and verbose, it never fails to be vital and inspiring. Excellent music by Alan Price, keyboardist and founder of the Animals.

The woman, with the help of Ash Correll - father of one of the other victims of the air disaster - will do anything to prove who is not crazy.
notes: Maybe we exaggerate, and we too see things that apparently do not exist, but we have the feeling that with this story we mean precisely an American socio-military reality, the same as _Fahrenheit 9 / 11_, but on the other side of the fence. Who knows if that's true. Ruben continues to be the promise of twenty years ago. Failure.

notes: Lots of psychedelia, a touch of early Gus Van Sant (_Drugstore Cowboy_), even the use of crude graphic animations as in some experimental cinema. The gaze is derivative but pertinent, the narrative "sick" enough, the inspiration of the bitter but authentic Argento.

notes: One wonders which Italy, with the evocation of this story, the authors regret. Perhaps the same as the (not surprisingly?) Most likeable character, Dino Abbrescia, who claims to be a fascist because nothing convinced him that it was better to be something else. Film of "national interest", of course, but the bill is from top-of-the-range TV fiction, like Renzo Martinelli. Cinema is elsewhere.

title: Pianosequenza

description: The encounters and clashes of a group of people: the writer Paolo and his girlfriend Maria, the pimp Francesco and the poet Cupid ...
notes: A hermetic film? Not so much, if the reflection on language and the challenge to the possibilities of the medium are accepted as the thematic fulcrum. 123 minutes of digital sequence shot: it took a technical ability and a courage that the young director Louis Nero (born in 1976) does not lack. We recommend just a little more humility. Starting from Sokurov and defining his basic idea of ??the sequence shot as the only fixed shot as "superficial" is madness. Also because some of the most beautiful sequence shots in the cinema (that of Widmark and Stewart on the river bank in _They Rode Together_) are beautifully, inexorably motionless.

title: The Assassination of Richard Nixon
actors: Sean Penn, Naomi Watts, Don Cheadle, Jack Thompson, Brad William Henke
description: In the winter of 1974, the forty-four-year-old Samuel J. Bicke goes through a period of profound crisis: he is separated from his wife, on bad terms with his brother and cannot keep a job for more than a certain period. His dream is to start a business with his mechanic friend Bonny, but to do so he needs a bank loan which is denied him. Persecuted by everyone, he becomes convinced that only killing Nixon will solve his problems ...
notes: Mueller's film flounders in the evident attempt to recreate a cultural and cinematic climate: the one that in the mid-1970s led to the creation of masterpieces such as _La conversation_ and _Taxi Driver_.

title: Cuore sacro
actors: Barbora Bobulova, Andrea Di Stefano, Lisa Gastoni, Massimo Poggio, Erika Blanc, Camille Dugay Comencini
description: Irene Ravelli inherited a strong business sense from her father, which she applies profitably in her Milanese company. After obtaining the release from seizure of the ancient family home in Rome, he discovers that the room once inhabited by his mother - now deceased - has remained intact, as if the old woman still lived there. The ghost of her parent and the meeting with an extraordinary child, Benny, generate a conflict in Irene that leads her to a total change ...
notes: Özpetek mixes miracles and familiar obsessions, voices and figures from within (the "ghosts" who return to guide the protagonist) and faces from the underground (the new poor, who still try to give themselves a demeanor, and the poorest of the poor, who do not shame), sacred images (the Pietà evoked by Irene, who supports the bum) and profane consolations (Irene sleeping covered in her mother's sumptuous fuchsia dress), in an incessant coming and going between inside and out, public exhibition and interior "quicksand" . The debts with _Europa '51_ by Roberto Rossellini are clear and declared (starting from the name of the main character).

title: My House in Umbria

notes: Jarmusch's ironic and minimalist touch saves the interlocking plot from the script exercise.

Initially accepted, she was fired for incapacity, while remaining the director's occasional lover. On his way he also meets Milan, a Czech refugee, with whom he has contrasting relationships and acrobatic passion. Inserted in a game bigger than her, between conspiracies and murders, she will become a star returning to the set and playing Liza in "The Demons".

title: L'amour braque
actors: Francis Huster, Sophie Marceau, Tchéky Karyo, Michel Albertini

The young foreigner, who has to find relatives in the French capital, falls madly in love with the girl, and at the same time is coveted by his cousin Aglè, an actress who is setting up Chekhov's "The Seagull" with a company. Between ups and downs, Mickey kills Marie and Leon ends up mad.

title: Trzecia czesc nocy

description: Poland, World War II. Michal is a bourgeois intellectual, the son of a musician, who is convalescing in a country house, while the conflict rages in Lviv, where he lives. With his wife Helena, the bond with which he is in a troubled moment, and with his son Lukasz, he spends this period trying to heal. Suddenly, while he is walking, a group of Nazi soldiers storm the house. In the armed clash, the murder of the family takes place. Only Michal and his father are saved. He returns to the city and tries to help some sections of the resistance. One day, during a mission, he is intercepted by the Nazis and chased into a building. A man in the same suit is shot for him. She enters his apartment, and discovers that the man's wife, pregnant and about to give birth, is identical to Helena. Her name is Marta. Helped her give birth, an increasingly complex survival begins for him, not only because of the obvious difficulties of the case, but also because Michal wants to save, first of all, Marta and her baby, thus trying to reconstitute the nucleus of his family, or to relive, perhaps, a new life ...

Griffith sends a man of his to Mexico to convince Villa, to the sound of cash, to be filmed in action. The first attempts are disastrous, but the two do not give up.
notes: The starting point is very tasty, just as the production effort (thanks to the commitment of HBO cable TV) and the cast (Antonio Banderas, in the role of Pancho Villa, above all) are of a higher level. Too bad for the realization, idle and repetitive.

The following nights, however, Agasa himself notices that Ai actually telephones secretly. This story is intertwined with the inauguration of two large twin towers, whose main architects are inexplicably murdered one after the other. The only clue is a broken cup found next to their corpses: there is enough work for Detective Conan ...

notes: The original project had been entrusted by two American producers to Mario Bava, who gave up to devote himself to _Diabolik_. Passed into the hands of Antonio Margheriti (aka Anthony Dawson), it becomes a bland and obvious thriller, purely imitative, which focuses on the itchy collegiate setting and some effect shots on the bodies of the murdered girls.

notes: An effective example, even if not among the best, of the policeman of the 70s, with Maurizio Merli in the role of the insubordinate and quick-mannered policeman who has no qualms about solving cases with punches. Not all the characters are believable and the direction here and there skips and slows the pace, but the action scenes are more than enjoyable.

In anticipation of his arrival, the military personnel stationed in the rainforest leads an incursion against the local tribe of the Yacumo and takes a young man hostage to negotiate with the natives. Monroe arrives on the site in the seaplane and, after several days of walking in the jungle, the members of his rescue team come across a Yacumo. They organize the release of the host and in return they are brought to the village, where they discover the remains of the four Americans and the coils of the material they have shot.

notes: More dream than reality in this film version of the homonymous miniseries aired on the BBC in 1986, which compared to the original is clean and "glamorous" and runs the risk of boredom and banality. Notable only the interpretation of Robert Downey jr. (in place of the titanic Michael Gambon on television).

notes: Last film directed by Kurosawa, at the time eighty-three.

title: Alfie

notes: In this dramatic comedy (it's not an oxymoron) about the misfortunes of seduction, about charm as a brand in the world of appearances, about the restless struggle between the sexes, the first twenty minutes are a flight to the emergency exit. Later, even those who are insensitive to Law's charisma enter the mechanism of the film - remake of Lewis Gilbert's 1967 English eponymous, starring Michael Caine - and enjoy the analogies (not a defect) with the sexual-sentimental worries of the popular US TV series.

notes: Also for this remake of the good Argentine film _Nove queens_ (2000) by Fabián Bielinsky, the result is not exciting, despite a first level cast. Directed by newcomer Jacobs (already involved in the past by the duo Clooney-Soderbergh in various roles, from that of assistant to that of executive producer), the film seems like a diligent homework, up to a surprise ending that is actually just that. that is expected.

title: Heimat 3 - Chronik einer Zeitenwende
actors: Salome Kammer, Henry Arnold, Michael Kausch Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Michael Kausch
description: Film in six episodes. November 9, 1989: fall of the Berlin Wall. Conductor Hermann Simon and singer Clarissa Lichtblau meet in the foyer of a large hotel in West Berlin. The two have been lovers in the past, but have lost touch for 17 years. They move to the Rhine valley and decide that this will be the center of their lives: thus begins a love story that is followed for a decade and that is intertwined with the existence of other people.
notes: Reitz greets the characters: he accompanies them into the new millennium, but he doesn't seem to see the signs of the future anymore. Historical fresco, coming-of-age novel, family saga and collective history, river film where everyone can find extraordinary moments. Until that little Mozart sonata that Hermann's grandson plays one night on the piano. The future is hers.

While wandering around, Joe meets a young student looking for violent emotions and a drug addict girl. He too takes drugs, and in a withdrawal crisis he is thrown out of the house of a couple who wanted to involve him in a sex triangle. Back home, Joe attempts to have sex with Holly's sister, but fails. But Holly discovers them together and throws her sister out of the house. Then she tries to cheat public assistance by pretending to be pregnant in order to get the subsidy.

title: Heat
actors: Joe Dallesandro, Sylvia Miles, Andrea Feldman, Pat Ast
description: Joe, a former child prodigy, goes to Hollywood in search of his fortune. He settles in an ugly motel and, in search of a chance, will agree to indulge in voracious women, passing from bed to bed, from mother to daughter. But nothing seems to happen in the professional field. Meanwhile, time passes and the murky situations in which he is involved become complicated ...
notes: Morrissey directs, and Warhol produces, a bitter, at times cynical, at times even humorous drama about American society and the Hollywood myth, which underlines their underlying disenchanted pessimism. A sort of Factory reinterpretation of _Viale del Tramonto_, revised freely, without the use of pre-established narrative schemes.

title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
actors: Bill Murray, Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Anjelica Huston, Willem Dafoe, Jeff Goldblum
description: Steve Zissou, legendary underwater explorer known for his documentaries, decides to set up an expedition to find the jaguar shark that devoured Esteban, his best friend and business partner. The crew, made up of a group of bizarre characters, are joined by a pregnant journalist and Ned Plimpton who claims to be Steve's son.
notes: This time, Wes Anderson's comedy of affections, which is a highly sophisticated specialization of sentimental and intellectual comedy, moves away from the mainland and the laws of gravity. Between blowing fuses, boarding pirates, unborn children listening to Proustian readings, inner tides that have been rising and falling in the same way for millennia, irresistible and unreliable mentors, freediving intelligence, seafloor failures, clumsy aspirations and approaches, faults they leave water trails. You see them for a few seconds before the sea takes them back and hides them.

title: Blade: Trinity

description: The vampire hunter Blade and his mentor Whister set out on the trail of the fearsome vampire Drake, with extraordinary powers that allow him to face even the light of day ...
notes: The author renounces the epic of the character, no longer tragic, almost a simple wrestling wrestler, grinning and vacuous. Atrocious disappointment because Wesley Snipes is a prepared and intelligent actor, and Blade, the one in the first two films, remains one of the best fantasy inventions and the best comic transpositions ever.

title: Are We There Yet?
actors: Ice Cube, Nia Long, Aleisha Allen, Philip Bolden, Jay Mohr
description: Nick Persons is in love with African American Suzanne Kingston, a young and attractive divorcee. The woman is in Vancouver on business and Nick plans to take her two sons Kevin, aged seven, and Lindsey aged eleven, to his new and very expensive car. But Nick does not know that the two are convinced that no man is up to their mother, so much so that they are used to dissuading all his possible suitors.
notes: From the director of _Beethoven_, _The Flintstones_ and _Snow Dogs - 8 subzero dogs_ a rather predictable family film. The four-handed script by Steven Gary Banks, Claudia Grazioso, J. David Stem and David N. Weiss is of little use.

But when a tight battle begins to take possession of a conspicuous inheritance, the two arrive at the short irons. They will do everything to get in possession of the money ...

title: Le mouton enragé
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Romy Schneider, Jane Birkin, Jean-Pierre Cassel, Florinda Bolkan, Henri Garcin, Georges Wilson, Estella Blain
description: Nicolas Mallet, a bank employee, is the embodiment of the classic travet that everyone bypasses and no one considers. In an attempt to shake him, his friend Claude Fabre - a moderately successful writer - prepares a plan to revolutionize his life: the first step will consist in submitting his resignation, after which he will have to devote himself body and soul to the seduction of beautiful and high-ranking women. Nicolas follows Claude's instructions to the letter and the fruits are not long in coming, but then he ends up going too far ...
notes: Lively and happily amoral, Deville's film counts on a well-assorted cast in which a luminous Schneider stands out.

To bring her home he ventures to Thailand and sinks his hands into a dangerous intertwining of politics, corruption and betrayal and ... magic! In fact, his opponent hires a Thai voodoo sorcerer, while ours will be protected by a Buddhist monk master ...
notes: The film directed by Ching Siu-tung, director of _Chinese ghost story_ and above all renowned "martial art director" (known in the West for _Shaolin Soccer_, _Hero_ and _The forest of flying daggers_), has better action scenes than usual, but little thing remains.

title: Hotel Rwanda
country: Canada, Great Britain, South Africa, Italy
actors: Don Cheadle, Sophie Okonedo, Nick Nolte, Joaquin Phoenix, Desmond Dube, David O'Hara
description: Rwanda, 1990s: when the conflict between Hutu and Tutsi erupts, Paul Rusesabagina - manager of one of the best hotels in Kigali, the country's capital - does all he can to save as many lives as possible, while the world seems to ignore a bloody war that kills nearly a million people in a hundred days.
notes: Terry George (_A Love Choice_) and protagonist Don Cheadle deserve above all respect for being able to bring to the screen the true story of Paul Rusesabagina, whose self-denial spared a grisly death to his family and over a thousand Tutsi refugees.

title: Hitch
actors: Will Smith, Eva Mendes, Kevin James, Amber Valletta, Julie Ann Emery
description: Alex "Hitch" Hitchens is a celebrated New York consultant who helps men win the woman of their dreams. While giving lessons to Albert, an accountant in love with the charming Allegra Cole, he meets Sara Meles, an expert in worldly news, who will give him a lot of trouble ...
notes: In this bubbly and witty sentimental comedy, very well written by newcomer Kevin Bisch, the point of view on love speech is completely masculine. To guarantee narrative flexibility and freshness to a plot that has become the exclusive prerogative of the TV series, there is a very good Will Smith, at his first time in the "bright pink" genre.

title: Le promeneur du champ de Mars
actors: Michel Bouquet, Jalil Lespert, Philippe Fretun, Anne Cantineau, Sarah Grappin
description: The story of the end of a reign and the end of a life: that of François Mitterrand. A passionate journalist approaches the President fighting his latest battle against the disease to extract a universal lesson on life, politics and history, love and literature ... But Mitterrand doesn't have much to give because for him the moment has come when past, present and future are confused in a time inhabited by doubts, the one in which all men are equal: the time of those who are close to death.
notes: This Mitterrand is of "vulnerable" steel. And the Marseille filmmaker, choosing the point of view of the young journalist (will the age also be that of illusions and uncompromising politics?), For example, digs into the Vichy archives, into wounds that do not heal. Without inquisitorial intent, indeed with the will to dispel doubts in order to restore the candor of men and ideas. An idealistic participation on the part of the narrator, of course, but also a symptom of passion. Guédiguian's is a lofty conception of cinema, because it foresees that everyone is put on the line. Him first and us immediately after.

title: Hide and Seek
actors: Robert De Niro, Dakota Fanning, Famke Janssen, Elisabeth Shue, Amy Irving, Dylan Baker
description: Little Emily, traumatized by her mother's suicide, begins to behave strangely. Her father David, a psychologist, realizes that the child reacted by creating an imaginary friend Charlie who orders her to do strange and dangerous things ...
notes: Polson's film is one of the "grandchildren" of _The Sixth Sense_: a film à la Shyamalan which, however, since it is neither built nor directed by Shyamalan, quickly reveals a predictable and cheap system. The screenwriter and producer said they were terrified of writing and reading the story, respectively. Lucky them! Because the mystery and the tension last about ten minutes.

title: The Clan
actors: Christian De Sica, Paolo Conticini, Sebastian Torchia, Max Tortora, Nadia Rinaldi
description: Franco and Dino, two Roman mechanics who are close friends, leave for Las Vegas to participate in the world Harley-Davidson rally, hoping to win the big prize and settle down forever. But their real big dream is another: to sing and dance to the notes of Frank Sinatra and Dean Martin ...
notes: The attempt at "sophisticated comedy" (director De Sica's obsession, from _Conte Max_ to _Trio_) has once again ruinous effects. The film was initially conceived as a theatrical musical, but the coup de grace are the choreographic-singing numbers, which cover about twenty interminable minutes.

title: La terza stella
actors: Alessandro Besentini, Francesco Villa, Petra Faksova, Marica Coco, Pippo Santonastaso, Francesca Giovannetti
description: In a small village, preparations are underway for the event of the year: the living chess game against the neighboring village. Each inhabitant has his role, including Ale (a poised and thoughtful man, owner of the Belvedere hotel) and Franz (a prison guard by profession, moody and dazed). The two are brothers-in-law and their relationship is not the simplest.
notes: Gentle, well-behaved, the two comedians do not irritate but neither do they have much fun. Indeed, from how the film was launched, one gets the impression that the target audience is children or at most adolescents.

title: The Lady Pays Off
actors: Linda Darnell, Stephen McNally, Gigi Perreau, Virginia Field
description: Elena Teacher of Pasadena is highly appreciated for her skills. But the successes that she achieves in teaching her do not satisfy her because she would like to be appreciated as a woman. At the end of the school year he decides to spend the holidays in Reno. Entering a gambling house, he loses a large sum at the roulette, which he is unable to return. The manager of the club, Matt Braddock, proposes to her to take care of her little girl Diana: in this way she will be able to extinct her debt. The idyll between the Elena and Matt is in sight ...
notes: As often happens in Sirk, little Diana, not a symbol of purity, but of tragedies that begin again, is the deus ex machina of the story.

Ivanna, troubled by the sinister atmosphere that prevails in the castle where she lives, soon begins to believe that Janos is suffering from a personality disorder similar to lycanthropy ...

notes: Not a memorable film, but not even worthy of the bloodbath he suffered at the American box office, Steyermark's work forgoes glitter and glamor to tell more real and dirty.

title: Politiki kouzina

description: 1960s: little Fanis is forced to leave Istanbul with his family and move to Athens. Here he struggles to fit into the new community, and gradually closes himself in a world populated by the dishes that his grandfather Vassilis cooked for him, transforming the passion for food into a real obsession ...
notes: The film runs colorful, superficial and not unpleasant, but it wastes a good idea and only partially succeeds in evoking a lost Mediterranean world, made up of intertwining between Europe and the East. Mostly it relies on the petty philosophy enunciated by the characters, and abounds in really annoying computer reconstruction effects.

title: Kinsey
actors: Liam Neeson, Laura Linney, Chris O'Donnell, Peter Sarsgaard, Timothy Hutton, John Lithgow
description: The son of an engineering teacher, Alfred Kinsey studies zoology against his father's will. A free spirit who can't stand the rigid religious devotion of his family, he becomes a biology teacher at Indiana University. Here he realizes the lack of scientific data on the sexual behaviors of the man and becomes a point of reference for students who turn to him for problems or doubts related to sex. Kinsey thus hires a team of researchers to interview people about their sexual habits. The impact of his detailed study, published in 1948, is compared in the press to that of the atomic bomb ...
notes: Where _Demons and Gods_, Condon's previous militant film, was academic and a bit victimistic-martyred, Kinsey is risky and very courageous. It is not for nothing that the Church attacked him at home. Alfred confirms this to his wife, in the end, among the trees, "come on, there is still a lot to do". An abrupt closure, which throws a tragic light on the results of our damned philosophical-scientific (civil?) Society.

title: Lemony Snicktet's A Series of Unfortunate Events
actors: Jim Carrey, Meryl Streep, Timothy Spall, Emily Browning, Liam Aiken, Billy Connolly
description: Violet, Klaus and Sunny, orphaned, inherit a considerable fortune and are targeted by the evil Count Olaf, who wants to get rich behind them. He tries in every way to eliminate the children and their guardians, but the three brothers give him a hard time: Violet knows how to create wondrous machines, Klaus is an avid reader, while Sunny bites everything that happens ...
notes: The original novels - in which the writer's narrator plays a central role - are full of inventions, lexical subtleties, witty details, and are marinated with sour irony. In the passage on the screen of the first three volumes of the saga (_An ominous beginning_, _La stanza delle serpi_, _La fatesta Finestra_), the fictional imagination weakens and becomes trivial, despite the visual system, the sets and costumes are splendid. Jim Carrey, then, is wrong not to contain himself. The cinematographic reduction thus ends up scissoring, synthesizing and damaging atmospheres and situations.

title: Marci X
actors: Lisa Kudrow, Damon Wayans, Richard Benjamin, Jane Krakowski
description: Ben Feld's record company, specializing in rap, is accused for the too strict language of the songs produced. The man has a heart attack due to stress, and the management of the company passes into the hands of his spoiled daughter Marci. The latter immediately tries to smooth out the differences with conservative politicians, forcing the leading rapper, Dr. S, to moderate the tone: the clashes between the two will soon turn into amorous skirmishes ...
notes: The wild Kudrow - the Phoebe of _Friends_ - and the biting Wayans in a lively but not very sharp comedy and not without stereotypes (the rampant Jewish bourgeoisie against the angry African-American community).

notes: Sympathetic in the stroke, tender but at the same time courageous and full of initiative, Roo with his new friend Effy stages delightful duets where the sweet naivety of childhood, the sacred feeling of friendship and an immeasurable affection for the figure stand out. maternal. Good feelings, therefore, with no savings in this classic aimed exclusively at a childish audience who will surely like it.

actors: Nicholas Aaron, Richard Hawking, Brendan Mackey, Ollie Ryall, Joe Simpson, Simon Yates
description: Inspired by the real story of Joe Simpson and Simon Yates in 1985. The two friends, passionate about mountaineering, climb the Siula Grande in the Peruvian Andes. Joe slips and falls, hanging in the void, attached to Simon only by the safety rope ...
notes: Skillfully mixing the first-person stories of the two protagonists with accurate and dramatic reconstructions of the terrible and fascinating scenes on the rock walls exposed to snowstorms and temperatures of - 26 degrees, Kevin Macdonald (director of the acclaimed "One day in September", reconstruction of the tragic terrorist blitz at the 1972 Munich Olympics) constructs a gripping drama that keeps the spectator glued to his seat until the end, also exposed to feelings of guilt, to the inevitable grudges, to fear and, at the bottom, to the human weakness that the protagonists transmit without diaphragms.

title: Hostage
actors: Bruce Willis, Kevin Pollak, Jimmy Bennett, Michelle Horn, Ben Foster, Jonathan Tucker
description: For a long time Jeff Talley was a negotiator for the LAPD. After a kidnapping ends in a massacre, he decides to retire to a provincial town. But fate pursues him there too, forcing him to put himself in the position of the negotiator again.
notes: The inconsistencies and errors nullify the effort (or is it just confusion in the launch phase of the project?) Of a plot in which we wanted to mix heterogeneous ingredients. The mix also fails because all the characters are paper shapes with easy tear or too crude. Bruce Willis should either take his leave of his icon or engage with more sophisticated scripts.

title: The Take
description: Argentina. On the eve of the great crisis of 2001, thirty workers occupy the now abandoned factory where they worked for a long time decided to restart the machine. Armed only of slingshots want to challenge the authorities.
notes: The documentary, however, seems to highlight a different position of the couple of the Canadian "no Global" who made it compared to what is thought of the subject from us, also in the "professor" and a little theoretical tone with which he conducted the thread of reflectionsThe writer Naomi Klein is the author of the script.

title: Manuale d'amore
actors: Carlo Verdone, Silvio Muccino, Margherita Buy, Sergio Rubini, Jasmine Trinca, Luciana Littizzetto
description: Four chapters: in _L'innamoramento_ Tommaso is an unemployed man in love with the bourgeois Giulia. In _The crisis_ Barbara, employed in an analysis laboratory, and her husband Marco, a driving school instructor, face their first crisis. In _Il betrayal_ the vigilante Ornella fines men for no reason to take revenge for an immediate betrayal. In _Abbandono_ Goffredo tries to overcome his wife's abandonment with the help of an audiobook entitled _Manuale d'amore_.
notes: The narrative organization pushes to make rankings between the various chapters. The most successful and fun is the one played by Carlo Verdone, tender is the one with Muccino and Trinca, the most boring and, sometimes, chilling, those with Rubini-Buy (the most melancholy) and Littizzetto-Abbrescia. Who knows why cinema is the main contraindication for Littizzetto's comic talent?

title: Ggotip
actors: Jung-hyun Lee, Sung-keun Moon, Yeong-ran Lee, Sang Mi Chu

title: Yasaeng dongmul bohoguyeog
actors: Jae-hyeon Jo, Dong-jik Jang, Ryun Jang, Sasha Rucavina, Richard Bohringer

title: Choyonghan kajok
actors: In-hwan Park, Mun-hee Na, Kang-ho Song, Min-sik Choi, Ho-kyung Go
description: The Kang family spent all of their savings in an isolated cottage in the hills, called Casetta Nebbiosa. They look forward to their first guest; he turns out to be a bizarre bum, and is found dead, apparently suicidal, the next morning. Then the father decides that they have to bury him in order to continue their business. Unfortunately, the next couple of young guests also decide to commit a double suicide after a night of passionate sex, so they soon end up underground as well. From then on, things go from bad to worse.

title: Banchikwwang
actors: Jin-Young Jang, Su-ro Kim, Kang-ho Song, Ho-kyung Go, Hang-Seon Jang
description: Dae-ho is a shy bank employee who, without saying anything to his father, goes into professional wrestling. After being subjected to repeated mistreatment by the bank manager - a maniacal, power-obsessed individual - he hopes to find a space without hierarchies in the struggle and a way to escape the manager's grasp. During training, he tries out the moves and strives to achieve the self-confidence he needs in his private life as well as in work. Eventually, however, he will have to deal with the identity he assumes when he steps into the ring wearing the Cruel King mask.

title: Shilje sanghwang
actors: Jin-mo Ju, Jin-ah Kim, Min-seok Son, Je-rak Lee, Ki-yeon Kim

title: Hae anseon
actors: Dong-Kun Jang, Jeong-hak Kim, Ji-a Park, Hye-jin Yu, Jin Jeong
description: Kang Sang-byeong is a South Korean Coast Guard member eager to shoot a North Korean girl. One night he pulls the trigger and kills a South Korean civilian who ended up in a no-go zone to meet with his girlfriend. Both kang and the dead civilian's girlfriend have problems with a nervous breakdown, leading the woman to believe that the coast guard members are her deceased lover.

title: Hawking
actors: Benedict Cumberbatch, Michael Brandon, Tom Hodgkins, Lisa Dillon

title: Bruiser
actors: Jason Flemyng, Peter Stormare, Leslie Hope, Nina Garbiras
description: Henry Creedlow, dissatisfied editor of "Bruiser" magazine, cultivates suicidal and homicidal fantasies that reach a climax when he discovers not only that his wife Janine is cheating him with the hated and tyrannical editor Miles Styles, but also that his best friend, stockbroker, ousted him from fruitful financial speculation. The next morning, upon awakening, Henry realizes, however, that he has a kind of neutral and white mask instead of his face, and takes the opportunity to implement a merciless retaliation ...
notes: Disappointing return to directing (after years of absence) of the master of _Monkey Shines_: flat, weak and predictable.

title: Vediamoci chiaro
actors: Johnny Dorelli, Eleonora Giorgi, Janet Agren, Angelo Infanti
description: In the hope of solving the financial problems of the private broadcaster he owns, Alberto Catuzzi launches a new program entitled Let's be clear. Shortly after, however, Alberto loses his sight due to a serious car accident, and the matter becomes complicated because direct control of the television passes into the hands of his friend Gianluca. Alberto adapts to his new condition and tries, as he can, to resume his work. When, following a new accident, he regains his sight, trouble begins ...
notes: Penultimate, disappointing film directed by Luciano Salce, which makes the most of Johnny Dorelli.

title: La strada nel bosco
actors: Elena Bucci, Marco Sgrosso, Giulietta De Bernardi, Antonella Paolini
description: Three love stories, in each of which three characters are captured during a journey, a drift, a shift.
notes: De Bernardi sets his "nocturnal" events in different corners of Italy (Rome, Naples, Turin, the province of Campania, with a digression in Thailand). The use of music and songs is fundamental.

title: Bullet Ballet
actors: Kirina Mano, Shinya Tsukamoto, Hisashi Igawa, Sujin Kim
description: Goda, a commercial whose sanity was upset by his girlfriend's suicide, obtains a gun and gets lost in the Tokyo slums. Beaten by a punk gang he ends up falling in love with one of them Chisato. When a rival gang threatens them, Goda intervenes.
notes: Tsukamoto explores the themes of _Tokyo Fist_ with greater realism.

title: Robots
description: Rodney Copperbottom has decided to go to Robot City to become a great inventor: here he finds love in the beautiful Cappy and sets out in search of his idol Bigweld, a genius. But the path is full of obstacles: first of all the evil Ratchet - who considers the robots outdated and ready for the dumpster - and his mother, the fearsome Madame Gasket ...
