notes: An intelligent and never banal parable on the contradictions of our society, exceptionally evolved but in some ways anchored to archaic thought patterns, _Robots_ successfully continues the path undertaken by Wedge himself and by Carlos Saldanha with the extraordinary _The Ice Age_.

title: Racing Stripes
actors: Bruce Greenwood, Hayden Panettiere, Caspar Poyck, Gary Bullock, Wendie Malick
description: During a storm, a traveling circus loses a baby zebra who is rescued by Nolan, a farmer who once trained thoroughbreds. Channing, Nolan's daughter, calls the zebra Striscia and introduces her to the other inhabitants of the barnyard: the grouchy pony Gegè, the wise goat Bocca di Rosa, the town pelican Gozzo, the Beaked rooster and the Lightning sleeper hound. The fact is that Striscia believes himself to be a racehorse.
notes: The underlying optimism dominates in a story with a family flavor like that of the old Disney, where even somewhat magical events peeped out, as well as in this film where a zebra takes part in a gallop race.

title: Cose da pazzi
actors: Vincenzo Salemme, Maurizio Casagrande, Lidia Vitale, Carlo Croccolo, Teresa Del Vecchio, Biagio Izzo
description: Back from vacation, the state official Giuseppe Cocuzza receives mysterious packages containing money: his wife and daughter, sister and brother-in-law encourage him to spend it as soon as possible. For nine months, on a regular basis on the 27th, the money continues to arrive: until an enigmatic character brings everyone back to eleven years earlier, when he had applied for a pension for a civil invalid and had clashed with the upright Cocuzza .. .
notes: For a comedy, values ??and ethical comedy are an original pretext, even if the language of cinema is cornered by a system that - in time and space - thinks of the wings and the curtain.

title: Tickets
directors: Ermanno Olmi, Abbas Kiarostami, Ken Loach
actors: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Carlo Delle Piane, Martin Compston, Silvana De Santis, William Ruane
description: A journey that starts from the center of Europe and arrives in Rome. A series of casual encounters: an unlikely love story, a family of illegal immigrants, an arrogant woman, three fans who come from Scotland to the capital to watch the Roma-Celtic Glasgow match ...
notes: Thinking about it in the abstract, what better set than a train and what better narrative inspiration than the stories that intertwine along its path? But the operation fails to the three directors who, not only do not find a homogeneous glue that is not a pretext, but also fail to make their respective differences collide, the "discrepancies" of style and tone that could represent the greatest value of the film.

title: Monster!
actors: M. Emmet Walsh, Tobias Mehler, Brendan Cowell, Jennifer Congram, Ashley Gavin, Angela Keep
description: Discharged from the psychiatric clinic where his obsession with the imminent invasion of monstrous beings had brought him, the former horror star Lloyd Reeves returns to the town where he lives. Here, however, during a "scary" film festival, his prophecies come true, and one of the creatures on the screen materializes and sows terror ...

title: Crimes of Passion
actors: Kathleen Turner, Anthony Perkins, John Laughlin, Bruce Davison
description: Joanna Crane is an established designer who seems to think only of work, but at night she lets herself be carried away by her own secret identity: China Blue, a prostitute who beats the sidewalks of Los Angeles. Meet the Reverend Peter Shayne, who would like to change her way even by the hard way.
notes: Shocking Russell film sinking, sometimes out of control, into abysses of grim violence. At the time he was in fact struck by censorship, which at home classified it as a pornographic work. However, it remains a rather effective thriller, at times disturbing in its reckless sway between naturalism and exploitation.

title: Chûgoku no chôjin
actors: Masahiro Motoki, Renji Ishibashi, Mako, Yuuichi Minato, Wang Li Li

title: Andoromedeia
actors: Hiroko Shimabukuro, Eriko Imai, Takako Uehara, Hitoe Arakaki

title: Blues Harp
actors: Hiroyuki Ikeuchi, Huntley Nicholas, Mickey Curtis, Daisuke Iijima
notes: Near Yokohama, Kenji, an ambitious member of the yakuza, is ready to do anything to rise in rank and increase his power. However, he has one obstacle: he must keep his homosexuality hidden. One day he meets Chuji, of mixed blood (his father was a black American), who peddles, plays the blues harmonica in his spare time and dreams of leaving. One day Chuji happens to save Kenji's life, chased by members of a rival clan: a story begins between the two.

title: Undefeated
actors: John Leguizamo, Clifton Collins jr., Adrian Martinez, Juan Carlos Hernández

title: Les uns et les autres
actors: Robert Hossein, Nicole Garcia, Geraldine Chaplin, James Caan
description: Between Moscow, Berlin, Paris and New York, the parallel events of four families (and three generations) of musicians and dancers, whose members intertwine their lives with the most important historical events of the twentieth century, from 1936 to 1980.
notes: Bulimic as and more than usual, the French director hires a cast of the first magnitude (entrusting different roles to each interpreter) and shuffles the narrative cards, especially at the temporal level. A film in perfect Lelouch style, which will exalt diehard fans and will make everyone else turn up their noses, indebted to the title, incipit and epilogue to the famous and electrifying Ravelian song.

title: Suspect Zero
actors: Aaron Eckhart, Ben Kingsley, Carrie-Anne Moss, Harry J. Lennix, Kevin Chamberlin, Julian Reyes, Keith Campbell
description: Federal agents Thomas MacKelway and Fran Kulok investigate a series of murders that apparently do not seem connected to each other: some macabre clues, however, seem to lead to the ruthless serial killer Benjamin O'Ryan ...
notes: Looking at Ben Kingsley - hallucinated, bald and with vaguely pointed ears - one immediately thinks of Nosferatu: an overlap legitimized by the previous film (a considerable operation, albeit with indisputable theoretical limits) by Merhige, _L'ombra del vampiro_. The film is not perfect and pays for some structural weaknesses, but it manages to work discreetly in depth on the anguish generated by identification with Evil.

title: Cursed
actors: Jesse Eisenberg, Christina Ricci, Joshua Jackson, Portia De Rossi, Shannon Elizabeth, Derek Mears, Nick Offerman
description: Los Angeles. Jimmi and Ellie, orphaned after an accident, realize they have acquired supernatural powers. When they begin to investigate the incident, they realize they have been attacked by a werewolf and must fight to survive its curse.
notes: Sort of a makeover of _I Was a Teenage Werewolf_ in the hills of Hollywood today, the new Wes Craven is less terrible than they described it but on the other hand still far from the glory days of the master of New Horror. Enjoyable the first part, let's say until the party in the pub-wax museum, especially for the digressions that see the young (and good) Jesse Eisenberg as protagonist. On the other hand, the entire final part is devastating, flat and digitized also from an aesthetic point of view.

title: In Good Company
actors: Scarlett Johansson, Dennis Quaid, Topher Grace, Marg Helgenberger, David Paymer, Clark Gregg, Philip Baker Hall, Selma Blair
description: Fifty-year-old Dan Foreman, commercial director of a company, loses his senior position following the acquisition of his company by a multinational. The new boss is Carter, an inexperienced young man, who as if that were not enough begins to woo Alex, Dan's beloved daughter.
notes: Human comedy that takes quite surprising paths. The core is the celebration of the good American family and the man of sound values, but around there is more, the progressive awareness of inadequacy, for example. In the end, Dan and Carter win against the powerful, but the latter actually fails, as a boss, as a boyfriend and as a "new man".

title: Brødre
actors: Connie Nielsen, Ulrich Thomsen, Nikolaj Lie Kaas, Bent Mejding, Solbjørg Højfeldt
description: Michael, married to Sarah and father of two daughters, must leave for Afghanistan on a United Nations mission. After some time comes the news that he is missing and is officially declared dead. Sarah finds comfort in Jannik, her husband's reckless brother: an affectionate relationship is established between the two. When Michael returns home, traumatized from captivity, the situation becomes explosive.
notes: Magnificent Connie Nielsen, but the film is bad, irritating, stylistically and morally vulgar. The success achieved around the festivals is inexplicable. The bottom line is: war jeopardizes the happiness of the living room and bedroom. A really great philosophy, no doubt about it.

title: The Jacket
actors: Adrien Brody, Keira Knightley, Kris Kristofferson, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Daniel Craig, Kelly Lynch, Brad Renfro
description: Jack Stark, a veteran of the first Gulf War and suffering from amnesia, is accused of a murder he did not commit and locked up in an asylum. Here he undergoes a new treatment on his mind, which causes him to hallucinate in which his past and his future emerge strongly. Only love for the beautiful Jackie helps him survive, but ...
notes: Maybury treats frames like a painter's canvas, deconstructs time, knows how to lead his excellent cast. From time to time, one feels sucked into the dilated pupils of Brody, the "man who did not want to die in vain". They produce Clooney and Soderbergh; music by Brian Eno.

title: Jian gui 2 Jian gui 2
actors: Eugenia Yuan, Shu Qi, Jesdaporn Pholdee, Philip Kwok
description: Joey recovers from an overdose of tranquilizers and subsequent gastric lavage. After discovering she is pregnant, she recontacts Sam, the man she wanted to take her life for: in front of his evasiveness, she falls back into emotional instability and feels threatened by strange presences ...
notes: It's not that the movie is bad, it's that it tastes like rancid fried food. More than the conventional ghostly apparitions, it is the sequence shot of the first final suicide attempt (computer corrected) that makes you jump. The long Italian trailer was already practically a bignamino of the entire film, including the highlight scenes (such as the one at the bus stop, among the best).

title: La febbre
actors: Fabio Volo, Valeria Solarino, Cochi Ponzoni, Gisella Burinato, Massimo Bagliani, Arnoldo Foà
description: Mario Bettini, a provincial surveyor, is a thirty-year-old full of ideas and enthusiasm. His dream is to open a place with friends, but when he is unexpectedly hired by the Municipality he understands that the new job contrasts with his entrepreneurial spirit. It will be the meeting with a girl to make him glimpse new existential perspectives ...
notes: D'Alatri has directed and written a film that has the pleasantness, the melancholy, the smiling harshness, the warmth of the classic Italian comedy. The performers are good, some very good, and Valeria Solarino combines her acting skills with an exceptional magnetic presence.

title: Nihon kuroshakai
actors: Sho Aikawa, Samuel Pop Aning, Yukie Itou, Dan Li, Michisuke Kashiwaya
description: Three friends, frustrated by continued discrimination for their Chinese origins, leave the countryside and flee to Tokyo, where they befriend a prostitute and engage in crime in hopes of earning enough money to leave Japan.
notes: More violence, degradation and characters without roots in this third chapter of the ideal trilogy of the Black Society where, and with this film it is clearer than ever, the "black society" is Japan, a country, in the eyes of Miike, which systematically it makes it impossible for anything that deviates from the norm to survive. Quintessence of Miikian cinema, paradigmatic of its themes, its genius and its unmistakable execution.

title: Silver - Shirubaa
actors: Kenji Haga, Shinobu Kandori, Rumi Kazama, Hisao Maki, Fujio Matsushima

title: Sarariiman Kintarô
actors: Kanako Enomoto, Michiko Hata, Naoki Hosaka, Toshiaki Megumi

title: Dead or Alive: Hanzaisha
actors: Riki Takeuchi, Sho Aikawa, Renji Ishibashi, Hitoshi Ozawa
description: Ryuchi's gang, a Chinese who emigrated to Japan to climb the top of the underworld, carries out a series of murders. Following the gangster, in addition to the local yakuza, there is also the detective Jojima, who in order to meet the policy of non-violence of the police asks for help from some criminals.
notes: Tracks of cocaine, guts mixed with spaghetti, sex and slaughtered throats: this and more in the first 5 minutes of _Dead or Alive_, the first chapter of Takashi Miike's sui generis trilogy. If in the same years Kitano reformed (from above) the Japanese gangster movie with brushstrokes of stylized and poetic anti-realism, Miike (from below) stains the genre with a bloody energy and situationism.

title: Hyôryuu-gai
actors: Teah, Michelle Reis, Patricia Manterola, Mitsuhiro Oikawa, Koji Kikkawa
description: The Japanese-Brazilian Mario and the Chinese hairdresser Kei are very much in love, but she is about to be taken to prison. The boy thus tries to organize an escape with his girlfriend in the Brazilian community of Tokyo but to finance it he needs a fair amount that there is no way to legally earn and thus gets into a sea of ??trouble ...
notes: Contemporary urban fable full of chases and criminal traffic in the usual rich and intertwined tale by Miike. The film was shot in three different cities then merged into one to give a sense of disorientation to the environment and history. Fast-paced, multifaceted and full of visual ideas in the typical style of the Japanese director.

title: Bizita Q
actors: Kenichi Endo, Shungiku Uchida, Kazushi Watanabe, Shoko Nakahara

title: Family
actors: Kôjirô Hongô, Kôichi Iwaki, Taishu Kase, Ryuuji Katagiri, Kazuya Kimura

title: Tengoku kara kita otoko-tachi
actors: Koji Kikkawa, Mai Oikawa, Nene Otsuka, Weng Rong Hua

title: Dead or Alive: Final
actors: Sho Aikawa, Maria Chen, Richard Chen, Josie Ho, Tony Ho
description: Yokohama, 2346. The city is in the hands of Woo, a homosexual dictator who has outlawed reproduction. A group of rebels, including the replicant Ry ?, kidnaps the son of the powerful detective Honda. To free him, they demand the return of some political prisoners. Woo seems to accept, but he is actually plotting against the rebels.
notes: Third and less successful chapter in the gangster trilogy of the prolific Japanese author, which concludes the personal reinterpretation of the stereotypes of the (exhausted) yakuza narrative. After the acid neurosis and the nostalgic calm of the first two episodes, Miike for the grand finale outrages (denying and surpassing it) the genre itself, drawing a crazy cyberpunk action epic.

title: Koroshiya 1
actors: Nao Omori, Tadanobu Asano, Shinya Tsukamoto, Alien Sun

title: Katakuri-ke no kôfuku
actors: Kenji Sawada, Keiko Matsuzaka, Shinji Takeda, Naomi Nishida

title: Araburu tamashii-tachi
actors: Mickey Curtis, Yoshiyuki Daichi, Hakuryu, Masatô Ibu, Takashi Miike

title: Shin jingi no hakaba
actors: Narimi Arimori, Yoshiyuki Daichi, Hirotarô Honda, Harumi Inoue

title: Jitsuroku Andô Noboru kyôdô-den: Rekka
actors: Riki Takeuchi, Ryôsuke Miki, Kenichi Endo, Mika Katsumura

title: Kin'yuu hametsu Nippon: Tôgenkyô no hito-bito
actors: Sho Aikawa, Shiro Sano, Yuu Tokui, Midoriko Kimura, Kogan Ashiya
description: The news of the bankruptcy of a supermarket chain in Osaka shakes the small print shop that prints its brochures: if the company's check, for ten million yen, is not covered, farewell to the printer. The president of the small print shop, the very active Umemoto, pleads with the supermarket tycoon but the old scoundrel says he doesn't own a single yen. Umemoto's lawyer advises filing for bankruptcy, but Umemoto would rather die. Then, just as he is about to kill himself, he is abruptly interrupted by a gang of thugs attacking a nearby homeless camp. Umemoto takes one of the injured homeless to the hospital and is later warmly welcomed into the camp by Kuwata, a writer with no luck, and the camp's "mayor", who sports dark glasses and an Afro wig. Overwhelmed by the kindness of these strangers, Umemoto unleashes his misfortunes. Moved, Kuwata and the mayor promise to help him save the printing house.

title: Kikoku
actors: Kenichi Endo, Mikkî Kâchisu, Renji Ishibashi, Kôichi Iwaki

title: Zebraman
actors: Sho Aikawa, Kyouka Suzuki, Teruyoshi Uchimura, Yui Ichikawa
description: 2010, Yokohama, Yachiyo district. Here lives Shinichi Ichikawa, a wimp who teaches at the local elementary school. His family is in disarray: his wife is cheating on him, his daughter is in a juvenile prostitution ring, and his son is targeted by bullies at school. Shinichi’s only reason for living is Zebraman, a TV show about a mysterious superhero. His only hobby - making Zebraman costumes - takes hold of him to the point that he gets into the habit of wearing one and wandering around the city late at night. In doing so he runs into various suspicious characters and each time manages to get involved in a fist fight. In reality, these dubious types are aliens from another galaxy who have invaded human bodies and plan to take over the Earth. Although taken aback, our recalcitrant hero providentially begins to defend his city. Meanwhile, the Japanese government launches an investigation into the strange events in the Yachiyo neighborhood. "Men in Black" charged with repelling aliens from outer space accidentally discover the existence of "a mysterious striped man" defending the city. Before the truth is fully exposed, however, the situation is definitely for the worse. The alien invasion begins: will Zebraman be able to defend peace, justice and the Japanese way of life?

title: Izo
actors: Mikkî Kâchisu, Ken'ichi Endou, Daisaku Akino, Chisato Amate

title: Joyû-rei
actors: Yûrei Yanagi, Yasuyo Shiroshima, Kei Ishibashi, Ren Osugi

title: Urusei Yatsura 2: Byûtifuru dorîmâ
description: Pupils from Tomobiki High School are excited about the inauguration of the student festival. But no one seems to realize that the eve of the festival has been repeating itself the same for who knows how long. As if that weren't enough, Ataru and his companions discover that they are the only living things left in the neighborhood. Who will be responsible for this absurd nightmare?

title: Karisuma
actors: Koji Yakusho, Hiroyuki Ikeuchi, Ren Osugi, Yoriko Douguchi

title: Oinaru genei
actors: Shinji Aoyama, Miako Tadano, Shinji Takeda, Akiko Okuda
description: In a Tokyo besieged by a mysterious and deadly toxic pollen, Haru and Michi - both gripped by their own obsessions - try to save their difficult love story. Meanwhile, they agree to be the guinea pig for a new drug that counteracts the effects of the poison ...
notes: Surreal mix of inertia, alienation and black humor.

title: Kôrei
actors: Koji Yakusho, Jun Fubuki, Tsuyoshi Kusanagi, Hikari Ishida

title: Kaïro
actors: Haruhiko Katô, Kumiko Aso, Koyuki, Kurume Arisaka, Masatoshi Matsuo

title: Occupe-toi d'Amélie
actors: Danielle Darrieux, Jean Desailly, Gregoire Aslan, Julien Carette
description: Marcel Courbois has a problem: to inherit a large sum of money from his uncle, he has to take a wife. But only for pretense. He then asks his friend Milledieu, lieutenant of the hussars, to help him by "lending" him his beautiful girlfriend, Amélie. Milledieu trusts and leaves, but on his return he discovers that his friend has taken care of the girl too much.
notes: Based on a 1908 vaudeville by Georges Feydeau, a comedy scripted by Jean Aurenche and Pierre Bost and already brought to the cinema twice more, in '12 and '33. Small part for the future director Jean-Pierre Mocky.

title: La traversée de Paris
actors: Jean Gabin, Bourvil, Louis De Funès, Jeannette Betti, Robert Arnoux
description: World War II: Paris is under German occupation. Martin, a former taxi driver, has to cross the city to deliver a few suitcases full of pork purchased from the black market. In the enterprise, the man brings with him a wanderer, Grandgil, who later turns out to be a renowned painter. The path will be full of obstacles and unexpected events ...
notes: In the hands of the screenwriters Jean Aurenche and Pierre Bost, the original story by Marcel Aymé loses the tragic tones of the ending to the advantage of a "light" dissolution. Bourvil won the Volpi Cup as best actor in Venice 1956, but Gabin is certainly no less.

title: Le ciel est à vous
actors: Madeleine Renaud, Charles Vanel, Raymond Vernay, Jean Debucourt
description: Villeneuve, France, 1930s. The garage owner Pierre has an irrepressible passion for flying, shared with his wife Thérèse. The two commit all the family assets to give life to their dream: to break the female record for flying in a straight line.
notes: Inspired by the life of Andrée Dupeyron, who in 1937 recorded the real record mentioned in the film, it is remembered as one of the most excellent results of the French Occupation cinema, while at its release in theaters it was misunderstood. The treatment of the screenplay, which tends to romanticize the story, is by Charles Spaak and Albert Valentin.

title: L'anello matrimoniale
actors: Carmen Villani, Ray Lovelock, Amparo Muñoz, Enzo Cannavale
description: The beautiful Monica, happily married to an illustrious plastic surgeon for seven years, does not know whether to remain faithful or to give in to the temptation embodied by the handsome neighbor Giorgio. When in doubt, the woman does not have too many scruples and decides to ask for a license directly from her spouse. Who, unexpectedly, gives her permission ...
notes: Former singer Carmen Villani (directed by her wife Ivaldi) in one of her sexy performances. With greater courage the film could have become his first "existential" comedy. The story is signed by the future producer Augusto Caminito and by José Luis Martínez Mollá, screenwriter of _A lizard with a woman's skin_.

title: Caught in the Headlights
actors: Erika Eleniak, Kim Coates, Brigitta Dau, Stacy Keach, Erin Gray
description: Three years after the failure to manage an informant, federal agent Kate Parker is tasked with bringing back the young Claire Scott, who left the country after witnessing a murder. Apparently this is an easy case, but the risks will not be long in coming ...
notes: Boredom and yawning with both hands.

title: Eureka
actors: Koji Yakusho, Aoi Miyazaki, Masaru Miyazaki, Yoichiro Saito

title: Distance
actors: Arata, Yusuke Iseya, Susumu Terajima, Yui Natsukawa, Tadanobu Asano

title: Tasogare seibei
actors: Hiroyuki Sanada, Rie Miyazawa, Nenji Kobayashi, Ren Osugi
description: Left a widower, forced to look after his children and his elderly mother, the low-ranking samurai Seibei Iguchi is known as "the shadowy Seibei" for the retired life he leads. The meeting (and the passion) with Tomoe, a friend of his youth, will bring him back to brandish the sword ...

title: Freeze Me
actors: Harumi Inoue, Shingo Tsurumi, Kazuki Kitamura, Shunsuke Matsuoka, Daisuke Lijima
description: Chihiro, a shy employee in Tokyo, hides a secret. Five years earlier she was the victim of gang rape and now one of her assailants has found her. He attacks her and communicates his intention to organize a party together with his two previous accomplices and also their boss. So he tells her boyfriend about the rape, making him run away in disgust, and not happy he gets her fired. But Chihiro has stopped beating and finally finds how to fill his freezer ...
notes: The director of the two _Gonin_ returns to tell of sadistic men and women driven to madness who resort to violence. The plot is not new, but the performer is magnificent and intense and the direction is energetic.

title: Chingoo
actors: Yoo Ohsung, Jang Dong-Kun, Seo Tae-hwa, Jeong Un-taek

title: Komodo
actors: Jill Hennessy, Billy Burke, Kevin Zegers, Paul Gleeson, Nina Landis
description: An island in North Carolina is infested with Komodo monitor lizards, whose eggs had been transported there twenty years earlier. Patrick - who lost his parents in the jaws of terrifying saurians - and the skeptical psychoanalyst Victoria return to the place: will they be able to save their skin?
notes: More than the dragons, it's directing and acting that are scary.

title: Night Song
actors: Merle Oberon, Dana Andrews, Ethel Barrymore, Artur Rubinstein, Eugene Ormandy
description: High-ranking Cathy Mallory, passionate about classical music, meets Dan Evans, a blind but very gifted pianist who plays in a swing band. To overcome her bitterness and capture her heart, Cathy pretends herself blind, but in the long run the deception comes to the surface ...
notes: Discreet sentimental drama.

title: Ercole contro Moloch
actors: Gordon Scott, Alessandra Panaro, Rosalba Neri, Arturo Dominici
description: The Greek warrior Glauco, who for his strength calls himself Hercules, offers to fight against Moloch, being deformed and bloodthirsty. Our hero will be able to save Medea, with whom he has fallen in love, before she is killed by the horrid monster.
notes: Mediocre peplum that recycles scenes from other films of the genre.

title: Room at the Top
actors: Simone Signoret, Laurence Harvey, Heather Sears, Donald Wolfit
description: Northern England. Susan Brown, the daughter of a well-to-do industrialist, is duped by Joe Lampton, a careerist employee who only cares about his money. To marry her he does not hesitate to leave his mistress Alice, who is also married and unhappy.
notes: The film won two Oscars: for best supporting actress (Simone Signoret) and for the screenplay by Neil Peterson, based on the novel by John Braine. Directorial debut for Jack Clayton (_Suspense_, The Great Gatsby_, _The Secret Passion of Judith Hearne_) who three years earlier produced _Moby Dick the white whale_ by John Huston.

title: Ship of Fools
actors: Vivien Leigh, Simone Signoret, Oskar Werner, Heinz Rühmann
description: First half of the 1930s. Among the passengers on a boat departing from Vera Cruz and bound for Bremen there are those who try to change their destinies. Mary lives with the nightmare of being alone; a Spanish noblewoman, deported because she promoted a popular revolt, tries to have a love affair with the ship's doctor; Bill, a failed baseball player, is forced to re-enter anonymity; Lowenthal, a German Jew is mocked by his compatriots ...
notes: Two Academy Awards, one for photography (Ernest Laszlo) and one for scenography (Robert Clatworthy and Joseph Kish). Good rehearsals by the actors.

title: Return to Paradise
actors: Vince Vaughn, Anne Heche, Joaquin Phoenix, David Conrad
description: Malaysia. Lewis risks being sentenced to death for being found in possession of hashish. Sister Beth has to work hard to convince her brother's two traveling companions, already on the run, to retrace their steps to turn themselves in and thus save Lewis for life. It won't be easy at all.
notes: Joseph Ruben (_A bed with the enemy_, _L'innocenza del diavolo_, _Money Train_) brings back to the screen the French film _Forza Majeure_ directed by Pierre Jolivet by modifying the ending. The result is far too complicated and tortuous. The interpreters, although willing, deserve a narrow pass.

title: Miracolo a Palermo!
actors: Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Tony Sperandeo, Luigi Maria Burruano, Vincent Schiavelli, Ludovico Caldarera
description: Twelve-year-old Totò has to choose whether to remain a child or become an adult. The boy is torn between the love for the beautiful Lina and the obsession with a death to be avenged ...
notes: It is not enough for the frail film to hole up in Fellini's oneirism, in the interpretation just over the top (by Sperandeo, Burruano and the macchiettist Vincent Schiavelli) and too under the lines of the Cucinotta, a faded clone of any sophialorèn. We want to say: if a grotesque fable had to and wanted to be, it would have been better to press the accelerator pedal on the side of the extreme, of the paradox, of the tragicomic reworking of a situation underpinned by mafia culture. In short, the sensation that one derives from it is of an involuntary and involuntary approach to the cinema of Ciprì & Maresco.

title: Son of the Mask
actors: Alan Cumming, Jamie Kennedy, Ryan Falconer, Bob Hoskins, Traylor Howard
description: Aspiring cartoonist Tim Avery became a dad a few months ago, when he realizes that little Alvey is gifted with the spectacular powers that a prodigious mask has given him. To complicate everything, we think the family dog ??who fights with the newborn for the control of the same. But even the bad Loki, the legitimate owner of the precious object, wants to get it back at any cost.
notes: The fracassone and cartoonish imagery evoked is quite nice and some gags mesh. Nothing to do, however, with the rhythm of the original: also because the chubby Kennedy cannot count on a "rubber face" by birth like that of Jim Carrey.

title: The Unbelievable Truth
actors: Adrienne Shelly, Robert John Burke, Chris Cooke, Julia McNeal, Katherine Mayfield

title: Speaking of Sex
actors: James Spader, Melora Walters, Jay Mohr, Nathaniel Arcand
description: Melinda and Dan are in crisis. She is too naive, he has problems with impotence. The woman seeks advice from a psychoanalyst experienced in depression, who wants to report due to a sexual relationship consumed with her in the elevator. The man is being treated by a psychologist, madly in love with Melinda's doctor. The plots multiply, and at the same time also the misunderstandings and sentimental implications ...
notes: Gary Tieche's script is sparse and poor in ideas. The dialogues are devoid of comedy and the rhythm is one that makes you want to sleep between seven pillows. McNaughton is far from his favorite territories. Those of _Henry_ to be clear.

title: The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas
actors: Dolly Parton, Burt Reynolds, Dom DeLuise, Charles Durning
description: As long as you remember, in a small Texan town there is a pleasure house very dear to all fellow citizens, and widely appreciated also by the governor and the public force, especially by the local sheriff, who has a relationship with the maîtresse. Until the "chick ranch" enters the crosshairs of a television preacher, sparking the war.
notes: From the Broadway musical of King and Masterson, a comedy with a funny idea but with a little slow development. Splendid the couple Parton / Reynolds, and the end with Parton singing _ I Will Always Love You_.

title: Maria's Lovers
actors: Nastassja Kinski, John Savage, Robert Mitchum, Keith Carradine

title: Hao xia
actors: Lee Hoi-San, Fung Hark-On, Damian Lau, Kong Lau, Sheng Kuo

title: Da zui xia
actors: Cheng Pei-pei, Yueh Hua, Chen Hung Lieh, Chan Hei, Chiang Yang
description: #Jade Face Tiger, of the Five Tigers clan, frees the two prisoners Red Tiger and Blue Tiger, as they are escorted to the prison by Chang Pu-Ching, the governor's son. They discover that their boss, waiting to be executed, has been escorted to the county judiciary offices by a secondary route. He then decides to take Chang Pu-Ching hostage, takes him to the Tsu Yun Temple and gives the magistrate five days to decide to exchange their boss with the hostage. The man of the law has a sister, Chang Hsuan-Yen (Cheng Pei-Pei) called "Golden Swallow", very skilled in martial arts. In men's clothes, the girl tries to meet the gang, with whom she has a first, victorious fight in the tavern where she stopped to spend the night. Jade Face Tiger orders to surprise the girl in her sleep and lead her to him, but Brillo Cat, a mysterious beggar who makes a living with his singing children, makes her leave the room with a trick. Rondine d'Oro asks the beggar about the location of the gang that kidnapped her brother. Through a song, he reveals the hiding place to her. The girl then reaches the temple in women's clothing, as a devotee of the Buddha. The men of the gang recognize her and, in the ensuing fight, the Golden Swallow is wounded by Jade-Face Tiger with a poison dart. At the end of her strength, the girl tries, chased, to hide in the forest ...
notes: One of the most famous martial arts films, directed by King Hu and starring icon Cheng Pei-Pei.

title: Long men ke zhen
actors: Polly Kuan, Chun Shih, Ying Bo, Jian Tsao, Han Xue

title: Chung chung lieh t'u
actors: Roy Chiao, Hsu Feng, Yuen Biao, Billy Chan, Hsiang Wu Chia

title: Xi you ji di yi bai ling yi hui zhi yue guang bao he
actors: Stephen Chow, Kit Ying Lam, Athena Chu, Jeffrey Lau

title: Xiaoao jiang hu
directors: Ching Siu-tung, King Hu, Ann Hui, A. Kam Yuen Wah, Tsui Hark
actors: Jacky Cheung, Man Cheung, Sam Hui, Lam Ching-Ying, Lau Shun

title: Malombra
actors: Paola Senatore, Maurice Poli, Claudia Cavalcanti, Maurizio Boni
description: Returning to the ancient family villa where Uncle Osvaldo lives with his wife's sister, deceased for years, the young Mark is welcomed by a series of cheerful and helpful girls. But there is also a mysterious neroved woman, who travels the house every night with a candlestick in your hand ...
notes: Imagine the sufferings of Antonio Fogazzaro (author of the well-known nineteenth-century novel of the same name) and Mario Soldati (who had taken the 1942 film with Miranda and Checchi) in the presence of this uninhabilitable soft and simply disheartening Pastrocchio. After this performance, the senator will think well of breaking the delay and giving the hard.

title: Die bian
actors: Lau Siu Ming, Michelle Mee, Huang Shutang, Zhang Guozhu

title: Di yi lei xing wei xian
actors: Lo Lieh, Bruce Baron, Nigel Falgate, Chi Lin Chen, David Wu
description: Three high school students outside the head place a homemade bomb for fun inside a cinema. A girl even more disturbed than them sees them and is love at first sight: thus begins an escalation of free violence and destruction perpetuated by the four on the streets of Hong Kong.

title: Suk san: Sun Suk san geen hap
actors: Yuen Biao, Man Hoi, Sammo Hung, Tsui Hark, Lee Moon

title: Shanghai zhi ye
actors: Kenny Bee, Ken Boyle, Sylvia Chang, Loletta Lee, Tsui Hark

title: Do ma daan
actors: Cherie Chung, Sally Yeh, Kenneth Tsang, Wu Ma

title: Shu shan zheng zhuan
actors: Ekin Cheng, Cecilia Cheung, Louis Koo, Patrick Tam, Sammo Hung

title: Chan sam ying hung
actors: Leon Lai, Lau Ching Wan, Fiona Leung, Mung Yo Yo, Michael Lam
description: Jack and Martin are killers of two rival bosses and are wounded during a bloody battle between their bosses. Marginalized and threatened by their clans, the two form a sincere friendship and decide to join forces to take revenge for the wrongs suffered.
notes: Great film by Johnnie To where his poetic summa reaches masterful levels: geometries of vision and maddening violence embellish a thriller that leaves no way out, shot as if it were a western by Sam Peckinpah where the land of conquest and frontier turns into metropolitan Hong Kong and nocturnal. The two protagonists are excellent: Lau Ching-wan and the famous Hong Kong pop singer Leon Lai.

title: Chuen jik sat sau
actors: Andy Lau, Takashi Sorimachi, Simon Yam, Kelly Lin, Cherrie Ying

title: Daai chek liu
actors: Andy Lau, Cecilia Cheung, Cheung Siu-Fai, Chun Wong

title: PTU
actors: Simon Yam, Lam Suet, Ruby Wong, Maggie Siu, Hung Ko
description: The sergeant is chased by a thug who has streaked his car and ends up beaten, and what's more, he loses his gun. Mike of the PTU (the patrol police) decides to help him by not reporting the loss of the weapon, at least until the morning. In the night, preventing a police superintendent from snooping too much, they look for the gun and end up in the middle of a gang war. Meanwhile, a child is pedaling alone ...
notes: The case manifests itself inscrutably in one of To's best films, set in an unusually deserted night Hong Kong: almost a theatrical backdrop for the specular ballet of power and loyalty that unites criminals and policemen.

title: Tian mi mi
actors: Leon Lai, Maggie Cheung, Eric Tsang, Len Berdick, Cheung Tung Cho 'Joe'

title: Aau dut
actors: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Lau Ching Wan, Maggie Siu, Lung Fong
description: In a war between corrupt cops and rival triads, with a bounty on the head of a boss that tempts many but no one seems able to aspire to, a mysterious foreign killer intervenes and hides dangerous secrets.
notes: Against the backdrop of a gloomy and claustrophobic Macau, the intrigues of one of the best noirs filmed in Hong Kong and produced by Johnnie To unfold. The intertwining, complex and articulated, gradually grows between action scenes, violence and a quote / homage to the famous final scene of _La Signora di Shangai_, until it explodes in an ending that is anything but conciliatory, devoid of hope or redemption. Superb, as always, is the interpretation of Tony Leung Chiu-Wai.

title: Wu jian dao
actors: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Andy Lau, Anthony Wong Chau-Sang, Eric Tsang
description: Chan has worked for so long undercover in the ranks of the triads that he is now a prominent figure. Similarly, Lau is a criminal, infiltrated for years in the police of which he has risen to the top. Their respective bosses are mobster Sam and Captain Wong have been enemies for years. The two infiltrators will mess up the cards on the table with dramatic results.
notes: First chapter of a trilogy between the mafia, police and internal affairs where appearances can be deceiving and plots leave no way out. A parade of Hong Kong movie stars relaunched the detective story at home and inspired Scorsese's American remake _The Departed_

title: Wu jian dao 2
actors: Edison Chen, Shawn Yue, Anthony Wong Chau-Sang, Francis Ng, Eric Tsang
description: Chen has just started his tenure as an infiltrator in the triads, while the equally young Lau joins the police on behalf of the same organizations. In the underworld, a sudden power vacuum seems to herald a war, but the refined son of the boss takes back control of the situation at least momentarily, while the passage of Hong Kong to China is imminent and the tension rises for everyone ...
notes: The second segment of the _Infernal Affairs_ trilogy and prequel, this episode has mafia epic aspirations worthy of _The Godfather_. The strong point is the excellent interpretations of Francis Ng, Eric Tsang and Anthony Wong.

title: Wu jian dao 3
actors: Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Andy Lau, Kelly Chen, Chen Daoming
description: Ming got away with it and is assigned to internal affairs: here he meets Yeung, a policeman with strange ties to the Chinese mafia. Maybe this is another of Sam's moles. For his part, Yeung suspects Ming himself. The latter, to unravel the intrigue, will turn to the psychologist Lee, who had loved and cared for Yan, his previous nemesis ...
notes: The last piece of the saga is the one that really justifies the title, plunging the viewer into a maze of truly infernal memories and paranoid fears. Genre cinema far beyond the genre, goes forward - with almost experimental techniques - in the psychological investigation of a man destroyed by guilt.

title: Chow lok yuen
actors: Cherman Boonyasak, Matthew Paul Dean, Lee Tung-Yi

title: Xianggang zhizao
actors: Sam Lee, Neiky Yim Hui-Chi, Wenbers Li Tung-Chuen, Amy Tam Ka-Chuen
description: Autumn Moon is an inconclusive young man affiliated with a triad, with a self-esteem that far exceeds his talent or accomplishments. He is in charge of debt collection and meets the feisty teenager Ping, who suffers from kidney failure and needs a kidney transplant, although he has very little hope of getting one. However, Moon falls in love with Ping and idealistically decides to transform into a better person and become his "savior". But this goal can turn out to be in vain for a person in his position and temperament.

title: Liulian piao piao
actors: Qin Hailu, Mak Wai-Fan, Biao Xiao Ming, Yung Wai Yiu
description: Yan is a young Chinese woman disappointed by the province and in search of fortune, Fan is a girl who has followed her family, attracted by easy money, in the Mong Kok district of Hong Kong. But for both, despite an intense but brief friendship born, the impact with the metropolis will have dramatic and unexpected consequences ...
notes: Delicate and chaotic drama at the same time where the frenzy of the city, with its colors and sounds, is balanced by the memories of the rural nuances of the province. Fruit Chan directs a group of talented non-professional actors with intelligence and sensitivity in this ruthless portrait of a confused society full of unshakable humanity.

title: Xilu xiang
actors: Yiu Yuet-Ming, Mak Wai-Fan, Mak Yuet-Man, Robby, Chu Sun-yau

title: Fat City
actors: Stacy Keach, Jeff Bridges, Susan Tyrrell, Candy Clark, Nicholas Colasanto
description: Stockton, California: The population, made up mostly of blacks and Mexicans, lives in miserable conditions. In the gym where the boxers train, the meeting takes place between the expert Billy, who thinks back to past victories and a defeat he never accepted, and Ernie convinced that he has a safe career ahead. Soon the two will be united by the same fate: proletarians of the ring and defeated by life.
notes: Bitter reflection on the other side of opulent America told by a former amateur boxer such as Huston. The film is dry and dense, thanks also a good team of actors. "Fat City" is a slang term for heaven on earth.

title: Umi wa miteita
actors: Misa Shimizu, Nagiko Tono, Masatoshi Nagase, Hidetaka Yoshioka

title: This Man Is Mine
actors: Irene Dunne, Constance Cummings, Ralph Bellamy, Kay Johnson
description: Happily married, Toni Dunlap finds herself out of the blue struggling to keep her husband Jim tied to her. Fran Harper, former schoolmate of Toni and recently divorced, has sneaked into the couple, who makes no secret of the intention to point to Jim's heart ...
notes: Tasty "romantic comedy".

title: The Company She Keeps
actors: Lizabeth Scott, Jane Greer, Dennis O'Keefe, Fay Baker, John Hoyt
description: Obtained parole for good behavior, Diane is placed in the care of Joan, a custodian who will have to help her reintegrate into society. However, the relationship between the two women begins to get complicated when Diane meets Larry, Joan's boyfriend ...
notes: One of Cromwell's best films, suspended between mello and noir atmospheres.

title: Sweepings
actors: Lionel Barrymore, Eric Linden, William Gargan, Gloria Stuart
description: Starting from scratch after the Chicago fire of 1871, Daniel Pardway managed to build the largest department store in the city. Now elderly, he would like to pass the hand to his four children (three boys and a girl), but only at the point of death will he find someone willing to take over ...
notes: Family drama with echoes of _Re Lear_.

title: I Dream Too Much
actors: Henry Fonda, Lily Pons, Eric Blore, Osgood Perkins, Lucien Littlefield
description: Having met between the jokes of a French carnival, the singer Annette and the composer Jonathan get married and move to Paris. The problem is that their decision was - so to speak - "facilitated" by alcohol: and when the hangover passes, the knots come to a head ...
notes: Lively comedy with music (by Jerome Kern).

title: La prise du pouvoir par Louis XIV
actors: Jean-Marie Patte, Raymond Jourdan, Giulio Cesare Silvani, Katharina Renn

title: Heimat 3 - Chronik einer Zeitenwende - Das Glücklichste Volk der Welt
actors: Michael Kausch, Salome Kammer, Henry Arnold, Matthias Kniesbeck Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Michael Kausch
description: November 9, 1989: the Wall has just fallen. And while Berlin and the world celebrate, Hermann Simon and Clarissa Lichtblau meet by chance in a hotel: he is a famous conductor, she is a famous singer. They met almost thirty years earlier; they have loved, left and found each other several times, they have traveled different paths, but now they discover that they can start over together. Clarissa says she has found a "special" home for them, and for Hermann it will be an extraordinary surprise: the place is a hill on the Rhine opposite the Lorelei Rock; that is in Hunsrück, very close to Schabbach, the village where Hermann was born ...

title: Heimat 3 - Chronik einer Zeitenwende - Die Weltmeister
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Uwe Steimle, Heiko Senst
description: June 8, 1990: the World Cup begins in Italy, which a month later will end with the triumph of Germany. We celebrate the inauguration of "Casa Gunderrode", the house renovated by Hermann and Clarissa. Among friends, Gunnar is increasingly frustrated by the relationship between his wife Petra and Reinhold and moves to Berlin, where he will enrich himself by selling fake pieces of the Wall to the Americans. Tobi helps Ernst to look for works of art and returns to the place where he was beaten by the GDR soldiers for being a pacifist: he will take away a huge statue of Lenin. Meanwhile, Hermann is commissioned a symphony for Reunification ...

title: Heimat 3 - Chronik einer Zeitenwende - Die Russen kommen
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Michael Kausch, Matthias Kniesbeck, Larissa Ivleva, Christian Leonard
description: September 1992: after the dissolution of the Soviet empire, American troops leave the Hunsrück; meanwhile, for the same reason, Ernst is released after two years of imprisonment in the USSR. A group of Germans blocked in Kazakhstan by the Communist regime also returned home with him: one of them married the young Russian Galina, who was hired as a maid in Anton's house. And while Hermann and Clarissa's ménage continues quietly, Anton's family is going through a stormy phase: in fact, his son Hartmut is at odds with him about their industrial activity, and what's more, he falls madly in love with Galina ...

title: Heimat 3 - Chronik einer Zeitenwende - Allen geht's gut
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Michael Kausch
description: 1995. Hermann lives a period of contradiction and inner malaise, which greatly depend on negative events: love with Clarissa is in crisis, due to his wife's desire to free herself from domestic security, symbolized by the nest on the mountain. Hermann's family of origin loses his elder brother, Anton, also a symbol: mentor of a Germany that is passing, cynical but capable, determined; Finally, the mutual indifference between Hermann and his daughter Lulu reaches the most painful paroxysm. Collaterally, the contradictory life of his nephew Hartmut, son of Anton, is fulfilled, divided, but with the same enthusiasm, between his farsighted projects, in the entrepreneurial field, and his private life with Galina (who is afraid to live his new life): but a much bleaker future seems to be looming for the spoiled scion of the old Anton, someone is preparing to present him the bill. The cynical and aloof Ernst at his brother's grave improvises an intense and atypical funeral oration; he declares his affection for that feared and admired brother, despite the differences. At the funeral of the patriarch, Hermann finds his first wife, Lulu's mother ... A bitter episode that makes some recent experiences and traces the epilogue of other older ones. Hermann is crossed back from his past: the fixed points, which he believed to be such and stainless, seem to dissolve or die, leaving him in full, conscious, solitude; on the other hand the pain (also physical: it ends with a leg inside a trap), makes it artistically reborn: this seems to define an equation. Clarissa was secretly certain of this equation: family stasis risked killing her artistically, just as it had already killed the music in her husband. But the equations seem to have life until they are interpreted; they create causes and effects and link them together: but, more often than not, arbitrarily. Hermann and Clarissa then review, in their own way, selfishly and egocentric, all the mosaic composed so far and their existences, but in a fatalistic way. Until the heavy symbols of each one are not confronted, and the weak between the two (at least temporarily) succumbs: each person carries with him his own experience, and manifests it, directs it into the future. So Clarissa decides to do, while Hermann loses direction and floats adrift. Anton's life suddenly ends. A life that consciously represents that rebirth of Germany destroyed by war, and which has focused on quality, sacrificing even its own freedom, in the name of work. But he dies happy, after yet another victory (albeit football), and despite his children, today, are only related by legal means. Hartmut, who still has the aura of a little boy, begins to understand that the strength of his father lives within him: but he sacrifices those schemes, and social roles, for a life outside the tradition more suited to the parent. That parent that the child experienced as a coercive shadow that cools everything in rationality, which now, surprisingly, he misses. But Hartmut is convinced of this: times have changed, quality is a concept that no longer pays, a more globalized vision of the market is born; you can not spend more than you earn, and this, on the death of the father, he also says to the employees, who, in response, desert the wake of the old master. Anton's funeral is little attended, without a priest, the relatives are around an unprecedented cinerary urn (a novelty of the times), which denounces a cultural impoverishment and of the collective soul: an ingratitude immediately stigmatized by the difficult and unconventional Ernst, The antithetical and mad brother of Anton and Hermann, his funeral oration, is perhaps the highest moment of the entire third series of Heimat.

title: Heimat 3 - Chronik einer Zeitenwende - Die Erben
actors: Salome Kammer, Henry Arnold, Michael Kausch Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Michael Kausch
description: The Simon saga has reached a crisis We are in '97, Reitz is almost at the end of his German saga and it will be necessary to study because this time he did not make any proselytes. It tells of the Ernst art museum, one of the scions of the family, entrusted to Hermann's daughter. The people of Schabbach, however, turn against the power of the Simons, with the excuse of protecting the forest and a social and economic tangle of vipers is formed which everyone is morally at the expense of. A story broken up into many streams, the redde rationem of the end of the century arrives, the protagonists (she is ill) are waiting for the author to bring them back on the saddle.

title: Heimat 3 - Chronik einer Zeitenwende - Abschied von Schabbach
actors: Henry Arnold, Salome Kammer, Michael Kausch
description: Reitz's epilogue between visionary scenes Reitz's epochal turning point, which began at the beginning of the century, comes to an end, it is the third act: the musician Simon, his Clarissa and all the great circus of his family and friendship relationships meet again for the end of the millennium to celebrate. Who, what, why? Nobody has clear ideas, there are those in jail, the old people suffer and die, an earthquake upsets men and things and not even the homeland is the same anymore. Gathering characters and emotions the puppeteer Reitz makes the last center: the visionary scene of the return to Schabbach is extraordinary in its fantastic rate and that finale with Mozart played by the child who will be great in the 2000s leaves us with a feeling of reasoned and pessimistic yearning of the heart and reason.

title: Millions
actors: Alexander Nathan Etel, Lewis Owen McGibbon, James Nesbitt, Daisy Donovan, Christopher Fulford
description: During an attempted train robbery, a bag full of cash ends up in the hands of Damien and Anthony, two children aged 8 and 10. The only thing to do is to spend the money immediately because in 12 days in England the euro will come into effect and the pounds will no longer be worth anything.
notes: _Millions_ confirms Danny Boyle's talent for tiny dazzling portraits, his ability to give us back an environment through the intertwining of a handful of characters and to handle humor, suspense and surreal touches (the parade of saints with which Damian chats). "Small is beautiful" could be the British director's motto, as was the Ealing comedies and the best examples of the 1980s English revival. And "small" for Boyle does not mean neither minimalist, nor sloppy, nor defiant.

title: Cheongpung myeongwol
actors: Choi Min-su, Jo Jae-hyeon, Kim Bo-kyeong, Lee Jong-su
description: Korea, 17th century: Gyu-yeop and Ji-hwan are the best samurai of the military school they attend. Once the formation is complete, the former is attached to a border unit, the latter at the garrison that defends the royal palace. When, following a coup, Gyu-yeop is arrested, he will find himself having to clash with his friend ...
notes: Although Kim Ui-seok proves that he does not yet possess a figure or a personal style, the film is robust, bloodthirsty and bloody. Not everything is oiled up (the first half hour is confusing and not very compact, the flashbacks are connected with a bit of haste), but the epic oozes from every frame.

title: Crimen ferpecto
actors: Guillermo Toledo, Mónica Cervera, Luis Varela, Fernando Tejero, Kira Miró
description: The charming and ambitious Rafael works in the women's department of a shopping center: his goal is to become responsible for the entire floor, but he has to contend with Antonio, the head of the men's department. When, after a heated discussion, Antonio dies, Rafael begins to suffer the blackmail of the only witness: Lourdes, an insignificant and complex order ...
notes: De la Iglesia does not save anyone or anything. The universe he stages is repulsive, a real hell (literal, in the last part): it is what surrounds us, it is what we are. Unbeatable script, golden palm performers. We laugh often, but with exquisite ruthlessness.

title: Enduring Love
actors: Daniel Craig, Samantha Morton, Rhys Ifans, Alexandra Aitken, Susan Lynch, Bill Nighy
description: Joe and Claire witness an accident involving a balloon. Marked by this terrible experience, Jed, another witness, obsessively binds himself to Joe, pursuing him in an ever more threatening way ...
notes: _L'amore fatale_ by Ian McEwan is a sinuous, dark and romantically desperate novel, of which the director Roger Michell only partially succeeds in transferring the suggestions to the screen. From the initial sequence, born for the cinema, which is beautiful, but fails to retain the shocking impact of the written page. Forced to the inevitable simplification of the haunting inner flow on which the dynamics and questions of the novel are built, the film ends up taking on the color of thriller and instead watering down the lacerating melodramatic predestination of his love triangle. And this despite the skill of the interpreters, especially Rhys Ifans, dazed and even tender in the role of the sentimental persecutor.

title: Deep Blue
description: A journey into the sea and its most fascinating, seductive and wild worlds: from coral reefs to the cliffs of the Atlantic coast, from the vast spaces of the open ocean to the nocturnal landscapes of the deepest abysses ...
notes: The film looks like a collage of the best BBC documentaries, especially those from the _The Blue Planet_ series which aired on the Discovery Channel. Why bring a television product to the big screen? To enhance it scenically? To take advantage of the long wave of the alleged success of documentaries in the hall? And in this second case, are we sure that all the documentaries distributed deserve a place in the sun and the praises of the critics? _Profondo blu_ has nothing of _Mondovino_'s slovenliness, we are literally on another planet: however, when the lights are turned on, there remains a vague sense of pretense.

title: Super Size Me
actors: Morgan Spurlock, Bridget Bennett, Jared Fogel, Alexandra Jamieson
description: Why are Americans so fat? Morgan Spurlock tried to give an answer by interviewing experts in twenty cities in the United States, but above all by eating only at McDonald's three times a day for a whole month, putting his own health at risk ...
notes: The mutation of poor Morgan is accompanied by rigorous interviews with doctors, scientists and nutritionists, and a tragic, hilarious journey into the "wonderful" world of fast food and their tactics to lure customers. McDonald's took offense, but it abolished the Super Size rations: and on the other hand, as Morgan asks, why should we drink two liters of Coca Cola per meal?

title: After the Sunset
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Salma Hayek, Woody Harrelson, Don Cheadle, Naomie Harris, Chris Penn
description: Max Burdett and Lola Cirillo, professional thieves, after a last millionaire heist take refuge in the Bahamas to enjoy the fruits of their thefts. But federal agent Stan Lloyd, who has been chasing them for eight years, discovers that the two are plotting a new and astonishing blow: the stakes, this time, will be a very precious diamond ...
notes: In the delicate balance between action and comedy, the first works decidedly better than the second: which, compressed between the cries of Hayek and a slightly uncomfortable Harrelson in comic clothes, is weak and tears a few laughter without conviction. Brosnan's performance is also mediocre.

title: Outremer
actors: Nicole Garcia, Marianne Basler, Brigitte Roüan, Philippe Galland
description: Zon is saddened as she awaits the return of her husband, a naval officer. Malène married to an apathetic man manages the local workforce that meditates the revolt. Gritte sees the first violence of Algerians eager to gain independence.
notes: Good first work by Roüan, scripted by Cédric Kahn among others.

title: How High
actors: Method Man, Redman, Obba Babatundé, Mike Epps, Anna Maria Horsford

title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
actors: Helen Mirren, Katie Holmes, Jeffrey Tambor, Barry Watson
description: Leigh absolutely has to get a good grade to get the scholarship but the terrible Mrs. Tingle puts a spoke in her wheel.
notes: I play the watchable, bloody and adolescent massacre that allows an amazing Helen Mirren to unleash a memorable act.

title: Manina, la fille sans voiles
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Jean-François Calvé, Howard Vernon, Raymond Cordy

title: La mariée est trop belle
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Micheline Presle, Louis Jourdan, Jean-François Calvé

title: Les novices
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Annie Girardot, Jean Carmet, Jacques Duby
description: Agnes is a nun who goes with her order to the beach for a swim in the sea. Finding some clothes that fit her perfectly and a motorcycle ready for use, Agnes decides to run away and go on an adventure, finding refuge in a prostitute's house. The friendship that will be born will push the second to deal with an unexpected vocation.

title: Don Juan 73
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Robert Hossein, Maurice Ronet, Mathieu Carrière

title: Femmina
actors: Monica Guerritore, Roberto Farnesi, Alberto Di Stasio
description: Silvia is married to a businessman, is the mother of a child and is dissatisfied with her married life. What could be better, then, than indulging in the pleasure of meeting a young and ardent stranger? Except that the lady did her math without knowing her husband's true profession: spying ...
notes: Inspired by the murky story of the Capriolo lovers, a film written by Giuseppe Patroni Griffi who never has the courage to dare with real eroticism. Between petty-bourgeois prudery and ridiculous implications (the husband-spy!), A project destined for shipwreck.

title: La femme et la pantin
actors: Brigitte Bardot, Antonio Vilar, Jess Hahn, Espanita Cortez, Claude Godard

title: Il plenilunio delle vergini
actors: Mark Damon, Rosalba Neri, Gengher Gatti, Sergio Pislar, Esmeralda Barros, Francesca Romana Davila
description: An amulet that makes its owner master of the world is the object that Franz searches for in Dracula's castle. However, he ends up becoming a vampire too, while his twin brother Karl continues the research in other ways.

title: Asterix et la surprise de César
description: Falbala and her boyfriend Tragicomix have been kidnapped by the Romans who want to use them for the circus games organized on the occasion of Caesar's triumph. Asterix and Obelix then go to Rome and, having become gladiators, they find the couple and combine all the colors in an attempt to free them.
notes: Characters born on comic strips rarely pass unscathed into animated films. Even the cute heroes created by the couple Goscinny and Uderzo lose a part of their comic vis and hold on the imaginary, especially if the skits and adventurous schemes tend to repeat themselves.

title: Sanbiki no samurai
actors: Kyoko Aoi, Kamatari Fujiwara, Mikijiro Hira, Tatsuya Ishiguro
description: The Ronin are Samurai trained in the art of war, who however do not answer to any master. One of them, forced to flee and sought after, finds refuge in a stable in which three unscrupulous men of humble origins have kidnapped the daughter of one of the masters-marauders of the village. The gesture of these individuals is more than anything else an act of moral rebellion against the exploitation of poor people by the feudal lords. The Samurai, following his code of honor, knows which side to take sides in the fight ...
notes: Social and political reflection by Hideo Gosha, who masterfully blends action and reflection, stillness and movement, painting a fresco of the Samurai culture.

title: Anya's Bell
actors: Della Reese, Mason Gamble, Thomas Cavanagh, Nancy McLoughlin, Kelly Rowan
description: Outcast by his comrades who consider him retarded, 12-year-old Scott forges a deep bond with Anya, a blind old lady. She realizes that the boy is dyslexic and suggests to his mother Jeanne to submit him for an examination. Shortly thereafter, however, Anya dies of a stroke, leaving a great void in Scott's life ...

title: It's All About Love
country: United States, Japan, Sweden, Great Britain
actors: Joaquin Phoenix, Claire Danes, Sean Penn, Douglas Henshall
description: John stops in New York to get his wife Elena, an ice skating champion, to sign the divorce papers. The woman asks him to stay a few days with her because she claims to be the victim of a plot. John humors her and ends up involved in a plot that will have serious repercussions on his life and on Elena's ...
notes: Luxury packaging - cinemascope, music by Zbigniew Preisner - and a contempt for the ridiculous that is genius. One of those films that in ten, twenty years will perhaps be taken as a touchstone. Of what, no one knows. There are not many, around, of works like this, pompous and grandiloquent.

title: Spanglish
actors: Paz Vega, Adam Sandler, Téa Leoni, Cloris Leachman, Ricardo Molina
description: The beautiful Flor, a Mexican in financial straits with a dependent daughter, accepts the job of housekeeper with a wealthy family in Los Angeles, the Claskys, in full marital crisis: John owns and runs a trendy restaurant, while his wife Deborah is from little unemployed. Completing the picture are the two children - Bernice and Georgie - and Evelyn, the mother of Deborah, a former jazz singer. Flor will have to adapt to the new situation and it won't be easy, as he only speaks Spanish ...
notes: An intelligent and bitter comedy, in which the good dialogues and the perfect definition of the characters and their identities are superior to the plot.

title: Be Cool
actors: John Travolta, Uma Thurman, Vince Vaughn, Cedric the Entertainer, Harvey Keitel, James Woods
description: Disappointed by the film industry, former loan shark Chili Palmer decides to devote himself to music. With the help of the beautiful Edie Athens, widow of a big shot of a record company, he sponsors the young and talented Linda Moon, becoming a successful producer: but things are not as easy as they seem ...
notes: In this sequel (ten years later) of _Get Shorty_ parade the ineffable Uma Thurman (who will dance with Travolta to the delight of the audience), DeVito and many others, well known and almost known. Fun, but AC. Witty, but fragmentary. A question of poses, of explosive jokes, of a cornucopia of details, of costumes on which a couple of treatises could be written.

title: The Paradise Virus
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Melody Thomas Scott, Ralf Moeller, David Millbern

title: Il tuo dolce corpo da uccidere
actors: Georges Ardisson, Françoise Prevost, Orchidea De Santis, Eduardo Fajardo
description: Determined to get rid of his domineering wife Diana, Clive Ardington, a British diplomat, uses the complicity of his wife's lover to kill her. Once the crime has been completed and the body is placed in a suitcase, the man leaves for Tangier where he expects to make any trace of the crime disappear permanently in the acid pits of a tannery. But fate is lurking: Diana seems not to be dead and Clive also has to deal with the police who have set their sights on him.

title: The Upside of Anger
actors: Joan Allen, Kevin Costner, Erika Christensen, Evan Rachel Wood, Keri Russell, Alicia Witt
description: When her husband suddenly dies, Terry finds himself grappling with a not-so-simple family situation and grappling with the demands and needs of Andy, Emily, Hadley and Popeye and her four daughters. Thus she ends up seeking consolation in the alcohol and affection of Denny, her neighbor, who gradually becomes a point of reference for her and her four daughters.
notes: The film has a bitterness of its own that makes it a singular product in American cinema today. Although schematic and tempted by stereotypes, _Litigi d'amore_ reserves some surprises in the cruelest thrusts and even in some directing contempt.

title: Il ritorno del Monnezza
actors: Claudio Amendola, Elisabetta Rocchetti, Enzo Salvi, Kaspar Capparoni, Gabriella Labate
description: Rocky Giraldi, son of the legendary policeman Nico, has followed in his father's footsteps and is an agent of the operational departments of the police. He is currently working on a seemingly easy case: the murder of an apartment thief. As the investigation proceeds, he discovers that behind there is an important round of drugs and laundered money ...
notes: The massacre of Giraldi / Amendola is false, nothing to do with that of Tomas Milian who was there for a while and not only did it. Not to mention that you don't laugh much. Everything to throw away? No, the ringer of the cell phone makes you laugh at the Trash. The authors have noticed it too, and they let us hear it four times.

title: The Last Remake of Beau Geste
actors: Marty Feldman, Ann-Margret, Michael York, Peter Ustinov, Trevor Howard

title: E ridendo l'uccise
actors: Manlio Dovì, Sabrina Colle, Ruben Rigillo, Marianna De Micheli, Fausto Russo Alesi
description: Ferrara, 1504: on the death of Ercole I, jealousies and resentments are unleashed between the four children: Alfonso, Duke of Este and husband of Lucrezia Borgia; Hippolytus, future cardinal; Giulio, born out of wedlock, and Ferrante ...
notes: It could be reproached for being a somewhat "old-fashioned" film: on the other hand, the stylistic tools adopted are typical of the 70s. But Florestano Vancini from Ferrara (_La long night of '43_, _La banda Casaroli_, _Bronte_, _Il delitto Matteotti_) wanted it like this, to add an important piece to the excavation work in history always present in his works. The actors are unknown and good, among which the jester Manlio Dovì stands out.

title: 40 gradi all'ombra del lenzuolo
actors: Marty Feldman, Barbara Bouchet, Edwige Fenech, Dayle Haddon, Enrico Montesano, Aldo Maccione, Sydne Rome, Tomas Milian, Marty Feldman
description: A beautiful lady with a lover found by phone. A couple who doesn't know what to invent to achieve arousal. An heiress who can't stand the bodyguard that her father has put on her heels, but who then needs him to defend herself from a lover. A young man who bribes a lady with the money her husband gave him to take to Switzerland. And finally, a girl who finds the ideal man just as she is about to commit suicide.
notes: It's okay that the film is episodic, but not even a blindfolded monkey could have put together this jumble of stupidity, vulgarity and double entenders.

title: Raul - Diritto di uccidere
actors: Stefano Dionisi, Violante Placido, Giancarlo Giannini, Nicola Farron, Alessandro Haber, Laura Betti, Ernesto Mahieux
description: Rome, 1938. Raul, a young law graduate who supports the theory of the "superman", commits a murder because he thinks it is possible to eliminate those who hinder the achievement of glorious goals. But then, in search of redemption, he agrees to meet the judge in charge of the investigation who begins a ruthless game of massacre with him ...
notes: Claudicant in the protagonist (Dionisi is only willing), the film lives its best moments thanks to the perfect "special participations" of Haber, Violante Placido, Mattioli, Jelo, Farron, Mahieux, to the extent of a sober and effective Giancarlo Giannini and to the last appearance of Laura Betti, able to summarize her histrionic, amazing malice in ten minutes.

title: Quando sei nato non puoi più nasconderti
actors: Alessio Boni, Michela Cescon, Rodolfo Corsato, Matteo Gadola, Ester Hazan
description: Thirteen-year-old Sandro is on a boat holiday in the Mediterranean with his father, a wealthy businessman from Brescia. One night, the boy ends up in the water and is saved by a hull of illegal immigrants en route to Italy ...
notes: Us and them. Citizens of the rich world and the new barbarians. Acceptance and refusal. Solidarity and distrust. Tolerance and racism. Hospitality and contempt. These are just some of the dichotomies that sustain and sustain almost all of the Italian cinema that it stages, romanza, represents the contradictory relationship between our society, our psychology, our culture and the "aliens": migrants, illegal immigrants, "others" who arrive mostly moved by poverty, need, despair. A good and serious director like Marco Tullio Giordana and two talented screenwriters such as Sandro Petraglia and Stefano Rulli in some scenes of the film, in some dialogues, in coloring some characters, in resolving some contrasts have not been able to elaborate those dichotomies well or to overcome them.

title: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
actors: Ewan McGregor, Hayden Christensen, Natalie Portman, Samuel L. Jackson, Christopher Lee, Ian McDiarmid
description: After fighting for three years in the Clone Wars, Anakin Skywalker embarks on his journey to the dark side of the force, jeopardizing his friendship with Obi Wan Kenobi and his marriage ...
notes: With _Episodio 3_, Lucas concludes his sci-fi chanson de geste in an imaginative riot that leaves you breathless, from the fight between Anakin and Obi-Wan cut out on the transparent erupting Etna to the alternating sequence, shot in digital, of birth-death- rebirth. Until the conclusion that it is a beginning: the Black Death rising on one side, the suns on the planet where Luke Skywalker will grow up on the other. If a criticism can be made, it concerns the overly transparent narrative mechanisms and elementary symbologies. But only this interests Lucas: the Myth. By definition, the zero degree of the story.

title: Beyond the Rocks
actors: Gloria Swanson, Rodolfo Valentino, Edythe Chapman, Alec B. Francis, Robert Bolder
description: The young and broke aristocrat Theodora marries an old millionaire enriched for the economic security of his family; but during her European honeymoon, between the Swiss Alps, Paris and London, she falls in love with Hector, lord of Bracondale, a playboy who hangs out in high society. When the husband discovers the relationship, he will leave on an archaeological expedition to North Africa.
notes: The only collaboration between Valentino and Swanson, the film seemed lost until 2004 and is also valid only for the sparks that the two stars unleash. In addition, glamorous environments, sumptuous clothes and that touch of exoticism and cosmopolitan refinement typical of the 1920s.

title: Last Days
actors: Michael Pitt, Asia Argento, Lukas Haas, Harmony Korine, Ari Tomais
description: A lonely boy, with long hair, torn jeans, a dangling shirt, a grunge "uniform". Walk in the woods, swim in the river, light a fire. Then, he wanders around a big battered house, puts on a women's slip, finds a rifle, cooks hideous cheese spaghetti, listens to a Yellow Pages ad agent, answers (or doesn't answer) the phone, plays a piece on the guitar. Distractedly, he crosses paths with four other guys who live in the same house, who talk to him, ask him.
notes: Inspired by the death of Kurt Cobain and the morbid curiosity that was unleashed around his last days (an experience that Van Sant lived for one of his young actors, River Phoenix), Last Days is one with _Gerry_ (who in Italy we have never seen) and _Elephant_. Not because you look like those films (this one is even drier, leaner, does not allow itself to be temporal virtuosity and is made mostly on fixed plans), but because, as the author said, "they are all three stories in which people he does not know exactly what is happening, because there are elements missing in all of them ".

title: The Perfect Score
actors: Erika Christensen, Chris Evans, Bryan Greenberg, Scarlett Johansson
description: Kyle and Matthew, to facilitate university admission, decide to steal the aptitude test from the school computer, so they know the questions in advance on the day of the exam. Other students join them, including the IT expert Francesca, but the boys will end up realizing that it is not good grades that make happiness ...
notes: Teen comedy, but with serious tones, _Perfect Score_ wants to be a sort of _Breakfast Club_ of the 2000s (the film is explicitly mentioned in a dialogue), in which the students scam to get a good score is the excuse to stage the discomfort of the end of high school and the transition to adulthood.

title: Le bon et les méchant
actors: Marlène Jobert, Jacques Dutronc, Jacques Villeret, Bruno Cremer, Brigitte Fossey, Serge Reggiani
description: France, late thirties: Jacques and his companion Simon, of Jewish origin, make ends meet by carrying out petty thieves and scams, constantly hunted down by the obstinate and tireless policeman Blanchot. But after the outbreak of the war, during the German occupation, criminals and law enforcement (assisted by the beautiful Lola) will find themselves on the same side of the barricade, putting their respective skills at the service of the Resistance ...
notes: Lelouch (co-writer with Pierre Uytterhoeven) forgoes the usual bombast and fires a light and enjoyable film, even if a little superficial in the description of the historical background.

title: Die Blechtrommel
actors: David Bennent, Mario Adorf, Angela Winkler, Daniel Olbrychski
description: #Gdansk, 1920s. Oskar Matzerath is an out of the ordinary kid who has decided to symbolize his rejection of a society that passively enters Nazi rule and war simply by stopping growing from the age of three and beating on the drummer he was given: a call that will not be heard.
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Gunther Grass and awarded at the 32nd Cannes Film Festival with the highest recognition.

title: Hangman's Knot
actors: Claude Jarman jr, Randolph Scott, Donna Reed, Frank Faylen

title: The Animals/Five Savage Men
actors: Henry Silva, Keenan Wynn, Michele Carey, John Anderson, Joe Turkel
description: A stagecoach is attacked by some outlaws, who kill all the male passengers and rape the only woman present. Having become a lover of a red man, she manages to clean up her rapists: but due to a series of circumstances, the Indian is held responsible for the violence and killed ...
notes: First and last film by Ron Joy.

title: Quel movimento che mi piace tanto
actors: Carlo Giuffrè, Martine Brochard, Renzo Montagnani, Cinzia Monreale
description: The lawyer and honorable Fabrizio Siniscalchi, advised by his cousin Salvatore, decides to switch to a party of the left. To do this, however, he must get rid of the noblewoman Livia, of whom he is the lover. Having been discharged in a hurry and for political reasons, the noblewoman meditates revenge and tries to implement it, helped by her friend Marquis Cecco Ottobuoni who puts her in contact with the young and beautiful prostitute Anna. The intention of the two aristocrats is to foster a relationship between the prostitute and the honorable member, in order to create a scandal that ruins her political career.

title: Una donna ha ucciso
actors: Frank Latimore, Umberto Spadaro, Lidia Cirillo, Lianella Carell
description: After the Second World War, Captain Prescott begins a relationship with the Neapolitan Anna. For him it is an adventure like many others, for her it is love. When the captain is transferred to Rome he decides to leave Anna. But the woman follows him to the capital where, neglected and humiliated, she ends up carrying out an extreme act.
notes: Inspired by a true story, the film must be trusted beyond the blatant love story, the postcard Naples and the emphatic final moral appeal. Great merits go to the rigor in the staging of Cottafavi. The ruthlessness of its framing makes a canonical melodrama desperate, with a tragic ending that brings out the abyss of human passions.

title: Donna è bello
actors: Andréa Ferréol, Joe Dallesandro, Marino Masé, Daniela Metternich

title: La settima donna
actors: Florinda Bolkan, Ray Lovelock, Flavio Andreini, Sherry Buchanan

title: È caduta una donna
actors: Isa Miranda, Rossano Brazzi, Claudio Gora, Luigi Pavese, Carla Martinelli
description: A single mother marries a young doctor who doesn't seem to tolerate her past. Reluctantly he decides to leave his son to his mother-in-law.
notes: Against the background of a cold and fatuous Milan, a melodrama unfolds freely based on the novel of the same name by Milly Dandolo and scripted, among others, by Zavattini.

title: Voglia di donna
actors: Gianni Cavina, Laura Gemser, Carlo Giuffrè, Rena Niehaus, Luciano Salce
description: Episode movies. In _Domenica con ... _, Bruno and his African wife record their embraces on tape, and the whole block attends. In _La peì_, Luisa cheats on her boyfriend with a mature lawyer and tries to evade a plan to unmask the affair. In _Il miracolo_, the ice cream maker Gesuino manages to have an adventure with Cicciolina, thanks to the invention of a mad scientist.
notes: Comedy without rhyme or reason that, in order to involve the viewer, tries to follow the path of eroticism pushed to the limit of vulgarity. The reflection on the relationship between sexuality and technology is barely sketched, and remains on a level of absolute superficiality.

title: Una donna di seconda mano
actors: Senta Berger, Enrico Maria Salerno, Stefano Amato, Rena Niehaus
description: Augusto wants to sexually initiate his nephew Luca. He thus entrusts him to the care of Nerina, a prostitute with whom he ends up falling in love.

title: L'occhio del ragno
actors: Klaus Kinski, Antonio Sabato, Van Johnson, Lucretia Love, Fredy Unger
description: Plot in preparation

title: Valerie
actors: Sterling Hayden, Anita Ekberg, Anthony Steel, Pete Walker

title: La donna giusta
actors: Karen Black, Margot Kidder, Virna Lisi, Marie-France Pisier
description: Terry, an American reporter in Rome in an existential crisis, decides to ditch the three women he's dating to find the right girl for him.

title: Through the Looking Glass
actors: Catherine Burgess, Laura Nicholson, Jamie Gillis, Marie Taylor

title: Le mani di una donna sola
