actors: Vanni Materassi, Marina Frajese, Bibi Cassanelli, Cristiana Borghi
description: A writer in crisis and his wife decide to stay in a luxurious villa. Here she is seduced by a vicious countess.

title: Spell - Dolce mattatoio
actors: Jane Avril, Martial Boschero, Paola Montenero, Giovanni De Angelis

title: Fantômas contre Scotland Yard
actors: Jean Marais, Louis De Funès, Mylène Demongeot, François Christophe
description: The journalist Fandor allies himself with the Juve commissioner to fight the diabolical criminal, who has decided to extort some Scottish noblemen kidnapped with a stratagem ...
notes: The series of Fantomas with de Funès is weak, but he still manages to snatch a few smiles. Rita Renoir was a famous strip-tease dancer.

title: Col cuore in gola
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Ewa Aulin, Charles Köhler, Vira Silenti
description: During a London tour, the French actor Bernard, walking in the night through the English capital, runs into Jane, a girl who is distraught in front of the corpse of a man. The recently murdered deceased is Prescott, owner of a night club. Bernard decides to help Jane out of trouble and tries to retrieve a compromising photo of her brother, ending up fighting a hit man and killing him. But is the woman really innocent?
notes: Brass adapts _The paper sepulcher_ by Sergio Donati with the advice of Guido Crepax to the scenography. The outcome is confusing and very uninspiring.

title: La mujer de la tierra caliente
actors: Laura Gemser, Stuart Whitman, Pilar Velazquez, Gabriele Tinti
description: Traveling through Latin America, an indigenous young woman and an American engineer, traveling as self -cleaning players, exchange their most intimate memories.

title: The Queen of Spades
actors: Anton Walbrook, Edith Evans, Ronald Howard, Yvonne Mitchell

title: Tu sei l'unica donna per me. Figlio delle stelle
actors: Alan Sorrenti, Jennifer, Anne Marie Carell, Tommaso Polgar
description: Daniel, a young singer-songwriter who came to the organizer Tumba for an audition, is identified by the same as a good talent and adequately launched. As the young man quickly runs to stardom, Gloria, a glamorous model, becomes his icy, aristocratic companion. However, the difficult relationship and the anxieties to conquer the affirmation provoke a strong depressive crisis in Daniel. Tumba himself invites the young man to a remote seaside resort hotel for a retreat and rest. Barbara, the young daughter of the owner of the hotel, being unemployed herself because in the dead season, makes friends with the singer. Tumba, worried about Daniel's relaunch, makes news of his alleged death appear in the newspapers; then, having announced the counter-news, he prepares the new concert. The too diligent organizer, now convinced that Barbara is a hindrance to her protégé, forces her to break off relations with her friend.

title: Le Journal d'une femme en blanc
actors: Maria-José Nat, Jean Valmont, Claude Gensac, Robert Benoît

title: Una donna chiamata Apache
actors: Al Cliver, Yara Kewa, Corrado Olmi, Marie-France Boyer, Rick Boyd
description: A cavalry officer saves an Apache woman bringing her with her, since she has fallen in love with it and wants to protect her from a smuggler of weapons. The latter, however, does not give himself for won and chases them together with him to take revenge.

title: Greta - Haus ohne Männer
actors: Dyanne Thorne, Tania Busselier, Eric Falk, Lina Romay, Esther Studer
description: The dictatorial government of a Latin American country fights resistance by creating the Las Palmas clinic, where girls suspected of supporting the revolutionary movement are imprisoned and tortured. Abi Philips, determined to shed light on the misdeeds of the clinic, is interned there with the help of Dr. Arkos: inhuman abuses await her in the institute, but also unexpected help ...
notes: Sex and sadism mixed for the umpteenth time by Jess Franco, who here declines with little imagination the macabre constants that have populated practically all of his films. The interpreters are unwatchable.

title: Tranquille donne di campagna
actors: Silvia Donisio, Philippe Leroy, Carmen Scarpitta, Christian Borromeo
description: In Italy, in the late thirties of the twentieth century, against the backdrop of a bucolic village, within the walls of an old farm, Guido created his own dictatorship, managing everything and requiring unconditional obedience to those around him. He believes that all women are his property and, like a rooster in the chicken coop, he goes out of his way to assert his cravings. The young son Alberto, on the other hand, is very different from him and dreams of freeing himself from his dictatorial yoke.

title: Il mulino delle donne di pietra
actors: Pierre Brice, Scilla Gabel, Wolfgang Preiss, Liana Orfei, Dany Carrel
description: The student Hans von Harnmen is carrying out a research on Dutch folk art and thus comes into contact with Gregorius Wahl, a sculptor who owns an extraordinary carillon, of extraordinary dimensions, which at every hour parades a series of female statues of life-size. Soon Hans falls in love with Gregorius' daughter, Helfi, who will discover that she is particularly attached to that music box.

title: Les ailes de la colombe
actors: Michele Placido, Isabelle Huppert, Dominique Sanda, Loleh Bellon
description: Two women share the favors of a young musician. The man is forced by his lover, an unscrupulous woman, to marry a very sick heiress who is close to dying. But things do not go as expected as we head towards a tragic consequence in a cold Venice.

title: Black Mama, White Mama
actors: Pam Grier, Sid Haig, Margaret Markov, Lynn Borden, Zaldy Zschornack
description: Two prisoners, a "black panther" and a white with a past as a prostitute, too difficult to manage in prison, are extradited in chains. But on the way, they really rebel, triggering a series of events that will culminate in a bloody shootout between a gang of gangsters and one of African-American revolutionaries.
notes: Blaxploitation meets the so-called "women in prison" under the direction of a Filipino filmmaker specialized in Z-movies. The result is enjoyable, if viewed with disenchantment and irony. A nice vintage document, however, with a great Pam Grier (Jackie Brown). Sid Haig is the creepy clown from Rob Zombie movies.

title: La guerra dei topless - Donne e diavoli
actors: Nunzio Filogamo, Luciano Fineschi, Steve Lang, Giovanni Vari

title: SS lager 5 l'inferno delle donne
actors: Giorgio Cerioni, Paola Corazzi, Rita Manna, Serafino Profumo

title: San Pasquale Baylonne protettore delle donne
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Stella Carnacina, Memmo Carotenuto, Orchidea De Santis, Gabriella Giorgelli, Lionel Stander, Gina Rovere, Gianni Cavina
description: Giuseppe, a cheap rascal, takes refuge in the small town of Busolone. Here he exploits the ingenuity of the inhabitants by pretending to be the intermediary magician of an alleged San Pasquale and prescribing love recipes to dissatisfied females.
notes: Trivial farce and pecoreccia with the "star" of the genre, Lando Buzzanca.

title: Bab El-Oued City
actors: Hassan Abidou, Mohamed Ourdache, Nadia Kaci, Mabrouk Ait Amara

title: The Hills Have Eyes
actors: Susan Lanier, Robert Houston, Martin Speer, Dee Wallace, Michael Berryman

title: Baba Yaga
actors: Carroll Baker, George Eastman, Isabelle de Funès, Ely Galleani
description: The photographer Valentina while returning home one night risks being run over by a car driven by a strange woman with the mysterious name of Baba Yaga. After this meeting Valentina, inexplicably attracted by the mystery that surrounds the woman, is involved in an adventure made of magic, mystery and sensuality.

title: Masoch
actors: Paolo Malco, Francesca De Sapio, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Inga Alexandrova, Valeria D'Obici

title: The Adventures of Hajji Baba
actors: John Derek, Elaine Stewart, Thomas Gomez, Amanda Blake

title: Stella
actors: Bette Midler, John Goodman, Trini Alvarado, Stephen Collins
description: When Stella Claire gives birth to Jenny, the result of a clandestine relationship with a rich man, she stubbornly refuses any financial help and raises the little girl alone. One day, however, she realizes that her job as a cosmetics salesman cannot guarantee an adequate standard of living for her daughter, while her father could pay her for college ...
notes: The plot is more or less that of the 1937 film with Barbara Stanwyck (_Stella Dallas_ by King Vidor), and this work by Erman can be criticized on various fronts: from the overdose of sentimentality to the cliché of characters. But it has a quality that many more sophisticated works lack: it knows how to involve, above all thanks to the interpretations.

title: Sahara
actors: Matthew McConaughey, Penélope Cruz, Steve Zahn, Lambert Wilson, Delroy Lindo, William H. Macy
description: The explorer Dick Pitt and his adventure partner Al Giordino find themselves in Africa, on the trail of the "Ship of Death". On the black continent, the two meet Dr. Eva Rojas, who is investigating a dangerous epidemic ...
notes: Just a little more "plasticized" than its predecessors (the "yesteryear" 007s and the cycles of Indiana Jones and the green stone), Eisner's film has the advantage - compared to many similar contemporary products - of using it in moderation. special effects, or in any case to "hide" them under a patina of old-fashioned realism. It does not want to surprise, but above all to amuse: and it succeeds.

title: Eroi all'inferno
actors: Lars Bloch, Ettore Manni, Rosemarie Lindt, Lu Kamante, Klaus Kinski, George Manes, Carlos Ewing, Franco Garofalo
description: In WWII German-occupied France, some Allied soldiers break out of prison and join the local resistance. Together with a handful of partisans, they orchestrate a daring plan that involves the conquest of an important German outpost, the stealing of burning top secret documents and the kidnapping of a high-ranking Nazi officer.
notes: Small parenthesis in war cinema for the multifaceted king of Italian trash, Aristide Massacessi alias Joe D'Amato (but here credited with the pseudonym of Michael Wotruba). Poor in means and ideas, he is abundantly basted with repertoire material and takes advantage of the brief appearance of Klaus Kinski.

title: We Don't Live Here Anymore
actors: Mark Ruffalo, Laura Dern, Peter Krause, Naomi Watts
description: Jack Linden and Hank Evans, college professors in a small college town, are good friends, as are their wives - Terry and Edith - and their respective little children. But the two couples soon begin a game of cross-betrayal that forces everyone to take note of how things really are ...
notes: Nothing new, mind you, and Curran takes it a bit too long, spinning around in circles for two thirds of the story: however, the writing is quite lucid and knows how to sink into the wounds of a dissatisfied life without patching up anything. More than malice towards figures with uncertain identity, that of the film is glacial softness.

title: Cyberflic
actors: Terence Hill, Marvin Hagler, Gisèle Blondet, Tommy Lane
description: Detective Skims returns to Miami after seven years of absence to take out a dangerous gang of terrorists. He pairs up with his old friend and colleague Mike. Seriously injured following an attack by the criminals themselves, he is considered by all to be dead. Thanks to the help of Mike's daughter, he is regenerated and thus turns into a hologram, a sort of special policeman with extraordinary powers: with his skills, he will have to save both Mike himself and the woman from certain death ...
notes: The latest film by Margheriti / Dawson contaminates crime "action" and fantasy comedy, with exotic settings and cyberpunk elements.

title: The Pacifier
actors: Vin Diesel, Lauren Graham, Faith Ford, Brittany Snow, Max Thieriot, Chris Potter
description: Marine Shane Wolf is tasked with protecting the children of a murdered scientist while he was working on a secret invention. The task is not as easy as it seems, as Wolf has to contend with the rebellious teenager Zoe, the shy 14-year-old Seth, the wild Lulu and little Peter and Tyler ...
notes: The affections, the tears, the baby food, the scholastic misadventures, the oppression, the lies and the micro-rebellions are the missions to be overcome every day and from which a series of situations and gags arises, partly resolved discreetly. With this film, Vin Diesel "gets his driver's license" in a genre that is career insurance.

title: Troppo belli
actors: Costantino Vitagliano, Daniele Interrante, Ernesto Mahieux, Jennifer Poli, Alessandra Pierelli
description: The dream of Costantino and Daniele, two handsome guys who are close friends, is to make it into the cinema. But their plans change when they come across Valeria, a model and actress by profession. The woman involves them in a scam orchestrated by their father, Dr. Giampalmi, who passes himself off as an actor's agent ...
notes: There is no air, there is no Rome, there is no costume, there is no acting (and the paradox is that the two, in fiction, spend a lot of money on a course, not surprisingly fake). And romanticism cannot help but manifest itself through the goods, the brands, the Porsche Carrera, the rings with diamonds, the hyper-sponsored jackets.

title: Lauras Stern
description: Laura has moved to a new city with her family, but she misses her old friends. One night, unable to sleep, he climbs to the roof and sees a falling star. Laura picks it up and decides to take care of it: thus I start a fantastic friendship.

title: Comandante
actors: Fidel Castro, Oliver Stone, Juanita Vera
description: The meeting between Oliver Stone and Fidel Castro: the Líder máximo talks about himself, the conditions of his country, the international political situation and the relationship with the United States.
notes: Castro is an old fox and Stone falls into the trap. Never that he answers directly, without ifs and buts, to the most embarrassing and urgent questions. Indeed, the "commander" folds the eye of the camera and the will of the interviewer to his own advantage.

title: Tutti all'attacco
actors: Massimo Ceccherini, Alessandro Paci, Dado, Rosalia Porcaro, Giovanni Cacioppo, Claudio Batta, Sabrina Venezia, Luis Molteni, Isabella Cecchi
description: Ax Bernabei, professional coach, trains the team of the Psychotherapeutic Center of his city. His big break comes when he is called by a Serie C team, whose President is a charming girl who has to deal with a disastrous budget. The Wong brothers are hired, five boys who are passionate about _Shaolin Soccer_ from China ...
notes: It was supposed to be a sort of sequel-remake of The Coach in the Ball, but then a series of "setbacks" turned it into a delirious and surreal "film". The film, let's face it, is terrible, but it lets itself be glimpsed thanks to its involuntary sympathy.

title: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle
actors: David Krumholtz, John Cho, Kal Penn, Paula Garcés, Neil Patrick Harris, Eddie Kaye
description: Harold Lee, an Eastern-born bank clerk, is mistreated and teased by his colleagues; for the most part he is in love with his neighbor Maria, but he does not dare to declare himself. His best friend Kumar Patel (of Indian ancestry) does everything he can to avoid starting work. One evening, the two smoke some marijuana and, inspired by the television commercial of a hamburger chain, they set off in search of a fast food ...
notes: Everything has a disturbing background, and the "trip" of the title is literal: a nightmare-journey, nocturnal, in an American province full of monsters, pitfalls, madness. The performance of the two protagonists, John Cho and Kal Penn, was discreet.

title: Porto da minha infância
actors: Jorge Trepa, Ricardo Trêpa, Maria De Medeiros, Leonor Silveira
description: On the thread of memories, recalled in the first person through his own voiceover, de Oliveira leads the viewer to the places of childhood and adolescence. The Porto (or Oporto, as the Italians call it) of the early decades of the twentieth century thus reveals a fascinating and forgotten face: the now dilapidated birthplace, the theater boxes and the operetta shows, the discovery of the magic of the cinema, the days spent with friends in elegant cafes ...
notes: With a hint of melancholy but without a shadow of sadness, the Lusitanian master takes us on a very personal and exciting journey through time.

title: A ciegas
actors: Naiwa Nimri, Alfredo Villa, Ramón Barea, Elena Irureta, Mariví Bilbao
description: Marrubi is married and has a child with Mikel: both are ETA terrorists and live in an apartment full of explosives. At his first action Marrubi loses control and shoots a teammate killing him. Since then she will be forced to flee.
notes: Calparsoro, through the portrait of a terrorist, denounces the madness of the armed struggle.

title: The Proprietor
actors: Jeanne Moreau, Sam Waterston, Sean Young, Austin Pendleton
description: Adrienne, a French writer of Jewish origin and a victim of Nazism, returns to Paris to buy the apartment in which she had lived as a young man. Together with her former black maid, she will be forced to deal with her tragic past.
notes: Despite Moreau's presence, the film is a senseless mess.

title: The Man in the Moon
actors: Sam Waterston, Tess Harper, Reese Witherspoon, Gail Strickland
description: Louisiana, summer 1957. Dani is 14 years old and has a rebellious spirit, but her rural life is tight. Something begins to change when 17-year-old Court Foster moves to the neighboring farm; the two teenagers form a tender friendship and Dani realizes she has fallen in love for the first time. Just when her older sister, the beautiful Maureen, comes back from town and draws Court's attention ...
notes: Robert Mulligan's latest direction _ (The darkness beyond the hedge) _ has the magic touch of a great storyteller: the slender matter of adolescent love and discomfort is elevated by his gaze to a filmic poem with melancholy and poignant tones. Good the very young Reese Witherspoon.

title: Starship Troopers 2: Hero of the Federation
actors: Bill Brown, Richard Burgi, Kelly Carlson, Cy Carter, Tim Conlon
description: Years after the epic clash with space bugs (that of the first episode), a platoon finds itself isolated on a remote planet and shrouded in darkness, with a single outpost in which only Captain Dax survives, accused of killing a superior . But it is the appearance of three foreigners that brings the real threat: a new breed of insects that has parasitized their bodies and threatens to infect the whole troop ...
notes: A special effects magician takes charge of the sequel to Verhoeven's ironic film, wasting the budget (albeit tight) with disgusting effects that are repeated ad libitum, orphans of any narrative idea.

title: Ritratto di borghesia in nero
actors: Ornella Muti, Senta Berger, Paolo Bonacelli, Capucine, Stefano Patrizi
description: Venice, summer 1938. The young Mattia Morandi from Lecco reaches the city because he has won a scholarship for the piano. Here, he quickly befriends Renato Richter and soon becomes the lover of his mother Carla. The young widow Richter is an excellent pianist and gives private lessons at the home of the very rich Mazzarini, whose daughter Elena falls in love with Mattia, who reciprocates her and leaves Carla. She does not tolerate either the failure of her dreams (she would have liked Elena to marry her son Renato) or Mattia's betrayal, and will do everything to take revenge and win back her young lover ..

title: Quingmei Zhuma
actors: Hou Hsiao-hsien, Ko Su-Yun, Wu Nien-Jen
description: Qin was promoted to personal assistant to a female executive; the promotion encourages her to leave her parents' home and go to live alone. Long, her boyfriend has never done anything good. He's trying to pull himself out of a trial, and has smoky ideas on how to set up an import-export with his brother-in-law in the United States. He tends to live in the past, and yes, he clings to his youthful fixation for baseball. Qin's boss chooses to leave the company when the company is absorbed by a larger company. Qin is offered a job as a regular secretary, and she too decides to leave. Now, at any moment he has plenty of time, and realizes how difficult it is to talk to Long, and how he is increasingly resembling Qin's father. The girl is now interested in a business with a colleague from the old office. Meanwhile, Long stays in touch with Guan, a childhood friend who was once also Qin's best friend. Guan is married to a Japanese man and lives in Tokyo, but the marriage is not going well. In the days and weeks that follow, the latent tensions between Qin and Long come to a head ...

title: Quei due
actors: Eduardo De Filippo, Peppino De Filippo, Assia Noris, Maurizio D'Ancora

title: Musa
actors: Jung Woo-sung, Ahn Sung-kee, Ju Jin-mo, Zhang Ziyi, Park Yong-woo

title: Il sorriso del ragno
actors: Thomas Hunter, Marilia Branco, Gabriele Tinti, Elena Nathanael, Leopoldo Trieste

title: Djurado
actors: Montgomery Clark, Scilla Gabel, Mary Jordan, Margaret Lee

title: Tin dei hung sam
actors: Andy Lau, Michelle Reis, Anthony Wong Chau-Sang, Claudia Lau

title: Crime and Punishment
actors: Patrick Dempsey, Ben Kingsley, Julie Delpy, Eddie Marsan
description: Raskolnikov is a student expelled from the university who, to demonstrate his contempt for bourgeois values, decides to murder an elderly usurer to whom he has pledged various objects and which he considers useless for society. Although he has not planned it, he also kills the old woman's sister as a witness to the crime. In the end, thanks also to the moral help of the young Sonja, with whom he is in love, he spontaneously surrenders himself to the police. Having established himself, Raskolnikov is not sentenced to death, but to a relatively short sentence to be served in Siberia. Paid his debt to justice, he meets Sonja again ...

title: Scusi si potrebbe evitare il servizio militare?... No!
actors: Attilio Dottesio, Erna Schürer, Riccardo Garrone, Orchidea De Santis, Gianni Dei, Attilio Dottesio, Fiorella Ferrero, Georgia Lepore
description: A married man with children is called to military service due to a bureaucratic error dating back many years.

title: Long hu feng yun
actors: Chow Yun-fat, Danny Lee, Sun Yueh, Carrie Ng, Roy Cheung

title: Xia dao Gao Fei
actors: Chow Yun-fat, Simon Yam, Ann Bridgewater, Anthony Wong Chau-Sang

title: Sik san
actors: Stephen Chow, Stephen Au, Christy Chung, Clarence Hui, Vincent Kok

title: Zhantai
actors: Wang Hong-wei, Zhao Tao, Liang Jing Dong, Yang Tian Yi
description: Winter 1979, in a small village in Shanxi (a Chinese province far from the major centers) a performance of the play "Train bound for Shaoshan" (Mao's hometown) is staged by the local cultural company. The life of four boys is intimately linked to the fate of the theater group to which they belong.
notes: Jia Zahngke, for the film that made it known to the public of Western festivals, chooses to tell the historical period 79-89, the richest in reforms, from a peripheral perspective. The title was chosen for its reference to both the idea of ??departure and that of arrival.

title: Kongbu fenzi
actors: Ku Paoming, Jin Shi-Jye, Lee Lichun, An Wang, Cora Miao
description: Against the backdrop of a Taipei dominated by the forces of capitalism, the lives of two couples intersect over a span of several weeks.

title: Guling jie shaonian sha ren shijian
actors: Zhang Guozhu, Elaine Jin, Juan Wang, Han Zhang, Xiuqiong Jiang

title: Duli shidai
actors: Chen Shiang-chyi, Chen Yiwen, Danny Deng, Hongya Yan

title: Mahjong
actors: Chang Chen, Congsheng Tang, Kaizo Hayashi, Elaine Jin, Virginie Ledoyen

title: Jiushi liuliu de ta
actors: Anthony Chan, Kenny Bee, Ping-Yu Chang, Kai-Ching Chi, Lu Chien
description: A rich man's daughter takes French lessons so that she can travel to France with her boyfriend. However, she ends up falling in love with a poor young man who studies civil engineering.

title: Feng er ti ta cai
actors: Kenny Bee, Anthony Chan
description: An unlikely love story arises between a blind man and a photographer.

title: Zai na hepan qingcao qing
actors: Kenny Bee, Chen Meifeng, Jiang Ling
description: Da-Nian, a young man from Taipei, goes to a remote village to take the teaching post left empty by his sister. Here, he falls in love with his colleague Su-Yun and is personally committed to defending the waters of the nearby river, threatened by illegal fishing.

title: Tui shou
actors: Haan Lee, Bin Chao, Victor Chan, Fanny De Luz, Chan Lester Chit-Man

title: Itsuka giragirasuruhi
actors: Kenichi Hagiwara, Kazuya Kimura, Keiko Oginome, Shinichi Chiba
description: To console Misato, his depressed partner who has just had an abortion, the gangster Kanzaki gets back into society with Imura and Shiba, his accomplices in the underworld. A luxurious hotel is robbed, but the loot is much less than expected. For the possession of the loot then a terrible series of ambushes are unleashed which will end only when all have been eliminated, except Kanzaki and Misato. On the verge of grotesque and (voluntary?) Comedy, the film consists of an almost uninterrupted series of shootings, killings, chases, one more daring and unrealistic than the other. The pace is ultra-fast, but there isn't much else.

title: Batoru rowaiaru
actors: Tatsuya Fujiwara, Aki Maeda, Taro Yamamoto, Masanobu Ando
description: In the near future, the Japanese government recruits a group of high school students to participate in the revolutionary Battle Royale. Equipped with a weapon chosen by chance and some rations of water and food, the students are left for three days on a desert island and their task is to kill each other in a game that, with no holds barred and with few rules , will have to leave only one winner alive.

title: Batoru rowaiaru II: Rekuiemu
actors: Tatsuya Fujiwara, Ai Maeda, Shûgo Oshinari, Ayana Sakai

title: 'A' gai waak
actors: Jackie Chan, Sammo Hung, Yuen Biao, Dick Wei, Mars, Winnie Wong

title: Ging chaat goo si
actors: Jackie Chan, Maggie Cheung, Charlie Cho, Chor Yuen, Brigitte Lin, Kwok-Hung Lam, Bill Tung
description: Hong Kong policeman Kevin Chang scores his first major success against drug kingpin Chu Tao. The boss's revenge, however, is not long in coming and Kevin is forced to question his entire existence to avoid being killed or arrested.

title: Bet Your Life
actors: Sean Carrigan, Corinne Van Ryck de Groot, Billy Zane, Jeanne Bauer
description: Cornered by some dodgy guys, Sonny Briggs proposes a bet: nothing more natural, given that we're in Las Vegas ... If he can stay alive for twenty-four hours Sonny will have his skin safe and so risks, decides to sneak away to Cleveland ...

title: La route de Corinthe
actors: Jean Seberg, Maurice Ronet, Christian Marquand, Michel Bouquet, Saro Urzì, Claude Chabrol
description: American radar installations in Greece suffer an attack, and an undercover NATO agent - who was investigating the disturbances generated by a central communications center in the Mediterranean - is killed. The suspicions fall on Shanny, the latter's widow, who in an attempt to prove her innocence will find herself embroiled in an international conspiracy ...
notes: Spying parody that mixes (with a very lively rhythm and sparkling sepia-black humor) references to Greek tragedy and to the master Hitchcock, so much so that Chabrol himself appears in a cameo. Despite the skilful effort, however, the result has an artificial and in the long run a bit tiring aftertaste.

title: Piège pour Cendrillon
actors: Dany Carrel, Madeleine Robinson, Jean Gaven, Hubert Noel
description: Completely devoid of memory, the young Michèle (or Dominique?) Is entrusted to the care of Jeanne, who tries to help her regain knowledge of herself. The mystery unfolds in a complicated series of flashbacks, at the end of which the truth will come out.
notes: Discreet psychological drama by Gaumont, directed without particular flashes but with solidity by the Cayatte of _Justice is done_ and _We are all murderers_. Based on a novel by Sébastien Japrisot, who also signs the screenplay (under the pseudonym of Jean-Baptiste Rossi, a perfect anagram of his name) together with Jean Anouilh and Cayatte himself.

title: xXx: State of the Union
actors: Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe, Samuel L. Jackson, Xzibit, Michael Roof
description: A group of radicals who oppose government policy plans to eliminate the president of the United States. Augustus Gibbons, an agent of the National Security Agency and his colleague Toby Lee Shavers, know that to avoid the coup d'état they have to resort to Darius Stone, a former soldier of the special forces currently locked up under strict surveillance in a military prison ...
notes: Tamahori has never been a great director, and here he does not contradict himself. It goes on with the so-called "one-liners", the mache and idiotic jokes. Good one: Speedman "If you run away, you look guilty", Ice: "I seem guilty since I was born". Amen.

title: L'uomo perfetto
actors: Francesca Inaudi, Gabriella Pession, Riccardo Scamarcio, Giampaolo Morelli
description: Lucia, a young and brilliant advertiser, is shocked by the news that Maria, her best friend, is about to marry Paolo, the only man Lucia loved since she was a teenager. To prevent the irreparable from happening, Lucia hires Antonio, a penniless actor, and transforms him into the man of Maria's dreams ...
notes: The actors are good, the direction and the script work well on the timing, rhythm and characters of a plot on loneliness and falling in love. Every sociological reference is wanted and filtered by the tradition of a cinema that comes from afar: the classic American comedies in black and white and those of Mario Camerini.

title: Flight of the Phoenix
actors: Dennis Quaid, Tyrese Gibson, Giovanni Ribisi, Miranda Otto, Tony Curran, Scott Michael Campbell
description: Following a plane crash, a group of survivors - workers and employees of an oil company - find themselves in the Gobi desert in Mongolia. Captain Towns encourages them and guides them to build a new aircraft using the wreckage of the crashed one because there is no possibility of being reached by rescue ...
notes: In this remake of Aldrich's film of the same name, the plot still works; pity that the human group is a bit 'too cute and gym and not a dirty, human dozen. The sudden "visionary" jolts in the desert are also slightly free. American cinema should occasionally remind itself of the roughness of the fathers.

title: Vieni via con me
actors: Mariangela Melato, Enrico Lucci, Daniele Passaro, Dino Nole, Alex Feldman, Dylan Fergus
description: In Utica, a small town north of New York, the Italian Maria lives with her three children, Michael, Lucia and Santino. The latter gives her some concern: she organizes small shots with friends to scrape together the money necessary to move to Miami. However, his mother always manages to blow his plans thanks to her husband's suggestions from the afterlife ...
notes: The story is among the most seen ever, with the classic Italian family of southern origins who have lived for years in a suburb a stone's throw from New York. What prompted Mariangela Melato to accept a role in such poverty of ideas and in such richness of clichés, God only knows.

title: Saimir
actors: Mishel Manoku, Xhevdet Feri, Lavinia Guglielman, Anna Ferruzzo
description: Sixteen-year-old Saimir, originally from a village in Albania, lives in a suburb near Rome with his father Edmond who traffics illegal immigrants with small farmers in the area. The boy can't stand his father's business but doesn't have the courage or strength to rebel. However, when he discovers that Edmond has agreed to introduce a minor to be initiated into prostitution, the conflict between the two explodes with violence.

title: Der Untergang
actors: Bruno Ganz, Alexandra Maria Lara, Corinna Harfouch, Ulrich Matthes, Juliane Köhler
description: April 20, 1945. Berlin is about to be besieged by Russian troops. Adolf Hitler took refuge with the other leaders of the Nazi regime in the bunker under the Chancellery. His typist Traudl Junge witnesses the collapse of Nazism, Himmler's betrayal, Speer's loyalty and the suicide of Goebbels, his wife Magda and the poisoning of his six children. The führer would like to push Germany to resist, but on April 30 he will commit suicide with Eva Braun.
notes: The operation has very realistic and daily intentions: to spy on the protagonists of History "from the keyhole". But in doing so, Bruno Ganz's acting ends up appearing on the verge of caricature.

title: Cellular
actors: Kim Basinger, Chris Evans, Jason Statham, William H. Macy, Eric Christian Olsen, Noah Emmerich, Valerie Cruz, Jessica Biel, Will Beinbrink, Greg Collins
description: The peaceful existence of Jessica Martin, a high school science teacher, is turned upside down when she falls victim to a kidnapping. Terrified and completely unaware of the reasons for her kidnapping, Jessica works hard to get a broken phone to work and then dials an unknown number in a desperate attempt to save herself.
notes: Actors committed to the loaf, frozen action, pathetic irony. And if you want to build on theories on time, space, technology, contemporary systems of representation of suspense, on the star-system, please ... We prefer any Gary Sherman.

title: The Wedding Date
actors: Debra Messing, Dermot Mulroney, Amy Adams, Sarah Parish, Jack Davenport
description: Kat Ellis returns to her native London for her sister's wedding. Terrified of meeting her ex-boyfriend, she hires a handsome young man to play her new flame ...
notes: Those who do not guess the ending must stay away from the cinemas for at least six months. The protagonist is TV star Debra Messing (_Will & Grace_), who remains an unmemorable presence on the big screen. The gigolo is Dermot Mulroney (_My best friend's wedding_), who works hard and continues to leave no marks. The only significant performance is that of Sara Parish, a slightly flustered character actor.

title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
actors: Kirsten Dunst, Ellen Barkin, Denise Richards, Allison Janney
description: In a small town in Minnesota, the annual beauty pageant is caught on television. Former Miss Gladys Leeman wants her daughter Becky to retrace her steps: she will have to contend with Amber Atkins, another girl who aspires to win the title.
notes: The director explores the environment of the American province with an amused tone.

title: Head in the Clouds
country: United States, Great Britain, Spain, Canada
actors: Charlize Theron, Penélope Cruz, Stuart Townsend, Thomas Kretschmann, Steven Berkoff
description: Gilda Bessé, a bohemian photographer, shares the apartment with Mia, a Spanish dancer and Guy Malyon, an Irish teacher. A love affair is born between the three but the game is interrupted when war breaks out and the German troops arrive in Paris ...
notes: We are among the literary atmospheres of Anaïs Nin and Gertrude Stein, we are in the painting of Picasso and Chagall, in the black and white of Cartier-Bresson, in the cinema of Renoir, in the music of Trenet and Josephine Baker, in the clothes of Coco Chanel and Elsa Schiaparelli. Too bad the film is exquisitely compiling: superficial like a fashion show. And that eroticism is glossy like a page from "Playboy" and therefore harmless. Like the rest of the film, interpreted, scripted, directed and - above all - designed for a strictly and boringly home-made vision.

title: Run of the Arrow
actors: Rod Steiger, Sara Montiel, Brian Keith, Ralph Meeker, Charles Bronson
description: Unable to accept the defeat he remedied in the American Civil War, Irish-born Confederate soldier O'Meara (Rod Steiger) decides to head west and start a new life among the Sioux Indian tribes. After undergoing a ritual called "the torture of the arrow", O'Meara is accepted by the Sioux, of whom he marries a young woman. However, his new identity will be severely tested when, following the conflict that breaks out between the Sioux and the troops of the Northern army, he will have to decide which side to take.

title: Sin City
actors: Bruce Willis, Mickey Rourke, Jessica Alba, Clive Owen, Elijah Wood, Rosario Dawson, Benicio Del Toro, Michael Madsen, Brittany Murphy, Carla Gugino, Rutger Hauer, Josh Hartnett, Nick Stahl, Devon Aoki, Jaime King
description: Sin City is a violent city where everything exudes corruption (even the police department). Here we follow the story of three men: Marv, seeking revenge after he finds the beautiful Goldie, with whom he spent only one night, a corpse in his bed; ex-photographer Dwight who accidentally killed a heroic cop and has to fix things; and policeman Hartigan in jail for a crime he didn't commit ...
notes: The result, from an aesthetic point of view, is sumptuous, perfect. But also cold. Moreover, and it is the worst thing, the film is the same as comics but not having understood the meaning it becomes a sterile replica.

title: Match Point
actors: Scarlett Johansson, Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Brian Cox, Emily Mortimer, James Nesbitt, Geoffrey Streatfield, Penelope Wilton, Matthew Goode, Alexander Armstrong, Simon Kunz, Miranda Raison, Rose Keegan, Ewen Bremner, Steve Pemberton, Rupert Penry-Jones, Margaret Tyzack
description: England. A tennis teacher teaches some members of a wealthy family. Thus he discovers the habits of British high society and soon falls in love with a young woman ...
notes: Woody Allen now directs with masterful simplicity: a few trolleys on the street, fields and reverse shots, hints of zoom on the faces in a couple of psychologically decisive moments, an exemplary sequence in alternate editing. A "cleaning" which corresponds to a disheartening and very lucid vision of human relationships.

title: Manderlay
actors: Bryce Dallas Howard, Isaach De Bankolé, Willem Dafoe, Danny Glover, Lauren Bacall, Jean-Marc Barr
description: On her way back to town with her gangster father, Grace ends up in a town, Manderlay, where blacks are enslaved by whites as expected. The girl, sensitive as someone who has just exterminated a community by invoking an eye for an eye can be, summons her father's mob and with the sound of a machine gun instills democracy in the villagers of every color. Could it be, forced liberation, true freedom?
notes: _Manderlay_ is declamatory, schematic, provocative, dense, moralistic, incorrect, uncomfortable as von Trier always has. His talent is beyond question, the fact that his cinema is still needed much less.

title: Don't Come Knockin'
actors: Sam Shepard, Jessica Lange, Tim Roth, Gabriel Mann, Sarah Polley, Eva Marie Saint, Fairuza Balk
description: While shooting his latest film, Howard - an actor now advanced in years - leaves the set to embark on a journey of self-discovery.
notes: Beautiful story of a generation that grew up without children (that of Wenders and his co-writer and protagonist Sam Shepard) and that suddenly finds itself old, forced to deal with that of children who grew up without fathers. Fragility and absences that reflect each other, staggered times, selfishness, regrets, impossible tenderness. But it is also a film about the myth, about the cinema we loved and that no longer exists, about the America we loved and that perhaps, somewhere, is still there.

title: Behind the Camera: The Unauthorized Story of "Charlie's Angels"
actors: Tricia Helfer, Lauren Stamile, Christina Chambers, Dan Castellaneta
description: Hollywood, late 1970s: producer Aaron Spelling contacts actresses Farrah Fawcett-Majors, Kate Jackson and Jaclyn Smith to play three charming secret agents under the orders of an elusive Charlie. The show, which was initially supposed to be called "The Alley Cats", thanks to an effective mix of action and irony, soon makes the three beautiful "Charlie's Angels" an international phenomenon: but when Fawcett decides to leave the series, the problems begin ...
notes: Tricia Helfer, "femme fatale" of the new version of _Battlestar Galactica_, has been called to play the blonde Farrah, itself a cult show.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
actors: Robert Patrick, Bo Hopkins, Duane Whitaker, Muse Watson
description: Buck and Luther want to rob a bank. On his way to the meeting place, Luther stops at the "Titty Twister", a place infested with vampires.
notes: A sequel to _From dusk till dawn_, it still combines horror with gangster. Good pace and you find it funny at the beginning, it evolves towards banality.

title: Avere vent'anni
actors: Gloria Guida, Lilli Carati, Ray Lovelock, Vincenzo Crocitti, Vittorio Caprioli
description: Lia and Tina, attractive twenty-year-olds from the province, meet by chance a certain Michele Palumbo known as "the Nazariot", who invites them to join the commune he manages in the city. Arrived on the spot by hitchhiking, the unfortunates discover a gallery of bizarre characters, including the "Riccetto", with an extravagant appearance but in reality an informer of the dirty local commissioner ...
notes: The master of the Italian detective is confronted with rebellion and feminism, but "gets high" sensationally. Gloria & Lilli, however, form a couple that cannot be forgotten. The film was thoroughly "purged" and censored, especially in the very violent original ending.

title: A History of Violence
actors: Viggo Mortensen, Maria Bello, Ed Harris, William Hurt, Ashton Holmes, Peter MacNeill, Stephen McHattie, Greg Bryk, Kyle Schmid, Sumela Kay, Aidan Devine, Heidi Hayes
description: Tom Stall, a family man with an apparently peaceful existence, in self-defense kills two criminals who tried to rob his diner. From that moment on, his life changed radically, and nothing will ever be the same ...
notes: Violence is disturbing and must be described as such. It is evident that Cronenberg distances himself from the mechanisms of spectacularization so typical of the latest Hollywood, in his "high" or "low" practices: the result is a film full of meaning and extremely disturbing. All the actors were excellent, from Mortensen to Bello, with a special mention for the scarred and sublime Ed Harris.

title: L'enfant
actors: Jérémie Rénier, Déborah François, Jérémie Segard, Fabrizio Rongione
description: Twenty-year-old Bruno and eighteen-year-old Sonia live thanks to her subsidy and the thefts committed by the boy and his gang. But when Sonia gives birth to Jimmy, Bruno - who until then had only cared about himself - must learn to be a father ...
notes: The Belgian brothers do not make abstract humanism. Not that there is no thesis, not that there is no mention of high arguments (loss of values, suffocation of ethics): but they are the secular (non-secular) sense of society and its responsibilities, and the religious (non-Vaticanist) sense ) of life and its sacredness, to make the film's balance and transparency magnificent. Palme d'Or in Cannes.

title: Where the Truth Lies
actors: Kevin Bacon, Colin Firth, Alison Lohman, Sonja Bennett, Rachel Blanchard
description: A journalist digs into a long-closed case, which fifteen years earlier had involved a famous couple from the show business. The two had found a dead girl in their hotel room and had been cleared of all charges due to an iron alibi. Since then, however, their artistic relationship at the height of success inexplicably broke down ...
notes: False truths, true lies, impulses that explode, eroticisms that scrutinize each other, appearances that deceive: it is Egoyan's cinema. Scanned by the Telethon, by the off-tone voiceover and by the choice of music not exhibited, it does not lack sudden outbursts of violence. And Colin Firth looks like Joe Pesci.

title: Free Zone
actors: Natalie Portman, Hana Laszlo, Carmen Maura, Uri Klauzner
description: After arguing with her mother-in-law, Rebecca leaves the hotel she is staying in and gets into a taxi. This is how he meets Hanna, a woman who will change his life ...
notes: At the East Fair, for two pennies, my father bought a lamb ... But wasn't it a mouse? Well no, the original version of this traditional Hebrew then arranged, as we know, by Branduardi says so, and there is also a wolf. It is clear that the meanings range from the biblical "sacrificial" to that of the struggle for survival. Impossible for the authors of over there, whether they are called Amos Gitai, Elia Suleiman or Amos Oz, to tell anything, even the simplest love story, without running into the drama of the context: an infinite war, a paradoxically Godless anger, violence. (also verbal) which is the only means of communication. Among women, in this case.

title: Caché
actors: Denis Podalydès, Daniel Auteuil, Juliette Binoche, Annie Girardot, Nathalie Richard, Daniel Duval
description: Journalist Georges Laurent begins to receive videos of him with his wife Anne and his family and drawings that are difficult to interpret. He has no idea who may have sent them to him. Over time, the content of the videotapes becomes more personal. Georges feels that a threat is looming over him and his loved ones, but since there are no concrete clues, the police cannot intervene.
notes: Haneke insists on building voyeuristic mechanisms (rationally rather than shaky) to test his characters (already shaky of them). Cold, livid and unexplained film.

title: Zuei hao de shih guang
actors: Shu Qi, Chang Chen, Mei Fang, Liao Su-jen, Di Mei
description: In _A Time for Love_, in 1966, a soldier falls in love with a girl who frequents a billiard room; she escapes him and he follows her across the country. In _A Time for Freedom_, a courtesan and a writer who is fighting for independence from Japan love each other in a 1911 brothel. Today, in _A Time for Youth_, an epileptic rock singer goes from bed to bed and her partner has a mistress too.
notes: The ungraspable happiness of love and the ephemeral certainty of feelings are declined by Hou with three different staging. The central episode, for example, is silent yet shot with a modern style, without any field / reverse.

title: Broken Flowers
actors: Bill Murray, Jessica Lange, Sharon Stone, Frances Conroy, Tilda Swinton, Jeffrey Wright, Julie Delpy, Chloë Sevigny
description: Unrepentant Playboy, Don Johnston has just been dumped by Sherry, his latest conquest. One day he receives an anonymous letter from one of his former lovers, who tells him that his son, a 19-year-old boy he has never met, has set out on his trail. On the advice of his best friend Winston, a hobby detective, he decides to conduct an investigation himself to unravel the mystery ...
notes: Always a weaver of the images of the present, houses, streets, figures on a background, sidereal communicative distances and, on the contrary, instinctive, tacit understandings, Jarmusch records Don's non-conclusive journey with dispassionate complicity, transforming him between the lines even in a journey through an invisible America made up of prestige prefabs, animal analysts and Hell's Angels elders. The camera lingers, highlights Don's loneliness, accepts his downtime, his perplexed looks; a couple of short intense zooms when reading the letter and the usual descriptive side carriages along the streets and houses. Pink, in the most varied shades, dips everything. Color par excellence female, not necessarily faint or deceptive, but rather a sign of a faded but not vanished tenderness, for all the women around Don, whom Jarmusch loves very much, with their mixture of unresolved desires (Sharon Stone), withered melancholy ( Frances Conroy), disarming eccentricity (Jessica Lange), untamed anger (Tilda Swinton).

title: The Three Burials of Melquiades Estrada
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Barry Pepper, Julio César Cedillo, January Jones, Dwight Yoakam, Melissa Leo
description: The body of the Mexican farmer Melquiades Estrada is found in the desert, where he was buried after being killed. Pete Perkins, a great friend of Estrada, decides to conduct the investigation to find the culprit, as the local authorities are not interested ...
notes: Sure, there's Peckinpah and Garcia's head, there's John Sayles and the troubled _Lone Star_, there's Monte Hellman, Arthur Penn, Martin Ritt and the lineup of filmmakers who somehow dared to rethink the western far from Ford and Hawks; or perhaps, even better, starting from them and then freeing oneself from them along the way. There is all this and there is the pleasure of Arriaga's modern narration, balanced here by a simple story and a more classic direction, compared for example to the uselessly chaotic _21 grams_. But there are also Camus's _Lo stranero_ and the piercing gaze on the alienation of those forced, like the Mexican Melquiades and the "pied noir" Mersault, to abandon their own "homeland". Which is an Ithaca of the heart, a place of the soul: in fact, our two cowboys break their backs to find it, the birthplace of Estrada, and risk not succeeding because they are not him, they do not carry it inside. Melquiades was Mexico, and it was with an intensity that the squalid Norton cannot understand except through a journey, an education, an awareness.

title: Peindre ou faire l'amour
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Sabine Azéma, Amira Casar, Sergi López, Philippe Katerine
description: William and Madeleine, who have been married for some time, live in a town at the foot of the mountains. The woman, a painter, in her visits to find subjects to paint meets Adam, a cultured, refined and blind man who lives with the young Eva. William and Madeleine buy an old abandoned house nearby and become friends with Adam and Eva. The day their house burns down, the painter and her husband offer to host them ...
notes: _Incontri d'amore_ by Arnaud and Jean-Marie Larrieu is an involuntarily comic film, impossible to take seriously. Do not misunderstand, not for the theme, which can be explored in a thousand ways, certainly also interesting, but for how they treat it. With a pro loco aesthetic of the French countryside and an intersection of intellectual snobberies to be frightening. Faced with the scene of Amira Casar's "sculpture" who after urinating asks Daniel Auteuil to be clean, how is it possible that directors, actors, screenwriters do not ask themselves questions about the meaning of what is happening and the effect it could have (and indeed has) on the public?

title: Batalla en el cielo
actors: Brenda Angulo, David Bornstien, Marcos Hernández, Diego Martínez Vignatti, Anapola Mushkadiz
description: Marcos, a mestizo driver, kidnaps one of his nephews with his wife who accidentally dies. Marcos proves to be more fragile than expected and confesses the crime to Ana, the daughter of his boss, a frivolous girl who prostitutes herself for pleasure.
notes: Marcos and his wife seem to come out of an episode of Cinico TV, but there is the suspicion that the unpleasantness they transmit is more provocative than significant. The young director, former player of the Mexican national rugby team, uses the camera like a club and spares nothing. Sex and violence, as if to say: I have no taboos, do you? An intellectual game that someone, at the Cannes Film Festival, took too seriously. To keep an eye on Anapola Mushkadiz, the actress who plays Ana: she is good and beautiful.

title: Election
actors: Nick Cheung, Louis Koo, Tony Leung Ka Fai, Andy On, Simon Yam
description: The leaders of the Wo Shing Society, Hong Kong's oldest Triad, are about to elect a new leader. There is great rivalry between the two candidates: the first is very tied to the traditions of the Triad, the other would like to reject them and is ready to resort to violence and fraud ...
notes: For his first film presented in Cannes, To relies on a cast of his veterans and the result is very solid. The film takes a while to start, harnessed by the explanatory sequences on the mechanisms of the Hong Kong Triads: but at the moment of take-off, it offers a memorable half-hour chase and a very hard and unexpected ending. There is also a sequel, even tougher.

title: Qing hong
actors: Gao Yuanyuan, Li Bin, Tang Yang, Wang Xueyang, Yao Anlian
description: 60's. Numerous Chinese families are forced to leave the cities to populate the countryside. Thus was born the love between a girl from Shanghai and a farmer.
notes: Fixed shots and almost total absence of music and editing. The choices of the director of Beijing's bicycles are justified by the origin of the work (dedicated to his parents, witnesses of the facts). That is to remember the period in which hundreds of Chinese families were sent by the government to the factories of the interior to constitute the "third line" of defense from the feared attacks of the Soviet army in 1983.

title: Joyeux Noël
actors: Bernard Lecoq, Daniel Brühl, Guillaume Canet, Diane Kruger, Benno Fürmann
description: Summer 1914: with the outbreak of the war, the Berlin tenor Nikolaus Sprink has to give up his career and the woman he loves. The Scottish Anglican priest Palmer volunteers to follow his young aide. Lieutenant Audebert goes to the front and leaves his pregnant wife. But then Christmas comes ...
notes: Known but dignified.

title: Chromophobia
actors: Ben Chaplin, Penélope Cruz, Ralph Fiennes, Ian Holm, Rhys Ifans, Kristin Scott Thomas
description: The dilemmas of modern London life where traditional values ??such as honesty, loyalty and friendship are sacrificed for the benefit of a new morality based on success and stardom.

title: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
actors: Deanna Dozier, Val Kilmer, Robert Downey jr., Michelle Monaghan, Joel Michaely
description: A criminal who would like to become an actor, a private investigator and an actress on the avenue of the sunset find themselves involved, in spite of themselves, in a murder ...
notes: Littered with ironic and highly cultured quotes from Chandler, Hammett, Ellroy, Halliday, with a shady "L.A. Confidential" bar and floating "Lady in the Lake" corpses, the film has the perfection of a well-written and perfectly acted mechanism. Newcomer Black is an esteemed screenwriter who has always been a fan of detective fiction, while Downey jr. and Kilmer - in the part of a gay detective - does not spare themselves (not even in a self-deprecating sense).

title: Nekam achat mishtey eynay
description: Second Intifada. Israeli director Avi Mograbi believes a dialogue between the besieged Palestinians and the ubiquitous Israeli army is possible. To explain the conflict, he resorts to the myths of Samson and Massada.
notes: The perspective is illuminating and original, at the end personal indignation explodes. And a dedication summarizes the profound meaning of the film. "To my son and his friends who refuse to learn how to kill."

title: Midnight Movies: From the Margin to the Mainstream
description: A journey into the cult films of the 70s. Through the testimonies of John Waters, David Lynch and George Romero, the director demonstrates the influence they have had on popular culture and modern society.

title: Crossing the Bridge - The Sound of Istanbul
description: Alexander Hacke, a member of Einstürzende Neubaten (a German avant-garde group) for over twenty years, comes to Istanbul to compose the music of _La sposa turca_. Here he meets the members of a neo-psychedelic band, Baba Zula. When the bassist leaves, the others ask Alexander to replace her. He accepts...
notes: Fatih Akin surprises us by capturing sound sensations with the camera ranging from the chaos of the city (traffic, muezzin, shouts, life) to the indigenous version of _Music_ by Madonna up to the neo-psychedelia of Baba Zula. A compelling and engaging portrait of a country through its voices.

title: Dal kom han in-saeng
actors: Lee Byung-hun, Shin Min-a, Kim Young-Cheol, Kim Roeha
description: A gang leader suspects that his girlfriend Hee Su is cheating on him with another man: he then asks his right arm Sun Woo to follow the girl and eliminate her if he catches her committing adultery. A tender affection blossoms between Sun Woo and Hee Su, but Sun's sense of duty and honor is irreproachable: not so, however, that of the boss ...
notes: Avenging violence, direction on the verge of aestheticization and a magnetic and fascinating protagonist, reminiscent of Delon from _Le Samouraï_ by Melville. A haiku-film, permeated by the painful awareness that there is no happiness except in dreams: as a surreal, almost metaphysical ending suggests.

title: Hollywood Flies
actors: Antonio Cupo, Bianca Guaccero, Brad Renfro, Casper Van Dien, Vinnie Jones, Caprice Bourret
description: Martina goes to Las Vegas to visit her brother Luca. Together they set out on a journey through Death Valley and load up two hitchhikers, Sean and Jamie, unaware that they are two robbers who just killed a policeman ...
notes: Difficult to become attached to characters that it is difficult to define such, and sorry to say because Cupo and Guaccero are not bad at all, but also the talent of the supporting actors (Brad Renfro!) Is a bit wasted. Is there an Italian way to this genre? It existed, today it is difficult to think of it if even films are "televised" and ideas are reduced, for complexity and inspiration, to the subjects of a fiction. Fabio Segatori flees to the West to avoid all this, but it is an empty journey.

title: Kingdom of Heaven
actors: Orlando Bloom, Eva Green, Liam Neeson, Jeremy Irons, Edward Norton, David Thewlis, Brendan Gleeson
description: At the door of Balian, a farrier who has lost his family, Godfrey of Ibelin appears one day, a crusader who after having fought in the Far East has momentarily returned to France. Claiming to be his father, the man takes Balian with him to the Holy Land ...
notes: Scott makes a beautiful war and adventure film that passionately and unambiguously marries the cause of peace and attributes unmistakable historical responsibilities to the West and to Christianity. Traversed by knights Templar warmongers and greedy for riches and fanatical and opportunistic priests and imams, dominated by two great wise kings (the leper Baldwin and Saladin), he condemns without appeal all those who kill with the cry "God wants it!". The English director, who knows how to shoot battle scenes like few others, indulges in the adventure story without ever losing sight of his basic thesis. Thus, he keeps stereotypes (psychological and narrative) at bay and builds characters of synthetic complexity, helped by the cast of exemplary co-stars (Liam Neeson and Jeremy Irons, David Thewlis and Ghassam Massoud) that surround the young Orlando Bloom and Eva Green, among the which, really, "only light runs". Jerusalem is all or nothing, justice is only that which is closed in the hearts of just men, and peace in the kingdom of heaven (as a final caption says) is still elusive.

title: Stage Beauty
actors: Ben Chaplin, Billy Crudup, Claire Danes, Rupert Everett, Tom Wilkinson
description: London, 17th century: an ordinance from King Charles II allows women to tread the stage, and overnight the actors hitherto specialized in female roles find themselves unemployed and desperate. In particular Ned Kynaston, the most famous "actress" in England ...
notes: The reconstruction is accurate, and Eyre (who as director of the Royal National Theater has produced more than a hundred shows) tries to dynamize a non-exciting script with nervous camera swings. The interest is entirely extra-film: pages of the history of theater and society of the seventeenth century. To evaluate the actors, the original film should be seen.

title: The Station Agent
actors: Peter Dinklage, Paul Benjamin, Jase Blankfort, Paula Garcés, Michelle Williams, Patricia Clarkson, Bobby Cannavale, Josh Pais, Richard Kind, Raven Goodwin, Lynn Cohen
description: Finbar McBride (Dinklage) is a young man with dwarfism who leads a quiet, solitary life. When his only friend dies, leaving him a plot of land in New Jersey that houses an old train depot, he decides to settle there. At his new destination he will meet an artist struggling with grief following a personal tragedy and a Cuban hot dog seller, with whom he will soon form an unusual trio.
notes: Newcomer McCarthy (also a screenwriter) picks up where the other children of the Sundance Festival landed, while the lesson of the "new American cinema" of the 70s continues to spread its seeds in the wind. Delicate, poetic, witty, brooding example of "slow cinema": the steel horses of the past ran aground on the railways of the province.

title: Feux rouges
actors: Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Carole Bouquet, Vincent Deniard, Charline Paul, Jean-Pierre Gos
description: Hélène and Antoine are on their way to pick up their children on vacation in the South of France. Exasperated by the heat and traffic jams, the husband decides to get off the highway and stops at a bar. The radio announces the escape of a dangerous criminal. After getting back on the road, the two argue furiously ...
notes: An effective noir that describes the trite destabilization of the bourgeois couple, but above all stages the reappropriation of the feral and dominating identity of the male, in conflict with the realized and "castrating" woman. Perhaps the development is a bit unsolved, but the actors are partly and compensate for the limits of the plot.

title: Miss Congeniality 2: Armed and Fabulous
actors: Sandra Bullock, Regina King, Enrique Murciano, William Shatner, Ernie Hudson, Diedrich Bader, Heather Burns
description: This time, Federal Agent Gracie Hart is on a mission to Las Vegas to investigate the kidnapping of her friends Cheryl Frasier and Stan Fields. She is accompanied by her colleague Sam Fuller ...
notes: It starts again (and it is the most successful part, even if already seen) from the metamorphosis of the protagonist, chosen as a woman-image, testimonial, guest of honor of popular TV programs. ) and there is no longer Michael Caine as a guardian angel: between a cover and a photo-call, we need to investigate the kidnapping of Miss United States. A few spirited moments are not enough: is the "Gracie Hart" case to be closed under urgent procedure?

title: Around the Bend
actors: Josh Lucas, Christopher Walken, Jonah Bobo, Michael Caine, Glenne Headly
description: After thirty years of absence, Turner returns to find his son Jason, a modest banker, who takes care of his son Zack and his grandfather Henry. But the latter, having reached the age of eighty-five, decides that the time has come to abandon earthly life. The three, respectful of his last wishes, embark on a journey to disperse the ashes in Albuquerque. It will be the right opportunity to retrace their life.
notes: A film of male generations compared, which manages to tell with humble participation a universe of identity and a way of seeing and living. Gorgeous Josh Lucas, huge Christopher Walken and Michael Caine, a bijou the little Jonah Bobo.

title: Hipnos
actors: Cristina Brondo, Demián Bichir, Feodor Atkine, Marisol Membrillo, Julián Villagrán
description: Psychiatrist Beatriz Vargas works in a nursing home that specializes in hypnosis. The death of a little patient forces her on a journey into the womb of madness and terror, between prophecies, secrets and crimes.
notes: A brick that has neither the strength of Sam Fuller's _The Corridor of Fear_ (for heaven's sake, we don't even think about it, heresy, heresy), nor the vulgar exploitation of Schmoeller's _Striscia girl strip_ (which was not set in an asylum, but in conclusion). The Filmax that produces the film and the directors involved continue to think of disturbing with elementary visual-sound tricks. Their products are the apotheosis of patination, where everyone has a grim look, doors creak and shadows kill.

title: Nessun messaggio in segreteria
actors: Carlo Delle Piane, Anna Falchi, Pierfrancesco Favino, Lorenza Indovina, Valerio Mastandrea, Simona Caparrini, Nicole Murgia, Giovanni Ferreri
description: After reading that, according to data from an Istat study, "for every young man who works there is an elderly person who stays at home", retiree Walter sets out on the trail of the boy who is working hard for him too .. .
notes: Shyness is a disease that afflicts men, women and many national filmmakers. Genovese & Miniero are no exception, gentle and polite since their refreshing debut, _Incantesimo Napoletano_. Too kind, too polite and too shy. Theirs is a funny, smiling and reflective comedy, stained with all-contemporary melancholy, which regrets not having surprised more courageously.

title: Tu devi essere il lupo
actors: Sara D'Amario, Ignazio Oliva, Valentina Carnelutti, Valentina Merizzi, Gianluca Gobbi
description: Fifteen-year-old Valentina, who grew up only with her father Carlo, a young taxi driver with a passion for photography, is in crisis. On the one hand he would like to rebel, on the other hand he fears losing his father too. When a woman enters their lives, old wounds reopen ...

title: The Last House on the Left
actors: Sandra Cassel, Lucy Grantham, David Hess, Fred J. Lincoln
description: Cassel and Graham are two girls who go to town to attend a concert. Here they meet a drug dealer who kidnaps them along with accomplices, one of whom has just escaped. After violence and torture, the two are killed. On the run again, the killers ask for hospitality, without knowing it, in the home of the parents of one of the young victims. These will prove capable of the same cruelty.
notes: Wes Craven's first horror film was attacked at the time for its marked and deliberately unspectacular rawness, but above all for the underlying paradox, which almost justifies the ferocity of maniacs with puritanism.

title: Body Count
actors: David Caruso, Linda Fiorentino, John Leguizamo, Ving Rhames
description: A robbery that ended in tragedy forces a gang to escape to Miami. Along the way they get into a mysterious artist.

title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
actors: Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer, Eve, Troy Garity, Michael Ealy
description: Calvin Palmer's shop is now well underway, thanks to a decidedly close-knit staff among which the hilarious Eddie and the entire band protagonist of the first episode (namely Jimmy James, Terri, Isaac, Ricky and Dinka) stand out. They are joined by the stylist Gina, owner of the beauty salon next door. But the old-fashioned shop, which has always been a meeting place for the neighborhood's picturesque and colorful humanity, will have to face a new unexpected event: the Nappy Cuts is rising in front of it, a fierce and very modern competitor ...
notes: Compared to the first episode changes the direction and some performers, but what does not change is the comedy always below the guard level.

title: Les filles de madame Claude
actors: Carina Barone, Françoise Gayat, Zora Kerowa, Antonio Ferrante, Carmen Russo
description: Jeanne Descat and her friends Doris and Nathalie have a very profitable secret occupation: they are girls-sequillo. One day all three receive a phone call that asks them to fulfill the extravagant requests of as many customers. Each of the girls uses everything that over time has learned to get away in the best way ...
notes: Behind the pseudonym "Régine Deforges" actually hides the actor and director Michel Lemoine. The Roman episode was shot and scripted by Mauro Ivaldi who, however, was not credited as a co-regista. Carmen Russo also appears in a cameo, at the time little more than twenty years old.

title: The Toast of New York
actors: Cary Grant, Frances Farmer, Edward Arnold, Jack Oakie, Donald Meek

title: Triple agent
actors: Katerina Didaskalu, Serge Renko, Cyrielle Claire, Grigori Manukov
description: 1936. Fjodor, general of the Tsarist army, lives in Paris with his wife Arsinoé, a Greek painter. While she becomes friends with the Communist neighbors, he is engaged in secret missions and keeps his wife totally in the dark about his double / triple life.
notes: Triple Agent is beautiful as long as the characters discuss politics, until they drop; it is a little less inspired, but always interesting, when the characters talk about art; it sinks into total uselessness as soon as we talk about something else. Curious film, which we would not have expected from the great Rohmer, an implacable analyst of feelings.

title: Agent Cody Banks 2: Destination London
actors: Frankie Muniz, Anthony Anderson, Hannah Spearritt, Cynthia Stevenson

title: Agent 69 Jensen - I skyttens tegn
actors: Ole Søltoft, Poul Bundgaard, Karl Stegger, Kate Mundt, André Chazel

title: Newman's Law
actors: George Peppard, Roger Robinson, Eugene Roche, Gordon Pinsent

title: Baraka sur X 13
actors: Sylva Koscina, Gérard Barray, José Suarez, Agnès Spaak

title: Kommissar X - In den Klauen des goldenen Drachen
actors: Tony Kendall, Brad Harris, Barbara Frey, Robert McDavid
description: Singapore. A scientist creates a destructive weapon but, believing it can be stolen by criminals, he relies on the feds.

title: Agente 3S3 passaporto per l'inferno
actors: Georges Ardisson, Barbara Simon, Georges Rivière, Seyna Seyn, Fernando Sancho

title: La madama, l'agente Minchiello e il caso Patacchioni
actors: Christian De Sica, Ines Pellegrini, Ettore Manni, Gigi Ballista, Grazia Maria Spina, Lorella De Luca, Alessandra Panaro
description: Agent Vito Mincchiello is forced by the circumstances to investigate a difficult case of murder. The girlfriend, a journalist and a prostitute will help him solve the intricate mystery.

title: Sono stato un agente Cia
actors: David Janssen, Corinne Cléry, Maurizio Merli, Ivan Rassimov, Philippe Leroy

title: Alle dame del castello piace fare solo quello...
actors: Edwige Fenech, Joachim Hansen, Francy Fair, Angelica Ott, Michaela May

title: Balsamus l'uomo di Satana
actors: Bob Tonelli, Greta Vayan, Gianni Cavina, Giulio Pizzirani, Andrea Matteuzzi

title: Cyborg 2087
actors: Michael Rennie, Wendell Corey, Eduard Franz, Karen Steele

title: No Man of Her Own
actors: Carole Lombard, Clark Gable, Grant Mitchell, Dorothy Mackaill

title: Pisma myortvogo cheloveka
actors: Roland Bykov, Iosif Ryklin, Viktor Mikhajlov, Nora Gryakalova, Aleksandr Sabinin, Vera Mayorova
description: The earth was devastated by a nuclear holocaust. Among the survivors there is a group of intellectuals who are in search of a little hope in the new pale and colorless world. One of them, a history teacher tries to contact the children of whom he has no longer news by writing to them.

title: Tent's Last Case
actors: Margaret Lockwood, John McCallum, Orson Welles, Michael Wilding

title: Watermelon Man
actors: Godfrey Cambridge, Estelle Parsons, Howard Caine, Kay Kimberly
description: Jeff Gerber is a white and racist insurer who magically wakes up one morning ... black: it will be very hard for him to adapt to his new condition ...
notes: Between Kafkaesque metamorphosis and the law of retaliation, the text by Herman Raucher - staged by Melvin Van Peebles, one of the fathers of "black" cinema - nimbly avoids the dangerous traps of the edifying apologue thanks to a sharp irony, which is so intelligent how bitter.
