notes: Michael Keaton is pretty boiled even though he still holds the scene, but Deborah Kara Unger is really boiled. The blockbuster package tries to deceive the real essence, produced in a 50 cent can, like cannellini beans or green beans. To talk to the dead, better a normal ouija board: we can do it in the living room too, without spending on dirty machinery.

title: Camp
actors: Daniel Letterle, Joanna Chilcoat, Robin de Jesus, Steven Cutts, Vince Rimoldi
description: After a series of Broadway flops, singer-songwriter Bert Hanley goes to work at Camp Ovation, a summer camp for young actors, singers and dancers. Here he finds the opportunity he was looking for to set up a new production.
notes: In Todd Graff's film the stereotype of the homosexual, the pretty little shit, the vamp, the loser, the good girl, the fat black woman - works precisely as such, a direct sign to tell an age and a world; while the socio-cultural discourse on adolescence appears sincere. Obviously, rhetoric reigns. But the performers are spot on, and the musical department is excellent: the gospel start seems to come straight from Hair; and then there's a gorgeous version of The Rolling Stones' Wild Horses, and a rousing Century Plant.

title: Die Geschichte vom weinenden Kamel
description: When an albino camel is rejected by its mother, the intervention of a musician is required for a ritual that makes her change her mind and allows her to be reintegrated into the group.
notes: The work, halfway between fiction and documentary, is also well thought out, and we are not surprised if the torment of the animal is also a little ours, that we feel sorry for its cruel fate. But all is well that ends well. If the intent was to tell the things of life (a civilization? A society?) Through the animal, we were too clouded with tears to understand it.

title: House of Wax
actors: Elisha Cuthbert, Chad Michael Murray, Brian Van Holt, Paris Hilton, Jared Padalecki
description: Trudy's Wax Museum stands at the bottom of the main street in the village of Ambrose. Not far away a cinema, a gas station, a "pet shop", a church. Someone, at a window, pulls the curtain aside to look at the boys who have been stranded in the woods and are looking for help in the village ...
notes: The film is more reminiscent of the "new horror" of the 70s rather than the classic one, both in the depiction of the maniac and his "techniques", and in the representation of an environment (the rural one) that seems on a human scale, but breeds monsters . The two imaginary registers are not perfectly merged, but overall it works. Only inspired by the films of the same name from the 1930s and 1950s.

title: Gong fu
actors: Stephen Chow, Wah Yuen, Qiu Yuen, Kwok Kuen Chan, Siu Lung Leung
description: China, 1940. An aspiring gangster wants to gain a prominent place in the underworld and with the help of a friend he attacks a village, posing as a member of the Ax Gang, a gang that sows terror. The villagers push them back without difficulty, but soon the real gang breaks into the village, and the man has to decide which side to take.
notes: _Kung Fusion_ begins as _A day long dream_ Hong Kong noir version, with a final ballet that dwarfs that of Kitano's _Zatoichi_; it continues with cartoonish surges of unprecedented violence, and with a fulminant use of digital; towards three-quarters, there is a scene involving Chow himself that cannot be believed, and which leaves you astonished; ends with a lollipop invasion that moves. In between, there is so much more. It is also a film about society and class division, about power, about the necessity of dreams. Even if in Italy it looks like a four-season pizza.

title: Quo vadis, baby?
actors: Angela Baraldi, Gigio Alberti, Claudia Zanella, Luigi Maria Burruano, Andrea Renzi
description: Giorgia, a declining Bolognese detective who works in her father's investigation agency, spends her nights wandering from one club to another. When Aldo - friend of her older sister, Ada, who inexplicably committed suicide sixteen years earlier - sends her videotapes that reconstruct the suicide diary, Giorgia begins to dig into the past to shed light on her existence and that of Ada.
notes: The script, the dialogues, the profiles of some characters are less calibrated than a good, enveloping, suspended direction, ready to take siege to the female characters and another man exhausted by the profession of a father (Burruano). Inspired by the novel by Grazia Verasani.

title: Seres queridos
directors: Dominic Harari, Teresa Pelegri, Dominic Harari, Teresa Pelegri
actors: María Botto, Marián Aguilera, Fernando Ramallo, Norma Aleandro, Guillermo Toledo, María Botto, Marián Aguilera, Fernando Ramallo
description: Madrid: Leni Dalinsky, Jewish, wants her family to meet Rafi, the Palestinian boy she has an affair with. Initially the two decide not to reveal the bond especially because of David, the brother of Leni, an Orthodox Jew. While waiting for their father Ernesto to come home for dinner, Leni and Rafi find themselves facing tragicomic situations with their various relatives, who behave strangely ...
notes: Teresa Pelegri and Dominic Harari are husband and wife and together they write the screenplay and direction of their film debut: a lively apartment comedy that opens and closes in the hectic hours of a Madrid evening.

title: Brodeuses
actors: Lola Naymark, Ariane Ascaride, Jackie Berroyer, Thomas Laroppe, Marie Félix
description: Seventeen-year-old Claire runs away from home, works as a cashier in a supermarket, gets pregnant and ends up working as an embroiderer for Madame Mélikian, who recently lost her son in an accident. The friendship that is established between the two women will help both to overcome their difficulties ...
notes: The slowness, the look of a fake documentary, the crumpled plot, the interpretation of actresses taken in the banlieue or in the bistro and placed in front of more stylized recitations easily generate more annoyance than style. This is the case of this film, which titillates metaphors and universal discomforts and ends up embracing boredom.

title: Inside Deep Throat
actors: Gerard Damiano, Erica Jong, Linda Lovelace, Norman Mailer, Gore Vidal, John Waters, Harry Reems, David Winters
description: The story of _Deep Throat_: shot in six days for $ 25,000, it earned over $ 600 million despite being banned in 23 states. Directors, actors and intellectuals narrate that particular period in America by reconstructing the historical, social and political context that gave a boost to the porn industry and originated a real evolution of customs and consumption.
notes: Damiano's film was "obscured", tried, condemned, but in the meantime he had contributed to change the perception on many aspects of society: and it is precisely this charge of vitality that the two directors are able to restore to us in their investigation.

title: Uncut - Member Only
actors: Morena Ciotoli, Cristina Mazzuzzi, Franco Trentalance, Luisa Corleone
description: Ciccio is stuck in bed following the fracture of the pelvis. His only purpose is to find a woman to sneak into his bed. The situation becomes complicated when a policewoman arrives who questions him about the disappearance of his girlfriend and tells him that he is suspected of murder.
notes: Zarantonello knows a lot about provocation and talent: he demonstrates that he knows the profession and that he is a goliardic flirt with irony (the film consists of a still shot of about eighty minutes focused on Ciccio's penis). His intent is clear: through a very bizarre point of view, he lowers the camera just above Ozu height to stigmatize the phallocentricity of the world with a grin. Funny, even tinged with a yellow detour, the challenge runs along the tracks of the senses with delighted and pleased pleasure. Medal of valor for the "protagonist", the porn actor Franco Trentalance, who offers himself with stoic generosity.

title: I fatti della Banda della Magliana
actors: Francesco Pannofino, Roberto Brunetti, Fabio Grossi, Francesco Dominedò, Leo Gullotta
description: The birth, the splendor and the decline of the Banda della Magliana, which from 1975 to 1991 raged in Rome. The confession of the repentant Luciano Amodio calls into question his ex-comrades: everyone has their own truth to tell ...
notes: Despite some heaviness, Costantini's is an interesting film, especially from the point of view of language. The characters speak an exaggerated and hyper-realistic Roman style. A sort of "argot" like the one Le Breton and Simonin invented for the French criminal milieu of the 1950s. An overcoming of the "life and street" language of Pasolini's memory. Among the actors, also some Rebibbia inmates.

title: I leopardi di Churchill
actors: Richard Harrison, Frank Braña, Giacomo Rossi Stuart
description: At the outbreak of the Second World War, two British twins with a German mother split up. One enters the Wehrmacht with the rank of officer and is sent to the French front: during a fight near a dam on the Meuse, he is fatally shot by the Allies. The twin, who remained loyal to Great Britain, is contacted by the French partisans to take the place - as a spy - of his brother ...
notes: A decent plot for a war film from our home that does not often appear on TV. Few means, naive certain situations, but a genuine sense of adventure. And the action scenes are pretty good.

title: Penombra
actors: Domiziano Arcangeli, Carmen Di Pietro, Paola Senatore, Marcella Petri
description: Osvaldo and Maria, a pair of corrupt aristocrats, let themselves be involved in a game of eroticism and dissolution by Alessio, Maria's lover, and Carlotta, her twin.
notes: He touches the soft core, Bruno Gaburro, also thanks to the generosity of Paola Senatore, but he always stops for a moment before the lights come on. Red, of course.

title: The Store - Grandi magazzini
description: Advertising and marketing strategies, internal management, staff training, the multiple organizational aspects of an important business corporation such as Neiman-Marcus of Dallas. Even by observing the details, as Wiseman always does, one can grasp the general picture of contemporary America.

title: The Dead Will Tell
actors: Anne Heche, David Andrews, Eva Longoria, Michael Arata, Amanda Baker
description: Emily receives a precious jewel as a gift from her boyfriend. It is a very ancient ring, beautiful, of great value and with a mysterious light. Once inside, however, Emily begins to be haunted by strange visions, daydreams, nightmares. She sees the battered ghost of a woman asking her for help.
notes: As the director of _The last time I committed suicide_, _La Vendetta di Carter_, remake of the cult film starring Michael Caine and of the horror _Boogeyman_, a television film without infamy and without praise. In addition to Anne Heche, Eva Longoria, Gabrielle Solis from _Desperate Housewives - The secrets of Wisteria Lane_ also plays a part.

title: Landslide
actors: Vincent Spano, Alexandra Paul, Luke Eberl, Jaime Gomez
description: Mark Decker, recently separated from his wife, moves with his son to a new residential complex owned by his father-in-law. Due to the tremors generated by the explosives used in a nearby construction site, a gigantic landslide takes place that hits the complex causing it to collapse. Mark Decker, his son, father-in-law and most of the apartment occupants are trapped in the rubble and are desperately trying to find an exit. Outside, meanwhile, Emma, ??Mark's wife, helped by their friend Danny, tries to free her loved ones and discovers that the avalanche was not caused by a simple accident ...

title: Identity Theft: The Michelle Brown Story
actors: Kimberly Williams-Paisley, Annabella Sciorra, Jason London
description: In the United States, a person's identity is stolen every six minutes. When Michelle Brown goes to an office one day to fill out a simple business administration form, she has no idea that that paper will fall into the wrong hands. Since then, dozens of bills and bills to pay for purchases she has never made are delivered to her home and the woman, after realizing that someone has stolen her identity, is firmly determined to find the culprit. What she doesn't know, however, is that the troubles have only just begun for her ...
notes: Inspired by the true story of Michelle Brown, from which fifty thousand dollars were stolen.

title: Once Upon a Honeymoon
actors: Cary Grant, Ginger Rogers, Walter Slezak, Albert Dekker, Albert Bassermann
description: American radio commentator Pat O'Toole tries to expose the pro-Nazi activity of an Austrian baron and ends up falling in love with his wife, who is American like him. He follows the woman - and her noble but treacherous consort - for various European countries on the threshold of the Second World War. Their arrival seems to precede the invasion of the German troops and the escape is increasingly difficult for Pat, who will end up mistaken for a Jew ...
notes: Love story and espionage, comedy and tragedy, skilfully blended in an anti-Hitler farce which, in a then disputed passage, demonstrates how already in 1942 the horror of the concentration camps was at least partially known.

title: L.I.E.

title: Brucia, ragazzo brucia

Unable to adapt again to her family ménage, she decides to reveal everything to her husband and take back her life and her emotions but her husband's reaction will lead to a tragic ending.

title: La fine dell'innocenza
actors: Annie Belle, Felicity Devonshire, Ciro Ippolito, Charles Fawcett
description: The young Annie, who remained orphaned by childhood, leaves the college in which he has always lived together with his lover Michael, an ambiguous individual who passes through his father. Once you arrive in Hong Kong, the man is arrested during a party on charges of being a currency trafficker. Staying alone, Annie ends up under the protection of Angelo and Linda, a wealthy and unscrupulous couple who begins to the world of sex and swingers. After a series of murky adventures, Annie finds refuge at a Buddhist convent where he will be able to find in herself the strength to get rid of his torturers.

title: Amarsi male
actors: Susan Scott, Gianni Macchia, Micaela Pignatelli, Lucio Dalla
description: Anna, secretary of a rich industrialist with whom she has shared not only professional moments, falls in love with Carlo, the left-wing boyfriend of her boss's daughter and a young university student. Severing any relationship with her boss, Anna goes to live with Carlo and tries to provide for both of them when, faced with the absence of job opportunities, she slips into a world of prostitution and drugs. Carlo's right-wing brother will ask Carlo to start a relationship with the daughter of a powerful businessman in order to guarantee financial well-being for the rest of his life.

title: Amatemi
actors: Isabella Ferrari, Pierfrancesco Favino, Donatella Finocchiaro, Branko Duric, Marco Cocci
description: When Nina, 35 years old married for fifteen years, is left by her husband, she sinks into a loneliness made of sloppiness and happy memories until her birthday. That same night she meets a stranger who makes her discover a long-buried sexuality. It is for her the beginning of a new life that makes her open to the encounter with men and women.
notes: De Maria is not helped by a screenplay (where he is an accomplice), which is full of happy undeveloped intuitions. Isabella gives herself up, she lays bare in both directions, but she is a victim of the script and the words. If it had been silent, the film would have had its own why.

title: I Heart Huckabees
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Isabelle Huppert, Jude Law, Jason Schwartzman, Lily Tomlin, Mark Wahlberg, Naomi Watts
description: After a series of casual encounters with a mysterious doorman, Albert Markovski decides to turn to Bernard and Viviane Jaffe, the "existentialist detectives", who investigate the deep mysteries of their clients' lives. The two investigators thus highlight the conflicting relationship between Albert and Brad Stand, a young and rampant executive of the Huckabees, a popular department store chain. When Brad also hires the Jaffes, Albert loses faith in himself until he allies himself with the troubling French philosopher Catherine Vauban.
notes: Russell and his screenwriter thought they were taking philosophical themes and turning them into a farce or they imagined giving a satirical step to a comedy by overloading it with words to write in capital letters, knowing that they were squeezed by everyday use. Assuming either of these was the film's lead option, the result is a disaster garnished with an interesting cast left adrift.

title: Mysterious Skin
actors: Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brady Corbet, Elisabeth Shue, Michelle Trachtenberg, David Lee Smith, Richard Riehle, Michelle Trachtenberg, Bill Sage, Chris Mulkey, Lisa Long, Chase Ellison, George Webster, Rachael Nastassja Kraft, Riley McGuire, Ryan Stenzel
description: At eight years old, Brian wakes up in his basement with a bloody nose with no idea what happened. After this event he is afraid of the dark, he pees in bed, he has terrible nightmares. Years later, his quest to find out what happened leads him to Neil McCormick, a charming and cold boy. Together, the two shed light on their past.
notes: Araki always knows how to build dazzling moments: but it is the imagery of Mysterious Skin that disappoints, not its staging. Ecstasy Generation was much tougher about love, sex, adolescence, loneliness, finding somewhere else, and not trying to comfort anyone.

title: Coach Carter
actors: Samuel L. Jackson, Rob Brown, Robert Ri'chard, Rick Gonzalez, Antwon Tanner
description: Richmond High School hires King Carter as coach to revive the basketball team. Carter must first get the respect from the players and lead the team to victory. As a first rule, it requires children to have good academic results, under penalty of exclusion from the team. In this way it attracts the ire of everyone, including teachers and parents.
notes: There is little to say about the film: it's the usual win and lose stuff, with the tough coach taming the unruly black guys. Basketball games aren't very photogenic, and in fact you don't see many of them in the film; everything is rather entrusted to rough dynamics between stereotyped characters.

title: Saved!
actors: Jena Malone, Mandy Moore, Macaulay Culkin, Patrick Fugit, Heather Matarazzo, Eva Amurri
description: When Mary, a Baptist high school student, becomes pregnant, everyone turns their backs on her, including her best friend Hilary. Only a few students comfort her ...
notes: He wants to be unfair, Saved! by Brian Dannelly, and the savory, the cutting edge, especially in the context in which it was born, that is the contemporary youth comedy. Too bad it's just a red herring: Saved's order! it will not be traditional, but it is entirely normative.

title: Il silenzio dell'allodola
actors: Ivan Franek, Marco Baliani, Flavio Bucci, Anna Maria Gherardi, Roberto Ceccacci
description: Belfast, 1970s. Like many boys his age, Bobby Sands frequents the IRA, the armed wing of Sinn Fein. When arrested, he is forced to confess to a crime he did not commit ...
notes: The nobility of the chosen theme clashes with a stylistic choice that does not have confidence in itself. Proof of this is the excessive and cumbersome use of a soundtrack that sifts the repertoire of classical choirs by inserting them into every hole in the film. A shame. Because both the intense interpretation of Ivan Franek and the scenography - almost completely indoors - of a Brechtian theater, did not need to be underlined.

title: Godzilla, King of the Monsters!
actors: Raymond Burr, Takashi Shimura, Akira Takarada, Momoko Kochi
description: American journalist Steve Martin investigates a series of mysterious disasters that have occurred off the coast of Japan when he comes face to face with a powerful and terrifying creature that can easily reduce Tokyo to dust. All conventional weapons prove useless in trying to shoot it down but a scientist finds a solution, which would put the life of the entire Tokyo bay at risk.

title: Il magnifico texano
actors: Glenn Saxson, John Barracuda, Barbara Loy, Beny Deus, Gloria Osuna
description: A corrupt judge guides terror in a Mexican town. A young man, in love with his daughter, will restore order and peace.

title: Wimbledon
actors: Kirsten Dunst, Paul Bettany, Kyle Hyde, Robert Lindsay, Bernard Hill, Amanda Walker
description: Tennis player Peter Colt no longer has the ambition he once had and is relegated to 119th place in the world rankings. Fortunately for him, he meets Lizzie Bradbury, a young colleague, who helps him regain his confidence and focus to participate in the Wimbledon tournament.
notes: Not only does the film reserve no surprises, but it does not even have tension, vitality, self-irony, that easy pursuit towards a "happy ending" that can also be taken for granted, but that the narrators should at least sweat a little. Perhaps he suffers from the lack of writer Richard Curtis and his incisive and malevolent pen on the team.

title: Peau d'âne
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Jean Marais, Jacques Perrin, Delphine Seyrig

title: Shubun
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Yoshiko Yamaguchi, Yôko Katsuragi, Noriko Sengoku
description: Two photographers of the tabloid newspaper "Amour" photograph the painter Aoye and the singer Miyako in attitudes of apparent intimacy, while by chance they find themselves in the same room of a mountain hotel. Back in town, Aoye takes the newspaper to court and for this he relies on Hiruta, a hard-working lawyer full of financial problems and with a sick daughter. The man, however, is bribed by the editor of the newspaper who offers him a large sum to make Aoye lose the case. But during the last hearing of the trial there will be a twist ...
notes: More than the story of Aoye and Miyako Kurosawa interests Hiruta's path suffocated by his sense of guilt.

title: La lengua de las mariposas

actors: Ismail Hakki Taslak, Kadir Kaymaz, Fizuli Caferof, Mustafa Çoban, Gülayse Erkoc, Hasbiye Günay, Boncuk Yilmaz, Ahmet Ulucay
description: In the 1960s in Tepecik, a small Anatolian village, Mehmet and Recep, two little boys, worked one as a barber's boy and the other as a helper to a watermelon seller. They both go crazy for cinema and, at night, try to build an improvised projector in an abandoned barn under the gaze of the village madman One day, Recep meets Nezihe, a widow to whom he promises to bring watermelons every day. He thus gets to know the woman's two daughters, Nihal and Güler. During the visits, Recep falls in love with Nihal, who is indifferent to his attentions. The one who seems to be interested in him is Güler ...

title: Piazza pulita
actors: Tony Anthony, Adolfo Celi, Richard Conte, Corrado Gaipa, Lucretia Love

title: Black Cat
actors: Patrick Magee, Mimsy Farmer, David Warbeck, Al Cliver, Dagmar Lassander
description: Philadelphia, 1840: writer Edgar Allan Poe is in the throes of a desperate creative crisis, trying to drown in alcohol. As he struggles to give birth to a story, money is scarce and his wife Virginia's black cat haunts him. Will it destroy his life or inspire his most famous tale?

title: Come l'America
actors: Sabrina Ferilli, Massimo Ghini, Henry Czerny, Gioia Spaziani
description: Postwar period. Together with her sister Paola and her two children, Antonia leaves for Canada, where her husband is already located. But here the man has made another family. Thanks to Mario's help, Antonia tries to rebuild her life. The male child does not understand the choices of the mother and moves further and further away from her and from her being Italian. Paola dies of a clandestine abortion. After the story with Mario, Anna in the hospital where she works as a nurse meets a doctor: friendship becomes love ...
notes: Short version of the melò miniseries directed by the Frazzi brothers tailored for a Ferilli who plays thinking of Sophia Loren.

title: Maiden Voyage
actors: Casper Van Dien, Peter Elliott, Christopher Stollery, Danielle Cormack
description: Kyle Considine, a former police officer, is a consultant for a security company. His boss, Trevor, entrusts him with the task of taking care of the security service of a cruise ship. Since the assignment doesn't seem too demanding or dangerous, Kyle brings with him the 16-year-old son with whom he has had a stormy relationship since his divorce from his wife. As soon as the ship sails, however, a group of ferocious terrorists, captained by Damien, take the ship's three hundred passengers hostage and demand fifteen million dollars in exchange for their release. But they did the math without our man ...

title: Unleashed
country: France, United States, Great Britain, Hong Kong
actors: Jet Li, Morgan Freeman, Bob Hoskins, Kerry Condon, Vincent Regan, Dylan Brown
description: Danny was trained from an early age as an attack dog to become the ultimate weapon of Bart, an unscrupulous man. But when Danny meets Sam, a blind piano tuner and his niece Victoria, he discovers a hitherto unknown world.
notes: The film is fun, non-trivial, with pitiful dialogues (because Besson manages the subjects, minus the screenplays) and fights equal to the skill of Jet Li, who begins to be no longer very young and throws it more on pure acting. By earning it. Freeman, on the other hand, gives it his all, but we are too used to seeing him in other contexts to be credible in a pure action movie.

title: Layer Cake
actors: Daniel Craig, Colm Meaney, Michael Gambon, Sally Hawkins, Sienna Miller
description: A refined businessman got rich by trading cocaine and ecstasy. But when he decides it's time to retire to enjoy the illicit gains, he finds himself having to return two favors to evil boss Jimmy Price. The conquest of freedom is not as immediate as he thought ...
notes: You can't say the movie is bad, but you can't say it cares that much either. It is a pity that we have not opted for greater sobriety: there is even the feeling that too many open slopes are struggling to close. The cast, while Kenneth Cranham and Jamie Foreman are beyond any line, is still luxurious: Michael Gambon makes an impression and Daniel Craig is remarkable.

title: Being Julia
country: Canada, United States, Hungary, Great Britain
actors: Annette Bening, Jeremy Irons, Bruce Greenwood, Shaun Evans, Michael Gambon, Miriam Margolyes
description: London, 1938. The seductive Julia Lambert is at the peak of her success. But her successful career as a stage actress and her marriage to impresario Michael Gosselyn no longer satisfy her. When Tom Fennel, a younger man who prides himself on being her great admirer, enters her life, Julia embarks on a passionate relationship.
notes: What does theater have to do with cinema? It can be a rhetorical and idle question. It depends on your point of view. For István Szabó, who brought the camera to the tables of the stage in several phases of his career, one of the answers concerns that circle of masks to which everyone is invited or forced. From Somerset Maugham.

title: Haute tension
actors: Cécile De France, Maïwenn Le Besco, Philippe Nahon, Franck Khalfoun
description: Two inseparable friends, Marie and Alex, go to Marie's parents' country house to prepare for their next university exam. Soon the two girls discover that the place has become the hunting ground of a bloodthirsty murderer.
notes: Aja has seen all the horror that counts, but there is no stench of homework, nor of exam, nor of a chair. He plays with cunning, he is able to surprise, and he knows how to sink the knife into the flesh, into the senses, into fears and even into eroticism. Then he goes down heavy with the gore, treated in an excellent way by the revived Giannetto De Rossi: pay attention to the incredible use of a living room furniture. A true genre film, with the so-called. Having it.

title: Kansen
actors: Michiko Hada, Mari Hoshino, Tae Kimura, Yoko Maki, Kaho Minami
description: In a dirty, dark and unmanned hospital, a patient dies, disintegrating while under the knife. Dr. Akai begins investigating to isolate the virus that caused such a horror. In the meantime, however, the remains of the deceased ended up in the ventilation system of the institute and it is impossible to recover them.
notes: After the delusional _Hypnosis_, Ochiai moves away from the well-known territories of the post-_Ringu_ and turns the best hospital weird hybrid since _The Kingdom_. Inexpensive, without flashy tricks, but with an excellent elaboration of suspense and history, _Infection_ proves to be a lucid metaphor on the ethical weaknesses of man and on the responsibilities of work.

title: Gas
actors: Francesco Venditti, Lorenzo Balducci, Loretta Goggi, Paola Ranzoni, Sandro Giordano
description: Latina. In an abandoned shed, Francesco, Emiliano, Sandro, Monica and Laura are torturing a fifty-year-old whom they kidnapped during the night. The only one not infected by collective madness is Luca who at dawn, when the others are asleep, rescues the man, then waits for the others to wake up ...
notes: Between background noises and a clockwork orange, the descent into hell has its own desperate vitality, its screaming rhythm, its vocation to lose. Thanks to a disruptive script, a firm and willing direction to get out of the ghetto of the stage from which it comes, and a cast of young and angry comedians, among which Lorenzo Balducci and the surprising Moran Atias stand out.

title: Red Water
actors: Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson, Coolio, aimz Woolvett
description: Fisherman John Sanders moves to the Louisiana Bayou to win back his ex-wife, but business is not going well. Ice, a Caribbean drug dealer with his posse in tow, arrives in the area in search of a sunken treasure. A ferocious bull shark from the sea greatly complicates everyone's business.

title: Sulla mia pelle
actors: Stefano Cassetti, Ivan Franek, Vincenzo Peluso, Donatella Finocchiaro, Mario Scarpetta
description: After three years in prison, Tony gets semi-release and finds a job in the Cimarosa dairy. He soon realizes that the owners are facing a difficult situation. Alfonso, the owner's son, has contracted a large financial debt and Bianca, the granddaughter in charge of the company, must find a way not to close the dairy.
notes: A crude and obvious melodrama, in which you already know immediately where you are going to end up, all the masks are fake and the script gets jammed. Discreet performance of the actors, sometimes a little over the top. As usual, the powerful Donatella Finocchiaro stands out.

title: Carmen
actors: Leonardo Sbaraglia, Paz Vega, Antonio Dechent, Joan Crosas, Jay Benedict
description: Spain, 1830. The writer Mérimée, passionate about archeology, goes to the south of Spain for some research. Here he meets José and his beautiful partner Carmen who tell him their tormented love story marked by passion and death ...
notes: Behind this vehicle for the beautiful Paz Vega, discovered in Lucia y el sexo, there is nothing to do with Bizet's famous work. Aranda, an expert professional on the verge of eighty years (The bloodstained wedding dress, Amantes), stages with a certain richness in the reconstruction and a not very fast pace. The actors are not up to par, starting with the protagonist.

title: Contronatura
actors: Andrea Di Stefano, Valeria Cavalli, Maya Sansa, Federico Scribani Rossi, Cesare Bocci
description: Giacomo is a loner who moves in a timeless world. Aware of the risk she runs, Francesca does not reject the attraction she feels for him ...
notes: The intentions of the newcomer Tofanelli are noble, but they do not deal with a script that leaks and fails to avoid embarrassing and not very credible situations.

title: Le papillon
actors: Claire Bouanich, Michel Serrault, Nade Dieu, Françoise Michaud
description: Elsa is an eight-year-old girl who dreams of spending her free time at the cinema with her mother. Instead, he will find himself accompanying the elder Julien on a scientific expedition in search of a rare butterfly. During the day the two will make a beautiful friendship.
notes: Film full of tenderness and humor.

title: My Summer of Love
actors: Nathalie Press, Emily Blunt, Paddy Considine, Dean Andrews
description: Mona lives with her brother Phil who, prior to her encounter with the faith and giving up alcohol, ran a pub in a Yorkshire town. Mona's best friend is Tamsit, a rich and spoiled girl who leads a decadent and transgressive life. An intense friendship begins between the two, destined to turn into falling in love.
notes: The two protagonists and the out-of-tune and saturnine Phil are macerated in a summer intoxication in which love and belief run on parallel tracks. All three are waiting for some chance of rebirth and the end of that seasonal dance in a timeless landscape, where nature has taken over in a post-industrial age.

title: Horse Sense
actors: Joseph Lawrence, Andrew Lawrence, Susan Walters, M.C. Gainey
description: The teenager Michael who, recently lost his father, decides to leave the ranch where he lives with his mother to go to his cousin in Los Angeles. He, attracted only by women and beautiful cars, ends up neglecting him. Disappointed Michael returns home to his mother, but something is about to happen that will change his life and that of his cousin.

title: Batman Begins
actors: Christian Bale, Michael Caine, Liam Neeson, Cillian Murphy, Morgan Freeman, Gary Oldman, Ken Watanabe, Katie Holmes
description: After witnessing the brutal murder of his parents, young Bruce Wayne travels the world trying to understand how injustices can be fought. Once back in Gotham City, he becomes Batman, a masked hero who uses strength, intelligence and every other means available to counter the forces of Evil that threaten the city.
notes: What seems like a long opening is actually the heart of darkness of the film, where some moments of fear, emotion, premonition are welded with the phantasmagoric hardness of the ninja training to which Bruce is subjected, with the descent into the depths of his own soul.

title: Holy Lola
actors: Jacques Gamblin, Isabelle Carré, Bruno Putzulu, Lara Guirao, Frédéric Pierrot, Maria Pitarresi
description: Pierre and Géraldine intend to adopt a Cambodian girl, but the local bureaucracy is infested with corruption. To succeed in their intent, the young couple will face a journey destined to change their lives forever.
notes: Tavernier denounces the adoption "market" and recounts, with Rossellinian respect and discretion, the present of a country where the memory of the horrors of the Khmer Rouge has not faded. The pressing and admirable film is neither a controversial television investigation file nor a generic docu-fiction: the style and form reflect a moral point of view. Tavernier's daughter Tiffany collaborated on the script.

title: Samaria
actors: Kwak Ji-min, Seo Min-jeong, Lee Eol
description: The very young Yeo-Jin and Jae-Yeong organize a prostitution ring via the Internet. Jae-Yeong's tragic death leads Yeo-Jin to make a decision that will upset his life and that of his father, a widowed policeman ...
notes: Beyond the "themes" it raises, Kim's film dissects a gray world, invaded by fear; and affects blood relations that suddenly reveal incurable unsuitability, attempting the impossible elaboration of a mourning: that of the death of morality. An excruciating lucidity and humanity emerge, which give goosebumps and do not offer easy answers to "bigger than life" questions.

title: Garden State
actors: Zach Braff, Kenneth Graymez, Ian Holm, Peter Sarsgaard, Natalie Portman
description: Upon news of his mother's death, Andrew Largeman returns to his hometown in New Jarsey from which he left nine years earlier due to disagreements with his father. Once home, he immediately realizes that despite his distance and his career as a television actor in Los Angeles, things have not changed.
notes: The rites of passage of age are no longer first-hand materials but the new director, helped by good actors (Peter Sarsgaard, Ian Holm, Jean Smart) and a discreet script mixed with lucid humor and non-pessimistic disenchantment, manages to lead us to Garden State in the company of the protagonist. History opens glimmers without closing them, dominated by the cumbersome question that has no answer: "And now?".

title: Connie and Carla
actors: Nia Vardalos, Toni Collette, David Duchovny, Stephen Spinella, Robert Kaiser
description: Connie and Carla, two provincial girls, want to become stars of the show, but they are far from seeing their dream come true. When they accidentally witness the murder of their employer, they must leave their city as soon as possible and build a new identity. They travel to Los Angeles where they find work in a drag queen show.
notes: The film is an explicit retelling of Wilder's _Some Like It Hot_, plus Blake Edwards's _Victor Victoria_, a touch of Barbra Streisand's _Yentl_ and a succession of musical hits revisited en travesti. Fortunately for him (and ours) he does not pretend to be anything more.

title: Nicholas Nickleby
country: United States, Great Britain, Germany, Netherlands
actors: Charlie Hunnam, Stella Gonet, Andrew Havill, Henry McGrath
description: Young Nicolas and his family enjoy a comfortable life until his father dies, leaving the heirs penniless. Nicolas, his sister and mother, then leave for London to seek the help of Uncle Ralph, whose intentions are not as good as they hope.

title: Une vraie jeune fille
actors: Charlotte Alexandra, Hiram Keller, Rita Meiden, Bruno Balp

title: L'adolescente
actors: Daniela Giordano, Tuccio Musumeci, Sonia Viviani, Marcello Martana
description: A Sicilian, married for interest, pours his sexual attentions elsewhere, the same goes for his wife. Between the two slips a busty niece who aims (for money) to separate her uncles. The girl will scandalize the country by telling everyone about the erotic "exploits" of the family.

title: Dracula 3000
actors: Casper Van Dien, Erika Eleniak, Coolio, Alexandra Kamp-Groeneveld

title: Gypsy
actors: Rosalind Russell, Natalie Wood, Karl Malden, Paul Wallace

title: La ragazza dei lillà
actors: Laurent Terzieff, Mario Adorf, Mimsy Farmer, Memé Perlini, Pascale De Boysson

title: Hanna D. - La ragazza del Vondel Park
actors: Ann-Gisel Glass, Sebastiano Somma, Antonio Serrano, Karin Schubert, Donatella Damiani, Jacques Stany
description: Amsterdam. Hanna is a teenager forced into prostitution to support her mother and earn her daily dose of drugs. Convinced that she can get out of the tunnel without too many problems, she will sink into a dead end cheat until the day she meets a person who will forever change her destiny and her life.

title: La ragazza del vagone letto
actors: Silvia Dionisio, Werner Pochath, Zora Kerova, Carlo De Mejo, Venantino Venantini

title: La ragazza di via Veneto
actors: Anna Maria Moneta Caglio, Carlo Giustini, Giulio Calì, Arturo Bragaglia, Carlo Delle Piane, Gisella Monaldi
description: Two boyfriends of modest conditions want to see their aspirations realized at all costs: she wants to become a model and an actress, he a boxing champion. Fortune initially seems to smile more at the girl, who is noticed by a producer, but the future husband puts a spoke in the wheel ...
notes: Naive playwright.

title: Fratella e sorello
actors: Claudio Amendola, Rolando Ravello, Ida Di Benedetto, Youma Diakite, Laura Betti
description: Giocondo and Serpente are two Roman losers: they know each other in prison, and once out they remain friends to the point of sleeping together. The arrival of the wife of one or the lover of the other gives them moments of fear ...
notes: A very tender work on the fear of women, not so beautiful as honest. As Citti liked it.

title: Ha-kala ha-surit
actors: Hiam Abbass, Makram Khoury, Clara Khoury, Ashraf Barhoum
description: Mona is about to marry Tallel, a star of Syrian television. For her it is the worst day of her life because once she crosses the border between Israel and Syria she will no longer be able to visit her family who live in the Golan Heights, occupied by the Israelis since 1967.
notes: Marriage when it is not broken down into scenes of a betrayed, neglected and finished love remains an excellent device for brilliant comedies. The ethnic dimension is a now worn variant of the vein. The farewell is made paradoxical by the dullness and senseless rigidity of the two fronts, by the stupid ballets of stamps and permits. Humor does not erase the sufferings and contradictions of the power of borders.

title: Hwal
actors: Han Yeo-Reum, Jeon Sung-Hwan, Seo Si-jeok
description: An elderly man brings a six-year-old girl who has been orphaned to live with him on a fishing boat. The man decides that he will marry the girl on her seventeenth birthday. But the meeting with a boy and the tender friendship that arises between the two young people undermines the balance that has been created.
notes: This time Kim stretches her strings too much. The final panism, during the celebration and relative pagan transubstantiation, is decidedly tacky, when _The island - Seom_ had already said everything, and with a very different effectiveness. And then, the more it proceeds, the more _The arch_ twists on itself, touching the ridiculous.

title: Factotum
actors: Matt Dillon, Lili Taylor, Fisher Stevens, Marisa Tomei, Didier Flamand
description: Henry Chinaski lives in Los Angeles and constantly changes jobs, because after a while he is inevitably fired. He would like to be able to dedicate himself only to what really interests him: women, alcohol, horse racing and above all the stories he writes ...
notes: From a novel by the great Charles Bukowski, a small film in its own angry way. The anger it takes to stay attached to life, despite the excessively swallowed alcohol and the days that go by burning one job after another. That Chinaski is played by a former rebel may seem inappropriate: but Dillon's decay isn't too artificial either, and in the end it applauds.

title: Geminis
actors: Christina Banegas, Daniel Fanego, Lucas Escariz, Lucrecia Capello
description: The Gadiz are a middle-class family where everything seems to be fine, but where in reality the control has been lost for some time, or perhaps it has never been. This is how no one has noticed that the two teenage sons - Jeremias and Meme - have an incestuous relationship. It will be their older brother Ezequiel, who has just returned from Spain, to find out.

title: La moustache
actors: Hippolyte Girardot, Vincent Lindon, Mathieu Amalric, Emmanuelle Devos
description: Marc decides to cut his mustache after wearing it for over a decade, but no one seems to notice the difference. What seems like a joke becomes a "nightmare" when everyone claims that Marc never had a mustache ...
notes: Subtly disturbing, _L'amore suspetto_ recounts typically masculine pathways of anxiety with icy precision. Interest is assumed to be upstream from appearance, but in reality no one escapes the induced desire to be seen. The film, it must be said, has its own charm above all in the excellent performance of the actors, in particular of Lindon, who opens glimmers to his anguish only with impassivity.

title: Odete
actors: Ana Cristina De Oliveira, João Carreira, Teresa Madruga, Nuno Gil

title: Travaux, on sait quand ça commence...
actors: Carole Bouquet, Jean-Pierre Castaldi, Aldo Maccione, Marcial Di Fonzo, Françoise Brion, Didier Flamand
description: Chantal Letellier is a socially committed lawyer. The woman tries to help a young Colombian architect to obtain a residence permit as soon as possible and he, out of gratitude, offers her to take care of the renovation of his house. To help him, many non-EU workers flock to him, obviously also illegal immigrants ...
notes: He would like to have the lightness of a Resnais-style comedy and instead is as heavy as indigestion at a freezing rally. It's as far-fetched, as embarrassing as his musical moments. A single dead time waiting for something that at least makes you smile. Only the grace and self-irony of Carole Bouquet are saved.

title: Wolf Creek
actors: John Jarratt, Cassandra Magrath, Andy McPhee, Kestie Morassi
description: Liz, Kristy and Ben travel by car to discover the Australian outback. After a hike in Wolf Creek National Park, the three discover that their car does not start. Unexpected help comes from a tow truck driven by Mick, who offers to repair the car, after taking it to his workshop. Once there, the boys fall asleep around a bonfire, while the mechanic begins to work. But when Liz wakes up she finds herself bound and gagged. It is the beginning of the nightmare.
notes: Inspired by a series of violent events that bloodied the Australian outback in the 1990s, _Wolf Creek_ is a beautiful realistic horror that thankfully owes more to Tobe Hooper's Don't Open That Door than _The Blair Witch Project_. Newcomer Greg McLean (director and screenwriter) knows how to handle suspense well (and uses the first half of the film to build, with an almost documentary style, a disturbing atmosphere) and knows how to dose surprise and violence. Which is a lot, bad and not consoling.

title: Istoriya Asi Klyachinoy, kotoraya lyubila, da ne vyshla zamuzh
actors: Iya Savvina, Lyubov Sokolova, Aleksandr Sirin, Mikhail Kislov
description: In the Soviet Union of the sixties in a community of poor peasants under the rule of an authoritarian dwarf lives Asja Kljacina, a beautiful blonde girl but slightly lame. Asja finds herself torn between two men: Stepan, a gross selfish from whom she is expecting a child but who has no intention of marrying her, and a tractor driver who has come from the city for the annual harvest, who would instead be willing to marry her despite being pregnant with another.

title: I Married a Witch
actors: Fredric March, Veronica Lake, Robert Benchley, Susan Hayward

title: La novia esangrentada
actors: Simon Andreu, Alexandra Bastedo, Monteserrat Julió, Maribel Martín, Ángel Lombarte

title: Melody
actors: Jack Wild, Mark Lester, Tracy Hyde, Roy Kinnear, Billy Franks

title: Ci sposeremo a Capri
actors: Tina Pica, Franco Sportelli, Enzo Turco, Rocco D'Assunta, Mario Siletti
description: Raffaele and Pasquale, already very close friends, have become enemies since Pasquale opened a betting shop at the Totocalcio in the district where the Raffaele lottery box office is located. But it happens that Raffaele jr., Raffaele's nephew and Maria, Pasquale's daughter, love each other and that a family friend fosters their passion.
notes: Harmless Neapolitan comedy.

title: Un monsieur de compagnie
actors: Jean-Pierre Cassel, Catherine Deneuve, Annie Girardot, Sandra Milo, Jean-Claude Brialy, Irina Demick, Adolfo Celi
description: Antoine, a young man allergic to work and with a passion for idleness, has his model of life in his grandfather. When the old man dies, he makes friends with an ice cream man and his friend, who ask him to work with them, putting him on the run. He ends up hosted by a young nobleman, a maniac of electric trains, and leaves by train for Rome where he works as a model in an atelier and makes friends with five beautiful sisters. After further travels, he falls in love with a female worker and starts working alongside her in the factory. He feels like he's living a nightmare, and in fact ...
notes: An animated comedy, with a French cast of great luxury, but overall little incisive.

title: 976-EVIL II: The Astral Factor
actors: Brigitte Nielsen, Patrick O'Bryan, René Assa, Debbie James

title: The Naked Face
actors: Roger Moore, Rod Steiger, Anne Archer, Elliott Gould, Art Carney

title: The Human Factor
actors: Nicol Williamson, Richard Attenborough, Iman, Robert Morley, Derek Jacobi, John Gielgud
description: Morris Castle, a distinguished and respectable British intelligence officer, has been a KGB mole for several years. The man did not allow himself to be persuaded for money or an ideological question, but because he was indebted to a Russian spy who saved his family. Despite doing his job in the best possible way, Morris fears that his beautiful wife Sarah will become the victim of reprisals.
notes: Otto Preminger draws his latest work from Graham Greene's novel of the same name and writes it together with Tom Stoppard. The film is weighed down by an excessive use of flashbacks that end up slowing down the narrative.

title: Four Faces West
actors: Joel McCrea, Frances Dee, Charles Bickford, William Conrad

title: Out of Reach
actors: Steven Seagal, Ida Nowakowska, Agnieszka Wagner, Matt Schulze
description: In this thriller, men with no morals trafficking in human beings choose the wrong girl to exploit and discover that her best friend is a fighting machine ready for revenge. Billy Ray Lancing (Steven Segal) is a former American secret agent who retired to seek some peace by living alone in contact with nature. However, Lancing began a close correspondence over the internet with Irena (Ida Nowakowska), an orphaned teenager living in Poland; they often exchange messages, and Lancing uses her letters to help her learn to read code. When Irena's letters stop arriving, and Lancing receives strange messages saying she won't contact him again, he becomes suspicious and leaves for Poland. Here, Lancing makes the shocking discovery that the humanitarian organization for orphaned children he had supported is nothing more than an international network for sexual exploitation. Working with Polish law enforcement, Lancing manages to find Irena and the other orphans before it's too late, and uses his long experience to catch the traffickers and his coding skills to keep in touch with Irena. .

title: Per un dollaro a Tucson si muore
actors: Benny Reeves, Ronny de Marc, Gisèle Sandré, Mary Grace Manes

title: Il compromesso... erotico - Ménage a quattro
actors: Pupo De Luca, Ria De Simone, Armando Marra, Alfredo D'Ippolito

title: Candido erotico
actors: Fernando Cerulli, Lilli Carati, Mircha Carven, María Baxa, Ajita Wilson

title: San Babila ore 20: un delitto inutile
actors: Daniele Asti, Pietro Giannuso, Giuliano Cesareo, Brigitte Slay
description: Milan, 1970s. Fabrizio, Franco and Marco and Alfredo, young neo-fascists returning from the funeral of an old hierarch, decide to make a punctual expedition against the "reds" of the Beccaria high school. Later, after a stop in a bar in Piazza San Babila, they pick up a girl and rape her, beat a striker, plan an attack on a union office and finally kill a couple of Communist boyfriends. It will be the rape victim who will have the courage to testify against them.
notes: Lizzani almost shoots a reportage on the phenomenon of the new right of the 70s. However, the narrative structure is a bit too confusing.

title: Der Dirnenmörder von London
actors: Klaus Kinski, Josephine Chaplin, Herbert Fux, Lina Romay
description: In Victorian London, a serial killer wanders about claiming victims among prostitutes.
notes: Yet another reinterpretation of the story of Jack the Ripper, the film offers a slender plot where sex exploitation and gore are the masters. _Erotic deep_ is based almost exclusively on the skill of Klaus Kinski.

title: The Fluffer
actors: Johnny Rebel, Michael Cunio, Babylon, Taylor Negron, Richard Riehle

title: Drumline
actors: Nick Cannon, Zoë Saldana, Orlando Jones, Leonard Roberts
description: Devon is a Harlem percussionist who wins a scholarship to attend college. His talent draws the attention of the school's musical director, Dr. Lee, who puts his students' appreciation of tradition above the popularity of being part of the college band. Devon's self-centered attitude doesn't make him sympathetic to Lee and percussion leader, Sean. He feels threatened by his qualities and behaviors: therefore, when he learns that Devon cannot read music, he tries to put him in difficulty ...
notes: Unusual film about marching bands.

title: Le notti erotiche dei morti viventi
actors: Laura Gemser, George Eastman, Mark Shannon, Dirce Funari

title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
actors: Will Ferrell, Christina Applegate, Paul Rudd, Steve Carell, David Koechner
description: San Diego, 1970s: host Ron Burgundy is the "dominant male" of local TV. With the arrival of the ambitious presenter Veronica Corningstone, feminism appears in the newsroom, but it does not seem to threaten its primacy, at least as long as it is limited to programs "for ladies" and is seduced by the charm of Ron. But when he overrides it in the conduct of the news, a war between the sexes opens, no holds barred ...
notes: Not happy with his first feature, McKay shot the sequel (_Wake Up, Ron Burgundy: The Lost Movie_) the same year. Steve Carell (_40 years a virgin_) appears in the role of Brick Tamland, naive meteorologist.

title: Seminò morte... lo chiamavano il castigo di Dio!
actors: Brad Harris, José Torres, Vassili Karis, Franco Pasquetto, Emilio Messina, Maretta Procaccini, Roberto Messina
description: A man whose entire family was exterminated takes revenge by killing all the murderers one after the other.

title: Inseminoid
actors: Stephanie Beacham, Robin Clarke, Jennifer Ashley, Steven Grives
description: In a space laboratory, a researcher is raped by an alien and becomes pregnant with two monsters.
notes: British Warren's vintage and anxiety-provoking fantahorror is a clumsy plagiarism of _Alien_ in a sexy sauce. Low-budget exploitation, with effects and _camp_ a go go. Only for lovers of the genre.

title: I jomfruens tegn
actors: Ole Søltoft, Sigrid Horne-Rasmussen, Bent Warburg, Mette Von Kohl

title: La bella Antonia prima monica e poi dimonia
actors: Edwige Fenech, Piero Focaccia, Riccardo Garrone, Dada Gallotti
description: The painter Claudio Fornaci loves love: on the one hand he amuses himself with the women of the village, on the other he helps two lovers, Antonia and Folco, whose union is hindered by their respective fathers.
notes: Farce full of free digressions, more modest than in similar films. Focaccia sings _La pantanda_ on the opening and closing credits.

title: No Nukes
directors: Daniel Goldberg, Anthony Potenza, Julian Schlossberg

title: Flesh and Fantasy
actors: Charles Boyer, Barbara Stanwyck, Edward G. Robinson, Betty Field, Robert Cummings

title: L'enfant de nuit
actors: Jean Claude Bouillon, Stefano Satta Flores, Agostina Belli, Antonio Cantafora

title: Fängelse
actors: Doris Svedlund, Birger Malmsten, Eva Henning, Hasse Ekman

title: Ghost Story
actors: Fred Astaire, Melvyn Douglas, John Houseman, Douglas Fairbanks jr., Craig Wasson, Alice Krige
description: Students Ricky, John, Edward and Sears are in love with the young and uninhibited Brit Eva. One evening, during a party at her home, they tragically cause her death. Fifty years later, the four friends create a sect and spend their days telling macabre stories: they do not imagine, however, that Eve is preparing to return to carry out her revenge ...
notes: Full of distressing sequences and particularly successful "horrifying" gimmicks, the film nevertheless remains a macabre tale of the dead returning for revenge, as many, perhaps too many, have already been seen. The cast of old glories works, but Irvin fails to make the leap.

title: Itinéraire d'un enfant gâté
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Richard Anconina, Marie Sofie L., Lio
description: Sam Lion, abandoned as a child by his mother and adopted by a circus family, raised among lions and elephants, has become a very skilled acrobat. Following an accident at work, forced to carry out another activity, in a short time he manages to create the cleaning company VICTORIA, a multinational of primary importance. Lost in a car accident his beloved wife Yvette, with whom he had Jean Philippe, a son of homosexual tendencies, Sam from his subsequent marriage to Corinne became the father of Victoria with whom, now of age, he usually confides. Now fifty years old and tired of success, Sam, having left on his yacht for a solitary voyage, makes himself believe dead. Accidentally recognized by his former employee, Al Duvivier, and having learned from this that his business empire is in crisis, Sam Lion returns in disguise to Paris and, with Al's help, manages to save his company. Succeeded in his intent, after having been recognized by Victoria, he returns to Africa to live in freedom with animals.

title: La cité des enfants perdus
actors: Ron Perlman, Daniel Emilfork, Judith Vittet, Dominique Pinon
description: In a surreal future world, the terrible and monstrous Krank cannot dream. Thus he decides to kidnap the children of the nearby town to steal their dreams. One day he kidnaps little Denree, One's adoptive brother, a man not very intelligent, but extremely good. One sets out on the boy's trail and discovers the evil Krank's plans.
notes: Directors Caro and Jeunet had already worked together with the visionary _Delicatessen_ and from their previous film they take up the dark and disturbing atmospheres, without forgetting the imagery of Jules Verne. Dickens' influence is also found in the orphanage sequences. The film is a grotesque futuristic French carnival.

title: I diafanoidi vengono da Marte
actors: Tony Russell, Lisa Gastoni, Franco Nero, Carlo Giustini, Michel Lemoine, Enzo Fiermonte, Linda Sini
description: The solar system is invaded by aliens, evanescent and greenish beings made only of light. They settle on Mars, which they transform into their base, and launch an attack on Earth's space stations, killing or hypnotizing crew members. Their goal is the conquest of planet Earth. But the Grounders, led by the valiant commander Mike Halstead, send a fleet on a mission to destroy the Martian base.
notes: The means available to Italian science fiction cinema have never been stratospheric, and the film certainly suffers from this condition. The film is one of four in the Gemma 1 series, shot by Margheriti, an artisan of Italian genre cinema.

title: Viaje al vacío
actors: Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Teresa Gimpera, Jack Stuart, Larry Ward

title: The Harder They Come
actors: Jimmy Cliff, Janet Barkley, Carl Bradshaw, Ras Daniel Hartman
description: Young Ivan Martin leaves his very poor country village to move to Kingston, where he dreams of becoming a successful singer. In the capital, however, the harsh laws of the record market and a cruel fate await him ...
notes: Cliff, one of the prophets of reggae, in a must-see classic for fans of the genre.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
actors: Alfred Molina, Meredith Baxter, Leslie Caron, Amira Casar, Nicolas Chagrin
description: The famous Belgian investigator Hercule Poirot returns from Istanbul to London aboard the prestigious Orient Express. At one point, a boulder placed on the tracks blocks the convoy: in the commotion, a passenger is found dead, stabbed nine times. The culprit is still on the train, and it will be up to Poirot to unmask him ...

title: Crash Landing
actors: Brandon Barash, John Beck, Robert Clotworthy, John J. Dalesandro
description: Expelled from the army ten years earlier (accused of causing a plane crash), Roger Masters makes ends meet by piloting a charter that transports tourists to Hawaii. The routine is interrupted when some mercenaries attack his aircraft, determined to kidnap the daughter of the owner of the company ...

title: Premonition
actors: Casper Van Dien, Catherine Oxenberg, Paul Anthony, Cam Cronin, Lorena Gale, Colin Lawrence
description: Not yet thirty, Officer Jack Barnes has already been appointed detective; and in addition to his career, his private life is also booming: a beautiful wife, adorable children, a luxurious home. But in a moment everything collapses: after a terrible accident, Jack begins to have visions that herald imminent catastrophes ...

title: Les compères
actors: Pierre Richard, Gérard Depardieu, Anny Duperey, Michel Aumont
description: To help bring home her son Tristan, who has cut the rope, Christine makes two of her former lovers - the shy teacher François Pignon and the rude journalist Jean Lucas - believe that she is the boy's real parent ...
notes: The scheme is consolidated, but the times are right and the alchemy between the protagonists works. The film will be remade in Hollywood in 1997 by Ivan Reitman (_Two fathers too much_), with Robin Williams and Billy Crystal; meanwhile, Veber shot - again with the couple Richard-Depardieu - _Due fugitives and a half_ (1986) and its American remake, _Fugitives for three_ (1989), with Nick Nolte and Martin Short.

title: Domani passo a salutare la tua vedova... parola di Epidemia
actors: Craig Hill, Claudie Lange, Pedro Sanchez, Chris Huerta, Carlo Gaddi
description: Two criminals rob a bank, but are in turn robbed: the search for the loot proceeds with difficulty, around the circle of organized crime. But the company will be long and tiring, due to the unexpected intrusion of bandits of all sorts ...
notes: Italian-Spanish Western (the full title reads _... word of Epidemia_) of uncertain authorship: according to the credits it is the work of John Wood (alias Juan Bosch), other sources attribute it to Ignacio F. Iquino. Mediocre product of a series B vein very popular at the time, which gave rise to western by-products of every quality, some well made and others (this) definitely to be avoided. Unwatchable actors.

title: Kiss Tomorrow Goodbye
actors: Barton McLane, James Cagney, Barbara Payton, Ward Bond, Luther Adler

title: Voices
actors: David Hemmings, Gayle Hunnicutt, Lynn Farleigh, Adam Bridge

title: Domani è troppo tardi
actors: Anna Maria Pierangeli, Gino Leurini, Vittorio De Sica, Lois Maxwell, Lauro Gazzolo, Carlo Romano, Olga Solbelli

title: Inginocchiati straniero... i cadaveri non fanno ombra!
actors: Hunt Powers, Chet Davis, Simone Blondel, Gordon Mitchell, Ettore Manni
description: Lazar Peacock, an unscrupulous bounty hunter, arrives in Palo Pinto, a town on the border of Mexico where Barrett, owner of a gold mine, is king. Having recognized, in the guise of Barrett, the notorious bandit Billy Ring, on whose head hangs a large bounty, Lazar blackmails him, managing to obtain the payment of one hundred thousand dollars in gold. When Barrett, backed by his men, tries to recover the sum paid, Lazar accepts the collaboration of an unknown gunslinger, recently arrived in Palo Pinto. Managed to escape the ambush of Barrett's men with the help of the gunslinger, Lazar also tries to get rid of the occasional companion.

title: Fangio
actors: Juan Manuel Fangio
description: The career of the great Formula 1 driver Juan Manuel Fangio, winner of five world titles, retraced by the words and thoughts of the same protagonist.
notes: A documentary of rare truth and beauty: spectator of his own life, Fangio relives the victories and defeats, the pomp and glories of an extraordinary career, adding anecdotes and comments. And the races become a metaphor for a life always lived on the limit, an adrenaline-pumping obstacle race that, when not on the road, crowd the lanes of existence. More courage or more recklessness? The answer does not exist; there is the burning force of a passion lived to the end.

title: Fango bollente
actors: Joe Dallesandro, Gianfranco De Grassi, Guido De Carli, Carmen Scarpitta, Martine Brochard, Enrico Maria Salerno
description: Ovidio Mainardi is, apparently, a quiet employee in charge of electronic computers in a large company. The monotony of work, the existential loneliness of a badly arranged marriage, where for the wife, more than the husband, the career counts, pushes Ovid, with two other partners, to let off steam in acts of vandalism and cruel cynicism, which manifests itself in a series of crimes, real outbursts of raw sadism. It will be an old retired police commissioner, "Santagà", who will understand that the crimes have no political, but "ecological" motives.

title: Valerie a tyden divu
actors: Jaroslava Schallerová, Helena Anyzova, Jan Klusák, Karel Engel
description: The complicated events of Valerie, a thirteen year old who lives in her grandmother's house, and who is at the center of a series of events involving vampires, spells, transformations and discoveries.

title: Phantasm
actors: Angus Scrimm, Reggie Bannister, Michael Baldwin, Bill Thornbury

title: I fantastici 3 supermen
actors: Brad Harris, Tony Kendall, Gloria Paul, Nick Jordan, Jochen Brockmann
description: The evil Golem has invented a machine that duplicates both banknotes and humans. To stop him, the secret services "enlist" two robbery masters and join them alongside Brad, a brave FBI agent.
notes: The incredible public success achieved by this trashy comic trio generated seven sequels.

title: The Phantom Planet
actors: Dean Fredericks, Coleen Gray, Tony Dexter, Francis X. Bushman

title: Le vieil homme et l'enfant
actors: Michel Simon, Roger Carel, Paul Préboist, Alain Cohen, Jacqueline Rouillard

title: War of the Worlds
actors: Tom Cruise, Dakota Fanning, Justin Chatwin, Tim Robbins, Miranda Otto
description: After a long time, divorced Ray Ferrier is about to spend a weekend with children Robbie and Rachel. Suddenly, however, a strange device emerges from the ground and incinerates everything it encounters: it is the beginning of the attack of the aliens on Earth. In general panic, Ray tries to save his children ...
notes: The first part - with the spectacular structure of the conflict, the crescendo of fear, insecurity and death, the apocalyptic visions, the close succession of accidents and catastrophes - is more interesting, compelling and "cinematic" than the other core of the story: the discomfort of a father who does not know how to be paternal, authoritative and reassuring.

title: The Notebook
actors: Gena Rowlands, Ryan Gosling, James Garner, Tim Ivey, Rachel McAdams
description: 1940s, North Carolina. Annie Hamilton, on vacation with her wealthy family, meets Noah Calhoun, a simple worker. The two have a passionate relationship and, after the summer, when they have to separate it is a tragedy for both of them. Years later they reunite: the girl, who has never forgotten her first love, is about to marry Lon, but she knows that first she must definitively close the Noah chapter.
notes: Nick Cassavetes is very different from his father John: he makes classic cinema, on the edge of academia. But the pages of our life can be seen without difficulty, and the tear is always lurking.

title: Ice Princess
actors: Hayden Panettiere, Joan Cusack, Kim Cattrall, Michelle Trachtenberg, Trevor Blumas
description: 17-year-old Casey Carlyle dreams of becoming a "princess of the ice slopes". However, her mother would like to see her enrolled in Harvard's mathematics and physics faculty. Casey decides to present an admissions experiment that applies elements of physics to figure skating figures. To prove his theory, he starts attending the team trained by a former figure skating star, who will soon become his teacher.
notes: Teen movie between _Cinderella_ and _They will be famous_ without real conflicts or problems that are not trivial stereotypes. You look more at the costumes than at the characters.

title: Because of Winn Dixie
actors: Jeff Daniels, Cicely Tyson, AnnaSophia Robb, Eva Marie Saint, Dave Matthews
description: Ten-year-old Opal has just moved to Florida and feels very lonely: her mother left home years ago and her father, a Protestant pastor, often disagrees. One day, at the supermarket, Opal meets a stray dog ??that she decides to take home. Thanks to the puppy, he will meet a number of extravagant characters ...
notes: Poor director Wayne Wang has one of the most bumpy careers in recent Hollywood. Hong Kong, in the US, he has done everything: from Eat a cup of tea to the diptych Smoke / Blue in the Face, from the sad Chinese Box to the digital erotic The Center of the World up to A five-star love with the Lopez waitress. Here he tries to give a bit of a "southern" atmosphere to the story, with a side of bizarre characters (the old "magical" librarian is Eva Marie Saint), but in the end the conventions of the childish genre leave no room and abounds with the protagonist's moves , grim counter-fields, pseudo-funny music. Not harmful to under 10s, however.

title: Taxi
actors: Queen Latifah, Jimmy Fallon, Henry Simmons, Jennifer Esposito, Gisele Bündchen
description: Belle Williams dreams of becoming an auto racing champion. Meanwhile, she has been named the fastest taxi driver in New York. The opportunity for Belle comes when Andy Washburn, a policeman without a license, gets into her taxi, who is chasing a gang of robbers led by the beautiful Vanessa.
notes: Comedy and action are guaranteed and of good quality in this film from which it was probably not legitimate to expect anything. In reality, the couple formed Queen Latifah and Jimmy Fallon, talent proposed by the timeless show Saturday Night Live, exhibits an interesting "chemistry" and even better the chase scenes directed by director Tim Story, which fill the void of a script that is not really. to remember.

title: L'educazione sentimentale di Eugénie
actors: Sara Sartini, Antonella Salvucci, Valerio Tambone, Cristian Tambone, Cristian Stelluti
description: The Duke of Missival entrusts Madame de Saint-Ange the sentimental education of his daughter Eugénie. Madame tries attraction for the girl, but is also interested in the marquis of Dolmancé. To achieve both its objectives, then the Marquis of Eugénie's cultural formation ...

title: La notte dell'alta marea
actors: Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Anthony Steel, Annie Belle, Hugo Pratt, Pam Grier

title: Bailey's Mistake
actors: Linda Hamilton, Kyle Secor, Jesse James, Paz de la Huerta, Jeremy Akerman
description: Liz, a widow for a week, discovers that her husband had spent a lot of money to buy an island off the coast of Maine called Bailey's Mistake. Accompanied by children, nine-year-old Dylan and teenage Rebecca, the woman tries to unearth something about the deceased spouse's secrets.

title: Il segreto del giaguaro
actors: Piotta, Antonello Fassari, Dario Ballantini, Lando Buzzanca, Isabella Biagini
description: "Romano de Roma" to the core, incurable maniac of the 70s and born optimist, er Piotta alias "the Jaguar" has its headquarters in a bar near Piazza Vittorio, a meeting point for bizarre characters from various generations. From time to time, some strange fact interrupts the routine, while the Jaguar teaches life and conquest lessons ...
notes: The "dirty dozen" made up of Fassari (directorial debut), the Manetti Bros., er Piotta / Tommaso Zanello and their associates celebrates the mythology of "coattitude" and the "Seventies all'amatriciana". Strictly reserved for fans: others stay away.

title: Maciste nell'inferno di Gengis Khan
actors: Mark Forest, José Greci, Ken Clark, Gloria Milland, Howard Ross
description: In the 12th century, the fearsome Genghis Khan kidnaps the beautiful heir to the throne of Poland. Maciste thus discovers that his beloved Arminia is none other than the princess and works to save her by sneaking into Khan's palace ...

title: Uccidete il vitello grasso e arrostitelo
actors: Jean Sorel, Marilù Tolo, Gigi Ballista, Maurizio Degli Esposti, Pier Paolo Capponi, Noris Fiorina
description: Enrico Merlo is the young son of a rich family who was sent to a Swiss boarding school after the death of his mother, who loved him very much and whom he venerated. To call him home is the news of his father's death. However, as soon as he arrives home, some suspicious facts lead him to think that Caesar, his elder brother, with whom he has always had little contact, in league with his cousin Green, who is in secret Caesar's death. the lover. He will thus decide to hire a private detective to clarify the facts.
notes: Soundtrack composed of Ennio Morricone.

title: Paganini
actors: Klaus Kinski, Deborah Kinski, Bernard Blier, Dalila Di Lazzaro
description: During a concert at the Regio di Parma, the great violinist Niccolò Paganini retraces his troubled existence, anticipating its epilogue. On the thread of memory flow the follies and extravagances, the success met everywhere and the idolatry of the public, the uncontrollable erotic obsessions and the specter of creditors, the relationship with the beloved son Achille ...
notes: The irrepressible, neurotic, Luciferian incontinent Klaus identifies himself with the figure of the Genoese musician with an ardor that borders on pathology. The erotic côté is ensured by the very young pre-Tinto Brass Caprioglio, credited in the cast as "Debora Kinski".

title: A luci spente
actors: Giulio Scarpati, Giuliana De Sio, Toni Bertorelli, Andrea Di Stefano
description: In 1943, the producer Ettore Benedetti and the homosexual and anti-fascist director Giovanni Forti signed two stars - the sensitive Elena Monti and the vacuous fascist Primo Ratelli - for the film _Redemption_. While round-ups and curfews go crazy, among the workers - provided with Vatican passes - everything from Jewish women to communist partisan will be found ...
notes: The result is better than similar operations, but it remains woody in its developments: it suffers from a miserable period reconstruction, a soporific rhythm, a morricon-like soundtrack and actors not always up to par (apart from certain De Sio-Bertorelli duets).

title: Giovanni Senzapensieri
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Eleonora Giorgi, Aldo Fabrizi, Luigi De Filippo, Franco Fabrizi, Gastone Pescucci, Richard McNamara, Rodolfo Bigotti, Alessandro Fersen, Tatiana Farnese, Anita Durante, Claudio Spadaro, Pasquale Zito, Valerio Isidori
description: May 1985. Giovanni, the last descendant of the fallen lineage of the Cantelmo, lives in the ancient family building together with two elderly aunts. To survive, he is forced to barter the inherited assets in exchange for food. One day, he by chance discovers some precious notes by Leonardo da Vinci.
notes: Director's debut film. Last roles for Aldo Fabrizi and Alessandro Fersen.

title: Don't Open 'Til Christmas
actors: Caroline Munro, Edmund Purdom, Alan Lake, Belinda Mayne

title: Alone in the Dark
actors: Christian Slater, Tara Reid, Stephen Dorff, Frank C. Turner
description: Edward Carnby, a detective specializing in paranormal phenomena, investigates the mysterious disappearance of a friend. Thus ends up in Shadow Island to fight against dark forces that want to take over the world.

title: Thunderbirds
actors: Bill Paxton, Ben Kingsley, Brady Corbet, Debora Weston, Soren Fulton
description: International Rescue is the Tracy family's rescue team. The arrival of the villain The Hood forces the family to flee: only little Alan remains, who will have to learn to get by on his own.
notes: Based on a 1960s series animated with puppets, the film is one of the most childish blockbusters imaginable.

title: I racconti di Viterburi - Le più allegre storie del '300
actors: Rosalba Neri, Christa Linder, Toni Ucci, Giacomo Rizzo, Peter Landers, Mario Brega
description: Messer Antonio, inexperienced with women, spends his wedding night with his mother-in-law, who has offered to instruct him. The Ghibelline Menico da Pistoia, who loves Tonia (the daughter of the Guelph Jacopo della Quercia), tries several times to enter his beauty's house, passing through the window, but a series of disastrous falls convince him to give up on the girl. A diabolical turkey ruins an unfaithful wife's affair with an exorcist friar. Mona Fiora uses an ingenious trick to make love with her mother's consent. Gallinella, Nicolò's wife, is at first afraid of consummating the marriage, but when it is decided to reduce her husband to death. In agreement with her husband, the wife of a miller obtains the labor for free, putting her lovers to the millstone. Cecco da Viterbo frees himself with the cunning of a man who would like to force him into a shotgun marriage with his sister.

title: Der Turm der Verbotenen Liebe
actors: Jean Piat, Teri Tordai, Marie-Ange Aniès, Uschi Glas, Frank Olivier
description: Accused of killing Queen Margherita's father, Captain Buridan decides to go to Paris to investigate the real killer. However, the French capital has long been the scene of the murder of young nobles, whose bodies are fished out in the Seine.

title: Le mille et une voix - La musique de l'Islam
description: The director of _Traversées_, of Tunisian origin but active in France for some time, travels the boundless universe-Islam (from Egypt to Tunisia, from Turkey to Senegal, up to the Indian subcontinent) documenting the many musical expressions that animate him. A good opportunity to dispel numerous and deeply rooted clichés.

title: Al'tovaya sonata: Dmitrij Shostakovic
description: Begun by Aranovic, this biography of the illustrious composer from St. Petersburg (1906-1975) has taken on its definitive appearance thanks to the archive materials selected by Sokurov, which focus on the dramatic contrasts between Shostakovic and the omnipresent, inflexible apparatus censorship of the Stalinist regime.

title: Marche à l'ombre
actors: Michel Blanc, Gérard Lanvin, Sophie Duez, Mimi Félixine, Béatrice Camurat

title: Yogen
actors: Daisuke Ban, Maki Horikita, Hana Inoue, Hiroshi Mikami, Noriko Sakai
description: Hideki Satomi reads in a newspaper clipping that his daughter Nana will die and cannot do anything to prevent it. After the tragedy he acquires paranormal faculties and tries to save the lives of those around him, in order to change the course of events and consequently also his past.

title: Perdita Durango
actors: Rosie Perez, Javier Bardem, Aimee Graham, Harley Cross, James Gandolfini
description: Mexico: story of the adventurer and prostitute Perdita Durango and her lover Romeo.
notes: Adaptation of the novel by Barry Gifford: a cohesive and high-tension story, whose images seduce and surprise, in their succession of robberies, shootings and sadistic gestures. Goya Award for directing won with full merit.

title: Pieces of April
actors: Katie Holmes, Patricia Clarkson, Derek Luke, Alison Pill, Alice Drummond
description: April Burns invites her family for Thanksgiving to her home in New York. During the trip, the parents argue, the other daughter remembers her sister's failures, the grandmother barely remembers everyone's name, and the youngest son continues to take photographs.
notes: Sotto la zest indie (digital and hand machine) is a seemingly black fairy tale, with a young girl trying to cook her turkey on the Lower East Side and clashes with various monsters but eventually finds family and multi-ethnic solidarity. And it is precisely the ending that spoils the film, which for over an hour stands on its feet and communicates sincere discomfort with dialogue from excellent sitcoms and actors in part.

title: Møgunger
actors: Adam Gilbert Jespersen, Jesper Christensen, Kirstine Rosenkrands Mikkelsen, Sebastian Aagaard-Williams
description: Eleven-year-old George, a newcomer to the residence _The apple garden_, is terrified along with another guest by JB, the tyrannical administrator of the complex. One day, all the children join forces with him, dreaming of taking revenge against JB. The police will also be involved ...

title: Undead
actors: Felicity Mason, Mungo McKay, Rob Jenkins, Lisa Cunningham, Dirk Hunter
description: The beautiful René, after losing her family farm, decides to leave Berkeley, the quiet fishing village where she was born, to try her luck in the big city. Suddenly, a meteor storm hits the city and causes an unknown infection. The undead awaken and René finds herself trapped among the zombies.
