title: The File of the Golden Goose
actors: Yul Brynner, Charles Gray, Edward Woodward, John Barrie
description: The inspector of the American police Novak, charged with stopping a worldwide trade in fake dollars, lands in England where a gang of counterfeiters is allegedly based ...
notes: Wanamaker debuts on the big screen with an average product, which has the merit of never letting the tension drop.

title: Wake of Death
actors: Philip Tan, Jean-Claude Van Damme, Simon Yam, Valerie Tian
description: Ben lost his wife, brutally killed by the Triad, a powerful Chinese mafia organization. From that day on, Ben, a former member of the Los Angeles mafia, lives the reality that revolves around him only in terms of revenge against those who committed that terrible murder. So when an orphan, who happens to be the daughter of an influential figure in the Triad, asks Ben to help him, it doesn't seem true that he can lead his hands and resolve the dangerous situation in his own way.
notes: Producer Philippe Martinez gets behind the camera and creates yet another action film for revenant Jean-Claude Van Damme. We didn't feel the need!

title: The United States of Leland
actors: Don Cheadle, Ryan Gosling, Chris Klein, Jena Malone, Lena Olin, Michelle Williams
description: 16-year-old introverted Leland Fitzgerald commits a terrible murder that shocks the entire community.
notes: Presented in competition at the 2003 Sundance Film Festival and co-produced by Kevin Spacey, unfortunately it did not generate echoes in the US. Needless to say, unnoticed in Italy. Definitely to be recovered and re-evaluated.

title: Lo straniero
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Anna Karina, Bernard Blier, Georges Wilson
description: Mersault, a modest employee who lives and works in Algiers, receives the news of his mother's death. Without being particularly pained, he goes to watch over the body and accompany it to the cemetery. Upon returning, after the funeral, he meets Marie, a typist friend of his, and begins a relationship with her. A neighbor, Raymond, who is supported by women, offers him his friendship and asks him for help in getting revenge on an Arab girl. Meursault, indifferent and willing to do anything, agrees and kills an Arab by firing on the corpse.
notes: The film, based on the novel by Albert Camus, is Visconti's least successful.

title: Nättlek
actors: Ingrid Thulin, Keve Hjelm, Jörgen Lindström, Lena Brundin
description: Jan, young and wealthy, is about to marry his fiancée Mariana. One day he decides to take his betrothed to the castle that will host them and in which the groom has spent his entire life. Crossing the rooms Jan relives some moments of his youth: when, although guided by an old aunt, he had participated in the disorderly life that his mother led among friends devoted to revelry and wildness. He also relives the troubles he felt towards his mother; it will be precisely the resemblance between his betrothed and his mother to make Jan unable to complete the marriage.
notes: Second film directed by Mai Zetterling who took the story from one of his novels.

title: Il fidanzamento
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Martine Brochard, Didi Perego, Anna Proclemer

title: Je t'aime moi non plus
actors: Jane Birkin, Joe Dallesandro, Hugues Quester, Gérard Depardieu

title: Smirennaja zizn'
actors: Umeno Matshueshi
description: In Aska, a remote village in the Japanese mountains, an elderly woman lives in perfect solitude. Her days are marked by elementary and archaic activities: cooking, poking the fire, sewing kimonos, praying ...
notes: Another notable example of Sokurov's "cinema of poetry". Musical themes from Tchaikovsky and from the Japanese tradition.

title: Nur Anfänger heiraten
actors: Muriel Baumeister, Benjamin Sadler, Heinrich Schmieder, Silvina Buchbauer
description: The upcoming wedding of Nina and Hannes - she is a well-known TV star, he is a famous architect - are destined to cause a sensation in the tabloid press, with its accompanying crowd of reporters and paparazzi. However, the closer "the event of the year" approaches, the more the two future spouses feel doubts and second thoughts arise ...

title: Koma
actors: Roy Chow, Andy Chi-On Hui, Kar Yan Lam, Angelica Lee, Kai Chi Liu, Annie Man, Ho-Yin Wong
description: A crime is committed during a wedding reception in a luxury hotel. The police are looking for the culprit, but the only eyewitness is one of the bride's bridesmaids who initially accuses another woman, but then portrayed ...
notes: It is a title that has nothing to do with the story but perhaps with the state of the viewer at the end of the screening. Lifting the veil of the thriller, the story actually describes an ambiguous love / hate relationship between two young people. Unfortunately, the whole is outlined in a very unlikely way and staged by a director with no idea with a musical motif that imitates the minimal Carpenterian one of Halloween.

title: Fat Albert
actors: Kenan Thompson, Kyla Pratt, Jermaine Williams, Keith Robinson
description: Fat Albert and the Cosby Kids, stars of a successful animated series, become real and are catapulted to Philadelphia to help Doris Robertson, a girl without friends. Fat Albert and his gang have twenty-four hours to complete the mission before a new installment of their show begins, but Fat Albert falls in love with Lauri, Doris's half-sister ...
notes: Zwick (the one - see case - of _My big fat Greek wedding_ and _If you invest, will you marry me? _) Puts in images, with negligible results, the animated series _Fat Albert and the Cosby Kids_, created by Bill Cosby and gone aired from 1972 to 1984.

title: Boogeyman
actors: Barry Watson, Emily Deschanel, Skye McCole Bartusiak, Tory Mussett, Andrew Glover
description: As a child, Tim was scared of his parents with the story of the Black Man coming to get him. At twenty, Tim continues to believe in his existence and to overcome this fear, he decides to return to his old home and find out if the Black Man really exists ...
notes: Sam Raimi produces this horror not particularly exciting but not to be thrown away. If you are satisfied with a couple of well-aimed shots in the stomach (the sequence of the prologue and that of the wardrobe with the clawing hangers are nice), the fun is guaranteed. If, on the other hand, you want to be a sophist then yes the effect materialization of the Boogeyman, a digital creature, is frankly ridiculous.

title: I gemelli del Texas
actors: Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello, Diana Lorys, Alfonso Rojas
description: Two pairs of swaddled twins are separated in a stagecoach attack. Two become ferocious bandits, while the others make a career as irreproachable journalists. When the former are charged with eliminating the latter, many misunderstandings will arise.
notes: The film, played on mistaken identity, has funny gags.

title: Tur & Retur
actors: Torkel Petersson, Amanda Davin, Jørgen Langhelle, Helena af Sandeberg
description: The elevenths Martin and Julia know each other for the first time in the departure room of an airport. Not only do children have an almost identical appearance, they also have a common destiny: their respective parents are separated. By mutual agreement, discontented with the relationship with mom and dad, they decide to exchange roles.

title: Caught in the Act
actors: Lauren Holly, Max Martini, Brian McNamara, Madeleine Potter
description: The idyllic ménage of Jodie, a mother of two children, collapses when she suspects she is being betrayed by her husband. When this is confirmed, Jodie turns to divorce lawyer Dan in whose office she meets Alice, who is convinced of her husband's infidelity. Then, one day, Alice is found dead ...

title: Paparazzi
actors: Cole Hauser, Robin Tunney, Dennis Farina, Daniel Baldwin, Tom Sizemore
description: Bo is a young actor who has finally achieved success, but along with fame came the hassles, in the form of a host of persistent photographers. When the intrusiveness of the paparazzi comes to cause a near-fatal accident, the actor loses control and engages in a relentless hunt to track down the photographers and claim revenge.
notes: An attempt to return to the exploitation of the Charles Bronson vigilante theme, unhappy, however, since the idea of ??making such a film for a teen-ager audience. The bad dialogues don't help, too bad for Dennis Farina, a mannian face that is seen too little nowadays.

title: Into the Sun
actors: Steven Seagal, Matthew Davis, Takao Osawa, Eddie George, William Atherton
description: A group of yakuza assassinated the mayor of Tokyo. CIA agent Travis Hunter, raised in Japan by an ex-yakuza and half-brother of the killed politician, is sent to investigate the incident. He finds himself facing a war between the old guard of the organized crime of the Rising Sun and the unscrupulous "young rampant" led by the insane Kuroda, who has entered into an alliance with the Chinese mafia for the worldwide drug trade.
notes: A film rather devoid of action (and even the little that is there certainly does not leave its mark) that will disappoint even lovers of the genre and fans of the rocky Seagal.

title: Gaz Bar Blues
actors: Serge Thériault, Gilles Renaud, Sébastien Delorme, Danny Gilmore
description: François Brochu has been running a service station for fifteen years with the help of his three children. Although his wife is long gone and he is beginning to show symptoms of Parkinson's disease, he runs the business profitably. The situation worsens the day in which the offspring manifest the desire to abandon it. Only 14-year-old Alain is interested in continuing the family tradition ...
notes: An intimate and introspective story, embellished with "colorful" dialogues (especially appreciable in the original language, where the setting in Quebec is very distinctive). Excellent performance by Serge Thériault as the head of the family.

title: Ragazza tutta nuda assassinata nel parco
actors: Robert Hoffmann, Pilar Velazquez, Irina Demick, Adolfo Celi, Philippe Leroy, Howard Ross, Patrizia Adiutori
description: In Madrid, the very wealthy entrepreneur Wallenberger is found dead on a carousel of the horror carousel at a carnival. No one can explain what prompted the man to regularly pay for the ticket for the attraction. Maybe someone lured him there? The first investigations already bring an answer: the man had taken out dizzying life insurance. Chris Buyer, a career insurer at the branches involved, is called to investigate the case and immediately attracts the attention of Wallenberger's young daughter and widow. But the murders continue.

title: Christiane F. Wir Kinder vom Bahnhof Zoo
actors: Natja Brunckhorst, Thomas Haustein, Jens Kuphal, Christiane Reichelt
description: The young Berliner Christiane lives with her mother and sister in a seedy neighborhood. Her friend Kessie takes her to the famous "Sound" nightclub, where she meets many peers and learns to smoke and get LSD. There he also meets Datlev, a kind boy but addicted to heroin; the two will gradually go through every step of drug addiction and will fall lower and lower, losing inhibitions and moral sense.

title: Travolto dagli affetti familiari
actors: Lando Buzzanca, Barbara Bouchet, Andréa Ferréol, Gloria Guida
description: Memè Di Costanzo leads an unruly life in a world of his own. One day, oppressed by the constant needs of his grandmother Nana and the old dog Piccolo, he breaks into the home of Eliana Salvetti, his lover, and settles there. After a short time, he is fired from his job and finds himself in a desperate situation. He then decides to circumvent Dr. Isotta Uccelli, owner of a pharmacy. Memè manages to marry her, and begins to manage the business. But Isolde's mother and sisters intervene ...
notes: A grotesque comedy with evident trash veins, it shows off a predictable comedy that relies on the lowest instincts. Buzzanca's character doesn't work.

title: Love! Valour! Compassion!
actors: Jason Alexander, Stephen Spinella, Stephen Bogardus, Randy Becker
description: Gregory invites seven of his friends to spend the summer in his secluded old mansion in New York. The guests are: the unsold Bobby, companion of the landlord, who, using touch, tries to explore the garden surrounding the villa; Art and Perry, two yuppies who arrive on site in Volvo and who are celebrating the fourteenth anniversary of their union; the English John, an austere individual who hates his twin brother James, who is ill with AIDS; Ramon, John's cohabitant, who physically attracted to Bobby tries to seduce him. Buzz who is forced to live with his HIV-positive status.
notes: Passionate second direction by Joe Mantello.

title: Suddenly
actors: Frank Sinatra, Sterling Hayden, James Gleason, Nancy Gates
description: The president of the United States is about to arrive in the Californian town of Suddenly for a few days of fishing. While the secret services are on the alert, a disillusioned war hero - recycled as a hitman - and two accomplices kidnap the sheriff and a family in a house in front of which the presidential convoy will pass: will they be able to carry out the attack?
notes: The thriller system is quite original for the time, but the tension risks falling under the weight of the dialogue. Oddly convincing Sinatra in her cynical character. Legend has it that Lee Oswald saw this movie before he shot Kennedy.

title: La porta delle sette stelle
actors: Stefano Dionisi, Pilar Abella, Luca Buratto, Sabrina Colle, Cosimo Fusco
description: David lost his anthropologist mother in India when he was a child, and despite being a prodigy pianist he is now a pilot of military aircraft. Contacted by a shady boss of the third sector, he gives up everything and starts to fly his private plane. He becomes involved in Raimondo's shady circle of women, and then meets another genius child, this time of computers, thanks to the computer infractions of which he becomes a billionaire.
notes: But the plot still has other twists, all variously implausible, and other set changes. The initial cue, of visionary indignation over the pervasive power of money, was probably generous and sincere. But the result is a slew of moralistic platitudes and pseudo-poetic dialogues on the edge of ridicule, played by stunned actors and bad actresses. The direction is scruffy, the hand of the powerful director of _Verso Sud_ and _Padre e son_ is unrecognizable.

title: L'uomo spezzato
actors: Federica Sbrenna, Stefano Calvagna, Valentina Pace, Ivo Garrani, Flavio Bucci

title: 24 ore di terrore
actors: Paul Janning, Joseph Warrender, Lauren Madison, Stephen Mason
description: Taken in Fiumicino by a shady individual in charge of taking him to France, the mysterious Tronchet is attacked while stopping in a motel. His identity is assumed by a certain Don Lewis: thus a complicated "international intrigue" begins ...
notes: Director and unknown actors for a negligible C-series thriller.

title: C'era una volta un gangster
actors: Richard Harrison, Ingrid Schoeller, Vittoria Solinas, Attilio Dottesio

title: From the Earth to the Moon
actors: Joseph Cotten, George Sanders, Debra Paget, Don Dubbins

title: Hip Hip Hora!
actors: Amanda Renberg, Björn Kjellman, Ellen Fjæstad, Linn Persson
description: At a party, 13-year-old Sofie drinks a few too many drinks and gets drunk. Seeing her in this state, some boys from her school take the opportunity to take compromising photos of her, and suddenly Sofie finds herself with a bad reputation on her shoulders ...
notes: Discreet children's film of Scandinavian production.

title: Cowboys & Angels
actors: Michael Legge, Alan Leech, Amy Shiels, David Murray, Frank Kelly
description: Twenty-year-old Shane dreams of leaving the office and studying art. His new roommate, gay Vincent, encourages him to change his life: the love for Gemma - Vincent's best friend - and the chance encounter with drug dealer Keith will give him the chance, but ...
notes: Passable debut feature film for Irish director Gleeson.

title: Land of the Dead
actors: Simon Baker, John Leguizamo, Dennis Hopper, Asia Argento, Robert Joy
description: The living dead have now become the majority: the few surviving human beings live in fortified cities where those who can afford it live in inaccessible skyscrapers, while the poor fight in the streets. Their only defense is a huge tank capable of intercepting and destroying the zombies, which in the meantime are organizing themselves into a dangerous army ...
notes: By internalizing the evolution of "new horror" and not giving in to the overwhelming power of special effects, in the fourth part of the saga Romero weaves as always a network of theoretical references, restoring its troubled and problematic value to horror.

title: Lords of Dogtown
actors: John Robinson, Emile Hirsch, Rebecca De Mornay, Heath Ledger
description: In the 70s, on the streets of Dogtown in Santa Monica (California), a group of young people with a passion for surfing was at the origin of a phenomenon destined to impose itself: skateboarding. The Z-Boys - as they are called - apply the skill they developed in the ocean waves to the concrete of the big city, perfecting their style in empty swimming pools and defying gravity ...
notes: Punctuated by a splendid vintage soundtrack and "broken" by an excellent editing, the film traces a bridge (ideal and stylistic) between the melancholy heroisms of the great American cinema of the 70s and the future-less bitterness of Van Sant's contemporaries and Araki.

title: Buffalo Soldiers
actors: Dean Stockwell, Joaquin Phoenix, Ed Harris, Scott Glenn, Anna Paquin, Elizabeth McGovern
description: West Germany, on the eve of the fall of the Wall: in an American military base, soldier Ray Elwood tries to sell weapons, favors and secrets on the black market. When the deal destined to change his life is about to close, Sergeant Major Robert Lee arrives at the base, accompanied by his daughter Robyn ...
notes: Adapting Robert O'Connor's novel of the same name, Jordan makes a caustic anti-militarist and anti-American satire, describing an army unable to relate to ideals even in peacetime. Too bad that the grotesque often leaves room for an easy and effective exasperation, at the expense of an excellent cast.

title: Blueberry
actors: Vincent Cassel, Juliette Lewis, Michael Madsen, Temuera Morrison, Ernest Borgnine, Tchéky Karyo
description: 1870. A quiet town on the edge of Indian territory is set on fire by Wallace Sebastian Blount, a murderer who wants to take possession of an Indian treasure hidden in a sacred mountain. But Major Mike Blueberry, along with trusty Runi - an Indian shaman he grew up with - are on his trail.
notes: Vaguely inspired by the _Blueberry_ comic, that pearl invented by Moebius and Charlier, the film confirms what after _Dobermann_ we already suspected. Jan Kounen claims to have seen - his goodness - "at least seventy, eighty classic westerns to learn the rules". But can the western be "learned"?

title: Fantastic Four
actors: Ioan Gruffudd, Jessica Alba, Chris Evans, Michael Chiklis, Julian McMahon, Hamish Linklater
description: After being exposed to radiation, some astronauts acquire superpowers: Reed Richards, acquires the ability to stretch his own body and takes the name of Mr. Fantastic; his girlfriend, Sue Storm, becomes invisible and manages to create magnetic fields; the younger brother of the girl Johnny Storm manages to control the fire and becomes the Human Torch, while the pilot Ben Grimm is transformed into a creature of stone, the Thing. The four use superpowers to fight against Doctor Doom's evil aims.
notes: Too many special effects, little creativity, unstoppable leveling down of the scripts. That of _Fantastici 4_ seems designed for teenagers stoned by Ritalin. What to say? The thickness of the characters has been canceled: apart from La Cosa (Michael Chiklis) all the others, good and bad alike, are little more than wearers with show faces. Jessica Alba, while beautiful, has a charisma equal to zero, and let's forget the Torch that in the comic has an important definition and here is transformed into the unconscious daredevil on duty. That _The Fantastic 4_ has been so successful in the US is a sign of the times.

title: Bewitched
actors: Nicole Kidman, Will Ferrell, Shirley MacLaine, Michael Caine, Jason Schwartzman
description: Actor Jack Wyatt wants to relaunch his career by bringing the sitcom _My Wife is a Witch_ to the big screen. When he meets Isabel Bigelow he is very struck by the similarity of her nose to that of Elizabeth Montgomery, the Samantha of the television series. He tries in every way to convince Isabel to accept the part, not knowing that the young woman is really a witch.
notes: So far, Nora Ephron's film works. But then, in the amorous skirmish between Kidman and Ferrell, where she tries, classically, to catch him, she flattens out, she doesn't have the effervescence and wickedness of the comedies of the golden years (50s included), and what's more she wastes sensationally two large side parts: those of the sorcerer father, Michael Caine, and of the mature prima donna, Shirley MacLaine, perhaps a witch herself, sacrificed in telegraphic and incocluding apparitions.

title: The Longest Yard
actors: Adam Sandler, Chris Rock, Burt Reynolds, James Cromwell, Walter Williamson
description: When Paul "Wrecking" Crewe, already a famous American football player, ends up in prison, he is given the task of putting together a team of prisoners to play a match against the sadistic guards. He accepts, but ...
notes: Sandler goes to great lengths not to disfigure Burt Reynolds' "coolness" (who appears in the role of co-coach Nate Scarboro), but the remake of the 1974 Aldrich film veers towards a comedy with a teenage target. Good action sequences, with actual NFL stars: the anger and incorrectness of the original, however, are watered down between slow motion, rap video editing and good feelings.

title: The Honeymooners
actors: Cedric the Entertainer, Mike Epps, Gabrielle Union, Regina Hall, Eric Stoltz, John Leguizamo
description: Ralph Kramden, bus driver married to Alice, is always looking for new ways to get rich, but usually ends up in a lot of trouble; luckily, his best friend, Ed Norton, is watching over him ...
notes: Inspired by the homonymous TV series broadcast by the American CBS in the 1950s (there the actors were all white, here all colored), _The Honeymooners_ is shot in Ireland. An old-fashioned comedy for comedy and romance, whose sitcom tones fit the performers perfectly. In particular to Cedric the Entertainer, a protagonist with contagious optimism and a soft, somewhat forced coolness.

title: The Dukes of Hazzard
actors: Seann William Scott, Johnny Knoxville, Jessica Simpson, Burt Reynolds, Lynda Carter, Willie Nelson
description: Cousins ??Bo and Luke Duke, with the help of their beautiful cousin Daisy and Uncle Jesse, are always in conflict with the Hazzard County authorities, represented by Boss Hogg and Sheriff Rosco Coltrane.

title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
actors: Johnny Depp, Freddie Highmore, David Kelly, Helena Bonham Carter, Noah Taylor, Christopher Lee, Missi Pyle, James Fox, AnnaSophia Robb, Adam Godley, Julia Winter, Deep Roy
description: Little Charlie Bucket makes his dream come true when he finds one of five tickets for a guided tour of the largest chocolate factory in the country. Accompanying him and the other four lucky winners is owner Willy Wonka, an incredible character. However, many surprises are lurking ...
notes: On everything, of course, there is Dickens, there are the greyness, the misery and the suggestions of Victorianism, the poverty and dignity of David Copperfield, the tailcoat and the top hat of Willy Wonka / Johnny Depp, the same as those of young dandy Alec Guinness in David Lean's Great Expectations, Helena Bonham-Carter's sweaters and mitts of a cold little Dorritt, a lopsided house and a threatening factory with gates closing in front of dismissed and dismayed workers, and snow, that falls and "dust" everything, as in a vintage Christmas card, slightly disturbing, gray-blue and white, engraved by the red flashes of the vans, the mopeds, the little men of the Wonka Factory. Lewis Carroll is the second natural father of _The Chocolate Factory_ (taken, like the previous one from 1971, from the book by Roald Dahl, heir to these authors much more subtle and visceral than Harry Potter's JK Rawling). More _Through the mirror_ than _Alice in Wonderland_ (even if you enter the factory through a miniature Disney door).

title: Stealth
actors: Josh Lucas, Jessica Biel, Jamie Foxx, Sam Shepard, Richard Roxburgh, Joe Morton
description: In the not too distant future, aviation developed a fighter jet piloted by artificial intelligence. The jet was placed on an aircraft carrier in the Pacific to "learn" combat maneuvers from the pilots on board. But when the computer develops its own thought, men must find a way to stop it before the war starts ...
notes: The Cohen of _The Fast and the Furious_ and _xXx_ does not contradict himself and packs yet another adrenaline-filled and decerebrated "popcorn movie": this time, however, even the public has deserted. Embarrassing that the talking computer of the plane aspires to refer to the Kubrickian Hal 9000.

title: Into the Blue
actors: Paul Walker, Jessica Alba, Scott Caan, Ashley Scott, Josh Brolin, James Frain
description: Bahamas. Four young scuba divers find a wreck that is said to contain great treasure. But once they reach their destination, they discover another and more sinister mystery. The four pledge not to reveal what they know, but the stakes put their loyalty to the test. All the more so when they themselves turn into prey.
notes: From a teen movie and marine filming expert like John Stockwell (Blue Crush) it was more than legitimate to expect good underwater scenes and an atmosphere at the right seaside temperature a balanced dose of adventure and bullying (the duo between Walker and Scott Caan works) , son of James, as well as the villain of the day, Josh Brolin, is the son of another well-known James). A brilliant promotional film of free diving, a sub discipline to be practiced without a wetsuit. And in fact the athletic and tanned and in love bodies of Jessica Alba and Paul Walker, the beauty of "Fast and Furious", are above all.

title: Domino
actors: Keira Knightley, Mickey Rourke, Mena Suvari, Lucy Liu, Christopher Walken, Jacqueline Bisset, Brian Austin Green, Ian Ziering, Macy Gray, Mo'Nique
description: The story of Domino Harvey, daughter of actor Laurence, who abandoned her modeling career for the Ford agency to become a "head hunter".
notes: Apart from some gigioneria of actors who cannot but get the applause (any reference to Christopher Walken is purely intentional), the film is an ugly mess with a jagged and hyperkinetic staging, of those that after a quarter of an hour you can do more (even for the din). Tony Scott has never been great, but persevering with this thundering, very 80s style of his, he ends up being diabolical too. Co-produces the good soul of the Scott family, Brother Ridley.

title: Red-Eye
actors: Rachel McAdams, Cillian Murphy, Brian Cox, Tom Elkins, Kyle Gallner, Amber Mead
description: Lisa Reisert, flying to Miami, shortly after take-off knows the real reasons that prompted Jackson, her charming traveling neighbor, to board. The young man has the task of killing a rich and powerful businessman and Lisa must help him; if he refuses to cooperate, his father will be killed by an accomplice who awaits Jackson's call.
notes: _Red Eye_ is very weak, it borders on the ridiculous in the attack on the Secretary of Security, it becomes obvious in the last sequence "a la Craven". There is only one element that really frightens, and displaces: the face of Cillian Murphy (_Batman Begins_, _28 days later_), with those icy eyes, as impudent and dangerous as the young Terence Stamp. But that's not enough to save the film.

title: The Island
actors: Ewan McGregor, Scarlett Johansson, Djimon Hounsou, Sean Bean, Steve Buscemi, Michael Clarke Duncan
description: Mid 21st century. Lincoln Six-Echo resides in a seemingly utopian place and like everyone else he hopes to be chosen to be sent to the Island, the last unspoiled spot on the planet. But when he discovers that he and the other inhabitants are only human clones with the aim of providing "spare parts" to their counterparts, he embarks on a daring escape in the company of the beautiful Jordan Two-Delta ...
notes: Leaving aside the incongruity of some characters and narrative junctions, what the film lacks is the right balance between the parts. After a start full of promises with the introduction of very interesting ethical, narrative and visual cues, in the second part Bay lets itself be carried away by an infinite sequence of useless pursuits, denying itself the pleasure of exploring perhaps more inaccessible but more fascinating routes such as for example a real confrontation between humans and agnates.

title: Herbie: Fully Loaded
actors: Lindsay Lohan, Michael Keaton, Matt Dillon, Breckin Meyer, Justin Long, Cheryl Hines
description: The young Maggie Peyton decides to participate in the Nascar championship with her wonderful car: the Beetle n. 53 artfully remodeled ...
notes: Let's face it: when you hear the air of a sequel or remake, you almost always feel a strong stench of burning. So it seemed in this case too: but the return of the most famous Volkswagen in the world is a surprise, and its adventures give life to an intelligent and funny film. Revised and corrected for our times, Herbie (and his new mistress, played by the good, sweet and strong-willed Lindsay Lohan) stages an updated version of the classic American dream.

title: Calcutta
description: Direct testimony of Calcutta, of the life of its inhabitants, of its colors, of its dense and contradictory atmospheres.

title: The One
actors: Richard Ruccolo, Meredith Monroe, Gabriel Hogan, Lori Anne Alter
description: Michael Blake, the owner of a start-up catering business in New York, has a tight court on Gail. Unfortunately, the girl is already betrothed to Gordie Parks, a jealous hockey player who punches him. Due to a variety of circumstances, the two become friends. So what to do?

title: The Ruling Class
actors: Peter O'Toole, Harry Andrews, Arthur Lowe, Alastair Sim, Coral Browne

title: Dark Command
actors: John Wayne, Claire Trevor, Walter Pidgeon, Roy Rogers, George 'Gabby' Gays
description: Defeated by Texan cowboy Bob Seton in both the race for the position of sheriff and in the race for the heart of the beautiful Mary McCloud, Will Cantrell gives up the profession of teacher and takes advantage of the outbreak of the Civil War to form a gang of renegades, apparently affiliated with the Southerners but in reality devoted to robberies and raids. Refreshed by the new situation, the rivalry between Cantrell and Seton will end up going on for a long time ...
notes: Despite the cuts imposed by the Republic, which greatly irritated Walsh, the film - based on a novel by W.R. Burnett and inspired by the exploits of the infamous William Quantrill - remains on dignified levels.

title: The Cold Heart of a Killer
actors: Kate Jackson, Corbin Bernsen, Michael Damian, Philip Granger
description: Jessie has major financial problems. To try and remedy this, his brother Matthew signs up for the famous Iditaroad, a dog sled race. His goal is to be the first to cross the finish line to win the prize money. But Matthew is killed under mysterious circumstances ...

title: Five Come Back
actors: Joseph Calleia, Chester Morris, Lucille Ball, John Carradine, Charles Aubrey Smith
description: The "Silver Queen" plane is forced to land in the cannibal-infested jungle. The aircraft can resume the journey with only five people. To have to choose the survivors will be the life prisoner Vasquez.
notes: The unity of place and action allows Farrow to create a moral apologue with this narrative archetype.

title: The Threat
actors: Charles McGraw, Michael O'Shea, Virginia Grey, Frank Conroy, Julie Bishop
description: Killer Arnold Kluger is locked up in a California prison. Once he escapes, he just wants to make up for those who put him in, Detective Williams and Judge MacDonald. And he manages to take them hostage with a showgirl, in the middle of the desert.
notes: Brilliant proof of character actor Charles McGraw.

title: Two O'Clock Courage
actors: Tom Conway, Ann Rutheford, Richard Lane, Jane Greer
description: A taxi driver brings a man into her car who tells her he is a victim of amnesia. The woman tries to make those few shreds of memory emerge from nowhere that allow him to reconstruct her story. The stranger soon realizes that he is suspected of murder.
notes: Mann directs a tense thriller.

title: The Saint Strikes Back
actors: George Sanders, Wendy Barrie, Jonathan Hale, Jerome Cowan, Barry Fitzgerald
description: Simon Templar, codenamed "The Saint", is an English private detective who gladly does without the help of the police. Traveling to the United States, he finds himself grappling with crime in San Francisco.
notes: First of five episodes of the original series of the "Saint", with an impeccable George Sanders.

title: La vocation suspendue
actors: Didier Flamand, Pascal Bonitzer, François Simon, Edith Scob
description: An abbot experiences his vocational choice with difficulty due to some theological disputes, such as that between Jesuits and followers of the Virgin.
notes: One of the first French films by the Chilean director, who theorizes freedom as an expression of dialectical positions with respect to a dogma. As often in Ruiz, the mechanisms and ways of survival of institutions are represented. It is a kind of film within a film, as it incorporates the making of a previous film into the narrative and alternates black and white and color. Adapted from the autobiographical novel by Pierre Klossowski (co-writer with the director).

title: P.I.: Post Impact
actors: Dean Cain, Bettina Zimmermann, Joanna Taylor, Nigel Bennett
description: In 2002 a huge meteorite hit the Earth causing earthquakes and devastation. Due to the impact, a huge cloud of dust darkens the sky and the entire northern hemisphere turns into a desolate expanse of ice. Three years later the survivors try to build a new civilization below the equator, but some radio signals coming from Berlin instill in them doubts about the future of the planet. Men are sent to try to identify the nature of the sound waves. They do not know that the salvation of humanity is in their hands.
notes: The originality of the writers of this film is zero.

title: Diggstown
actors: James Woods, Louis Gossett jr., Bruce Dern, Oliver Platt, Heather Graham
description: Con man Gabriel Caine ended up in prison for selling copies of ancient masterpieces, made of plastic. Within the four walls of the jail he first heard of Diggstown, the betting capital on underground boxing matches. Gabriel tries to outwit local boss John Gillon by arranging a rigged fight, during which former champion Roy "Honey" Palmer challenges amateurs one after another. The problem is to inform Roy that the encounters are not real ...
notes: However Ritchie had done better (edged weapon, How I'll Kill a Killer, The Shrink).

title: Madagascar
description: New York: a group of animal rights activists free a giraffe, a zebra, a hippo and a lion from the zoo. The four, used to living in captivity, encounter many difficulties in the real world and in their journey, destination Madagascar ...
notes: Film quotes and a captivating soundtrack seal a high-level package, in which the improvements of digital technology stand out. The best of itself, however, the film offers in outlining a sort of "buddy movie" in which the sacred value of friendship is in force and the protagonists discover that freedom is a good that - if faced lightly - can also generate anxiety and fear.

title: Never Die Alone
actors: DMX, Michael Ealy, David Arquette, Drew Sidora, Antwon Tanner, Robby Robinson
description: Paul, an aspiring white-skinned journalist, wants to learn about the hard life of the black ghetto. He finds himself helplessly witnessing the murder of King David, a drug dealer bent on changing his life. He then begins to investigate his death, studying the cassettes with the daily recordings that the criminal has made of his exploits ...
notes: Produced by the rapper DMX label, it is obviously a vehicle for stars, and the protagonist all in all gets along with dignity. The screenplay, however, does not overcome the pretext, and the beautiful lights of Matthew Libatique or the hip-hop score are not enough to mask it. For enthusiasts only.

title: Dear Frankie
actors: Emily Mortimer, Gerard Butler, Jack McElhone, Mary Riggans, Sharon Small, Katy Murphy
description: To protect her little son, Lizzie has always told him that her father works aboard a ship and, to make it more effective, she has written bogus letters to little Frankie. But when she finds out that the alleged ship is on its way to town, Lizzie must decide whether to tell the truth or find a stranger pretending to be Frankie's father ...
notes: Despite the subject matter, Auerbach's debut manages not to be blackmail or pathetic. Backed by a good performance of the actors, the film does not slip into easy sentimentality and finds its fair measure despite the improbable falls of the script.

title: Hotel
actors: Franziska Weisz, Birgit Minichmayr, Marlene Streeruwitz, Rosa Waissnix
description: Irene gets a job as a receptionist in a hotel. When she discovers that the girl who worked there before her has mysteriously disappeared, Irene begins to investigate putting her very existence in serious danger.

title: Imaginary Heroes
actors: Sigourney Weaver, Emile Hirsch, Jeff Daniels, Michelle Williams, Deirdre O'Connell
description: Faced with the suicide of Matt Travis, a promising swimmer, the family begins to crumble. Tim is a troubled teenager; Ben, the father, lives like a stranger in the house; Sandy, the mother, likes to spend her days smoking marijuana. The situation precipitates to the point of forcing everyone to deal with long-hidden secrets ....
notes: Written and directed by 25-year-old newcomer Dan Harris, the film is more adept at illustrating adolescent restlessness than adult problems. The skeleton in the wardrobe of the spouses makes you wait and under the existential smoke there seems to be little roast. However, the Weaver was good.

title: La morte viene dal pianeta Aytin
actors: Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Renato Baldini, Ombretta Colli, Enzo Fiermonte
description: The fearsome inhabitants of the extraterrestrial people Atyn invade the Earth with the aim of eliminating the human race.
notes: Fourth and last film in the _Gamma uno_ series, directed by Margheriti and scripted by Ivan Reiner and Renato Moretti, the film is the weakest of the tetralogy. Good soundtrack by Lavagnino.

title: Without a Paddle
actors: Matthew Price, Andrew Hampton, Seth Green, Dax Shepard, Matthew Lillard, Burt Reynolds
description: After Billy's death, Jerry, Tom and Dan leave Philadelphia for the woods and mountains of Oregon. The missing friend was in fact obsessed with a treasure hidden in the area, and the three want to pay homage to him by starting to look for it. It will not be an easy task, especially after the meeting with the surly Del Knox ...

title: Things to Do Before You're 30
actors: Donna Alexander, George Innes, Scott Bunce, Rosie Cavaliero, Charlie Cox, Emilia Fox
description: In 1983 Don Robson founded a football team, Athletico Greenwich. Twenty years later, six players are the same as they originally came, but things have gotten complicated: Cass isn't sure he's up to becoming a father, Adam has never confessed to friends he's gay, Colin has started dating Vicky but he risks ruining everything, Dylan is in love with the woman his father is about to marry, Billy is trying to save his marriage and Johnny does not accept that his father, the founder of the team, is about to die.
notes: The gaze on the characters is affectionate but very bitter, the film flows easily and not always banal, football wisely remains in the background.

title: Blu Gang e vissero per sempre felici e ammazzati
actors: Antonio Falsi, Tina Aumont, Guido Mannari, Jack Palance, Maurizio Bonuglia

title: Duma
actors: Alex Michaeletos, Campbell Scott, Mary Makhatho, Hope Davis, Jennifer Steyn
description: Xan, 10, lives with her parents on a ranch in Kenya. One day he finds an orphaned cheetah cub and adopts it, giving it the name Duma. The baby and the cat grow up together sharing numerous adventures until the moment of separation arrives ...
notes: Taken from a novel by Carol Cawthra, _Duma_ is the latest film directed by the American Carroll Ballard, a director specialized in adventure films where man and Nature continually confront each other in a fascinating dialectic. Here the story focuses on the relationship between a child, played by the surprising Alex Michaeletos, and a cheetah, but Ballard never plays on the confusion of roles and the animal is not required to be human, building a truly equal relationship with a wonderful nature in the background. The journey that the two undertake thus becomes a perhaps obvious but never banal metaphor of the entrance into adulthood for the boy and a touching essay on the value of friendship.

title: The Undercover Man
actors: Glenn Ford, Nina Foch, James Whitmore, Barry Kelley, David Wolfe

title: Deathbed
actors: Tanya Dempsey, Brave Matthews, Meagan Mangum, Dukey Flyswatter

title: Wolves of Wall Street
actors: Jeff Branson, Louise Lasser, William Gregory Lee, Angela Pietropinto

title: Sundown
actors: Gene Tierney, Bruce Cabot, George Sanders, Harry Carey, Joseph Calleia
description: During the Second World War, Zia, the adopted daughter of an Arab merchant who trades in arms, plays a double game in East Africa in favor of the British, led by Major Coombes.
notes: Paternalistic film enriched by the photography of Charles Lang and the grace of Gene Tierney.

title: Escalation
actors: Lino Capolicchio, Claudine Auger, Gabriele Ferzetti, Didi Perego, Leopoldo Trieste

title: Una domenica sì
actors: Nik Novecento, Elena Sofia Ricci, Dario Parisini, Mario Mazzarotto
description: Dario, Nik and Davide are three fellow soldiers on Sunday leave. Dario waits for his friend Elena to arrive by train from Rome and Nik hopes that she will bring a friend of hers with her to spend time with. However, events take an unexpected turn and the two friends decide to join Davide at the rich Alfonso's home.

title: Motocross Kids
actors: Lorenzo Lamas, Alana Austin, Bobby Preston, Brandon Alexander, Jerry Asher
description: Some bad guys on their roaring two-wheels terrify Callie and her friends, who are motocross fans. The girl's father, the instructor Evan Hanson (with the help of the friendly chimpanzee Cody) will take care of defeating them ...
notes: Renegade's long-time Lamas remains in the saddle (on a motorcycle), but the film is of a disheartening poverty.

title: Deadline at Dawn
actors: Susan Hayward, Paul Lukas, Bill Williams, Joseph Calleia
description: Awakening from a hangover, Alex - a sailor on leave - finds himself in his hands a large sum of money belonging to the uninhibited Edna, who had invited him home. Perplexed, Alex decides to return the money and returns to the girl with her friend June: but in the meantime Edna has been killed, and the two have only four hours available (before Alex's ship departs) to track down the killer. But in the middle of the night strange encounters take place, and the clues get confused ...
notes: Unique, remarkable feature film by Clurman. Written by Clifford Odets, from a novel by Cornell Woolrich; photograph by Nicholas Musuraca.

title: Split Second
actors: Stephen McNally, Alexis Smith, Jan Sterling, Paul Kelly, Richard Egan
description: Sam Hurley, a ferocious and ruthless killer, escapes from the penitentiary with two fellow inmates. To facilitate their escape, the trio kidnaps a group of unfortunates and heads to a remote location in Nevada: the destination was not chosen at random, as Hurley knows that, the next morning, the area will be the scene of a nuclear experiment. Minute by minute, the tension builds to unbearable levels ...
notes: Powell (former star of the brilliant musical and comedy, but also convincing as Philip Marlowe in Edward Dmytryk's _The Shadow of the Past_) makes his directorial debut with this taut and concise noir produced by Rko.

title: Seven Miles from Alcatraz
actors: Bonita Granville, Jeff Craig, Frank Jenks, Cliff Edwards
description: After Pearl Harbor, Alcatraz prisoners fear that the infamous prison is among the possible targets of an aerial bombing. Two of them, Champ Larkin and Jimbo, make a desperate attempt to escape and manage to land on a tiny lighthouse island, inhabited only by five souls. The escapees, however, are unaware that even that strip of land is in the sights of the Nazis ...
notes: Not one of Dmytryk's major works, but significant of the climate of terror that reigned at the time also in the United States. Albert S. D'Agostino also collaborated on the film, credited as "art director" for over 330 titles from 1921 to 1958.

title: Drive Me Crazy
actors: Melissa Joan Hart, Adrian Grenier, Stephen Collins, Susan May Pratt, Ali Larter
description: Nicole and Chase, despite being different, are forced to live next to each other. She is always ready to follow the latest fashion, he is a constant protest. The two have something in common when Nicole's favorite guy invites another girl and Chase's woman decides to leave him.
notes: Discounted weaving.

title: Bailey's Billion$
actors: Dean Cain, Laurie Holden, Tim Curry, Jennifer Tilly, Max Baker
description: In drawing up her will, a billionaire leaves all her possessions to her dog Bailey rather than to her nephew. To try to regain possession of what they believe has been taken from them, they kidnap the four-legged friend. Their plans are screwed up by a little girl, her mother and the ethologist Ted.
notes: Animalist comedy.

title: Going All the Way
actors: Jeremy Davies, Ben Affleck, Amy Locane, Rose McGowan, Rachel Weisz
description: Indiana, 1954: after completing their military service (the first near Kansas City, the second in the Japanese rear during the Korean War), Sonny and Gunner return home. Oppressed by his overprotective mother, Sonny is left alone and attempts suicide. Gunner gets engaged to a Jewish girl instead, but his mother hinders him. Freedom for them is elsewhere ....
notes: This "nostalgia operation" - from a novel by Dan Wakefield, very famous in the States - is Pellington's little personal debut feature film, coming from MTV and directed towards _Arlington Road_. The young cast will also have increasing fortune in the years to come.

title: Khamosh Pani
actors: Kiron Kher, Aamir Ali Malik, Arsad Mahmud, Salman Shahid, Shilpa Shukla
description: 1979. 18-year-old Saleem lives with his mother Ayesha in Charki, a small village in Pakistani Punjab. Over time, the boy gets more and more involved in a group of Islamic fundamentalists, leaves his girlfriend Zubeida and radically changes his lifestyle. The situation worsened when a group of Sikh pilgrims from India arrived in the village. Among them is an individual who is looking for his sister Veero, kidnapped in 1947. The meeting with this man awakens sad memories in Ayesha ...
notes: The beginning, with some vaguely Bollywood hints and some echoes of the Ray family sagas, promised more. Instead, it is a film of simple and didactic realism, with a solid and traditional structure, which focuses on the impact and relevance of a not too well known story (the fate of Indian women after the arrival of Muslims in the villages of Pakistan) .

title: La cura del gorilla
actors: Claudio Bisio, Stefania Rocca, Ernest Borgnine, Gigio Alberti, Fabio Camilli
description: Sandrone known as Gorilla suffers from a split personality: one cheerful, boorish and ironic and the other rational, cold and violent. Since he suffers from insomnia, Sandrone decides to become a private detective, an activity that fits perfectly with his nightlife ...
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by Sandrone Dazieri (Einaudi), the noir begins with a collage of sequences discarded from a Nirvana-like imagery (the producer is the same: Maurizio Totti), then transitions into sentimental comedy, therefore into yellow and never into a original dimension, already pleased to be a film when, at best, it would look good on television. Claudio Bisio, the perfect Zealight sidekick and mature actor in theaters, the chemical alchemy of the big screen is not suitable. Bebo Storti and Stefania Rocca work better, while the trip does not give grace to the great Ernest Borgnine. The bulky off-screen voice, which denounces narrative limits, is inadmissible. The direction is blocked and the breath is very short.

title: Dai si gin
actors: Kelly Chen, Nick Cheung, Cheung Siu-Fai, Hui Shiu Hung, Simon Yam
description: A gang of robbers escapes the encirclement of the police and takes refuge in a popular barracks. He takes a family hostage but, surprised, he also has to contend with another group of "colleagues", who have their own lair in the same building. In the meantime, the siege of the police is managed by a rampant "image consultant", convinced that the operation can turn into a mammoth mass media event capable of reviving the now compromised police forces.
notes: It is a powerful allegory, not very original, but managed by To with the usual expressive radicality. There is a spectacular breath that enchants, without surprising only with special effects.

title: Man of the House
actors: Tommy Lee Jones, Cedric the Entertainer, Christina Milian, Paula Garcés, Anne Archer
description: Roland Sharp, a Texas Ranger, is tasked with protecting a group of cheerleaders who witnessed the murder of a major drug dealer. To do this, he has to pretend to be the girls' coach's assistant and move in with them.
notes: The babysitting of the girls (the cheerleaders are the very jovial ones, tripping and busty 98-toothed big boy who fidget on the edges of the playing fields) does not reserve surprises and the two or three "various and possible" options to make the story proceed are carried out with laziness. The film is intended to be an action-comedy. In this case it sounds like an insult.

title: King Kong
actors: Naomi Watts, Jack Black, Adrien Brody, Jamie Bell, Kyle Chandler, Andy Serkis, Evan Parke, Colin Hanks, John Sumner, Lobo Chan, Thomas Kretschmann
description: 1930s: Director Carl Denham moves to the Skull Islands, near Sumatra, to shoot a documentary. Arriving there, the crew discover the King Kong gorilla, who lives in a jungle where some prehistoric creatures have been protected and hidden for millions of years. When Kong meets the beautiful Ann Darrow, he succumbs to her charm and ends up being captured and transported to New York, where he is locked up in a cage and exhibited to the crowd. But then...
notes: Jackson makes us tremble, jump, horrify, move and even laugh, evoking the mortal clash between civilization and nature, between cinema and its impossible materialization.

title: Tornado
actors: Timothy Brent, Anthony Marsina, Alan Collins
description: Vietnam, the end of the "dirty war". Captain Harlow endangers the lives of his soldiers to uphold the honor of his regiment. Sergeant Sal Maggio firmly opposes him, thus attracting the ire of the officer.
notes: Filmed in the Philippines with more means than _The Last Hunter_.

title: The Locals
actors: John Barker, Dwayne Cameron, Kate Elliott, Aidee Walker, Paul Glover

title: Gummo
actors: Jacob Reynolds, Nick Sutton, Lara Tosh, Jacob Sewell, Darby Dougherty, Chloë Sevigny, Carisa Glucksman, Wendall carr, Jason Guzak, Casey Guzak, Harmony Korine

description: Henry wants to commit suicide by jumping from the Brooklyn bridge, but an old schoolmate dissuades him and introduces him to his wife.

title: Un amore targato Forlì
actors: Leonard Mann, Rena Niehaus, Adriana Asti, Gigi Ballista, Mario Scaccia
description: Having moved to Rome, the young Stefano Santi, faced with the realities of the capital, will repeatedly make the figure of the provincial. He will also meet Giorgia, an unscrupulous architecture student temporarily linked to a university friend.

actors: Antonio Cifariello, Dominique Wilms, Fausto Tozzi, Egle Martin

description: Gloria is a porn actress who performs in live shows. After his workmate falls ill, he is replaced by a boy, Manu, who turns out to be surprisingly good, so much so that Gloria gets involved with him. But Gloria doesn't know that the boy is full of gambling debts. Things soon start to change ...

title: Amori, letti e tradimenti
actors: Marisa Mell, Don Backy, Ugo Bologna, Sonia Viviani, Malisa Longo
description: Commendatore Mordacchia, a building speculator, tries in every way to get his grip on the lands of a shepherd. Instead, she will lose her fortunes by playing broomstick with him.

title: Ginger Snaps Back: The Beginning
actors: Katharine Isabelle, Emily Perkins, Nathaniel Arcand, JR Bourne
description: Canada, 1815: Lost in a snowy forest, Ginger and Brigitte Fitzgerald take refuge in a village whose inhabitants live in terror. Unaware of the threat looming over them (a pack of ferocious werewolves roams outside those walls), the girls realize too late the meaning of a previously heard prophecy: "Kill the child, or a sister will be forced to kill the other ... ".
notes: The script has a somewhat crude structure, but also literary echoes (Hawthorne, le Brontë) and some unpredictable subtleties. Unfortunately the direction, very flat, has a frayed pace and does not fully exploit the potential of the story.

title: Wat zien ik?
actors: Ronnie Bierman, Sylvia de Leur, Piet Römer, Jules Hamel, Bernard Droog

actors: Eric Jungmann, Michael Bailey Smith, Justin Urich, Aimée Brooks

description: Willard is harassed by the office manager at work and by his mother at home. His only friends are Cathryn and two mice that the young man decides to use as a tool of revenge. Until he finds out that they too have a plan ...
notes: Willard's head of office is R. Lee Ermey, the sergeant from "Full Metal Jacket".

title: Costa!
actors: Georgina Verbaan, Daan Schuurmans, Katja Schuurman, Kurt Rogiers
description: A week of wild and unbridled vacation on the hot beaches of the small Balearic island, which has quickly become one of the most renowned entertainment capitals in Europe. Janet, Rens, Frida and their friends, descended from the mists of cold Holland, go wild between swims, passions and nights in the disco ...

title: Beethoven's 5th
actors: Dave Thomas, Faith Ford, Daveigh Chase, Tom Poston, Katherine Helmond
description: During one of his raids, Beethoven unearths a hidden treasure. Naturally, the discovery wreaks havoc in the quiet life of the sleepy village of Quicksilver, where the friendly Saint Bernard had arrived with his friend Sara on a visit to Uncle Fred ...

title: Hong Xiguan zhi Shaolin wu zu
actors: Jet Li, Tse Miu, Chen Sung Young, Chi Chuen-Hua, Damian Lau
description: China: Shaolin warrior Kwun discovers his village destroyed and his family massacred by Manchu soldiers. The only survivor of the horrendous massacre is his son Ting, who will collaborate with his father in search of the killers ...
notes: Directors are capable of combining visual and athletic spectacularity with numerous thematic clichés.

title: La città prigioniera
actors: David Niven, Lea Massari, Ben Gazzara, Martin Balsam, Michael Craig
description: After the liberation from the Nazis, Athens became the scene of clashes between opposing partisan factions. Meanwhile, a handful of British soldiers under the orders of Major Peter Whitfield guard the Zeus hotel: among them, however, a traitor lurks. But despite his best efforts, the hotel suffers a siege and is eventually mined. Whitfield then tries to save himself and the few survivors ...
notes: Based on a novel by John Appleby, the story (scripts Eric Bercovici, Marc Brandell and Guy Elmes) does not stand out for its originality, but the cast is of great prestige. Photography by Leonida Barboni, music by Piero Piccioni.

title: The Golden Age of Comedy
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Will Rogers, Carole Lombard, Jean Harlow

title: One Hundred and One Dalmatians
directors: Clyde Geronimi, Hamilton Luske, Wolfgang Reitherman
description: Pongo is a splendid example of Dalmatian. He lives with his owner Rudy in London and works to make him fall in love with Anita, the lovely owner of a beautiful Dalmatian dog named Peggy. In no time at all, the four are back together. While Rudy and Anita are tidying up their house, helped by the housekeeper, Cruella De Mon, an old schoolmate of the girl, shows up. Cruella knows that Peggy is about to give birth to her puppies and wants to buy them to make a fur coat with their coat.
notes: Produced after the flop of Sleeping Beauty, it was a closed production and had to be made economically. The innovative possibility was then used to transfer the photographed drawing directly onto the transparencies for animation, thus skipping the inking process. And if the plot, taken from Dodie Smith's children's book of the same name, is really very elementary, the animation hasn't aged a day and gives a still modern flavor to this Disney Classic.

title: The Brothers Rico
actors: Richard Conte, Dianne Foster, Kathryn Grant, Larry Gates, James Darren

title: Hannie Caulder
actors: Raquel Welch, Robert Culp, Ernest Borgnine, Christopher Lee, Diana Dors

actors: Barbara Magnolfi, Marc Porel, Stefania D'Amario, Vanni Materassi, Antinisca Nemour
description: After the death of their father, the two sisters Dagmar and Ursula arrive in a luxurious hotel on the Riviera to overcome the moment of discouragement and get on the trail of their mother. Meanwhile, a mysterious killer begins to kill the girls in the area, all linked by a rather unusual circumstance: before being murdered, they had had sexual intercourse ...

title: La diligencia de los condenados
actors: Richard Harrison, Fernando Sancho, Erika Blanc, Bruno Corazzari, Gustavo Re, Fernando Rubio
description: A stagecoach transports the man who must testify against a dangerous criminal, Anthony Stevens, who is being held awaiting trial for murder. An accomplice of these, Ramon the Aztec, intercepts the vehicle and kidnaps the passengers, leading them to a post house guarded by a certain Robert Walton. The bandit threatens them to discover the identity of the witness, but there is a twist: Walton is actually called Wayne Sonnyer and is a former gunfighter, who has some unfinished business with Stevens. At first the man saves the hostages: then the clash with the old enemy will be inevitable.
notes: Spaghetti-western minor, signed by a Catalan director grinder of the genre.

title: The Amityville Horror
actors: Ryan Reynolds, Melissa George, Jesse James, Jimmy Bennett
description: In 1974, Ronald DeFeo, a boy suffering from mental disorders, kills all members of his family in his sleep. A year later, George and Kathy Lutz move into what appears to be their dream home, not caring what happened right there ...
notes: The American dream of home ownership stumbles upon the relentless and powerful evil, and the violence of the past resurfaces to haunt the living. Because if it's not houses that kill people, you can't even run away from your problems. Many moments of tension and fear, a balanced but effective use of effects and a quick and suspended ending. Remake of the 1979 film of the same name.

title: False Pretenses
actors: Peta Wilson, Anthony Lemke, Stewart Bick, Melanie Nicholls-King, Marie-Anne Alepin, Conrad Pia, Francis X. McCarthy, Cas Anvar
description: Diane and Rand are a loving and close-knit couple. At least until Mitch, a friend and financial advisor, disappears into thin air taking with him a large amount of money stolen from Rand's company. In reality, it is a sum that Rand himself had secretly "borrowed" from his own company over the years. Shocked by scandal and shamed, Rand chooses to commit suicide. Left alone, Diana seeks consolation, but not finding any, she decides to abandon everything and move to Mexico. At first the new challenge seems to make her find new stimuli, but when she casually meets Mitch, she realizes that it is necessary to face the past ...

title: Ladies Night
actors: Paul Michael Glaser, Claudette Mink, Kett Turton, John Salley
description: Plot in preparation

title: Crimes of Passion
actors: Dina Meyer, Jonathan Higgins, John Brennan, Amy Sloan, John H. Brennan
description: When the charming Rebecca sues Jerry Diggins, an executive of the multinational where he works, for sexual harassment, the man is fired and abandoned by his wife. In vain Jerry tries to prove his innocence but the case ends up in court. What no one suspects is that Rebecca and Jerry are lovers ...

title: Jung-Gwok chiu-yan
actors: Danny Lee, Terry Liu, Wong Hap, Yuan Man-Tzu, Lin Wen-wei
description: After a series of sinister rumblings, a dormant volcano for centuries suddenly returns to activity, sowing panic on the coasts of the Japanese archipelago. The author of the disasters is the princess Dragon Mom, queen of a people of the abyss, intent on subjugating humanity or destroying it. Professor Chang, an atomic scientist, runs for cover by transforming the kung-fu champion Rhema into Infra-Man, an invincible cyborg with exceptional abilities. The hero, half man and half machine, defeats a host of mutant sea creatures and when the terrible princess kidnaps Chang's daughter to force her father to give her similar super-powers, he doesn't hesitate to risk his life to free her.

title: Milano... difendersi o morire
actors: Marc Porel, George Hilton, Anna Maria Rizzoli, Al Cliver, Guido Leontini

title: Saint Ange
actors: Lou Doillon, Virginie Ledoyen, Catriona MacColl, Dorina Lazar
description: Anna works as a cleaner at Saint Ange, a semi-abandoned orphanage. When he suddenly begins to feel dark presences, he begins to investigate and realizes that the children were subjected to terrible atrocities.
notes: For wanting to be too “artistic”, Laugier neglects the rhythm and the film is affected, boring, never scary. With the risk that the viewer, not captured by the suspense, pays attention to the plot (predictable, as always) and immediately understands where it is headed.

title: The Running Man
actors: Laurence Harvey, Lee Remick, Alan Bates, Bob Cunningham, John Merlon
description: Rex Black, a young and experienced pilot, simulates his own death in a plane crash and thus manages to retire to Spain with his beautiful wife after having collected the substantial life insurance policy. The insurance agent, however, who investigates the dynamics of the alleged death begins to woo the fugitive's wife, unleashing unpredictable consequences ...
notes: Veteran Carol Reed shoots a pleasant and refined comedy, with the help of extraordinary actors like Lee Remick and Alan Bates, which is tinged with yellow tones and full of adventurous developments. Exciting chases, typically Britsh verve and amorous skirmishes between the protagonists worthy of the best sentimental carousel.

title: Windfall
actors: Casper Van Dien, Robert Englund, Gregg Henry, Libby Hudson
description: A terrifying hurricane is about to hit the eastern part of the United States, one of the worst in the last century. Meanwhile, a senior police officer manages to land a major casino robbery: former thieves Ace and Scratch, now the club's security guards, try to stop him from escaping ...

title: Going in Style
actors: George Burns, Art Carney, Lee Strasberg, Charles Hallahan
description: Al, Willy and Joe are three retirees who make a living on their very modest pensions. The three often meet in a modest suburban park to feed the pigeons and suffer insults from the children who are there to play every day. One day Joe decides that there is no point in wasting the time they have left to live like this and convinces the other two to land a robbery. The prospect is to finally enjoy life after so many years of sacrifice. When the fateful day arrives, something is wrong.
notes: The three old men are George Burns, Art Carney and Lee Strasberg and this is enough to save the film.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
actors: Martin Freeman, Zooey Deschanel, Mos Def, Sam Rockwell, Bill Nighy, John Malkovich, Anna Chancellor
description: One morning, Arthur Dent discovers that a bulldozer is about to tear down his house, that his best friend is actually an extraterrestrial on a mission and that the Earth is about to be destroyed: the only hope is to escape before it's too late. .
notes: Wacky adventures, alien creatures that seem to come out of the galactic bar of _Stellar Wars_ and epochal inventions such as the Point of View weapon or the Improbability Engine make the film a brilliant and intelligent apologue against the common sense that invades our present. A proposal for a new "meaning of life", which privileges friendship, love and - why not? - also the pleasure of smiling.

title: George and the Dragon
actors: James Purefoy, Piper Perabo, Patrick Swayze, Michael Clarke Duncan, Joan Plowright
description: At the end of the First Crusade to liberate the Holy Land, the soldiers return home. George, an English knight, retires to the north of the country where King Edgaar reigns. When Lunna, the king's daughter, is kidnapped George proposes to go look for her in exchange for a plot of land ...

title: Fei ying
actors: Michelle Yeoh, Luke Goss, Brandon Rhea, Brandon Chang, Lisa Selesner
description: Lulu Wong, who is a rock star by day, transforms into Silver Hawk, champion of justice, at night.
notes: Jingle Ma, active since the 80s as a director of photography, relies on the undoubted skills - acrobatic and otherwise - of Michelle Yeoh, but the final result is only for admirers of the genre.

title: Returner
actors: Takeshi Kaneshiro, Anne Suzuki, Kirin Kiki, Goro Kishitani, Yukiko Okamoto
description: 2084. The last human beings have taken refuge in the mountains of Tibet, besieged by the Daggra, an invincible alien race. The young Milly decides to go back in time, in 2002, to destroy the first spaceship and the first alien to come to earth. He meets Miyamoto, a bounty hunter intent on killing Mizoguchi, a ruthless member of the triads transplanted to Japan. Miyamoto then finds himself fighting alongside the girl against Mizoguchi's men to recover the alien ...

title: The Marrying Kind
actors: Judy Holliday, Aldo Ray, Madge Kennedy, Sheila Bond

title: Karussell des Lebens
actors: Barbara Wussow, Jacques Breuer, Aline Metzner, Christiane Höbigter
description: Prue Shackleton is courted by Nigel, a serious and honest man who could guarantee her a solid future from a sentimental and economic point of view. Undecided about what to do, Prue decides to take a long pause for reflection and goes to Cornwall to visit Aunt Phoebe, an artist. On the train that will take her to her destination, Prue meets little Charlotte Collins, a child without a family who is on her way to her grandmother where she finally hopes to find permanent accommodation. Arriving in lush green Cornwall, Prue meets Daniel Cassens, an artist friend of Aunt Phoebe, who claims to be Charlotte's father. Prue is attracted to Daniel, but is left very badly when he, without any warning, inexplicably leaves Cornwall. Meanwhile, as Charlotte's relatives seem unable to care for her, Phoebe offers her hospitality. Unexpectedly, Daniel comes back ...

title: The Little Mermaid II: Return to the Sea
description: Ariel's daughter, Melody, is unwittingly drawn into the vengeful Morgana in the diabolical plan to conquer the Seven Seas. Thanks to childhood friends Sebastian and Flounder, Ariel will be able to free the little girl from Morgana's clutches.
notes: Useless and parasitic sequel, released only in home video.

title: Fritz the Cat
description: A frequenter of brothels and drug-based parties, to escape police repression, the cat Fritz leaves New York for California, in the company of a stone marten. Along the way he ends up involved in the attack of a Nazi biker. Admitted to hospital, he regains strength more by virtue of female visits than medical treatment ...
notes: Based on the well-known underground comic by Robert Crumb, it is the first cartoon v.m. 18. Fiercely anti-Disney (even in the graphic style full of contrasts), it hits the mark with the portrait of a protagonist who poses subversive but embodies the desires of the average man. Terrible the Italian dubbing.

title: The Incredible Hulk: Married
actors: Bill Bixby, Jack Colvin, Lou Ferrigno, Rosalind Chao, Brian Cutler

actors: Thomas Lee, Peter Conway, Deborah Scott

Incredibly had to be nominated for Oscar for visual effects but given the shortage of films with these characteristics, in 1974 the Academy did not award the prize.

title: Histoire d'O
actors: Corinne Cléry, Udo Kier, Anthony Steel, Jean Gaven, Christiane Minazzoli
description: The beautiful photographer or is conducted by his René, of which he is a real slave, at Roissy Castle. According to the will of his lover and master, in that perverse place he subjected to sadomasoed rituals by masked men, including the cold and brutal Sir Stephen. However, he falls in love with her and states teachingly willing to the retaliation of O.
notes: Inspired by the novel of the same name by Pauline Réage.

title: Histoire d'O: Chapitre 2
actors: Sandra Wey, Rosa Valenty, Manuel de Blas, Carole James, Christian Cid
description: To prevent a rich financier from purchasing their company, a group of industrialists pays Madame or to organize a party based on Sadomaso Games, and then blackmail the man.

title: Simona
actors: Laura Antonelli, Patrick Magee, Maurizio Degli Esposti, Raf Vallone
description: During a bullfight, Simona has a flashback that brings her back to the torrid relationship with the young Georges he became a lover. Together, they involve a third woman in their amusements, Marcelle, cultured to spy on the two in intimate attitudes and victim of the constraints of a father and uncle possessive and incestuous.

title: The Pumpkin Eater
actors: Anne Bancroft, Peter Finch, James Mason, Richard Johnson
description: Jo and her third husband Jake live in London in a family extended with six of her eight children but the marriage crosses a period of difficulty. She is convinced that he betrays her and accuses him continuously. On the other hand, her psychiatrist believes that she uses motherhood as a sort of justification to mask her sexual drives (and from this the large offspring). Jo is exhausted and all this creates a mental fragility in her that will have to be addressed in a final confrontation with Jake.

title: Anna, quel particolare piacere
actors: Edwige Fenech, Corrado Pani, Richard Conte, John Richardson
description: Anna loves Guido, who traffics drugs. She ends up getting into the business, but, getting pregnant, she refuses to have an abortion. For this, he flees to Rome, and he ends up in jail, but for a short time.
notes: It starts as a crime story but ends up in a third-rate melody, alternating outbursts of violence, nudity and tear-jerking sequences.

title: Maschio, femmina, fiore, frutto
actors: Anna Oxa, Ninetto Davoli, Massimo Boldi, Jimmy il Fenomeno
description: Two twins arrive in Rome from Bari and undertake different paths. In the end, both of them are destined to sing as if they were one, but of dual and ambiguous sex.
notes: Anna Oxa plays both characters, with rare transforming enthusiasm. The film is the culmination of Galliano Juso's trashy Apulian production: a series of regional sculptures involving the Tuscan Carlo Monni, Massimo Boldi and even Jimmy il Fenomeno. For fans of junk cinema, a milestone; for the canonical viewer, a horrendous film; for anyone, a product for which one can only feel tenderness. Ruggero Miti will close his film directorial career here.

title: Il piacere
actors: Lilli Carati, Isabella Andrea Guzon, Steve Wyler, Laura Gemser, Dagmar Lassander

title: Alla ricerca del piacere
actors: Barbara Bouchet, Farley Granger, Rosalba Neri, Umberto Raho, Patrizia Viotti, Dino Mele, Petar Martinovic

title: Casa di piacere
actors: Valentine Demy, Alex Freyberger, Alessandro Scotti, David D'Ingeo

title: La seconda notte di nozze
actors: Antonio Albanese, Katia Ricciarelli, Neri Marcoré, Angela Luce, Marisa Merlini, Patrizio Pelizzi
description: Italy, end of the Second World War: Lilliana, widow, is forced to leave Bologna with Nino due to serious economic problems. The two move to Puglia near their brother-in-law Giordano, brother of Lilliana's husband, who had been madly in love with her in his youth ...
notes: The story of an upside-down migratory journey (from North to South, but above all from the city to the countryside, as it happened during and at the end of the war), the film has the air of a fairy tale of other times, those in which the differences are they could still reconcile, concrete needs regulated dreams. Written as always on the tip of a pen, with perfect interpreters.

title: La bestia nel cuore
actors: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Luigi Lo Cascio, Alessio Boni, Stefania Rocca, Angela Finocchiaro, Francesca Inaudi, Giuseppe Battiston
description: Sabina has everything to be happy: she is beautiful, she has a job she likes and a partner she loves. But for some time she has been plagued by strange nightmares. When she becomes pregnant, Sabina looks back on her childhood spent in a middle-class family and brings back a distressing secret ...
notes: It has all the flaws of recent Italian cinema, with penniless people living in lofts. The direction oscillates (too) cautiously between different tones and the desire to close the circle at all costs is excessive, to give a sort of "happy ending" to each character, arriving at a questionable parallel between incest and adultery. The comedy brackets with Finocchiaro and Battiston are saved, but it's really too little.

title: I giorni dell'abbandono
actors: Margherita Buy, Luca Zingaretti, Goran Bregovic, Alessia Goria
description: Olga, thirty-five with two children, is left by her husband. After completely losing her self-confidence, she finds happiness again thanks to an encounter with a neighboring musician and a painful self-analysis.
notes: It could have been a melting pot of love and madness, and above all a descent into a state of hallucination (and subsequent rise). Instead, the film directed and written - with many co-writers - by Faenza, from the novel by Elena Ferrante, is a missed opportunity, by defect and by excess. Due to the constant "bass" (from TV movie) held by the camera, the text becomes excessive and redundant, with a heavy risk of ridicule.

title: Cinderella Man
actors: Russell Crowe, Renée Zellweger, Paul Giamatti, Craig Bierko, Paddy Considine, Bruce McGill
description: In the years of the Great Depression, to be able to support his family, James Braddock decides to try his luck with boxing: and in 1935, he arrives to challenge the world heavyweight champion Max Baer in a fifteen round match ...
notes: Family film, with children proud of their father and devoted and faithful wife. But also a choral film, with a champion (hero of the "working class") who knows how to embody the popular sentiment and the desire for rebirth that belongs to everyone. Crowe has the face of the honest boxer, the good family man and the Cinderella whose dream doesn't end at midnight. The manager Giamatti is all passion, eyes, brain and irony.

title: Due contro tutti
actors: Walter Chiari, Raimondo Vianello, Aroldo Tieri, Licia Calderon, Maria Silva, Antonio Molino Rojo, Félix Fernández, Rafael Luis Calvo
description: After a long wandering, the Bull brothers and Jonathan Bullivan find themselves in Golden City, a town in the Deep West, in the hands of a group of criminals led by Mayor Fats Missouri. Will our heroes succeed in making justice triumph?
notes: Nonsense disguised as a western comedy.

title: Guess Who
actors: Bernie Mac, Ashton Kutcher, Zoë Saldana, Judith Scott, Nicole Sullivan
description: Percy Jones always thought his gorgeous daughter Theresa would be married to a guy halfway between Denzel Washington, Colin Powell and Tiger Woods. When Theresa brings Simon Green home, her father is not the happiest as the groom-to-be is ... white.

notes: Slowly and with various uncertainties and narrative inconsistencies, the film slowly deflates after a promising start and Nigel Cole misses the opportunity to once again demonstrate the good things that had been said about him for Grace's Weed and Calendar Girls.

title: Mindhunters
country: United States, Netherlands, Great Britain, Finland
actors: Val Kilmer, Christian Slater, LL Cool J, Kathryn Morris, Jonny Lee Miller, Eion Bailey
description: Seven promising FBI agents must pass a final test to become psychological profiling. They are then transported to a desert island by Jake Harris, an instructor with unorthodox methods, and here they have to contend with a time-obsessed serial killer, called "the puppeteer". But the simulation becomes reality when one by one the members of the team fall victim to ingenious traps that target their weaknesses.
notes: Imagine a cross between Ten Little Indians and Survivor (with a hint of the classic The Dangerous Game). On an implausible cue, almost more science fiction than thriller, a heavy-footed action-movie specialist bases a film that holds up for the first hour and then collapses with disheartening predictability. The characters are opaque, the cast does not shine, suspended between old aborted promises (Kilmer and Slater) and new uncertain promises.

notes: Cantet conducts Rampling very well - hard and fragile, impenetrable and melodramatic - and Young, shocked by the first orgasm experienced on the sand and therefore a prisoner of that dream. title: Gabrielle
