description: Paris, early 1900s. Hervey comes home one evening and finds his wife's farewell letter. Which, surprisingly, returns after a few hours. Not as if nothing had happened, but almost. In his life another man, perhaps insignificant. Between the two begins a game of psychological slaughter, ready to explode into drama.
notes: Taken from a story by Conrad, which alluded to the helplessness of the positivist man, very sure of himself, in the face of the whirlwind of passion, jealousy, and obsession with love. Chéreau chooses as a register that of "chamber" cinema, very focused on the actors (Pascal Greggory and Isabelle Huppert are monstrously good), on the close-ups, on the glimpses of the environment stolen here and there. The result is stylistically perfect, rigorous in its handling but also formal and a little plastered.

title: Good Night, and Good Luck.
actors: David Strathairn, George Clooney, Jeff Daniels, Robert Downey jr., Patricia Clarkson
description: 1953: Edward R. Murrow, famous CBS anchorman and host of the talk show "Person to Person", comes into possession of a ban list belonging to Senator Joseph McCarthy and containing the names of suspected pro-Communists. Despite the difficulties and threats, Murrow manages - with the help of his producer - to return repeatedly to the burning topic ...
notes: Reworking themes, structures and stylistic features of the best US cinema of the 50s, 60s and 70s, with a pasty and contrasting black and white, tight dialogues and an exemplary cast, Clooney's film keeps the pleasure of storytelling in perfect balance. the moral requirement.

title: Les amants réguliers
actors: Louis Garrel, Clotilde Hesme, Julien Lucas, François Toumarkine
description: Paris, 1969: returning from the burning experience of the "joli mai" of the previous year, some young people turn to opium. Between two of them, a 20-year-old and a girl of the same age, an intense and limitless love is born ...
notes: It is clear, a film like _Les amants réguliers_ can annoy on principle. the combination of "French May" - "black and white" is likely to reject. What is there still to say about a contemporary myth like that of Paris in 1968, already mummified by the rhetoric of those who were there or who persevered in believing that only those years were formidable? The annoyance is understandable. All the more so if to recall those moments is a maudit filmmaker, still tied to an image of a pure artist, far from the compromises of the market, so romantic in its definition as to appear "impossible". Where will the makeup be? In an age that has lost its innocence, in short, _Les amants réguliers_ is an alien, more than from another world of another time. And perhaps this paradox makes it, as well as essential, very topical.

title: Mary
actors: Juliette Binoche, Matthew Modine, Forest Whitaker, Heather Graham, Stefania Rocca, Marion Cotillard
description: Marie, an actress is trapped in the part of Mary Magdalene that she has just finished playing and decides to flee to Jerusalem; Tony, a presumptuous and arrogant director lost in contemplation of himself and his work; and Ted, a television reporter who is doing a special on Jesus Christ and is completely absorbed in his work and his metropolitan lifestyle.
notes: Filmed with an enveloping and sinuous style, with the camera that is on the characters and follows their wandering, Mary is like an uninterrupted flow, narrative and of consciences, where crises, explosions, breaks never arrive alone but they chase each other, from Jerusalem to New York, from one year to the next, from a cinema hall to a television studio to a synagogue. The explosion of a bomb in Jerusalem is reflected in the crisis of a newborn crying and unable to breathe in an incubator in New York: the private and the collective are inexorably mixed in all corners of the world and we, taken at the center of a whirlpool of suffering, we cannot but collapse, question ourselves, ask for forgiveness. More beautiful in the New York part, nocturnal, macerated by the lights and blacks that mix in the cross fades, and a little more didactic in the Middle Eastern part, however Mary has a compact and tormenting strength that never stops. It is the film of an author who has passed through the circles of hell, has somehow re-emerged from it and now asks us to have, with him, the courage to look inside and around us.

title: The Brothers Grimm
country: Great Britain, United States, Czech Republic
actors: Matt Damon, Heath Ledger, Monica Bellucci, Jonathan Pryce, Peter Stormare
description: During the Napoleonic Empire, Will and Jack Grimm made their living by protecting peasants from monsters and demons with the help of exorcisms and fake magic formulas. When the French authorities discover that the two are deceivers, Will and Jack, to escape arrest, find refuge in an enchanted forest where they meet a sorceress who tests their courage.
notes: Critics have been hostile to this film, but if the writing shows uncertainties, the image takes her by the hand and supports her. The hide and seek game between reality and fantasy transports the viewer to an alchemical cinema where each shot shows an extraordinary wealth of details and a multiplication of the action, as in the great paintings by Bosch and Bruegel, without giving up making us smile at our fears.

title: Brokeback Mountain
actors: Jake Gyllenhaal, Heath Ledger, Michelle Williams, Anne Hathaway, Scott Michael Campbell, Anna Faris, Randy Quaid, Linda Cardellini, Kate Mara, Roberta Maxwell, Peter McRobbie

notes: The fact that the two lovers are men, representatives of a virile imagination par excellence (the western one), is almost secondary. Even if from the closures of the context - from the tragedy of having to hide in order to love and from the certainty of not being able to be accepted by the world - the forced choices that determine the destinies of both arise, and which are therefore almost a blasphemy. _The Secrets of Brokeback Mountain_ is also an ensemble film, because the three families (that of Ennis, that of Jack, plus the latter's parents to whom a splendid sequence is dedicated in the finale) go to reconstruct that "American fresco" so dear to the Taiwanese director since the time of _Ice Storm_. The not at all obvious rehearsals of the two protagonists, Jake Gyllenhall (Jack) and Heath Ledger (Ennis), add a few more thrills to a vision that in itself ensures vast emotions.

notes: Meirelles with The Constant Gardener comes out of Brazil and faces an adaptation from Le Carré with an international cast and production to tell in flashbacks, between England and Africa, the love story between a quiet British diplomat and a fervent activist for human rights. Well played by Ralph Fiennes and Rachel Weisz, the film is still a hybrid, a somewhat lacquered gift box for audiences willing to a little commitment. Quite traditional, though.

Starting from a Gaberian slogan, attributable to the screenplay by Rossella Drudi, Claudio Fragasso consumes a nice revenge against the committed generation of '77. description: Antoine manages to get himself sent to Tangier to supervise a construction site. Here he finally finds Cécile ... Thirty years ago they loved each other, they broke up and never saw each other again. She has a new life, but he has never been able to forget it. Antoine has only one fixed idea: to win her back.
notes: The film, presented at the Berlinale in 2004, is a kind of renewed version of The Lady Next Door by François Truffaut, directed by two very intense and close-knit actors. The set is no longer the soul of the story, but a backdrop, nourished at most by collective feelings of guilt that remain in the background. Unbalanced and exhausted.

title: Deuce Bigalow: European Gigolo
actors: Jeroen Krabbe, Til Schweiger, Elisabetta Canalis, Hanna Verboom, Rob Schneider, Eddie Griffin
description: Deuce Bigalow decides to exploit his success with women by becoming a gigolo. To learn the art of seduction, attend classes at a dedicated college in England. He discovers that there is a secret and very exclusive society to which all high-class gigolos are associated and that a serial killer is killing the best seducers ...
notes: It is the sequel to _Deuce Bigalow: Male Gigolo_ (1999), which came out in Italy with the title _Gigolò per mistake_. What prompted Columbia (among the producers is Adam Sandler, who appears for a moment) to reprogram the stupid "erotic" misadventures is easily understood. And there is even a cameo by Elisabetta Canalis ...

title: Fragile
actors: Calista Flockhart, Yasmin Murphy, Elena Anaya, Gemma Jones, Richard Roxburgh, Colin McFarlane
description: A children's hospital is close to closing, but due to a train disaster, everything is postponed for a few days. Nurse Amy grows fond of Maggie, who claims that on the second floor, sealed off for years, Charlotte "the mechanical child" still roams.
notes: Japanese-style ghost story, a rare example of a film that "is" its title: fragile.

title: Backstage
actors: Samuel Benchetrit, Sandy Lakdar, Isild Le Besco, Noémie Lvovsky, Emmanuelle Seigner
description: Lucie, 17, is a "normal" teenager. His mother, an autograph collector, devotes all his free time to chasing the characters he loves. Lucie, on the other hand, has only one star on her mind. Everybody knows. Her room is covered in photos of her beloved. One day, by chance, fate leads her to approach him ...

title: Corpse Bride
description: Victor is about to marry his girlfriend Victoria when, on the way to join her, he stops in a forest to rest. A twig pokes out of the ground and, as a joke, Victor slips the wedding ring into it. The twig is revealed to be the finger of a girl killed long before she comes back to life and claims to be officially married to Victor.
notes: In his Spoon River musical, reminiscent of Disney's "skeleton dance" and the dueling skeletons of _The Argonauts_, Burton focuses on love, the beating heart and the emptiness of the pains of love that hurts. This applies to both the living and the dead.

title: All the Invisible Children
directors: Mehdi Charef, Emir Kusturica, Spike Lee, Ridley Scott, Stefano Veneruso, John Woo
actors: Maria Grazia Cucinotta, Rosie Perez, Damaris Edwards, Wu Jiang, Ernesto Mahieux
description: Seven episodes that have stolen childhood as their leitmotif, the existence of defenseless creatures who suffer from serious social problems, but also from the indifference of adults who walk looking too high and seem to ignore them ...
notes: If Truffaut had not been carried away by death before his time, he would have sponsored the initiative, although he was well aware of the difficulties in filming (reporting, reworking) the stumbling blocks of all growth and making children "act" bypassing the inevitable rhetoric that surrounds almost always a story, a non-adult drama.

title: Elizabethtown
actors: Orlando Bloom, Kirsten Dunst, Susan Sarandon, Judy Greer, Jessica Biel, Alec Baldwin
description: Drew Baylor has just lost his job and his fiancée when he is informed that he must return to his hometown of Elizabethtown in Kentucky to attend his father's funeral. On the plane he meets Claire Colburn, a stewardess who helps him fix his life ...
notes: A film about the wisdom of personal failure, about provincial America that is healthy and not a horror background, about creative mourning, rebirth "on the road", love that is born on board and the music that plays inside. And on the history of cinema, on actors, on Hollywood and on the hope that we can look beyond the blockbusters, the slippery and immunodeficient screenplays.

title: Qi jian
actors: Dai Liwu, Kim So-yeon, Duncan Lai, Leon Lai, Liu Chia-Liang, Sun Honglei, Donnie Yen, Charlie Young
description: China, early 15th century: the new government of the Ming dynasty decides to ban martial arts. But seven brave warriors, who have taken refuge in a remote village, are not willing to accept this imposition ...
notes: The realistic and claustrophobic conception of the "wuxiapian" according to Tsui clearly differs from the new age vision of Zhang Yimou and Ang Lee: here the solemnity of samurai iconography, the usual supernatural choreography of Chinese swordsmen and the rude concreteness of an imaginary less refined and more barbaric. The result is epic and cruel: those who thought it was no longer hero time will have to change their mind.

title: Four Brothers
actors: Mark Wahlberg, Tyrese Gibson, Andre Benjamin, Garrett Hedlund, Fionnula Flanagan
description: Bobby, Angel, Jeremiah and Jack are adoptive siblings, each with a radically different existence from the others. When their foster mother is killed in a robbery, the four reunite to find the culprit ...
notes: John Singleton, after the remake of _Shaft_, continues on the path of the action blockbuster designed especially for the African American public, and this time it hits the mark, at least in terms of box office. That he is a talented director is out of the question. This is demonstrated by some purely adrenaline-fueled sequences, such as the Fort Apache-like shooting at the four brothers' house and the showdown between the boss of the bad guys and Mark Wahlberg in the "desert" of snow and ice. Too bad he relies on the easy and tangled script by David Elliot and Paul Lovett, overloaded with unlikely moments (above all, the siege of the corrupt cop and Tyrese with its incredible epilogue). Of the old militancy, that is when he dreamed of a radical cinema, Singleton retains few things, just the amusing hint of the union of gangsters. The rest, honestly, is business as usual.

title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose
actors: Laura Linney, Shohreh Aghdashloo, JR Bourne, Jennifer Carpenter, Tom Wilkinson
description: The lawyer Erin Bruner reluctantly agrees to defend a priest, Father Moore, accused of the murder of a young woman to whom he practiced an exorcism ... This is a very rare case of demonic possession recognized by the Catholic Church, and in fact an aura of holiness.
notes: The contamination between legal thriller and horror is original, with an alternation between the trial phases (not very successful to tell the truth) and satanic flashbacks. The direction plays little with special effects and a lot on colors, sound and above all on the convincing evidence of Tom Wilkinson and Carpenter, engaged in screams and frightening contortions.

title: Edmond
actors: William H. Macy, Julia Stiles, Joe Mantegna, Rebecca Pidgeon, Ling Bai, Frances Bay
description: Due to the premonition of a sorceress, Edmond Burke completely changes his life: he abandons his job as a stockbroker and leaves his wife. But things are not going quite as he had imagined ..
notes: Edmond is directed by a cult horror director, is based on a play by a cult author (David Mamet), and he would have liked to become a (small) cult. But Gordon's short film perishes under the blows of the petty philosophy of a preaching, simplistic and old play.

title: Casanova
actors: Heath Ledger, Jeremy Irons, Charlie Cox, Lena Olin, Sienna Miller, Stephen Greif
description: Casanova falls in love with the beautiful Venetian Francesca, who rejects him. While the Inquisition is on his trail to arrest him, Casanova tries in every way to approach Francesca ...
notes: The 1950s air of the film evokes more _The Adventures of Giacomo Casanova_ di Steno than Fellini's obscure eighteenth century. After his "authorial" beginnings (_My life on all fours, _Happy birthday Mr. Grape_), Hallström has unfortunately got stuck in the recent "European-flavored" Hollywood cinema, which is a far more deadly trap than Hollywood escape cinema. So he takes himself a little too seriously, failing to be light and have fun all the way.

title: Bubble
actors: Debbie Doebereiner, Dustin Ashley, Misty Dawn Wilkins
description: What to do in the suburbs of Ohio when you are (almost) dead? Work, eat, sleep and go back to work. It is the biorhythm of Kyle, a reserved boy who finds in Martha a shoulder for a chat, in front of fries and hamburgers, at the canteen of the doll factory where they work. Young Rose bursts in from outside, disrupting their routine. He has a daughter, another rhythm, and in fact it doesn't last long there. When she is murdered, in her house, the culprit must necessarily be a monster from outside. Or maybe not.
notes: Immersion of Soderbergh in the most depressing province, with a violence that dozes and escapes uncontrollably, deaf. Merciless gaze and photography.

title: Le parfum de la dame en noir
actors: Denis Podalydès, Sabine Azéma, Jean-Noël Brouté, Pierre Arditi, Isabelle Candelier
description: Mathilde Stangerson and Robert Darzac, recently married, go on vacation to their friends Edith and Arthur Rance at the Castle of Hercules. But Larsan reappears on their way, terrifying the beautiful Mathilde. Inspector Rouletabille, with the help of faithful Sainclair, investigates to find out how Larsan managed to break into the castle.

title: The Fine Art of Love-Mine Haha
actors: Urbano Barberini, Jacqueline Bisset, Enrico Lo Verso, Galatea Ranzi, Eva Grimaldi
description: Germany, early 1900s. Some girls are raised in a boarding school next to the Black Forest. The girls grow up completely isolated from the world, without knowing what happens outside the walls of the boarding school.

title: Tau man chi D
directors: Wai Keung Lau, Siu Fai Mak
actors: Jay Chou, Anne Suzuki, Edison Chen, Anthony Wong Chau-Sang, Chau-Sang, Shawn Yue
description: After winning his first race, 18-year-old Takumi turns his attention to racing "drifts", a sport he has been able to practice every day delivering tofu with his father's Toyota AE86.

title: Final Fantasy VII: Advent Children
description: Two years after defeating Sephiroth, Cloud finds himself alone again, mulling over the past wondering if he has acted in the better world. The world is back to normal, but a major epidemic is spreading across the country ...

title: Yôkai daisensô
actors: Ryuunosuke Kamiki, Hiroshi Aramata, Kiyoshirô Imawano, Chiaki Kuriyama
description: While "visiting" the remains of ancient Babylon to find some hidden treasure, two looters accidentally wake up Daimon, a demon trapped in the ruins of the city ...

title: No One Can Hear You
actors: Kelly McGillis, Kate Elliott, Tom Huntington, Kieren Hutchison, Emily Barclay
description: Trish Burchall is a reporter whose job it is to track down a serial killer. The "modus operandi" of this latest maniac involves first the killing of young women, then the massacre of their relatives. The police try to keep the investigation secret and avoid the hype of the press, so Trish is forced to investigate on her own. Obviously she will put her life in serious danger: in fact, the more she discovers about the killer, the more she recognizes herself and her family in the profile of potential victims ...
notes: Yet another thriller with a serial killer on the hunt for a beautiful girl. Everything spotted.

title: Sat sau ji wong
actors: Jet Li, Eric Tsang, Simon Yam, Gigi Leung, Keiji Sato, Paul Rapovski
description: When an elderly Japanese millionaire learns that someone will try to kill him, he offers a huge reward to whoever brings him the hit man. Nonetheless, the rich man leaves his skin, but the bounty will still be given to whoever catches the murderer: a disgraced killer and an athletic poor fellow with pangs of conscience team up to find the "king of murderers" ...
notes: Jet Li plays a more comic role than usual, but shares the weight of the comedy with the good and likeable Eric Tsang, the "Hong Kongese Danny DeVito". Although the humor is not entirely convincing, the excellent action choreography saves the film.

title: Dune
actors: William Hurt, Alec Newman, Giancarlo Giannini, Saskia Reeves, James Watson
description: Paul and Jessica Atreides with Duke Leto, father of Paul, are sent by the emperor of the galaxy to Arrakis, a city on the desolate planet Dune, with the task of increasing the production of the precious spice. The Atreides take over from the Harkonnen family who, not wanting to lose such a profitable concession, meditates revenge ...

title: Deadly Isolation
actors: Sherilyn Fenn, Nicholas Lea, Andreas Apergis, Marcel Jeannin, Sara Bradeen
description: As Susan mourns the death of her husband Ron, two criminals escape from prison. These are the men who participated with him in the theft of a lot of diamonds. Convinced that Susan is the key to finding the stolen property Patrick, the more charming of the two, approaches the woman and earns her trust. But the police are on their trail ...

title: Chain of Command
actors: Michael Dudikoff, Todd Curtis, Keren Tishman, R. Lee Ermey, Steve Greenstein

title: Poslednij poezd
actors: Pavel Romanov, Pjotr Merkurev, Aleksej Merkurev, Natalja L'vova
description: While the final Nazi defeat takes place in the Russian winter, the corpulent doctor Paul Fischbach is catapulted to the front (assuming that someone, in the general collapse, still knows where the front is ...). Faced with the desolation of the soldiers and the senseless cruelty that surrounds him, Fischbach's peaceful and good-natured nature and his own professional ethics enter an irreversible crisis ...
notes: Born in 1976 and son of the homonymous great director of St. Petersburg (the author of My friend Ivan Lapscin and Controlli sulla strada), German jr. begins by signing a work that does not leave indifferent.

title: Cave In
actors: Mimi Rogers, Ted Shackelford, Bruce Allpress, Paul Gittins, John Brazier

title: Beautiful
actors: Minnie Driver, Kathleen Turner, Hallie Kate Eisenberg, Joey Lauren Adams, Leslie Stefanson
description: Mona is a girl with a specific dream: to become Miss America. All his actions are aimed at this goal. To complicate her plans is an unexpected pregnancy, which resizes her entire lifestyle.
notes: A missed opportunity for Sally Field to prove that she is as good as a director as she is as an actress

title: Ladri ma non troppo
actors: Valerio Mastandrea, Marco Giallini, Pierfrancesco Favino, Carlotta Natoli, Giorgio Tirabassi
description: Cosimo, his wife Marisa and his friend Ruggero pretend to be art thieves, but in reality they collaborate with the police commissioner to crush the powerful criminal organization led by Napoleone Vallero. In preparation for the shot, however, the three are fascinated by the charisma of the skilled and expert gentleman thief.

title: Rough Air: Danger on Flight 534
actors: Eric Roberts, Alexandra Paul, Anne Openshaw, Kevin Jubinville, Russell Yuen
description: Aircraft pilot Mike Hogan stopped flying after unintentionally causing an accident. But the company is in urgent need of officers and so is forced to return to service in spite of himself. His return is anything but peaceful: on the 534 aircraft in which he is co-pilot, a vacuum creates panic; moreover, a dangerous killer knocks the captain out of his hands. Mike is forced to maneuver the vehicle alone through a storm and to deal with the criminal who has taken the passengers hostage. Plus the flight attendant is his ex-girlfriend.
notes: Yet another television variation on the theme of _Airport_, obviously complete with a heroic and tormented protagonist.

title: Wedding Crashers
actors: Owen Wilson, Vince Vaughn, Christopher Walken, Rachel McAdams, Keir O’Donnell, Isla Fisher, Jane Seymour, Bradley Cooper
description: John Beckwith and Jeremy Gray, business partners (they are divorce mediators) and lifelong friends, share the same hobby: inviting themselves to weddings. Whether it's a Jewish, Italian, Irish, Chinese or Hindu reception, the two take advantage of the situation to meet and win over the guests. But one day...
notes: Of course, those expecting an auteur cinema will be disappointed: but slapstick, "politically incorrect" and social satire mix well, and we laugh often and willingly. It is just a pity that the writers did not have the courage to give more space to splendid ancillary characters such as the old grandmother, who may be dumb but has understood everything about life.

title: Buena Vida
actors: Ignacio Toselli, Moro Anghileri, Óscar Núñez, Alicia Palmes, Sofia da Silva
description: Hernán's house is bought by Pato's parents, his fiancée, with the intention of turning it into a pastry shop ...

title: Nine Lives
actors: Glenn Close, Sissy Spacek, Robin Wright, Holly Hunter, Dakota Fanning
description: Sandra, who has been in prison for some time, would like to establish contact with her son who has come to visit her. Diana has started a new life, but has to deal with a past relationship. Holly discovers that her stepfather caused her great pain. Sonia is upset because her boyfriend has revealed a secret of theirs to friends. Samantha must act as a peacemaker between her parents in constant quarrel. Lorna tries to console her ex-husband after his wife's suicide. Ruth thinks about abandoning her husband for her lover. Camille has to deal with the new limits of her body. Maggie allows her life to be overshadowed by that of her daughter Maria ...
notes: The experiment of García, son of the Nobel Márquez and winner of the last Locarno Film Festival, obviously risks being artificial but is often saved for a certain rawness and for the commitment of the actresses (which would have been better not to dub). However, it remains a film that is too "written", a virtuoso concentration of nine series of Donne al bivio in ten minutes. The most intense episodes are the first three and the last two.

title: Evil Eyes
actors: Adam Baldwin, Udo Kier, Mark Sheppard, Jennifer Gates, Kristin Lorenz

title: Elvis Has Left the Building
actors: Kim Basinger, John Corbett, Annie Potts, Sean Astin, Mike Starr
description: It seems that the life of Harmony, a cosmetics seller, is inextricably linked to Elvis Presley: not only was the woman born during one of his concerts, but one day she runs over a group of "the King" impersonators with the car. Frightened, she escapes by being chased by the FBI ...
notes: Zwick has an idea not even bad, that of a curse that falls on the double of Elvis: it is a pity he does not know what to do about it. Most of the time the film turns in vain, and we end up regretting even the previous and banalotto _My big, fat Greek wedding_. The Italian title, for once, almost seems like a fair punishment.

title: El sol bajo la tierra
actors: Fabio Testi, Eduardo Fajardo, Massimo Serato, Alan Collins

title: Don't Give Up the Ship
actors: Jerry Lewis, Dina Merrill, Diana Spencer, Mickey Shaughnessy

title: Ti piace Hitchcock?
actors: Elio Germano, Chiara Conti, Elisabetta Rocchetti, Cristina Brondo, Ivan Morales
description: In the video library, the film student Giulio observes Sasha and Federica, two beautiful women in their thirties, as they compete for the rental of _Delitto per delitto_. Furthermore, Sasha lives in the building opposite Giulio, who begins to spy on her: so, when her mother is found dead, the boy suspects that the two young women - emulating Hitchcock's film - have exchanged the favor of a murder. Obsessed with this hypothesis, he decides to follow Federica to prevent a second crime, but the shadowing takes his hand and a ruinous fall forces him in a plaster cast in his apartment, where he fears he could be the next victim himself ...

title: Broken Blossoms
actors: Lillian Gish, Richard Barthelmess, Donald Crisp, Arthur Howard
description: Chen, a spiritual teacher and peaceful popularizer of Buddhist doctrine, goes to England to spread his teachings. During his stay in London he meets Lucy, a girl for whom he feels a sincere attraction, who has the misfortune of being tormented and mistreated by his father, a famous boxer. And when Chen intervenes during one of the man's outbursts, rescuing Lucy from his beating, he is forced to face the boxer's desire for revenge.

title: Judith of Betulia
actors: Henry Walthall, Blanche Sweet, Mae Marsh, Robert Harron

title: Orphans of the Storm
actors: Lillian Gish, Dorothy Gish, Joseph Schildkraut, Frank Losee

title: La strana voglia
directors: Pasquale Fanetti, Roberto Francesconi, Fedor Skubonia
actors: Malù, Ángeles López Barea, Giancarlo Teodori, Zvonco Zrncic
description: Jeff, theatrical director and musician, collects a young homeless man on the street, who becomes the object of his desire. Soon, Jeff's ex -girlfriend discovers the new tree of the ancient lover and, out of spite, decides to seduce her.

title: Voglia di guardare
actors: Jenny Tamburi, Marino Masé, Sebastiano Somma, Laura Gemser, Lilli Carati
description: A surgeon requires the young wife to satisfy the desire for the owner of a brothel. In doing so, he will be able to spy on her hidden behind a mirror.

title: Mulan II
description: The emperor of China asks Mulan and her future husband Shang to escort his three daughters to the province of Mongolia. The marriage that awaits the girls is used by the emperor to establish a new alliance. The proud Mulan will make a decision that will please the girls very much.

title: Povero Cristo
actors: Mino Reitano, Edmund Purdom, Curd Jürgens, Rosemarie Dexter

title: Give Us This Day
actors: Lea Padovani, Sam Wanamaker, Kathleen Ryan, Charles Goldner

title: Ride in the Whirlwind
actors: Jack Nicholson, Millie Perkins, Cameron Mitchell, Katherine Squire
description: Welcomed and nourished by a certain Blind Dick, the cowboys Wes, Vern and Otis are unaware that their host is part of a gang of robbers and murderers. They are therefore mistaken for accomplices and attacked by the men of the law: Otis leaves us the feathers, while the other two manage to escape. But due to the events, Vern will also die and the peaceful Wes will be forced to kill ...
notes: Made rough and essential by the direction of Hellman, the film (written by Nicholson himself) represents, together with its twin _The Shootout_, one of the key titles of the anti-rhetorical turning point suffered by the American genre par excellence during the 1960s.

title: Deus e o Diabo na terra do sol
actors: Geraldo Del Rey, Yoná Magalhães, Lidio Silva, Othon Bastos
description: In the Brazilian Northeast, the farmer Manuel enters the circle of a bizarre saint, the "blessed" Sebastião. Transformed into the "cangaceiro" Satanás, however, he will have to beware of the terrible António das Mortes, executioner of all the "blessed" ...
notes: The prophet of "Cinema nôvo" sets up a complex metaphor on the historical-social dialectic of his country.

title: Plain Truth
actors: Mariska Hargitay, Alison Pill, Kate Trotter, Alec McClure, Andrew Martin-Smith
description: Eighteen-year-old Katie, who lives in a small Amish community in Pennsylvania, is accused of giving birth to and then killing a child whose body has just been found. The girl will be hired by the energetic lawyer Ellie Harrison, who will have to move to the Amish community ...

title: Locusts
actors: Lucy Lawless, John Heard, Dylan Neal, Greg Alan Williams
description: When a deadly attack of locusts strikes in the United States, genetically created in the laboratory and particularly aggressive, the Department of Agriculture calls into question Dr. Maddy Rierdon: the strong-willed and determined scientist is in fact the only person able to manage the very delicate emergency...

title: Colpo grosso... grossissimo... anzi probabile
actors: Nino Castelnuovo, Luciana Paluzzi, Terry-Thomas, Juan José Menéndez
description: Calogero, Antonio and the "Monsignore" plan a robbery against the Roman Department Stores. They call to their aid a skilled (unfortunately only of fame) French burglar, Pierre Le Compte. He arrives accompanied by his lover Jacqueline who gets to know Sandro. The man, after the usual internship, will become president of the Roman Department Stores (but neither the girl nor her friends know his identity). Upon request, Sandro, also to please Jaqueline with whom he is in love, agrees to participate in the robbery. The shot is successful but the safe is empty ...
notes: Laughable comedy directed by the versatile Tonino Ricci.

title: Break of Hearts
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Charles Boyer, John Beal, Jean Hersholt

title: The Skeleton Key
actors: Kate Hudson, Gena Rowlands, John Hurt, Peter Sarsgaard, Joy Bryant
description: After her father's dramatic death, Caroline quit her job as a rock band manager to devote herself to people who have been mistreated. He thus moves to Louisiana to take care of Ben who, after a mysterious accident, is no longer able to speak. In the house where Ben and his wife Violet live there is a strange atmosphere: Caroline has the feeling that some secrets related to voodoo rituals are hiding in her home ...
notes: This film is a respectable epigone, which at first recalls certain titles of the Baby Jane genre and certain scenographies a la Suddenly last summer. It is perhaps too long, it lacks rhythm, it is mechanical in many passages (director Softley has always been a flat illustrator), but, in addition to evoking atmospheres full of charm, it has a final gimmick that raises it clearly above the average of the genre, with some splash of metacinema. Kate Hudson as a horror screamer is discreet, while Gena Rowlands and John Hurt are all to enjoy.

title: Hanno cambiato faccia
actors: Adolfo Celi, Giuliano Disperati, Geraldine Hooper, Francesca Modigliani
description: Engineer Valle is invited by his employer, Dr. Giovanni Nosferatu, to a mountain villa for an interesting job offer. He does not have time to listen to the proposal, who immediately discovers that his boss is the modern incarnation of a vampire who aims to govern the institutions of society and the minds of citizens.

title: Odissea nuda
actors: Enrico Maria Salerno, Patricia Dolores Donlon, Venantino Venantini
description: Enrico, an Italian intellectual, comes to Polynesia to shoot a documentary with a humanity, a society and a morality different from those he is used to. It would be a chore if he weren't impressed by what he sees and by the sheer indifference to anything other than joie de vivre.

title: La vampire nue
actors: Olivier Martin, Maurice Lemaître, Caroline Cartier, Ly Lestrong

title: Terrain vague
actors: Danièle Gaubert, Jean-Louis Bras, Maurice Caffarelli, Roland Lesaffre

title: Les yeux cernés
actors: Robert Hossein, Marie-France Pisier, Michèle Morgan, François Patrice

title: The Girl on the Motorcycle
actors: Alain Delon, Marianne Faithfull, Roger Mutton, Marius Goring

title: Trans-Europe-Expres
actors: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Marie-France Pisier, Nadine Verdier, Alain Robbe-Grillet
description: A director, his wife and a producer travel by train from Paris to Antwerp. The director dictates the blueprint for a drug smuggling film, based on what's going on around him.

title: Le cinque giornate
actors: Adriano Celentano, Enzo Cerusico, Marilù Tolo, Luisa De Santis
description: Milan, March 18-22, 1848: Cainazzo is a thief who becomes involved in the insurrection by chance, just like the baker Romolo. The two become friends during the construction of the barricades, the attacks of the rioters and the reprisals of the Habsburgs. Romulus, however, when the celebrations for the victory break out, intervenes to stop the violence of a revolutionary, thus marking his own destiny.
notes: The grotesque reinterpretation of a central episode of our Risorgimento is too big, falling into indifference without eliciting any laughs. This is undoubtedly the most unusual direction of Dario Argento.

title: Eddie Murphy Raw
actors: Eddie Murphy, Tatyana Ali, Billie Allen, James Brown III, Edye Byrde
description: Eddie Murphy, an American comedian, mocks everything and everyone by touching on various topics. He does not spare profanity and mockery when speaking of American showmen, couples and Italians.

title: The Naked and the Dead
actors: L. Q. Jones, Aldo Ray, Cliff Robertson, Raymond Massey, Richard Jaeckel, William Campbell

title: Nudo e selvaggio
actors: Michael Sopkiw, Suzane Carvalho, Milton Morris, Marta Anderson
description: Scientist Kevin Hall travels to Brazil in search of dinosaur remains. The plane carrying him crashes in the middle of the Amazon. For the passengers who survived the accident (Hall and some extravagant characters) a troubled and never-ending odyssey begins: in the hostility of the tropical forest, they will have to deal with ferocious animals, quicksand and dangerous natives who practice cannibalism.
notes: Brazilian production film but with the Italian Tarantini behind the camera, already a specialist in erotic comedies in the 70s: beautiful photography, but otherwise we are faced with laughable adventures with stereotyped characters and unnecessarily gory scenes.

title: I'm All Right Jack
actors: Ian Carmichael, Peter Sellers, Terry-Thomas, Margaret Rutherford, Richard Attenborough, Dennis Price

title: Blue Nude
actors: Gerardo Amato, Susan Elliot, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Renato Romano, Joe Neri, Italo Spinelli, Monica Scattini
description: Rocco Spinone, a young Italian who lives in America, lends himself to any kind of job to make ends meet, including that of an actor in porn films, an activity that his friend Lilly carries out with whom he will soon fall in love. Persecuted by a policeman who is an enemy of immigrants, who accuses him of having had a relationship with an underage girl, the young man is forced to pay a large sum to him and to the child's father. Meanwhile, her friend dies on set shooting a scene that is too violent ...

title: Le ore nude
actors: Rossana Podestà, Philippe Leroy, Keir Dullea, Umberto Spadaro

title: Vacuuming Completely Nude in Paradise
actors: Timothy Spall, Michael Begley, Katy Cavanagh, Caroline Ashley

title: Una famiglia per caso
actors: Elda Alvigini, Lando Buzzanca, Giovanna Ralli, Enzo Marino Bellanich
description: Through a series of adventurous events, sometimes on the verge of legality, four people, tired and disappointed by life and eager to change it, get together and finally realize that they can create a better future for themselves.
notes: Pathetic TV by-product.

title: Eugenie
actors: Soledad Miranda, Paul Müller, Andrés Monales, Greta Schmidt
description: Eugenie, a young and very beautiful but equally shy girl, lives with her stepfather, a famous writer of erotic stories. One day he happens in his hands one of these books and the effect that derives from the exciting reading is powerful and shocking: in fact he begins to feel terribly attracted to the man who acts as a father. The man ends up realizing the change and welcomes the girl in her morbid world made of even extreme sexual perversions.

title: A Face to Kill for
actors: Crystal Bernard, Doug Savant, Claire Rankin, Barry Corbin
description: Allison Bevens, a horse trainer by profession, falls victim to a deception hatched by her husband and is unjustly jailed. In prison, however, he has plenty of time to devise the right retaliation to inflict on his better half: he will begin by making himself unrecognizable, undergoing a facial plastic surgery ...

title: Geppo il folle
actors: Adriano Celentano, Claudia Mori, Chantal Benoist, Pietro Brambilla
description: Geppo, a successful singer in Italy and Europe, also wants to break through in America, where I live Barbra Streisand, his idol and the only performer who he considers to be at his height. However, he does not know English and decides to turn to the attractive professor Gilda and follow her lessons.

title: Monamour
actors: Anna Jimskaya, Riccardo Marino, Max Parodi, Nela Lucic
description: Marta and Dario, married for some time, are in crisis because he dedicates too much time to work and neglects his wife. In Mantua, during a work trip to Dario, Marta knows the French Leon and a passion breaks out between the two.

title: James Dean
actors: James Franco, Valentina Cervi, Michael Moriarty, Enrico Colantoni, Barry Primus
description: On September 30, 1955, a student sedan pulls onto Route 46 just as a Porsche 550 Spyder - driven by James Dean - runs fast. The crash is devastating and causes the death of one of Hollywood's most counter-current stars.
notes: Rydell retraces the career and life of the actor, who at the time of the fatal accident was already a star even though only _The Valley of Eden_ was released on the big screen, directed in 1954 by Elia Kazan (_Burned Youth_ and _The Giant_ ). To give a face to the actor who embodied the ideal of the rebel is James Franco (interpreter of the three _Spider-Man, as well as _The Company_).

title: Disperato addio
actors: Massimo Girotti, Lise Bourdin, Andrea Checchi, Xenia Valderi
description: The nurse Luisa meets Andrea and Maurizio in the hospital where she works, two doctors who make a close court to her. The woman falls in love with the first, talented and successful surgeon and marries him. A few years pass and Luisa, after a quarrel with her husband, takes refuge from Maurizio who, in order not to embarrass her, goes to stay in the hotel. Andrea, however, does not believe in the innocence of the woman, he abandons her and leaves for America. Luisa goes back to work, gives birth to a child, but, when she discovers that she is seriously ill, she desperately tries to commit suicide.
notes: Usual tear-jerking drama that lingers on the background, liquidating Luisa's drama too quickly.

title: Shamus
actors: Burt Reynolds, Dyan Cannon, Giorgio Tozzi, John Ryan

title: La passione di Giosuè l'ebreo
actors: Anna Bonaiuto, Leonardo Cesare Abude, Marcello Mazzarella
description: In 1492 Queen Isabella expelled Jews and Muslims from Spain, which she wanted Catholic. The anti-Jewish hatred crosses all of Europe and the young Giosuè with his family takes refuge in Naples and then in Sicily, where he lives in a village of Jews forced to convert to Catholicism and where his erudition and his mystical tension they lead to inevitable sacrifice.
notes: Divided quite neatly into two parts, Pasquale Scimeca's The Passion of Joshua the Jew tells a story of contemporary intolerance in an ancient key. An austere, "pictorial" film, intense but not particularly original (along the trail that goes from Pasolini to Benvenuti).

title: Jud Süss
actors: Ferdinand Marian, Kristina Söderbaum, Werner Krauss, Heinrich George
description: In the 18th century, Duke Karl Alexander at the time of his coronation promises to rule with honesty and loyalty. The advice and schemes of the ambitious Jewish treasurer Suss Oppenheimer, however, end up corrupting him and bringing the duchy to the brink of civil war.

title: Vampyros lesbos
actors: Ewa Strömberg, Susann Korda, Victor Feldman, Dennis Price

title: Faceless
actors: Helmut Berger, Brigitte Lahaie, Telly Savalas, Christopher Mitchum

title: The Moderns
actors: Keith Carradine, Linda Fiorentino, John Lone, Wallace Shawn

title: Thoroughly Modern Millie
actors: Julie Andrews, Mary Tyler Moore, James Fox, Carol Channing, John Gavin
description: Millie moves to the city to modernize her life and appearance. Becoming friends with Dorothy, an aspiring actress, Millie dreams of becoming a secretary and marrying her boss. But, when her boss proves more interested in Dorothy than she is, Millie realizes she's not quite as ready for modernity.

title: Nel più alto dei cieli
actors: Livio Barbo, Edy Biagetti, Giorgio Bonora, Gisella Burinato

title: Viva Zapatero!
actors: Rory Bremner, Sabina Guzzanti, Daniele Luttazzi, Michele Santoro, Enzo Biagi
description: Sabina Guzzanti starts from the story of her "Raiot", the program broadcast on Raitre which closed after only one episode (despite the excellent listening results), to give a picture of the current situation of the mass media in Italy.
notes: Guzzanti's direction does not have the effectiveness and "air" of Michael Moore's films and takes little account of the external context (as Moore knows how to do in the best works). Its natural destination would be television. But, here and today, this is a contradiction in terms. So it is welcome in theaters and then on DVD because, if only as a reminder, it must be seen.

title: Dear Wendy
actors: Jamie Bell, Bill Pullman, Michael Angarano, Danso Gordon, Chris Owen, Novella Nelson
description: Dick, a convinced pacifist, finds a gun he calls Wendy, and instead of throwing it away he decides to keep it. With his friends he founded a secret club called "the Dandies", which has pacifism and a love of arms as its guiding principles. The fundamental rule is not to resort to the use of the latter, but all "Dandies" find themselves in a situation where it is difficult to respect it ...
notes: The moral apologue is aimed at revealing once again how the founding myths of the States are violent and hypocritical. Programmatic and provocative as always is von Trier, author of subject and screenplay: those who love him will also love this film, those who hate it will hate it.

title: La orca
actors: Rena Niehaus, Gabriele Ferzetti, Flavio Bucci, Carmen Scarpitta, Bruno Corazzari, Piero Faggioni, Piero Palermini, Michele Placido, Miguel Bosé, Otello Toso, Jacopo Tecchi, Vittorio Valsecchi, Enzo Consoli
description: Plot in preparation

title: Mauvais esprit
actors: Thierry Lhermitte, Ophélie Winter, Maria Pacome, Leonor Watling, Clémentine Célarié
description: Vincent Poirel, manager of a multinational, won the contract to build an Olympic stadium. The original project, however, is by the young architect Simon Variot, who when he discovers it goes to the construction site and is run over by Poirel. Simon dies, but resurrects in the body of Poirel's son, who does not understand why the little one hates him so much ...
notes: The staging of the story is rather crude and does not actually skimp on the verge of pure disgust. It should be added that the plot is not very original and the director who had impressed well with the previous film _15 August_ here ends up being unnecessarily vulgar and too "scatological".

title: Oedipus Orca
actors: Rena Niehaus, Gabriele Ferzetti, Michele Placido, Carmen Scarpitta, Miguel Bosé, Piero Faggioni
description: Alice, returned to her family after experiencing the tragedy of a kidnapping, is unable to return to a normal life. The memory of the ambiguous relationship that had united her with her jailer is mixed with the profound disturbance of the senses that Alice feels in front of a friend of her mother, a mature man who could even be her real father ..

title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
description: In the town of Bikini Bottom, someone has stolen the crown of King Neptune. Mr. Krabb, head of the SpongeBob square sponge, is accused of the theft. SpongeBob, convinced of his innocence, leaves with the intention of finding the precious crown and exonerating Krabb.

title: Creep
actors: Franka Potente, Vas Blackwood, Ken Campbell, Jeremy Sheffield, Paul Rattray
description: Kate finds herself trapped in the London Underground. To escape the demonic presences that chase her along the four hundred km of labyrinthine tunnels she will have to resort to her cunning and her legs ...
notes: The initial idea was strong, as was the choice to set the film all in one night, until dawn when the subway reopens. But after ten minutes the starting point is exhausted, the film repeats itself without rhythm and you have to resort to a thousand implausible tricks to get to an hour and twenty.

title: Dark Water
actors: Jennifer Connelly, John C. Reilly, Tim Roth, Dougray Scott, Pete Postlethwaite
description: Following a tough legal battle over custody of her daughter, Dahlia moves in with her baby in a new home. But here her problems are not over: the young woman must in fact deal with mysterious and dark noises, a strange leak of dark water from the ceiling and the ghosts of the previous owners ...
notes: The direction is rigorous, and he has the courage to take his time (it is therefore very far from boxed horror); the gaze on the metropolis as a prison of the spirit is very convincing; and Jennifer Connelly gives an excellent performance as an actress. _Dark Water_ reworks the Japanese original with a good contextual conscience.

title: Una storia milanese
actors: Danièle Gaubert, Romolo Valli, Enrico Thibault, Lucilla Morlacchi

title: Malamore
actors: Jimmy Briscoe, Nathalie Nell, Remo Girone, Antonio Marsina, Leopoldo Trieste, Monica Scattini, Serena Grandi, Elisabeth Kaza, Renata Zamengo, Leonardo Treviglio

title: Sorbole... che romagnola
actors: Maria Rosaria Riuzzi, Massimo Ciavarro, Milly Corinaldi, Luciano Pigozzi
description: Due to the default of her agency, which does not pay her for the hotel, the tour guide Orietta makes a virtue of necessity and improvises herself as a beautician, physiotherapist and dietician in a small northern village. Thanks to his care, the fat wives of local notables - who consoled themselves in the arms of a prostitute - are transformed into real beauties, winning back their husbands. The meritorious action will win her the love of a handsome boyfriend.
notes: This little film has the dubious merit of being an antelitteram fable on the benefits of dietetics, and finds its highlight in the song _Madonna romagnola_. With a very young Massimo Ciavarro.

title: Avanti a lui tremava tutta Roma
actors: Anna Magnani, Tito Gobbi, Hans Hinrich, Gino Sinimberghi, Giulio Battiferri, Antonio Crast, Bruno Gebel, Joop van Hulzen, Ave Ninchi
description: Ada, an established opera singer, unwittingly makes Nazi soldiers discover that her fellow tenor Marco is hiding an English soldier in his villa. Ready to arrest the artists at the end of the performance of the Tosca, the military of the Gestapo will have to deal with the train drivers of the theater, who have ingeniously prepared an escape route for their colleagues.

title: The Gunfighter
actors: Gregory Peck, Helen Westcott, Millard Mitchell, Jean Parker, Karl Malden

title: Romanzo criminale
actors: Kim Rossi Stuart, Stefano Accorsi, Anna Mouglalis, Pierfrancesco Favino, Claudio Santamaria, Jasmine Trinca, Elio Germano, Riccardo Scamarcio
description: Rome, 1970s: the Lebanese, the Freddo and the Dandi, three young men from the small Roman underworld, come together to control the territory. From the kidnapping of Baron Rosellini to the control of the heroin trafficking, they set up a real criminal organization that has the protection of the mafia and politicians. The only one who tries to counteract the excessive power of the group is Commissioner Scialoja who ends up falling in love with Patrizia, Dandi's woman.
notes: Let's say right away that the film basically keeps its promises: the direction inserts the rhythm of the 70s Italian crime story into the Leonian plot, creating an original style that confirms the talents of Placido (who carves out a cameo) behind the camera. ; while the extraordinary photography by Luca Bigazzi resembles a nightmare, set in a suffocating darkness, with the camera attached to the bodies of the many protagonists that does not give respite and does not allow air (among other things, an excellent shortcut to avoid expensive reconstructions of epoch): a darkness that becomes light only in the final sequence, to underline a liberation that can only pass through the death of the former children of Magliana. Also active is a soundtrack that accumulates emotions thanks to a repertoire that ranges from _Io ho in mente te_ of Equipe 84 to the Giorgia version of _I Heard It Through the Grapevine_ passing through the _Bambola_ of Patty Pravo and the double Califano of _Tutto the rest is boredom_ and _I'm in love with you_. And an almost perfect cast, with Favino a notch above a high average.

title: L'asino d'oro: processo per fatti strani contro Lucius Apuleius cittadino romano
actors: Barbara Bouchet, Sami Pavel, John Steiner, Marisa Fabbri, Dada Gallotti, Paolo Poli, Leopoldo Trieste
description: In ancient Mauritania, the young Roman Lucius Apuleius (Samy Pavel) and his friend Aristomene (John Steiner) run into a series of misadventures due to the transformation experiments of a witch, which lead Lucius to behave like a man while he has the likeness. of a donkey and of a donkey when he becomes a man again.
notes: Farce based on the work of the Latin writer Lucius Apuleius.

title: Milano rovente
actors: Antonio Sabato, Philippe Leroy, Tano Cimarosa, Marisa Mell, Franco Fantasia
description: Salvatore is a Sicilian transplanted to Milan, absolute master of the prostitution racket. When one of his best "girls" is found dead, the man discovers that the Frenchman Roger is responsible for exploiting prostitutes to sell drugs. Thus begins a no holds barred war between the two ...
notes: First detective story for Lenzi who mixes the typical codes of the American gangster film with the more purely Italian ones (and therefore imbued with social criticism) where the nocturnal and secret Milan manages to exert a particular charm. Excellent music by Rustichelli and good general rhythm, supported by the two good performers and by the austere charm of Marisa Mell.

title: Torino violenta
actors: George Hilton, Emanuel Cannarsa, Giuseppe Alotta, Franco Nebbia
description: Commissioner Moretti, in order to stem the increasingly violent and omnipresent criminal activities in Turin, improvises himself as an executioner and crosses the boundary of legality. Inspector Danieli, on the other hand, acts on the basis of the "code" and tries to redeem his colleague. The result is the birth of an internal conflict within the police, in which it becomes increasingly difficult to establish the concepts of justice, legality and ethics.
notes: Among the most violent 1970s detective stories in our home, he recycles the stylistic features of the genre with decent results, without reaching the peaks of a Fernando Di Leo. Ausino is also a screenwriter and extra. George Hilton is credible in the part of Moretti.

title: I milanesi a Napoli
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Carlo Campanini, Nino Taranto, Dolores Palumbo, Enrico Viarisio, Eva Nova, Carlo Sposito, Enzo Turco
description: Clemente Simoni and Dora Vincenzi, two Milanese industrialists, plan to set up a "Telepizze" factory in Naples, that is, Neapolitan-style pizzas, packaged according to the chemical formula invented by Simoni. Meanwhile, Franco Baraldi, the general secretary of the company for which the two work, is involved in another initiative, which aims at the industrialization of Sorrento embroidery. Immacolata Santolillo, a nice Sorrentine, owner of a workshop where the famous embroideries are made, and sister of the "Bersagliere", owner of a well-known pizzeria, with a clever stratagem causes the construction of the planned embroidery factory to be suspended. Meanwhile, the pizza chefs of Naples, led by Immacolata herself, decide to oppose the "Telepizze" industry by any means.

title: Napoli ... i 5 della squadra speciale
actors: Richard Harrison, Lina Polito, Enrico Maisto, Tommaso Palladino

title: Brenno il nemico di Roma
actors: Gordon Mitchell, Tony Kendall, Ursula Davis, Massimo Serato
description: In 391 BC the Gallic hordes commanded by Brenno massacre Romans along the border. A brave commander, Marco Furio Camillo, could oppose the enemy but, accused of corruption for political rivalry, decides to self-exiled to Ardea. The Senate sends an embassy to Brenno: Misia, priestess of Minerva, whom the rooster marries, saving Rome. The previous boyfriend of the woman, Quinto Fabio, however, kidnaps her and so Brenno resumes hostilities against the Republic and, on the Allia river, defeats the resistance, forcing the Roman population to flee to nearby cities ...
notes: Penultimate film by Gentilomo, now at the end of its peplum phase and close to devoting himself to painting.

title: Necromancy
actors: Orson Welles, Pamela Franklin; Lee Purcell, Michael Ontkean

title: I racconti romani di una ex novizia
actors: Karin Mayer, Gino Cervi, Francis Blanche, Luciana Turina, Tania Lopert, Céline Bessy
description: To cheer up his cellmates, a prisoner tells a story that Pietro Aretino would have already told in the past to Leo X. It is the story of Nanna, who entered the convent full of devotion and then left without virginity and without faith. Later she manages to marry thanks to the help of her mother and to convince her husband of her own illegality. One day, Nanna learns that her husband is organizing an orgy with four friends and a servant, so she abandons him to become a prostitute. When her daughter gets old enough, Nanna will start her on the same path ...

title: Roma drogata: la polizia non può intervenire
actors: Bud Cort, Marcel Bozzuffi, Eva Czemerys, Guido Alberti, Leopoldo Trieste, Maurizio Arena, Umberto Raho

title: I violenti di Roma bene
actors: Antonio Sabato, Pierre Marfurt, Pupo De Luca, Franca Gonella, Cesare Barro, Gianluca Farnese, Giacomo Rossi Stuart

title: The Man in Grey
actors: Margaret Lockwood, Phyllis Calvert, James Mason, Stewart Granger
description: England, Regency period (1811-1820). Clarissa, a noblewoman of the English aristocracy, marries the surly Marquis of Rohan who soon betrays her with Hester, a friend of hers of humble origins. The latter tries in every way to encourage the falling in love between Clarissa and the adventurer Rokeby with the hope of taking the place of the noblewoman.
notes: The film, based on a novel by Lady Eleanor Smith that follows the patterns of the sensation novel (a literary genre halfway between a gothic novel and strong melodrama), was a box office hit in the 1943-1944 season.

title: Zero Effect
actors: Bill Pullman, Ben Stiller, Ryan O'Neal, Kim Dickens, Angela Featherstone
description: 300 Systematically blackmailed by a stranger, tycoon Gregory Stark turns to Daryl Zero: known as the best detective on the square, but elusive and elusive to the point of refusing to personally meet his clients. Stark thus finds himself discussing the details of the case not with him in person, but with his assistant Steve Arlo. It doesn't take Zero long to discover that the blackmailer (indeed, the blackmailer) is a certain Gloria Sullivan: but almost without realizing it he falls in love with her, and will find himself forced to choose between the woman and the commitment made with Stark ...
notes: Passable directorial debut by Lawrence Kasdan's son.

title: Identikit
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Guido Mannari, Ian Bannen, Mona Washbourne

title: Il mare
actors: Umberto Orsini, Françoise Prevost, Dino Mele, Renato Scala

title: Born to Kill
actors: Claire Trevor, Lawrence Tierney, Walter Slezak, Audrey Long

title: First Men in the Moon
actors: Edward Judd, Martha Hyer, Lionel Jeffries, Miles Malleson
description: A United Nations expedition - composed of a Russian, an American and an Englishman - arrives for the first time on the moon, where it finds some shocking artifacts: a shred of the English flag and a yellowed manuscript. They are traces of a previous moon landing, which even took place in 1899 under the aegis of Queen Victoria. The surviving explorer is tracked down to Earth by UN agents and reveals the details of the incredible journey ...
notes: Inspired by a 1901 novel by Herbert George Wells, the film has its strength in Ray Harryhausen's special effects, which like good wine improve over the years.

title: Rocketship X-M
actors: Lloyd Bridges, Osa Massen, John Emery, Noah Beery jr., Hugh O'Brian

title: Per sempre - Fino alla morte
actors: Urbano Barberini, David Brandon, Gioia Scola
description: A couple of hoteliers are linked by a terrible secret dating back eight years: the murder of her wife. One evening, while it's raining outside, a stranger shows up looking for a room: but the next day, declaring he can't pay the bill, offers to work for the two murderous lovers. Man seems to know their past, who are they really about?
notes: Horror variation on the theme of _The postman always rings twice_, the television work of Bava son is certainly not _Ossessione_ by Visconti, however it is one of the most valuable feature films made for the _Brivido giallo_ series.

title: Legenda o Suramskoj kreposti
actors: Dodo Abasidze, Levan Uchaneshvili, Urab Kipcidze, Lela Alibegashvili
description: Near Tbilisi there is a stronghold whose foundations are constantly collapsing: to strengthen them, it will be necessary to sacrifice the son of the chief of the city, who will agree to be walled up alive ...
notes: The Georgian master is inspired by an ancient legend of his land, creating a rarefied, mysterious and hieratic visual poem.

title: Hollywood Wives: The New Generation
actors: Farrah Fawcett, Melissa Gilbert, Robin Givens, Dorian Harewood
description: Tired of her husband's constant betrayal, Hollywood star Lissa Roman decides to hire a private investigator to stalk him. In this difficult phase of her love life, the woman will be able to count on the affection and support of her best friends: Kyndra is a famous singer, too busy with her career and not very dedicated to looking after her teenage daughter; Taylor is the wife of a well-known producer and cheats on her husband with a screenwriter. Between gossip, betrayal and confidences, Lissa's life is turned upside down by the kidnapping of her daughter and a new love on the horizon ...
notes: Between luxury homes, expensive cars and plastic surgery, even the actresses cry.

title: Solarbabies
actors: Richard Jordan, Jami Gertz, Jason Patric, Lukas Haas, Charles Durning, Adrian Pasdar
description: A nuclear war has dried up the oceans and the Earth has become a desert planet whose most precious resource, water, is managed by the multinational E-Protecorate. The corporation removes children from their families and trains them for war and sport in orphanages. But one day little Daniel finds a magical extraterrestrial sphere that grants his every wish. Thus begins a glowing flight to freedom ...
notes: A lot of productive effort just to copy _Mad Max? _ Well yes, nothing new under the sun of the apocalypse, including sets, make-up and wigs. Sure, the young Gibson didn't have a magic sphere, but a touch of originality never hurts ...

title: Le scarpe al sole
actors: Camillo Pilotto, Cesco Baseggio, Carlo Ludovici
description: With Italy's entry into the war in 1915, a veteran of Libya and two young men, including one just married, are recruited to defend the borders of the homeland. The hard life in the trenches, between assaults, retreats, moments of stalemate and tragic losses, will deeply mark the three men.
notes: Taken from the book _Diario di guerra_ of 1921 by Paolo Monelli, former officer of the Alpini, it is the directorial debut of the documentary maker Marco Elter. The focus is more on the characters and the dramatic events they experience rather than the action. The 1935 Venice Film Festival awarded the film with the Ministry of Propaganda Cup for being the most ethically significant film.

title: Il bacio del sole - Don Vesuvio
actors: O. W. Fischer, Nino Taranto, Lorella De Luca, Marisa Merlini
description: Naples, in the first post-war period, many young people live abandoned to themselves, committing violence and petty theft. A priest, Don Mario Borrelli, decides to take care of them and obtains permission from the Cardinal to mix with the boys in disguise in order to be able to help and control them more effectively. He dresses as a poor sailor, spends the night in their company and stands out for the vivacity of his spirit and for the natural authority that leads him to dominate, so much so that they give him the nickname of Vesuvius. He also manages to save the boys from the hands of the police, making himself known and vouching for them. However, the superior authority received news that was not entirely appreciated, so Don Mario was forced to give up his disguise and present himself as a priest. In seeing Vesuvius appear before him in a cassock, the boys at first believe it is a bad joke; but when they are convinced of the seriousness of the matter and understand that Don Vesuvio (as they continue to call him) is truly a priest, the group splits up: some leave, while others decide to stay, especially since the dynamic priest has succeeded in the meantime. to have at their disposal a dilapidated house, in which the children feel at ease. Thus the house of the street urchin arises, with great difficulty, with a few willing people who help Don Mario. The boys gradually grow fond of work; but often the money is not enough to feed them. Faced with certain phenomena of misunderstanding, Don Vesuvio, disheartened, is about to abandon the company, but provident benefactors opportunely intervene. The young dissidents who have separated from the group do not sit idle: during a party they break into the house and steal the money deposited in the common box. However, they are chased by the robbed, who, after a fight, regain possession of the sum. In the hustle and bustle, the smallest of the brigade, while crossing a road, is hit by a car: his death in the hospital will at least have the effect of provoking the repentance of the dissidents, who will re-enter the group of workers.

title: Road to Salina
actors: Mimsy Farmer, Robert Walker jr., Rita Hayworth, Ed Begley
description: A man, wandering around the southwestern United States, is mistaken by the owner of a gas station for her son who disappeared years ago. The tramp thinks of taking advantage of the situation, but regrets when his alleged sister appears, a neurotic who had had an incestuous relationship with the deceased.

title: Cent mille dollars au soleil
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Lino Ventura, Reginald Kernan, Andréa Parisy, Bernard Blier

title: Make Mine Laughs
actors: Ray Bolger, Joan Davis, Dennis Day, Anne Shirley, Leon Errol, Gil Lamb
description: Traveling among the sequins of the "vaudeville".
notes: This is the second of three "pastiche" that Rko has obtained by assembling unpublished materials with other taken from previous productions of the studio. Actor Gil Lamb connects and comments on the various performances, including choreographic moments, songs and variety numbers (such as that of ventriloquist Robert Lamouret).

title: L'empire des Loups
actors: Jean Reno, Arly Jover, Jocelyn Quivrin, Laura Morante, Philippe Bas, Didier Sauvegrain
description: In the 10th Arrondissement, Captain Paul Nerteaux investigates the brutal murder of three women of Turkish origin. To carry out the investigation he must be able to infiltrate Turkish immigrants and the only person who can help him is Jean-Louis Schiffer, a retired colleague who has a reputation for being corrupt.
notes: Between exaggerated brutality and the tiring progress of the intrigue we would feel like saving only two things: Laura Morante, who overcomes the difficult test of "genre cinema" without replicating the stereotype of the neurotic that Italian directors have sewn on her, and of course Jean Reno, who, imitating John Wayne, punches the screen even without doing anything.

title: Fever Pitch
actors: Drew Barrymore, Jimmy Fallon, Jason Spevack, Jack Kehler, Maureen Keiller
description: Lindsay, a successful manager, falls in love - reciprocated - with Ben, a high school teacher. Although their interests are diametrically opposed, the relationship is booming until the baseball season begins and Lindsay is forced to deal with Ben's "first" great love: the Boston Red Sox ...
notes: Directing the US remake of _Febbre a 90 ° _, the Farrellys contain themselves: no scatological humor, no paradox about diversity (and yes that the sports people would have offered material ...). There remains an honest romantic comedy, some great sports footage, and a perfect big kid Jimmy Fallon (ex _Saturday Night Live_).

title: Passo a due
actors: Kledi Kadiu, Laura Chiatti, Genti Kame, Stefania Barca, Monica Vallerini, Nathalie Guetta
description: Beni, a student at the Tirana dance academy, dreams of being a dancer. This is why he emigrates illegally, but once he arrives in Rome he realizes that Italy is not the paradise he had imagined while watching TV ...
notes: At the cinema as on TV, the boy wears the dancer's fabric well, but the acting here is as hidden as ideas. Barzini tries, in vain, to swerve from time to time on some avenue not at sunset, but the mission is impossible and the result is definitely more as a child than a big screen. The girls bewitched by the Friends of Maria De Filippi will be exalted. The girl who accompanies Kledi in the dance raids is Laura Chiatti, here at the debut.

title: Back to Gaya
description: In Gaya, the land where the Gayani live, beings 30 centimeters tall similar to humans in all respects, there is the Dalamite, a magical stone that guarantees life to its inhabitants. When the stone is stolen, the brave Zino and his friend Boo set out on a mission to find it.
notes: Brave and even a little reckless film; courageous because the directors have embarked on the titanic adventure of producing the first European 3D animated film with an infinitesimal budget compared to productions made in the USA. Unconscious, because the story is a fairy tale that turns into a somewhat twisted reflection on the media society. The result? Acceptable.

title: Genesis
actors: Sotigui Kouyaté
description: A griot, or an African storyteller, uses the oral tradition of his people to evoke the origin of the universe, the stars and our planet. In a journey to the magical discovery of evolution and the struggle for life, images follow one another that illustrate the animal world in its wonders and oddities.
notes: With _Microcosmos_ they had placed the magnifying glass on the incredible world of insects: now documentary makers Claude Nuridsany and Marie Pérennou are expanding the field to the origin and development of life. Poetry is not lacking, but the link between the spectacular sequences and the commentary of the griot (the African actor Sotigui Kouyaté) appears a bit artificial.

title: Zombi Holocaust
actors: Ian McCulloch, Alexandra Delli Colli, Sherry Buchanan, Peter O'Neal
description: In a New York hospital, prof. Drydock and his assistant Laurie are concerned about the unexplained mutilation of corpses that are occurring. Set a trap, they discover the defiler but he, instead of being captured, prefers to kill himself. Shortly before dying, however, he murmurs a strange word, "Kito". Thanks to Laurie and Chandler, a doctor of the Sanitary Section, they discover that they are faced with some phenomena of cannibalism and the existence in the Moluccas archipelago of an island called Kito. They then go to the place ...

title: Confessioni segrete d'un convento di clausura
actors: Mark Damon, Rosalba Neri, Angela Bo, John Turner, Mirella Rossi

title: Permanent Vacation
actors: Chris Parker, Leila Gastil, Richard Boes, Ruth Bolton, Sara Driver, María Duval, Frankie Faison
description: In a semi-deserted New York, after an unspecified war, the wandering drift of the young Aloysius, his encounters and deteriorated relations with his girlfriend are described. Each encounter confirms it in its isolation.

title: La mujer de Benjamín
actors: Eduardo López Rojas, Arcelia Ramirez, Malena Doria, Juan Carlos Colombo

title: Le occasioni di Rosa
actors: Marina Suma, Angelo Cannavacciuolo, Sergio Boccalatte, Gianni Prestieri

title: Les aventuriers
actors: Alain Delon, Lino Ventura, Joanna Shimkus, Serge Reggiani
description: Victim of a left-handed shot together with his friend Roland, Manu sees his pilot license withdrawn. Apparently repentant, the authors of the joke reveal to the two the existence of a treasure hidden in a plane sunk in the ocean off the coast of Congo. Roland and Manu thus decide to leave for Africa accompanied by Laetitia, a young sculptor who dreams of settling in an old fort on the sea of ??Provence ...
notes: The director and José Giovanni (also author of the original novel) script this not particularly original story, but made enjoyable by the gaglioffa verve unlined by the duo Delon-Ventura.

title: The Heartbreak Kid
actors: Charles Grodin, Cybill Shepherd, Jeannie Berlin, Audra Lindley

title: I Want to Marry Ryan Banks
actors: Jason Priestley, Bradley Cooper, Emma Caulfield, Mark L. Walberg
description: 600 TVM What to do when the career of your most famous client and best friend suddenly crashes? Over the past decade Ryan Banks has been one of the hottest characters in Hollywood. Now, however, his image as a golden bachelor begins to suffer from the passing years and the crowd of fans that Ryan could boast until recently is dwindling fast. Todd Doherty, Ryan's agent and his great friend, has a brilliant idea capable, he hopes, of getting him back on the crest of the wave: to produce a reality show during which Ryan, after selecting 15 suitors, will be able to find the woman of his life. Everything is booming, the share is skyrocketing, Ryan's popularity soon returns to the highest levels but there is only one small drawback: Todd ends up falling in love with Charlie, the owner of a bookstore, the same girl that Ryan decided to ... marry!

title: Say Nothing
actors: Nastassja Kinski, William Baldwin, Hart Bochner, Jordy Benattar
description: 300 The arrival of a stranger puts the marriage of Grace and Matt in crisis, the classic perfect couple, who has had everything from life. Now not only is Grace and Matt's marriage in crisis, but their lives are also in danger ...

title: Seul contre tous
actors: Philippe Nahon, Blandine Lenoir, Frankye Pain, Martine Audrain

title: Monster in Law
actors: Jennifer Lopez, Jane Fonda, Michael Vartan, Wanda Sykes, Adam Scott
description: Charlotte, aka Charlie, has finally met the man of her dreams: Kevin Fields. But when he meets Viola, the future mother-in-law, he understands that it will not be an easy task: Viola is in fact terrified of losing her son and does everything to terrify her. But Charlie decides to go on the counterattack: it will be war with no holds barred ...
notes: The film itself would be disheartening: but the witch Fonda is back in great shape, and alongside her shine the sly comedy of Wanda Sykes (famous in theater and on TV) and the five-minute appearance of the great 80-year-old Elaine Stritch. The young people, thank goodness, are watching (including the director).

title: Soy Cuba - O mamute siberiano
description: Through interviews with the cast, the phases of the making of Soy Cuba, shot in 1964 by Mikhail Kalatozov and fiercely anti-American, are retraced. The film, accused of formalism and lack of realism, was banned in Cuba after harsh protests. Rediscovered in 1992, it immediately struck Coppola and Scorsese.

title: Geronimo
actors: Armando Silvestre, Chuck Connors, Kamala Devi, Pat Conway
description: 1883. To try to continue the fight against the whites, the Indian chief Geronimo, in command of his apaches, takes refuge in Mexico. In the meantime, the United States Congress opens an investigation thanks to which the rights of the Indians are recognized.
notes: Western series B on the side of the Indians, embellished with beautiful photography by Alex Phillips. The film, however, went down in history (so to speak) for the somewhat over the top, but at the time much appreciated test, by Chuck Connors, when it was not so rare for white actors, even of a certain fame, to interpret Native American roles, even historically existed.

title: Nochnoj dozor
actors: Konstantin Khabenskij, Vladimir Menshov, Valerij Zolotukhin, Mariya Poroshina, Galina Tyunina, Gosha Kutsenko
description: The delicate balance between the forces of Light and those of Darkness is in danger: an ancient prophecy, however, predicts that one day a Chosen will appear capable of putting an end to the millennial battle between the two factions. We just have to see who he will side with ...
notes: A balance by definition fragile. More interesting than beautiful is Bekmambetov's film, which in some ways looks like an American B-movie intended for home entertainment, with some clumsy mixes of videogame aesthetics and metropolitan action. But this view of post-Soviet Russia still dominated by bureaucratization (vampires need written permission to bite into victims!) Is fascinating. Just as it is amusing that the night watchmen (the good guys) have the power plant as the headquarters of their organization. It is not only the concretization of an obvious metaphor such as that of light, but a segment of the imagination for which the epicenter of the Good is where a primary ("nationalized") need such as that of energy is satisfied. Inevitable two sequels, but with much more money available.

title: La tigre e la neve
actors: Roberto Benigni, Nicoletta Braschi, Jean Reno, Emilia Fox, Steven Beckingham, Jonah Lotan
description: The poet Attilio De Giovanni is madly in love with Vittoria. Since her sentiment is unrequited, Attilio is willing to do anything to win her: even to follow her to Iraq, at the very beginning of the conflict wanted by the Americans to oust Saddam Hussein ...
notes: Benigni is Benigni, for better or for worse: a little talking cricket and a little clown, a little Fellini (especially in the incipit / dream, where Montale, Borges, Ungaretti and Yourcenar appear in a truly extraordinary participation becomes a catchphrase, with Tom Waits singing _You Can Never Hold Back Spring_) and a little Charlie Chaplin, a slave of love (that tram with his beloved who runs away into Michalkov's cinema) and a slave to himself, but still vital and tattered, acrobat and jester, a professor who would like to teach - first of all - the desire to do everything to heal himself and guard against human diseases.

title: Youngblood
actors: Rob Lowe, Cynthia Gibb, Patrick Swayze, Ed Lauter
description: The young and talented Youngblood dreams of escaping from his father's farm: his only chance to succeed is to break into ice hockey, making himself noticed by the talent scouts of his Canadian town. The turning point, however, is a common desire, the competition is unbridled and the means to emerge are not always fair. It helps complicate matters with Youngblood's relationship with the coach's daughter ...
notes: "Sports" film in the most banal sense of the term, respects all the obligatory passages of the genre, including the love subplot. If the ending wisely spares us the molasses, the attempt to make Lowe a sex symbol is rather pathetic.

title: Sie tötete in Ekstase
actors: Susann Korda, Fred Williams, Howard Vernon, Paul Müller
description: A geneticist who contaminates human and animal embryos is expelled from the professional register, because he is judged immoral by his colleagues. Retired with his wives on a desert island and out of love with life, he kills himself. The wife seeks revenge, seducing and then eliminating those responsible.
notes: Sort of remake of the previous _Miss Morte_.

title: The Bogus Witch Project
actors: Steve Agee, Bino Bates, Michael Ian Black, Eric Bram, Frank Cassini
description: In the wake of the "case" _The Blair Witch Project_, a super-independent short film that has risen to the rank of an authentic global media phenomenon, some filmmakers have created a series of short episodes with a parodic character, which are subsequently brought together in a sort of collage. The results, however, do not go beyond the classic joke between friends.

title: 36 fillette
actors: Delphine Zentout, Etienne Chicot, Olivier Parnière, Jean-Pierre Léaud

title: Tapage nocturne
actors: Dominique Laffin, Marie-Hélène Breillat, Bertrand Bonvoisin, Joe Dallesandro, Dominique Basquin, Daniel Langlet, Bruno Devoldère, Bruno Grimaldi, Georges Mansart, Pascal Tristant

title: Brève traversée
actors: Sarah Pratt, Gilles Guillain, Marc Filipi, Laëtitia Lopez, Marc Jablonski

title: Blood for Dracula
