actors: Joe Dallesandro, Arno Juerging, Vittorio De Sica, Udo Kier, Maxime McKendry, Arno Juerging, Milena Vukotic, Dominique Darel, Stefania Casini, Silvia Dionisio, Inna Alexeievna, Gil Cagne
description: Count Dracula is now dying for the absence of virgin blood. So he goes to Italy, believing he will find a profusion of them precisely because it is the land of Catholicism.
notes: Second experiment (after The monster is on the table ... Baron Frankenstein) for the bizarre Morrissey / Margheriti couple: very funny, unbridled while being rigorous and compact, with a strong social criticism towards the conservative and bigoted society and some contemptuous hints of the struggle of class. Udo Kier, in the role of life, is a perverse, grieving vampire, at times heartbreaking in his sentence. The rest of the cast, including Warholian fetish Joe Dallesandro, is to applause.

title: Madame und ihre Nichte
actors: Ruth-Maria Kubitschek, Edwige Fenech, Fred Williams, Rainer Penkert

title: The Last American Virgin
actors: Lawrence Monoson, Diane Franklin, Steve Antin, Joe Rubbo, Louisa Moritz, Brian Peck, Kimmy Robertson

title: La vierge du Rhin
actors: Jean Gabin, Andrée Clément, Élina Labourdette, Renaud Mary, Nadia Gray

title: La vergine di Norimberga
actors: Rossana Podestà, Georges Rivière, Christopher Lee, Jim Dolen

title: Le frisson des vampires
actors: Sandra Julien, Jean-Marie Durand, Jacques Robiolles, Marie-Pierre Tricot

title: Martha, Inc.: The Story of Martha Stewart
actors: Cybill Shepherd, Tim Matheson, Joanna Cassidy, Jude Ciccolella
description: After a poor childhood in Nutley, New Jersey, Martha Kostyra's ambition, determination and singular culinary talent - aka Martha Stewart - lead her to fame and fortune and to found a true financial empire, whose foundations will shake. following an "insider trading" scandal on Wall Street ...
notes: Intelligent satire on the rise and fall of one of the queens of the American small screen, the undisputed authority of the domestic ménage: Shepherd's interpretation is flamboyant, but full of humanity. Matheson, the Otter of _Animal House_, plays the husband-victim of this capricious diva.

title: Midwives
actors: Sissy Spacek, Peter Coyote, Terry Kinney, Alison Pill, Susannah Hoffman
description: In a cold and stormy night, in an isolated country house in Vermont, the midwife Sibyl Danforth faces a difficult birth, full of complications, to the point that she would prefer to move with the parturient to the hospital, but the climatic conditions do not allow it. In the morning the woman takes her last breath, probably due to a heart attack, and Sybil successfully attempts a risky Caesarean section, bringing to light a healthy baby. For the family of the deceased, however, it is not enough and Sybil finds herself accused of manslaughter, with the risk of losing her job in which she has always put all of herself.

title: Hanno rubato un tram
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Carlo Campanini, Juan De Landa, Lucia Banti, Lia Reiner
description: Bologna. Cesare, conductor of a tram, is the victim of the envy of a conductor who signals every slightest infringement to get him suspended. Degraded and suspended he decides to steal a tram.
notes: Subject by Luciano Vincenzoni, assistant director Sergio Leone, photography by Mario Bava. But the film does not fully convince.

title: Benvenuto reverendo!
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Lianella Carell, Giovanni Grasso, Gabriele Ferzetti
description: Giuseppe is released from prison after serving his sentence for theft. Animated by good intentions, he goes to a small village and goes in search of the parish priest, for whom he has a letter of recommendation. Giuseppe would like some work; but the parish priest is seriously ill, has a fever, delirium, cannot help him. Driven by hunger, Giuseppe steals one hundred lire from the alms box; but he is discovered, threatened, pursued. Finding a parish priest's cassock, wearing it and thus disguised, he can leave the town. On the road he is stopped by a deputy brigadier of the carabinieri, who takes him for the parish priest and begs him to go with him to the castle of a rich landowner. He invokes the intervention of the believed parish priest to calm the peasants, who have called a general strike and want to invade the lands. In exchange, the owner offers "Don Peppino" a large sum to rebuild the ruined church.

title: Il maestro
actors: Aldo Fabrizi, Alfredo Mayo, Mary Lamar, Marco Paoletti, Félix Fernández

title: La morte viene dallo spazio
actors: Paul Hubschmid, Fiorella Mari, Madeleine Fischer, Ivo Garrani

title: Searching for David's Heart
actors: Ricky Ullman, Danielle Panabaker, Billy Aaron Brown, Jayne Brook, Corri English, Kendre Berry
description: When David dies in an accident, his sister Darcy can't rest, feeling responsible for what happened. Thus begins a journey on the trail of the person who received David's heart, donated for a transplant, in the hope of finding something of his brother and thus silencing his own feelings of guilt ...

title: Masjävlar
actors: Sofia Helin, Kajsa Ernst, Ann Petren, Barbro Enberg, Joakim Lindblad
description: Mia, in her 30s career, single, has lived in Stockholm since the age of 15. For his father's 70th birthday he decides to return to Dalecarlia, his hometown. At first everything goes for the best, but with the passing of the days the ancient conflicts re-emerge especially with the two sisters, Eva and Gunilla ...
notes: With one eye on Ingmar Bergman's female profiles and another on the familiar hecatombs and ferocious humor of certain Dogma (co-producing von Trier's Zentropa), he finds some happy, rare moments of truth thanks to a peculiar staging and cast sturdy. Awarded in Sweden as the best film of the year, and in Rotterdam by the public.

title: The Adventures of Sharkboy and Lavagirl in 3D
actors: Taylor Lautner, Taylor Dooley, Cayden Boyd, George Lopez, David Arquette, Kristin Davis
description: Ten-year-old Max is abused and laughed at by school bullies and is unable to make friends with anyone. To escape loneliness, he invents two imaginary friends, namely Sharkboy and Lavagirl, who soon become real ...
notes: Robert Rodriguez continues in his schizophrenic production that on the one hand gives birth to adult nightmares and on the other infantile dreams, like the _Spy Kids_ saga, which this film approaches. Rodriguez, director and deus ex machina of the operation, involved almost his entire family in the production and enjoyed working with 3-D, but with really disappointing results.

title: Texas
actors: Fausto Paravidino, Iris Fusetti, Riccardo Scamarcio, Valeria Golino, Valerio Binasco
description: Three Saturdays in the life of a group of friends who live in the Piedmont suburbs. Enrico, after three months of absence, tries to understand how much his friends have changed during his absence. Gianluca, his best friend, lives with his parents, owners of a mechanical workshop, and is engaged to Cinzia, of peasant origin. But then he meets Maria, the town teacher, married to Alessandro ... Davide instead is obsessed with being still a virgin. Elisa fears that everyone will take their own path disappearing from the lives of others ...
notes: A first part characterized by an excited acting and too much wanting to say (in the "declarations of intent" the author quotes Cechov, Lynch and Ford, Fellini and Kaurismäki, Truffaut and Scorsese) is followed by a second one that fine-tunes the breath of a choral work permeated with conscious, precise bitterness (brought, above all, by Valerio Binasco). The same one that echoes from a re-reading of _The Crying Game_, the musical theme of _La wife of the soldier_.

title: Paradise Now
actors: Kais Nashif, Ali Suliman, Lubna Azabal, Amer Hlehel, Hiam Abbass, Ashraf Barhom
description: Said and Kaled, two Palestinian friends, are recruited as suicide bombers for an attack in Tel Aviv. The day before their death mission they decide to spend the last evening in the company of their respective families. The next day, however, something goes wrong and the two must find themselves in a difficult situation ...
notes: It holds up and thrills despite some habits of international auteur cinema. The construction of the characters has clear and simple dynamics, which offer various access keys to the European spectator (especially in the figure of Suha, a middle-class girl who grew up in France). It seems to be the first feature film shot in Nablus.

title: Dracula A.D. 1972
actors: Stephanie Beacham, Christopher Lee, Peter Cushing, Christopher Neame
description: A hundred years have passed since the killing of Dracula by Van Helsing, who also died in the course of the terrible struggle. Now Johnny, a disciple of the vampirologist and Jessica, niece of one of his descendants, have decided to resurrect him during a black mass. The story that happened a century earlier is destined to repeat itself when Dracula begins to claim victims among Jessica's companions. It will be up to Johnny, the new Van Helsing, to try to defeat the prince of darkness.
notes: This film that still sees the legendary couple Lee / Cushing still deserves the sufficiency. The following year the sequel was shot: _I satanic rites of Dracula_.

title: Frankenstein Must Be Destroyed
actors: Peter Cushing, Freddie Jones, Veronica Carlson, Simon Ward
description: Aided by his assistants Karl Holst and Anna Spengler, Baron Victor Frankenstein kidnaps the mentally disturbed Doctor Frederick Brandt. In the plans of the mad scientist there is the most daring and risky undertaking ever attempted in surgery: the transplantation of Brandt's diseased brain into the body of Professor Richter. The result of the operation is a hybrid and monstrous creature that sows violence and terror around itself ...
notes: The fifth film in the series produced by Hammer sees the definitive transformation of the baron into a diabolical lord of Evil, supported by the very inspired direction of Fisher and by a Cushing never so dark and disturbing.

title: Project Viper
actors: Patrick Muldoon, Theresa Russell, Curtis Armstrong, Joe Avalon
description: A new form of life called "Viper", developed in the laboratory and constituted by the fusion between human DNA and microchip, must be transported to Mars to continue the experimentation. To this end, NASA trains a team of specialists and sends it into orbit: but the "thing" - similar to a sort of snail - turns out to be starved of human flesh and exterminates the entire crew. The delicate situation requires the intervention of special agent Mike Connors and doctor Nancy Burnham, "inventor" of the deadly creature: which, however, does not seem to be the only one in circulation ...
notes: Nothing new under the sun of "science-fiction".

title: The Plague of the Zombies
actors: André Morell, Diane Clare, Brook Williams, Jacqueline Pearce

title: Assassination Tango
actors: Robert Duvall, Rubén Blades, Kathy Baker, Luciana Pedraza
description: John J. Anderson, a hitman by profession, deeply attached to his girlfriend Maggie and her daughter Jenny, is sent to Argentina to honor a new contract. But when the man he has to kill, an Argentine army general, forces him to stay in Buenos Aires, John decides to take advantage of the situation. He meets Manuela, a dancer who becomes his dance teacher and who guides him in the universe of tango. The hard return to the reality of his mission will be very difficult ...
notes: The film, unsolved here and there, was born from Duvall's passion for tango. Produced by Francis Ford Coppola.

title: Soy Cuba
actors: Sergio Corrieri, José Gallardo, Raúl García, Luz María Collazo
description: Havana, in 1958, there is a year left before the fall of the Batista regime and the advent of the Castro revolution. Young Maria offers herself to the Americans in a luxury hotel. One of them who spent the night with her realizes the poverty of the neighborhood where the girl lives. Pedro, a settler on a farm where sugar cane is grown, sets fire to everything when he discovers that the owner intends to sell the crop to an American company. Dissident Enrique sacrifices himself when one of his comrades is shot down by the police. Mario gives hospitality to a follower of Fidel and joins the revolutionary army after being bombed by Batista's air force.
notes: The grandiose style is enhanced by the wide angle that offers wonderful glimpses of an extraordinary nature and pages of dignified poverty written without words in the wrinkles of the faces of every Cuban; realities that are only apparently distant but which without contradiction belong to the essence of Cuba and its people. Then there is the extraordinary and natural use of the sequence shot, which on the occasion of the funeral of the revolutionary student Enrique, gives almost three minutes of shocking emotions and that makes even the most daring technicality of De Palma pale.

title: Submerged
actors: Steven Seagal, Christine Adams, William Hope, Nick Brimble, Alison King
description: Military Chris Kody is released from the prison he is in and re-aggregated to his old team, tasked with capturing a scientist who has developed a diabolical psychic control system capable of transforming anyone into a ruthless killer ...
notes: A film tailor-made for Seagal, that is, null in all respects.

title: Craj - Domani
actors: Teresa De Sio, Giovanni Lindo Ferretti, Uccio Aloisi, Matteo Salvatore
Robert Downey jr., Kiefer Sutherland, Bruce Dern, Winona Ryder
description: Ralph and Scott are two young people who, in a small town in the American province, protest against the war in Vietnam. Their personal reasons, however, are different: if Ralph is a convinced idealist, Scott appreciates the lifestyle more than anything else and uses marijuana extensively.
notes: A well-known playwright, Ernest Thompson makes his feature film directorial debut from his own screenplay. The reconstruction of the period would also be effective, but the definition of the characters, between youth and soap-opera, does not allow for that shot that saves costume films from the cliché of nostalgia. The limit was already evident in the original title: 1969.

title: Don Quijote de Orson Welles
actors: Francisco Reiguera, Akim Tamiroff

title: Shaun of the Dead
actors: Simon Pegg, Kate Ashfield, Nick Frost, Lucy Davis, Dylan Moran
description: Shaun, committed at the last stage of life, would like to solve his personal problems once and for all: a twisted relationship with his mother and girlfriend, for example. For the moment, however, he spends his free time at the pub, with his friend Ed. One day, their town is found invaded by the living dead ...
notes: Funny English "pastiche" that elaborates and distorts the stereotypes of Romero's zombie films, among other things present in two cameos (he is an undead and a newspaper reader). Some of the gimmicks are a bit forced and the aura of worship surrounding the film is excessive, but it's fun. Later, the director and actor ended up in Hollywood.

title: Storie scellerate
actors: Ninetto Davoli, Franco Citti, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Silvano Gatti, Enzo Petriglia
description: Bernardino and Mammone, two criminals waiting to be executed, tell each other some stories set in the papal Rome of the 1800s, stories of love and betrayal, abuse and malicious jokes ...

title: Due pezzi di pane
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Anna Melato, Philippe Noiret, Alessandro La Torre

title: Oliver Twist
country: Great Britain, Czech Republic, France, Italy
actors: Barney Clark, Ben Kingsley, Leanne Rowe, Mark Strong, Jamie Foreman, Lewis Chase, Harry Eden, Edward Hardwicke
description: London, 19th century: having escaped the clutches of the family he has been entrusted to, little Oliver Twist meets a street thief who belongs to old Fagin, always ready to hire new recruits. At his first "feat", Oliver is arrested, while the other boys get away with it. Having clarified Oliver's extraneousness to the affair, the wealthy Mr. Brownlow withdraws the complaint against him and welcomes him into the house. But his old companions do not intend to give up on him ...
notes: Polanski does not find an original staging key, and Dickens' memorable creatures remain rigid and inexpressive like those of a time-faded print.

title: Clodia/Fragmenta
actors: Olimpia Carlisi, Elide Melli, Riccardo Reim
description: "Total" author of _Necropolis_ (1970), partner of Mario Schifano in _Transplantation, consumption and death_ (1969, dedicated to himself) and _Umano non human_ (1971), a leading figure in the Italian underground of the 70s, Brocani creates a film that transforms its deliberate fragmentation into a proud declaration of poetics.

title: Balto III: Wings of Change
description: In the snowy northern lands, the delivery of mail has always been entrusted to dog sleds; now, however, the advent of airplanes has marginalized Balto and his companions, who have been sidelined without much ado. But when an aircraft crashes into the side of a mountain, the animals will be able to prove their worth ...
notes: Based on a screenplay by Elana Lesser and Chris Ruby, the second sequel (distributed directly on home video) puts aside the sermons to focus on the traditional adventure: the outcome rewards the intentions, even in terms of animation, and is at least as engaging as the first chapter.

title: Abbott & Costello Meet Frankenstein
actors: Bud Abbott, Lou Costello, Lon Chaney jr., Bela Lugosi, Glenn Strange
description: The placid routine of Wilbur and Chick, employed in a transport agency, is turned upside down by none other than Frankenstein's "creature" and Count Dracula. energize "by grafting a new brain into it. It will be Larry Talbot (alias the wolf-man) who in turn plunged into America from the London mists, to lend a hand to the two unfortunate messengers ...
notes: In the late 1940s, Universal came up with the idea of ??involving the popular Yankee comedy duo in a series of horror parodies, of which this film constitutes the first, tasty chapter.

title: Bad Apple
actors: Chris Noth, Colm Meaney, Mercedes Ruehl, Robert Patrick, Dagmara Dominczyk

title: The Descent
actors: MyAnna Buring, Craig Conway, Natalie Jackson Mendoza, Molly Kayll, Stephen Lamb, Shauna Macdonald
description: A group of speleologists explore an underground cave. Once inside, things get bad ...
notes: Free and aware horror: he asks the gore to say things, he does not neglect the anti-moralistic cruelty, he has the courage to cut and suspend himself in the finale. And it has a funnel-like structure that gives no escape.

title: Must Love Dogs
actors: Diane Lane, John Cusack, Elizabeth Perkins, Christopher Plummer, Dermot Mulroney, Stockard Channing
description: Sarah Nolan, a 40-year-old kindergarten teacher, is fresh from a divorce, but her sisters Carol and Christine decide she needs to meet someone ASAP. The widowed father Bill becomes the model to follow, given the results recently obtained from his internet appointments: so also for Sarah begins the process of encounters with suitors known on the web ...
notes: A demonstration of incurable optimism in the American family and in destiny, which always reserves a second chance. Lubitsch is cited to describe love skirmishes, but the great Berliner lacks the famous touch. Recommended for those who love _ Doctor Zhivago_.

title: Kontroll
actors: Sándor Csányit, Zoltán Mucsi, Csaba Pindroch, Eszter Balla, Lajos Kovács
description: Bulcsú, a subway controller who has cut all ties with the outside world, falls in love with Szofi, a girl who takes the subway every day. For him this love represents the turning point, but a series of murders committed in the subway draws the attention of the company's executives to him.
notes: Evocative Hungarian techno thriller that mixes Bessonian saturations of the 80s and an orgy of hyperkinetic visions almost from commercials. Far from the commonplace of a punitive and militant Hungarian cinema, it screams its originality and its modernity, with a counterproductive visual arrogance. But the gloom of underground history sticks to you and remains: there is a spark of greatness.

title: Enron: The Smartest Guys in the Room
description: The story of one of the worst financial scandals of all time, the one that involved financial operators and senior executives at Enron, a major US company, accused of embezzling over a billion dollars while investors and employees lost all their savings .
notes: Based on the book by two reporters, Bethany McLean and Peter Elkind, the film is the chronicle of an ordinary and shameless story of arrogance, of an aberrant religion of personal profit against savers and investors. The fictional billionaires who star in many films have never been nice; the real ones, mediocre stars of the courts, are unspeakable. The director, wishing to inform, report and entertain, analyzes this incandescent material with Errol Morris style.

title: Sky High
actors: Michael Angarano, Kurt Russell, Kelly Preston, Danielle Panabaker, Kelly Vitz, Lynda Carter, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, Dee Jay Daniels, Will Harris, Nicholas Braun
description: Sky High is a school located in the middle of the clouds for pupils who have to practice the use of their superpowers. Among the members there is Will Stronghold, son of Commander and Jetstream, the legendary defenders of good, but the boy disregards the expectations of his parents thus ending up in the class of "assistants". But Will will bring out the strength and courage to defend his family, friends and school from an evil enemy ...
notes: Oedipus, rewritten in comics, is still Oedipus. Funny jokes, classic situations revisited with originality, brilliant direction and script for funny actors who adapt to the metacinematographic game.

title: Scusi, lei è normale?
actors: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Renzo Montagnani, Enzo Cerusico, Ray Lovelock, Aldo Maccione
description: The young homosexual Franco lives with Nicola, a transvestite who calls himself Nicole. During a dance marathon, Franco meets Anna Maria Immacolata, a beautiful girl and excellent dancer, with whom he begins to practice assiduously. Nicole, jealous of this relationship, fakes suicide ...
notes: Minor work by Lenzi.

title: Il bambino sull'acqua
actors: Vittoria Belvedere, Giuseppe Fiorello, Mattia D'Alessio, Valeria Fabrizi
description: The rare and serious form of asthma that affects the little son Valentino radically changes the menage of the young spouses Antonia and Renzo: she is forced to leave her job, he multiplies the hours in the factory to scrape together the necessary money. The family tightens around the little one, but the difficulties increase and the contrasts are not lacking ...

title: Cleopatra
actors: Claudette Colbert, Henry Wilcoxon, Warren William, Joseph Schildkraut
description: 48 BC: Cleopatra, queen of Egypt, sees in the submission to Rome of Julius Caesar - her lover - a way to consolidate her personal power. After the assassination of Caesar, he will flee to Alexandria and bond with Marcus Anthony ...
notes: DeMille's recipe: grandeur, freedom in historical reconstruction and a touch of sensuality.

title: The Interpreter
actors: Nicole Kidman, Sean Penn, Catherine Keener, Jesper Christensen, Yvan Attal
description: Silvia works as an interpreter at the United Nations headquarters in New York. One day he overhears a telephone conversation about the murder of an African head of state. From that moment his life is in danger. Silvia is placed in the custody of federal agent Keller, convinced that the woman is also part of the plot ...
notes: Pollack and his writers build this thriller with dramaturgical skill that does not need "explosive" scenes with glowing fireworks. You hear the concentric waves of political current events, you choose a coherent and plausible ending, two complex actors are managing very well.

title: Les poupées rousses
actors: Romain Duris, Kelly Reilly, Audrey Tautou, Cécile De France, Kevin Bishop, Evguenya Obraztsova
description: Xavier has grown up, is thirty years old, has become a writer, but the problems are always the same: economic (it is not easy to survive with writing) and sentimental (he keeps going from one adventure to another). When he has to write the script for a normal love story and, at the same time, babysit his ex and nurse his grandfather, he goes into crisis ...
notes: Less choral than _The Spanish apartment_, _Bambole russe_ is yet another film on the crisis of the thirties, a film about cool characters shot in a super-cool, smart and effective way even if with half an hour too long. Kelly Reilly is especially remembered of the protagonists.

title: Valiant
description: During the Second World War, the slender and young pigeon Valiant manages to join the team of carrier pigeons in the service of Her Majesty. Its task is to carry important messages from one side of the Channel to the other, avoiding the fearsome attacks of the hawks in the service of the enemies ...
notes: Although the budget is terribly lower than that of US mega-productions, the level of animation of this all-British film does not disappoint. On the other hand, the excessive simplicity of the plot is not convincing, which too soon renounces building a warp that allows multiple levels of reading.

title: Sophie Scholl. Die letzten Tage
actors: Julia Jentsch, Fabian Hinrichs, Gerald Alexander Held, Johanna Gastdorf, André Hennicke, Florian Stetter
description: Munich 1943. A group of young people founds the White Rose, a peaceful resistance movement aimed at bringing down the Third Reich. The only woman in the group is Sophie Scholl who is arrested, along with her brother Hans, while handing out flyers at the university. In the following days she is questioned by the Gestapo officer Robert Mohr who is struck by the girl's singular courage.
notes: The staging of their sabotage, between claustrophobia and forced silence, brings history to a stylistic figure. From their arrest onwards, the film ends in a grueling, courageous resistance of the protagonist to her fate. Following the last four days of Sophie, Hans and his friend Christoph too philologically, of their summary trial, between police offices and prison. If fairness and mid-tones take precedence over emotion, this does not diminish the commitment to make one glimpse from the openings (the windows of the cell, the glimmers of light between one interrogation and another) obscurantism of every dictatorship.

title: The Legend of Zorro
actors: Antonio Banderas, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Rufus Sewell, Giovanna Zacarías, Raúl Méndez, Adrian Alonso, Nick Chinlund
description: Alejandro and Elena have a ten-year-old son, Joaquin. When California, on the verge of becoming the 31st state of the Union, is threatened by an evil plot hatched by unscrupulous landowners and businessmen, Alejandro does not hesitate to don the mask of Zorro to foil their intent despite that means. jeopardize the safety of his family.
notes: The hero created in 1919 by Johnston McCulley has seen, endured and overcome many, but this time he can't make it. Overwhelmed by the action "relapse" of director Martin Campbell (the same as the most successful _The Mask of Zorro_) is, in many scenes, a very agitated 007 masked. Disoriented by the screenplay's chain accelerations (by Orci and Kurtzman, good for _Alias_, not _The Island_) he is more of a seasoned acrobat than an ironic executioner. The alchemy between Banderas and Zeta-Jones is a pale memory. Blockbuster contracts aren't equipped for miracles.

title: Millennium
actors: Kris Kristofferson, Cheryl Ladd, Daniel J. Travanti, Robert Joy
description: Investigating the causes of an air disaster, Detective Bill Smith discovers that some individuals from the future are involved in the affair, determined to avert the irreparable ecological catastrophe to which the Earth seems destined ...
notes: From a novel by John Varley, a film attributable to the "committed" science fiction trend.

title: CrissCross
actors: Goldie Hawn, Arliss Howard, James Gammon, David Arnott
description: 1969. A 12-year-old lives in Kay West with his mother, a woman who performs as a stripper in a local bar to pay the bills. When he finds out about his business, the guy tries to get the woman to quit that job, to no avail. A restaurant owner then hires him to fetch fish from a boat in the bay, leaving him to discover illicit drug trafficking. The baby then decides to steal a load and take the money earned to his mother.

title: Il dolce corpo di Deborah
actors: Carroll Baker, Jean Sorel, Evelyn Stewart, Luigi Pistilli, George Hilton
description: Marcel and Deborah are on their honeymoon in Geneva: everything seems to be going well, but one day they meet their old friend Philip, who blames them for the suicide of his girlfriend Susan. From that moment on, the two newlyweds are persecuted by Philip, who pursues them with messages of vengeance. To deal with the terror, Deborah begins taking barbiturates. One evening, the ex-friend enters the bedroom and tries to kill the woman in her sleep: Marcel intervenes, triggering a spiral of dramatic events that drag the couple into the abyss ...
notes: Erotic film disguised as yellow, it serves a cheap plot that is only the pretext to discover the bodies.

title: Voto di castità
actors: Gillian Bray, Enzo Colajacono, Flavia Fabiani, Laura Gemser
description: An elderly man decides to leave all his possessions to his nephew. These, however, unexpectedly decides to become a priest. The money then goes to a hospice for prostitutes.

title: La famiglia Brandacci
actors: Silvio Spaccesi, Mara Venier, Leo Gullotta, Annabella Schiavone
description: The life of Pio Brandacci, a delicatessen and a restless father, is turned upside down by his daughter's sudden decision to marry Ricky, a dumb-looking boy fanatic of Madonna and the son of two bourgeois hippies.

title: Beloe solntse pustyni
actors: Anatoli Kuznetsov, Spartak Mishulin, Kakhi Kavsadze, Pavel Luspekayev
description: A Red Army soldier named Sukhov fought for years in the Russian civil war. Just as he is about to return home to his wife, he is chosen to guard and protect the harem of Abdulla, a guerrilla leader. The assignment will prove to be more difficult than he thought.

title: Jours tranquilles à Clichy
actors: Andrew McCarthy, Nigel Havers, Stéphanie Cotta, Stéphane Audran, Barbara De Rossi
description: In the libertine and decadent Paris of the 1930s, Joe, an American boy with literary ambitions, makes friends with Carl, a young Polish photographer. Together they attend brothels and give themselves to vices and entertainment but the war looms threatening on Europe.

title: Yeelen
actors: Issiaka Kane, Aoua Sangare, Niamanto Sanogo, Balla Moussa Keita

title: De battre mon coeur s'est arrêté
actors: Romain Duris, Niels Arestrup, Emmanuelle Devos, Jonathan Zaccaï
description: Thomas, 28, seems to have followed in his father's footsteps in his work: he deals with real estate sales, using unorthodox methods to clear the buildings occupied by immigrants. The chance encounter with his old piano teacher, however, leads him to believe that he could still become a talented pianist. For this he begins to seriously prepare for the audition ...
notes: Audiard chooses the most unpleasant point of view, that of Thomas, and forces the viewer to follow his painful path. It is useless to seek redemption, because even in the face of beauty one is immobile and stained with blood, like Thomas in the finale. Remake of _Rapsodia per un killer_.

title: Telets
actors: Leonid Mozgovoj, Marija Kuznetsova, Sergej Razhuk, Natalja Nikulenko
description: 1923: in his early fifties, Lenin is slowly heading towards death. Isolated and immobilized due to the serious illness that has consumed his body and mind, the great leader is forced to the margins of that history that has contributed so much to change ...
notes: A glimpse of shocking humanity, signed by Sokurov.

title: Fantômes
actors: Guillaume Verdier, Dina Ferreira, Olivier Boreel, Céline Bozon, Armelle Legrand
description: After leaving his first love, Antoine travels to Paris, but the girl's ghost haunts him. Destroyed by the death of her boyfriend Bruno, Mouche summons her spirit to materialize it. One evening, mature Viviane meets the ghosts of the men in her life ...
notes: Suggestive, but not without its ups and downs.

title: Satan's Skin
actors: Patrick Wymark, Linda Hayden, Barry Andrews, Avice Landone
description: In seventeenth-century England, after the discovery of a strange animal, the boys of a village begin to worship the devil.
notes: Horror that looks at the vein of witches in vogue in those years. The film manages to disturb even without a large budget. The rural setting is the perfect setting for pagan rites.

title: Flightplan
actors: Jodie Foster, Peter Sarsgaard, Sean Bean, Erika Christensen, Marlene Lawston
description: Berlin. Kyle Pratt, a recently widowed astronautical engineer, is returning to the United States with his daughter Julia. During the flight the little girl disappears, but the searches on board do not give results and, what is worse, no one remembers seeing her ...
notes: The psychological aspect of the script (Bowling and Ray) is one of the most calibrated (if we exclude the entrance on the scene of a Chess therapist to be interned immediately) of a film that knows how to plan the tension but not to the last framing. The composition of the cast is a wake-up call for the less distracted viewer. The take-off is good, the landing is not so good.

title: Napoleon Dynamite
actors: Jon Heder, Jon Gries, Aaron Ruell, Efren Ramirez, Haylie Duff, Tina Majorino, Sandy Martin
description: Napoleon Dynamite, an eccentric and extravagant teenager who lives with his grandmother and 32-year-old brother, decides to help Pedro, his best friend, become a class representative at Preston High School, snatching the title from Summer Wheatley.
notes: Dry, pauperistic, full of grotesque gimmicks, structured like comic strips, caustic and awake, the film is the first work, funny and not to be underestimated, by 24-year-old Jared Hess.

title: Va, vis et deviens
actors: Yaël Abecassis, Roschdy Zem, Sirak M. Sabahat, Roni Hadar
description: In Ethiopia, during the famine of 1984-85, the Jewish population was helped by Israel and the United States to reach Israel. Schlomo, although not Jewish, is forced by his mother to pretend to be one in order to save himself. The boy later pretends to be an orphan and is adopted by a family of French Sephardi Jews. Growing up he discovers Western culture, racial prejudices and war in the occupied territories. Neither Jew nor orphan, Schlomo is just a black man like so many others, with a deep nostalgia for his mother whom he hopes one day to find again ...
notes: Everything is difficult: to be accepted by the rabbinic community, to maintain a bond with the mother, to be loved by Sarah, to understand the political reality of the country: but the parable of Schlomo (well summarized by the original title, which follows the three phases of the film) it is realized thanks to his will to simply be and become a man. Mihaileanu starts from the complexity of a little known historical fact (the "Moses" operation) and dresses it with a universal meaning. The paradoxicality of the script highlights the senselessness of the case, of religious dogmatism and of "return" racism. To see, experience and review.

title: Hope Springs
actors: Colin Firth, Heather Graham, Minnie Driver, Mary Steenburgen
description: Colin is an English portrait painter who, after the end of his relationship with his girlfriend Vera, takes refuge in a cheap hotel in a small town in Vermont. The owner of the hotel tries to cheer him up and arranges a meeting with Mandy, a local girl who works as a nurse: the two start dating, but in the meantime Vera arrives in town, perhaps ready to make peace with Colin. ..
notes: Although based on a novel by Charles Webb, the author of _The Graduate_, this romantic comedy shows no trace of malice, and the only idea of ??the director-screenwriter seems to be the frame of golden autumn leaves.

title: Johnson Family Vacation
actors: Cedric the Entertainer, Vanessa Williams, Steve Harvey, Solange Knowles
description: Nate Johnson is invited by his wealthy, know-it-all brother to a big family reunion in Missouri. Nate loads his split-up wife Dorothy and his three children, teenager Nikki, future little rapper DJ, and precocious seven-year-old Destiny into his new SUV, for what he imagines will be a leisurely ride from Los Angeles to Los Angeles. St. Louis. However, between a wary wife, quarrelsome children, angry police officers, bizarre hitchhikers, bad food, and an unfortunate accident with a concrete mixer, getting to the coveted destination will be a nightmare.
notes: First disappointing film by video clip director Christopher Erskin.

title: Pote tin kyriaki
actors: Melina Mercouri, Jules Dassin, George Foundas, Titos Vandis
description: Homer Trace arrives in Greece from Connectout. He is a scholar and intends to devote himself to the art and culture of ancient Greece. At Pireo he meets Ilya, a prostitute with a strong character, capable of going beyond the "commercial" relationship with his customers, so much so that on Sunday he goes out for a walk with them. Homer aims to become an engine of his change: for two weeks she will be his student and he will instruct it on the history of his own country.
notes: Adaptation of the Pigmalion of Goerge Bernard Shaw, revisited a few years later also by the famous My Fair Lady (1964), which however did not refer to this film but took inspiration directly from the 1956 musical (and therefore antecedent).

title: A Saintly Switch
actors: Vivica A. Fox, David Alan Grier, Rue McClanahan, Al Waxman
description: Dan Anderson - a late NFL quarterback - and his wife Sara are on the verge of divorce. After a traumatic move to an old house in New Orleans, the couple's children try to remedy the situation and gather in the attic in search of the "magic" capable of reviving harmony between parents ...

title: Assault on Precinct 13
actors: Ethan Hawke, Laurence Fishburne, John Leguizamo, Kim Coates, Ja Rule, Brian Dennehy
description: Chief Sergeant Jake Roenick faces a real battle. Due to bad weather, some transfer inmates, including boss Marion Bishop, are taken into custody by District 13. Suddenly the district suffers a series of attacks that strain the cops' stamina, forcing Jake to cooperate with the inmates. to survive.
notes: French director Jean-François Richet (_Ma 6-T va crack-er_) directs - very well - the remake of the John Carpenter's classic. Which remains an unrivaled masterpiece, and in fact works only as a starting point, as a "western" model to be inspired by. The new _District 13_ speaks the acrid language of the peripheral revolt, frames stereotypical characters (the "wounded" cop, the "seductive" gangster, the "redeeming" woman) and makes them interact according to unsettling coordinates. Who are the bad guys, really? All. Or none. Atmospheres of a very solid American B-movie, however, filtered by a very European (even "ideological") sensitivity, if it is true - as it is true - that the producer Pascal Caucheteaux is also French like the director. Nothing transcendental, but cinema anyway with muscles and all the dots on the "i". Excellent cast, Brian Dennehy in the lead.

title: Habana Blues
actors: Alberto Yoel, Roberto Sanmartín, Yailene Sierra, Zenia Marabal
description: Ruy and Tito are two young Cuban musicians. Tito lives with his grandmother, Ruy with his wife Caridad, and two children. When they hear the news of the arrival of Martha and Lorenzo, two Spanish record producers looking for new talent, they understand that their big break has come.
notes: Despite the musical connotation, which reveals great turmoil in the world of youth bands, the film is strongly inspired by the contradictions that animate today's Cuba: on the one hand the desire to escape and on the other the strong rootedness with the past. Ruy and Tito perfectly represent these antithetical tendencies, which the two overcome thanks to the feeling of friendship.

title: Fantômas
actors: Jean Galland, Thomy Bourdelle, Tania Fédor, Jean Worms, Georges Rigaud
description: The Marquise of Langrune has invited some friends to her castle of Beaulieu: among the guests are Lord Beltham and Princess Danidoff, who has priceless jewels with her. But there is tension in the air: the mysterious Fantômas is lurking ...
notes: The characters invented by Allain and Souvestre are back (in a version so-so).

title: La vérité sur Bébé Donge
actors: Danielle Darrieux, Jean Gabin, Jacques Castelot, Daniel Lecourtois
description: Admitted to the clinic, the wealthy businessman François Donge is on the verge of death. According to the "official" version, it would be a food poisoning: but in reality it is his wife Bebe who organized everything ...
notes: From a novel by Georges Simenon (scripted by Maurice Aubergé), a discreet film.

title: Insiang
actors: Hilda Koronel, Mona Lisa, Ruel Vernal, Rez Cortez, Marlon Ramirez
description: The peddler Tonya lives in a shack on the outskirts of Manila with her daughter Insiang and her husband's very poor relatives, who abandoned her. Now Tonya is with Dado, a rascal who rapes Insiang: his mother believes Dado's version, however, and the girl ponders revenge ...
notes: Brocka signs the first Filipino film presented in Cannes.

title: Bodas de sangre
actors: Antonio Gades, Cristina Hoyos, Juan Antonio Jiménez, Pilar Cárdenas

title: Crash
actors: Don Cheadle, Matt Dillon, Sandra Bullock, Jennifer Esposito, Thandie Newton, Ryan Phillippe, Brendan Fraser
description: A Chinese couple, two casual loving cops, two gossiping car thieves, a prosecutor and his bored wife, a racist cop and the idealistic young recruit, a successful black TV director and his wife, a Persian trader who buys a gun to defend his shop, a Hispanic worker and his child, terrified of bullets: all destined to meet and clash within hours in LA.
notes: Racism and fear, resentment, cultural and ethnic conflicts: the connections between the characters are paths that converge in a roundabout steeped in pessimism on the American way of life.

title: Edison
actors: Kevin Spacey, Morgan Freeman, Justin Timberlake, LL Cool J, Dylan McDermott, Piper Perabo
description: The young and ambitious journalist Josh Pollack uncovers an internal corruption affair at Frat, Edison City's most elite police unit, and would like to reveal everything in the newspaper he writes for. His boss Moses Ashford, an award-winning photojournalist for his reportage who, however, does not seem to love scandals anymore, tries to stop him and eventually fires him. But Pollack is determined to go all the way, even with the risk of endangering his life and that of his beloved ...
notes: Elementary script, use of useless slowdowns, blows of mind, involuntary humor, gooey romanticism, great shooter ending. There are no more villains than they used to be, and Freeman and Spacey have to pay their taxes too.

title: Everything Is Illuminated
actors: Elijah Wood, Eugene Hutz, Jonathan Safran Foer, Stephen Samudovsky, Zuzana Hodkova
description: Young Jonathan Safran Foer sets out in search of the woman who saved his grandfather's life during World War II. He arrives in a Ukrainian town where he meets Alex who agrees to be his guide. It is for him the beginning of a surprising and full of revelations experience, on the importance of memory, the Holocaust, the meaning of friendship and, above all, love.
notes: In fact, the film is a delightful journey into the problems of today's world, such as the confrontation between different, almost irreconcilable cultures. Then there is the contrast between the speed of everyday life and the pleasant slowness of a film that works in the fascinating ravines proposed by the memory / oblivion dichotomy, between the natural tendency of the human being to forget and the need to remember his own story. _Everything is illuminated by the light of the past_ and Trachimbrod, the fantastic or erased place from human history, finally becomes real, embodying the essence of that great tragedy of the world that was the Holocaust.

title: Mai + come prima
actors: Laura Chiatti, Natalia Piatti, Marco Velluti, Marco Casu, Pino Quartullo, Nicola Cipolla
description: A group of friends, after the high school exam, decide to go on a mountain holiday. Among them is an extremely sensitive and self-deprecating handicapped boy. In close contact with nature, all of them will have to learn to look after themselves and make important decisions ...
notes: Campiotti's cinema loves large natural spaces and high-sounding breath. Here, despite the sincere inspiration and trust in the story (inspired by an autobiographical episode by the director, this time also the producer), the screenplay, by Campiotti and the usual collaborator Alexander Adabachian, does not escape the didacticism of distilling life precepts as a Coelho bestseller . Which ends up frustrating the educational intent ("seek the strength within yourself"). The cast of almost all rookies, on which Max Cipolla stands out, the spastic boy, has no faults. Not even Natalia Piatti, already an effective girl in The time of love. Naturism and new age temptations out of time contribute to never making us feel these "warriors of light" (with the working title) really authentic. Nice cameo by Francesco Salvi.

title: In Her Shoes
actors: Cameron Diaz, Toni Collette, Shirley MacLaine, Anson Mount, Richard Burgi
description: Rose, a popular lawyer, and Maggie, a splendid girl who is especially interested in parties, are two sisters who have in common only the DNA and the size of their shoes. After a terrible fight, Rose chases Maggie out of the house. The latter, having nowhere to stay, sets out on the trail of her grandmother, whom she hasn't seen for years, and begins to rethink her life.
notes: Curtis Hanson is one of the few directors in Hollywood who still believes in characters, in stories, in cinema that is built with details, dialogues, passing scenes, connections that explore the plot. The complicity, the interdependence, the disagreement, the emulation, the emotional failure between two sisters are fascinating subjects rendered with intelligence.

title: Cinderella
directors: Clyde Geronimi, Wilfred Jackson, Hamilton Luske
description: Cinderella, orphaned of her beloved parents, lives with her cruel stepmother and two horrible stepsisters Anastasia and Genoveffa, who treat her like a servant. Meanwhile, the King decides that the time has come to find a wife for his son and holds a grand ball to which all the unmarried girls of the realm are invited. Unfortunately, Cinderella does not have a suitable dress for the party, but she remedies with the help of her animal friends by meeting the fury of her stepsisters ...
notes: The formula of the 12th Disney classic knows how to charm children of all ages by combining the fable of "Cenerella" with the adventures of her funny mice against the cat Lucifer, completely absent in the various versions of the fairy tale, from Perrault to the most ancient ones. The tantrums of the old sovereign who dreams of grandchildren bring to mind the comedies of Cukor set in European courts, with even a hint of transgression in the fetishism for the slipper that will be caught only by the most savvy adults. Finally, at least two songs have rightly become absolute hits, still hummed today: Dreams are Desires and Bibbidi-Bobbidi-Boo.

title: Due mattacchioni al Moulin Rouge
actors: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Margaret Lee, Antonella Steni
description: A dancer is killed in a night club. The investigations, carried out by an alleged police inspector, undergo an arrest for the sudden disappearance of the victim's body. In the end, however, it will be discovered that it was an advertising ploy implemented by the dancer herself and her manager. Lara St. Paul, Nini Rosso, the Borrah Minevitch, the Rock Brothers, Pery Han, the Hully Gully Boys, Anita and Louis

title: Elysium
description: Year 2113: on earth devastated by an atomic disaster, four boys must fight for the survival of the human species. The battle they are forced to face is against an enemy who landed by the spaceship Elysium ...
notes: The film, with an animation reminiscent of the PlayStation, hits an infinite series of commonplaces.

title: Melissa P.
actors: Maria Valverde, Letizia Ciampa, Primo Reggiani, Fabrizia Sacchi, Geraldine Chaplin, Nilo Zimmerman, Claudio Santamaria, Carlo Antonelli, Pier Giorgio Bellocchio, Marcello Mazzarella, Elio Germano, Alba Rohrwacher, Davide Pasti
description: Melissa is a 16 -year -old Sicilian girl. Disappointed by boyfriend Daniele, he embarked on a journey to self -destruction that leads her to discover a world of sexual perversion for her until then unimaginable. The anchor of salvation to get out of the spiral of depravity in which it fell could be represented by the beloved paternal grandmother, the only person to whom Melissa feels like ...
notes: Not that the bestsellers of reference was an opera chief, but given the film he wants to re -evaluate it. "If there was an examination of immaturity, she would pass him with flying colors" shows an unpleasant professor to the young woman. And the joke is an compound metaphor of the operation.

title: Lord of War
actors: Nicolas Cage, Ethan Hawke, Bridget Moynahan, Jared Leto, Ian Holm
description: Arms dealer Yuri Orlov must always stay one step ahead of everyone: Interpol agent Jack Valentine, who has been on his trail for some time, his business rivals, but also some of his clients, some of the best-known dictators of the world. world.
notes: The theme with a capital T, in layman's terms, often risks eating the film. The most engaging things concern the protagonist's family milieu (the relationship with his brother, the betrayal of his wife) and the not obvious role of the Ginko on duty, the upright policeman played by Ethan Hawke who for a curious short circuit in the definition of the characters he is more unpleasant than the villain

title: An Unfinished Life
actors: Robert Redford, Jennifer Lopez, Morgan Freeman, Josh Lucas, Damian Lewis, Becca Gardner
description: Einer Gylkison, along with his right-hand man and greatest friend Mitch Bradley, have lived on his ranch in Wyoming for over forty years. And it is here that one day Jean shows up with her 11-year-old daughter Griff, fleeing the mistreatment of her husband Gary ...
notes: The secondary plot, in which Einer - who knows why - takes it into his head to free the grizzly that had hurt Mitch, ends up eating the film, and the "politically correct" imposes ecological emphases. Freeman plays the same role as _Million Dollar Baby_. Hallström confirms himself as a cloying illustrator, with only a certain sensitivity for places to his credit.

title: La marche de l'empereur
description: A documentary about emperor penguins: love, drama, courage and adventures in the heart of the Antarctic where, every year, they leave the water and face a long march on the ice to reach the ice floe and reproduce.
notes: The director-biologist Jacquet catalyzes an empathy that activates some genetic memory and projects on this Antarctic saga intuitions, fears, feelings, anthropomorphic concepts. The result is a splendid narrative documentary, which does not trace the visits to the humanized zoos of similar Disney products nor revisits the accurate and spectacular ethological-scientific vein of the many films on nature made for TV.

title: Goal!
actors: Kuno Becker, Alessandro Nivola, Marcel Iures, Stephen Dillane, Anna Friel
description: Santiago Munez emigrated from Mexico to the United States with his family in search of a better future. His dream, since he was a child, is to become a soccer player. One day a talent scout offers him an audition for the English team Newcastle United. Santiago accepts and leaves for Great Britain ...
notes: Danny Cannon has been absent from the big screen since 2000, when he began a massive series of directing for CSI. Here he packs a rather weak and conventional product, with a dream come true, not returning any of the many contradictions of the world of football. Among the stars of the balloon appear Zidane, Shearer and Raul.

title: The Big White
actors: Robin Williams, Holly Hunter, Woody Harrelson, Alison Lohman, Giovanni Ribisi
description: Travel agent Paul Barnes lives in Alaska with his wife Margaret, who suffers from Tourette's syndrome. He would like to move to a warm place, but he has no money. He then tries to get hold of the insurance of his brother Raymond who disappeared into thin air, but the insurance agent tells him that at least 7 years must pass for the policy to be redeemable. When Paul finds a body in a landfill he decides to pretend it's his brother's. But he didn't take into account the arrival of two hit men, looking for a body ...
notes: Situations (partially successful), dialogues, characterization of the actors are cut, with moderate imagination, on the serial patterns of the black comedy. One immediately thinks of certain minor cinema influenced by the Coens (the fault of the cast and some atmospheres) and of the obvious features of an independent cinema that considers genres a bar to be overcome or under which to slip.

title: The Wild Blue Yonder
country: France, Germany, Great Britain, United States
actors: Brad Dourif, Ellen Baker, Franklin Chang-Diaz
description: An alien returning from a failed mission to earth, tells what would happen if a space shuttle orbiting the earth could no longer return there because the living conditions on our planet have become impossible. The astronauts would be forced to look for another planet to settle in.
notes: In this astonishing space odyssey, which enters the interplanetary highway beyond the Copernican orbits (thanks to "string theory"), Herzog accumulates frame debris, uses the voice off like Scorsese but then indulges in silent cinema, singing Sardinians, from the sonatas of Handel, steals pieces of ancient film (planes and trains of the early 1900s) as Ed Wood would have done, interspersing them with lessons in the style of the Neptune Consortium: more than at the cinema, it seems to be at the planetarium. With sincere irony he thanks NASA for its "poetic sense" and leaves us drowning in flakes of particles, fragments of former life for an unknown that we cannot (yet) grasp.

title: Mørkets øy
actors: Sofie Gråbøl, Paul-Ottar Haga, Sina Langfeldt, Terje Strømdahl

title: Yesterday's Children
actors: Jane Seymour, Clancy Brown, Kyle Howard, Denis Conway
description: Jenny Cole happily married with one child and expecting another has a recurring dream: she sees a small town dominated by a large church. The woman confides everything to her mother and this shows her some drawings she had made as a child and which portray a place very similar to the one Jenny dreamed of. After various investigations, mother and daughter come to the conclusion that the small town really existed in Ireland in the 1930s. So Jenny, accompanied by her son, leaves for Ireland to try to discover the mysterious bond that exists between her and that place ... Maybe Jenny has lived there in the past?

title: The Governess
actors: Minnie Driver, Tom Wilkinson, Harriet Walter, Florence Hoath, Harriet Walter, Florence Hoath, Bruce Myers, Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Arlene Cockburn, Emma Bird, Adam Levy
description: England 1830. Rosina is the sophisticated eldest daughter of a wealthy Jewish family. But when his father is killed, his world is shattered. The girl decides to pass herself off as a gentile under the name of Mary Blackchurch and leaves for the Hebridean islands, in Scotland, where she finds employment as a housekeeper with the Cavendish, a wealthy couple. Soon between her and Charles Cavendish, a scholar and photography enthusiast, an attraction arises, destined shortly to turn into true passion, aided by the fact that she stimulates and assists him in her photographic studio. This, of course, is destined to precipitate the situation.

title: Una bella governante di colore
actors: Ines Pellegrini, Renzo Montagnani, Marisa Merlini, Orchidea De Santis, Jean-Claude Vernè, Gianfranco D'Angelo
description: The industrialist Nicola Sallustri, who cheats on his wife with a doctor, has a son, Simone who gets any maid who comes within range of him pregnant. When it also happens to Miriam, a black woman, he forces his son to marry her. Not for this, but Simone will give up his Gallicism.

title: I vizi morbosi di una governante
actors: Rino Bellini, Beppe Colombo, Annie Carol Edel, Corrado Gaipa

title: Cenerentola '80
actors: Pierre Cosso, Bonnie Bianco, Sandra Milo, Adolfo Celi, Vittorio Caprioli, Edy Angelillo, Sylva Koscina

title: Scooby-Doo and the Legend of the Vampire

notes: Bitter, but not really bitter, like the novel by Steve Martin (also author of the screenplay) from which it is taken, a refined minimalist, vaguely Hopperian (Edward), but as "polished" by the bright enamel of contemporary Los Angeles artists, neon, colors, characters framed in their isolation with a certain naive tenderness, Shopgirl tells the solitary and silent story of Mirabelle.

notes: The predictable, desired apparatus of Jewish tradition on which to ironize is rather meager, it is all external, formal, but above all the script does not stand out for its Yiddish humor. Here, if anything, what works is the mechanism of farce, albeit here and there predictable and limping, seasoned with elements of intercultural comedy and programmatic sexual "openings" (the lesbian daughter, the inhibited son, the nymphomaniac niece, the idyllic brothel). All thanks to an overwhelming Henry Hübchen and an outline of expressive character actors.

notes: The English mastiff Statham in his antipathy works, Gassman has the physique of the role and the beautiful Valletta would make a dead man sensitive, not to mention the action scenes choreographed by Corey Yuen: in short, the sufficient ingredients to send neurons on vacation without feeling guilty is not lacking.

notes: The free accumulation of events - with _The King_ (sacrilege !!!) who first becomes involved in a murder in spite of himself then turns into an exterminating angel - makes the story morally objectionable, not to mention that the ostentatious "distance" of author towards his characters, almost without any judgment, is a double-edged sword and stinks of fake a mile away. Great proof of William Hurt, the sinful father, and beautiful Pell James, the daughter. The rest is to be thrown away.

notes: Solitary and solipsistic wanderings from the nouvelle vague, zero communication, desemantized sexuality. As in The Hole, poor but brilliant choreography and sung numbers update the decadence of Hollywood-style 1950s Hong Kong musicals. More than a sexy comedy - the watermelon is not the marine eel, despite the winking press campaign - a polyptych on the meaning of the body.

notes: Torrid mélo adventurous.

description: A poacher finds a precious stone and attempts to resell it. The man is stopped by the men of the Ministry of Science because that object is a gem that has an inexhaustible source of energy. To find the deposit he goes to Africa where he meets two lion cubs, children of Kimba and Lia.
notes: From one of the masters of Japanese animation.

title: Big Fat Liar

Jason will try in every way to stop the making of the film.
notes: Shawn Levy directs a children's comedy with clear satirical intent, but it misses the mark. Lee Majors' cameo as a stunt performer at sunset.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
actors: Brad Pitt, Angelina Jolie, Vince Vaughn, Adam Brody, Michelle Monaghan, Kerry Washington
description: John and Jane Smith have been married for years and are going through the inevitable crisis. Each of them actually hides something from the other: Mr. and Mrs. Smith are actually two ruthless killers who work for rival organizations. When they are tasked with killing each other, the two discover a new source of emotion in their relationship ...
notes: You watch the film more than anything else to see extra-script glances between the two stars, which can somehow justify their alleged love story. It is not the films that adapt to reality shows but our perception-expectation as spectators, and this is an "anthropological" tragedy. Noteworthy is the photography by Bojan Bazelli, former historical collaborator of Abel Ferrara.

title: Chicken Little

He becomes the laughing stock of the city and just as people begin to forget, a piece of sky really falls on their heads. This time Chicken Little and his bunch of friends really have to save the world ...
notes: What is new about this zoomorphic animation from Disney that has caught up with the times (from Pixar)? That we must always think that tomorrow will be a better day, and have self-confidence. The problem is that he spits it out to us, more than self-evidently, from the very first minute, and forgets a little thing called intertwining, or conflict.

title: The Cave
actors: Cole Hauser, Morris Chestnut, Eddie Cibrian, Rick Ravanello, Lena Headey, Piper Perabo

Speleologists then begin to explore the place, but underground not only find a new ecosystem, but a hitherto unknown species ...
notes: There is a likelihood of the set - twelve thousand caves have been discovered in Romania - and palpable scientific advice, especially biological, which justifies the genetic modifications of the ferocious invertebrates that terrorize explorers. The devil has almost nothing to do with it, but he will show up in the (almost certain) sequel to which the ending winks.

As if that weren't enough, there is the gang headed by the beautiful Tsu and her brother Kien, with whom the Yamakasi are forced, in spite of themselves, to collaborate ...
notes: Dramatic complexity is not the strong point of this project. If anything, it is the fascination of acrobatic scenes in pure commercial style (climbing of buildings, fighting in mid-air on scaffolding, final Kill Bill-style battle) to win a moderate consensus.

title: Gargoyle
actors: Michael Paré, Sandra Hess, Fintan McKeown, Kate Orsini, Tim Abell
description: Romania, 1532. The skies of the region are haunted by a gargoyle. Terrified, the inhabitants decide to hunt the evil creature and turn to a priest who, using a crossbow, manages to kill it. Bucharest, today. Two CIA agents are called to prevent the kidnapping of the son of an American ambassador. To upset the plans of the agents a terrible earthquake, which puts the kidnappers to flight and awakens the gargoyle, which has been buried for centuries.
notes: A rather low-level monster movie that fully reflects Wynorski's style. Special effects fall within the fairly poor average of productions of this type, while dialogue and acting leave something to be desired.

title: Cry_Wolf

description: Owen Matthews, kicked out of his old school, enrolls in Westlake Prep, a high school where a terrible crime was committed. Here with other guys he spreads the news online that the perpetrator of the crime is a serial killer called "the riddler" who will soon hit again ... When the victims described for fun begin to really disappear, Owen and his friends understand that to be in trouble.
notes: Small thriller with a usual setting and a now classic cut, so skilled in its double and triple final reversals as to be unusual. Written well (by director Jeff Wadlow with Beau Beaumont), with non-decerebrated dialogues, it also has the merit of not exploiting in a redundant or banal key the many "clichés" it stages (Halloween, the shower, the deserted library). It cheats a bit, in a not inconsiderable detail, but it is effective.

Now, thanks to a transplant, she has regained her sight but nothing can give her back the child who is no longer there. A nightmare torments her every night, she seems to relive the last moments of the life of the giver of her eyes, in the dream a man tries to kill her.

In pain, Russell decides to travel to Italy to visit the small Tuscan town where his beloved was born and raised. Soon, his curiosity is drawn to Angela, a young woman who everyone believes is cursed by the devil. Despite the warnings, Russell becomes convinced that there is some connection between Angela's strange behavior and his wife's death, discovering baffling truths.

notes: Based on the book of the same name by James Mills, published in Italy by Mondadori, a discreet 1970s detective story cited by Jonathan Demme as one of his favorites of the period. Richard Gere appears in one of his first roles, but the best is Yaphet Kotto.

The lawyer Nicola Lombardo, a liberal who took office in the town hall with the uncertain authority conferred on him by the governor of Catania, tried in vain to curb the popular reaction and to start a reorganization work in the name of justice and equality. The picciotti occupy the town hall of Bronte and give life to a popular government. Nino Bixio, immersed in the preparations for the landing in Calabria, cannot leave hotbeds of revolt behind him and personally goes to Bronte at the head of a strong contingent of Garibaldi soldiers. Having 150 people arrested, he sets up a military court to try five major suspects, including the lawyer Lombardo. In just one day the process ends; the accused are all found guilty and shot.

title: Fuori vena

title: La fin du monde

title: Me and You and Everyone We Know
actors: Miranda July, John Hawkes, Miles Thompson, Brandon Ratcliff, Carlie Westerman, Hector Elias
description: Christine Jesperson is an artist who in her spare time chauffeurs elderly people with walking problems. Richard Swersey, a clerk in a department store, in the shoe department, has instead returned from a failed marriage and has to look after two children. One day, Christine and Richard get to know each other and their meeting is destined to change the lives of both of them.
notes: Beautiful debut of July, independent doc, with a clear and clean look, a lot of undisguised skill and an equally sense of humor; this is what allows her not to become pedantic and to observe with humanity the many shy and solitary characters that intertwine with the main story: the two petulant teen-agers who provoke the fat young man who looks at them from the window; the old man from the institute who found the love of his life at the age of seventy; the director of the museum who harshly hides her terrors; the grumpy little girl who buys improbable items for her future home; Richard's two children - aged 14 and 7 - having their first sexual "experiences", with their partners or on the Net.
