description: Frank, leader of a gang of outlaws, would like to learn to read and write and for this reason he kidnaps Melissa, a young teacher wife of Brandt, rich and degenerate ranchero. He, reached by the news of the kidnapping while some friends are traveling on a hunting trip during which long-range rifles and telescopes are tested, begins the search for the kidnappers. Meanwhile, Melissa, several times protected by Frank from the assaults of the other members of the gang, falls in love with him. The two attempt to save themselves by reaching the border and trying to escape Brandt's hunt.
notes: Violent and rather crude Western.

title: Pamuk Prenses ve 7 cüceler
actors: Zeynep Degirmencioglu, Salih Güney, Suna Selen, Mehmet Asik

title: Two Smart People
actors: Lucille Ball, John Hodiak, Lloyd Nolan, Hugo Haas, Lenore Ulric

title: Vital
actors: Tadanobu Asano, Nami Tsukamoto, Kiki, Kazuyoshi Kushida

title: La vie de bohème
actors: Matti Pellonpää, Evelyne Didi, André Wilms, Kari Väänänen
description: Marcel, Shaunard and Rodolfo are respectively a writer, a pianist and a painter. Or rather, they try to be. They know and make friends in the name of the same miserable loneliness, the same disordered nonconformity. The three penniless live by expedients, but have not lost the taste for irony, the profound sense of friendship, the ability to cultivate hope and to believe that one day it will come true.
notes: It is well known that nothing ever happens in Kaurismaki's films. This is no exception, but once you get used to the low pressure, the rhythm becomes very brisk: in the apparent immovability, there are devastating glimpses of irony and sadness, sarcasm and rot.

title: Ligne de vie
actors: Vincent Perez, Tanya Meshcherina, Armen Dzhigarkhanyan
description: While waiting for his plane to Paris, Philippe Robin at Moscow airport is approached by Oksana, a mysterious woman who offers to show him the real face of the Russian capital. Succumbing to his charm, Philippe lets himself be led on a tour of bars and night clubs, until Oksana pours something into his glass ...

title: Tav aszi zápor
actors: Annabella, Istvan Gyergyai, Ilona Dajbukát, Karola Zala, Germaine Aussey
description: Maria is a waitress who becomes pregnant and is fired. Humiliated in the village, she flees to the city where she is welcomed among prostitutes: when the authorities take the child away from her, she commits suicide; but from beyond he watches over his daughter who seems to want to retrace his steps ...
notes: Anthropologist and director, Fejös became an American citizen in those years.

title: Il mio amico Babbo Natale
actors: Lino Banfi, Vittoria Belvedere, Gerry Scotti, Gianluca Grecchi, Sergio Graziani, Daniela Morozzi, Isabella Cecchi, Stefania Spugnini, Emiiano Coltori
description: An industrialist from Northern Italy who does not believe in the values ??of life and Christmas will be "redeemed" by a Santa Claus from the Apulian accent.
notes: For Banfi it is the first fiction by Mediaset, while for the host of _Passaparola_ it is the debut in fiction after 120 episodes of situation-comedy.

title: Memoirs of a Geisha
actors: Gong Li, Zhang Ziyi, Ken Watanabe, Michelle Yeoh, Mako, Eugenia Yuan
description: A Japanese girl is taken from her family, who lives in misery, to work as a servant in a geisha's house. Years pass and the girl becomes a legendary geisha named Sayuri. Beautiful and talented, Sayuri seduces the most powerful men of the time even if her heart beats in secret for the only one she can never have ...
notes: The ostentatious elegance and aestheticism of such a postmodern film - one for all: Sayuri's dancing debut scene - should not be mistaken for pure formalism, nor does it compromise the enjoyment of what honestly looks like a colossal, exotic fresco " of yesteryear ".

title: Ti amo in tutte le lingue del mondo
actors: Leonardo Pieraccioni, Marjo Berasategui, Giorgio Panariello, Rocco Papaleo, Massimo Ceccherini, Giulia Elettra Gorietti, Francesco Guccini, Barbara Enrichi
description: Gilberto, a professor of gymnastics, has just separated from his wife when he discovers that Paolina, a sixteen-year-old student of his, is madly in love with him. The girl declares her love to him in all the languages ??of the world on slips of paper that she finds everywhere. Gilberto does not know how to resolve the situation, especially as Paolina would kill him if he discovered that there is a rival. And there is a rival, Margherita, an animal psychologist at the Pistoia zoo ...
notes: If anything, it is the supporting actors who make up points for general neglect: a vulgar Papaleo, a horny teacher, an inspired Ceccherini, a little hippy little brother, and a surreal Panariello, the protagonist's stammering brother. All the rest is flatness, and even a little vulgarity, unlike the previous films: even the farts of stracultiana devotion return to plague the proclaimed purity of the Peter Pan in Florence. The only reference to Leonardo's childhood soul is Tricarico's intense song, Musica. There are those who save themselves with music and those who ruin them: to Guccini the palm for the worst cameo. But the takings have already proved us wrong.

title: Have No Fear: The Life of Pope John Paul II
actors: Thomas Kretschmann, Bruno Ganz, Joaquim De Almeida, John Albasiny, Charles Kay, Jasper Harris, Inga Salkauskaite, Petar Goranov, Michael Klesic
description: The film traces the story of Karol Wojtyla from his election as Pope on October 16, 1978 until his death on the evening of April 2, 2005. John Paul II, who passed unscathed from a terrible attack in St. Peter's Square on May 13, 1981, contributed to the collapse of communism in Eastern Europe.

title: Natale a Miami
actors: Christian De Sica, Massimo Boldi, Massimo Ghini, Vanessa Hessler, Giuseppe Sanfelice, Raffaella Bergé
description: A few days before the start of the Christmas holidays, Ranuccio, his son Paolo and Giorgio are left by their respective companions. To forget his wife Daniela, Giorgio leaves with Mario, his best friend, who must join his ex-wife and daughter Stella in Miami, who is in love with Giorgio. Still in Florida, Ranuccio joins his twenty-year-old son Paolo and his friends ...
notes: A film of the Nothing, a jumble of show skits stuck to each other with saliva: the "surprise" of a trans, a fellatio stuck in a braces, a pan of devoured testicles, an immeasurable number of fucks that do not go to sign.

title: Kirikou et les bêtes sauvages
description: The wise Nonno tells the story of the small and ingenious Kirikù: when he became a gardener, then a detective, a potter, a merchant, a traveler and also a doctor ...
notes: Forget about three-dimensional flattery, the layout favors the truth of the drawing with a movement analogous to the philosophical simplicity of the script. How to never trust appearances, think for yourself, not get scared and ask questions until we get answers. The Manichean contrast between Good and Evil is not part of this microcosm of women and children: apart from the wise Grandfather, the elderly represent a foolish resistance to the thoughtful enterprise of Kirikù.

title: Rumor Has It...
actors: Jennifer Aniston, Kevin Costner, Shirley MacLaine, Mark Ruffalo, Richard Jenkins, Mena Suvari
description: Sarah Huttinger, a New York Times obituary journalist, has agreed to marry her fiancé Jeff. But she is not convinced that she has made the right choice ... The opportunity to understand what she really wants comes when she meets the billionaire Beau Burroughs, who reveals some secrets about her and her family ...
notes: The grandmother, Mrs. Robinson, is the film's ace in the hole: an insolent, foul-mouthed Shirley MacLaine, perennial cigarette, crotchless in the evening, red miniskirt by day, five earlobe piercings, who apostrophes her granddaughter: " Sarah, you won't want to believe everything you see in the cinema! ". And Kevin Costner is the "real" Benjamin, never graduated and much more a womanizer, a kind of "rite of passage" for all the women in the family. Produced by Clooney, Soderbergh and associates, well written by TM Griffin (_Ocean's Eleven_ and _The genius of the scam_), ironically directed by Rob Reiner, very funny in the first part, a little weaker in the second, a pleasant homage to the great "New Hollywood ".

title: Reinas
actors: Veronica Forqué, Carmen Maura, Marisa Paredes, Mercedes Sampietro, Betiana Blum, Gustavo Salmerón
description: Magda, Ofelia, Helena, Nuria and Reyes are five mothers, tempered by the rhythm of modern life, who, on the eve of their children's wedding, are faced with a surprise. All five must come to terms with themselves to arrive at the joint ceremony that their children are about to celebrate ...
notes: It is a pleasant comedy, inspired more than Almodóvar by his usual ideas (the mélo and the sophisticated American comedy), embellished by a female cast that alone is enough and advances to enliven any screenplay. However, stereotypes are not lacking (a father a cop, the other communist worker: united by the acclaimed virility).

title: Jin-Rô
description: Ten years after the end of World War II, anti-terrorism policeman Fuse is suspended from service for not stopping a young girl's kamikaze attack in time. In an attempt to gather information about the victim, Fuse runs into her sister, with whom he forms a strong relationship despite the rivalries.

title: Hotaru no haka
description: On the evening of September 21, 1945, Seita, a young boy, died of starvation at the train station in Kobe, Japan. In his hands he holds only a tin box containing bone fragments belonging to his little sister Setsuko. When passersby throw the box away, the ghost of the little girl appears and immediately after that of the boy. Thus begins a long flashback that tells their story, which began in June of that same year, during the bombing of Kobe by the Americans.
notes: Produced by the Ghibli stable of Hayao Miyazaki in 1988, the same year in which "My neighbor Totoro", "The tomb of the fireflies" also sees the light one of the few examples of anti-militarist animation with the dual aim of reminding the world of the horror of war and shaking the traditional apparent coldness of the Japanese audience with a tragic and shocking story.

title: Bee Season
actors: Richard Gere, Juliette Binoche, Flora Cross, Max Minghella, Kate Bosworth
description: Little Eliza, very good at spelling words, is entered in the national "Spelling Bee" competition held in Washington. But just as she trains for the decisive test, her family crumbles: her father Saul, a professor of religious studies, goes into crisis with his wife Miriam, while his older brother Aaron - once Saul's favorite - lives badly. situation...
notes: A writer, a screenwriter and two directors have put together the most demented and literally s-c-o-n-n-e-s-s-o film of the year. But if you have the joke ready and you are in the company of someone with an equally "sense of humor", laughter is guaranteed.

title: The Chronicles of Narnia. The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
actors: Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, William Moseley, Anna Popplewell, Tilda Swinton, Jim Broadbent
description: Lucy, Edmund, Peter and Susan Pevensie enter a closet and discover that it is the entrance to the enchanted world of Narnia. On this earth an evil witch has cast the spell of eternal frost. The forces of good, led by a proud lion, must collide with those of evil to save Narnia and the four brothers find themselves involved in the battle ...
notes: Already blockbuster in the USA, transposition of a literary saga with a hundred million books sold, _The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe_ is a conventional fantasy that reminded us, for its atmosphere, The infinite story version Wolfgang Petersen, only with more advanced special effects. To see it you have to go well prepared, and in any case it seems that the kids appreciate a lot and it is to them that the show is aimed. The ideological readings make you smile, which would see in Leo a sort of theo-con emblem that preaches just wars and clashes of civilizations, when instead the symbols are more elementary and therefore harmless. And then, it is frankly difficult for anyone, even the most rigid viewers, not to cheer at least a little for the Witch, similar to Jeeg Robot Steel's Queen Ymica, played by Tilda Swinton with evident participation.

title: Open House
actors: Christine Lahti, Grace Lynn Kung, Daniel Baldwin, Mark Rendall, Chris Potter, Eva Marie Saint
description: Samantha Morrow, a middle-class woman, after a long marriage crisis, is thrown out of the house by her husband along with her son Travis. He finds hospitality at a boarding house where he meets Lavender Blue, a runaway teenager and other boys. The new environment and some loyal friends will help her regain her self-confidence.
notes: Taken from Elizabeth Berg's best-seller, it stands out above all for the remarkable interpretation of Eva Marie Saint (remember _International Intrigue_?) In the part of Samantha's mother, who tries to warn her about the traps of married life.

title: Natale a casa Deejay - A Christmas Carol
actors: Linus, Albertino, Daria Bignardi, Digei Angelo, Platinette, Alessio Bertallot

title: Biruma no tatekoto
actors: Koji Ishizaka, Kiichi Nakai, Takuzo Kawatani, Atsushi Watanabe
description: At the end of the Second World War, in Burma, a Japanese soldier after having witnessed the slaughter of his own unit, which he had preferred to be exterminated in order not to surrender to the enemy, decides to become a bonzo to devote himself to the cult of the dead.

title: The Devil in Miss Jones
actors: Georgina Spelvin, John Clemens, Harry Reems, Marc Stevens

title: Memories Within Miss Aggie
actors: Deborah Ashira, Patrick L. Farrelly, Rolf Beck, Eric Edwards

title: Odyssey, the Ultimate Trip
actors: Sandy Long, Richard Bolla, Nancy Dare, Sandy Long, Michael Gaunt

title: The Satisfiers of Alpha Blue
actors: Lysa Thatcher, Robert Kerman, Herschel Savage, Sharon Mitchell

title: Gerard Damiano's People
actors: Jamie Gillis, Serena, Bill Berry, Kasey Rodgers, Eric Edwards

title: For Richer for Poorer
actors: Georgina Spelvin, Richard Bolla, Bobby Astyr, Mary Margaret

title: Yukinojo Henge
actors: Kazuo Hasegawa, Ayako Wakao, Fujiko Yamamoto, Eiji Funakoshi
description: Yukinojo, a 19th-century performer of female roles in the theater, is obsessed with the idea of ??avenging her parents. Acting in a traveling production, among the audience he recognizes the three men who twenty years earlier pushed his parents to suicide. With cunning, intrigue and the help of the daughter of one of the three, he begins to destroy their lives.

title: Year of the Horse
description: Rock'n'roll movie that traces the artistic path of Neil Young and Crazy Horse. The live concerts and interviews with the protagonists were made in Europe and America during the 1996 "Year of the Horse" world tour, with the exception of some short clips from 1976 and 1987.
notes: The documentary, wanted and produced (credited as Bernard Shakey) by Young, is yet another collaboration with Jarmusch: the director had already shot two videos for him, which he had set to music for himself _Dead Men_ by Jarmusch, where he appeared in a cameo . Presented at the Venice Film Festival in the "Special Events - Images and Music" section.

title: Kruimeltje
actors: Ruud Feltkamp, Hugo Haenen, Eric van der Donk, Sacha Bulthuis
description: Rotterdam, 1921: little Crumb has never met his parents, and for this reason he envies his friend Keesie who instead has a family. One day, Crumb meets a grocer who appears to know his father's identity. It will be the shopkeeper who will help the boy in his search ...
notes: Not just for kids.

title: Stealing Christmas
actors: Tony Danza, Lea Thompson, Angela Goethals, Betty White, David Parker
description: Jack Clayton, a bank robber, arrives in a small town to escape capture. Following a misunderstanding, the rogue finds himself impersonating Santa Claus and falling in love with Sarah: will the joy of the citizens manage to warm Jack's heart enough to persuade him not to rob the bank?

title: Eve's Christmas
actors: Elisa Donovan, Sebastian Spence, Cheryl Ladd, Winston Rekert
description: Eve has everything to be a fulfilled woman: she has a good job and dates with high-level people. What she lacks is the human warmth, love and affection of her relatives. On Christmas Eve, an angel shows up and offers her the opportunity to make a wish. Eve chooses to go back in time.

title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame II
description: Now that Frollo is gone, the bell ringer Quasimodo is fond of little Zefiro, the little son of Esmeralda and Febo. In an attempt to steal the "Fidèle", the precious bell of Notre Dame, the evil wizard Sarousch and the beautiful acrobat Madeleine kidnap Zephyr, triggering the furious reaction of Quasimodo ...

title: Atlantis: Milo's Return
directors: Victor Cook, Toby Shelton, Tad Stones
description: Milo and Kida reunite with their friends to investigate strange facts around the world that seem to be related to the secrets of Atlantis ...
notes: It should have been the beginning of a TV series and it feels a lot, so much so that the structure seems to be broken into three episodes. Nothing to do with the far-reaching adventure of the original.

title: Undercover Christmas
actors: Jami Gertz, Shawn Christian, Tyne Daly, Winston Rekert, Anne Hawthorne
description: Jake, a federal agent of wealthy origins, gets involved in a love story. Jake is given the task of protecting Brandi, a bartender who has reported her multi-million dollar boyfriend for tax fraud: but then, unexpectedly, Jake has to go to his parents' house during the holidays and is forced to take Brandi with him too ...

title: Padre Speranza
actors: Bud Spencer, Salvatore Cascio, Marco Messeri, Angelo Infanti, Mauro Ursella, Alex Sandro, Valentina Lainati
description: Don Vasari is a nonconformist priest often in disagreement with the high hierarchs of the Church. For this reason he is sent to a juvenile prison in a small town in southern Italy. Nino, a sixteen-year-old inmate, is accused of murder but Father Speranza does not believe in his guilt and undertakes a courageous personal investigation to exonerate him.

title: Il mistero di Lovecraft - Road to L.
actors: Gianluca Curti, Federico Greco, Roberto Leggio, Simonetta Solder

title: Saw II
actors: Donnie Wahlberg, Dina Meyer, Shawnee Smith, Tobin Bell, Franky G, Glenn Plummer
description: Jigsaw, ruthless killer, has returned to strike. But this time, Detective Eric Mason managed to find out where the riddler is hiding. But the raid on the monster's lair is only the beginning of a new nightmare involving eight people and Mason himself ...
notes: Bousman writes and directs with one eye on the mechanical citation of '90s horror (how much damage _Scream_ did!) And another on the troubled imagination of the times (the poster with the severed fingers evoked the Twin Towers for perspective). With its sadism, _Saw 2_ is far from harmless. You can appreciate it as long as you don't ignore it.

title: Mrs. Henderson Presents
actors: Judi Dench, Bob Hoskins, Will Young, Kelly Reilly, Thelma Barlow, Christopher Guest
description: The eccentric 70-year-old Laura Henderson buys an old abandoned cinema, but with the help of the impresario Vivian van Damm she transforms it into the Windmill Theater, a theater dedicated to the music hall. Business doesn't go well until the two have the idea of ??having the actors play naked.
notes: Inspired by the true story of Mrs. Henderson and Vivian Van Damm (her director) and the Windmill, which was the last London theater to close its doors under German bombing, the film is Stephen Frears' beautiful homage to cinema English that he likes best, Ealing's comedies from the 40s and 50s and documentaries from the 30s.

title: Beneath Clouds
actors: Dannielle Hall, Damian Pitt, Jenna Lee Connors, Simon Swan

title: Final Cut
actors: Ray Winstone, Jude Law, Sadie Frost, John Beckett, William Scully
description: A group of decent people discover that using a hidden camera someone has filmed the most despicable moments of their lives. Theft, betrayal, sexual abuse, adultery are just some of the practices perpetuated daily. But no one imagined that the most unspeakable sides of their ambiguous personalities could become a film and that their most trusted friend was hiding behind the camera.

title: Sugata Sanshiro
actors: Denjirô Ôkôchi, Susumu Fujita, Yukiko Todoroki, Ryunosuke Tsukigata
description: Story of Sugata Sanshiro, who learns the art of living from judo, taught by the first master of that discipline in Japan.

title: Ichiban utsukushiku
actors: Takashi Shimura, Shôji Kiyokawa, Ichirô Sugai, Takako Irie
description: In 1944, in a factory of lenses for military use in Japan, a group of volunteers asked for the same exhausting shifts as men.

title: Tora no o wo fumu otokotachi
actors: Denjirô Ôkôchi, Susumu Fujita, Kenichi Enomoto, Masayuki Mori

title: Zoku Sugata Sanshiro
actors: Denjirô Ôkôchi, Susumu Fujita, Ryunosuke Tsukigata, Akitake Kôno

title: Asu o tsukuru hitobito
directors: Akira Kurosawa, Hideo Sekigawa, Kajiro Yamamoto
actors: Susumu Fujita, Hideko Takamine, Kenji Susukida, Masayuki Mori

title: Waga seishun ni kuinashi
actors: Setsuko Hara, Susumu Fujita, Denjirô Ôkôchi, Haruko Sugimura

title: Subarashiki nichiyobi
actors: Isao Numasaki, Chieko Nakakita, Atsushi Watanabe, Zeko Nakamura
description: Two penniless boyfriends want to spend a day in the best way.

title: Shizukanaru ketto
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Takashi Shimura, Miki Sanjo, Kenjiro Uemura

title: Ikimono no kiroku
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Takashi Shimura, Minoru Chiaki, Eiko Miyoshi

title: Condorman
actors: Michael Crawford, Oliver Reed, Barbara Carrera, James Hampton
description: Comic artist Woody would like to experience the exploits of the heroes he creates. The opportunity is offered to him by Natalia, an agent employed by the CIA, who "transforms" him into Condorman: the new spy will fight against Krokov, a madman in the service of the Russians ...
notes: Baffling adventure film produced by Disney.

title: A Nero Wolfe Mystery: Wolfe Stays In
actors: Maury Chaykin, Timothy Hutton, Saul Rubinek, Bill Smitrovich
description: During a lunch, Nero Wolfe stains his tie and is forced to leave it on the table in his study. It will be precisely with that accessory that the murder of the actress Rita Sorrell will be committed. Once arrived on the spot, Inspector Cramer can only ascertain the evidence of the evidence and accuse the famous investigator.

title: Batman Beyond: Return of The Joker
description: Gotham City, 2039: The Joker, leader of the Jokerz street gang, announces his return after stealing high-tech weapons from Wayne companies. Behind the Batman mask is young Terry McGinnis, a teenager with a turbulent past who has become the protege of a Bruce Wayne too old and ill to fight crime. Terry meets Bruce by saving his life in the robbery carried out by the Jokerz and, later, he takes his place on the trail of the historical enemy ...
notes: Paul Dini's script offers a world-class characterization of the Joker. The film showcases flashes of irony and grotesque, and overall it is well done.

title: Koko, le gorille qui parle
description: The extraordinary linguistic performances of Koko, a gorilla entrusted by the San Francisco Zoo to Francine Penny Patterson, a psychologist who taught Koko sign language from an early age, providing him with a vocabulary of about 350 words thanks to which Koko could communicate with men.

title: Shu dan long wei
actors: Jet Li, Jacky Cheung, Charlie Cho, Billy Chow, Valerie Chow, Suki Kwan
description: After unsuccessfully trying to save his wife, killed by a gang of a boss called "the Doctor", Kit Li privately works as a bodyguard and stunt double for Frankie Lone, a particularly cowardly martial arts film actor. During a visit by Frankie to the exhibition of the crown jewels of Russia at a Hong Kong hotel, "the Doctor" and his gang burst into the building and are preparing to steal the precious: for Kit Li this could be the occasion. to take their revenge ...
notes: The usual, endless and cloying series of kicks and punches, to which Jet Li has unfortunately accustomed us. Nothing new on the eastern front.

title: Tras el cristal
actors: Günter Meisner, David Sust, Marisa Paredes, Gisèle Echevarría
description: Klaus was a Nazi leader who nurtured and cultivated an insane passion for abusing and killing children after abusing them. In his madness, with the war coming to an end and the consequent fall of the Reich, the man will decide to commit suicide, but will fail in his attempt, remaining instead paralyzed in such a serious way that he has to live the rest of his days closed in a lung of d ' steel. To take care of him, in a lonely villa where the family took refuge to escape the war court, are his wife Griselda, his hateful half, and Rena, his teenage daughter. That is, until a young pseudo nurse, Angelo, enters the scene and reveals to Klaus that he is aware of his secrets.

title: El mar
actors: Roger Casamajor, Bruno Bergonzini, Antònia Torrens, Hernán González
description: Manuel Tur and Andreu Ramallo are ten years old when the civil war arrives on the island of Mallorca, where they live. Their first encounter with the cruelty of adults takes place when a friend's father is shot before their eyes. After ten years, the two find themselves in an island hospital to take care of tuberculosis: the civil war is over, the social climate is depressing and the two men water between a past full of obsessive memories and a dark future.

title: Club vacanze
actors: Alvaro Vitali, Andy Luotto, Lucio Montanaro, Bruno Minniti
description: Two clumsy young men are mistaken by a hotel owner for two dangerous thugs and their suitcase for the loot of a robbery. The hotelier, to take possession of the suitcase, hires one as a waiter, the other as a barman, causing a series of daring misunderstandings.

title: Friday Night Lights
actors: Billy Bob Thornton, Lucas Black, Garrett Hedlund, Derek Luke
description: Texas, 1988: In an economically depressed town of Odessa, the local high school football team faces the state championship semifinals under the guidance of coach Gary Gaines. The expectations of the students and of the whole community in general are very high, and the frenzy for the upcoming event mounts: will our heroes be able to conquer the coveted title?
notes: Good declination of the sports sub-genre with social and racial implications and a nice indie look. Screenplay, among others, by Berg himself, who sweetens the homonymous investigative book by journalist H.G. "Buzz" Bissinger. A TV series was taken from the film, which was still developed by Berg.

title: Devi
actors: Chhabi Biswas, Sumitra Jatterjee, Sharmila Tagore, Purnendu Mukherjee
description: Convinced that his daughter-in-law is the goddess Kali reincarnated and returned to Earth, an old landowner ensures that the woman receives the tributes and honors appropriate to her rank. The son tries in every way to dissuade him, but little by little madness creeps into the family ...
notes: Ray adapted a tale by Tagore himself.

title: Nature Unleashed: Avalanche
actors: Andrew Lee Potts, Adam Croasdell, Zahary Baharov, Peter Gaitandjiev
description: Thom and Jock, who moved from the United States to Russia in search of fortune, have founded a company that offers tourists excursions in the snow of the Ural mountains. But a large avalanche as well as putting their business at risk sows terror in the village of Dubroz. From that moment on, their only aim is to save as many people as possible.

title: Sniper 2
actors: Tom Berenger, Bokeem Woodbine, Erika Marozsán, Tamás Puskás
description: Thomas Beckett, a former Marine sniper who had been on a mission to Panama to try to stop drug trafficking, is this time instructed by the US government to hit a Serbian general accused of instigating and directing an ethnic cleansing operation against the Muslims. His partner in this mission will be a death row inmate who, thanks to this post, could earn his freedom.
notes: Tom Berenger returns as Thomas Beckett in this sequel to _One Shot One Kill. The direction this time is by Craig R. Baxley, TV movie specialist.

title: Pinocchio 3000
description: Scamboville, year 3000. With the help of Spencer, a cyber-penguin, and Cyberina, a holographic fairy, Geppetto invents Pinocchio, a humanoid robot. Pinocchio's dream is to become a real child, but first he must help his friends to foil the diabolical plan of the mayor of Scamboville who wants to turn all children into robots.

title: The New World
actors: Colin Farrell, Christian Bale, Q'Orianka Kilcher, Jesse Borrego, Ben Chaplin, Christopher Plummer, Jonathan Pryce, Noah Taylor
description: 1607: the settlers begin to settle and build their cities on American soil. In Jamestown, the conflict between the American Indians and the men who arrived from Europe to start a new life seems to ease when Pocahontas, one of the natives, and John Smith, a soldier of the English army, fall in love ...
notes: For 25 years Malick had been thinking about his singing to the New World, and on paper the project was perfect for his solemn style, heedless of logical sequences. But something went wrong: the voices off become chanting, the poetry of the images is all too "poetic", souls soften, opportunities are wasted.

title: Giacomo l'idealista
actors: Marina Berti, Massimo Serato, Andrea Checchi, Tina Lattanzi

title: Lettere di una novizia
actors: Pascale Petit, Jean-Paul Belmondo, Massimo Girotti, Lilla Brignone
description: Twenty-year-old Rita is forced to take vows, hiding from everyone that she killed her ex-lover, found in bed with her mother, and that she had no choice but to become a nun.

title: L'imprevisto
actors: Tomas Milian, Anouk Aimée, Jeanne Valerie, Raymond Pellegrin

title: Venga a prendere il caffè da noi
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Francesca Romana Coluzzi, Milena Vukotic, Jean-Jacques Fourgeaud
description: Emerenziano Paronzini, deputy head of service in the district tax office of a small town, decides - at a mature age - to marry one of the Tettamanzi sisters: Tarsilia, Camilla and Fortunata. Choosing the latter, he moves into the house of the three, who pamper him together with the maid Caterina. He soon became the lover of all of them, he was caught on the most beautiful by an illness ...
notes: From the novel _La spartizione_ by Piero Chiara (also written by the author, director and Tullio Kezich), Lattuada sketches a portrait of the respectable and repressed bourgeoisie of the province. Perfect Tognazzi in the part of the bourgeois enjoyment.

title: Le farò da padre
actors: Irene Papas, Gigi Proietti, Teresa Ann Savoy, Isa Miranda, Bruno Cirino
description: The young Roman lawyer Saverio Mazzacolli has great ideas on how to speculate in construction, but little money to implement them. He wants to build a tourist village for rich people and to do this he tries to exploit the knowledge of the wealthy Countess Raimonda Spina. Determined to want her money at all costs, he kidnaps her retarded daughter. But passion is around the corner.

title: A cavallo della tigre
actors: Nino Manfredi, Mario Adorf, Gian Maria Volonté, Valeria Moriconi
description: A man does everything to escape from the prison in which he is locked up and once out he sacrifices himself to help his wife and lover of the latter.

title: La bugiarda
actors: Catherine Spaak, Enrico Maria Salerno, Marc Michel, Riccardo Cucciolla
description: Maria, a beautiful and casual girl, pretends to be a stewardess to make herself more attractive in the eyes of her male prey. He begins dating two unwitting men, dividing between them and inventing mountains of lies until his game is discovered. Maria does not lose heart and tries to involve them in a ménage à trois.
notes: Based on the comedy of the same name by Diego Fabbri (1956), the film maintains the unscrupulous and mocking tone towards the machismo of the time and portrays a memorable figure of an independent woman thanks also to the brilliant interpretation of Spaak, but suffers from a too evident theatrical structure which in the long run harms the rhythm of the story.

title: L'ingorgo - Una storia impossibile
actors: Alberto Sordi, Marcello Mastroianni, Ugo Tognazzi, Annie Girardot, Fernando Rey, Angela Molina, Stefania Sandrelli, Miou-Miou, Ciccio Ingrassia
description: A businessman and his secretary get stuck in their Jaguar in a large traffic jam near the Roman highway surrounded by individuals of different social origins: a Neapolitan family, an elderly married couple traveling for the 30th anniversary of wedding, a young man who would like to meet his girlfriend, four armed men in a Mercedes, a feminist with her guitar and an ambulance operator. At first, everyone tries to organize themselves as best they can to endure the unexpected but with the passing of the hours the situation degenerates, giving way to prejudice, selfishness and violence.

title: Wicker Park
actors: Josh Hartnett, Rose Byrne, Matthew Lillard, Diane Kruger, Christopher Cousins
description: Matthew is about to get married. While finalizing a deal, he runs into a woman who looks like his old flame Lisa. This one, which disappeared two years earlier without a trace, however, had left an indelible mark on Matthew's heart. Following the stranger, he will discover that it is another person ...
notes: A remake of _L'appartamento_ di Mimoun, McGuigan's film abuses mirrors, shop windows and various reflective surfaces, in an attempt to play with symbols. The result is torturous, but the fast-paced flashbacks work, and the packaging - photography by Peter Sova and the right soundtrack - helps engage.

title: The Black Dahlia
actors: Josh Hartnett, Scarlett Johansson, Hilary Swank, Aaron Eckhart
description: 1947. Bucky Bleichert and Lee Blanchard are two policemen friends, former boxers, in love with the same woman, the mysterious Kay Lake. Their existence is turned upside down when the two find themselves investigating the brutal murder of Elizabeth Short, a young woman with actress ambitions nicknamed the Black Dahlia.
notes: De Palma continues his reflection on post-cinema that began with the extraordinary Femme Fatale. Cinema is dead because it is now putrefied by the virus of déjà-vu, of repetition, of the eternal return of the identical: we have passed from the Bazinian "illusion of reality" to the disturbing "reality of illusion". The director talks about the impossibility for anyone, today, to tell stories.

title: Oro nero
actors: Juan De Landa, Carla Candiani, Piero Pastore, Federico Benfer
description: Marta and Nicola had met as children while they were playing in the underground tunnels of the Bacu Abis mine. Many years pass and the two kids, now adults, meet again in Carbonia. Marta, having become an elementary teacher, arouses the interest of Nicola who ends up falling in love with her; but the boy's closed and taciturn character does not make him express his feelings and Marta, who has a brotherly affection for him, ends up getting engaged to a young engineer. During a tunnel inspection, a landslide hits the two rivals ...
notes: Alongside moments of great intensity there are evident drops in tension.

title: Hateshinaki yokubo
actors: Hiroyuki Nagato, Sanae Nakahara, Ko Nishimura, Taiji Tonoyama
description: While the war was still raging, Lieutenant Hashimoto and three accomplices had buried a large quantity of morphine in an air-raid shelter under a military hospital, agreeing to meet again ten years later to seize the loot. On the day of the appointment, however, five people show up who claim to have had part in the pact: in a climate of mutual suspicion, the group decides to overcome the differences and to proceed with the recovery. But when morphine comes back to light, the rivalries turn into a bitter struggle of all against all ...
notes: Hard and ruthless, one of the three films shot by Imamura in the year of his debut.

title: The Devils
actors: Vanessa Redgrave, Oliver Reed, Dudley Sutton, Max Adrian, Gemma Jones, Murray Melvin, Michael Gothard, Georgina Hale, Brian Murphy, Christopher Logue, Graham Armitage, John Woodvine, Andrew Faulds, Kenneth Colley, Judith Paris

title: A Lust to Kill
actors: Jim Davis, Don Megowan, Allison Hayes, Sandra Giles
description: Taking advantage of the permission to attend the funeral of his brother, killed by the men of the law, a convict - using a weapon passed to him by his girlfriend - takes advantage of it to escape: as soon as he is free, he rushes on the trail of his former accomplices, whom he considers responsible for the death brother ...
notes: A rather obvious "B-western".

title: The Nero Wolfe Mysteries: Wolfe Goes Out
actors: Maury Chaykin, Timothy Hutton, Bill Smitrovich, Colin Fox
description: Nero Wolfe and Archie Goodwin visit Andrew, an orchid expert who lives in Westchester. He invites them to visit his greenhouse, where they discover the corpse of the private nurse - and new girlfriend - of Andrew himself, who died from the fumes of a pest control insecticide. Wolfe decides to take the case ...

title: Derailed
actors: Vincent Cassel, Clive Owen, Jennifer Aniston, Addison Timlin, RZA, Melissa George
description: After a chance meeting at the station, two married managers - Charles Schine and Lucinda Harris - clandestinely date. But a sadistic criminal breaks into their hotel room, and after terrorizing them he also begins to blackmail them ...
notes: The script is the worst part of this film, which was sufficiently directed by the Swedish Håfström. The Owen-Aniston couple tries hard, but is out of place; not even the sadist Cassel is saved. The characters are far too monolithic to look authentic. In short, the tension and rhythm - essential ingredients for a thriller - are at a minimum.

title: U-Carmen e-Khayelitsha
actors: Pauline Malefane, Andile Tshoni, Lungelwa Blou, Andries Mbali, Zamile Gantana
description: A Carmen set in South Africa, in the local Xhosa language. Carmen, a worker in a tobacco factory, meets Jongi, a police sergeant. A story of love and death is born. For her, Jongi leaves the police and begins to frequent the criminal circles where the girl grew up ...
notes: Entrusted to the Dimpho di Kopane theater company and the exceptional interpretation of Pauline Malefane as the protagonist, Bizet's work is enlivened despite the fact that it remains essentially the same. Golden Bear in Berlin.

title: Une partie de plaisir
actors: Paul Gégauff, Danièle Gégauff, Clemence Gégauff, Paula Moore
description: Chronicle of the gradual collapse of the marriage of Philippe and Esther, an initially happy high-bourgeois couple with a young daughter. All is well, but he is obsessed with sexual freedom, and he is so convinced and exalted that he pushes his wife to practice it in turn and betray him. But then he feels a fierce and unexpected jealousy that leads to terrible consequences.

title: The 40 Year Old Virgin
actors: Steve Carell, Catherine Keener, Paul Rudd, Romany Malco, Seth Rogen, Elizabeth Banks
description: Andy Stitzer, works in an electronics store, but hasn't had sex at forty yet. When his friends find out, they decide it's time for him to have this experience and try to help him in every way with Trish, a single mom who has piqued his interest ...
notes: The dubbing certainly does not fully convey Steve Carrell's verbal humor, but many defects are already at the origin: episodic, low-cut, haphazardly edited, vulgar but not enough, suddenly feel-good and direct with flatness. It all started with a sketch of Carrell a few years ago. One, two, three sketches and, after twenty minutes, boredom spreads.

title: A futura memoria
actors: Pier Paolo Pasolini

title: Sopralluoghi in Palestina
actors: Pier Paolo Pasolini, don Andrea Carraro
description: Pier Paolo Pasolini goes to Palestine in the company of Don Andrea Carraro in search of the places of the Passion. The aim is to find inspirations and locations for his _The Gospel according to Matthew_, but the places, although they hide unexpected contrasts and are spiritually touching, disappoint him ...
notes: The confrontation between the layman Pasolini and the man of the church strikes and proposes an exciting debate. Pasolini sought the roots of history and spirit in the Holy Land and was struck by the contrasts: folklore and modernity, progress and poverty. A man in search of the religious roots of his secularism, a director in search of a film. In the end he understands that the Gospel is everywhere: he will shoot in Matera.

title: The Family Stone
actors: Sarah Jessica Parker, Diane Keaton, Claire Danes, Rachel McAdams, Dermot Mulroney, Craig T. Nelson, Luke Wilson
description: Everett Stone wants to introduce his girlfriend Meredith, a hyperactive New Yorker, to the family before the wedding. He then decides to spend Christmas with his parents, but the young woman does not like the relatives who try to persuade him to leave her. Meredith then asks for help from her sister Julie, who promptly shows up ... but complicates matters further.
notes: A sort of _I introduce you to my_ in a dramatic way. Conventional but incisive example of family drama that begins as a Christmas comedy and closes on the emotional emptiness of the following Christmas. You can hate it, or have a nice liberating cry.

title: Island Prey
actors: Olivia Hussey, Don Murray, Anthony John Denison, Edward Asner
description: Catherine Gaits is a handsome middle-aged woman married to a successful man, but she has very little time to devote to her. To give her life a shake up, the woman decides to accept the invitation to dinner from Peter, a charming and attractive friend of her husband. What Catherine doesn't know is that her "admirer" has some weird ideas in her head. Peter is so obsessed with her that he wants to possess her at all costs. Catherine finds herself prisoner of a sick mind and much more serious with no apparent escape route.
notes: In the role of Catherine is the former angelic Olivia Hussey (_Romeo and Juliet_ and _Jesus of Nazareth_ by Zeffirelli).

title: Skinwalkers
actors: Harrison Lowe, Adam Beach, James Dalgam, Saginaw Grant
description: Joe Leaphorn, an Indian-born police investigator, returns to the Navajo reservation where he was born and raised to investigate a series of rather bizarre murders. Although Joe has no doubts that the killers are attributable to humans, his young colleague Jim Chee has a totally different theory. Jim, an apprentice shaman, is convinced that Skinwalker is the one to commit the murders, a magical figure who, according to a Navajo legend, sums up all the Native American murders. Jim is convinced that Skinwalker takes revenge, killing all those who have desecrated the sacred land of the Indians.

title: Their Eyes Were Watching God
actors: Halle Berry, Ruben Santiago-Hudson, Michael Ealy, Nicki Micheaux

title: Hammersmith Is Out
actors: Elizabeth Taylor, Richard Burton, Peter Ustinov, Beau Bridges
description: Billy (Beau Bridges) is a psychiatric hospital attendant who is fascinated by two people: Jimmie Jean (Elizabeth Taylor). a blonde waitress, and Hammersmith (Richard Burton), a patient who is kept tied up in a straitjacket in a locked room. Hammersmith promises Billy fame and fortune if he will free him and Billy lets himself be tempted, as long as JImmie Jean is in the game. The three then escape and begin a path, littered with thefts and murders, thanks to which Bily will make his own incredible social climb.

title: I'll Be There
actors: Charlotte Church, Craig Ferguson, Jemma Redgrave, Imelda Staunton
description: Sixteen years ago, rock star Paul Kerr had everything he could want: fame, success and all the money he wanted. He did not know, however, that he also has a daughter named Olivia who now wants to meet her dad. The task that Olivia has to complete is to get her father and mother back together, who have not spoken to each other for almost twenty years.
notes: In the role of Olivia is Charlotte Church, an English child prodigy, who a few years ago had climbed the world charts with a record of opera arias. Directs Craig Ferguson as actor in _The Grass of Grace_ and _Lemony Snicket - A Series of Unfortunate Events_.

title: Det regnar på vår kärlek
actors: Barbro Kollberg, Birger Malmsten, Gösta Cederlund, Ludde Gentzel
description: David and Maggi are two young men who accidentally meet on a train: he has just been released from prison where he served a sentence for theft while she runs away from the family after discovering she is pregnant and not knowing who the father of the creature is. The two fall in love and begin a difficult pilgrimage to Sweden ...
notes: A simple theatrical plot serves Bergman as a starting point for an exercise of his poetics, still sour in some respects, in this tragic film (with echoes of Michael Curtiz) and ironic (detectable the presence of Frank Capra) at the same time, full of allegorical characters and bright hope for the future despite adversities, not only climatic ones.

title: Skepp till India land
actors: Holger Löwenadler, Anna Lindahl, Birger Malmsten, Gertrud Fridh
description: Johannes, a sailor, returns from a long voyage and finds Sally, the woman he once loved and who now rejects her. As he wanders on the beach, memories resurface: the turbulent relationship with his father Blom; the blossoming of love with Sally; his father's attempt to kill him during the recovery of a wreck and before Blom's own suicide.
notes: The port of Gothenburg is used as a natural set for this early work by Bergman, influenced by neorealism and in which the usual attention to psychological and emotional introspection is combined with a careful look at the life of fishermen. Above all, love, the only antidote to human morality identified by Bergman.

description: Five episodes for one of the most hermetic films among those that "interpreted" '68. The most enigmatic is the one about the Black Panthers who kill a white girl in a London car graveyard. They speak by slogans, and their speeches, however, would kill anyone anyway. The most "nouvelle vague" is the one with Anne Wiazemsky "graffitara". The most beautiful, ça va sans dire, is that of the recording sessions of _Sympathy for the Devil_ by the Rolling Stones. Birth of a masterpiece, with Brian Jones still in the front row, Mick Jagger as handsome as an Adonis and Keith Richards on a stool inventing riffs.

title: Città canora
actors: Giacomo Rondinella, Maria Fiore, Nadia Gray, Tina Pica, Giovanni Grasso, Carlo Romano, Mirko Ellis, Paola Borboni
description: Maria, the beautiful daughter of Don Salvatore, flirts with Giacomo, a young sailor of his flotilla. Don Salvatore, however, has decided to give her in marriage to Renato, the son of a dear friend of his, who has been dead for some time. When he discovers that a bond of mutual affection has been born between Maria and Giacomo, Don Salvatore does not hesitate to dismiss the sailor; at the same time he pushes away Mary, who was preparing to flee with James. Following a misunderstanding, Giacomo believes that Mary no longer loves him; the young man, who has a beautiful voice and knows how to use it, then decides to accept a piece of writing offered to him and goes to Milan, where he successfully debuts in a magazine. Maria, who in turn believes herself abandoned, declares herself willing to marry Renato ...

title: Akai satsui
actors: Masumi Harukawa, Ko Nishimura, Shigeru Tsuyuguchi, Yuko Kusunoki
description: Hiraoka enters the house of Riichi, who has gone out with his son, and rapes his wife Sadako. She thinks about taking her own life, but she lacks the courage. Two days later, Riichi leaves again and Hiraoka returns, but Sadako makes a radical decision ...
notes: The Japanese master sinks his hands into the deepest human instinct.

title: Non perdiamo la testa
actors: Ugo Tognazzi, Franca Valeri, Daniele Vargas, Tina Pica, Carlo Campanini
description: Suffering from a very rare disease, the naive Tony receives an invitation from a lady dedicated to charitable activities to spend the last few days he has left in the luxury of his villa. But it is a scam: Tony is healthy as a fish, the lady a cheat and the villa the hideout of a group of counterfeiters. Trouble will follow.
notes: Debut as scriptwriters of the couple Scarnicci and Tarabusi, authors of various variety shows and television broadcasts such as the historian _Un due tre_, the film (the fourth that Mattòli shoots in 59) is in fact a collage of gags tailored on Tognazzi with the excuse of the parody of the English detective story. However, it has its own charm.

actors: Carl de Vogt, Ressel Orla, Georg John, Lil Dagover, Friedrich Kühne

actors: Paul Biensfeldt, Lil Dagover, Georg John, Meinhart Maur, Rudolf Lettinger

actors: Florian Heiden, Alexandra Schalaudek, August Zirner, Christian Wunderlich
description: Seventeen-year-old Mattis Lomberg reunites with his twin sister Mieke, who has spent a long time abroad for study. The affection that naturally exists between them will eventually turn into something shocking.
notes: Dror Zahavi approaches a burning subject with all the caution of the case.

title: Angel-A
actors: Rie Rasmussen, Jamel Debbouze, Franck-Olivier Bonnet, Michel Chesneau
description: After being beaten for the umpteenth time, André decides to end it all. The man, who has large debts with several criminals in Paris, decides to jump off a bridge. But just before jumping into it he realizes that a girl is about to do the same. The unknown woman takes the first step and André follows her, saving her from drowning ...
notes: Far from the happy results of Nikita and especially Léon, this is a cheap frappe, which steals the ingredients from at least a dozen cinema classics. An exercise in style that annoys, so much is the waste of energy and talents. Not to mention the meritorious Bessonian amorality elsewhere, which has now become clerical spiritualism without even the integralist integrators.

title: Arthur and the Minimoys
description: Ten-year-old Arthur tries to decipher an enigma that leads to a treasure hidden in the garden of his house and left by his grandfather, who has suddenly disappeared for four years. Thus ends up in a magical world inhabited by the Minimei tribe, African elves no more than a few millimeters tall, at war with the terrible Acolytes: in addition to the treasure, there is the love of Princess Selenia at stake.
notes: When Besson writes the stories, we are at the zero degree of complexity; and the joints, the references (The sword in the stone, Bug's Life), the twists and turns can be foreseen with a shot in advance. The children, however, have fun and participate.

title: Police Python 357
actors: Yves Montand, François Périer, Simone Signoret, Stefania Sandrelli
description: Both Inspector Marc Ferrot and Commissioner Ganay, his direct superior and married to the disabled Thérèse, have a relationship - without mutual knowledge - with the beautiful Sylvia Leopardi. The discovery of the latter's body raises a crawl space: Ferrot, in charge of the investigation, is convinced that it was Ganay himself who killed her, exasperated by the fact that Sylvia wanted to interrupt the affair. Little by little, however, the inspector discovers that the killer has scattered a series of red herrings that make suspicions converge on him ...
notes: The plot is not very smooth, but Corneau's second work certainly does not lack tension.

actors: Barbara Bouchet, Renzo Montagnani, Manuel Gallardo, Maria Luisa Merlo

On his way he meets a splendid black stallion with whom a beautiful and tender friendship is born. Thanks to the wild animal, Neera will participate in an important race and be able to return home.

actors: Anthony Steffen, Eduardo Fajardo, Mary Paz Pondal, Stelio Candelli

When he learns that he has inherited a gold mine and goes there to take possession of it, he discovers that the precious deposit actually belongs to a certain Berg. To tell the truth, the man has a regular deed of assignment that guarantees it before the law. Joe learns that the act was violently extorted and with the help of a brave barber tries to stand up to the usurper.
notes: Fourth last and unmemorable film by Leopoldo Savona who made his debut alongside Giuseppe De Santis in _Days of love_.

title: Eccezzziunale veramente. Capitolo secondo... me
actors: Mauro Di Francesco, Diego Abatantuono, Sabrina Ferilli, Anna Maria Barbera, Carlo Buccirosso, Ugo Conti
description: Donato, former head of the ultra Milan supporters, returns home after twenty years of exile in Spain. Thus he discovers that he had a son from Geneva, his then girlfriend. The boy does not know who his real father is. Donato decides to meet him anyway, but to his great disappointment, he finds himself in front of a diehard Inter fan!
notes: Cinematographically speaking, the film is frighteningly poor, scoundrel, devoid of backbone and rhythm, a spitting photocopy of the first episode and unable to exploit the succulent (on paper) novelties of the cast, among wasted and forgotten race characters (like luxury cameos) of some Milan players).

title: The Divine Woman
actors: Greta Garbo, Lars Hanson, Lowell Sherman, Polly Moran, Dorothy Cumming, Johnny Mack Brown, Cesare Gravina, Paulette Duval, Jean De Briac
description: Marianne, in the hope of being able to become an actress, goes to Paris where he meets Lucien, a soldier. The two fall in love with her but during an absence of Lucien, sent by service to Algeria, Marianne grants herself to a producer who supports her in her aspirations, making her the star she dreamed of being of her. However, Lucien's return is destined to upset the situation.
notes: A work that is almost completely lost: only a few fragments remain, of which the longest lasts 9 minutes.

title: Bunhongsin
actors: Kim Hye-su, Kim Seong-su, Park Yeon-ah, Go Su-hee
description: Sun-jae ophthalmologist is married, but she feels lonely and lets herself go by buying shoes. After learning that her husband is cheating on her, she moves with her daughter Tae-soo to a new city. Here he accidentally finds a pair of red shoes and takes them home, unaware that there is a curse on them: they unleash repressed greed in every person who sees them ...
notes: Extremely cumbersome horror and also with author claims, witnessed by theatrical flashbacks in costume with ballet scenes. Inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's _Red shoes_ (like Powell and Pressburger's masterpiece) is a surreal circumstance, but above all ridiculous.

title: Under Capricorn
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Joseph Cotten, Michael Wilding, Margaret Leighton
description: Australia, 1831. The Irish nobleman Charles Adare (Michael Wilding) arrives in Sydney following his cousin, who has just been elected governor of the colony. The latter, disobeying the directives of his illustrious relative, goes into business with Sam Flusky (Joseph Cotten), a humble ex-stable boy in Ireland and a former prisoner who served seven years in prison in Australia on a murder charge which ended in simple detention at the another head of the world, and now a rich landowner. Invited to a reception at the luxurious Flusky estate, he meets his beautiful and depressed wife Lady Henrietta (Ingrid Bergman). The two discover that they met in Ireland while still children and Sam has the idea of ??using this meeting to try to restore the will to live in his wife, often prey to nightmares, but once serene, indomitable and strong-willed. The arrival of the man seems to counteract the authority of the enigmatic housekeeper Milly (Margaret Leighton) over the events of the house, which she controls perhaps more than is convenient.

title: Stimulantia
actors: Ingrid Bergman, Daniel Bergman, Gunnar Björnstrand, Gunnel Broström

title: Galileo
actors: Cyril Cusack, Lou Castel, Gigi Ballista, Paolo Graziosi, Giulio Brogi
description: We are at the end of the 16th century: Galileo Galilei meets Giordano Bruno, makes observations with his telescope until he is convinced that the Sun is at the center of the universe and the Earth revolves around it. Although his acquaintances in the papacy dissuade him from falling into heresy, the scientist defends his theories until, under threat of torture, he is induced to the humiliating abjuration of 1633.
notes: Didactic without being Brechtian, mechanical in rhythm, Cavani's film however has the merit of accurately describing the papal environment, whose arrogance and dullness stand out as an explicit criticism of the "old" who resisted in the Church in the aftermath of the Second Vatican Council .

title: L'ospite
actors: Lucia Bosé, Peter Gonzales, Glauco Mauri, Giancarlo Maio
description: A writer, having obtained permission to attend a psychiatric hospital to prepare his next novel, notes several medical and social deficiencies in the treatment of patients, but his criticisms are not well received by doctors. The scholar also has the opportunity to meet Anna, a woman now healed, who is entrusted to her brother. However, reintegration into the family and into society proved difficult and Anna, terrified of an aggressive approach by a young man, flees to the house of her deceased uncles. There she relives the past in a fantastic way, before being taken over by the police.

title: Trevico-Torino... Viaggio nel Fiat-Nam
actors: Paolo Turco, Victoria Franzinetti, Stefania Casini, Vittorio Franzinetti

title: Gioco di società
actors: Lina Sastri, Mario Adorf, Alessandro Haber
description: An industrialist, after discovering a playmate who is cheating, blackmails him by proposing for a fee to kill his wife. The killer will be confronted by a woman who, offering him an even higher sum, will ask him to kill her husband instead.
notes: Adaptation of a short story by Leonardo Sciascia.

title: Peperoni ripieni e pesci in faccia
actors: Sophia Loren, F. Murray Abraham, Angela Pagano, Casper Zafer, Elio Pandolfi
description: Maria, who has dedicated her entire life to her family, is now alone, because her husband Jeffrey, a former journalist who became a fisherman, is always at sea and because her children, Francesco, Mario and Miriam have moved elsewhere and have the their lives. On the occasion of her mother's name day, Maria gathers the whole family for a nice party on the terrace of the house.
notes: The incipit of this incredible umpteenth chapter in accattatevillo style, ominously resembles that of the American remake of _Strolled by an unusual destiny_: Murray Abraham seems Adriano Giannini in thirty years and Sophia Loren the grandmother of Madonna. A shame to see Lina's talent once again thrown into the nets of a slaughter that involves everyone, actors of solid tradition and top quality collaborators (Beppe Lanci, Umberto Marino, Elvio Porta, Enrico Job ...) Sophia sings a song on the opening credits that reads: "You were always smoking the gitanes on the sea against the wind". The tomato soup was better.
