Soon the connections with the well -known number one place in Rome become more and more dense with mysterious thefts of paintings, new and disturbing murders and an increasingly corrupt and violent world.

title: Les aventures de Rabbi Jacob
actors: Louis De Funès, Suzy Delair, Marcel Dalio, Renzo Montagnani

title: Crema, cioccolato e pa...prika
actors: Barbara Bouchet, Renzo Montagnani, Silvia Dionisio, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia
description: Professor Bonifazi runs a luxury clinic, which is run by his nephew Michele and Ossobuco. The arrival of "Bebè", a dietician recommended by Mrs Mazzetta, will create a lot of confusion.

title: Voyage of Terror: The Achille Lauro Affair
actors: Burt Lancaster, Eva Marie Saint, Brian Bloom, Renzo Montagnani

title: Kicking & Screaming
actors: Will Ferrell, Robert Duvall, Mike Ditka, Kate Walsh, Musetta Vander
description: Phil Weston has a problem: his father Buck. From an early age, in fact, Phil had to suffer the intrusiveness and competitiveness of the parent, and with the adult age reached for a while the situation has not changed. Now he coaches the football team in which his ten-year-old son plays and manages to lead them to the final of the championship: but here - not even on purpose! - finds himself in front of Buck, who in turn is the trainer of the strongest team of the tournament. Rivalries and old grudges do not take long to emerge: who will win the coveted "family derby"?
notes: Comedy to fresh water directed by Bob Dylan's son.

title: Masked and Anonymous
actors: Bob Dylan, Jeff Bridges, Penélope Cruz, John Goodman, Jessica Lange, Chris Penn
description: In a climate of political and social uncertainty, the unscrupulous promoter Sweetheart plans to make a lot of money by organizing a great "benefit" concert. With the support of TV producer Nina Veronica, Sweetheart mounts the event properly and in the meantime ensures the presence of the legendary musician Jack Fate, currently a guest of the country's prisons. Everything seems to be going well, but tough journalist Tom Friend works to unmask Sweetheart's true intentions ...
notes: Super cast but controversial intent a little watered down for the debut of the television screenwriter Charles. Recommended only for the most avid Dylanians.

title: Le Diable et les dix commandements
actors: Françoise Arnoul, Charles Aznavour, Fernandel, Louis De Funès, Alain Delon, Lino Ventura, Micheline Presle, Françoise Arnoul, Michel Simon, Danielle Darrieux
description: Seven episodes to illustrate the Ten Commandments. In the first, two religious confide their youthful adventures. In the second, the husband of a stripper rediscovers his wife's beauty. In the third, a young man is looking for his real mother. In the fourth a madman believes himself to be God. In the fifth a woman becomes the lover of her best friend's husband. In the sixth, a seminarian lets himself be killed by a trafficker to have him sentenced to death. In the seventh, a bank employee tries alone to recover the stolen stolen goods.
notes: The Devil himself introduces this irreverent representation of the Decalogue, with a great cast. The French edition differs in the second episode, replaced by another.

title: Le gendarme à New York
actors: Louis De Funès, Michel Galabru, Christian Marin, Guy Grosso
description: The Brigadier Cruchot, of the French gendarmerie of Saint Tropez, is invited to New York together with some colleagues for an international conference of police bodies. Despite his ban, in the American metropolis he follows him in incognito his daughter Nicole, a true champion in the art of ficca in trouble.
notes: Second out of five films with Louis de Funès in the role of the Brigadier Cruchot, simply called "Le Gendarme". The first of the series, _a girl in Saint Tropez_, of the previous year, had been a sensational success of the public in France, and the series continued until 1982. Unfortunately in Italy the verbal comedy of the legendary French comedian is lost with dubbing.

title: Le corniaud
actors: Bourvil, Louis De Funès, Venantino Venantini, Beba Loncar, Saro Urzì
description: Marechal, a small French trader collects a Cadillac from Naples to take to Paris, but ignores the load: drugs and jewelry. Remotely controlled and harassed by a gang bent on seizing the precious cargo, Marechal is close to completing his mission when he realizes he has been involved in a shady deal. With subtle cunning he then manages to unmask the bandits and make them fall into the hands of the police, earning a conspicuous cash prize for the considerable contribution made to the recovery of the stolen goods.

title: Le grand restaurant
actors: Louis De Funès, Bernard Blier, Maria-Rosa Rodriguez, Venantino Venantini
description: The president of the United States disappears while having lunch in a luxury restaurant in Paris: the manager of the restaurant, Monsieur Septime, will have to extricate himself from policemen, secret agents and political opponents who believe him responsible for the kidnapping ...
notes: The thin spy plot is a pretext for de Funès' gags.

title: Oscar
actors: Louis De Funès, Claude Rich, Agathe Natanson, Claude Gensac
description: An entrepreneur gets into trouble when the assistant asks him for the hand of his daughter, who is pregnant with the driver (he fired). Meanwhile, a waitress exchanges her suitcase for another full of stolen jewels ...
notes: Misunderstandings and twists for a brilliant comedy that keeps the pace and pulls more than a laugh.

title: La folie des grandeurs
actors: Louis De Funès, Yves Montand, Alice Sapritch, Karin Schubert

title: Le gendarme et les extra-terrestres
actors: Louis De Funès, Michel Galabru, Maurice Risch, Jean-Pierre Rambal

title: Il marito è mio e l'ammazzo quando mi pare
actors: Catherine Spaak, Hywel Bennett, Vittorio Caprioli, Hugh Griffith

title: Scacco alla regina
actors: Rosanna Schiaffino, Romolo Valli, Aldo Giuffré, Gabriele Tinti

title: La sculacciata
actors: Antonio Salines, Sydne Rome, Vincenzo Crocitti, Gino Pernice, Paolo Gozlino
description: After only six years, the marriage of Carlo and Elena goes into crisis as the man, desperate, finds himself helpless. Spouses are unable to remedy the sudden decline in desire; all their efforts to rekindle the dormant sexual passion, following the advice of a female rotogravure and resorting to sophisticated erotic games, seem to be useless ...
notes: Faint adaptation of the comedy _Neurotandem_ by Silvano Ambrogi, also author of the screenplay; it is a failed attempt at bitter humor, caught halfway between itch and social satire. With very disengaged actors, the film proceeds without conviction towards a false ending.

title: Autostop rosso sangue
actors: Franco Nero, Corinne Cléry, David Hess, John Loffredo, Carlo Puri
description: Walter (Franco Nero) and Eva (Corinne Cléry) are a couple in crisis who are crossing California aboard a camper in an attempt to put things right and find some harmony. The two find themselves giving a lift to a man, whose vehicle has broken down, but who turns out to be a dangerous robber who has robbed a bank and is fleeing both the police and his two cronies, whom he has betrayed by stealing from them. the substantial swag: 2 million dollars.

title: Gegè Bellavita
actors: Flavio Bucci, Lina Polito, Pino Caruso, Enzo Cannavale, Marisa Laurito
description: Gegè is a good for nothing, with the only "great" advantage of being a phenomenon in bed. When his wife discovers that, in addition to lazing around, he is cheating on her with her neighbors, she decides to use her husband's talents to her advantage.
notes: Grotesque comedy that misses the mark by trespassing into a predictable comedy.

title: La polizia ha le mani legate
actors: Claudio Cassinelli, Arthur Kennedy, Franco Fabrizi, Valeria D'Obici
description: In Milan, a bomb suddenly explodes in a hotel. Commissioner Rolandi begins to investigate managing to discover the identity of some of the characters involved, but these are let out of the scene just before being able to speak with Rolandi ...
notes: Dense and disturbing atmospheres for a film that manages to realistically outline the heavy and oppressive climate of the years of lead. The pessimism of which the ending is steeped, also evident in the choice to kill Rolandi's friend and colleague, returns the sense of inability, the limit of justice to act concretely on reality in order to modify it (obviously, for the better ). Sadly current.

title: ...e la vita continua
actors: Urs Althaus, Virna Lisi, Béatrice Camurat, Renato Cestié, Moana Pozzi, Valeria D'Obici
description: TV series that tells the saga of the Betocchi family from the second post-war period up to the 1980s. The father, a Lombard entrepreneur, returns from Switzerland where he had taken refuge and resumed his industrial activity. The eldest son, a young rampant, acts without too many scruples to take his place and the reins of the company.

title: Hitting a New High
actors: Lily Pons, Edward Everett Horton, Jack Oakie, John Howard, Eric Blore
description: Suzette's dream, who performs in a nightclub, is to tread the prestigious stage of the Metropolitan. To help her rise, her agent launches her as "Oogahunga, the bird-woman": she will spark the spark with a rich safari-loving music lover ...
notes: Last of the three films starring the French singer.

title: Nippon konchuki
actors: Sachiko Hidari, Kazuo Kitamura, Jitsuko Yoshimura, Seizaburo Kawazu
description: The story of Tome, born in 1918 in a peasant village: exploited from a very young age, both at work and sexually, forced to make prostitution a means of sustenance and survival ...
notes: Imamura faces an "exemplary" personal story without reticence and transforms it into a collective metaphor.

title: Messalina, Messalina
actors: Anneka Di Lorenzo, Vittorio Caprioli, Lori Wagner, Bombolo

title: Miracoloni
actors: Benedetto Casillo, Victor Cavallo, Mauro Di Francesco, Francesco Salvi, Bombolo

title: Liquirizia
actors: Christian De Sica, Stefano Ruzzante, Massimo Anzelotti, Barbara Bouchet, Ricky Gianco, Giancarlo Magalli, Jimmy il Fenomeno
description: It is the year of maturity for the classes of 1959, and the students of two high schools in Padua compete on a stage: the high school students try their hand at a play with existentialist implications, while the boys of the accounting form a rock band ...
notes: Claims of acute social analysis mixed with the exaltation of student spirit.

title: Pride & Prejudice
actors: Keira Knightley, Rosamund Pike, Matthew Macfadyen, Brenda Blethyn, Donald Sutherland, Jena Malone, Talulah Riley, Carey Mulligan, Judi Dench, Rupert Friend
description: When the charming Mr. Bingley - rich and bachelor - moves to Longbourn accompanied by his friend Darcy, he wreaks havoc in the existence of the Bennet family. The mother immediately thinks about the possibility of settling her five daughters: Jane, Elizabeth, Mary, Kitty and Lydia ...
notes: This version of Austen's novel makes one regret that of 1940 by Robert Z. Leonard, with Garson and Olivier: flat, opinionated and conformist (Wright goes into it with the carts, perhaps to revive her), with a stellar cast but not always in part. Much sponsored at home (England), yet another example of "literary" cinema, lifeless and illustrative.

title: Munich
actors: Eric Bana, Daniel Craig, Ciarán Hinds, Mathieu Kassovitz, Hanns Zischler, Ayelet Zurer, Geoffrey Rush
description: During the 1972 Olympics in Munich, Palestinian extremist Black September commando takes hostage and then kills Israeli athletes. Following the attack, a team of five men is secretly assigned by the government to track down and kill those responsible. Avner, a former Mossad officer, son of a patriot, agrees to be the head of the mission: for a long time he will have to abandon his identity and his affections ...
notes: It is no wonder that even the American neo-cons felt stung by _Munich_, who does not speak of 9/11 and war, but speaks of trials, of cross reprisals, of missing fathers or liars or opportunists, of "home" as a place of the soul, of the human need to break bread sitting at the same table. With a master's hand for genre cinema (each action is guided by the director with a style and a tension that refer backwards, directly to Duel) and a spasmodic attention and an instinctive pity for every single, minimal character (from the seductive Dutch spy to the French family traversed by Oedipal yearnings, from the writer killed in Rome to the father of a family who was the victim of the second attack), Spielberg composes a humanist and pacifist fresco, soaked in blood and deathly weary of war.

title: Fun with Dick and Jane
actors: Jim Carrey, Téa Leoni, Alec Baldwin, Richard Jenkins, Angie Harmon
description: After the unexpected bankruptcy of the company he works for, Dick Harper finds himself buried in debt. For some time he desperately searches for another job, but without success. With the help of his wife Jane, he embarks on a career as a thief until he realizes that it is time to take revenge on his former boss, the shrewd Jack McCallister.
notes: Today, when more than a crisis of the Dream we can speak of a crisis in the American system, the precipice is even more dizzying: careers, houses, cars, consumer goods in the wind. Joking about it can be very bitter but also very healthy, and "Dick and Jane: Operation Theft" (remake of the '77 film) starts in full swing, with a Jim Carrey in a state of grace (not too nice at first) and Téa Leoni able to stand up to him. Unfortunately, if the script and the gags work (the succession of robberies with or without a mask is very funny), it is the director who cannot keep up with the pace of the operation: Dean Parisot, more televised than film, who can't keep up with the step of the feature film, he repeats himself, flounders a bit.

title: Isabella, duchessa dei diavoli
actors: Brigitte Skay, Fred Williams, Mimmo Palmara, Sal Borgese
description: An Alsatian baron massacres the family of a French duke to seize his lands and his title. Isabella, the duke's little daughter, manages to escape and, raised by the gypsies, after twenty years she will seek revenge.

title: Il figlio dello sceicco
actors: Tomas Milian, Bo Svenson, Kirsten Gille, Andrea Aureli, Roberto Messina
description: Frightened by the prospect of his greedy brother succeeding him in the regency, the elderly sheikh of the United Arab Emirates discovers that he has an unsuspecting natural son who works as a gas station attendant in Rome. To accept the succession, however, the young man sets a condition ...
notes: Bruno Corbucci director, Galliano Juso producer, Tomas Milian protagonist: a dry terno sometimes a guarantee of "popular" quality, others of extreme tamarraggine. As in this case: for lovers of the Italic "stracult" it is a title to celebrate, for all the others a tremendous experience. The Cuban actor plays free-wheeling, as rarely elsewhere.

title: Bandidos
actors: Terry Jenkins, Enrico Maria Salerno, Cris Huerta, Marco Guglielmi, Venantino Venantini
description: A gang of outlaws assault a train. Richard Martin, skilled at shooting thanks to his experience in a circus, tries to resist the attack but the gang leader Billy Kane is faster, disarms him and breaks his hands. This leads Richard to teach his marksmanship to others and one of his students is Ricky Shot, a fugitive who is very interested in what happened. Martin believes that Ricky wants to avenge him but in reality the man just needs the outlaw to testify that he was not one of the attackers but just a mere passenger. For the two will soon come the time of direct confrontation with Kane.

title: Il dio chiamato Dorian
actors: Helmut Berger, Richard Todd, Herbert Lom, Marie Liljedahl, Margaret Lee, Maria Rohm, Beryl Cunningham, Isa Miranda, Eleonora Rossi Drago, Renato Romano, Stewart Black
description: Dorian, a rich and handsome young man, loves Sybil, an aspiring actress: a feeling that distracts him, at least a little, from his extreme narcissism. In this period he is also posing for a portrait that his painter friend Basil is making of him. When the portrait is finished Dorian expresses his regret: he will necessarily have to age and wither but the painting will remain unchanged over time, portraying its beauty. That same night he has a violent quarrel with Sybil, which he drives away. With fright the next morning he discovers that his image in the portrait appears slightly tired, as if aged. Dorian thus decides to hide the painting and continues his vicious life, without sparing himself. Yet, to age, it is only the image.
notes: Adaptation, translated into contemporary London, of the story of Dorian Gray.

title: Tre storie proibite
actors: Lia Amanda, Isa Pola, Gabriele Ferzetti, Bruno Vecchi, Gino Cervi
description: Following the collapse of a staircase, three young women, Renata, Anna Maria and Gianna, who were injured along with others, are welcomed to the hospital in the same ward. The three episodes of the film tell their story, including childhood abuse, escaping marriages and drugs.
notes: The misery of the bourgeoisie staged without flashes.

title: Au nom de tous les miens
actors: Michael York, Brigitte Fossey, Jacques Penot, Helen Hughes
description: Martin Gray is about to take his own life, after a furious fire destroyed his villa in the Midi of France and killed his wife and his four children. At the last moment he changes his mind and decides to record a message that tells his tormented life: from the internship in the Treblinka field where he lost his family, at the entrance alongside the Russian army in Berlin and escape to the United States.
notes: Enrico tells the true story of Martin Gray with emotion without giving in to pathetism. The images of the concentration camps is really touching and at the same time. There is also an eight -hour television version of the film.

title: Archimède, le clochard
actors: Paul Frankeur, Jean Gabin, Darry Cowl, Bernard Blier, Dora Doll

title: Too Late Blues
actors: Bobby Darin, Stella Stevens, Everett Chambers, Nick Dennis

title: Il giorno del giudizio
actors: Ty Hardin, Craig Hill, Gordon Mitchell, Rossano Brazzi, Rosalba Neri

title: Miss Europa
actors: Louise Brooks, Georges Charlia, Augusto Bandini, André Nicolle

title: Sorstalanság
actors: Marcell Nagy, Béla Dóra, Bálint Péntek, Áron Dimény, Péter Fancsikai, Dani Szabó
description: Budapest: Köves, 15, sees his life change with the advent of Nazism. The Jewish population begins to be discriminated against, the people who previously were close to his family distance themselves ... And then the deportations to Auschwitz, Buchenwald and Zeitz begin ...
notes: In the succession of episodes of everyday life in the concentration camp, which are now stylistic features of a different genre, an image stands out, perhaps sought after, but symbolic: in the open and in the cold of the concentration camp, the skeletonized bodies of the resisters sway, bend , they stagger, but they do not agree to collapse. Synthesis of a universal resistance, it reaffirms a human dignity that is independent of the historicity of the Holocaust. In addition to the duty of memory, the natural detachment of those who return is told, and the ability to enjoy the ray of sunshine that falls where every God has died. In front of which, perhaps, it is worthwhile not to set aside, but to reconsider the aesthetic discussions.

title: Hans
actors: Simona Nasi, Eugenio Allegri, Silvano Agosti, Franco Nero
description: Hans Schabe has a severe hereditary psychotic disorder. Over the years, the disease worsens and Hans regresses to the point of catalyzing all the fears and hatreds of society.
notes: We reiterate that a certain quality of the gaze is not lacking (see the final sequences in the psychiatric hospital), but the doubt is that the excessive cerebrality of the film, with its rhetorical anti-racist messages to the point of banality, hides an underlying inconsistency. The invention of earthworms to dispose of waste to be fed to the "black" workers, but only from the point of view of "carnivores from the savannah" is amusing. For the depth - aesthetic and moral - we advise the young Louis to turn elsewhere, perhaps to his uncle Sam (Fuller) and his _The corridor of fear_.

title: Café Chantant
actors: Virgilio Riento, Alberto Talegalli, Nino Taranto, Ugo Tognazzi, Corrado Mantoni
description: Sor Clemente escapes his unbearable wife for one evening and ends up with the butler and uncle Angelino to see a variety show.
notes: Presented by a young Corrado, the best of the Italian magazine of the time parades, from Ugo Tognazzi to Raimondo Vianello, from Aldo Fabrizi to Nino Taranto, to the Quartetto Cetra.

title: È arrivata la parigina
actors: Magali Noël, Jorge Mistral, Titina De Filippo, Maria Fiore, Franco Fabrizi
description: An ambitious French girl, who moved to Italy to be an actress, fails to break through and then opts for a normal life. But love and work are around the corner.
notes: A rather harmless bittersweet drama, carried out professionally by the artisan of genres Camillo Mastrocinque.

title: Outfoxed: Rupert Murdoch's War on Journalism
description: Director and producer Robert Greenwald analyzes in detail and documented the media empire of Australian-by-birth and American by adoption tycoon Rupert Murdoch. A system aimed at manipulating the opinion of three quarters of the planet is analyzed through the programs and news programs of the Fow News Channel. Greenwald contacted former FNC associates who offered their valuable testimonials and gathered the opinion of Walter Cronkite, the dean of American anchormans. Through the Moveon.org website, he monitored the channel round the clock to verify his theories.

title: College
actors: Buster Keaton, Anne Cornwall, Flora Bramley, Harold Goodwin
description: Ronald is a good guy who doesn't excel in any kind of sport. When he arrives at college he finds that all schoolchildren put a lot of effort into sporting activities. To impress the beautiful Mary, Ronald tries to join all the different college teams, but fails. The only sport he manages to practice successfully is rowing where he manages to win a race. This infuriates the loser who, out of spite, kidnaps the girl. In an attempt to free her from the brute, Ronald demonstrates that he knows how to practice all the sports in which, a short time before, he had shown himself to be denied.
notes: Second of the three films shot for United (_The general_ and _I ... and the cyclone_).

title: Arachnid
actors: Chris Potter, Alex Reid, José Sancho, Neus Asensi, Ravil Isyanov
description: A man is taken to a small clinic on the island of Guam in critical condition. Doctors notice a series of unidentified insect bites on her body, and begin investigating the causes of her illness. Unable to figure it out and suspecting an imminent epidemic, they send a group of scholars to the island where the man lived to investigate. But the airplane that hosts them suffers a breakdown and the scientists find themselves shipwrecked in an unknown and apparently deserted land. When they arrive at the man's village, they find it deserted, while they notice that a new species of spider is spreading through the forest. The priority is no longer research, but survival.

title: Murderball
directors: Henry Alex Rubin, Dana Adam Shapiro

title: Best of the Best 2
actors: Eric Roberts, Phillip Rhee, Chris Penn, Edan Gross, Ralf Moeller, Patrick Kilpatrick
description: In a clandestine fighting arena, Travis Brickley is killed after losing a martial arts duel to Brakus. Walter Grady, son of Travis' best friend, decides to avenge his death by challenging Brakus ...
notes: Nothing more than a series of kicks, punches and hasty rhetoric.

title: Seed of Chucky
actors: Jennifer Tilly, Redman, Hannah Spearritt, John Waters, Keith-Lee Castle

title: Biancaneve e i sette ladri
actors: Peppino De Filippo, Mischa Auer, Silvana Pampanini, Luigi Pavese
description: Milan is deserted for mid-August, but the accountant Peppino Biancaneve is still in the city: he is preparing the speech with which he will ask his future father-in-law for his daughter's hand. Unfortunately, all of his plans fall apart when a jester hurls him the evil eye.
notes: Openly parodic title of the Disney classic, it has absolutely nothing to do with it except for the name (and only the name) of the character of De Filippo, one of those typical wretches who only dream of leading a quiet existence and come punctually dissatisfied. Based on the short story _Il ladro_ by Anton Germano Rossi, a slightly tired comedy of misunderstandings, in a precarious balance between pink tones and yellow instincts.

title: Io sono il capataz
actors: Renato Rascel, Silvana Pampanini, Luigi Pavese, Marilyn Buferd
description: One day Uguccione is mistaken for C6, a dangerous revolutionary agent, and immediately transferred to Parazuela. Here he puts himself in command of the insurrectionist troops.
notes: Alberto Albertazzi, in 1951, criticized the lack of originality of comic stunts and defined the contribution given by Rascel as "scarce, or at least irrelevant".

title: L'incantevole nemica
actors: Silvana Pampanini, Robert Lamoureux, Carlo Campanini, Pina Renzi, Buster Keaton

title: Mat'
actors: Vera Baranovskaja, Nikolaj Balatov, Aleksandr Cistjakov, Anna Zemstova
description: Palageja Niloyna, widow of an alcoholic worker, fears for the fate of her son Pavel who joined the revolutionary movements. To protect him, he decides to reveal to the police where he has hidden weapons. She will notice the mistake made, so much so that it will be she, after the death of her son, who will lead the march on May 1st, brandishing the red flag.
notes: Pudovkin's first feature film, based on the novel of the same name by Maxim Gorky. Bolshevik melodrama, a masterpiece of the history of cinema which, due to the political message, has made more than one nose turn up. Intense and cinematically flawless, he makes masterful use of parallel editing, of which Pudovkin was one of the leading theorists.

title: Méditerranées
actors: Vincent Cassel, Enrico Lo Verso, Monica Bellucci, Richard Bohringer, Luc Palun, Gilbert Melki, Foued Nassah, Ariane Kah, Victor Cavallo
description: Pitou returns to Marseille after seven years in prison. Everything changed: his brother married his ex-girlfriend Margherire, while his best friend Gilles became a local mafia boss, violent and corrupt. Pitou becomes involved in a murder but refuses the help of his old friend. Wanted by the police and by Gilles' own men, he hides on the outskirts of Marseille, in a neighborhood where the absence of rules is the law.

title: Combien tu m'aimes?
actors: Monica Bellucci, Bernard Campan, Gérard Depardieu, Jean-Pierre Darroussin
description: After winning a large sum of money in the lottery, François proposes to Daniela, a splendid prostitute from Pigalle, to abandon the profession to become his wife. She accepts: but Charly, a powerful Parisian gangster, is not willing to give up his favorite ...
notes: Filmed almost entirely indoors, it rests on three / four over-the-top characters: from the stereotypical Italian to the semi-stoned gangster who wears Armani, from the gymnastic and fashionable travet to the integrated secular Muslim. Between assorted jokes and opera pieces (from Verdi to Puccini), an authorial delirium that allows everything and its opposite, not caring about the public.

title: Potomok Cingiz-Chana
actors: Valeri Inkishanov, A. Dendincev, L. Belinskaja, Anjuska Sudakevic
description: A Mongolian hunter, found by the oppressors of his country in possession of a talisman that makes him believed to be descended from Genghis Khan, is the object of interested concern. He is almost induced to sign a dangerous treaty with the "bad guys" ...
notes: Based on a short story by Novoksonov.

title: Murder in Greenwich
actors: Christopher Meloni, Robert Forster, Maggie Grace, Toby Moore
description: Martha Moxley, who attends high school in Greenwich, Connecticut, is murdered in 1975. The first suspect is Michael Skakel, the young neighbor: but his relationship with the Kennedy family allows him to escape arrest. Ten years pass and the case is reopened thanks to the obstinacy of Mark Fuhrman, a police detective who had collaborated in the investigation of O.J. Simpson. Fuhrman gets help from Steve Carroll, who had handled the burning matter at the time. Although the two can't stand each other, they manage to get the culprit arrested.
notes: Based on a true story.

title: Ma l'amore mio non muore
actors: Lyda Borelli, Mario Bonnard, Gian Paolo Rosmino, Vittorio Rossi Pianelli

title: Un grand amour de Beethoven
actors: Harry Baur, Annie Ducaux, Jany Holt, André Nox, Jane Marken

title: Le capitaine Fracasse
actors: Fernand Gravey, Assia Noris, Jean Weber, Alice Tissot, Vina Bovy

title: Berlin Alexanderplatz
actors: Heinrich George, Maria Bard, Margarete Schlegel, Bernhard Minetti

title: Espoir - Sierra de Teruel
actors: Miguel Del Castillo, Pedro Codina, Serafín Ferro, José María Lado

title: La hora de los hornos
directors: Fernando E. Solanas, Octavio Getino, Santiago Álvarez

title: Ritorno
actors: Jane Avril, Laura Betti, Luigi Diberti, Ilaria Occhini, Paolo Brunatto, Fabio Garibba
description: Alarmed by a (false) telegram announcing the serious health conditions of the father of one of them, the two protagonists return home after many years ...
notes: Rai production, whose intimistic tones represented for Amico (also screenwriter, with Enzo Ungari) "a reaction to post-1968 demagogy and conformism".

title: Miyamoto Musashi
actors: Chojuro Kawarasaki, Kanemon Nakamura, Kigoro Ikushima

title: Ljubavni slucaj ili tragedija sluzbenice P.T.T
actors: Eva Ras, Slobodan Aligrudic, Ruzica Sokic, Miodrag Andric

title: Nevinost bez zastite
actors: Dragoljub Aleksic, Bratoljub Gligorijevic, Vera Jovanovic, Ana Milosavljevic

title: Sweet Movie
actors: Carole Laure, Pierre Clementi, Anna Prucnal, Sami Frey, Jane Mallett

title: Chocolat
actors: Isaach De Bankolé, Giulia Boschi, François Cluzet, Jean-Claude Adelin
description: In Cameroon garrisoned by the French, little France, daughter of an often absent diplomat, spends her days in the enchantment of the African landscape together with her mother Aimée and the black servant Protèe. The apparent equilibrium is broken by the arrival of white guests who unknowingly trigger unexpected reactions while France's mother begins a path of sensual rediscovery ...
notes: The directorial debut of Claire Denis, assistant to Rivette and Wenders, the film is a splendid and moving reflection on the relationships of class and race observed with the innocence of a childish gaze where the landscape and interpersonal relationships are painted with disturbing realism.

title: Beau travail
actors: Denis Lavant, Michel Subor, Grégoire Colin, Richard Courcet

title: Trouble Every Day
actors: Vincent Gallo, Tricia Vessey, Béatrice Dalle, Alex Descas, Florence Loiret-Caille
description: Shane and June Brown are a couple on their honeymoon in Paris. The priority of man, however, seems to be to find Lèo, a scientist with whom he was a collaborator and whose studies were dedicated to experiments on libido. Like Leo's wife, Coré, Shane suffers from uncontrollable cannibal impulses, inextricably linked to sexual desire.
notes: Claire Denis starts from horror premises to weave yet another human symphony of bodies, clashes and encounters. There are no explanations, no narrative dissolution, only the succession of sensations, the set of moods and tensions that shape the experience of diversity. And again, with all the conflicts that exist, is the distance between a Jew and a non-Jew in the sentimental-family sphere so irremediable nowadays? It will be said that everything is soup, if the end justifies the means. notes: Inspired by the protagonist of the first category action for sexual harassment, the direction of Niki Caro redeems itself from the conventionality of the overrated The Girl with the Whales, plays well the alternation between work and forensic scenes, does not slip into factious feminism. But Michael Seitzman's screenplay, which looks at (and mixes) Norma Rae, _Official and gentleman_ and _Silkwood_ and _Erin Brockovich_ with authentic tones at the same time, borders on the tearful and artificial. We go beyond the improbability of the supermodel in a blue overalls, because the setting is realistic, we appreciate the great performances of Sissy Spacek and Richard Jenkins and the atmosphere of Dylan, looted from the soundtrack. The intent is sacrosanct, and the emphasis on the reclaiming force of a group and individuals, too.

notes: Written by Kazuo Ishiguro (author of the novel from which Ivory's last good film, _Quel che remains del giorno_ was based) and starring Ralph Fiennes and half the Redgrave family (Natasha Richardson protagonist, flanked by mother Vanessa and aunt Lynn Redgrave in the roles of the aunt and mother-in-law respectively), The White Countess is a film with an unlikely script, which blatantly tells everything and suggests nothing, and which has forgotten the taste for suspension and psychological ambiguity. Waste of talent, certainly not of emotions.

title: Transamerica
actors: Fionnula Flanagan, Felicity Huffman, Kevin Zegers, Graham Greene, Elizabeth Peña, Burt Young
description: Bree is a transsexual who lives in Los Angeles and is waiting for the last surgery, the one that will definitely make her a woman. One day he receives the call from a New York prison: it is Toby, a boy looking for the father he has never met. Bree realizes that he is the boy's father, born of a casual relationship he had in college. To close with his past, Bree decides to meet him and flies to New York ...
notes: The newcomer Tucker hits the masterpiece at the first shot with a magnificent portrait set like a diamond between two sexes, between two shores, between two ideas of the world, between two conceptions of humanity. It is not just the direction, careful not to forget the icons of cinema on the road, but the writing: see, for example, the amazing sequence of Bree's return to the family home, where love collides every second with the cynicism: a piece of tragicomic cinema as it hasn't been enjoyed in decades. And what about Felicity Huffman? Already awarded with the Golden Globe, it should bring home the most deserved Oscar, trying not to miss the category. His is a performance that responds in grace-kissed rhymes to the equally extraordinary Bill Murray of _Broken Flowers_, a film closely related to _Transamerica_: both struck by the desire to try, to recur, to never feel lost, to reclaim society and interpersonal relationships free and free from dogmas and religions, from hypocrisy and from the structural discomforts of contemporary man. Among the supporting actors, in addition to a perfect cameo by Burt Young, will remain the all-Indian romanticism of Graham Greene, also a trans (in) flight, an Indian who turned into a cowboy with an Indian soul, ready to (with) share with Bree. intoxication of another life. notes: When love burns the soul begins at the moment of the famous concert held in 1968 in Folsom prison, it goes back in flashbacks, a few clear lines about Johnny's childhood, military service in Europe and early compositions, Memphis and the first wedding, music, great love. Unlike most biopics, it does not want to tell the whole story of the protagonist, but only "those" years (from 1954 to 1968) and above all "that" story: the beautiful love story between Johnny Cash and singer June Carter who , for ten years, they only managed to love each other in front of 10,000 people, on the stage, and escaped into private life. "You dress in black because you didn't find anything else. You invented that sound because you don't know how to play well. You tried to kiss me because you didn't want to. When do you decide to take a responsibility?", June asks him at the beginning of their friendship. Meanwhile, he marries two other men with whom he has children, while Johnny, self-destructive and electrified, moves away from his wife, drinks, takes drugs, sinks. Until June gets him back on track. title: Arrivederci amore, ciao
actors: Alessio Boni, Isabella Ferrari, Michele Placido, Carlo Cecchi, Alina Nedelea

notes: The protagonist is the sum of many ideological scraps that today wallow plump, paradigms of an ideology of prevarication and unscrupulous and applauded accumulation. Soavi indulges in horror and virtuosity, in search of a spectacle held back by a script that is too concerned with clarity. Great triumph of Evil in the final.

title: Aeon Flux

notes: Theron was missing a role as a sci-fi heroine: the opportunity comes from this MTV production, which takes the idea from a pre-existing animated series (by Peter Chung) and scripted by Phil Hay and Matt Manfredi. A thin weave, a carryover neo-humanism (how far away _Gattaca _...), but an original scenic setting, inspired by Bauhaus architecture and design.

notes: How do you approach _Hostel_? With some reasonable doubts but with the knowledge that Eli Roth is not looking for easy solutions. Is there therefore no hope for the executioners and above all for the victims? The answer remains in midair, and perhaps in this ambiguity that forces you to ask questions, lies the political value of the film.

The best fragment is _Il divorzio_, written by Janet Wolf and Sergio Amidei and directed by Franciolini. notes: Written and directed immediately after the war, the film has the particularity of showing Americans and Russians working together - even praising the friendship between the two blocs - to defeat the common enemy. Putting aside the political agenda, with tones perhaps a little too over the top, it remains a fashion thriller, without smudges but also without particular flashes. Impressive images of Germany devastated by the bombings.

The informer was her lover and there is no mercy for any of her descendants.
notes: In John Dickson Carr's novel The Court of Witches, loved by Yeats, the mystery remained unsolved. Here an explanation is given and both the good structural inventions and the detailed portrait of the environment present in the original text are lost along the way.

However, he is convinced by some scammers to produce a film that evokes his tragic love story and entrusts the task of directing it to a boy who physically resembles him.
notes: A thin but not silly comedy that offers the public a ferocious and not at all obvious portrait of the world of cinema with an interesting metacinematographic work. Soldati has a complicated subject on his hands and in the end he comes out well but the work paired with Carlo Borghesio is not always well blended. Second film produced by Lux after the transfer of the company from Rome to Turin.

title: In un altro paese
description: It is called _Excellent Cadavers - The Mafia and the Death of the First Italian Republic_ the book by Alexander Stille, the starting point of _In an other country_. _Excellent corpses_ like Sciascia's book and the resulting film Rosi. Years pass, but the endemic anthropological, social and political problems of the violent land of Sicily remain almost unchanged. Stille, writer and journalist, walks through the streets of Palermo with the intention of decrypting the season of crimes and punishments through the mysteries and shadows that stand out on the ancient and splendid Arab-Norman palaces today headquarters of the institutions, among the markets open air that hide the silence and the fears, the wounds and remorse of the common people, forced to witness the systematic elimination of the anti-godfathers, the real and involuntary heroes that mafia cancer has ringed with strategic stubbornness starting from the end of the years' 70.
notes: In this poetically indispensable film, the suffering and respectful images - accompanied by the firm voice of Fabrizio Gifuni - of the bodies crushed by abuses of power, the tears of relatives, the extraordinary shots of Letizia Battaglia that have dramatically historicized them, the frightening peasantry of a region that is struggling to find peace, to reconcile with itself. And who dreams, in his mournful silence, of another country, another modesty, a simple serenity.

title: Bell'epokèr
actors: Totò Onnis, Dino Abbrescia, Laura Marinelli, Nino Frassica, Frank Lino
description: Bari, 1999. Two strange figures wander around in the darkness of an audience. Petrol, rope, matchstick and in a few minutes the Politeama Theater becomes ashes. Detachment, superimpositions, dissolves and we are in the beautiful epokèr, between jaunty costumes and wild dancers, smoky poker games and resounding Bari aristocracy, barons and prostitutes, intrigues, passions and symbols.
notes: Nico Cirasola's intent is clear: to metaphorize the loss of a theater to remember and bring to everyone's attention the void left by Petruzzelli. Nico Cirasola thinks of Tornatore's _Nuovo Cinema Paradiso_, which he manages to evoke despite the poverty of means.

They will convince the governor to send a commission of inquiry.

Only when for reasons of prestige, the company is forced to create something new, Mr. Fielding authorizes the construction of the car designed by Johnny. But it is immediately put aside, although it presents itself very well and reveals excellent qualities. But Mr. Fielding's resistances are overcome thanks to the will of Johnny and the owner's beautiful niece, Lisa ...

notes: Says their creator Nick Park: "Wallace and Gromit are like an old couple, a little intolerant but very patient towards each other". Suspended between Ealing's comedies and Hammer's horror films, a delightful reinterpretation of British genre cinema. With all due respect to Truffaut ...

notes: That this film could have won the Oscar for best foreign film is not incredible: it is in fact a fairy tale full of clichés, didactic in representing a social cross-section in which society has its faults and criminals still have a good soul. Americans, unaccustomed to seeing a cinema other than their own, liked all of this.

actors: Jeffrey Hunter, Arthur Kennedy, Diana Lorys, Sara Lezana

title: Musikanten
actors: Alejandro Jodorowsky, Sonia Bergamasco, Fabrizio Gifuni, Juri Camisasca
description: Marta, TV screenwriter, has one great passion, Beethoven's work. Together with Nicola, she presents to the director of the network she works for, a project on non-scientific disciplines through which she meets a guru who subjects her to hypnosis. Obsessed by the genius of the composer, Marta continuously listens to his music until, through hypnosis, she finds herself living in 1826 and discovering that she was Prince Lichnowsky, a friend of the composer ...
notes: It is difficult to summarize in a few words the plot of _Musikanten_, conceived as a work in three movements that spiritually continues themes and stylistic features (here a mixed technique of HD Sony, 35mm and digital camera) of _Perduto amor_, of which the narrator (and noble) Manlio Sgalambro, and Lucia Sardo. Disorienting but not unpredictable, for those accustomed to the interests of the Sicilian musician: from the search for the One above good and evil to oriental philosophies, to the controversy, in the Leopardian sense, with the present, which, as already claimed by a character of his first film about Italy in the 1960s, he is ill, very ill. One can tune in or not to the paradoxical irony and Socratic passion of the author, but one cannot fail to recognize the rarity and honesty of the experimental trait and the cognitive demon, the one that should push to be better. With the usual multidisciplinary approach, Battiato fills his film with musician obsessions, like the "dervishes tourneurs" of a rare silent film. The almost Herzogian attempt to identify the dark and terrible side of the process of artistic creation (and its confrontation with the market) leaves the didacticism of the dialogues, the desired anti-naturalism of the acting and the sporadic inconsistencies of accents in the background.

title: Stay

But Henry's analysis has increasingly disturbing consequences on Sam's life, starting with the tension created in his relationship with Lila, his girlfriend and former patient.
notes: In an aquatic, hallucinatory, unstructured New York, the game of hide and seek between them, after two hours of effect sets, liquid paintings, spirals, stairs, melts (so to speak) only in the epilogue. Balance game between reality and illusion, which stops at the packaging, even if it is very elegant.

title: La guerra di Mario
actors: Valeria Golino, Marco Grieco, Andrea Renzi, Rosaria De Cicco, Anita Caprioli
description: Mario, nine years old, was entrusted by the Juvenile Court to Giulia and Sandro, a forty-year-old couple from the educated and well-to-do bourgeoisie. Giulia is perfectly at ease as a putative mother, while Sandro is intimidated by the presence of the child. Mario finds himself living in a completely different world from the one he has known up to that moment, torn between his new family and his real mother ...
notes: A dry answer to the emphatic rhetoric of the Scampia Boys led by the singer Gigi Finizio at the Sanremo Festival is given to us by Antonio Capuano, natural, ideal and spiritual heir of Sergio Citti, even if moved a few kilometers lower than the boot, in degradation absolute of a region, Campania, and an area, that of the Neapolitan, which for some time have sadly crossed the threshold of human dignity.

title: Piano 17
actors: Giampaolo Morelli, Elisabetta Rocchetti, Enrico Silvestrin, Giuseppe Soleri, Antonino Iuorio

Disguised as a cleaning man and with the bomb connected to a timer, Mancini gets stuck in the elevator with two unsuspecting employees, while his two accomplices, outside, should keep the situation under control. But things don't go as planned ...
notes: _Piano 17_ by the Manetti brothers, a "miracle budget" film (ie financed with money collected miraculously) with all the actors working for free, is the first complete example of a new trend: noiresco. A mix between the glorious 70s policeman and the Italian-Mediterranean noir that is so fashionable now, the caciarona all'ammatriciana aesthetic and the gender trend that is talked about in the good salons of cinephilia.

title: Torremolinos 73
actors: Javier Cámara, Candela Peña, Juan Diego, Malena Alterio, Fernando Tejero, Mads Mikkelsen, Ramón Barea
description: In Franco's Puritan Spain, Alfredo López, a salesman of encyclopedias, suddenly finds himself out of work. To make ends meet, he is therefore forced to agree to shoot erotic films in Super 8, directed to the countries of Scandinavia. The protagonist is his wife Carmen, who despite herself becomes an international sex symbol. Alfredo then, seized by the relative success, ventures to move to auteur cinema inspired by Bergman.
notes: Director and debut screenwriter, Berger creates a good period reconstruction. Social criticism, on the other hand, is less effective, over which the homage, somewhat an end in itself, to trash cinema takes over.

title: Anche libero va bene
actors: Kim Rossi Stuart, Barbora Bobulova, Alessandro Morace
description: Tommi, eleven years old, lives in Rome, with his father Renato and his sister Viola. The sudden return of Stefania, the mother who had previously abandoned the family no longer giving any news of herself, reopens lacerating conflicts. In particular, Tommi questions the father figure ...
notes: The delicacy of certain passages (those apparently secondary at school, among the best things) make the defects bearable, which to be honest - especially when it is a debut - it is good to underline. Despite the intentions, more than Gianni Amelio it seems to us that Rossi Stuart follows the Cristina Comencini method: to the synthesis between psychology and staging he prefers the radicality of the script, the writing that precedes gestures and looks. For this reason, a certain schematism runs through the film: the father at one extreme shouted and over the top; the mother to the other, taciturn and evanescent to the point of disappearance. Without nuances, without mysteries scattered among the shots. In short, it is on "cinema" that Rossi Stuart has to work, perhaps learning from his mentor Amelio for whom the scripts are only canvases, Rossellinian "pizzini" which, if made of iron, weigh.

description: In the 1960s, for a scientific experiment, a new species of fish was introduced into Lake Victoria. Thus, in a short time, the "Tilapia of the Nile" causes the extinction of almost all the local fish races. Today it is exported all over the world: huge freighters land daily in the area to load the catch and unload weapons destined for the many African wars ...
notes: A film that is sometimes too didactic, to which a certain cinematic verve would have been good, and yet highly instructive for the kind of truth it tells, and which forces us to open our eyes to our pettiness. Even buying frozen fish, from now on, will be a political act.

title: Il mio miglior nemico
actors: Carlo Verdone, Silvio Muccino, Ana Caterina Morariu, Agnese Nano, Paolo Triestino
description: Achille De Bellis, established top manager of an important hotel chain owned by his wife Gigliola and his brother-in-law Guglielmo, fires one of his employees, Annarita, for theft. Orpheus, Annarita's 23 year old son, convinced of his mother's innocence, decides to avenge her. Thus begins to follow Achilles everywhere to discover his weaknesses and ruin his existence ...
notes: The result of the pact between two such happily popular figures as Verdone and Muccino is discontinuous, it takes breath away from the supporting actors and lingers on a more than proven Capitoline comedy. Less biting than expected but a lot of honesty in telling the drift of the parents, more spoiled by the well-being of their children. Whose dilemmas lie between lithium and amphetamine, in search of other masters.

title: Separate Lies
actors: Tom Wilkinson, Emily Watson, Rupert Everett, Hermione Norris, John Warnaby, Richenda Carey
description: James Manning, a popular lawyer, is happily married to the charming Anne. When the husband of the Manning cleaning lady is found dead, victim of a hit-and-run, James suspects his neighbor - the aristocrat Bill Bule, who has just returned from America - and begins to investigate ...
notes: A rookie director, the screenwriter Fellowes (Oscar for _Gosford Park_) adapts a novel by Nigel Balchin: the result is a fake noir of a British bourgeois environment, with mélo implications and returning do-gooders. Everything already seen. Wilkinson and Watson offer solid proof of acting, but Everett is unquestionably off the mark.

title: V for Vendetta
actors: Natalie Portman, Hugo Weaving, Stephen Rea, Stephen Fry, John Hurt, Tim Pigott-Smith
description: In the near future, a totalitarian regime oppresses London. An avenger named V, disguised as Guy Fawkes (the rebel hanged in the historic conspiracy of the powders of 1605), educated and gentleman, saves the young Evey from the violence of some cops: together they will fight against a regime that persecutes foreigners, homosexuals and opponents.
notes: Inspired by the comic by Alan Moore and David Lloyd (1989) and produced by the Wachowski brothers with Joel Silver, the film is shot almost entirely indoors (in Germany) and at times recreates the claustrophobic anguish of the "graphic novel", but the anti-authoritarian motive remains crushed by the confrontation with a much more articulated reality.

title: The Producers
actors: Nathan Lane, Matthew Broderick, Uma Thurman, Will Ferrell, Gary Beach, Roger Bart
description: Broadway: Max Bialystock, a disgraced theater producer, decides - with the help of shy accountant Leo Bloom - to stage a show destined to be a flop, only to escape with the money set aside by unsuspecting investors. The choice falls on _The Spring of Hitler_, a text written by Franz Liebken, a Nazi criminal sheltered in the United States. The director Roger DeBris, completely devoid of talent, and Ulla, a Swedish sex bomb who, in addition to being part of the dance troupe, is employed as a secretary-switchboard operator are then hired. In the role of the protagonist there is the same Liebken, who, however, is injured shortly before going on stage and is replaced by the director. On the night of the premiere, the show was a resounding success that undermined the plans of Bialystock and Bloom ...
notes: Dignified (but nothing more) remake of the hilarious debut by Mel Brooks, released in Italy with the title _Per Please don't touch the old ladies_ (1968),

title: Forever Blues
actors: Franco Nero, Daniel Piamonti, Paola Saluzzi, Robert Madison, Minni Minoprio
description: While on his way to a specialist visit accompanied by his mother, Marco, an autistic child, meets Luca, a lonely trumpet player who has to perform in a jazz club in the evening. The two end up spending a day and part of the night together. It is the beginning of a great friendship ...

title: Find Me Guilty
actors: Vin Diesel, Annabella Sciorra, Ron Silver, Alex Rocco, Linus Roache, Peter Dinklage
description: The longest trial in American history, which lasted twenty-one months (between 1987 and 1988): that of Giacomo - known as Jackie Dee - Di Norscio, affiliated with the Lucchese clan. At one point, Jackie is offered the opportunity to shorten her detention to thirty years as long as she testifies against many of her closest friends: but he, firmly determined not to betray his "family", decides to defend himself against. alone and - thanks to his cheeky sense of humor - surprises everyone ...
notes: Lumet's camera, 80 years of very solid profession, has always circumnavigated between courtrooms and police districts, from _The word to the jurors_ to _The verdict_ and _Terzo degree_, and not infrequently drew inspiration from news events (think of _Serpico_ ). Here he contaminates (in complicity with T.J. Mancini & Robert J. McCrea) the legal scene with the cynical comedy in the style of _Sopranos_: his sympathies are politically incorrect and definitely hang on the side of the "unpresentable" criminals. Watching the film, one senses the bizarre procedural dynamics that allowed even "apparent culprits" like O.J. Simpson or Michael Jackson not to get "stuck". As one character says: "Power corrupts, absolute power corrupts absolutely". In a small but memorable cameo, the beautiful Annabella Sciorra evaporates a trail that has the scent of an indelible erotic fluid.

title: La vida secreta de las palabras
actors: Sarah Polley, Tim Robbins, Javier Cámara, Eddie Marsan, Steven Mackintosh
description: Hanna is a lonely nurse who, during the holidays, accepts a replacement on a platform where she takes care of Joseph, temporarily blind and scarred by numerous and severe burns on his body. Together, the two will face painful memories ...
notes: A restrained yet naive drama (a white goose on board, two loving sailors staging a humble karaoke) in which everything goes perfectly until the revelation - free and redundant - of the causes of her pain and the overly explanatory ending. The acting has something miraculous (the firmness of Polley is impressive) and the soundtrack mixes Paolo Conte, Tom Waits and Antony and the Johnsons.

title: Doom
actors: Dwayne Johnson, Karl Urban, Rosamund Pike, DeObia Oparei, Ben Daniels, Dexter Fletcher
description: Communications between researchers on the "red planet" and on Earth are mysteriously interrupted. Something serious has happened, and the only ones authorized to intervene are the paramilitaries of the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, including Grimm and Sarge: what the rescuers ignore is that it was precisely the researchers who unknowingly unleashed the mutations that generated an army of "hellish" creatures ...
notes: Pure American "action" routine, overloaded with clichés and not tempered by irony. You save the five minutes in subjective, which follow the historical "shooter" for PC from which the film is based.

title: Gojira

The city of Tokyo is in danger of being destroyed by its fury and a single extreme solution is looming on the horizon.

title: Dog Soldiers

Forced to flee, they run into Ryan, badly injured, and find refuge in the cottage of a zoologist, Megan ...
notes: Marshall sets up a mechanism that manages to be rhythmic, adrenaline-pumping and terrifying without ever taking itself too seriously. Great example of a film where the low budget is offset by passion and professionalism.

notes: The film directed by a specialist in the horror genre (_Nightmare 2 - The revenge _ and _Wishmaster 2 - Evil never dies_) is based on real events.

notes: A graceful remake of Henry Cass's _Last Holiday_, almost unknown to us, is a harmless comedy, smoothly directed by Wang (who has lent his talents to better operations in the past).

With the assistant Gilbert Ponton and the devoted secretary Nicole, Nostro carries on the investigation between Paris and New York focusing on three main suspects ...
notes: Clouseau is no longer a "monster", but a sympathetic clumsy, who even happens to solve a case (while the "authentic" inspector has never happened, except by accident, and in any case he never noticed it ). Which evidently, for any admirer of pure Clouseauian madness, is disappointing; because in this way an entire imaginary and spatial universe is no longer put in crisis, but a simple parody is made. The lack of any idea of ??direction does not improve the operation. However, at least three gags work well (the English lesson, the globe - especially the "second bar", Monty Python style - and Martin and Reno's disguise at the final party): it could have been worse.

notes: The director and creator of the first chapter is back but the formula was already repetitive in the first film, imagine the third. Some deaths, however, are creative enough to be of interest to lovers of the genre.

notes: Wyler draws the story from the novel of the same name by John Fowles and immerses it in a claustrophobic atmosphere, also due to somewhat literary dialogues whose weight ends up exacerbating the sense of oppression. title: Vidas Secas
actors: Átila Iório, Maria Ribeiro, Orlando Macedo, Jofre Soares
description: Brazil. Fabiano's family, made up of his wife Sinha Vitoria, their two children, a dog Baleia and a parrot, moves around in the north-east sertão, haunted by drought. Fatigue leads all its components to despair and to commit acts and thoughts on the verge of madness. With the arrival of winter and rain, things improve, but life goes on and summer comes back again ...
notes: Brazilian "cinema novo" at its best: poverty of means, black and white of great impact, simple but strong narration, generous and sensitive gaze. Based on a novel by Graciliano Ramos, the film gently and humbly tells a shocking family story.

title: Le comte de Monte Cristo
actors: Pierre Richard-Willm, Michèle Alfa, Aimé Clariond, Marcel Herrand
description: Edmond Dantes manages to escape from prison after being unjustly incarcerated. He thus sets out in search of those who have betrayed him.

title: My Name Is Julia Ross
actors: Nina Foch, Dame May Whitty, George Macready, Roland Varno

title: So Dark the Night
actors: Steven Geray, Micheline Cheirel, Eugene Borden, Ann Codee

title: Terror in a Texas Town
actors: Sterling Hayden, Sebastian Cabot, Carol Kelly

title: Un chapeau de paille d'Italie
actors: Jim Gérald, Marise Maia, Paul Ollivier, Albert Préjean, Valentine Tessier

title: And Then There Were None
actors: Barry Fitzgerald, Walter Huston, Louis Hayward, Roland Young

title: Pandora and the Flying Dutchman
actors: James Mason, Ava Gardner, Nigel Patrick, Sheila Sim, Harold Warrender, Mario Cabré
description: Beautiful Pandora is not at all interested in her numerous suitors. Then one day she meets Stephen, falls in love with him and agrees to marry him. But when a mysterious yacht appears in the sea, the girl feels she has to swim to him. The boat is owned by an aristocrat to whom she feels a strong attraction, but he rejects it. The man is the "Flying Dutchman" who, having killed his innocent wife, has been wandering desperately on the sea for three hundred years ...
notes: Thanks to the presence of a James Mason in a state of grace, the film gets its own distinctive touch. Less incisive the beautiful Ava Gardner, however, with the right charm to play Pandora. Excellent photography by Jack Cardiff.

title: Szegénylegények
actors: János Görbe, Zoltán Latinovits, Tibor Molnár, Gábor Agárdi

title: Fényes szelek
actors: Lajos Balázsovits, András Bálint, Adrienne Csengery, Ferenc Deák B.

title: Még kér a nép
actors: Lajos Balázsovit, András Bálint, István Bujtor, Gyöngyi Bürös

title: Vizi privati, pubbliche virtù
actors: Lajos Balázsovits, Pamela Villoresi, Franco Branciaroli, Teresa Ann Savoy
description: After seeing the conspiracy against his father, Emperor Franz Joseph, fail, Prince Rudolf of Habsburg retires to a castle with his mistress. In the sumptuous residence, surrounded by a small circle of friends, he continuously organizes banquets and parties until the scandal reaches the court and pushes the emperor to intervene.

title: Apa
actors: Miklós Gábor, András Bálint, Klári Tolnay, Dani Erdélyi, Kati Sólyom

title: Ten Little Indians
actors: Hugh O'Brian, Shirley Eaton, Daliah Lavi, Mario Adorf, Leo Genn
description: Ten people who do not know each other are invited to a mountain chalet and abandoned with no connection to the world. Once they arrive, a mysterious voice announces to them the respective crimes committed in the more or less remote past. On the living room table stands a sculpture depicting ten little Indians. From that moment, the tenants are killed one after the other following the ritual dictated by a macabre rhyme.
notes: The second film adaptation (after René Clair's in 1945) of Aghata Christie's excellent thriller of the same name has an anonymous direction and a cast that is certainly not stellar. Too bad, because the book remains one of the most cinematic ever.

title: Édes Emma, drága Böbe - vázlatok, aktok
actors: Johanna Ter Steege, Enikö Börcsök, Péter Andorai, Éva Kerekes

title: He Walked by Night
actors: Richard Basehart, Scott Brady, Roy Roberts, Whit Bissell
description: Roy, an electronic technician with no family or friends, chooses to become a thief. Unscrupulous and with scientific methods, the new Roy does not hesitate to kill to achieve his goals. When this happens to a policeman, the entire Los Angeles department organizes a vast manhunt, asking for the help of the civilian population to identify him ...
notes: Written by John C. Higgins, Crane Wilbur and Harry Essex, it is a claustrophobic noir film, shot with documentary techniques as was the fashion in post-war Hollywood. Extraordinary exteriors shot by Anthony Mann (uncredited), as well as the striking black and white by John Alton. Also good Basehart, enigmatic and resolute lone assassin.

title: María Candelaria
actors: Dolores Del Rio, Pedro Armendariz, Alberto Galán, Margarita Cortés

title: Enamorada
actors: Maria Felix, Pedro Armendariz, Fernando Fernández, José Morcillo
description: During the Mexican Revolution, General José Juan Reyes and his troops take control of the town of Cholula, near Mexico City. Here, the general falls in love with Beatriz Peñafiel, the beautiful but indomitable daughter of one of the richest men in the area.

title: La perla
actors: Pedro Armendariz, María Elena Marqués, Fernando Wagner

title: Salón México
actors: Marga López, Miguel Inclán, Rodolfo Acosta, Roberto Canedo

title: E' piccerella
actors: Eduardo Notari, Rosè Angione, Alberto Danza, Antonio Palmieri

title: The Phantom of the Opera
actors: Lon Chaney, Mary Philbin, Norman Kerry, Arthur Edmund Carewe

title: The Phantom of the Opera
actors: Robert Englund, Jill Schoelen, Alex Hyde-White, Bill Nighy
description: Christine Day is a young Broadway singer; for an audition he chooses a piece composed almost 100 years earlier by a musician named Erik Destler. The man had made a pact with the devil; in exchange for the success and love of the public, he agreed to be forever disfigured. When Christine sings her music, she finds herself catapulted into London in 1881, where a mysterious masked character is willing to do anything to make her an opera star ...
notes: Modern and not very successful version of Gaston Leroux's novel, already transposed several times on the screen. Robert Englund in the role of the hooded monster does nothing but replicate his much more famous Freddy Krueger.

title: Animal Farm
description: Mr. Jones is on the brink of ruin because his owner neglects work and prefers to get drunk. But one day the animals rebel against their master and decide to manage by themselves what they rename "animal farm", under the guidance of the pig Napoleon ...
notes: Based on the novel of the same name by George Orwell, famous above all for "1984", it is a strong criticism of the communist model, without denying the injustices that led to the October Revolution.

title: You'll Find Out
actors: Peter Lorre, Boris Karloff, Bela Lugosi, Kay Kyser, Dennis O'Keefe

title: À nous deux
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Jacques Dutronc, Jacques Villeret, Paul Préboist
description: Françoise is a charming bourgeois, Simon is a nice rogue: they meet and fall in love, so much so that Françoise decides to give up her comfortable life to raid - like Bonnie and Clyde - in the South of France ...
notes: Neither the couple of actors, nor sporadic inventions and jokes, are enough to flavor Lelouch's overcooked recipe.

title: Visions of Eight
directors: Milos Forman, Kon Ichikawa, Claude Lelouch, Youri Ozerov, Arthur Penn, Michael Pfleghar, John Schlesinger, Mai Zetterling
description: Eight different directors with their unique visions of the world recount the 1972 Munich Olympics, which went down in history for the terrorist attack of the Palestinian organization Black September.

title: Le chat et la souris
actors: Michèle Morgan, Serge Reggiani, Jean-Pierre Aumont, Philippe Léotard
description: Madame Richard, a beautiful middle-aged lady, has just been widowed: unfortunately for her, however, the stubborn Inspector Lechat is convinced that it was she who got rid of her husband ...
notes: Lelouch (also screenwriter) dyes his exasperatingly romantic atmospheres yellow: fans will applaud, others less.

title: Carlito's Way: Rise to Power
actors: Jay Hernandez, Mario Van Peebles, Luis Guzmán, Sean Combs
description: Late 1960s. The early years of the legendary gangster Carlito Brigante who, seduced by the power of the terrible New York slums, enters a deadly circle of greed and revenge. Carlito will quickly become the king of the Spanish Harlem heroine and quickly learn that the only way to keep power is to show loyalty to friends and respect the rules of the road.

title: Inside Man
actors: Denzel Washington, Clive Owen, Jodie Foster, Doug Aguirre
description: Four men and a woman disguised as house painters raid the Manhattan Trust headquarters taking about fifty people hostage and forced to wear overalls and masks. Meanwhile, the police surround the bank while detective Keith Frazier is in charge of negotiating with the head of the criminals who has studied the plan in detail ...
notes: It seems like a (simple) detective story and instead continues to talk, from another point of view, of the post 9/11 rubble: social, moral, racial ... Human miseries. Wealth built on the abomination of abominations (the Shoah) and then transformed into a philanthropic screen. Spike Lee is truly one of the few filmmakers who always have an ethical outlook, whatever he does. After that, Inside Man is also a great detective story.

title: Widow on the Hill
actors: Natasha Henstridge, James Brolin, Jewel Staite, Roman Podhora
description: Linda Dupree, a young and charming woman who lives in the city, decides to move to a rural area. The girl, determined to start a new life, comes into contact with the Cavanaugh family. Linda, who is a nurse by profession, takes care of the seriously ill wife of the head of the family Hank. Soon the woman seduces the mature Hank and after the death of his wife takes his place. His behavior arouses suspicion about one of the man's daughters who tries to convince her father that her stepmother has horrible secrets to hide.
notes: The film, which recalls the plot of _Anime in delirio_ with Joan Crawford, is based on a true story.

title: Im toten Winkel - Hitlers Sekretärin
description: Between 1942 and 1945, Traudl Junge was the closest person to the Führer, witnessing the progressive crumbling of a deadly machine of power and destruction that had long been considered invincible. A "wheel" of a macabre and deadly gear, which in front of the camera confesses without seeking alibis or acquittals.

title: Obyknovennyy fashizm
description: The director of _Nove giorni in un anno_ clearly analyzes the mechanisms of fascination exercised by violent and reactionary systems, proposing "reflections on daily existence under Nazism, with moments that are also terribly allusive to a certain monumental and empty rhetoric typical of all dictatorships" (Giovanni Buttafava).

title: Basic Instinct 2: Risk Addiction
country: Germany, Spain, Great Britain, United States
actors: Sharon Stone, David Morrissey, Charlotte Rampling, David Thewlis, Hugh Dancy
description: London: the famous writer Catherine Tramell is once again in trouble with justice. Scotland Yard assigns her case to Andrew Glass, a criminal psychologist who has the difficult task of evaluating her. But Andrew too, like detective Nick Curran before him, is involved by the woman in a dangerous game of seduction ...
notes: After a while, despite the unintentionally ridiculous jokes that Stone shares with all the other characters (especially analyst Charlotte Rampling), it gets deadly boring. At which, Caton-Jones is distracted trying to resume the new towering London architecture.

title: 16 Blocks
actors: Bruce Willis, Mos Def, David Morse, Jenna Stern, Casey Sander
description: At the end of the shift, Detective Jack Mosley is assigned to accompany Eddie Bunker, a petty criminal, to the courthouse sixteen blocks away. It would seem like a chore, but the situation becomes complicated when a black van starts following them and Eddie is in danger of coming to a bad end ...
notes: A real metropolitan western (there is also an ambulance-coach), almost exemplary in its essentiality. Apart from the twist that explains everything, the film has a crystalline linearity and direction, units of time, place and action in the closed perimeter of a city full of traps. Willis and Morse perfectly in part.

title: Die Große Stille
description: Life inside the great Chartreuse, the monastery in the French Alps, where the Carthusian monks live with their supreme rule that provides for the most absolute detachment from the world.
notes: Silence is (the gold) of our days, and so too is the thirst for spirituality - transversal to religions - and the yearning for a rediscovered simplicity: the austerity of essential environments of wood and stone, the childish and candid aspect of the monks resumed playing in the snow, the details of their humble, glorious work routine are reminiscent of Rossellini by _ Francesco, jester of God_. Only a few repeated captions - passages from sacred texts that refer to poverty and humility - interrupt the contemplation of this unique and truly unrepeatable object here and there (among the clauses of the agreement there is that for which no other film can be shot in those places). A philosophical essay on the density of time, an inexplicable, incomparable and necessary experience.

title: Failure to Launch
actors: Matthew McConaughey, Sarah Jessica Parker, Zooey Deschanel, Justin Bartha, Bradley Cooper, Terry Bradshaw, Kathy Bates
description: Trip meets Paula and between the two it is love at first sight. In particular, Paula represents the ideal woman for Trip, perfect from all points of view ... And this gives rise to some suspicion in the young man: was it not his parents, eager to get rid of him, who hired her?
notes: The only happy notes come from the supporting actors: Kathy Bates, Terry Bradshaw (the latter former American football champion, now a well-known TV face in the States) and above all Zooey Deschanel, daughter of the director and director of photography Caleb: a fascinating kit of sadomasochistic skill .

title: Eight Below
actors: Paul Walker, Jason Biggs, Bruce Greenwood, Moon Bloodgood, Gerard Plunkett
description: During an expedition to Antarctica, three explorers are forced to abandon their sled dogs - six Siberian huskies and two Eskimo wolves - to escape to safety. The animals will have to face a thousand dangers before rescuers set out in search of them ...

title: Five Guns West
actors: John Lund, Dorothy Malone, Mike Connors, R. Wright Campbell
description: America, civil war. Five desperate outlaws find themselves at a station for diligence just before implementing a criminal plan.

title: Fuoco su di me
actors: Omar Sharif, Massimiliano Varrese, Sonali Kulkarni, Zoltan Ratoti, Maurizio Donadoni
description: After living for a long time in France, Eugenio returns to Naples in convalescence with a bad wound sustained in battle. These are the last months of the Reign of Joachim Murat. Eugenio rediscovers his roots ...
notes: Lambertini compiles his public and private, political and intimate fresco with humble honesty. Aided by the vitality of that living stage called Naples, by actors of polite professionalism, by trajectories that support the points of contact and passages of Western and Eastern cultures and by a face that evokes Salma Hayek, that of Sonali Kulkarni, a Graziella d melodramatic impact. Good performance by Omar Sharif.

title: Not of This Earth
actors: Paul Birch, Beverly Garland, Morgan Jones, William Roerick

title: Attack of the Crab Monsters
actors: Richard Garland, Pamela Duncan, Russell Johnson, Leslie Bradley

title: Roll Bounce
actors: Bow Wow, Chi McBride, Wesley Jonathan, Meagan Good, Mike Epps
description: Late '70s: Xavier "X" and his friends, phenomena of roller-dance, watch helplessly as the track they were training on closes. They manage to find another one, but it's controlled by skaters who don't like them. The challenge between the two groups is inevitable ...
notes: With more than one eye on Spike Lee's _Crooklyn_, this other Lee's film is much more than a "vintage" fashion promotional operation, even if it often leans on a TV-like "black" comedy. Between nostalgia of the 70s, family dynamics and the elaboration of mourning, it maximizes the glamor and energy of the "skating jam".

title: The Wasp Woman
actors: Susan Cabot, Anthony Eisley, Barboura Morris, William Roerick
description: The queen of cosmetic researchers develops and tests a wasp enzyme capable of rejuvenating the skin. At night, however, it turns into a giant wasp thirsty for human blood ...
notes: The Corman factory as it can be stereotyped: absurd story, low budget and amused fun.

title: The Little Shop of Horrors
actors: Jonathan Haze, Jackie Joseph, Mel Welles, Dick Miller, Myrtle Vail, Jack Nicholson

title: Last Woman on Earth
actors: Betsy Jones-Moreland, Antony Carbone, Robert Towne
description: Harold Gern, a successful industrialist, is on vacation in Puerto Rico with his wife Evelyn and Martin, his friend and lawyer. During a boat trip the three decide to do some diving. When they emerge they realize with horror that they are unable to breathe without the help of oxygen cylinders. A catastrophe has killed all humans and Harold, Martin and Evelyn discover they are the only three survivors.
notes: With the maximum economy of means, a simple story and few characters, Roger Corman makes a film in which tension and mystery are the masters. Among many questions that keep the attention alive, everything is suspended until the last. Screenplay by Robert Towne.

title: Creature from the Haunted Sea
actors: Antony Carbone, Betsy Jones-Moreland, Robert Towne, Beach Dickerson
description: American swindler Renzo Capetto sees the possibility of making the coup of his life when a revolution breaks out on a Caribbean island. Helping to make the rulers escape with the national treasure in his boat, he plans to kill them to take possession of the riches and to place the blame for their death on the mythical sea monster that haunts the waters. Problems will come when the monster really shows up.

title: The St. Valentine's Day Massacre
actors: Jason Robards, George Segal, Ralph Meeker, Jean Hale, Clint Ritchie

title: Nanny McPhee
actors: Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson, Colin Firth, Angela Lansbury, Imelda Staunton, Thomas Sangster
description: Mr. Brown, a widowered funeral home owner, has his work cut out with his seven terrible children. They came to hunt 17 nannies in a short time. When Nanny McPhee, an ugly, bulbous-nosed woman with a protruding tooth, shows up, Mr. Brown is initially perplexed, but then decides to entrust her with his children. With prodigious results ...
notes: Between Mary Poppins and All together passionately, a coming-of-age tale of hyper-saturated colors and British humor interpreted and scripted by Emma Thompson starting from the illustrated books by Christianna Brand. Between nostalgic and cloying, like an aniseed candy.

title: Tristan + Isolde
actors: James Franco, Sophia Myles, Rufus Sewell, David O'Hara, Henry Cavill, Richard Dillane
description: The king of Ireland instructs the knight Tristan to escort his daughter Isolde to the future husband, an English nobleman: but during the journey, the two fall in love. The relations between England and Ireland, already in a critical phase, are further put to the test ...
notes: The Scott brothers entrust the direction of an old project of theirs to the revived Reynolds, for several years rather in the shade. The result is not exciting: after a start with solid technical values ??and rather convincing, we slip into the "teen movie" along the lines of Luhrmann's _Romeo + Juliet_, but without that freshness and with much less effective interpreters.

title: Lemming
actors: Laurent Lucas, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Charlotte Rampling, André Dussollier
description: Double couple for dinner, bourgeois context. A he and a she, Dussolier and Rampling, agé; one she and one him, Gainsbourg and Laurent Lucas, young and fascinating, albeit mysterious. All great performers. Intent swingers are feared but no, we slip into a psychological thriller, with hints of horror. One of the two women is treacherous, the other, perhaps, possessed. Seduction flows on the hidden side of bourgeois conventions, the dark side, of allusions and repressed anxieties, which could rise again as ghosts.
notes: Director Dominik Moll is confused, he starts out like Michael Haneke and ends up like David Lynch, with no personal style other than déjà-vu. And the symbolisms are not forgiven, such as that of the small suicidal rodent, the lemming, which functions as a deus ex machina and leaves a little disconcerted.

title: Saddam
actors: Mauro Stante, Riccardo Leto, Frank Adonis, Joe Labarbera, Federica Gili

title: La luna e il lago
actors: Matthieu Legavre, Angelo Pardo, Elena Russo, Luigi Maria Burruano, Francesco Scianna
