description: Elsa's husband, in love with another woman, left his wife and two children, Andrea and Rossana during the All Saints weekend in the holiday home on the Sila. Little Andrea will be able to make friends with Luca, a neighbor of his, who has a secret to hide.

title: Oltre l'oceano
actors: Ben Gazzara, Jill Clayburgh, Peter Reigert, Helene Michell, Sergio Rubini, Treat Williams, Rebecca Glenn
description: A rich New York businessman in crisis lands in Bali: here, thanks to the nature, the beauty of the places, the religious beliefs, the rituals and the festivities, the sweetness of the population and perhaps a love encounter, he will try to make sense of own life...
notes: Gazzara's only (and unfortunately mediocre) cinematographic direction.

title: Macabre
actors: William Prince, Jim Backus, Christine White, Jacqueline Scott

title: The Americano
actors: Glenn Ford, Frank Lovejoy, Cesar Romero, Ursula Thiess

title: The Gun That Won the West
actors: Dennis Morgan, Paula Raymond, Richard Denning, Chris O'Brien

title: The Blood Beast Terror
actors: Peter Cushing, Robert Flemyng, Wanda Ventham, Vanessa Howard
description: A series of terrible murders in the English countryside sees the victims, all handsome young men, bled to death. The Scotland Yard investigator thinks the killer is a bird of prey, but will discover that the solution to the mystery is more terrible than he imagines.
notes: Produced by Tigon it is a Hammer in the Soul film.

title: The Old Dark House
actors: Tom Poston, Robert Morley, Janette Scott, Joyce Grenfell
description: Tom, a traveling salesman who trades in American cars, arrives one evening at Femm Castle in Wales to deliver one. Tom finds his client Caspar dead in a trap door in the manor, but that's not the only, shall we say, strange thing he discovers. The surprise is great when he gets to know the other members of the family, including the sisters of the deceased Morgana and Cecily. But the troubles for him are not over because other cruel crimes are committed in the old castle.
notes: Remake of the film of the same name directed by James Whale in 1932. Back then the actors were called Boris Karloff, Melvyn Douglas and Charles Laughton. Production is Columbia, Hammer and Castle.

title: Strait-Jacket
actors: Joan Crawford, Diane Baker, Leif Erickson, Howard St. John
description: Lucy is discharged from the psychiatric clinic where she had been locked up for tearing apart her husband and his mistress with an ax. Waiting for her in the house of her brother and his wife who have decided to host her, she finds her daughter Carol who, at the time, was a child. That natural relationship of affection is re-established between mother and daughter, which is disturbed by Lucy's nightmares. The situation worsens when the corpses of a doctor and a farmer are found and it turns out that they were killed in the same way as the murders committed twenty years earlier.
notes: Castle resolutely shoots a film based on a story by Robert Bloch.

title: The Night Walker
actors: Robert Taylor, Barbara Stanwyck, Judi Meredith, Hayden Rorke

title: The Landlord
actors: Beau Bridges, Lee Grant, Diana Sands, Pearl Bailey, Walter Brooke
description: Edgard Enders, heir to a wealthy New York family, decides to invest his money in the renovation of a dilapidated building in Harlem. The black tenants give the new white landlord many problems, but the clash will lead Earl to suffer the fascination of a community full of life and contradictions, very different from his environment.
notes: Ashby's directorial debut, a year before _Harold and Maude_, doesn't always find a spirited rhythm, but it makes up for it with the effective portrayal of the characters. In addition, the egalitarian intent of the film is lightened by a script capable of making fun of both sides.

title: Crack in the Mirror
actors: Alexander Knox, Orson Welles, Juliette Gréco, Bradford Dillman

title: Mandingo
actors: Perry King, James Mason, Susan George, Richard Ward, Ken Norton

title: Terra em transe
actors: Jardel Filho, Paulo Autran, José Lewgoy, Glauce Rocha, Paulo Gracindo
description: Leftist intellectual Paulo Martins, fatally wounded in a clash with the military of the imaginary South American country where he lives, recalls his past. The relationship with Porfirio, a man of power, the affinities with the progressive governor Felipe and the relations with Sara and Silvia.
notes: One of the most important works of the nôvo cinema.

title: News from Home
description: Wandering through a New York imbued with the atmospheres of Edward Hopper's paintings, the Belgian director's camera composes an abstract and fragmented mosaic of everyday life in the metropolis. Akerman's voice off accompanies the images, reading the affectionate letters received from her mother.

title: Coronado
actors: Kristin Dattilo, Clayton Rohner, Michael Lowry, John Rhys-Davies
description: After discovering that her fiancé has traveled to El Coronado, a Central American country on the verge of revolution, Claire Winslow follows in her footsteps. Arriving at the scene, the woman joins forces with Arnet McClure, a TV reporter who secretly supplies the rebels with weapons sent by the US government ...
notes: Confusing political-adventurous mess.

title: Il fantasma di Corleone
description: Is it possible that a man (Bernardo Provenzano) has managed to live hidden on an island for 42 years, hunted down by hundreds of policemen and continues to be the supreme leader of the Cosa Nostra? The disturbing question is posed in rhetorical form by the authors Andrea Purgatori and Marco Amenta, with the latter at the helm of directing.
notes: Interesting and educational docu-fiction, which, not surprisingly, boasts the active collaboration of the Free Association of Don Luigi Ciotti among its credits. The delirium is all Pirandello and the land is that of mysteries and volcanoes.

title: A Wrinkle in Time
actors: Katie Stuart, David Dorfman, Gregory Smith, Kate Nelligan, Alfre Woodard, Alison Elliott
description: Meg and Charles set out in search of their father, who disappeared during an experiment he was working on for the government. Calvin and three extravagant ladies named Which, Who and Whatsit help them. The sextet is involved in an expedition that will reserve amazing adventures ...

title: Camouflage
actors: Lochlyn Munro, Leslie Nielsen, Vanessa Angel, William Forsythe
description: Aspiring actor Marty is going through a rather complicated time: his girlfriend dumped him, he was evicted from his apartment and mistreated by his agent. Hoping to make some money, he relies on investigator Jack Potter who will have to look for enough evidence to sue his agent. But due to a series of fortuitous circumstances, Marty finds himself working as a detective and following a case of "business as usual": going to Oregon to watch the wife of a jealous client. Poor Marty will find himself in a rather complicated situation from which he will have a hard time extricating himself.
notes: Entertainment action comedy.

title: Zathura: a Space Adventure
actors: Tim Robbins, Dax Shepard, Jonah Bobo, Kristen Stewart, Josh Hutcherson
description: Danny and his brother Walter discover the box of a game called "Zathura" in the cellar: but as soon as they start playing, the entire house is projected into space. Unable to return, they must continue the game, putting aside any rivalry and facing unexpected encounters and spectacular tests together ...
notes: An intelligent family comedy, which Favreau based on a good book by Chris Van Allsburg (scripted, among others, by David Koepp). The special effects reconstruct the Hollywood science fiction of the 60s in the service of a tale of brotherly affection, never cloying, inspired by the best Spielbergian pedagogy.

title: Terkel i knibe
directors: K. Vestbjerg Andersen, T. Christoffersen, S. Fjeldmark
description: Terkel is a middle school boy with a rather complicated life. In the family, things are not going so well: his sister makes him suffer and his uncle is a drunkard. Furthermore, Terkel is somehow responsible for the suicide of a classmate, Doris, who was in love with him. Things get even more complicated when Terkel begins receiving death threats. Only the new teacher is a point of reference and thank goodness, because a rather animated class trip is looming on the horizon ...
notes: Elio delle Storie Tese also maintains that Terkel is not really a “children's film”, who is involved in the film as the author of the soundtrack but also as the Italian voice of the narrator. The Simpsons and South Park have certainly paved the way and served as a model: here the gaze is darker, there are no half-words or cautions, but the attraction for horror does not prevent very ironic outcomes; the language is mimetic, the technique is captivating: the operation seems not scandalous but more than legitimate.

title: Le grand voyage
actors: Nicolas Cazalé, Mohamed Majd, Jacky Nercessian, Kamel Belghazi
description: Mustapha, an elderly Moroccan living in France, asks his son Réda to accompany him on the ritual journey to Mecca that every Muslim must make at least once in their life. The two set off together by car for a journey of 5000 km which will represent for them the opportunity for a confrontation that had been missed until then.
notes: Ismaël Ferroukhi's film, awarded by Luigi De Laurentiis as a first work in Venice in 2004, has the simple and classic structure of an intergenerational road movie and two extraordinary performers, Nicolas Cazale and Mohamed Majd. Ferroukhi's screenplay exalts the differences between the two travelers through silences, leaving the viewer the space and the way to reflect. It is not cheap.

title: The World's Fastest Indian
actors: Anthony Hopkins, Diane Ladd, Jessica Cauffiel, Paul Rodriguez
description: New Zealand, 1960s: Now that he is retired, Burt Munro dedicates all his passion to tuning his old 1920 Indian motorcycle. His dream is to attend Speed ??Week in Salt Lake, Utah, to race on the legendary Bonneville track. Against all odds and against all difficulties, he will be able to board a ship, with 2000 dollars in his pocket and a battered heart in his chest ...
notes: An old-fashioned "road movie" that begins with a hymn to the gods of speed and gently unwinds to its happy ending, from New Zealand beaches to the white expanses of Bonneville. Classic to the core.

title: Onde
actors: Filippo Timi, Ignazio Oliva, Anita Caprioli, Marina Remi
description: Francesca is a girl who has a conspicuous purple birthmark on her face that lives as a disfiguring defect. But one day, at the Aquarium of Genoa, he meets Luca, a young musician who has recently become blind. Even for him, now forced to inhabit a world made only of sounds, blindness prevents a peaceful relationship with others. From the meeting between the two, however, an acquaintance is born destined to lead to the construction of an intimate and secret world that will lead to an overwhelming love story.
notes: Fei's direction is ethically mirroring the contents of the script written together with Pierre Nosari with Federica Masin. Anita Caprioli literally experiences first-hand the difficulty of normality understood as the search for oneself, for healthily unstable balances. And Ignazio Oliva supports her step.

title: Fear of the Dark
actors: Kevin Zegers, Jesse James, Linda Purl, Rachel Skarsten, Charles Powell
description: Twelve-year-old Ryan Billings was diagnosed with acute dark phobia. For this reason the boy spends all his nights without sleeping, attentive to any shadow or noise, convinced that he can be attacked by horrible beings. These fears of his are underestimated by his family members who, despite the doctors' diagnosis, are unwilling to believe that someone could enter the house to attack him. So much so that one evening his parents decide to go out for dinner, leaving him at home with his brother Mark. Things are fine as long as a long storm catches them and the power goes out.
notes: The film starts quietly and then increases the tension by the minute.

title: Gorod Zero
actors: Leonid Filatov, Oleg Basilashvili, Vladimir Menshov, Armen Dzhigarkhanyan

title: Io sono mia
actors: Stefania Sandrelli, Maria Schneider, Michele Placido, Anton Diffring

title: L'eroe sono io
actors: Renato Rascel, Delia Scala, Marisa Merlini, Geppa, Enzo Biliotti
description: Righetto is an ice cream seller and has a small stature complex. To impress Silvia, he pretends to be a photo novel actor.

title: Gli assassini sono nostri ospiti
actors: Anthony Steffen, Margaret Lee, Livia Cerini, Giuseppe Castellano

title: La revanche des mortes vivantes
actors: Kathryn Charly, Anthea Wyler, Veronik Gathy, Sylvie Noak

title: Proshu slova
actors: Inna Churikova, Nikolaj Gubenko, Katya Volkova
description: A son dies in Lizaveta Uvarova, president of a provincial Soviet: the private dimension thus dramatically overlaps the cadences and commitments of public life ...
notes: Three years before _Thema_ - his best known film, also distributed in Italy - Panfilov shoots one of his major works.

title: Choke
actors: Dennis Hopper, Chelsy Reynolds, Roy Tate, Michael Madsen
description: Henry, an honest businessman, discovers that his daughter killed a man investing him with his car. Ron is a shady figure who tries to convince him to participate in an illegal transaction. Of course Henry refuses the proposal, but he doesn't know that Ron is able to blackmail him because he has witnessed the investment.
notes: All too conventional.

title: Sen no Rikyu
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Eiji Okuda, Kinnosuke Nakamura, Go Kato

title: Let's Do It Again
actors: Sidney Poitier, Bill Cosby, Calvin Lockhart, John Amos, Ossie Davis
description: Clyde Williams and Billy Foster are a pair of blue-collar workers who have promised to raise funds for the fraternity they are part of. Their methods, however, also include that of participating, altering the result, in a boxing match in New Orleans: hypnotizing the supposed loser they transform him into a kind of maddened beast and betting heavily on victory they return to Atlanta with the money. For the fraternity. Too bad that the gangsters of New Orleans after realizing what happened, show up in Atlanta rather angry and ask for the money they won back. There is no other option but to try the coup again in the same way, at another meeting.

title: The Fog
actors: Tom Welling, Selma Blair, DeRay Davis, Kenneth Welsh, Maggie Grace
description: A secluded town on the northern coast of California is shrouded in thick mist rising from the sea: ghosts of a bloodstained past are hiding, now seeking revenge ...
notes: In this remake of Carpenter's film, everything unravels smoothly, with no connection between the facts: zero tension, tautological and involuntarily self-suggestive dialogues (catchphrase: "What's going on?" "I don't know !!!"), none of the performers (including _Smallville_'s Superman, and a black actor inevitably reduced to speck) has a shred of credibility. And even the computer fog is less effective than the original one.

title: Happy Hour oder Glück und Glas
actors: Martina Gedeck, Heio von Stetten, Monica Bleibtreu, Petra Berndt
description: Greta is not the kind of person who gives in to impulses. Now, at 37, she has achieved excellent social status, patiently building a successful career as a travel agent despite still living with an alcoholic mother who doesn't make life very easy for her. Greta is in love with Simon, the owner of a bar, Happy Hour. The young man represents everything a girl could wish for: he is attractive, sensitive, intelligent, attentive ... Greta, however, does not know that in the past of the man she loves there is a dark side that she will soon discover ...

title: Sex & Philosophy
actors: Daler Nazarov, Mariam Gaibova, Farzana Beknazarov, Tahmineh Ebrahimova, Malohat Abdulloeva
description: John turns fifty: in the throes of a midlife crisis, he decides to unmask his lies and to invite his four lovers, who until then lived without each other's knowledge. Faced with the truth, women relive their love story, while John shares his reflections on the meaning of existence, on the inevitability of time, on passion. But a nemesis is lurking: invited to the home of one of them, the man will experience firsthand the situation he had created ...
notes: Loneliness and illusions, crossed by the common thread of a chronometer that collects the moments of happiness experienced, and marked by the protagonist's monologue.

title: Just Like Heaven
actors: Reese Witherspoon, Mark Ruffalo, Donal Logue, Dina Waters
description: Elizabeth is a young doctor, absorbed in her work and practically devoid of a love life: involved in a terrible car accident, she dies and finds herself suspended in an intermediate state. Meanwhile, his house - now empty - is rented by a lonely young architect who has the destiny of being the only one to see the spirit of Elizabeth, with whom he weaves a relationship ...
notes: The new Hollywood "do-goodness" weighs down even the best of brilliant intentions. The "politically correct" discontent both those who would like a serious treatment of certain themes, and those who consider lightness a founding gift of comedy.

title: The Wild
description: In the footsteps of Madagascar, here is a new animation story dedicated to the animals of a zoo. This time the protagonist is Ryan, a young lion who is mistakenly transferred from the New York zoo to an African zoo. It will be his companions, after a mass escape, to unite, overcoming the differences, to be able to bring Ryan back home.
notes: At home Disney resists the self-defeating belief of using contemporary pop in an excessively emotional function. And the insistence on wanting to repaint a dated conception of stories with modernity. A film that carries a healthy "message" ("it is what you have inside that determines who you are") but terribly out of time.

title: Ti lascio perché ti amo troppo
actors: Alessandro Siani, Mariana Braga, Francesco Albanese (II), Maria Mazza
description: Since Daniela left him, Mariano no longer lives. In vain, friends try to introduce him to new girls. One day, quite by chance, however, Ana Paula, a beautiful Brazilian girl, enters his life.
notes: The film is light, a little theater filmed in the manner of Salemme. However, if we are indulgent it is for the freshness of the performers, starting with Alessandro Siani, who approaches with modesty the humor of Massimo Troisi without being sacrilegious. With actors like him, and like others, especially from Campania and Puglia, who rage in "regional" cinema, it would be necessary to reckon, because they are interpreters of a popular art that is more alive than ever.

title: ...e se domani
actors: Luca Bizzarri, Paolo Kessisoglu, Luigi Maria Burruano, Sabrina Impacciatore
description: Mimì, to help the woman he loves and who would like to open a boutique, unable to get a loan, decides to organize a bank robbery. Things do not go in the desired way and Mimì finds himself locked in the bank with hostages. To try to help him out of this situation will be Matteo (a lawyer), who has always been his best friend, who knows the background of his gesture.
notes: The intent would be the grotesque comedy, but the shyness of the television soul that pervades the operation prevents the tones from showing up in their ferocious faces. The interpreters were good (especially Sabrina Impacciatore) and the direction was willing.

title: Keeping Mum
actors: Rowan Atkinson, Kristin Scott Thomas, Maggie Smith, Patrick Swayze
description: Walter Goodfellow is the vicar of a small English village and is so obsessed with the idea of ??writing the perfect sermon that he does not realize that the harmony in his family is literally falling apart: the 17-year-old daughter Holly frequents a series of bad boys, the son Petey skips school because he is tormented by bullies and his neglected wife Gloria devotes herself a little too much to the private lessons of the golf master ... To restore order in the family will be the arrival of Grace, the new handyman woman, the whose behavior is somewhat reminiscent of Mary Poppins, albeit with several dark and mysterious sides.
notes: The premises bode well: a cynical black comedy, marked by the all-English love for the "eccentricities" that lie beneath the rural quiet, a great cast, dominated by a Maggie Smith on the tip of a pen and supported by Kristin Scott Thomas and Rowan Atkinson in two roles not unlike those who cast them in Four Weddings and a Funeral. Unfortunately, the mixture does not work, flattened by a school direction and script, which never reach either the mockery or the real nastiness. Little more than an "old England" postcard.

title: Running Scared
actors: Paul Walker, Cameron Bright, Vera Farmiga, Karem Roden, Johnny Messner
description: Joey is a "little fish": his role is to make the weapons used for the murders disappear. Only instead of throwing them into the river, as he should, he hides them in the cellar. Things get complicated when a gun, used to kill a policeman, ends up in the hands of the neighbor's son, just ten years old, who uses it against his stepfather. He happened to be the grandson of a Russian boss connected to Joey's gang, who is now in real trouble ...
notes: It was hoped that the era of Tarantino's followers was over forever: but no, unfortunately. If trash, in its most correct definition, is a vulgar imitation, here we are at its quintessence.

title: Boulevard
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Monique Brienne, Magali Noël, Pierre Mondy

title: An American Rhapsody
actors: Scarlett Johansson, Nastassja Kinski, Raffaella Bánsági, Tony Goldwyn, Ágnes Bánfalvy, Zoltán Seress, Klaudia Szabó, Zsolt Zágoni, András Szöke, Erszi Pásztor
description: In 1950, a Hungarian couple, Peter and Margit, decide to leave the country oppressed by the communist regime to emigrate to the United States. They leave with their eldest daughter, Maria, but are forced to leave the newborn Suzanne at home, entrusting her to a couple of loving guardians. Six years later, the little girl is reunited with her parents in Los Angeles, where, due to the trauma suffered, she grows up developing a rebellious and insecure personality.
notes: Strongly autobiographical debut for the established publisher Éva Gárdos, in this immigration drama with a credible Scarlett Johanssen in the role of an ordinary teenager, locked up behind a wall of stubborn reserve and passive hostility.

title: The Angelic Conversation
actors: Dave Baby, Timothy Burke, Simon Costin, Christopher Hobbs

title: Un amore
actors: Rossano Brazzi, Agnès Spaak, Gérard Blain, Marisa Merlini

title: L'avventura di un italiano in Cina
actors: Rory Calhoun, Yoko Tani, Robert Hundar, Camillo Pilotto, Pierre Cressoy
description: Arriving in Beijing from Venice after an endless series of vicissitudes, Marco Polo falls out of favor with the sovereign's minister and is imprisoned. However, he will manage to escape and, once free, will join the ranks of the rebels ...
notes: The historical reconstruction is obviously implausible, but this China of fantasy is missing the sense of the marvelous that runs through _The million_. The plot then, despite the liberties taken with respect to the text, is rather weak. A little better the direction and above all the interpretation of Calhoun, who shows off a smug self-confidence. Some exterior sequences are taken from Lizzani's _The Chinese wall_.

title: Azumi
actors: Aya Ueto, Shun Oguri, Hiroki Narimiya, Kenji Kohashi, Takatoshi Kaneko
description: Azumi is a child who, orphaned of her mother, is adopted and saved by a teacher of the samurai technique, as well as general of the imperial army. After ten years of teaching Azumi, who has learned the techniques alongside nine men, goes on a mission to kill three powerful shoguns.
notes: The film is dominated by a strong sense of oppression.

title: Breakin' All the Rules
actors: Peter Mac Nicol, Jamie Foxx, Gabrielle Union, Bianca Lawson, Morris Chestnut
description: Quincy's life, the editorial director of some magazines, takes a bad and unexpected turn the day his girlfriend Helen announces that she wants to leave him, the day of their engagement party. Deeply depressed, Quincy begins to write a letter to Helen to explain his feelings, but analyzing his emotions, his notes take a different direction. So Quincy decides to write a book on how to "break up" without trauma. Then Nicky, his cousin Evan's girlfriend, comes in and makes him fall in love again.
notes: Daniel Taplitz returns to directing after seven years (_Commandments_) with an acceptable sentimental comedy.

title: Ice Age: The Meltdown
description: The ice age is about to end: when Diego, Manny and Sid realize that all the melted ice will pour into their valley, they look for a way to escape the flood and save the other animals ...
notes: Echoes of Noah's Ark and Tex Avery's flashes of wickedness, surreal digressions in the Busby Berkeley musical and a rare balancing act poised on a pile of falling peaks: everything mixes in the emigration of the bizarre, multi-ethnic "family". More fun than the first, with a narrative that is a pure pretext, as it happened in the Warner cartoons of the golden age.

title: Elementarteilchen
actors: Moritz Bleibtreu, Christian Ulmen, Martina Gedeck, Franka Potente, Nina Hoss
description: Bruno and Michael are two very different brothers: the first is obsessed with women, while the second is completely absorbed in his work (he is a molecular biologist) and seems totally disinterested in sex. Then, one day, they both meet love, but the two women become seriously ill ...
notes: Silver Bear in Berlin and based on a novel by Michel Houellebecq, the film does not go beyond the scholastic transposition of a literary text. The malaise of the French writer is completely lacking; and if the narrative track as such is treated with respect and balance (also thanks to the good protagonists), it is the "background" that disappoints.

title: Mater Natura
actors: Maria Pia Calzone, Valerio Foglia Manzillo, Enzo Moscato, Vladimir Luxuria
description: Desiderio is a young transsexual who, with his friends, is trying to stage a show entirely acted by transsexuals. When she meets Andrea, a splendid boy with whom she establishes a deep feeling, she stops prostituting herself: but Andrea is about to get married, and the discovery of this harsh reality throws Desiderio into despair ...
notes: Between Fassbinder, Schroeter and - above all - Piscicelli, Andrei's film makes fun with sparkling dialogues and a colorful staging of the discomfort of those who are not afraid to face their feelings and define themselves as "irregular women" or "metropolitan disasters".

title: Who Slew Auntie Roo?
actors: Shelley Winters, Mark Lester, Ralph Richardson
description: A mentally ill widow, after losing her daughter in an accident, lures a young orphan into her home.
notes: Updated version and turned to horror of the fairy tale Hansel and Gretel, the film never manages to strike terror: the protagonist herself is ridiculous and not disturbing as it should.

title: Il regista di matrimoni
actors: Sergio Castellitto, Donatella Finocchiaro, Sami Frey, Gianni Cavina, Maurizio Donadoni, Ludovico Caldarera
description: Franco Elica, a director by profession, goes into crisis when his daughter marries a fervent Catholic and is asked to shoot yet another version of the _Promessi sposi_. He then decides to leave, in search of inspiration, for Sicily: here he meets Prince Gravina di Palagonia, a penniless noble who asks him to shoot for the wedding of his daughter Bona. Franco immediately falls in love with the girl and does everything he can to make sure this wedding doesn't get busy ...
notes: Between the serious and the facetious, Bellocchio stages a sort of "tragedy of ridiculous men", not without polemical thrusts and immersed in a dreamlike and surreal suspension.

title: Scary Movie 4
actors: Leslie Nielsen, Carmen Electra , Anna Faris, Regina Hall, Conchita Campbell, Andre Benjamin
description: Cindy Campbell has to take care of an old lady in the left "Grudge House". The girl discovers that the house is haunted by the ghost of a child. Meanwhile, she falls in love with Tom Ryan, her neighbor, who alone takes care of her children. But the world is attacked by Tr-iPods, giants who destroy everything in their path. Tom escapes with his children and ends up in a mysterious village where time seems to have stopped a hundred years ago ...
notes: The structure is well known: sexual and scatological comedy, over the top acting, ironic cameos, references to politics and show business. Despite everything it still works.

title: Rent
actors: Anthony Rapp, Adam Pascal, Rosario Dawson, Jesse L. Martin, Wilson Jermaine Heredia
description: New York, East Village. Mark and Roger live in the same apartment. While Roger is disillusioned and cynical, Mark is full of life and wants to make a film about their existence, love, loss and AIDS.
notes: The grainy images of this film in the film are the most vital and interesting thing about _Rent_, the acclaimed Broadway musical inspired by Puccini's _Bohème_, brought to the screen today by Chris Columbus: 135 minutes of boredom. Slow, static (there is no need for many environments to "move" a musical, as Chicago demonstrates), never completely melodramatic, never metropolitan, with very pale tributes to _West Side Story_ and insistent echoes (in the musical column) of _Bohème_, _Rent_ not only is it not a cinematic reworking of Jonathan Larson's work, but it does not even reach good filmed theater. Bravo Anthony Rapp and Tracie Thoms (who play the best number of the film, Maureen Tango) and Idina Menzel. Apart from Rosario Dawson, Mimì unlikely, at best only in the number of the lap dance.

title: Wild Things: Diamonds in the Rough
actors: Sarah Laine, Sandra McCoy, Linden Ashby, Ron Melendez, Claire Coffee
description: In Blue Bay Marie Clifton is about to inherit by the disappeared mother two splendid and precious diamonds renamed her mother and daughter, but her stepfather Jay holds the testament on the pretext that the goddaughter would not be ready to hold such a heavy responsibility.

title: Fiaba nera
actors: Giulietta De Bernardi, Cesar García Pérez de Leon, Antonella Boschetto
description: An angel appears in the life of a pregnant woman who wanders aimlessly through the streets of a gloomy and oppressive Turin.
notes: Enigmatic and disturbing work by the assistant director and son-in-law of Tonino De Bernardi. A rare example of avant-garde cinema that irritated and "amazed" the audience of the 23rd Torino Film Festival.

title: The Perez Family
actors: Marisa Tomei, Alfred Molina, Anjelica Huston, Chazz Palminteri
description: Juan Raúl Perez, a Cuban peasant, has been imprisoned for over twenty years in the Castro prisons of Havana as a political prisoner; organized an escape plan, he daringly flees to Florida in the hope of seeing his wife and daughter who are waiting for him. But a mistake by the US immigration office causes him to be assigned a former prostitute as his wife: Perez does not give up, and is determined to do everything to get things right ...
notes: The Indian Nair grapples with the Cuban question and directs a sufficiently brilliant film, which at times manages to entertain but not - as it would be intended - to make us reflect.

title: La mentale
actors: Samuel Le Bihan, Samy Naceri, Clotilde Courau, Marie Guillard
description: After serving a four-year sentence, Dris, a petty thug from the banlieu, decides to settle down with Lisa, a girl he met before his incarceration. But Yanis, an old friend who has achieved some fame in the world of evil, forces his hand and involves him in a robbery.
notes: Routine action movie.

title: Firewall
actors: Harrison Ford, Paul Bettany, Virginia Madsen, Carly Schroeder, Jimmy Bennett, Alan Arkin, Robert Patrick, Mary Lynn Rajskub, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Vince Vieluf, Kett Turton, Vincent Gale
description: Jack Stanfield, a computer systems specialist responsible for cybersecurity at a large bank, is blackmailed by a thug who, after stalking him for a year, holds his family hostage. To free his loved ones he will have to be able to penetrate the system that he himself has set up, in a real race against time.
notes: It's as if old Harry (64 years old on July 13th) had never gotten off Air Force One: perhaps out of fear of some other September 11th, perhaps because he was aware of his inexorable avenue of sunset (at least for those roles that were fine until about ten years ago). Among other things, bewildered and lost, he even recently turned down the part in Syriana thanks to which George Clooney won the Oscar and, of course, thanks. As for _Firewall - Access Denied_, what about? He is the character you expect and that Spike Lee (for example) has been careful to include in his latest heist film Inside Man. Here the theft is mainly against the audience. At least the (more) demanding ones.

title: Take the Lead
actors: Antonio Banderas, Rob Brown, Yaya DaCosta, Alfre Woodard. Laura Benanti
description: The story is based on a real story of a professional dancer who decides to volunteer to teach dance in a special school that hosts a group of socially maladjusted teen-agers with various problems with justice. After the first resistances the boys start, then they get excited until they help create a new dance form that mixes classical ballet and "street" styles.
notes: The highest reference is _They will be famous_ (the show), the dialogues could very well be replaced by silent movie captions, they are so stereotyped. "Only" the dance sequences are saved (and how could it be otherwise, given that Friedlander shoots video clips for pop stars?) And the chutzpah of Banderas. A man for all figures.

title: In ascolto. The Listening
actors: Maya Sansa, Michael Parks, Andrea Tidona, James Parks
description: A thirty-year-old Roman woman accidentally finds a briefcase destined to upset her existence. Inside there are in fact some secret documents concerning the system called Tumbleweed, a very modern technological invention that allows you to carry out interceptions of all kinds. The woman is believed to be an industrial spy and her life is suddenly in danger.
notes: Beautiful face of the protagonist, Michael Parks, Tarantinian face; and functional experience of Tidona. Maya Sansa is always more beautiful but here it seems to have happened by chance. Also because of a screenplay that limps, filled with gaps, which does little work on the characters.

title: Le dernier trappeur
actors: Norman Winther, May Loo, Alex Van Bibber, Ken Bolton, Denny Denison
description: In the Yukon Mountains, the life of one of the last hunters, Norman Winther, and his wife, Nebaska, an Indian Nahanni. A documentary film about an existence now as rare as a diamond and the severe and spectacular nature of the Rocky Mountains.
notes: A film made in wonderful exteriors and in more than extreme production conditions, at temperatures even below fifty degrees. Not only for the crew but also for Winther and his wetsuit, for which, among other things, it can happen to slip in the running in the icy water and have to pull out. A timeless figure, which echoes a western spirit, with essential simplicity. A story, true and incomparably adventurous, unfortunately diminished by the director's excessively didactic approach, by an emphatic soundtrack and a narrative voice bordering on the obvious. The paradoxical underlying ecological assumption can be fully shared: to save the planet, man would have had to stop being a parasite and return a little more hunter.

title: Adams æbler
actors: Ulrich Thomsen, Nicolas Bro, Tomas Villum Jensen, Ali Kazim, Nikolaj Lie Kaas, Gyrd Løfqvist, Mads Mikkelsen
description: A young neo-Nazi, Adam, is imposed a social service: helping the local parish priest. Among the tasks that are entrusted to Adam is that of preparing an apple pie made with the fruits of the tree in front of the church. But fate seems to be raging against Adam, who encounters all kinds of difficulties on his way.
notes: The really successful thing about the film is the point of view: if the world around us is totally surreal, the first to be amazed - and we with him - is Adam, played great by Ulrich Thomsen (_Festen_). Succeeding through madness to bring back to reality a guy who goes around with Hitler's holy card seems to us the most diabolical of retaliation.

title: Two for the Money
actors: Al Pacino, Matthew McConaughey, Rene Russo, Armand Assante, Jeremy Piven, Jaime King
description: Brandon Lang, a young former football star forced to retire from a disabling injury, has a great gift: he gets the match predictions very easily. He is thus spotted by Walter Abrams, shark of the betting world, who makes him his protégé ...
notes: Starting with a series of impressive real-world data, the film enjoys throwing Pacino across the fence from Stone's _Every cursed Sunday_. Nothing that hasn't been seen before, but don't get bored. Also because, as Abrams would say, "put your ear to the door ... Can you hear it? It's the noise of possibilities".

title: Ask the Dust
actors: Colin Farrell, Salma Hayek, Donald Sutherland, Eileen Atkins, Idina Menzel, Justin Kirk
description: In the Los Angeles of the Great Depression, Arturo Bandini, a young aspiring Italian-American writer, makes ends meet hoping to emerge. In a bar he meets a provocative Mexican waitress with whom he begins a passionate and contrasted relationship, also due to the specter of social exclusion - which hovers over both of them - and to the different vision that the two have of their own redemption. From the novel of the same name by John Fante.
notes: Among the folds of the Hotel Alta Long, there is even a yellowed projection of the mad Homer Simpson: Donald Sutherland in the shadow of his character from _Day of the Locust_. But in _ Ask the dust_ everything is yellowed, or rather "sepia", worn out, already seen, passed through the meat grinder of iconographic abuse. Studded with highly improbable dialogues, weighed down by the tireless (and literary) voice off of the protagonist Bandini, asleep by the always soft photography, it is also interpreted by the most inexpressive actor of the moment (Colin Farrell) and by the no more than decorative Salma Hayek. A great screenwriter (Towne has written _Chinatown_ and _L'ultimo corvée_, among others, may not necessarily be a good director.

title: The Squid and the Whale
actors: Jeff Daniels, Laura Linney, Anna Paquin, Owen Kline, Jesse Eisenberg
description: The Berkmans are an eccentric New York family. His father Bernard has a past as a writer but currently teaches, while his mother Joan discovers that she also has a talent for writing, causing her husband's envy and jealousy and throwing the two children into tension. To complicate matters, it is the affairs of the heart: Bernard falls in love with a young student, Joan with his son's tennis teacher ...
notes: Excellent use of the actors (as usual, senselessly dubbed), the relationships between the characters are shown with sufficient ambiguity, without judging, poised between participation and antipathy, as in a minimal and softened Solondz.

title: I, a Man
actors: Tom Baker, Nico, Bettina Coffin, Valerie Solanis, Ingrid Superstar
description: Tom Baker is a blond bisexual who meets six women in one day. With some he has sex, with some he talks, with some he fights ...
notes: Andy Wharol's voyeuristic gaze greets the exploits of his fetish actor Tom Baker as he wanders, the only man in a female cast, among the bodies of the co-stars. The title, on the other hand, is a parody of _I, a women_, a Swedish red light film, then in vogue in New York. Wharol and Morrisey lead the viewer to confront their own taboos, creating a short circuit between the untold and the shown. Legend has it that the part was accepted by Jim Morrison. It was the Doors manager, worried, who convinced him to decline.

title: Sound Barrier
actors: Charlie Wilson
description: Obsessed with the secret surrounding his mother's death, Jesse - 11 years old and deaf and dumb - now hopes to be able to solve it with a letter and a key to a warehouse. From Manhattan, Jesse then leaves for Queens, but ...
notes: Second chapter of the "sound trilogy" shot by the Iranian director transplanted to New York.

title: Die Höhle des gelben Hundes
actors: Babbayar Batchuluun, Nansal Batchuluun, Nansalmaa Batchuluun
description: In the boundless spaces of the Mongolian landscape, a nomadic family lives off sheep farming, in full harmony with nature. During one of her walks, her seven-year-old daughter Nansa finds a small dog in a cave which she gives the name Zochor. But one day the little dog disappears ...
notes: An exotic and primitive context that becomes a metaphor for a condition of the spirit. Not for everyone: neither at the production level (it was shot by a German troupe literally encamped in a remote village not far from the protagonists' tent) nor spectatorial: pictorial insistence on the beauty of faces and landscapes of the steppe, narrative thinness far beyond the limits of essential.

title: The Riverman
actors: Kathleen Quinlan, Cary Elwes, Sarah Manninen, Bruce Greenwood, Sam Jaeger, Cary Elwes, Sarah Manninen, Kathleen Quinlan
description: Robert Keppel, a retired criminal psychologist, is called by the police to try to solve a series of murders perpetrated in Seattle and referred to by the local press as "The Green River Murders" because the bodies were abandoned in the waters or on the banks of that river. Keppel is contacted by an old opponent of his, serial killer Ted Bundy - incarcerated in Florida and soon to pay for his crimes with his life - who wants to help him solve the murders by providing an analysis of the multiple murderer.
notes: Good tension in this thriller by Bill Eagles (_Beautiful Creatures_).

title: Memorîzu
directors: Katsuhiro Otomo, Tensai Okamura, Kôji Morimoto

title: Time Bandits
actors: Craig Warnock, John Cleese, Sean Connery, Ian Holm, Ralph Richardson, David Warner
description: Kevin is an eleven-year-old boy who enjoys fantastic readings to overcome the boredom of the endless evenings spent next to his parents, fans of television and household appliances. One night he sees six dwarfs come out of the closet who possess the plant of time with some holes, through which it is possible to pass from one era to another in history. The Supreme Being made the world in six days and neglected some refinements, such as the famous holes, which allow the six dwarves to steal in one era and eclipse themselves in another. And just during one of their escapes they swoop into Kevin's room taking him with them as a companion in adventures and robberies over the centuries.

title: Vermisàt
actors: Carlo Cabrini, Maria Monti, Antonio Bessato, Giancarlo Badessi

title: La doublure
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Gad Elmaleh, Kristin Scott Thomas, Virginie Ledoyen, Alice Taglioni, Richard Berry, Dany Boon, Karl Lagerfeld
description: Billionaire Pierre Lavasseur risks being framed by a photo that reveals his extramarital affair with a famous model. The only solution for him is to deny everything, explaining that the girl, in reality, was in the company of another man who appears in the photo: to make the story credible, however, he must make sure that the two really date. ..
notes: A puny little film that has the merit of brevity and the merit of not taking itself seriously. And that gives three or four really funny moments. A praise to the "character actors" Richard Berry, Kristin Scott Thomas, Dany Boon and Michel Aumont. The opening titles are original.

title: Mission: Impossible III
actors: Tom Cruise, Michelle Monaghan, Ving Rhames, Keri Russell, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Laurence Fishburne, Maggie Q, Billy Crudup, Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Simon Pegg, Eddie Marsan, Bahar Soomekh
description: Ethan Hunt, about to marry Julia, has decided to retire from the IMF operations team to devote himself exclusively to training new agents. However, he agrees to go on a mission to Berlin to recover agent Lindsay, who had been a valid student of his. It is the beginning of a series of events that will see him forced to risk everything he holds dear in the fight against Owen Davian, an extremely dangerous arms dealer, in league with deviant apparatuses of the IMF itself.
notes: At each location - from Rome to the Vatican (rebuilt in the Royal Palace of Caserta), from Shanghai to Berlin - there is at least one exciting action. But it is the "intrinsic" emotion that is missing, and the third installment of the saga (more and more to 007, but without the reiterated details and humor that created "bondmania") ends up being a collage of spectacular sequences. The adrenaline always at its maximum makes you calm down.

title: Barrio
actors: Críspulo Cabezas, Timy Benito, Marieta Orozco, Alicia Sánchez, Eloi Yebra, Marieta Orozco, Alicia Sánchez, Enrique Villén, Francisco Algora, Chete Lera, Claude Pascadel, Pedro Miguel Martínez
description: Rai, Javi and Manu are three boys who live on the outskirts of Madrid, in a rundown neighborhood from which they dream of being able to leave. All three, in addition to having to fight with the usual problems of adolescents, come from disadvantaged families and, to raise some money, they decide to try to make do. Everything is fine: selling stolen flowers or delivering pizzas to your door. But Rai - who is somewhat the leader of the trio - has a secret that he does not share with the other two and when it comes to the surface, his friends will also get involved.

title: Lost & Found
actors: Artie Lange, Neal MacMillan, Ever Carradine, Stephanie Chang, David Spade, Sophie Marceau, Artie Lange, Ever Carradine, Stephanie Chang, Neal MacMillan
description: Lila is a refined and romantic French girl, without a boyfriend, but with a terrier to keep her company. Dylan, on the other hand, is the classic boy next door that a woman like Lila has never known her. Dylan, to impress her, plans to kidnap the beast and then find it again. Her plan would be perfect, if her ex-boyfriend didn't get involved, who decides to join the treasure hunt too ...
notes: David Spade (formerly _Saturday Night Live_), orphan of Chris Farley who died two years earlier, is joined by Artie Lange. But the new couple is not working properly. To give her face to the beautiful Frenchwoman is Sophie Marceau on an American trip.

title: The Bride Walks Out
actors: Ned Sparks, Robert Young, Barbara Stanwyck, Gene Raymond, Robert Young, Ned Sparks
description: Carolyn and Michael decide to start a house together. But there is one point on which Michael does not want to hear reasons: Carolyn has to quit her job. But when she realizes that it's not easy to make ends meet with just one salary, she looks for another job without her husband's knowledge ...
notes: Discreet and lively "conjugal" comedy.

title: Piccoli fuochi
actors: Dino Jaksic, Valeria Golino, Carlotta Wittig, Mario Garriba, Ulisse Minervini, Daniela Giordano (I)

title: First Daughter
actors: Katie Holmes, Marc Blucas, Amerie Rogers, Michael Keaton
description: Her parents are the free world leader, the president of the United States and his First Lady, which causes Sam to have a lot of trouble in college, where everyone believes she is just a spoiled little girl. She will be able to prove the contrary and will come to befriend Mia, who had welcomed her by showing off a great temper.
notes: It should have been a sort of modern fairy tale, moreover interpreted by the idol of American teenagers Hilary Duff (not that this would have been an added value) but the script is unsavable. Disturbing that a thoroughbred actor like Forest Whitaker is behind the camera.

title: Padre Pio
description: The life of Padre Pio, from childhood to Pietrelcina, to the priesthood, to the stigmata up to life in the convent of San Giovanni Rotondo.
notes: Distributed by Rudolph Genti and Marco Dell'Utri's Moviemax (that of _Donnie Darko_ and _terkel in Troble_) produced by the TV world of the choregist Corradi, pioneer in imposing Japanese cardboard in Europe, is an unconventional hybridization of overtaking and catechesis technique and catechesis For the use and consumption of religion teachers (there is also a cameo of Wojtyla, here bishop of Krakow, on which a similar biography is coming on Mother Teresa). Phrases made, Christianity from Santino, all superficial, obsolete animation. _Marcellino bread and wine_ was more honest and compared it seems bergman.

title: Sangue - La morte non esiste
actors: Elio Germano, Emanuela Barilozzi, Luca Lionello, Libero De Rienzo
description: Stella wants to go away, away from her father and away from the pain of her mother's death. Iuri, his elder brother, has a very intense relationship with Stella with whom he is deeply and unhappily in love. The father is unaware of everything just as Iuri is unaware of Stella's escape plan ...
notes: Ambitious, presumptuous, carnal, rigorously low budget, the son of a corrosive imagination, which (is) consumed in the instant in which it is done and shown: Libero De Rienzo's first work looks a lot like Libero De Rienzo, a nervous rhapsodic, who works little but intensely, _Santa Maradona_ and _A / R round trip_ with Ponti and Catherine Breillat (_To my sister! _), naive and cheeky, mature and adolescent. A personality, and a cinema that is about to be born, of contrasts and contrasts, of punches and caresses, of disappearances and illuminations.

title: Yours, Mine and Ours
actors: Dennis Quaid, Rene Russo, Sean Faris, Katija Pevec, Dean Collins
description: Frank and Helen, both widowed, reunite after 30 years and discover they love each other as in their youth. They would like to get married but have to deal with their 18 children who do not look favorably on a possible expansion of the family ...
notes: If the plot reminds you of anything, it is because about forty years ago in Melville Shavelson's _Appointment under the bed_ it was Henry Fonda and Lucille Ball's turn to face the same situation, inspired by a true story. In this ultra-classic and conservative family comedy, the screenwriters also draw a little from Shavelson's _Un husband for Cinzia_. The only updates are in the fact that now to know something about the person we like we type his name on Google and that even the former flower daughters cry on the ending of _Official and gentleman_. Quaid and Russo (who never get angry !!!) work well, harmless plastic figurines on computer-reconstructed skies and seas, replicants of a cinema that is now impractical and, one wonders, for which families.

title: Promised Land
actors: Pamela Gordon, Chad Smith, Lalaine, Ruth Gerson, Giuseppe Cederna
description: Ethan Wildwood is a failed actor who is commissioned by a documentary producer friend to tour the American provinces in search of real life stories. Ethan runs into Vicki, a singer whose daughter Mary Jane was kidnapped ten years earlier, and decides to deal with her story.

title: Pendulum
directors: James D. Deck, James D. Deck
actors: Stephanie Vogt, Matt Battaglia, Alaina Kalanj, Rachel Hunter, James Russo, Matt Battaglia, Alaina Kalanj, Stephanie Vogt
description: Dallas: Officer Amanda Reeve is hired to deal with the murder of a law professor. During his investigation, he discovers that in all probability the victim was asking for sexual services from the students in exchange for promotion: shortly thereafter, however, the tracks begin to intertwine and become terribly complicated ...

title: Fando y Lis
actors: Sergio Klainer, Diana Mariscal, María Teresa Rivas, Tamara Garina

title: The Devil's Rejects
actors: Sid Haig, Bill Moseley, Sheri Moon Zombie, William Forsythe, Ken Foree, Matthew McGrory, Leslie Easterbrook, Geoffrey Lewis, Priscilla Barnes, Dave Sheridan, Kate Norby, Lew Temple, Danny Trejo, Michael Berryman, P.J. Soles, Deborah Van Valkenburgh, Mary Woronov, Daniel Roebuck
description: Baby and Otis Firefly are trapped in their secluded home, surrounded by Sheriff Wydell and his men. The brothers wait for the right moment to meet their father, Captain Spaulding, and when they decide to come out they kill anyone in their path ...
notes: It goes without saying that there are no "good guys" in this story, since they all participate in the same slaughterhouse. However, their riding on the wastelands of the James Lee Burke (Texan vein) and the Cormac McCarthy is epic; or in silence towards death as in Sam Peckinpah. With the addition of a gothic-fairytale touch that contrasts with the western from the macabre side and stirs the ghosts of the world of Oz, as evidenced by that spastic little tin man who at first stirs under the bullets of the cavalry. Backed by a good mix of irony and desperation, the film is exceptional but of course it should only be recommended for those who have a little hair on their stomach. Refrain from candid souls.

title: Stestí
actors: Pavel Liska, Tatiana Vilhelmová, Anna Geislerová, Marek Daniel, Bolek Polívka
description: Monika, Tonik and Dasha have known each other since childhood. Monika hopes that her boyfriend, who has left for America, invites her to join him. Tonik has gone to live with his aunt and together they fight to defend their farm from advancing industries. Dasha has two children and a married and unemployed lover: when her depression worsens, the woman is hospitalized in a nursing home and her children are placed in the care of Monika ...

title: Big Momma's House 2
actors: Martin Lawrence, Cynthia LeBlanc, Nia Long, Emily Procter, Zachary Levi
description: Malcolm is on the trail of the creator of a very dangerous computer virus that allows access to documents and data owned by the government. To get closer to Tom Fuller, the creator of the virus, she puts on the shoes of the new nanny of the children: little Andrew and the two older sisters Carrie and Molly. Malcolm must then again resort to his alter ego Hattie Mae Pierce, aka Big Mama ...
notes: Martin Lawrence returns to take on the bulky role of Big Mama: fantastic make-up and unleashed histrionics of the protagonist in this second chapter, but the sentimentality prevails over the slightly demented comedy of the first and the result is too sugary.

title: Volver
actors: Penélope Cruz, Carmen Maura, Lola Dueñas, Blanca Portillo, Yohana Cobo, Chus Lampreave, Antonio de la Torre, Carlos Blanco, María Isabel Díaz
description: Raimunda covers the traces of the murder of her husband by her daughter Paula (who had been threatened by him), then decides to directly manage a restaurant with friends without men. Meanwhile, the spirit of the mother - who died years before in a fire - returns to phrases alive, generous with advice ...
notes: The gazes intertwine on the pitch / reverse, mothers and daughters talk to each other, sitting side by side on a bench, at night or at the set kitchen table. The windmills of La Mancha mark the returns to the country, a close-up fixes the tears in the eyes of Penélope Cruz or the awareness in those of Carmen Maura: Almodóvar now has the great simplicity of the classics.

title: The Da Vinci Code
actors: Tom Hanks, Audrey Tautou, Ian McKellen, Alfred Molina, Paul Bettany, Jean Reno
description: The night before the appointment with Professor Robert Langdon, the curator of the Louvre museum is murdered. Langdon becomes the main suspect, but with the help of Sophie Neveu he discovers clues that lead to a religious sect that has been hiding a terrible secret for two thousand years ...
notes: Hanks is not believed with that long hair on the neck, sloppy and badly washed, which is supposed to be "intellectual"; Reno is not believed to be an upright policeman; let alone believe in Tautou as "the last living descendant of Jesus Christ" ... The only ones that work are McKellen, Bettany and Molina: a little bit for the blockbuster of the year.

title: L'amico di famiglia
actors: Giacomo Rizzo, Laura Chiatti, Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Clara Bindi, Gigi Angelillo, Barbara Valmorin, Marco Giallini, Valentina Lodovini, Lucia Ragni, Antonella Salvucci
description: Geremia, a 60-year-old moneylender from a small town in the Agro Pontino, is unpleasant in appearance and character, but feels good and socially useful. He thinks he is saving the families he lends money to: but from the moment he agrees to "help" a couple who has to organize their daughter's wedding, his life will take an unexpected turn ...
notes: In a (sur) real, de Chirico and fascist scenario, Sorrentino sinks his story of usurious powers and cultural degradation, of filth and stinginess, of morbidity and cynicism, building an allegory at the limits of nihilism on an increasingly beautiful country devastated by the paratelevision squalor.

title: Red Road
actors: Kate Dickie, Tony Curran, Martin Compston, Nathalie Press, Andrew Armour, Paul Higgins, Carolyn Calder, Jessica Angus
description: Jackie works as an operator in a CCTV surveillance center. Every day she watches over a small part of the city of Glasgow, until a man she never wanted to see again appears on the monitor.
notes: The atmosphere built by Arnold is suggestive, dark and sick, interwoven with a sadomasochism that is not so latent and very feminine, interrupted by disarming flashes of fragility. The relationship between the two protagonists is built with acute psychological precision. Only in the end does the unveiling and the recomposition betray expectations a little.

title: Indigènes
actors: Samy Naceri, Bernard Blancan, Jamel Debbouze, Aurélie Eltvedt, Benoît Giros
description: 1944-45. France is fighting the Nazis. Four soldiers are recruited in Africa and sent to the front lines, where they stand out for different reasons and ideals.

title: Crónica de una fuga
actors: Nazareno Casero, Rodrigo De la Serna, Pablo Echarri
description: Buenos Aires, 1977. Claudio Tamburrini, a famous Argentine Serie B footballer is kidnapped by a group of men in the service of the military government, and imprisoned with other people in a dilapidated house in Moron. After four months of interrogations, violence and humiliation, his fate seems sealed, except that during a violent storm together with other inmates, he manages to force a window and escape ...
notes: The contents take over and the film cannot rework itself in a cinema if not didactic and obvious. Among the happy notes, the interpretation of Rodrigo De La Serna, the livid photography and a finale that partially straightens the painful operation.

title: Iklimler
actors: Ebru Ceylan, Nuri Bilge Ceylan, Nazan Kesa, Mehmet Eryilmaz
description: Isa, a university professor, and Bahar, a television producer, loved each other deeply, but after the wedding, things changed. Both react to the crisis in a childish and predictable way. He finds consolation in the arms of a former lover, she locks herself up in a state of mind close to depression.
notes: A type of cinema that seeks the spectacular in the slight jolts of the heart, those that do not seem to affect the severe fixity of the landscape (third protagonist of the story) and instead create incurable inner upheavals, with unhealed scars.

title: Marie-Antoinette
actors: Kirsten Dunst, Jason Schwartzman, Rip Torn, Judy Davis, Asia Argento, Aurore Clément
description: Marie Antoinette, the youngest of the daughters of Francis I and Maria Theresa of Austria, at the age of fourteen was given in marriage to Louis XVI, the future king of France. The young woman arrives in Versailles, where she has to face a very different environment from that of the Austrian court, without also being able to win the sympathy of the people.
notes: La Coppola stages today through a coming-of-age story where the teenager grows up maturing only in a sentimental sense. The other directions are closed: this is an epic of love towards a golden age withered for lack of social and civil props. Hit the spot Aphex Twin, The Cure and more on the soundtrack.

title: El laberinto del fauno
actors: Ivana Baquero, Doug Jones, Sergi López, Ariadna Gil, Maribel Verdú, Alex Angulo
description: 1944. A girl travels with her mother and adoptive father to rural areas of Northern Spain after Franco's victory. The young woman meets (or perhaps thinks she meets) a faun who promises her a fantastic kingdom, provided that she passes three tests ...
notes: Del Toro's exhibited autorialism never manages to deal with gender in a coherent and effective way and the heaviness of the approach becomes a plaster cast but also myopia. Together with The Devil's Thorn and a phantom third chapter coming up, it should form a trilogy on the Spanish Civil War and its horrors, but it is not scary, it does not move and it does not interest.

title: Flandres
actors: Samuel Boidin, Henri Cretel, Inge Decaesteker, Patrice Venant, Jean-Marie Bruveart, David Poulain, David Legay
description: Demester splits his time between his farm and Barbe, a childhood friend. The man loves her secretly and painfully, and accepts the little she can give him. When Demester goes to war in a distant country, Barbe pines for his return.

title: Quand j'étais chanteur
actors: Cécile De France, Gérard Depardieu
description: A very popular 50-year-old singer in Clermont-Ferrand meets a 27-year-old real estate agent with a 4-year-old son and many problems. They visit empty apartments, secrets and desires are revealed.

title: Babel
actors: Cate Blanchett, Brad Pitt, Gael García Bernal, Mahima Chaudhry, Jamie McBride, Adriana Barraza, Elle Fanning, Koji Yakusho, Rinko Kikuchi
description: Three intertwined events but set in Morocco, Tunisia, Mexico and Japan. It all begins when tragedy strikes a couple on vacation ...
notes: The story comes and goes, in time and space, attentive to time zones, lights, bodies, sounds of so many different continents. In every narrated life, the hesitations of ancient misunderstandings that we all pay daily are intertwined: a couple parched by misunderstandings, a father and a daughter closed in their respective universes, a Mexican governess who is unable to break through the cultural barriers of America, a Moroccan family which faces the undoing of traditional values.

title: 7 Seconds
actors: Wesley Snipes, Tamzin Outhwaite, Dhobi Oparei, Georgina Rylance
description: Jack Tolliver mistakenly steals a painting by Van Gogh of enormous value and the Russian bandits, in search of the same work, after a fierce shooting that kills almost the entire gang, capture his partner. To save her, Jack will have to ally with his enemy, a tenacious NATO military policeman.
notes: Snipes again in an action role, for a film released directly on video, proves to be athletic enough. But the director imitates the already tremendous Michael Bay advertising style and the script doesn't help. He gasps between one fight and another: only for fans of hand-to-hand clashes.

title: Laitakaupungin Valot
actors: Janne Hyytiäinen, Maria Heiskanen, Maria Järvenhelmi, Ilkka Koivula
description: A shy night watchman looks for a modest place in the sun, and runs into a beautiful and calculating woman who, with a group of thugs, takes advantage of his need for love and frames him in a blow for which he is held solely responsible. .
notes: Chaplinian right from the title, Le luci della sera gives a lot of space to aspects of Aki's poetics that border on the manner: very dilated shots and leaden horizons in the heart and in the context. However, one cannot fail to love the author's stubbornness, the ability to fall in love with characters who otherwise would not find a homeland, a memory, an identity in the cinema.

title: Southland Tales
actors: Dwayne Johnson, Seann William Scott, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Justin Timberlake, Bai Ling, Miranda Richardson, Mandy Moore, Kevin Smith
description: July 4, 2008: a nuclear attack shocks America. In California, an energy generator alters the Earth's rotation. An action star, a porn star and twins try to stem the damage ...

title: Fast Food Nation
actors: Greg Kinnear, Kris Kristofferson, Patricia Arquette, Ethan Hawke, Luis Guzmán, Catalina Sandino Moreno
description: Don Anderson, marketing manager of the "Mickey's" fast food chain, is sent to Colorado to investigate the scandal of the "Big One" hambuger, the flagship product of the house, which turned out to be spoiled. Arrived on the spot, Anderson will discover the atrocities of the management and exploitation of illegal immigrants ...
notes: Taken from the book by Eric Schlosser, Linklater's film, actually a docufiction, starts well but then finds the only way to support his thesis in the shock effect. The purpose is shared, minus the way in which the social, political and economic drama that the modern food industry contributes to spread is represented. More sobriety would have helped.

title: The Wind That Shakes the Barley
actors: Cillian Murphy, Padraic Delaney, Liam Cunningham, Gerard Kearney, William Ruane, Orla Fitzgerald
description: 1919: the Irish form a guerrilla army against the English army, sent to block the independence movement. The Irish republican movement splits, favoring the survival of the dying British empire. Damien and Teddy are two brothers at first united, then divided by political choices at the antipodes ...
notes: In Loach's cinema, militancy and storytelling are indispensable: the director strives, from film to film, to keep them in balance. Sometimes he succeeds perfectly (as in the first works and in "Sweet Sixteen"); others less so, especially if the perspective of militancy crosses - as it happens here - into the territories of history.

title: Summer Palace
actors: Guo Xiaodong, Hu Ling, Zhang Xianmin
description: Yu Hong leaves his village, his family and his loved one to go to study in Beijing. At university she discovers sexual freedom and forbidden pleasure and falls in love with her classmate Zhou Wei.

title: Transylvania
actors: Asia Argento, Amira Casar, Birol Ünel
description: Zingarina and Marie, two friends, are on their way to the feast of Herod, a pagan ceremony that is celebrated in Romania. Zingarina is looking for the man she loves and who left her.
notes: Gatlif continues to represent a polyphonic and poly-everything universe as if it were caught between an exotic rite and the free gaze of the nomad (associating in this with Kusturica, much imitated and much copied). But these borderless journeys have now become the way of themselves. And they smell of old like the cinema that is committed to account for it.

title: Speaking Parts
actors: Gabrielle Rose, Arsinée Khanjian, Tony Nardi, David Hemblen

title: Celos
actors: Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, Daniel Gimenez Cacho, María Botto, Luis Tosar
description: Antonio and Carmen live in the province. He works as a truck driver for an orange processing company, while she is a worker in the same factory. On the eve of the wedding, the worm of jealousy takes hold of Antonio because of a photograph in which Carmen appears smiling next to a young man. After a first breakup, they get married, but the ghost of the mysterious José continually reappears in thoughts ...

title: Ginger Snaps: Unleashed
actors: Emily Perkins, Tatiana Maslany, Eric Johnson, Janet Kidder
description: On the run from Bailey Downs to prevent what happened to her sister Ginger from happening to her, Brigitte is found by the police and locked up in a rehabilitation facility. Deprived of the only antidote that allowed her not to turn into a werewolf, Brigitte meets on her way a girl very similar to her, who will help her with her new problems and escape the curse that haunts her.
notes: Sequel to _Ginger Snaps_ (2000).

title: El amante bilingüe
actors: Ornella Muti, Imanol Arias, Loles Leon, Javier Bardem, Julieta Serrano

title: La pasión turca
actors: Ana Belén, Georges Corraface, Ramon Madaula, Silvia Munt
description: Desideria Oliván, aka Desi, has everything she wants from life, a caring husband, a nice house in Huesca and good friends. The only flaw in her relationship is a rather lukewarm sex life. During a vacation in Istanbul with his life partner, Desi has a hot relationship with Yaman, the tour guide who has the task of accompanying them on excursions. The woman, stunned by passion, does not realize that by relying body and soul on Yaman she will be dragged into a sea of ??troubles.
notes: Vicente Aranda's film won the 1995 Goya Award for Best Production Direction and Best Original Music.

title: United 93
actors: J. J. Johnson, Lewis Alsamari, Gary Commock, Trish Gates, Polly Adams, Cheyenne Jackson
description: The real-time account of what happened on United Flight 93, one of the hijacked planes on September 11, 2001, which crashed near Shanksville, Pennsylvania after the passenger riots.
notes: United 93 is the scariest disaster film of the past thirty years, and the most anxious thriller of recent seasons. The work on gender, which exists and is robust, does not in any way devalue the status of social, political and civil commitment. United 93 represents the destruction of the walls of weeping, with the names and surnames of the fallen, to identify here yes - that gigantic and poisoned bubble that goes by the name of contemporaneity. It is always the weakest who lose out. To be seen strictly and if possible not dubbed. We are very close to the masterpiece.

title: X-Men: The Last Stand
actors: Patrick Stewart, Hugh Jackman, Ian McKellen, Famke Janssen, Anna Paquin
description: Having discovered a cure for mutants, the hunt for the X-Men reopens: this time, the plot revolves mainly around the resurrection and fall of Jean Gray, who became a Phoenix, very dangerous and almost omnipotent mutant ...
notes: Plagued by too many characters (especially among the "bad guys", reduced to the thickness of a bad video game), it is compared to the two previous chapters that the film disappoints. On paper he faced two of the most interesting events of the heroes of comics (and in fact a first project involved two films): but with Ratner at the helm instead of Singer, the result is more muddled than comics.

title: Over the Hedge
description: RJ, an enterprising raccoon, inserts a coin into a vending machine to eat a packet of chips that fit together and ignite a furious fight between the animal and the machine. From there, RJ's adventures to get food begin. After attempting to steal a bear's food supply, the raccoon tries to involve a group of newly hibernating animals (a hyperkinetic squirrel, a wise turtle, a family of fearful porcupines, and so on) to collect the food it it serves to compensate the bear. And this is where humans appear ...
notes: In the second part the film does not take off to the end even if the characterization of the characters is successful and fun. The pace of the film, however, is pressing and the comic stunts are continuous and functional, demonstrating once again how the writers of today's cartoons are often more creative than those of a lot of fiction. In the original version the voices of the protagonists are Bruce Willis, Nick Nolte and Steve Carell.

title: Shortbus
actors: Raphael Barker, Lindsay Beamish, Justin Bond, Jay Brannan, Paul Dawson, Sook-Yin Lee, PJ DeBoy, Alan Mandell, Peter Stickles, Alan Hardman
description: The Shortbus club is the meeting place for people with sexual problems. Rob and Sophia frequent him, happy spouses even though she has never reached orgasm; a couple of homosexual boys who would like to start a threesome; a girl who prostitutes herself because she cannot have stable ties ...
notes: The director follows his characters in search of love and weaves them through a physical place: but behind their erotic performances, what really matters is tenderness, the search for an authentic feeling, honesty towards oneself and the partner. . And sex becomes only a step towards knowing oneself and others.

title: Hak se wui yi wo wai kwai
actors: Simon Yam, Albert Cheung, Nick Cheung, Louis Koo, Ka Tung Lam
description: After becoming the leader of the Triad, Lok must face his rival who seeks to increase his business with China.

title: 4-4-2. Il gioco più bello del mondo
directors: Michele Carrillo, Claudio Cupellini, Francesco Lagi, Roan Johnson
actors: Valerio Mastandrea, Francesca Inaudi, Nino D'Angelo, Roberto Citran, Alessandro Guasco
description: The stories of those who love and experience football. But the lesser one, of those who got lost along the way: the promises that remain such, the frustrated prosecutors, those who think they have discovered the new Maradona ...
notes: Happiness of gaze, situations and accents, not so much originality of direction.

title: Aquamarine
actors: Sara Paxton, Emma Roberts, Joanna 'JoJo' Levesque, Jake McDorman
description: Hailey and Claire, two great friends are about to spend their last summer together before Claire moves cities with her family. One day, after a violent storm, the pool of the club they frequent is filled with numerous marine species, including a mermaid, Aquamarine, who falls in love with a boy. Hailey and Claire would like to help her get back to sea, but Aquamarine doesn't want to know until she gets out with the guy she's in love with ...

title: Mehri to ploio
actors: Alexis Damianos, Christos Tsangas, Eleni Burbuchaki, Giorgos Haralambidis, Venia Paliri, Iota Economidou
description: A rude mountaineer leaves his village to embark for Australia. On the ship, he first works as a farrier for a friend, but falls in love with his beautiful girl. Then he meets a sensual tomboy and, finally, when he arrives at his destination, he meets a woman with whom he chooses to leave ...
notes: First film by Alexis Damianos who chooses to tell his Greece with a rather personal narration: from three stories to stage only one. In the first the roots of the people, in the second the relationship with nature, in the third - inspired by a song - love. Straub of Damianos says: «we would not be worthy of being spectators if not loving it, seeing it again, reprogramming it».

title: Fierce People
actors: Donald Sutherland, Diane Lane, Anton Yelchin, Chris Evans
description: Finn Earl, a 15-year-old son of a famous anthropologist, would like to spend the summer at his father's fiand at work in South America. His mother, a masseuse with serious cocaine problems, however, forces him to follow her by moving to a wealthy client of hers. Finn devotes his attention as a young anthropologist to the very rich people who roam the house.
notes: It is a coming-of-age story that devotes some attention to the social rituals of the upper-class retired in the countryside, but which veers towards strong and dramatic tones. The good cast is not enough to keep Dunne's film (protagonist of _Fuori ora_) on its feet.

title: Fratelli di sangue
actors: Fabrizio Gifuni, Barbora Bobulova, Fabrizio Rongione
description: Three brothers who have not seen each other for some time find themselves in the basement where they took refuge as children, where an old radio broadcasts uncensored phone calls. Meanwhile, upstairs, preparations are underway for Christmas lunch. For fun, the three decide to call the radio station: but when they start talking about Christmas night ten years ago, the situation gets out of hand ...
notes: The director studied with Mike Leigh and you can feel it: his are urgencies that flesh out the bodies in the desperate search to touch the bottom, the dreaded goal. While constrained by space, the film manages not to be fixedly theatrical. Excellent actors.

title: Tre giorni d'anarchia
actors: Enrico Lo Verso, Roberto Purvis, Renato Carpentieri, Gaetano Aronica
description: July 1943: the Yankees land in Sicily and in a village scorched by a torrid summer, peasants and notables, women and children, freed from fascism, dream for seventy-two hours of occupying the fields and mines, of being masters of their own destiny.
notes: Three days of "anarchy", in fact, extracted from History and reworked by Vito Zagarrio (the third direction after La donna della luna and Bonus malus, books and essays, and fruitful teachings at twenty-four frames per second) with an affectionate look towards the cinema that filters the quotationism that crowds the three-pointed imaginary of the most filmed island and that becomes a dignified unicum, an original faded here and there by some too many didacticism, but honest and true, like the interpretation of Enrico Lo Verso , returned to the acting levels of his beginnings.

title: Ratten - Sie werden dich kriegen!
actors: Ralph Herforth, Anne Cathrin Buhtz, Christian Kahrmann, Karin Neuhäuser
description: In the bowels of the city lies a threat from which it is difficult to escape: rats. Ten times more numerous than humans, they await the right moment to attack the city of Frankfurt. Frank, who took the field with his team of specialists, discovers a giant colony of rats. Getting them right will be an unlikely undertaking.

title: Mr. 3000
actors: Bernie Mac, Angela Bassett, Michael Rispoli, Brian J. White
description: Having reached 3,000 strikes, Stan Ross thinks he has entered the baseball Hall of Fame, and satisfied he retires. Ten years later, an error in the count is discovered and three of these strikes are invalidated. So, almost fifty years old, Stan returns to business to regain the title of "Mr. 3000", on which he has in the meantime built a series of fruitful activities now put at risk. His return to the world of sport is mocked by an old flame, the journalist Maureen Simmons, but the bickering will soon rekindle the passion between the two ...
notes: Dignified but not very funny, he didn't even appeal to Americans, which is saying something.

title: The Beast
actors: William Petersen, Karen Sillas, Charles Martin Smith, Ronald Guttman
description: The small coastal community of Graves Point is devastated by the tragic and inexplicable disappearance of a young couple at sea. After some inspections, Dr. Talley - a marine biologist - believes that he has found the mystery solved: a very rare and enormous squid would wander in the depths ...

title: The Hitcher II: I've Been Waiting
actors: C. Thomas Howell, Kari Wuhrer, Jake Busey, Shaun Johnston
description: After being released from the local police station, Jim Halsey heads to Texas with his girlfriend Maggie. But apparently the experience did not help him, because along the way he falls into the fatal mistake of giving a lift to a stranger who will renew the nightmares of almost twenty years before ...

title: One Last Dance
actors: Patrick Swayze, Lisa Niemi, George De La Pena, Matthew Walker, Stefan Wenta, Timothy Webber
description: When the artistic director of a brilliant dance company dies, three famous dancers - overcoming ancient disagreements - try to revive the fortunes of the company by putting together a show from a few years before that never went on stage ...

title: Held Up
actors: Jamie Foxx, Nia Long, Eduardo Yáñez, Barry Corbin, John Cullum, Jake Busey
description: Michael and his fiancée Rae set out on the journey with the intention of reaching the Grand Canyon. During the various stages of approaching the coveted destination, Michael confesses to the girl that the vintage car in which they are traveling was bought with the nest egg set aside to buy a house. The very angry Rae leaves him in the lurch and hitchhikes back to Las Vegas. But for Michael the worst is yet to come, as not only do they take his car away, but he is taken hostage by a robber.
