notes: Steve Rash, director of _Dreaming of Manhattan_, directs an acceptable comedy that does not depart from the usual stereotypes.

title: The Breed
actors: Michelle Rodriguez, Eric Lively, Oliver Hudson, Taryn Manning, Hill Harper
description: College friends Nicki, Matt, John, Sara and Noah have decided to spend a weekend on a seemingly deserted island. After finding a torn and shredded corpse, the five realize that the place is not uninhabited and that a tough fight for survival awaits them ...
notes: Apart from the ending and a couple of action sequences in the second part, the overall view is rather disheartening. Not even the fiercest enemies of horror deserve jokes like "Those who live so extreme usually die young" or "I told you: the dogs of this place are not friends of man." With all due respect to patron Wes Craven.

title: Hush
actors: Tori Spelling, Victoria Pratt, Tahmoh Penikett, Susan Hogan

title: Sometimes in April
actors: Idris Elba, Oris Erhuero, Arthur Yuhi Abia, Johannes Bausch, Carole Karemera, Pamela Nomvete, Oris Erhuero, Fraser James, Debra Winger
description: In April 1994, Hutu nationalists resorted to the use of arms against their Tutsi countrymen in Rwanda. Thus began one of the darkest periods in African history, which will lead to the deaths of nearly 800,000 people. Ten years later, the teacher Augustin must decide whether to see his brother, who has been on trial for being a member of the Hutu party.

title: H2Odio
actors: Chiara Conti, Mandala Tayde, Claire Falconer, Anapola Mushkadiz, Olga Shuvalova
description: Five girls of different nationalities - Olivia, Summer, Ana, Christina and Nicole - meet on an island to start a diet that involves only ingesting water. Olivia, who seems to be the quietest of the group, holds a disturbing secret.
notes: Infascelli tries the experimental route with little success.

title: E l'aura fai son vir
actors: Thierry Toscan, Alessandra Agosti, Dario Aghilante, Giovanni Foresti
description: A foreigner arrives in Chersogno, a village in the Occitan Alps: he is a French shepherd who is looking for a place to move with his family and his goats, because in the Pyrenees, where he lives, they are installing a nuclear power plant. To be accepted, man must overcome the distrust of many locals ...
notes: A beautiful film on the themes of hospitality and community, on the refusal and the inability to consider what we are, what we were and what we have played and lost. Self-produced and partly financed by the same workers, it "pierced" the threshold of indifference thanks to the public's tam-tam.

title: Sentenza di morte
actors: Robin Clarke, Richard Conte, Enrico Maria Salerno, Adolfo Celi, Tomas Milian, Lilli Lembo

title: Série noire
actors: Patrick Dewaere, Marie Trintignant, Bernard Blier, Myriam Boyer
description: A marginal character - Frank Poupart, an officially representative, actually a fence and a half-notch criminal - gets help from a poor girl to eliminate his accomplice and other people who hinder his foul designs ...
notes: Based on a short story by Jim Thompson (original _A Hell of a Woman_), it is one of the best polar of the '70s, which reworks and perfectly restores the haunted atmosphere of the great noir writer's novels. In a world where you cheerfully tear yourself apart, the "dropouts" are the first to crash. Corneau's direction and great performance by Patrick Dewaere, who then committed suicide in 1982.

title: Salt of the Earth
actors: Rosaura Revueltas, Will Geer, David Wolfe, Mervin Williams

title: The Cutter
actors: Chuck Norris, Joanna Pacula, Daniel Bernhardt, Bernie Kopell
description: A private detective investigates the disappearance of a well-known diamond expert, kidnapped on the orders of a Nazi criminal.

title: Le collectionneur
actors: Maude Guérin, Luc Picard, Lawrence Arcouette, Charles-André Bourassa

title: Tremors 4: The Legend Begins
actors: Michael Gross, Sara Botsford, Billy Drago, Brent Roam, Lydia Look
description: In 1889, the site that will become Perfection Valley is home to the town of Rejection Valley. The inhabitants are completely dependent on a nearby silver mine for its income, and when a hot spring causes graboid eggs to hatch the mine becomes too dangerous to work in. Its owner is Hiram Gummer, great-grandfather of Burt. He arrives in town to fix the problem, but finds he is in way over his head dealing with the monsters. As Hiram picks up the lessons that will one day be imparted to Burt, the town readies itself for a final showdown with the graboids. The worms are back but this time in a prequel, set in 1889 Nevada as silver mines inspector Hiram Gummer, the great-grandfather of Burt Gummer, arrives in the small settlement of Rejection Valley and faces off against the so-called graboid worm monsters devouring the local inhabitants.

title: Odinokij golos celoveka
actors: Tat'jana Gorjacheva, Andrej Gradov
description: Deeply traumatized by the horrors of the civil war, the solitary Nikita cannot give an address to his existence: the love for his wife Lyuba is now only an emotion belonging to the past, and in the new post-revolutionary Russia there seems to be no place for he...
notes: Sokurov's debut in the fictional feature film - based on two short stories by Andrei Platonov, shot in 1978 but banned by censorship for almost a decade - already outlines some of the guidelines of his cinema to come, both on a thematic level (the dichotomy between flesh and spirit) and on the stylistic one (in a markedly "expressionist" sense).

title: Madame
actors: Nancy Brilli, Lorenzo Flaherty, Galatea Ranzi, Francesca Lancini, Christophe Caron, Manuela Arcuri, Attilio Fontana, Rossella Falk
description: Doris Tarlazzi and her daughter Isabelle arrive in Italy from London to sign the deed of sale for the old family villa. Forced by a mishap to stay in the house, the two women have different reactions: Doris is annoyed, while Isabelle is conquered by the beauty of the mansion and cannot understand why her mother wants to get rid of it so hastily. The girl then discovers a photo of a beautiful sad-looking woman who she believes may be her maternal grandmother, Emma: Doris has always been reticent about it, and Isabelle can't help but wonder what mystery lies behind that charming. figure ...

title: The Ripper
actors: Patrick Bergin, Gabrielle Anwar, Samuel West, Michael York
description: London, 1888, Whitechapel neighborhood: a serial killer who calls himself Jack the Ripper kills prostitutes in a brutal way and then vanishes into thin air. The case is entrusted to Inspector Hansen, who tries to bring the ferocious killer to justice thanks to a single witness: the woman who lives with him ...

title: Ellie Parker
actors: Naomi Watts, Rebecca Riggs, Chevy Chase, Scott Coffey, Mark Pellegrino
description: Ellie Parker would like to become an actress and that's why she goes from one audition to another, from one disguise to another. But no one wants to help her, neither her best friend, nor her would-be boyfriend and what about her manager?
notes: _Ellie Parker_, in fact, is the "banal" part, in the open air of _Mullholland Drive_, where the mysteries of the double character of David Lynch's masterpiece played by the protagonist of _Ellie Parker_, Naomi Watts (very good), are unfolded, psychoanalysed, shown without the fears and hidden readings typical of the cinematographic journey of the brilliant author of _Cuore selvato_. The result is, however, discreet, like a classic Sundance product (where it premiered in January 2005), capable of giving birth to a beautiful portrait of an actress in an abstract, suffocating, airless Los Angeles (the scenes are almost all indoors), in which the cinema comes out with broken bones, like a painting sifted through by evocations that seem to give no more hope. It is no coincidence that, in one of the film's happy moments, one hears a joke that does not leave indifferent: "Do you remember the 70s? The future was a promise, now it is a threat".

title: A Prairie Home Companion
actors: Garrison Keillor, Meryl Streep, Lily Tomlin, Kevin Kline, John C. Reilly, Woody Harrelson, Tommy Lee Jones, Virginia Madsen, Lindsay Lohan
description: Since 1974 "A Prairie Home Companion" has been a very popular music program on the radio. Among the artists who perform: the two sisters Yolanda and Rhonda Johnson, the singing cowboys Dusty and Lefty ... The mysterious woman and Guy Noir, the security officer who seems to come out of a Raymond novel, also wander around the stage. Chandler, the bossy stage manager and his secretary. But it seems that the program is about to close, or so a mysterious character seems to have decided.
notes: At 81, after the setback of The Company, Altman signs a masterpiece, a happy, funny and light film about death, about America, about himself. An hour and a half inside the theater where the broadcast is broadcast live instead of three days around the country where the country'n western is born: nevertheless, we are in _Nashville_. Nashville thirty years later, where a nation's fear and confusion have been replaced by the melancholy and joy of its "veterans".

title: RV
actors: Robin Williams, Cheryl Hines, Joanna 'JoJo' Levesque, Josh Hutcherson, Jeff Daniels
description: Due to a major business meeting, Bob Munro convinces his wife and children to forgo their Hawaii vacation for an RV trip to the Rocky Mountains, Colorado. Once at their destination, the Munros have to contend with a bizarre community of campers, all rigorously equipped with campers ...
notes: Obvious comedy with a sometimes scatological humor, which compares the usual wealthy and framed but arid family with another dazed and post-hippie, but naturally happier. Sonnenfeld and Williams put on automatic pilot: good feelings and ecology triumph, but also yawns.

title: L'estate del mio primo bacio
actors: Laura Morante, Neri Marcoré, Regina Orioli, Raffaella Lebboroni, Andrea Renzi, Gabriella Bellisario, Jacopo Petrini
description: Like every year, 14-year-old Camilla spends her summer holidays on the Argentario with her family. In addition to finding her old friends, this time she meets Adelmo, a handsome and gloomy 17-year-old, who takes care of the maintenance of the swimming pool ...
notes: Not that the result makes you tear your clothes off: that a slice of our contemporary cinema is attracted to pre-adolescence is the child more of a misunderstanding (the very young go to the room and therefore we talk about them) than of a real need. In short, the temptation to leave the vision with the classic echissenefrega is strong. However, the product is decent, the direction (at the debut) clean and the actors in part. In addition to the aforementioned and talented Morante, we must certainly remember Gigio Alberti (who seems to know a second youth also given the beautiful role played in _4-4-2_) and Neri Marcorè. A summer juice to drink in one go and quickly.

title: Ten Canoes
actors: Richard Birrinbirrin, Johnny Buniyira, Peter Djigirr, Frances Djulibing, David Gulpilil, Jamie Gulpilil
description: Dayindi is in love with one of Minygululu's three wives, his older brother. The young man resents having to wait for the consent of the elders to be able to marry, but this is what the law of his people wants. So that he does not forget the teachings, Minygululu takes advantage of the ritual that accompanies the goose hunt, to tell his brother an ancient legend about Yeeralparil, who is also eager to conquer his beautiful sister-in-law.
notes: A lot of meat in the fire for an indefinable film: a "fictionalized" documentary, with David's sly voice off, subtitles translating the Ganalbingu language, shot in the Land of Arnhem, Gulpilil's homeland, with the people of Ramingining, co-author of the script a starting from a 1930s photograph of the anthropologist Donald Thompson.

title: La dignidad de los nadie
description: Stories and testimonies about the social resistance in Argentina that tackles unemployment and hunger. There are Martín, hit by a stray bullet, Toba who helps him, Antonia and Chipi who feed over two hundred people every day in a neighborhood on the outskirts of Buenos Aires ...
notes: Fernando Solanas tells the daily heroisms of those who, through forms of self-management or dusting off ancient cooperative concepts, have tried and still try to unite to resist degradation and poverty, which down there still has nineteenth-century aspects, like a Dickensian cross-section of London. Moving, or rather exciting, the women of the "farmers" united against the banks that take away land and farms. _The dignity of the last_ is therefore a precious testimony on a possible social resurgence.

title: Poseidon
actors: Kurt Russell, Josh Lucas, Richard Dreyfuss, Jacinda Barrett, Emmy Rossum, Mike Vogel, Mia Maestro
description: On New Year's Eve, while the passengers are celebrating, a 50-meter tidal wave hits the luxurious Poseidon ship and capsizes it. The survivors, led by Dylan and Robert, try to escape ...
notes: Wolfgang Petersen said he took his cue from _The Adventure of Poseidon_ by Roland Neame (founder, in 1972, of the "catastrophic"), to write a new screenplay, with contemporary characters. And that the story of Poseidon is the story of these characters. This demonstrates that contemporaneity, especially cinematic, is far flatter and duller than the past. In fact, Petersen's film, with means that Neame's did not even dream of, works well, especially in the first part, on a spectacular and "anxious" level. Too bad the characters are less interesting than those embarked on any _Love Boat_.

title: Annapolis
actors: James Franco, Tyrese Gibson, Jordana Brewster, Donnie Wahlberg, McCaleb Burnett, Chi McBride
description: Jake Huard, worker and amateur boxer, wishes to join the Navy to fulfill his aspirations: the training, however, turns out to be very hard, and the young man has to face the hostility of some colleagues and above all of Lieutenant Cole. But thanks to the support of his roommate and beautiful Ali, Jack finally manages to make his dream come true.
notes: The film does not add anything new to the vein set within military academies: clichés and banalities abound, even if overall the pace is quite smooth. The soundtrack contributes to an unnecessary superabundance of meaning.

title: The White Diamond
description: Report of the adventure undertaken by director Werner Herzog and aerospace engineer Graham Dorrington aboard the White Diamond airship, designed by Dorrington himself, with which the two flew over Guyana and explored the Amazon rainforest.

title: Hoodwinked
directors: Cory Edwards, Todd Edwards, Tony Leech
description: Little Red Riding Hood is at her grandmother's house, in front of the big bad wolf: suddenly the grandmother peeps out of the closet where she was locked up and the woodcutter bursts through the window ...
notes: Pushed and loose quotationism for a pleasant product and nothing more, adopted child of the _Shrek_ saga.

title: The Omen
actors: Liev Schreiber, Julia Stiles, Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick, Mia Farrow, David Thewlis
description: The son of an American diplomat is born dead. On the advice of Father Spiletto and unaware of his wife, the newborn is replaced by Damien, a child born the same night, whose mother died in childbirth. Around the little one, however, an increasing number of disturbing facts occur: it is in fact the long prophesied Antichrist ...
notes: Farrow, a Satanist nanny, winks at the possessed imagination of which she was the absolute star, but you really never get excited. Professional packaging, a bit like a TV show, raised only by the remarkable performance of the actors: above all Liev Schreiber in the sinister role of the diplomat.

title: Katok i skripka
actors: Igor Fomchenko, Vladimir Zamanskij, Marina Adzhubei, Yura Brusser
description: Little violinist Sasha fails the music exam, but develops a singular friendship with Sergej, a steamroller worker. Sasha is thus able to overcome tests unusual for him, such as repairing and driving the vehicle or defending a weaker child ...
notes: Final test of the directing course at the VGIK in Moscow.

title: The Shaggy Dog
actors: Tim Allen, Kristin Davis, Zena Grey, Spencer Breslin, Robert Downey jr.
description: Investigating an animal testing laboratory, Deputy District Attorney Dave Douglas is infected with a top-secret gene mutation serum. The man then becomes a dog and, from his "privileged" situation, can get to know his family better: however, Dave wishes to become human again, and to do this he will have to appropriate the serum and find the criminals who caused his transformation ...
notes: An incongruous mix of action and comedy, it presents, with sufficient panache, gags that are too often very predictable and all in the gut. Hardly passable as a family film, for the others it is better to abstain.

title: The Proposition
actors: Guy Pearce, Ray Winstone, Emily Watson, Danny Huston, John Hurt, Noah Taylor
description: In Australia in 1880, Captain Stanley, obsessed with the capture of Arthur Burns and his band of brigands, holds the bandit's two younger brothers in his hands. He proposes a difficult choice to Charlie Burns: to betray and hand over his older brother Arthur or to witness the hanging of younger Mike, a victim of his own mental illness more than guilty of serious crimes.
notes: Written and set to music by Nick Cave, Hillcoat's return to cinema after a decade of video, is among the best westerns of recent years: dirty, arid and mean, at times suspended between life and death and crossed by an exceptional cast, in which stands Ray Winstone.

title: Hooligans
actors: Elijah Wood, Oliver Allison, James Allison, Joel Beckett, Geoff Bell
description: Matt, a journalism student, is unjustly expelled from Harvard because he is found in possession of cocaine of dubious origin. For a change of scenery, she moves to London, where her sister Shannon lives with her husband Steve. Here he comes into contact with the world of hooligans and is fascinated ...

title: When a Stranger Calls
actors: Camilla Belle, Tommy Flanagan, Katie Cassidy, Tessa Thompson
description: Jill has to look after the children of two wealthy friends of her father who live in a luxury secluded mansion. The hosts leave leaving her a series of numbers to call only in an emergency. As Jill explores the many rooms, the phone starts ringing and a disturbing voice threatens the girl. Fear turns to terror when Jill discovers that the calls are coming from inside the house ...

title: Slither
actors: Nathan Fillion, Elizabeth Banks, Gregg Henry, Michael Rooker
description: After a meteorite hits a quiet American town, strange things happen. Grant, the first to go to the place where the meteorite fell, begins to suffer from a strange syndrome: a parasite has settled in his brain and is progressively transforming him into a monster. His wife Starla and the policeman Bill try in every way to prevent it from infecting other people ...
notes: Gunn comes from Troma and then wrote _Scooby Doo_ and the remake of _ Dawn of the Living Dead_. No wonder that, in his directorial debut, he tries the path of horror comedy, with mixed results despite the cast proving to be spot on.

title: Meltdown
actors: Casper Van Dien, Venus Terzo, Stefanie von Pfetten, Amanda Crew
description: Despite the warnings of the scientist Nathan, a dangerous experiment continues that leads to the explosion of an asteroid, of which the main fragment heads towards the Earth. Although it can be diverted, the asteroid is so close to the sun that it causes increased global warming and an apocalyptic situation on Earth. In this climate, Nathan offers his sister Carly and boyfriend Tom the chance to go with a couple of loved ones to a weather station in the Arctic.

title: Dead End
actors: Ray Wise, Lin Shaye, Mick Cain, Alexandra Holden, Billy Asher
description: As has been tradition for the past twenty years, Frank Harrington reluctantly takes his family to celebrate Christmas with his mother-in-law. Along the way, however, he opts for a shortcut and this will prove to be the beginning of the greatest nightmare of his life: a terrifying black car with an invisible driver and a mysterious lady in white sow death in their wake.

title: One Eyed King
actors: William Baldwin, Dash Mihok, Justin Bradley, Johnny Griffin
description: New York. Five street kids make a pact that no one will ever be able to dissolve. Over the years, those kids have grown into men and when one of them, Dennis, is killed, their friends, conducting a private investigation, will have to face a shocking truth. Routine thriller with little meat on the stove.

title: The Break-Up
actors: Jennifer Aniston, Vince Vaughn, Vincent D'Onofrio, Jon Favreau, Cole Hauser
description: Brooke and Gary's relationship has come to an end, but neither of them wants to leave the apartment they live in. On the advice of their respective friends and confidants, the two decide to resort to any means to persuade the other person to leave ...
notes: Peyton Reed (_Abbasso d'amore - Down with Love_) knows how to direct a film (and above all he knows how to close it), but the script, especially in the first part, is less sharp and quick than one would expect from a comedy. The best jokes go to the co-stars, friends and relatives of her and him, and above all to the magnificent Marilyn Dean, the owner-despot of the art gallery (a prodigious Judy Davis), who reveals the formula "Telly Savalas", or his secret weapon for (re) conquest.

title: The Matador
actors: Pierce Brosnan, Greg Kinnear, Arlin Miller, Azucena Medina, Jonah Meyerson
description: Danny is a traveling salesman on the avenue of sunset with a good last chance in Mexico. Here he meets an alcoholic killer who asks him for help with a murder. The unusual, but deep friendship that is established between the two will change the lives of both.
notes: Superfine fun, where every single thing works, even the conclusion, absolutely not as accommodating as it might appear on the surface. Very good Greg Kinnear; and Pierce Brosnan, in the role of his life, is unforgettable.

title: Chaos
actors: Jason Statham, Ryan Phillippe, Wesley Snipes, Henry Czerny
description: Besieged by the police, a group of robbers takes employees and customers of a Seattle bank hostage. Lorenz, their boss, asks to negotiate with Detective Conners, who is currently suspended from duty due to a hostage situation that has gone wrong. Flanked by a rookie, the young Dekker, Conners discovers that the gang has fled: a frenzied chase begins ...
notes: The idea is simple: to pit Snipes against Statham, perhaps the brightest stars of Western "action" today, and in fact the action holds. Too bad that the plot wants to appear smarter than it is, between double plays and implausible twists.

title: C.R.A.Z.Y.
actors: Marc-André Grondin, Michel Cote, Danielle Proulx, Pierre-Luc Brillant, Émile Vallée, Mariloup Wolfe
description: On December 25, 1960, Zachary Beaulieu was born, the fourth son of a cheerful family. Growing up, Zac realizes that he is different from his brothers, as he is attracted to boys: it is not easy for him to accept him, and above all to make his beloved father accept him ...
notes: A story of emancipation, a cross-section that winks in particular at Truffaut's cinema: swollen with pop icons, David Bowie and Bruce Lee attached to walls and doors, Pink Floyd and Rolling Stones, drug, sex and rock'n'roll ; and, most of all, a sexual ambiguity that has tormented Zachary since childhood (played by the actor Marc-André Grondin, authentic double of the first Keanu Reeves), the most restless of the five heirs (whose initials form the word of the title) . Vallée has the merit of writing the script well and building characters that are immediately loved or hated, but leaves some flaws in the direction, a few minutes too many and a feeling of missed great opportunity.

title: Atomik Circus - Le retour de James Bataille
actors: Vanessa Paradis, Jason Flemyng, Benoît Poelvoorde, Jean-Pierre Marielle

title: The Cooler
actors: William H. Macy, Alec Baldwin, Maria Bello, Shawn Hatosy, Ron Livingston, Paul Sorvino
description: Bernie Lootz is the most wretched player in all of Las Vegas. His privacy is a disaster and he owes a huge debt to Shelly, the boss of the Shangri-la casino who saved his life years earlier. In return, Bernie had to put his bad luck in the service of the underworld: just sit down at a casino table where a player is winning to put an end to good luck. When he has only a few days left in debt, Bernie meets Natalie, a new waitress whom he inevitably falls in love with and who will bring him luck. But also a lot of trouble, especially with Shelly ...

title: The Big Bounce
actors: Owen Wilson, Morgan Freeman, Sara Foster, Gary Sinise, Bebe Neuwirth, Kris Kristofferson, Scott Caan, Harry Dean Stanton, Vinnie Jones, Charlie Sheen
description: Surfing is everything to Jack Ryan. Until a stunning blonde bursts into his life with a foolproof plan to make him a billionaire. He'll just have to rob a villa ...
notes: The good cast and the Elmore Leonard novel, from which it is based, are thrown to the wind. It only lasts 88 minutes, but it never seems to end.

title: Beyond Re-Animator
actors: Jeffrey Combs, Elsa Pataky, Santiago Segura, Tommy Dean Musset
description: The insane Dr. West ended up in prison due to experiments on resuscitation of the dead that led to the death of a girl. The scientist discovers, using the few tools at his disposal and with the help of the young Dr. Phillips, the secret to bringing the deceased to life fully functional, with memories and abilities intact. But a prison riot upsets West's plans.
notes: The third chapter of Yuzna's bloody splatter saga, marks the umpteenth return of the zombie resuscitator played by the sinister Jeffrey Combs, the undisputed star of the triptych: less gory than expected but full of delicious gimmicks, especially if you don't change the channel on the credits.

title: Parentesi tonde
actors: Karim Capuano, Eva Henger, Raffaella Lecciso, Roberta Bonacci, Francesca D'Auria, Antonio Zequila, Igor Righetti, Nello Iorio, Enzo Fichetti, Giucas Casella, Flavia Vento

title: Romanze in Moll
actors: Marianne Hoppe, Paul Dahlke, Ferdinand Marian, Siegfried Breuer, Elisabeth Flickenschildt, Karl Günther, Anja Elkoff
description: Petty-bourgeois wedding in a nineteenth-century German city. The husband, returning home, finds his unconscious wife with an empty bottle of barbiturates beside her. He tries his best to save her and the woman is hospitalized in desperate conditions. Rummaging through his wife's belongings at home, the man - a rather clumsy and amorphous bank accountant - discovers a necklace of pearls of great value, and, starting from it, reconstructs the second life of his wife, of which he had not had. the slightest hint. In fact, the woman had long had an adulterous relationship with a rich noble of the city, in turn unaware of the marriage of his beloved. But the charming character is not entirely foreign to her husband's world. A relative of hers, a manager of the bank where her husband works, was aware of the woman's identity. He too fell in love with the beautiful lady, he was the source of a squalid blackmail that resulted in the woman's attempted suicide.

actors: Laura Mennell, Paul Dzenkiw, Christie Will Wolf, Kristina Copeland
description: January 11, 1992: Three murders, apparently without motive, occur in conjunction with a series of supernatural events. Little Sara Tobias, with the help of her friend Raden, manages to escape the two fugitives who killed her parents, writing in blood, next to her mother's body: "11:11". Despite being saved, the number 11 will haunt Sara for life, and twenty years later, when the same strange supernatural phenomena appear, she will have to deal with her past.
notes: This Western horror mimics Asian curses stories, but the plot is horribly confusing and the atmosphere is hiding.

title: Wondrous Oblivion
actors: Sam Smith, Delroy Lindo, Leonie Elliott, Stanley Townsend, Emily Woof
description: London, 1950s: David, a cricket fan, is looking for someone to teach him. He finds him in the neighbors, father and daughter, who emigrated from Jamaica. But due to pressure from the neighborhood residents, David's parents forbid their son to hang out with them ...
notes: The director delicately tackles the issue of racism.

title: Dans ma peau
actors: Marina de Van, Laurent Lucas, Léa Drucker

title: Mein erster Freund, Mutter und ich
actors: Andrea Sawatzki, Herbert Knaup, Jasmin Schwiers, Florian Jahr
description: Sixteen-year-old Nicole can't believe her eyes when she sees Daniel, handsome, likeable and charming, enter her class. It is love at first sight and feeling like Cinderella, she tries not to miss her prince charming. On his way he finds his mother Sonia who tries to make her think again about the qualities of the boys.

notes: It's fun, _American Dreamz_, and it's less harmless than it may seem. Because it demonstrates how all the subjects of a cathodic empire that does not know (middle) East or West (there are so many parables that reach everywhere ...) are equally idiot even without being American. In the sense that communication, especially mass television, a now global phenomenon, has transformed the dream of being able to become someone other than what one is in the greatest source of collective unhappiness. It is true, one in a thousand succeeds: the other 999 inevitably become cannon fodder of the system, manipulated by those who are higher up. title: Tower of London
actors: Basil Rathbone, Boris Karloff, Barbara O'Neil, Vincent Price

title: Orzowei, il figlio della savana
actors: Stanley Baker, Peter Marshal, Doris Kunstmann, Vincenzo Crocitti

title: Varjoja paratiisissa
actors: Matti Pellonpää, Kati Outinen, Sakari Kuosmanen, Esko Nikkari

title: La otra
actors: Dolores Del Rio, Agustín Irusta, Victor Junco, José Baviera

title: The Black Pirate
actors: Douglas Fairbanks, Billie Dove, Tempe Pigott, Donald Crisp
description: A young nobleman dreams of avenging the death of his father, who was killed in a pirate attack. To fine-tune his plan, he manages to infiltrate the pirate gang, posing as one of them. But things get complicated when the pirates capture a ship on which there is a girl whom he wishes to save from the clutches of his own companions.

title: Showa zankyo-den: Chizome no karajishi
actors: Ken Takakura, Ryo Ikebe, Junko Fuji, Masahiko Tsugawa, Michitaro Mizushima

title: Showa zankyo-den: Shinde morai masu
actors: Ken Takakura, Ryo Ikebe, Junko Fuji, Michiko Araki, Takeya Nakamura

title: Sketches of Frank Gehry
actors: Frank Gehry, Sydney Pollack
description: An opportunity to get closer to the life and works of one of the most famous contemporary architects. Among the best known works of Frank Gehry (born in 1929 and winner of the prestigious Pritzker Prize) the Guggenheim Museum in Bilbao.
notes: The documentary structure is traditional (with the interviews fitting into a linear path), we are not in the presence of Werner Herzog and his non-fiction. However, the fluidity of the speeches, the exceptional nature of Gehry's creations, the anti-academic freedom of his architecture make this Dream Maker a very enjoyable and ... instructive film.

title: Water
actors: Lisa Ray, Seema Biswas, Kulbhushan Kharbanda, Waheeda Rehman
description: India, 1938: a group of widows live in absolute poverty in a temple in the holy city of Varanasi. One of them tries to escape the social restrictions imposed by widowhood by starting a relationship with a man of a higher caste, a follower of Mahatma Gandhi ...
notes: Who is the Mehta aimed at? To Westerners who feel reassured in front of his representations? Or to compatriots who still today, in times of scientific-economic growth, live with strong contradictions? The answer is in the box: a bit of Bollywood to give an exotic touch, with just that little bit of folklore that doesn't hurt. For export.

title: Mortuary
actors: Dan Byrd, Denise Crosby, Stephanie Patton, Alexandra Adi
description: After her husband's death, Ms. Doyle moves to California with her two children. Together they take over the management of the Fowler brothers' funeral home, soon discovering - and at their own expense - that something lurks near their new home ...
notes: It doesn't even start badly, this _The Keeper_: which works as long as Hooper can manage a suspense made of nothing, that is, played on the suspicious and terrified looks of the inhabitants or on the silent voids that surround the mansion. When the horror is highlighted, however, the "low budget" nature of the production takes its course, and everything becomes a "I wish but I cannot".

title: Sylvia
actors: Gwyneth Paltrow, Daniel Craig, Jared Harris, Blythe Danner
description: History of the romantic relationship between the English poet Ted Hughes and Sylvia Plath.
notes: Aside from the performance of Gwyneth Paltrow, the film remains a predictable melodrama without any bite. Aesthetic research is an end in itself and makes the film unnecessarily glossy. Pure form.

title: Secondhand Lions
actors: Michael Caine, Robert Duvall, Haley Joel Osment, Kyra Sedgwick

title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
actors: 50 Cent, Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, Joy Bryant, Omar Benson Miller
description: Marcus, the son of a single mother, wants to become a rap singer, but the sudden death of the woman leads him to take a bad path: he begins to sell drugs and is involved in a war between rival gangs that leads him to prison. Here he manages to cultivate his great passion and meets Bama, who will later become his manager: a dangerous firefight awaits him ...
notes: Inspired by the true story of rapper 50 Cent - real name: Curtis Jackson - and played by himself, the film takes its title from the singer's debut album. However, the outcome is self-indulgent and well known: an injury in the career of Irish Sheridan.

title: Antonio guerriero di Dio
actors: Jordi Mollà, Andrea Ascolese, Eleonora Daniele, Paolo De Vita
description: Padua, 1263. In the city basilica the masses of faithful celebrate the remains of Antonio, who died in 1231, and transferred there as per his will. Backwards, through the character of Folco, a former thief who became a friar and friend of Antonio, we retrace the path of the Portuguese nobleman, scholar of theology and human sciences, educated at home by the Augustinians and shipwrecked on the Sicilian coast in 1221. He entered the circle of S Francis of Assisi, dedicated to hermitism, penance, extraordinary works of charity and very vigorous sermons against usury exercised even by the most eminent Paduan citizens.
notes: Great effort of historical reconstruction, dozens of locations, costumes and impeccable sets in this megaproduction (supported by the Ministry for Cultural Heritage and Activities). All to the disadvantage of the screenplay, which entrusts to the voice off of Folco (Paolo De Vita, the most natural of the cast) what the images are unable to convey on their own, that is, the motivations, the meaning and the difficulties of such an extreme spiritual path. .

title: Militia
actors: Dean Cain, Jennifer Beals, Frederic Forrest, Stacy Keach, John Beck
description: Special Agent Ethan Carter must infiltrate the subversive "Brotherhood of Liberty" militia, a far-right paramilitary organization that wants to overthrow the US government and impose a new world order. The dangerous group, led by TV presenter George Armstrong, has come into possession of three missiles with enormous destructive potential and threaten the life of the American President. Alongside Carter, in addition to the charming recruit Julia Sanders, is former Special Agent Fain, a shadow of the protagonist's past ...

title: Den' zatmenija
actors: Aleksej Ananisnov, Eskender Umarov, Irina Sokolova, Vladimir Zamanskij, Aleksej Jankovskij
description: A young doctor travels to an uninhabited city. Incomprehensible mysterious forces hinder his search: oppressive heat, the presence of strange characters, terrifying visions, dialogue with a deceased friend, the appearance of aliens.
notes: Sokurov is inspired by a science fiction novel by Arkady and Boris Strugackij, the same authors of _Stalker_. The film is structured according to a continuous contradiction between the various internal elements of the film: the soundtrack does not follow the scenes, the colors change drastically and suddenly, the relationships between the different levels of the cinematographic discourse, between the protagonist and the screenplay, between the contemporary man and the world are shattered.

title: Il giardino delle delizie
actors: Maurice Ronet, Evelyn Stewart, Lea Massari, Franco Bertoni

title: Romasanta
actors: Julian Sands, Elsa Pataky, John Sharian, Gary Piquer, David Gant

title: Dirty War
actors: Louise Delamere, Shamshad Akhtar, Fuman Dar, Kameal Nisha Bisnauthsingh
description: In London, authorities are preparing to face a long-announced nuclear terrorist attack that is now upon us. Firefighters and men from the anti-terrorism offices work side by side to avert the threat and reassure the population. But it is too late to stop the terrorists: one morning, at the Liverpool underground station, a very powerful bomb explodes, killing passers-by and releasing a toxic radioactive cloud into the sky. The police take action to avoid a second attack, the firefighters have to evacuate the contaminated area, and the men of the civil protection have the difficult task of managing the restoration of order among masses of terrified citizens.

title: Hawaii, Oslo
actors: Trond Espen Seim, Jan Gunnar Røise, Evy Elise Kasseth Røsten, Stig Henrik Hoff
description: On the hottest night of the year, in Oslo, the lives of a group of people, strangers to each other, are dramatically intertwined. Frodo and Milla have just had a baby; declining singer Bobbie-Pop wants to end it; then there are Leon, a kleptomaniac locked up in a nursing home and his best friend Vidar ...

title: Fauteuils d'orchestre
actors: Cécile De France, Valérie Lemercier, Albert Dupontel, Laura Morante, Claude Brasseur
description: Jessica arrives in Paris from the provinces and finds work as a waitress at the Bar des Théâtres. Here he enters into a relationship with the acclaimed pianist Jean-François Lefort, the famous actress Catherine Versen and the important art collector Jacques Grumberg ...
notes: A cinema of characters, dialogues, atmospheres, bistros and corners of villas in luxury districts, a crossroads of artists, musicians, collectors. A bustle of puzzle-registered personalities as Altman would like. Dedicated to the memory of Suzanne Flon and with an amused actor performance by Pollack as director Sobinski, a name borrowed from Lubitsch's _We want to live_.

title: Ultraviolet
actors: Milla Jovovich, Cameron Bright, Nick Chinlund, Sebastien Andrieu, William Fichtner, Ida Martin
description: Late 21st century. Humanity has been decimated by an error in bio-genetic experimentation: instead of creating super-soldiers, the virus has transformed people into bloodsucking, vampires who in turn spread the disease. Violet, a splendid vampire who has contracted the virus, must protect Six, a boy who possesses the secret for the salvation of humanity: in fact, the cure for all Bloodsucking flows in her blood.
notes: The film is made up of a series of interminable fights set in an aesthetic that oscillates between the glacial commercial of a trendy amaro and the bar video game. The bodies of the actors portrayed on the computer so as to be similar to the abundant digital animations. A pinball machine, a pixelated imaginary where the cinema is not clear where it is, certainly not in the story and much less in the staging. Milla is good, we know, we have always supported her; but if you throw it away with such crap you can only say that it has a great future behind it.

title: The Beautiful Country
actors: Nick Nolte, Tim Roth, Bai Ling, Temuera Morrison, Damien Nguyen
description: 1990. Binh, called since childhood "Bui doi" (or "less than dust", an insult addressed to Vietnamese children with American fathers), is a young Vietnamese who grew up in an adoptive family who leaves the village where he lives to seek his real mother. After spending some time with her, he resumes his journey with the intention of finding his father, an American soldier who has left no traces ...

title: Half Light
actors: Demi Moore, Therese Bradley, Mickey Wilson, Joanna Hole, Hans Matheson, Henry Ian Cusick
description: Rachel Carlson, a successful writer, moves into a cottage in Scotland a year after the tragic death of her son Thomas, but is haunted by guilt. One day, a woman tells her to see Thomas next to her trying to talk to her ...
notes: Moore engages with "metaphysical" atmospheres: the outcome is so-so.

title: Underclassman
actors: Kelly Hu, Nick Cannon, Adrian Young, Art Bonilla, Bart McCarthy, Ian Gomez
description: After the mysterious death of a school newspaper assault reporter, the LAPD captain sends bicycle officer Tracy "Tre" Stokes on an investigative mission. "Tre" goes undercover in the school (an exclusive private high school attended by high society students) and immediately gets into trouble with the principal: but he discovers that the boy's death is linked to a recent series of car thefts in turn part of a bigger deal that also involves drug trafficking ...
notes: Flat and predictable script: It's not with movies like these that Nick Cannon can aspire to the title again Eddie Murphy.

title: Mon petit doigt m'a dit...
actors: Catherine Frot, André Dussollier, Geneviève Bujold, Laurent Terzieff, Valérie Kaprisky, Bernard Verley
description: For a bet made with her husband Colonel Bélisaire, the sprightly Prudence Beresford improvises herself as a detective. In the small provincial village where the two live there is something wrong: an old lady has disappeared, a doll returns from the past and the notary is hiding something ...
notes: The alternation between "pink" brackets and yellow intertwining works very badly: the plot is weighted by cloying dialogues and proceeds in confused jumps (towards the end comes a theft of jewels, a double and other unfair twists). The face of Laurent Terzieff is remembered to the maximum, which seems to be "painted by El Greco" (so says one character).

title: Jazireh ahani
actors: Ali Nasirian, Hossein Farzi-Zadeh, Neda Pakdama
description: In the Persian Gulf, a small community of homeless people settle on an old abandoned oil tanker. As everyone's existence settles down, Captain Nemat, leader of the group, begins to sell the iron parts of the ship. The cargo thus risks sinking, with the hope of those who believed in a new life.
notes: As can be seen from the summary, the second film by the thirty-three-year-old Mohammad Rasoulof (presented at the _Quinzaine des Réalisateurs_ 2005) is based on an allegorical assumption that is all too open. Moreover, perhaps because it derives from a play written by the director himself about ten years ago, it is at times static, even if its chorality is effectively "orchestrated". Luckily the director fills the metaphor with pulp by using the set well, and his ability to work on script and editing is unquestionable. A film that seems the opposite of the increasingly abstract works of the consecrated Iranian masters. The young director tends rather to the sketch, to "pink neorealism", not without a bitter underlying disenchantment.

title: The Yes Men
directors: Dan Ollman, Sarah Price, Chris Smith
description: Two activists became famous all over the world under the name of Yes Men. Mike Bonanno and Andy Bilchbaum have successfully carried out spectacular scams to attract the attention of the mass media and public opinion. Brilliant and brazen they have become the terror of large multinationals, such as oil companies, which they have often managed to make fun of, at the same time arousing the hilarity and indignation of the people. #After numerous battles in the name of noble causes, in particular those related to ecology and environmental protection, the couple of friends found themselves in difficulty. The typical midlife crisis: they are over forty and the realization that not much (at first glance) has changed despite the enormous commitment, meant that the Yes Men epic could end.

title: La tourneuse de pages
actors: Déborah François, Catherine Frot, Pascal Greggory, Xavier De Guillebon
description: Twelve-year-old Mélanie seems well disposed towards the piano and tries the competition for admission to the conservatory, but fails. Deeply disappointed by the casual attitude of the commission president, a famous pianist, she decides not to play anymore. A decade later, Mélanie ends up working in a law firm, headed by the husband of the woman who changed the course of her life ...
notes: A social revenge, subtle, merciless, dilated, which becomes a metaphor for a class revenge. A true 1968 film, played very well by veteran Catherine Frot and the unprecedented, inscrutable, resolute Deborah François.

title: Descent
actors: Luke Perry, Natalie Brown, Michael Dorn, Rick Roberts, Brandi Ward
description: A secret government project to harness alternative energy sources has taken the wrong turn: tectonic plates begin to move causing earthquakes, floods and other terrible natural disasters. To resolve the situation, General Fielding enlisted the help of eccentric scientist Jake Rollins.

title: Komodo vs. Cobra
actors: Michelle Borth, Jerri Manthey, Glori-Anne Gilbert, Ryan McTavish
description: On a remote Pacific island, the US government is conducting a series of top-secret tests on the effect that are capable of causing highly radioactive rays. But something is wrong and the experiment soon turns into a tragedy. A Komodo monitor and a king cobra, subjected to radiation, grow out of all proportion and, once the laboratory is destroyed, wreak havoc on the entire island. No one is able to stop their destructive force and the fight between the two gigantic beasts will be no holds barred.
notes: Pure trash shot on an island in Hawaii.

title: Man-Thing
actors: Matthew Le Nevez, Rachael Taylor, Jack Thompson, Rawiri Paratene
description: Following mysterious deaths in the town of Bywater, Sheriff Kyle will start investigating until he realizes that everything revolves around an ancient legend of the Seminole Indians.

title: The Shape of Things
actors: Gretchen Mol, Paul Rudd, Rachel Weisz, Frederick Weller
description: Adam, an introverted college student who works as a part-time caretaker in a museum, meets Evelyn, a provocative artist and iconoclast. It is love at first sight and a relationship is born between the two, during which the boy introduces her to his best friends, boyfriends Jenny and Philip. But Evelyn's influence causes a drastic change in Adam's character, which begins a clandestine affair with Jenny, thus ruining the relationship with Philip.
notes: A witty film about the eternal battle between the sexes that LaBute drew from one of his plays, choosing the same actors who had already played the roles on stage. Good soundtrack with songs by Elvis Costello

title: 800 balas
actors: Sancho Gracia, Angel de Andrés López, Carmen Maura, Eusebio Poncela

title: Jailbait
actors: Stephen Adly-Guirgis, Michael Pitt, Laila Robins, David Zayas, Eric Trosman
description: Randy is a young man who is accused of drug possession, ends up in court and is convicted. His cellmate is Jake, who serves a life sentence for slitting his wife's throat. Jake is very outgoing in welcoming Randy, whom he immediately asks to be complacent in his requests for sexual favors. The boy is terrified and at first reacts violently.

title: Slow Burn
actors: Ray Liotta, Jolene Blalock, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Donny Falsetti
description: District Attorney Ford Cole is in a heated confrontation with gang leader Luther Pinks. Meanwhile, he is manipulated by the attractive lawyer Nora Timmer and a mysterious witness who accuses the woman: Ford will have 5 hours to unravel the problem ...
notes: The director-screenwriter believes himself to be an author and trivially unleashes the _Rashomon_ effect (different versions of the same event, reconstructed in flashbacks). Thus it masks the most obvious solution behind a series of very smoky about-faces and fragile diversions. All with a style that allows itself intuitive pauses and uses a conceptual and unlikely language.

title: Revolver
actors: Jason Statham, Ray Liotta, Vincent Pastore, Andre Benjamin
description: Jake Green, released from solitary confinement after 7 years in prison, discovers he has a blood disease that will lead to his death in three days. As soon as the news is heard, he is approached by the "loan sharks" gang who promises to protect him from the vengeful boss Macha, who wants him dead for some events that occurred before his imprisonment. In return, he will have to comply with two conditions: give up all his money and obey their instructions ...
notes: After the unfortunate remake of _ Swept away by an unusual fate in the blue sea of ??August_, Guy Ritchie returns to the cinema he knows best, the gangster one. Assisted in the adaptation by Luc Besson, he makes a mediocre, boring and pretentious film.

title: Agent trouble
actors: Catherine Deneuve, Richard Bohringer, Tom Novembre, Dominique Lavanant

title: Dans Paris
actors: Marie-France Pisier, Romain Duris, Louis Garrel, Joana Preiss, Guy Marchand

title: En soap
actors: David Dencik, Trine Dyrholm, Claes Bang, Jakob Ulrik Lohmann
description: Charlotte, in crisis with her partner, has just moved and doesn't know what she wants. Veronica is actually Ulrik, a transsexual in (dramatic) waiting for surgery, lives with the dog Miss Daisy, occasionally prostitutes herself and lives barricaded at home, apart from a few rare visits from her mother (the rest of the family has cut with her).
notes: The film by Danish director Pernille Fisher Christensen is made of suspension. Of gullibility, sexual choices, decisions and the very desire to make them. The title is metadiscursive, it refers to the rhythm, dilated, almost circular, and to the emotional interaction that is established (between and) with the two protagonists. Two fragile souls like those of the truly strong, looking, very difficult, for what the best scripts can only suggest, as in this case. The two performers are exceptional, entrusted with a neurotic tour de force at very high risk. Jury Prize in Berlin 2006.

title: La strada segreta
actors: Irene Ferri, Toni Bertorelli, Francesco D'Ignazio, Franco Trevisi
description: Mauro, a young jazz musician who lives in the Emilia province, is the victim of a very serious accident. Lucy, her twin sister who is an astronomer by profession, arrives at his bedside from Rome. The sister in telepathic relationship with her brother senses that it was not a normal accident.

title: Dr. Terror's House of Horrors
actors: Peter Cushing, Ursula Howells, Christopher Lee, Donald Sutherland
description: During a train journey, the dismal Dr. Shock, thanks to the reading of the cards, predicts to his five traveling companions - an architect, a householder, a trumpeter, an art critic and a doctor, what their future will be.
notes: Horror produced by Amicus, a company founded by Max Rosenberg and Milton Subotsky.

title: The Night Caller
actors: Alfred Burke, John Saxon, Patricia Haines, Alfred Burke, John Carson
description: In London twenty-three girls who had responded to an advertisement have disappeared into thin air. From the examination of a selenium sphere, which came to England from space, it turns out that it is possible to transfer bodies from one planet to another. The scientist who makes the discovery pays with his life, but the police now know that a being from another world has moved to earth. The doctor's assistant will help the detectives by finding the mysterious Madra, an alien from the planet Ganymede and in need of "replenishing" human blood.
notes: Science fiction tinged with horror by the director of _L'ombra del gatto_.

title: Category 6: Day of Destruction
actors: Thomas Gibson, Nancy McKeon, Chandra West, Brian Markinson
description: Chicago is hit by an anomalous heat wave that lasts for weeks. The power games between two power companies, the Midwest and Lexer, cause a terrifying blackout: but that's not all, because two tornadoes are about to hit the city and the inhabitants must be evacuated as soon as possible ...

title: Memoria del saqueo
actors: Mick Jagger, Keith Richards, Ron Wood
description: After the fall of the military dictatorship in 1983, successive democratic governments initiated a series of reforms to transform Argentina into a prosperous and liberal economy. Twenty years later, the Argentines have lost everything: the main national companies have been sold to foreign corporations, the money from privatizations has ended up in the pockets of corrupt officials, workers are exploited, unemployment and poverty reign ...
notes: A real pamphlet for future reference, structured in ten chapters, "narrated" in voice over by the director himself, who at times appears as an interviewer for journalists and political observers. He physically enters the places of power, from the parliament (protagonist the chameleon Menem) to the banks, and goes out among the shacks on the outskirts of Buenos Aires, the demonstrations of the Madres and savers cheated of their savings, up to what remains of the privatized companies and sold off to foreign lobbies. A critical and lucid discourse against globalization, which stands as a reminder of corporatism and the "mafiocracy" that have betrayed and plundered a country.

title: Date Movie
actors: Alyson Hannigan, Adam Campbell, Sophie Monk, Carmen Electra , Tony Cox, Eddie Griffin
description: Julia, an incurable romantic, has met the man of her dreams, the English Grant Fockyerdoder. But before he can get married, he will have to meet his in-laws and deal with Grant's best friend, the beautiful Andy, who will try in every way to make the marriage fail ...
notes: It starts with My Big Fat Greek Wedding, on which Harry Met Sally, Meet My Parents, My Best Friend's Wedding, Bridget Jones, Freak Out, Pretty Woman and other more out-of-the-ordinary romantic comedies pile up in bulk. The whole thing lasts 83 minutes. Too much for a single film.

title: Thumbsucker
actors: Lou Taylor Pucci, Tilda Swinton, Vincent D'Onofrio, Keanu Reeves, Benjamin Bratt, Vince Vaughn, Kelli Garner
description: Justin is a teenager who obsessively sucks his thumb like children, has problems at school and an unrequited crush on Rebecca. His father doesn't want to feel old and insists on being called by name instead of dad, his mother dreams of winning a date with a TV star and his teacher desperately wants to please students to the point of sharing his alcohol with them ...
notes: Bitter coming-of-age tale, with a tone between surreal and grotesque. Together with the contemporary _Napoleon Dynamite_ and _La mia vita a Garden State_, it could be a thread on American marginalized young people: but, despite the cast, it is the least successful of the three.

title: The Sentinel
actors: Michael Douglas, Kiefer Sutherland, Eva Longoria, Martin Donovan, Kim Basinger, Ritchie Coster
description: Pete Garrison, special agent, David Breckinridge, chief of intelligence, and the ambitious Jill Marin, in her first assignment, investigate a plot to kill the president. A traitor is hiding in the high hierarchy of the secret services and the main suspect is Garrison. Who is trying to frame him?
notes: Does the plot remind you of anything? Maybe _In the center of the viewfinder_, Petersen's '93 film with Clint Eastwood? Based on the novel by Gerald Petievich, _The Sentinel_, it seems instead the remake of Petersen's film, plus "there is something rotten in the Services". Icing on the cake: Eva Longoria, unrecognizable, and Kim Basinger who follows (but demeaningfully) her character of _L.A. Confidential_.

title: Curious George
description: A museum is in considerable economic crisis. To save him, the shy guide named Man with the Yellow Hat improvises himself as an adventurer and leaves for Africa in order to find a precious idol. When he returns from his trip, he will take George with him, a cute little monkey that makes trouble. Together, the two will live catastrophic but fun experiences.
notes: Produced by Ron Howard. Inconsistent animated version of the hero for the little ones George, born in the 1930s in the illustrated books by Margret and Hans Augusto Rey. Definitely out of time. Some children identify with it, but the parents sleep in front of a protagonist unable to be understood by the older ones.

title: The Lake House
actors: Keanu Reeves, Sandra Bullock, Shohreh Aghdashloo, Christopher Plummer, Dylan Walsh, Lynn Collins
description: Kate Forester, a doctor who lives alone, begins a close correspondence with the architect Alex Burnham, the new tenant of her house on the lake. the letters that the two exchange are more and more passionate until they discover that they live in different years and that to meet they must overcome the temporal barrier that separates them.
notes: The central idea of ??this film (remake of the Korean _Il mare_) was suggestive, almost a concentrate of the sense of melodrama, suspended between time and eternity: from _The portrait of Jennie_ to _Dream of a prisoner_, to _If you let me delete you_ by Gondry. Written with discreet skill before inevitably wrapping itself between temporal planes, the American version was entrusted to a non-brilliant Argentine director, who floods the whole of songs (up to Paolo Conte), but at times manages to do in a small song of love for Chicago, home of the visionary architecture of the 20th century. But the real temporal paradox that makes the film interesting is the central couple of actors, who find themselves together after _Speed_ (1994) and seem to want to go back to when she was still a diva and he was not yet enchanted by the _Matrix_ saga.

title: The Snow Walker
actors: Barry Pepper, Annabella Piugattuk, James Cromwell, Kiersten Warren

title: Bug
actors: Ashley Judd, Michael Shannon, Harry Connick jr., Lynn Collins, Brian F. O'Byrne, Neil Bergeron, Bob Neill
description: Agnes, whose son disappeared 10 years earlier, lives day to day in a seedy motel along a dusty highway in the middle of the United States. Waitress in a gay club, to have fun occasionally indulges in whiskey and cocaine evenings with a friend. But one day he meets an introverted Gulf War veteran and together they set out on a journey to get rid of their miseries ...
notes: The latest cinematic effort by the director of _L'exorcista_, distributed in Italy only on DVD, tries to reflect the paranoia of a country at war (but not at war) without totally hitting the target. Shot almost entirely in motel rooms, everything is overly loaded and saturated.

title: Blessed
actors: Heather Graham, Fionnula Flanagan, James Purefoy, Alan Mckenna
description: Samantha and Craig are a newly married couple who are very keen to have a baby. However, the analyzes say that she is sterile, so they both decide to resort to artificial fertilization. The clinic dealing with their case actually carries out experiments on embryos, and soon the woman will realize that there is something terrible about her pregnancy.
notes: More than a brother film of _Godsend_ it is a sort of remake of _Rosemary's Baby_. A trend now back in fashion that makes the film even more predictable and obvious. After all, no one seems to believe in the project and the film was already released _straight-to-video_ in the United States.

title: Laguna
actors: Henry Cavill, Joe Mantegna, Sergio Castellitto, Emmanuelle Seigner, Charles Aznavour, Daniela Alviani
description: New York City, 1970s. A terrible accident causes the death of the members of Terenzio Aprea's family. The son Thomas, the only survivor, is entrusted to "uncle Joe" and "uncle Nicola", two Italians who played with their father in pizzerias and at Mafia funerals. After spending his youth in New Yok with Joe, 20-year-old Thomas comes to Venice to work in Nicola's restaurant. Here he meets Thelma, the beautiful and young wife of his uncle, and immediately falls in love with her, not reciprocated. Life in Italy turns out to be even tougher when Thomas uncovers a serious secret about his family's death.
notes: An anomalous mafia movie that can count on a varied and international cast.

title: Trauma
actors: Colin Firth, Naomie Harris, Dorothy Duffy, Cornelius Booth, Mena Suvari
description: Waking up in a hospital bed after spending a week in a coma, Ben learns that his wife lost her life in the car crash in which he was injured. Tormented by guilt, he is admitted to a psychiatric clinic, where he meets Charlotte, whose spirituality conquers him. In fact, Ben agrees to meet a medium, but the séance proves to be destabilizing: the psychic claims that Elisa is still alive!
notes: Formally very glossy, the first feature film with a good budget by Englishman Evans runs aground in the shallows of a screenplay with abused passages and full of holes. And it does not come out.

title: The Keeper
actors: Dennis Hopper, Asia Argento, Helen Shaver, Lochlyn Munro
description: The dancer Gina after being attacked by a maniac who killed her boyfriend, is kidnapped by a policeman with severe mental disorders and an obsession for night club dancers.
notes: B movie with a double plot, unlikely and somewhat boring. Only credit: psychopathic Dennis Hopper.

title: The Painted Veil
actors: Naomi Watts, Edward Norton, Liev Schreiber, Diana Rigg, Zoe Telford
description: Twenties: Kitty followed her husband, Dr. Walter Fane, to China, who - very absorbed in his studies - neglects her. Thus she falls in love with the English vice consul; but when Walter discovers the affair, he forces his wife to follow him to a remote location in China, struck by a deadly cholera epidemic. Here the two, little by little, get closer ...
notes: This by Curran is the thinnest of the three film reductions of William Somerset Maugham's novel, after that of Boleslawsky (1934) and Neame (1957). Especially interesting because, for the first time, the same specific weight is attributed to both protagonists.

title: A Mighty Wind
actors: Parker Posey, Eugene Levy, John Michael Higgins, Christopher Guest, Jane Lynch, Catherine O'Hara, Harry Shearer, Michael McKean
description: On the death of Irving Steinbloom, manager and icon of folk music, his son Johnatan decides to bring together in a great celebratory concert all the musicians his father made (almost) famous in his long career. The memorial is attended by Mitch & Mickey, the trio The Folksmen, and the colorful New Main Street Singers. For just one night, at New York's Town Hall, the bands will put aside misunderstandings and old grudges to play together in homage to Irving and that kind of music.
notes: Guest (also performer and musician) signs a colorful mockumentary that lovingly teases the world of American folk, investigating the lives and careers of non-existent musical groups. Fun and unpretentious.

title: Stupeur et tremblements
actors: Sylvie Testud, Kaori Tsuji, Taro Suwa, Bison Katayama, Yasunari Kondo

title: Atoll K
actors: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Suzy Delair, Max Elloy, Suzet Maïs

title: The Guys
actors: Anthony La Paglia, Sigourney Weaver, Irene Walsh, Jim Simpson, Charlotte Simpson
description: Joan is a reporter who comes into contact with Nick the New York fire captain who lost eight of his company's twelve men in an attempt to evacuate the World Trade Center towers after the terrorist attack. Nick has been given the responsibility of singing their praises at a series of commemorative ceremonies, but he has no experience in this area and isn't sure what to say. Joan offers to help him, and for several days she meets him, highlighting how much (or how little) she knew about his men. Together they try to find the words to honor their memory.
notes: Based on a play by Simpson himself.

title: Hukkle
actors: Ferenc Bandi, Józsefné Rácz, József Forkas, Ferenc Nagy

title: Monique
actors: Albert Dupontel, Marianne Denicourt, Sophie Mounicot, Marina Tomé, Gilles Gaston-Dreyfus
description: After several years of marriage, Alex and Claire lead a sad and bored life. He proves to be more and more taciturn in the couple's relationship, while at work, after a brilliant career as an established photographer, he is increasingly apathetic and unmotivated. When his exasperated wife decides to ditch him and leave with her sculpture teacher, Alex has nothing better to do than order a very expensive sexy doll called "Monique" on the internet. From this moment on, Alex's life will undergo an unexpectedly exciting turn ...
notes: French director Valérie Guignabodet makes a brilliant comedy about the vices and weaknesses typical of middle-aged males.

title: Mon idole
actors: François Berléand, Guillaume Canet, Diane Kruger, Philippe Lefebvre (II)
description: Bastien is a production assistant. While waiting to turn around, he works on the show _It's Tissue Time_, which is to say "time for handkerchiefs", or people who burst into tears in front of the cameras. But his big break could be near: the producer Broustal, his undisputed idol, invites him to spend the weekend in his country house in the company of his charming and very young wife ...
notes: From the crackling satire on the reality world to the game of cat and mouse: too much meat even if the characters are not evil. Or rather, they are completely. First among them is the King Midas of trash TV, fascinating and sneaky like few others, the true engine of the film.

title: A Private Function
actors: Michael Palin, Maggie Smith, Denholm Elliott, Richard Griffiths

title: I Am Dina
actors: Maria Bonnevie, Gérard Depardieu, Christopher Eccleston, Pernilla August

title: Love Liza
actors: Philip Seymour Hoffman, Kathy Bates, J.D. Walsh, Stephen Tobolowsky
description: A man falls into depression and comes into conflict with his mother-in-law after his young wife's unexpected suicide ...
notes: The tragicomic side of human despair in a story that explores the possibilities and impossibilities of reconciliation with life. Always good and up to par Kathy Bates and Philip Seymour Hoffman.

title: Uprising
actors: Leelee Sobieski, Hank Azaria, David Schwimmer, Jon Voight
description: 1939: During the Nazi occupation of Poland, 350,000 Polish Jews are killed by starvation and disease in the Warsaw ghetto. Mordechai and Yitzhak, both teachers, organize the Jewish resistance by founding the Jewish Fighting Organization. In 1943, they will lead about two hundred boys and children in an uneven fight with artisanal weapons against Hitler's troops, managing to resist for several months.
notes: The little-told story episode, the excellent cast and Avnet's choice to ignore the construction of tension before the commercial break make this NBC TV movie a product of cinematic dignity.

title: Morvern Callar
actors: Samantha Morton, Kathleen McDermott, Linda McGuire

title: Evelyn
country: Germany, Ireland, United States, Netherlands, Great Britain
actors: Sophie Vavasseur, Niall Beagan, Pierce Brosnan, Hugh Macdonagh
description: Desmond Doyle falls into despair when his wife abandons the family, even after Christmas. The man is unemployed and has no one to look after his children, so the court entrusts Evelyn, Dermot, and Maurice to a church-run facility, promising their father that he will be able to obtain foster care as soon as he is financially able. While Desmond looks for a job, Evelyn and her brothers grow up in the orphanage ...
notes: Based on a true story, a sentimental film that ends in the pathetic, crowded with stereotypes and interwoven with postcards, definitively flattened by an uninspired direction.

title: Les jours où je n'existe pas
actors: Antoine Chappey, Clémentine Baert, Luis Miguel Cintra, Antoine Michot
description: Antoine exists one day out of two: at the stroke of midnight, every once in a while, he disappears to reappear twenty-four hours later in the same place, completely unaware of what happened during his absence. All this causes him many problems when he meets and falls in love with Clementine, a girl who lives, like anyone else, full time.
notes: Debut feature film by the director of _Sicilia! Si gira_, a documentary dedicated to the _modus filmandi_ by Danièle Huillet and Jean-Marie Straub, is characterized by an insistent use of the pianosequenza and an alienating, almost Brechtian acting. A cultured and enigmatic apologue on time, full of literary quotations and philosophical reflections.

title: Pokemon 4Ever
description: In a forest, Ash meets Sammy, a teleported Pokemon trainer from the past. Together they will try to save Celebi, a legendary Pokemon, from the aims of a hunter.
notes: The fourth installment of the famous animated series involves time travel and few surprises. In Italy it was only released on DVD. For fans only.

title: Silent Night
actors: Linda Hamilton, Matthew Harbour, Romano Orzari, Alain Goulem, Martin Neufeld

title: Le temps qui reste
actors: Melvil Poupaud, Jeanne Moreau, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Marie Rivière, Daniel Duval, Christian Sengewald, Louise-Anne Hippeau, Henri de Lorme, Walter Pagano, Violetta Sanchez, Ugo Soussan Trabelsi, Alba Gaïa Kraghede Bellugi, Victor Poulouin, Laurence Ragon, Thomas Gizolme
description: Romain, thirty years old, is a photographer. One day he discovers that he is suffering from an incurable disease: he has only a few months left to live. As he nears the end he becomes more and more cruel to his partner, hateful to his sister and parents ...
notes: Not everything works in _Le temps qui reste_, and it seems to us a forcing studied at the table for the incursion of the female character, as if to solve with a coup de theâtre the legitimate need for paternity of the homosexual lover. In the first part, however, we fly high and the credit, it must be said, is above all the actors. Very good Melvil Poupaud, who seems refractory to the too symbolic role, like Christ of Mantegna, who perhaps would like to sew Ozon on him, and puts his own effort into facing death with unhealthy nervousness. The most beautiful sequence is that of the confrontation with his father, an extraordinary Daniel Duval.

title: The Waterboy
actors: Adam Sandler, Kathy Bates, Fairuza Balk, Henry Winkler, Jerry Reed
description: Bobby is a water carrier for the college football team in the country where he lives. The clumsy air makes him the favorite target of players and team coach, who enjoy teasing him with constant jokes. The arrival of a new coach will take Bobby to the next level and become an unsurpassed defender, leading his team to victory in the championship.
notes: Great success in the US, this banal comedy rises only thanks to the interpretation of Adam Sandler, capable of giving an extra touch of humanity to a character who otherwise risks remaining a mere speck.

title: Two Thousand Maniacs!!
actors: William Kerwin, Connie Mason, Jeffrey Allen, Ben Moore
description: Six North American tourists end up in a southern town, Pleasant Valley, which celebrates the centenary of the Civil War. The country turns out to be inhabited by bloodthirsty murder maniacs of the Yankees.

title: Color Me Blood Red
actors: Gordon Oas-Heim, Candi Conder, Elyn Warner, Pat Lee, Jerome Eden
description: An eccentric artist, Adam Sorg, finds the right color in human blood to paint his pictures. After using his own, he decides to procure the raw material by carrying out a series of heinous murders.

title: The Wizard of Gore
actors: Ray Sager, Judy Cler, Wayne Ratay, Phil Laurenson
description: Montag is an illusionist who during his shows submits some spectators to all kinds of torture. The girls return unknown between the public, but after about an hour the wounds caused by the magician reappear, causing death.

title: The Gore Gore Girls
actors: Frank Kress, Amy Farrell, Hedda Lubin, Henny Youngman
description: Detective Abraham Gentry investigates the crimes of some topless bar dancers. After a roundup of imaginative murders, Gentry unmasks the serial killer.

title: Blood Feast 2: All U Can Eat
actors: John McConnell, Mark McLachlan, Melissa Morgan, Toni Wynne, J.P. Delahoussaye, Chris Mauer, John Waters, David F. Friedman
description: Fuad Ramses III, grandson of the murderous maniac of _Blood Feast_, reopens his grandfather's restaurant in the same spirit and in the same way as his crazy predecessor.

title: Mala noche
actors: Doug Cooeyate, Sam Downey, Nyla McCarthy, Ray Monge
description: A clerk in a drugstore that is a hangout for alcoholic and smokers' dropouts, Walt falls desperately in love with Johnny, a Mexican illegal immigrant who doesn't speak a word of English and has arrived in Portland with his friend Pepper. Johnny doesn't care about Walt, but he plays the game to scrounge him a few beers and a few meals, even Walt agrees to be mistreated, perhaps because he believes that people today are too far from the concept of death.
notes: Gus Van Sant's first feature film, shot for $ 25,000 in contrasting black and white, is vaguely inspired by an autobiographical tale by the poet Walt Curtis.

title: Pas sur la bouche
actors: Sabine Azéma, Isabelle Nanty, Audrey Tautou, Pierre Arditi

title: Babangon ako't dudurugin kita
actors: Sharon Cuneta, Christopher De Leon, Hilda Koronel, Bembol Roco
description: Hi falls in love with the ambitious and penniless Alfred. The boy would like to start his own business, but in order to do so he must accept the help of Salve's father. The two get married, but things get worse and Alfred gets together with the woman who offered him a job: Hi, he falls into misfortune, and little by little he ponders revenge ...
notes: Heartbreaking mello.

title: Natutulog ba ang diyos
actors: Ricky Davao, Lorna Tolentino, Gary Valenciano, Marita Zobel
description: Andrew and Gillian were born at the same time and on the same van from two very different families. Andrew's parents are wealthy landowners, while Gillian's are mere servants. The problem is that the latter decide to exchange them without the knowledge of the other couple.
notes: Brocka's food film.

title: Macho Dancer
actors: Jacklyn Rose, Daniel Fernando, Alan Paule, William Lorenzo
description: Arriving in Manila from the province, the young Paul enters a gay prostitution ring. Instructed by the boys of the brothel where he works, he becomes a stripper: but the police brutally extort the "macho dancers"; and after a beating, Paul finds the help and love of a prostitute and the friendship of a "colleague", who has lost his sister. The two will find her in a brothel and try to snatch her from her pimps, complete with a tragic shooting.
notes: Masterpiece of the greatest filmmaker in the Philippines (but little loved at home), this film by Lino Brocka, between Fassbinder and Friedkin, as between noir and melò, composes a merciless portrait.

title: Pasan ko ang daigdig
actors: Sharon Cuneta, Tonton Gutierrez, Loretta Marquez
description: Lupe found herself an adult without having been a teenager, a victim of a degraded environment and without opportunities. Forced to look after her mother, who is seriously ill, she dreams of leaving everything behind and finding happiness, but the ransom has a very high price ...
notes: Brocka signs another ruthless portrait of Philippine society.

title: Octane
actors: Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Madeleine Stowe, Norman Reedus, Bijou Phillips

title: Live Once, Die Twice
actors: Kellie Martin, Sadie LeBlanc, Cindy Sampson, Bruce Gray, Mark Antony Krupa
description: Nicole's life is destroyed by the accident that makes her the widow of her husband who died during a fishing trip. The police have strong doubts about the tragedy because the man's body is not found. One day Nicole is contacted by her husband's friend who confides in her that there is something sinister in the affair.

title: Éloge de l'amour
actors: Bruno Putzulu, Cecile Camp, Jean Davy, Françoise Verny, Audrey Klebaner

title: La truite
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Jean-Pierre Cassel, Jeanne Moreau, Daniel Olbrychski
description: Young Frederique (Isabelle Huppert) lives in a country town, works in the family trout farm and is trapped in a boring marriage with Galuchat. Tired of provincial life, she decides to abandon everything and everyone to move to the city and enter the financial sector. However, he ends up in a ruthless corporate universe, where he relies on his predatory fascination with men to move forward.

title: Kicking and Screaming
actors: Josh Hamilton, Sam Gould, Catherine Kellner, Jonathan Baumbach
description: After graduating from college, Jane tells her fiancé Glover that she wants to move to Prague to study. Glover declines the invitation to accompany her, deciding to go and live with some friends, who prefer to be in a state of inertia rather than devote themselves to study. None of them want to make fundamental decisions but, at the same time, nobody wants to end up like Chet, the student who still works in a bar in his 10th year of university.

title: Fort Saganne
actors: Gérard Depardieu, Philippe Noiret, Catherine Deneuve, Sophie Marceau

title: L'été meurtrier
actors: Isabelle Adjani, Alain Souchon, Suzanne Flon, Jenny Clève

title: The Bridge of San Luis Rey
actors: F. Murray Abraham, Kathy Bates, Gabriel Byrne, Geraldine Chaplin, Robert De Niro, Harvey Keitel, Javier Corbe, Dominique Pinon, Pilar López de Ayala, Samuel Le Bihan, Mark Polish, Michael Polish, Adriana Domínguez, John Lynch, Emilie Dequenne

title: Camille Claudel
actors: Isabelle Adjani, Gérard Depardieu, Laurent Grévill, Alain Cuny

title: Greendale
actors: Sarah White, Eric Johnson, Ben Keith, Erik Markegard, Elizabeth Keith

title: Silver City
actors: Chris Cooper, Richard Dreyfuss, Danny Huston, Michael Murphy, Kris Kristofferson
description: During the election campaign for the election of the future governor in Colorado, Dicky Pilager's name ends up in the crosshairs of enemies when he comes across a dead body while filming a commercial for environmental politics. His campaign manager, Chuck Raven, then decides to hire Danny O'Brien, a former journalist turned private detective, to understand the connections between the victim and the enemies of the Pilager family.

title: Sunshine
actors: Ralph Fiennes, Rosemary Harris, Rachel Weisz, Jennifer Ehle

title: Dominion: Prequel to the Exorcist
actors: Stellan Skarsgård, Gabriel Mann, Clara Bellar, Billy Crawford

title: Clean, Shaven
actors: Jennifer MacDonald, Peter Greene, Alice Levitt, Megan Owen

title: Claire Dolan
actors: Katrin Cartlidge, Vincent D'Onofrio, Colm Meaney, Patrick Husted

title: Keane
actors: Damian Lewis, Abigail Breslin, Amy Ryan, Liza Colón-Zayas

title: Drawing Restraint 9
actors: Shigeru Akahori, Matthew Barney, Björk, Koji Maki, Yushin Maru

title: The Chumscrubber
actors: Glenn Close, Kathy Copeland, Jamie Bell, Camilla Belle, Justin Chatwin
description: Troy, apparently an ordinary teenager, actually sells drugs to his schoolmates. When the boy is found dead in his room, hanged himself during one of the pool parties organized by his mother, the hunt for pills is officially on: Billy, Lee and Crystal know, in fact, that it is Dean who knows his hiding place .. .
