notes: Small murders between friends and others: kidnappings, drug use and sale, disinterested parents and all the degradation and indifference of the American province. A formidable cast, put together and then thrown to the wind: first of all Ralph Fiennes, who tries in vain to escape from the stereotype in which he was cast.

title: Dahmer
actors: Jeremy Renner, Bruce Davison, Artel Kayàru, Matt Newton

title: Down in the Valley
actors: Edward Norton, Evan Rachel Wood, David Morse, Rory Culkin, Bruce Dern
description: In today's desolate San Fernando Valley, Harlan is an anachronistic and disillusioned cowboy. One day he meets Tobe, a 17-year-old rebellious and romantic, and his brother Lonnie. A friendship is born with the boy and a passionate relationship with Tobe, but destined to have dramatic implications due to her father, the policeman Wade, against the love story.
notes: A film that leans neither towards the melancholy of a lost universe nor towards the narrow-mindedness of an integralist contemporaneity. It moves with thoughtful times, with an apt cast (good Norton, also producer, and Morse) and with a generous romanticism that belongs to the people as well as to the urban context.

title: Tout feu, tout flamme
actors: Yves Montand, Isabelle Adjani, Lauren Hutton, Alain Souchon
description: Pauline is used to taking care of the whole family: when her father makes yet another trouble, she is the one who takes care to intervene. This will be how the two will learn to know each other ...
notes: Rappeneau directs an agile, funny and above all brilliant comedy. The Adjani-Montand couple works wonders.

title: Strings
actors: James McAvoy, Catherine McCormack, Julian Glover, Derek Jacobi

title: Les enfants du siècle
actors: Juliette Binoche, Benoît Magimel, Stefano Dionisi, Robin Renucci
description: The passion between a brave writer and a decadent poet ...
notes: Based on a true story, Kurys's film is an amour fou tale that too often gets bogged down in discussions and literary ambitions, resulting in lengthened and pretentious. Good alchemy between the performers.

title: The Dark
actors: Sean Bean, Maria Bello, Richard Elfyn, Maurice Roëves, Abigail Stone
description: Adelle travels with young Sarah to the remote farm bought by her father, James, on the Welsh coast. Adelle, who is already suffering from hysterics, progressively loses control of herself when Sarah appears to have drowned. The place - it turns out - has been cursed since, fifty years earlier, a mass suicide took place on the same cliffs. The colors become supernatural with the appearance of Ebril, a child who died in that ritual past ...
notes: Burdened by ponderous dialogue, the rather long wait of the horror segments becomes hard to bear. At the point, the chills pay off only in part.

title: Kinky Boots
actors: Sarah-Jane Potts, Joel Edgerton, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Ewan Hooper
description: Charlie is the latest heir to an English shoe factory with a noble past, now in crisis due to the economic situation and reckless financial choices. Charlie stumbles upon an unexpected opportunity when he meets Simon, a young black man who performs at night as a "drag queen" with the name Lola. The boots she will make for him will prove to be an unexpected success ...
notes: Definitely derivative of the sexy-proletarian comedy of _Full Monty_, this is a film probably out of time. Taken in and of itself, however, it remains an enjoyable product, especially thanks to the graceful Anglo-Nigerian Chiwetel Ejiofor.

title: The Sentinel
actors: Chris Sarandon, Cristina Raines, Martin Balsam, John Carradine, José Ferrer, Ava Gardner

title: Bandidas
actors: Penélope Cruz, Salma Hayek, Steve Zahn, Dwight Yoakam, Denis Arndt, Audra Blaser, Sam Shepard
description: Mexico, early 1900s. Sara Sandoval, daughter of a banker, and Maria Alvarez, of peasant origins, team up to oppose Tyler Jackson, an official of the Bank and Trust of New York, charged with expropriating land for the railroad. The two girls soon become wanted and Inspector Quentin is put on their trail ...
notes: Based on the distant model of Malle's _Viva Maria! _ (With the Bardot-Moreau couple), Luc Besson produces a western with two characters too stereotyped to be funny (the upper-class woman struggling with the harshness of the West, and the woman of the people ). Unbearable protagonists from the first minute.

title: Imagine Me & You
actors: Piper Perabo, Lena Headey, Matthew Goode, Celia Imrie, Anthony Head, Darren Boyd
description: It's the big day for Rachel who is about to marry Heck, her long-time lover and best friend: but as she is walking towards the altar, her gaze falls on Luci, the wedding florist, and she is struck by love at first sight. . As the ceremony progresses, Rachel is increasingly in crisis ...
notes: Yet another cuteness with a gay background, with the character of Luci who looks like a real gallant prince charming. Designed for those looking for the "happy ending", it describes well how a story can begin (and end), but it is characterized by an excessive compliance towards the outing of True Love: together, its greatest defect and value.

title: Workingman's Death
description: An overview of manual work around the world. In "Heroes" you can see men and women who spend their lives in the coal mines of Ukraine, which have been declared illegal for years. "Ghosts" takes place among Indonesian open pit sulfur miners. "Leoni" tells about work in a Nigerian slaughterhouse; "Brothers" focuses on workers disarming disused ships with blowtorches in Pakistan. In "Future" we move to China with the work in blast furnaces. Finally we go to Germany where a foundry has been transformed into a tourist attraction.
notes: Refined assemblage of atrocious and fascinating images of five extreme work situations around the planet. Death at work, the work of death: the short circuit with the essence of cinema is there, and also the fallout from liberalism, globalization, de-unionization. If it is true that working, as the quote from Faulkner with which the Austrian Glawogger opens the film says, is the only thing that man can do for hours every day. And that leads him to be so unhappy. Extraordinary.

title: Shutter
actors: Ananda Everingham, Natthaweeranuch Thongmee, Achita Sikamana, Unnop Chanpaibool
description: Tun, a young photographer, and his wife Jane run over a girl and escape without rescuing her. When shortly after they develop some photos taken at a party, they see a female figure appear: it turns out that the ethereal presence is Natre, an old girlfriend of Tun. The two will go to the girl's village to investigate her mysterious apparitions: but new disturbing secrets are hidden in other photographs ...
notes: Yet another oriental "stencil" horror: to those who already know the genre it does not offer much more than a technical exercise and a slew of clichés and predictable twists. It was inevitable that an American remake was made.

title: Junebug
actors: Embeth Davidtz, David Kuhn, Alessandro Nivola, Alicia Van Couvering
description: The accomplished George Johnsten meets the gallery owner Madeleine in Chicago during a charity auction and it is love at first sight. When Madeleine decides to meet an artist originally from the South of the States, George takes the opportunity to introduce her to his family, who live in North Carolina. However, the choice will soon open a Pandora's box, from which old emotions, rivalries and jealousies will re-emerge.

title: L'après-midi d'un tortionnaire
actors: Gheorghe Dinica, Radu Beligan, Ioana Ana Macaria, Coca Bloos, Dorina Chiriac
description: Frant Tandara, a former torturer of the Romanian prisons, more than ten years after the fall of the Ceausescu regime is ready to confess his crimes to a journalist and a former political prisoner, whom he welcomes with a bouquet of flowers. Between technical problems and the reticence of the interviewee, who speaks either too fast or too slowly, the interview finds it hard to get going. To curb the insistence of the journalists, Tandara's wife intervenes, asking them to stop torturing her husband!
notes: Pintilie, a Romanian director forced first into silence and then into exile from 1979 to 1991, chooses to stage the humanity of the monster to tell, not without paradoxical touches, the banality of evil.

title: Eroica
actors: Edward Dziewonski, Barbara Polomska, Ignacy Machowski
description: Film built on two episodes, both set in the Second World War. In the first "Polish Scherzo", a cunning boy, in an attempt to save his skin, becomes a hero and finds a reason to fight.

title: Invisible Waves
actors: Tadanobu Asano, Hye-jeong Kang, Eric Tsang, Maria Cordero
description: Forced by his employer, a Hong Kong boss, to kill his wife after having had a clandestine relationship with her for months, the Japanese cook Kyoji is sent by ship to Thailand: in theory to calm things down a bit, in practice to be eliminated away from prying eyes.

title: Kaena: La prophétie
description: At the top of Axis, a gigantic plant that stretches above the clouds, is a village that is in great danger. Axis is in fact withering away. The villagers pray to their gods but nothing happens until Kaena, a rebellious young girl supported by a mysterious force, challenges the High Priest and the ancestral beliefs of her people by venturing to earth to discover what dark secrets lurk beyond. beneath the blanket of clouds.

title: Irène
actors: Cécile De France, Bruno Putzulu, Olivier Sitruk, Estelle Larrivaz
description: Irène is thirty years old, an excellent career, an apartment with a view of Paris and many nice friends, but he is still single. So she decides to start the search for Prince Charming ...

title: Just My Luck
actors: Lindsay Lohan, Chris Pine, Faizon Love, Missi Pyle, Tom Fletcher
description: Ashley Albright is the luckiest girl in Manhattan, but Blindfolded Goddess turns her back when she kisses Jake Hardin, aspiring rock band manager at a costume party. As Ashley's life plunges into the abyss of black cats, broken mirrors, and walking under flights of stairs, Jake suddenly lands a great deal and starts a successful career. The two, of course, are destined to meet again ...
notes: Predictable both in the gags on bad luck and in the well-known romantic plot, the film signals Lindsay Lohan's debut on the big screen as the protagonist, immediately "rewarded" by a nomination for the Razzies.

title: The Benchwarmers
actors: Rob Schneider, David Spade, Jon Heder, Jon Lovitz, Craig Kilborn, Molly Sims, Tim Meadows
description: All their lives, Gus, Richie and Clark sat on the sidelines, living in the shadow of the school's great baseball stars. But now the big break has come for them. With the help of coach Mel, they have to contend with one of the strongest teams in the student league.
notes: Undoubtedly the film is over the top, so it would be unfair to evaluate the behavior of the characters by comparing them with real people. But it is disturbing to see how these adults try to increase their self-esteem by outclassing and humiliating young children, however much one tries to portray them as "bullies".

title: Silent Hill
actors: Radha Mitchell, Sean Bean, Laurie Holden, Deborah Kara Unger, Kim Coates, Jodelle Ferland
description: Little Sharon has recurring nightmares in which the name of a place appears, Silent Hill. His mother Rose decides to go there: but once at her destination, Sharon mysteriously disappears ...
notes: Inspired above all by the first chapter of the videogame, with the child who transforms her deformed anxieties but also her desires into reality, a sumptuous film that unfortunately fails to scare. The presence of Roger Avary is completely superfluous, in the sense that the script seems to be a component not received, or at least not perceived, and the film suffers, revealing itself to be an empty shell. With wonderful inlays, but still a shell.

title: Dracula: Pages from a Virgin's Diary
actors: Zhang Wei-Qiang, Tara Birtwhistle, David Moroni, CindyMarie Small

title: Cowards Bend the Knee
actors: Darcy Fehr, Melissa Dionisio, Amy Stewart, Tara Birtwhistle

title: Notte italiana
actors: Mario Adorf, Giulia Boschi, Marco Messeri, Tino Carraro, Roberto Citran
description: Otello, a Paduan lawyer, goes to the Po delta area to make an estimate on land to be expropriated. On the spot he meets many people and discovers, more or less involuntarily, the misdeeds and connivance of a local squire. Shocked and disappointed, he returns to town with Daria, a sweet girl from Polesine.

title: Tideland
actors: Jeff Bridges, Jodelle Ferland, Alden Adair, Wendy Anderson
description: Jeliza-Rose and her father Noah move to Texas after her mother dies from an overdose. The next night Noah follows in his wife's footsteps. Jeliza-Rose withdraws into herself, conversing only with doll heads that she sticks on her fingers, until she meets her singular neighbors, Dickens and sister Dell.
notes: Tideland is a very personal film, imaginative and macabre, scary and funny, fairytale and layered. Gilliam builds a sort of Alice in the land of horrors in total and anarchoid freedom, making a film more fascinating than accomplished but with a richness, a refinement of style, an inventiveness such as to be forgiven for all inconclusions, the result more of creative generosity than of real gaps.

title: 13 (Tzameti)
actors: George Babluani, Pascal Bongard, Aurélien Recoing, Fred Ulysse
description: A young tinsmith who by chance takes the place of a truand who died of an overdose for not sure what deal. As in a blues score, the boy just has to show up at the crossroads and show the fateful number. Accompanied to a remote location, despite himself he discovers the plot. He is the thirteenth participant in a circular Russian roulette: you aim the gun at the back of the head of those in front of you. To the survivors - and the bored rich who bet on them - a lot of money. But the mythology of failure has its rules, and winners take risks too.
notes: Very dry, with a black and white that in intentions looks more at Ejzenstejn than at Melville, Babluani's film is as cold as a dagger blade, yet it does not forget a certain basic humanism, so as not to lead us into the temptation to think of the characters as a numbers. Almost a _Hostel_ in polar version, or a _Do not horses kill themselves like this? _ But set in the milieu. Intense the protagonist Georges, brother of the director, and amazing as usual Aurélien Recoing.

title: The Saddest Music in the World
actors: Mark McKinney, Isabella Rossellini, Maria De Medeiros, David Fox
description: 1933 Winnipeg (Canada). During the era of the great depression, the owner of a brewery, Lady Port-Huntly (Isabella Rossellini), to increase the use of alcohol, decides to organize a competition for the saddest song in the world.
notes: The hasty and plastic montage from impressionist and silent cinema (like L'Herbier), a legless Rossellini who could have lived in a Tod Browning film and the uninterrupted air from Sanremo / Helzapoppin 'of the entire operation, actively collaborate to make of the film a bitter and inventive bizarre, supported by a style without uncertainty and a decidedly anarchic humor.

title: Destricted
directors: Marina Abramovic, Matthew Barney, Marco Brambilla, Larry Clark, Gaspar Noé, Richard Prince, Sam Taylor Wood
description: Seven directors explore the boundary between art and pornography.

title: Mimic 2
actors: Alix Koromzay, Bruno Campos, Will Estes, Gaven Eugene Lucas
description: Entomologist Remy, a biology teacher in New York, is suspected by police detective Klaski of being the "black widow" serial killer. Soon, however, elements emerge that reveal how the killer is actually a monstrous mutant insect, capable of assuming human features ...

title: Comment je me suis disputé... (ma vie sexuelle)
actors: Denis Podalydès, Mathieu Amalric, Emmanuelle Devos, Emmanuel Salinger, Thibault de Montalembert, Chiara Mastroianni

title: On a volé la Joconde
actors: George Chakiris, Marina Vlady, Margaret Lee, Paul Frankeur
description: In 1910 Vincent, a gentleman thief, achieves an exceptional feat by stealing the Mona Lisa from the Louvre museum in Paris. Falling in love with Nicole, a beautiful maid who prefers money to love, Vincent will be forced to flee through France with policemen and bandits at his heels interested in tracking down the painting.

title: Quicksand
actors: Michael Keaton, Michael Caine, Judith Godrèche, Rade Serbedzija
description: A New York banker, Martin Raikes, is sent to the South of France to investigate a film set that the bank he works for is financing. Not more than a day goes by and a government officer is killed on the set, and Martin finds himself accused of inadvertently putting his hands on the murder weapon. Pursued by gangsters and corrupt policemen, the banker escapes revealing himself to be very ingenious in disguises: he manages to get in touch with two of the protagonists of the film and tries to prove his innocence, but the pursuers also raise the stakes taking Martin's son prisoner ...

title: Geuddae geusaramdeul
actors: Song Jae-ho, Han Suk-kyu, Baek Yun-shik, Jeong Won-jung
description: On October 26, 1979, Korean President Park Chung Hee, in office since the 1961 coup, was assassinated by Kim Jae Kyo, the director of secret services. But what are the events leading up to the fateful night?

title: Le petit lieutenant
actors: Nathalie Baye, Jalil Lespert, Roschdy Zem, Antoine Chappey
description: Antoine is an ambitious young man who, despite a wife in Le Havre, asks to be assigned to Paris at the end of the police school. Here comes Caroline Vadieu, a former alcoholic, to take over. An encounter between two solitudes and a dry and unconventional representation of life in the police. Best European film of the Venice Days in 2005.

title: Salinui chueok
actors: Kang-ho Song, Kim Sang-kyung, Kim Roeha, Song Jae-ho
description: 1986: a young woman is found raped and killed near a provincial village. A couple of months later, more rapes and murders follow in similar circumstances. The local detective, Park Doo-man, is assisted by Seo Tae-yoon, who came specially from Seoul, but the investigations do not take off ...
notes: Bong Joon-ho, one of the most promising directors of the new cinema in Seoul, creates an atypical and political thriller about a difficult moment in Korean history: in fact, the ethical contradictions of a country where censorship and repression, applied mechanically, result in the intertwining in the grotesque, to the point of paralyzing the investigations ..

title: Angst
actors: Erwin Leder, Rudolf Götz, Silvia Rabenreither, Edith Rosset

title: Double Whammy
actors: Denis Leary, Elizabeth Hurley, Luis Guzmán, Victor Argo, Chris Noth
description: Police Officer Ray Pluto lives with the horrifying memory of a car accident in which his wife and son lost their lives. Ray, trying to stop mad murderer who shoots wildly, gets hit with severe pain in his back and loses his gun. A child picks it up and kills the killer with the weapon, becoming a hero and transforming Ray into the laughing stock of colleagues and journalists. The man will be able to raise his fortunes by saving the life of a neighbor and finally finding love.

title: When Will I Be Loved
actors: Neve Campbell, Frederick Weller, Ashley Shelton, James Toback

title: La fille seule
actors: Virginie Ledoyen, Benoît Magimel, Dominique Valadié, Véra Briole

title: A Dirty Shame
actors: Tracey Ullman, Johnny Knoxville, Selma Blair, Chris Isaak, Suzanne Shepherd
description: Sylvia Stickles is a sexually repressed woman who develops an insatiable sexual appetite following a car accident that causes her a concussion.

title: La boîte noire
actors: Bernard Lecoq, José Garcia, Marion Cotillard, Michel Duchaussoy
description: After a serious car accident, where he is convinced he has killed a boy, Arthur Seligman falls into a coma for several hours and wakes up in the hospital, suffering from confusion syndrome and unable to remember the moments before the accident. The nurse records on tape the words pronounced by Arthur in a state of consciousness: the man will thus try to shed light on the origins of the accident, trying to extricate himself from ghosts, memories and hallucinations.
notes: Before shooting the polar L'Immortale, in 2010, the French actor Richard Berry made his directorial debut with this anomalous psycho-thriller, contaminated by mystery suggestions and folded on the alterations of conscience of the tormented protagonist.

title: Deux
actors: Isabelle Huppert, Bulle Ogier, Manuel Blanc, Arielle Dombasle

title: Saving Face
actors: Michelle Krusiec, Joan Chen, Lynn Chen, Wang Jin, Koh Guang Lan
description: A woman of Chinese origin, an established surgeon, already has a rather complicated life: she is in love with a colleague, but she does not have the courage to declare her homosexuality. Things get worse when the mother shows up at her pregnant door. To avoid the shame, unacceptable for oriental culture, of becoming a single mother, the girl sets out on a search for a Chinese bachelor to introduce her ...
notes: A polite comedy that deals with large-scale themes (the gap between too different cultures, the widespread prejudices of a social and sexual nature) with lightness of gaze and writing, without falling into the stereotype of the eternal mother-daughter clash of generations.

title: Lila dit ça
actors: Vahina Giocante, Mohammed Khouas, Karim Ben Haddou

title: Straight Time
actors: Dustin Hoffman, Theresa Russell, Gary Busey, Harry Dean Stanton
description: Max Dembo, released from jail and provoked by Earl Frank, the sadistic guardian of his bail, tries to go straight. However, he gets involved by his friend Jerry in organizing a robbery at a jewelry store ...
notes: From Edward Bunker's autobiographical novel _Come una ferociabia_, which also appears in a small part, the film was initially directed by Dustin Hoffman (with the collaboration of a young Michael Mann), who was then succeeded by Grosbard. The tension of the robbery and chases is well thought out; moreover, the screenplay has an admirable realistic adherence and finds a "loser" yet never pathetic protagonist.

title: Talk of Angels
actors: Polly Walker, Vincent Perez, Franco Nero, Frances McDormand, Ruth McCabe, Marisa Paredes
description: 1930s: To escape the pressures associated with her imminent marriage to an activist, the young Irishwoman Mary travels to Spain. But here, hired by a rich family as a governess, she finds herself in a similar situation, attracted to a married man engaged in the revolt against Franco ...
notes: A bit artificial, but acceptable.

title: Fakiren fra Bilbao
actors: Sidse Babett Knudsen, Julie Zangenberg, Moritz Bleibtreu, Aksel Leth
description: Their names are Emma and Tom, they are thirteen years old and are identical as two drops of water: when - together with their mother - they move into an old and mysterious mansion, they find themselves involved with a nice and lively sprite in an intrigue based on spells, spells and a very precious diamond ...

title: Deathwatch
actors: Jamie Bell, Rúaidhrí Conroy, Mike Downey, Laurence Fox

title: Fear X
actors: John Turturro, James Remar, Nadia Litz, Amanda Ooms
description: When his wife is killed in a seemingly random accident, Harry Cain, agitated and moved by mysterious visions, begins a journey to discover the true circumstances that led to that death. He spends his nights viewing tapes recorded by CCTV cameras in the mall where the tragedy occurred. His obsession grows from tape to tape, as the police gradually lose interest in the case ...
notes: Definitely the worst film by the Danish Refn, it is also the only one distributed in Italy. After a morbid and stylistically flawless first part, it struggles to take off and gets lost as the reason of its protagonist. Final to forget.

title: Last Call
actors: Jeremy Irons, Neve Campbell, Sissy Spacek, Shannon Lawson, Paul Hecht

title: Infidelity
actors: Kim Delaney, Kyle Secor, Cristián de la Fuente, John Maxwell
description: Danielle, a charming couples therapist, cheats on her husband Jim with young Miguel. As the relationship consolidates, the game becomes more and more dangerous so that Danielle's situation gets out of hand. The woman is trapped in a double life from which she can no longer get out.

title: Branca de neve
actors: Reginaldo da Cruz, Ana Brandão, Luis Miguel Cintra, Diogo Dória, João César Monteiro
description: After some photographs of the corpse of the Swiss writer Robert Walser, found in the snow in Herisau in 1956, the screen is invaded by darkness: the tale of Snow White is taken from where the Grimm brothers left it, that is, since the prince awakens Snow White, but this time the heroine refuses the happy end ...

title: Walkabout
actors: Jenny Agutter, David Gulpilil, Lucien John, John Meillon
description: A fourteen-year-old girl and her six-year-old brother are left alone in the Australian desert by her suicidal father. An aboriginal helps them, but in the meantime he triggers a sexual tension with the girl that will have a tragic and unexpected outcome ...
notes: Fascinating second work for the former operator Roeg.

title: When in Rome
actors: Mary-Kate Olsen, Ashley Olsen, Leslie Danon, Derek Lee Nixon
description: Leila and Charly are in Rome to participate in a summer internship at a fashion house. The inexperience of the two and the aversion nurtured towards them by the director of the Roman offices of the "maison", however, led to their dismissal. Meanwhile, the love stories between Charly and Paolo and between Derek and Jami intertwine.

title: Petites coupures
actors: Daniel Auteuil, Kristin Scott Thomas, Pascale Bussières, Ludivine Sagnier
description: Bruno, a journalist faithful to the ideals of communism but disappointed in politics, is above all a man who loves women, from wife to lover. One day his uncle, a candidate for mayor, asks him for help in organizing the electoral campaign. Bruno goes to the mountain village where he lives: there he meets a woman who thunders him.

title: Gods and Generals
actors: Jeff Daniels, Stephen Lang, Robert Duvall, Mira Sorvino, Kevin Conway, C. Thomas Howell

title: Owning Mahowny
actors: Philip Seymour Hoffman, Minnie Driver, Maury Chaykin, John Hurt, Sonja Smits, Ian Tracey, Roger Dunn
description: A bank manager has a terrible habit that gets him in trouble: gambling.
notes: Based on the novel Stung by G.S. Ross, which is based on the biggest banking fraud in Canada.

title: Freedom
actors: Fatima Ennaflaoui, Valentinas Masalskis, Axel Neumann

title: Deuces Wild
actors: Stephen Dorff, Brad Renfro, Fairuza Balk, Matt Dillon, Ronnie Marmo, Shamus Murphy, Alex City, James Franco
description: In 1950s New York, dominated by gang wars, Leon and Bobby have lost a brother to an overdose and are now fighting to keep drugs out of their neighborhood, along with the Deuces gang. To hinder the plans come the rivals Vipers, determined to export shady trades out of their territory: the clash between gangs will be inevitable.
notes: Despite the good cast of young actors, the film suffers from an artificiality that makes it not very credible: the reconstruction of New York half a century ago is lacking in depth and the dialogues sound fake. Life and fiction are tragically confused in the fate of Brad Renfro, who died in 2008, aged just 25, from a heroin overdose.

title: Der Heilige Berg
actors: Leni Riefenstahl, Luis Trenker, Ernst Petersen, Frida Richard

title: L'altra donna
actors: Anita Caprioli, Alessio Boni, Monica Carmen Comegna, Edoardo Baietti
description: The architect Simone and Fiammetta, a happy couple with their son, live a peaceful life and share dreams and passions. But one day, after Simone has appeared on TV, Fiammetta begins to receive anonymous phone calls, strange gifts, bunches of roses and a videotape that reproduces a cheerful family with a child ...

title: The Cat's Meow
actors: Kirsten Dunst, Edward Herrmann, Eddie Izzard, Cary Elwes, Joanna Lumley, Jennifer Tilly
description: The true story of the mysterious murder of the great producer and "father of the Western" Thomas H. Ince, which took place in 1924 on the Oneida, the yacht of media magnate William Randolph Hearst on which illustrious guests such as Charlie were together that same weekend. Chaplin, diva Marion Davis (the owner's non-secret lover) and gossip columnist Louella Parsons.
notes: Adaptation of a play by Steven Peros. The subject is based on a real fact that Bogdanovich learned in the past from Orson Welles. Excellent script, refined storytelling and brilliant interpretations of the protagonists. Hollywood Confidential does not betray the unmistakable style of the master.

title: Prozac Nation
actors: Christina Ricci, Anne Heche, Michelle Williams, Jason Biggs, Jonathan Rhys Meyers
description: Elizabeth struggles with depression in her freshman year of college at Harvard.
notes: Based on the autobiographical novel of the same name by Elizabeth Wurtzel: a film full of defects, exaggerated and exaggerated, uncertain between the tones of drama and black comedy, but supported by an intense performance by Christina Ricci.

title: The Warrior
actors: Irfan Khan, Puru Chibber, Aino Annuddin, Manoj Mishra
description: Rajahstan is oppressed by a cruel lord, who squeezes the villages under the threat of his ferocious warriors. Their leader Lafcadia, engaged in yet another devastation, almost kills a girl who discovers she is tied to her son. In remorse, the warrior abandons his sword and takes refuge in his village in the Himalayas: but his master has asked for the head of the traitor and his emissaries are already on his trail ...
notes: From the evocative desert landscapes to the Himalayan snows, the hero's path of atonement is well articulated and the violence of this archaic world is mostly kept off-screen.

title: La chatte à deux têtes
actors: Frédéric Longbois, Jacques Nolot, Vittoria Scognamiglio, Olivier Torres, Sébastien Viala
description: In the red light cinema "La chatte à deux têtes" the patrons, including a group of regular transvestites, meet in the darkness of the room and participate in impromptu sexual encounters. Meanwhile, the cashier of Italian origins tells her life and her sentimental past to the young projectionist and a middle-aged customer.

title: Piñero
actors: Benjamin Bratt, Giancarlo Esposito, Talisa Soto, Nelson Vasquez, Rita Moreno, Mandy Patinkin
description: In 1970s New York, Miguel Piñero slowly made his way, later considered a precursor to rap and hip-pop. Jailed for drug dealing, the poet and playwright writes _Short Eyes_, an ambient drama in Sing Sing that leads him to critical and public success. Celebrity and coast-to-coast offers from Broadway to Hollywood are not enough for him to leave his past behind.
notes: Benjamin Bratt's performance is the only spark of vitality in an otherwise formulaic biopic, which tries in vain to revive the tale with a free video montage, but is instead irritating.

title: Columbo: Murder with Too Many Notes
actors: Peter Falk, Billy Connolly, Scott Atkinson, Hillary Danner
description: Finlay Crawford, Hollywood composer and conductor, kills a talented musician, who has been his ghostwriter in recent years and who composed the soundtrack of the last film for which he won an Oscar. Jealous of a talent that would have clouded his own, Crawford will have to deal with the intuitions of Lieutenant Colombo.

title: The Three Outlaws
actors: Neville Brand, Alan Hale, Bruce Bennett, Jeanne Carmen
description: Ready to leave their criminal lives, America's three greatest wanted men - Butch Cassidy, the Sundance Kid and Bill Carver - rob a last train and leave for Mexico. In retaliation, the bank where they deposit the money is robbed by El Gallo, a local thug. The three, on the verge of bankruptcy and at risk of deportation, thus make a new series of shots, designed in the style of El Gallo. An American detective arrives in search of the three and gets the help of El Gallo himself ...
notes: Typical 1950s "low budget" western, with little psychology but a lot of action: enjoyable at times.

title: A Thunder of Drums
actors: Richard Boone, George Hamilton, Luana Patten, Charles Bronson
description: Lieutenant McQuade is having trouble with the cavalry commander. The situation becomes complicated when he discovers that his old flame is now engaged to the captain.
notes: A subdued western that, however, manages to shine thanks to the excellent cast, above all Boone, and the precise direction of Joseph N. Newman.

title: Comando al infierno
actors: Guy Madison, Raffaella Carrà, Stan Cooper, Piero Lulli
description: The Commandos of the Maggiore Carter are sent to Germany to free Professor Van Kolstrom who, together with his daughter Sara, was captured by the Nazis to work on the formula of a bacteriological weapon that could overturn the course of the war. When Sergeant Nolan and the men of his dispersed patrol kill the raiders by mistake, the major requires them to continue the mission knowing that there is no longer time to organize another. Disguised as soldiers of the Wehrmacht, the Americans release Sara that the Germans are transferring to another prison and, together with her, reach the stronghold in which the scientist is prisoner.

title: Monnaie de singe
actors: Robert Hirsch, Sylva Koscina, Jean-Pierre Marielle, Jean Yanne, Alberto Closas
description: Baron Baullord and Lucille, two forgers, ask the painter Taupin to reproduce a five-hundred-franc note for them. The artist, unaware of the couple's hidden projects, creates a perfect fake for them that unleashes a scam and a long series of troubles. As the buddies get to safety, Taupin ends up locked up in jail. However, in his projects, in addition to escape, there is also the conquest of the love of the beautiful and dangerous Lucille ...
notes: From the novel _La veuve de Modane_ by Paul Chaland, this comedy does not pursue excessive artistic pretensions, but has on its side the vivacity of a pressing rhythm and the over-the-top acting of Robert Hirsch.

title: 7 Hyden Park - La casa maledetta
actors: Christina Nagy, David Warbeck, Carroll Blumenberg, Rossano Brazzi
description: Joanna has been paraplegic since she fell down the stairs to escape a priest who raped her. Married, nightmares take over. But it's not her past that traumatizes her.

title: Horror of the Blood Monsters
actors: John Carradine, Robert Dix, Vicki Volante, Joey Benson

title: 976-EVIL
actors: Stephen Geoffreys, Jim Metzler, Sandy Dennis, Robert Picardo

title: A cuore freddo
actors: Enrico Maria Salerno, Rada Rassimov, Colette Descombes, Giorgio Dolfin, Luciano Bartoli

title: Rustlers' Rhapsody
actors: G. W. Bailey, Tom Berenger, Marilu Henner, Andy Griffith

title: Africa ama
directors: Alfredo Castiglioni, Angelo Castiglioni, Guido Guerrasio, Oreste Pellini

title: Stranger Than Fiction
actors: Will Ferrell, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Dustin Hoffman, Queen Latifah
description: The universe of Harold, a tax agent, is shocked when he begins to hear a mysterious narrator who reports live on his life. This is Kay, a writer in decline struggling with her latest book which is the faithful description of Harold's life, for which she has foreseen a tragic epilogue.
notes: The idea is not bad, the Pirandello implications intriguing, the character in search of an author, played by the good Ferrell, spot on. The problem arises when the Swiss Marc Forster chooses as the register of the film that of the Hollywood sentimental comedy, which mortifies any glimmer of originality. A wasted opportunity.

title: All the King's Men
actors: Sean Penn, Jude Law, Kate Winslet, Patricia Clarkson, James Gandolfini, Mark Ruffalo, Anthony Hopkins
description: Willie Stark is an activist who fights for civil rights in Louisiana: thanks to his charisma and his ardor, he wins the trust of the people and reaches the position of governor of the state. But power turns him into a corrupt man, at ease in malpractice: journalist Jack Burden follows him step by step in his rise and becomes his close collaborator and confidant ...
notes: The remake of the homonymous film by Robert Rossen (1949) is a meaningless meatloaf, surpassed by history and current events. Zaillian - former director of _A Civil Action_ and established screenwriter (_Schindler's List_, _Gangs of New York_, _The Interpreter_) - makes a hole in the water.

title: Red Dust
actors: Jamie Bartlett, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Ian Roberts, Hilary Swank
description: Sarah, a New York prosecutor, returns to her native South Africa (where she was arrested at 16), to represent Alex and Steve, both tortured in 1986 by the police, whose officer has already been convicted of other crimes and is now seeking Alex's forgiveness. Steve in the meantime disappears ...
notes: Civil and procedural cinema where the attention to the characters and the skill of the performers (Bartlett, Swank and the promising Ejiofor) make the difference. Tom Hooper, first-time filmmaker on the big screen, comes from award-winning TV productions such as _Prime Suspect_ with Helen Mirren - who will win together with him every existing television award with _Elizabeth I_.

title: San Antonio
actors: Gérard Lanvin, Gérard Depardieu, Michel Galabru, Barbara Schulz
description: Due to a negligence of the usual Bérurier, San Antonio ends up in trouble with the superiors: even a super-beer like him can risk his job. But when the President of the Republic disappears, at Quai des Orfèvres all that remains is to turn to his best agent ...
notes: Unreleased in Italian cinemas (but later released on DVD with the title Spy Zone), this cinematic adventure from San Antonio - hero of the polar invented by the writer Frédéric Dard - unfortunately turns out to be an ordinary short film, which pursues the fake exoticism of old films with Belmondo. Depardieu is particularly disgusting (as Bérurier must be), while Lanvin remains a notable unspoken talent.

title: Pathfinder
actors: Karl Urban, Jay Tavare, Nathaniel Arcand, Wayne Baker
description: The only survivor of the shipwreck of a Viking expedition that came to raid the American coasts, a young man is adopted by a tribe of natives: nicknamed "Ghost" for his pale complexion, he grows up among them and becomes a brave warrior, making available of his new family his military skills. But when the Vikings return to wreak havoc among the peaceful people of the Wampanoag, he'll have to choose which people he really belongs to ...
notes: Patinated epic, full of slow motion and toned colors, steeped in mechanically stacked stereotypes. Remake of "The Ice Archer" (by Norwegian Nils Gaup) screaming for revenge.

title: Perfect Strangers
actors: Sam Neill, Rachael Blake, Joel Tobeck, Robyn Malcolm
description: Melanie, with her friends in a coastal New Zealand town, meets an extremely charming stranger. She decides to follow him to his home which turns out to be a fishing boat; the next morning, the boat leaves to head for a remote island. What began as a gallant outing turns to kidnapping, yet Melanie feels mysteriously drawn to the stranger ...
notes: Curiously hybridized thriller with a romantic story, Preston's film, while suffering from a plot that is intricately wrapped around twists that lead to fantasy, unleashes its own magnetic charm. Above all thanks to the performance of Sam Neill and the enveloping soundtrack.

title: The Last Command
actors: Sterling Hayden, Anna Maria Alberghetti, Richard Carlson, Ernest Borgnine, J.Carroll Nash, Ben Cooper
description: In the Alamo fortress, besieged by Mexican forces, Jim Bowie, along with other legendary heroes of the Texas War of Independence such as Davy Crockett and William Barret Travis, organizes the Texan resistance and falls fighting to the last.

title: Remo Williams: The Adventure Begins
actors: Fred Ward, Joel Grey, Wilford Brimley, Jon Polito, William Hickey, Patrick Kilpatrick
description: Escaping death, policeman Remo Williams is given a new identity and welcomed into an obscure anti-crime organization, secretly backed by the government. Transformed into a martial arts master, thanks to the training of the Korean Chiung, he will give a hard time to powerful and corrupt criminals.
notes: Guy Hamilton, director of the minor chapters of the James Bond saga, makes a crude and smashing film, which can be counted among the action _cult movies_ of the 80s. Enjoyable b-movie, _My name is Remo Williams_ mixes martial arts, crime and comics with high doses of humor. Inspired by_Destroyer_, a series of novels by Warren Murphy and Richard Sapir, he launched the icon _action_ Fred Ward.

title: La Cina è vicina
actors: Glauco Mauri, Elda Tattoli, Paolo Graziosi, Daniela Surina

title: Amami
actors: Moana Pozzi, Nadia Rinaldi, Tony Esposito, Victor Cavallo, Novello Novelli, Flavio Bucci
description: Anna is a very successful porn actress. However, her father Tullio is unaware of the profession and believes her to be a theater actress. When he finds out the truth, he will be deeply troubled.

title: So Evil My Love
actors: Ray Milland, Ann Todd, Geraldine Fitzgerald, Martita Hunt, Raymond Huntley

title: American Dreamer
actors: JoBeth Williams, Giancarlo Giannini, Tom Conti

title: American Gothic
actors: Rod Steiger, Yvonne De Carlo, Michael Pollard, Janet Wright

title: Hamlet
actors: Nicol Williamson, Judy Parfitt, Anthony Hopkins, Marianne Faithfull
description: Acceptable, a little "screamed" version of Shakespeare's tragedy.

title: Fright Night Part 2
actors: Roddy McDowall, Julie Carmen, William Ragdale, Jonathan Gries

title: Amo un assassino
actors: Umberto Spadaro, Delia Scala, Andrea J. Bosic, Marco Vicario
description: A woman falls down the stairs. Commissioner Pietrangeli, investigating his death, discovers that his daughter is the lover of the deceased's husband.

title: Stacy's Knights
actors: Kevin Costner, Andra Millian, Mike Reynolds, Ed Semenza

title: Horace 62
actors: Charles Aznavour, Giovanna Ralli, Raymond Pellegrin, Jean-Louis Trintignant

title: Arabella
actors: Virna Lisi, James Fox, Margaret Rutherford, Terry-Thomas

title: L'assassino... è al telefono
actors: Telly Savalas, Anne Heywood, Rossella Falk, Osvaldo Ruggieri

title: L'assoluto naturale
actors: Laurence Harvey, Sylva Koscina, Isa Miranda, Amalia Carrara
description: The natural absolute tells the chronicle of an impossible love story between a young photographer and a middle -aged woman from the Italian bourgeoisie. Taken from the novel of the same name by Goffredo Parise of 1967, it develops mainly in modernist interior abstracts and on sports machines launched on roads that seem not to take anywhere.
notes: Photography by Ennio Guarnieri and soundtrack composed of Ennio Morricone.

title: The Road to Hong Kong
actors: Bing Crosby, Bob Hope, Joan Collins, Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin
description: After Chester is wrong by mistake a secret formula, a series of misadventures begin for him and his friend Harry.
notes: Last chapter of the series of comic films _Road to ..._ the Crosby/Hope couple returns for the seventh time in this film full of gags. Joan Collins replaces Lamour.

title: Attentato ai tre grandi
actors: Ken Clark, Horst Frank, Jeanne Valerie, Carlo Hintermann, Howard Ross
description: In 1942 in Berlin #the German counterintelligence learns # of the meeting in Casablanca of Churchill, Roosevelt and De Gaulle. Consequently he decides to prepare an attack on the three politicians. Five German veterans parachuted near the city. Only three of these, with the help of Faddja, a local girl, manage to arrive at their destination, but the entire Allied command on alert is waiting for them.
